dkar chagakrung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun/ (1)can brtso brgyad ba bod skyod kyi gnas tshul ngo ma bkod pa/krang go hwa/(10)bod du dpung bskyod byed skabs dge stag sprul sku'i skor thos rtogs byung ba'i gnas tshul phran bu/ wang ku'e/(51)ngas dmag dpyang khrid de 'os langs byas pa'i rgyud rim/sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus/(73)nga mdo zhi'i las byar skyod skabs kyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhig cin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/(96)bod don zhi gros dang de'i snga rjes kyi gnas tshul skor/

phun tshogs dbang rgyal/(112)bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i sngon rjes su/ lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar/(146)bod skyod thog ma'i dus kyi 'tshams 'dri'i byed sgo zhig dran gso byas pa/ dbyin hpha thong /(174)gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa dang lag len bstar rgyu'i skor gyi gnas tshul/ lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar/(199)〈gros mthun 〉gzhir bzung bod kyi sbyi tshogs lam lugs gang ci legs bcos bya rgyu'i skor bka' shag nas rdzong gzhis khag la bkram pa'i rtsa tshig (213)krung dbyang sku tshab brang cin wu'u bod la thog mar phebs skabs ngas sne shan du bskyod pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhig zhol khang bsod nams dar rgyas/(225)bod kyi mi rigs dang mi dmangs 'od zer bde skyid kyi lam du bskyod pa/ krang cin wu'u/ (251)paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs la srung skyel zhus pa'i dran gso/ yā han krang /(262)2

bod mi rigs la bcings 'grol 'thob thabs kyi 'gro lam/ li lu'e han/(319)dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang /nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/(360)bod kyi mi rigs dar rgyas yong ba'i rlabs chen gyi kha phyogs 'gyur mtshams/ paṇa chen er ti ṇi chos kyi rgyal mtshan/(373)bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod ljongs yar rgyas dang mi dmangs la bde skyid yong 'go tshugs pa yin/bsam gling bsod nams stobs rgyas/(387)bod zhi bas bcings 'grol byung ba'i gnas tshul kho bo'i myong thog tu gang byung ba mdor bsdus tsam brjod pa/gser tshang phun tshogs bkra shis/(401)bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa'i snga rjes kyi mthong thos thor bu/ cin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/(429)bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas lo lnga bcu 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba dang chabs cig rang gi myong tshor zil thigs tsam gleng ba'i gtam/ ye shes 'phrin las/(444)bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa ni bod smongs sgo kun nas 'phur mchongs ngang gong 'phel 'gro ba'i lam tshad rdo ring zhig yin/ gling dbon pad ma skal bzang (461)3
bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nabar dran gso zhu/ lo ngo lnga bcu'i ring bod kyi sman rtsi yar zla'i dpal la 'gran pa'i smi

༄ga /krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun/bod kyi mi rigs ni krung go'i khongs gtogs kyi lo rgyus yun ring yod pa'i mi rigs gcig yin/ mi rigs gzhan dag mang po dang 'dra bar rang tsho'i rgyal khab chen po 'di ni gsar bzo dang gong 'phel gyi bya rim nang du rang 'gan gzi brjid can 'khur myong yang / nye lam lo ngo brgya lhag tsam nas phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab (dis go kru'u yis)kyi stobs shugs krung go'i nang du btsan 'dzul byas rkyen bod kyi sa gnas su yang btsan 'dzul byas te/ mgo g.yog dang dkrugs shing sna tshogs byas par ma zad/go min tang log spyod srid gzhung nas bod kyi mi rigs la sngon gyi log spyod srid gzhung dang 'dra bar mi rigs gnya' gnon dang /mi rigs dkrugs shing gi jus byus sngar mus bzhin du lag len byas gshis/ bod mi rigs nang khul mthun bsgril med par rgyab

'gal du song / bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung nas kyang phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi mgo g.yog dang dkrugs shing la ngo log ma byas par rang gi rgyal khab la yang sha zhen med pa'i byed stangs byung bas/ gnas tshul de dag gis bod kyi mi rigs dang / bod kyi mi dmangs gzhan gyi bran g.yog dang sdug bsngal tshabs chen gyi g.yangs su lhungs/ gcig stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i lor krung go'i mi dmangs bcings bkrol gyi dmag 'khrug rgyal khab yongs kyi sa khongs re gnyis ma gtogs gzhi rtsa'i rgyal kha lon stabs mi rigs so so thun mong dang nang gi spyi dgra go min tang log spyod srid gzhung gtor zin 'og mi rigs so so'i phyi yi spyi dgra phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi btsan gnon stobs shugs mtha' skyod btang ste gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gsar btsugs byas pa'i gtam bsgrags so// krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas krung go'i mi dmangs chab srid gros tshogs nas gtan la phab pa'i gung thung gang ling gzhir bzungs te/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab khongs gtogs kyi mi rigs thams cad 'dra mnyam thog phan tshun rogs ram mthun bsgril byas te phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab dang mi rigs so so'i nang gi mi dmangs kyi spyi dgra ngo rgol byed rgyu dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab 'di 2

nyid mi rigs tshang ma mdza' 'thun rogs 'brel gyi khyim tshang chen po zhig tu 'gyur rgyu/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mi rigs rnams kyi khyim tshang chen po'i nang du mi rigs grangs nyung so sos gcig tshogs sdod pa'i sa gnas su mi rigs kyi sa gnas rang skyong lag len byed rgyu dang / mi rigs grangs nyung so so nas rang rang gi skad cha yi ge gong 'phel byed rgyu dang / yul gyi goms pa'i gshis lugs dang / chos la dad pa bcas la srung 'dzin nam bcos bsgyur gang byed kyi rang dbang yod pa/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas mi rigs grangs nyung so so de dag gi chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ slob sbyong rnams yar rgyas kyi bya ba gong 'phel du gtong rgyu la rogs ram byed rgyu sogs kyi dril bsgrags byas/ de nas bzung rgyal khab nang gi mi rigs rnams bod dang tha'e wen gnyis kyi sa gnas ma gtogs tshang ma bcings bgrol byas zin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gcig bsgril 'go 'khrid dang / mi dmangs srid gzhung rim pa gong ma so so nas thad kur 'go 'khrid mdzad 'og tu mi rigs grangs nyung so sos mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang phun sum tshogs par longs su spyad par ma zad/ mi rigs kyi sa gnas rang skyong gi bya ba byas dang byed bzhin pa de ltar yod/ bod du yod pa'i phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi btsan gnon stobs shugs dang de'i nyes 3

skyon bcas bde blag tu bsal ba dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mnga' khul dang rang btsan gyi dbang cha gcig bsgril gyi bya ba 'grub par byed rgyu dang / rgyal khab srung skyob byas te bod kyi mi rigs dang / bod kyi mi dmangs bcings bkrol thob nas krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khyim tshang chen po'i nang du tshur log te/ rgyal khab nang gi mi rigs gzhan dag dang mtshungs par charigs 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang longs su spyod pa dang / rang gi chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ rig gnas slob sbyong bcas kyi las don gong 'phel du gtong ched krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bka' phab ste mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag dpung bod bskyod kyi skabs 'dir/ bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung nas krung dbyang la 'thus mi ched du btang nas gros mol thog bod zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun 'jog rgyu'i brda sprad pa bzhin/ gcig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga gcig lo'i zla bzhi ba'i mjug bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa pe cin rgyal sar 'byor bstun/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'thus mi 'phral du bsko gzhag gnang ste/ bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa dang lhan du mdza' mthun gyi gzhi rtsa bzung nas bka' mol gnang zhing / bka' mol gnang ba'i 'bras bu la 4

phyogs gnyis ma'i blo rtse mthun te/ gros mthun 'di nyid bzhag par ma zad/ de don lag len du mngon par bstar ba'i 'gan len rgyu/dang po/ bod kyi mi dmangs rnams mthun bsgril byas te phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi btsan shugs bod nas mthar skrod gtong dgos/ bod kyi mi dmangs krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mes po'i rgyal khab khyim tshang chen po'i nang log dgos/gnyis pa/ mi dmangs bcings bgrol dmag bod du bskyod de rgyal khab brtan por srung rgyu la bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung nas rogs ram lhur len byed rgyu/gsum pa/ krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros tshogs kyi gung thung kyang ling gi mi rigs srid byas gzhir bzung ste/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas gcig bsgril gyi 'go khrid 'og bod kyi mi dmangs la mi rigs kyi sa gnas rang skyong lag len byed rgyu'i dbang cha yod/bzhi pa/ bod kyi chab srid lam lugs da mus la krung dbyang gis bcos bsgyur mi byed par/ tā la'i bla ma'i sngar yod go gnas dang dbang cha yang krung dbyang nas bsgyur bcos mi byed/ dpon rigs mtho dman rnams kyang sngar bzhin gnas rgyu/lnga pa/ paṇa chen er ti ni'i sngar yod go gnas dang 5

dbang cha rang 'jags gnas dgos/drug pa/ tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen er te ni'i sngar yod go gnas dang dbang cha zhes pa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / paṇa chen er te ni sku phreng dgu pa mthun po'i skabs kyi go gnas dang dbang cha/bdun pa/ krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros tshogs kyi gung thung kyang ling nang thag bcad pa'i chos lugs la dad pa rang mos byas chog pa'i srid byus la lag len byas te/ bod kyi mi dmangs kyi chos lugs la dad pa dang / yul gyi goms pa'i gshis lugs sogs la brtsi 'dzin byed rgyu dang / dgon pa gra tshang la srung skyobs byed rgyu/ dgon pa gra tshang gi yong sgor krung dbyang nas bsgyur bcos mi byed/brgyad pa/ bod kyi dmag sgar rim gyis bcings bgrol dmag la tshur bsgyur nas krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal khab srung ba'i drag shugs khag gcig tu bsgrub rgyu/dgu pa/ bod kyi gnas tshul dngos yod gzhir bzung ste rim gyis bod rigs kyi skad cha dang / yi ge/ slob grwa'i slob sbyong bcas gong 'phel gtong rgyu/bcu pa/ bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul gzhir bzung ste rim gyis bod kyi so nam dang / 'brog las/ bzo rigs/ tshong 6

las rnams gong 'phel du btang nas mi dmangs kyi lto gos sogs je legs su gtong rgyu/bcu gcig pa/ bod kyi lam lugs sna tshogs legs bcos byed rgyu'i skor la krung dbyang nas btsan shed kyis mi byed par/bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung rang nas legs bcos byed rgyu dang /mi dmangs nas legs bcos byed dgos zhu dus/ bod kyi 'go byed rnams dang gros bsdur gyi thabs shes la brten nas thag gcod rgyu/bcu gnyis pa/ sngar phan phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab dang go min tang la nye 'brel byed pa'i dpon rigs nas/ phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab dang go min tang dang 'brel thag mthar phyin pa bcad de/ da phyin ngo log dang skyon gnod ma byas na las tshan rang 'jags byed chog par sngar byas la brtsad gcod mi byed/bcu gsum pa/ bod bskyod kyi mi dmangs bcings bgrol dmag gis gong gsal don tshan rnams kyi srid byus la srung brtsi byed rgyu ma zad/ nyo tshong drang bzhag mi dmangs kyi khab skud tsam yang gang byung mi len/bcu bzhi pa/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bod kyi sa gnas su byung ba'i phyi 'brel gyi las don mtha' dag gcig bsgril gyi sgo nas byed rgyu dang / 'dra mnyam gnyis phan/7

phan tshun gyi mnga' khul dang rang btsan gyi dbang cha la brtsi 'jogs thog nye 'dabs rgyal khab dang zhi mthun gyis gnas rgyu ma zad/ drang 'brel gyi tshong las 'dzugs rgyu dang gong 'phel du gtong rgyu/bco lnga pa/ gros mthun 'di nyid lag len du bstar ba'i 'gan len phyir/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bod la dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang sa gnas dmag sgar gyi dmag spyi khang 'dzugs rgyu dang / krung dbyang nas btang ba'i las byed ma tshad/ bod khul gyi las byed yang gang mang rug ste las ka byed rgyu/dmag srid u yon lhan khang nang 'gro mi rnams bod kyi sa gnas srig gzhung dang / yul phyogs so so/ dgon pa gtso che bcas nas rgyal khab la sha zhen yod pa/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bskos pa'i 'thus mi dang / gnad yod kyi phyogs tshang ma mnyam gros thog nas ming tho phul te krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la bsko gzhag gnang ba zhu rgyu/bcu drug pa/ dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang / sa gnas dmag spyi dang / bod bskyod kyi mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag bcas kyi 'gro song krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas gtong rgyu/ bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung nas mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag la 'bru dang / gzhan yang nyer mkho sgrub rgyu/8

bskyel 'dren bcas la rogs ram byed rgyu/bcu bdun pa/ gros mthun 'di nyid ming rtags bkod 'phral rtsa bar bzung ste lag len byed rgyu/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa/gartso bo 'thus mi/ rlis wun han/'thus mi/ krang cin u/krang go hwa/sung kri yon/bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yodapa/gartso bo 'thus mi/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/'thus mi/ khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/thub bstan bstan dar/thub bstan legs smon/bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub/1951lo'i zla 5tshes 23la pe cin/9

can bco brgyad pa bod skyod kyi gnas tshul ngo ma bkod pa/krang go hwa/gcig950lo'i zla ba dang por lho nub yongs rdzogs bcings 'grol gtong ba'i dmag 'thab mjug 'gril ma thag nga tsho'i cun gyis mu mthud nas bod ljongs bcings 'grol gtong bar dpung skyod byed pa'i gzi brjid kyi las 'gan dang len zhus pa yin/ bod ni mes rgyal gyi cha shas shig dang bod ljongs mi dmangs ni rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi gras shig red/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug de rgyal yongs la rgyal kha'i phyogs su khyab gdal 'gro ba'i skabs lo brgya phrag nang rang rgyal gyi bod ljongs stangs 'dzin byed mkhan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs dang /phyi rgyal gyi log spyod shog kha/ bod du yod pa'i kho tsho'i rgyug khyi bcas skrag nas bla 'dar zhing / kho pa tshos brel brel tshub tshub ngang bod rang btsan zer ba zhig rdzun bzo byas nas bod kyi mi dmangs mes rgyal dang kha bral du btang ste ji srid bar kho pa tsho'i bran g.yog tu bkol rgyu'i re ngan bcang gi yod/ nga 0

tsho'i tang gis gnyin mo'i rmi lam gtong mkhan de dag la snga tshud nas go brda gsal po sprad zin pa ste/ ma'o kru'u zhis chab srid gros mol tshogs 'du gsar pa'i gra sgrig tshogs chen thog gnang ba'i gsung bshad nang 'dzam gling yongs la brjid nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas ༷krung gor nges par du rang btsan dgos pa dang krung go nges par du bcings 'grol gtong dgos/ krung go'i don dag ni nges par du krung go'i mi dmangs rang nyid kyi 'dod mos ltar rang gis thag gcod byed dgos pa las/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab ci 'dra zhig gis kyang the jus spu tsam byed du 'jug gi min zhes khyab bsgrags gnang ba red/'on kyang log spyod stobs shugs ni rang 'gul gyis lo rgyus kyi gar stegs nas phyir 'then byed mi srid/ lo ngo mig stong lhag tsam nang bod ni chos srid zung 'brel gyi mnga' bdag gzhis ma'i lam lugs yin pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran spyi tshogs shig red/ mi dmangs tshos mun nag gi zhing bran gyi 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod cing / thon skyed rgyu cha rnams bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid gzhung dang / dgon pa/ sku drag bcas mnga' bdag chen po gsum la dbang gi yod/ de'ang gsal por bshad na zhing bran bdag po chen po gsum gyi lag tu bzung yod/ bran g.yog tshor chab srid kyi dbang cha spu tsam yang med pa dang spyir btang mi lus kyi rang dbang tsam yang med/ bod la dbang sgyur byed mkhan log spyod stobs shugs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de sra brtan du gtong ched cung che ba'i dgon sde dang sku drag gi khyim tshang mar btson khang btsugs te rgyun ldan rta lcag gzhus pa phud/ da dung mig ril 'don pa dang / sna khug 'breg pa/ rting rtsa gcod pa/ pus mo'i lha nga bkog pa sogs thos pa tsam gyis skrag snang skye ba'i khrims gcod drag po sna /1

tshogs gtong gi yod/ o'u gling gi dus rabs bar ma'i rjes lus can dang /mun nag can/ log spyod can/ gdug rtsub can bcas las kyang ngan pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs des bod ljongs mi dmangs sdug bsngal gyi g.yang du bskyur bar brten bod mi dmangs tshos nyin mtshan kun tu bcings 'grol 'thob rgyu'i re sgug byed bzhin du gnas yod/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes bod ljongs rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs tsho'i sems la krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod ljongs bcings 'grol gtong ched drang bden gyi dmag dpung mgyogs gtong yong ba'i re ba de bas kha tsha por gyur/ skabs der mtsho sngon du bzhugs pa'i paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis kyang ma'o kru'u zhi dang spyi khyab si ling kru'u ter rlung 'phrin phul te krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu dang bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs tsho'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi re ba der thugs yid mthun pa'i rtags mtshan bstan gnang ba red/ ma'o kru'u zhis sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i nang lhung ba'i bod ljongs mi dmangs la thog mtha' bar gsum du thugs 'khur ha cang chen po gnang ste paṇa chen er te ṇir rlung 'phrin bka' lan stsal ba'i nang sna krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod kyi mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo de skong thub nges yin/ bod kyi rgyal gces mi sna yongs rdzogs kyis thun mong thog 'bad brtson byas nas bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyu dang rgya bod mi dmangs kyi mthun sgril gyi ched du 'bad 'thab gnang rgyu'i re ba byed bzhin du yod7ces gsungs yod/skabs der bod ljongs gcig pu ma gtogs mes rgyal skam sa chen po tshang 12

ma bcings 'grol btang zin cing / bod kyi mi dmangs bcings 'grol gtong ched dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod nas mtha' skyod btang ste mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur dang lho nub mtha' snye mtshams sra brtan du gtong ba/ rlabs chen gyi mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug de mthar phyin pa byed rgyu bcas kyi ched du si ling yon li'u po khren dang / ho'o lung / chab srid u yon teng zha'o phing bcas nas nga tshor ma'o kru'u zhi'i mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i mdzub ston brgyud bsgrags gnang byung /ma'o kru'u zhi mchog gis bod kyi khyad chos la dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang ba dang bod kyi rnyog 'dzing che ba'i lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dang chab srid kyi rnam par tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye zhib gnang ste nga tsho bod du dpung skyod byed mkhan gyi dmag dpung la nan tan ngang tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus lag len bstar rgyu dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don legs sgrub byas te mtho rim mi snar brtson len byed rgyu/mang tshogs tshor shugs rkyen bzang po thebs su 'jug pa dang mthun sgril byed rgyu/ rgyal gces khrims srung gi dgon sde la srung skyong byed rgyu/ chos dad rang mos dang yul srol goms gshis la brtsi 'jog bcas byed dgos khar/ mi rigs kyi mthun sgril dam zab byas nas mthun sgril byed thub pa'i rgyal gces stobs shugs yod tshad la mthun sgril gyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang de'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi rgyug khyi ste btsan nye kha bral ring lugs par nus shugs gcig sdud kyis rdung deg gtong dgos zhes bka' slob gnang yod/ gtso 'dzin tshos nga tsho'i cun gyis dka' sdug che zhing gal 'gangs che ba'i khur po de legs par 'khur te ma'o kru'u zhi'i mdzub ston lag len mthar phyin pa bstar /3

rgyu de la nga tshos bod du bcings 'grol dpung skyod bya rgyur thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i don snying ldan yod cing / bod du bskyod rgyu de gsal por bshad na srid jus la brten nas gom pa spo rgyu dang srid jus la brten nas lto za rgyu de red/ srid jus ni srog rtsa yin pas nges par du mang tshogs dang 'brel ba dam zab byed dgos pa dang mang tshogs la brten dgos/ yang dag pa'i srid jus la brten nas krung go dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi log spyod shog kha'i 'dre gtam gyi smug pa gtsang sil bzo rgyu dang / lo rgyus thog nas lhag bsdad pa'i mi rigs kyi 'gal zla dang 'khon 'dzin rtsa med bzos nas khams bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs dang rgyal gces mi sna rnams btsan rgol rgyal /ce) zu ga /chen 1(1lha)(31( /sde/ /bye/ the / lha)(ga sa kya dar cha na ga tu mthun la da thub pa da sa rgyu bka' slob gnang byung /krung gung lho nub cus dang lho nub dmag khul khang gis bod ljongs bcings 'grol gtong rgyur dpung skyod byed pa'i chab srid kyi skul slong bka' rgya khyab bsgrags gnang rjes si ling yon ho'o lung sku ngo mas dpung skyod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig gi las don 'gan bzhes gnang zhing / cun yongs kyi dpung sdes gcig gyur thog rtsa 'dzugs la bcos sgrig byed pa dang / skul slong gi slob gso gting zab rgyag pa/ dpung sde chen po rdog thon gong sngon 'gro'i yan lag dpung sde zhig ched gtong gis lam bar du brtag dpyad zhib 'jug dang srid jus dril bsgrags byas nas dngos gzhi'i gtso shugs dpung sde'i ched du 'gro lam bshang rgyu bcas dang / bod skyod dpung sder dngos po mkho 'don byed rgyur 'gan srung byed ched lho nub dmag khul khang gis dpung sder skul slong dang 'brel lam seng rogs skyor si ling pu'u zhig btsugs te las dmag dang /

dmag mkho'i yo byad mkho sgrub dpung sde/ mkha' dmag dpung sde bcas skong 'then gyis lam bzo dang skyel 'dren gyi las 'gan 'khur ba red/ dpung sde'i drag shugs dang 'gul skyod kyi nus par shugs snon rgyag ched spun zla'i dpung sde khag gis spro sems ha cang chen pos mtshon cha yag shos dang rta drel yag shos nga tshor rgyab skyor gnang byung / sa mtho'i khor yug dang gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ldog la 'tshams thabs byed ched nga tsho'i dpung sdes da dung dus tshod dam 'dzin byas nas dpung skyod dang / dmas rgyag 'tsho ba'i bdag gnyer bcas kyi sbyong brdar byas te 'tsho ba sa mtho can dang khams bod can du 'gyur rgyu'i mi 'bod tshig bton pa red/ tang gi thugs 'khur gzab bzhes dang / spun zla'i dpung sde/ de bzhin rgyal yongs mi dmangs bcas kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i rgyab skyor 'og nga tsho'i cun yongs kyis bod du dpung skyod byed pa'i gra sgrig gi las don khag bde blag ngang legs sgrub zin pa red//950lo'i dpyid kur rgyal yongs su dmag 'khrug rnam par rgyal ba'i 'bod sgra'i khrod du cun yongs kyis spro nyams chen po'i sgo nas rlabs chen gyi lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpung skyod byed 'go btsugs shing / dpung sdes nyin bgrod mtshan sdod dang la brgyab chu bcad kyi rkang thang mar le dbar tshig stong lhag tsam bskyod rjes dkar mdzes la 'byor/ lung pa de ni de snga nga tshos rgyang skyod byed skabs 'thab phyogs dmag dpung gnyis pa dang bzhi pa mnyam 'dzoms byed sa zhig yin zhing / skabs der dmar dmag gis tang gi mthun sgril 'dra mnyam gyi mi rigs srid jus nan tan gyis lag len bstar ba'i dbang gis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul bde blag ngang bgrod pa dang rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs la shin tu zab pa'i shugs rkyen bzang po zhig bzhag pa red//5

skabs de'i dkar mdzes bod pa srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khur mkhan rgyal gces pa dge rtag sprul skus nga tsho mthong ma thag spro sems chen po'i ngang shar rer tshoms chen nang gdan drangs pa ma zad/ lam seng rtswa dang 'bru rigs gra sgrig byed mi yang ched mngags btang song / rang nyid spyi khyab si ling kru'u te dang spun grogs yin zer mkhan sprul sku des gad mo dgod bzhin du lha med smra ba khyed rnam pa yang bskyar phebs byung / 'on kyang lha yod smra ba ngas spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang khyed rnam par dga' bsu dang brtsi bkur zhu gi yin zhes gsungs/ ri 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs su khong gis ched mngags mi btang ste mtsho sngon zhing chen nas pā lu'u cun gyis hran shis su dmag 'thab byed pa'i sa bkra zhig nyos pa de da lta'ang tshoms chen nang du bkal 'dug khong gis chos sgrom gyi nang nas lo mang ring nyar tshags gzab nan byas pa'i dmar dmag gi bka' rgya dang sbyar tshig sogs bton te dga' spro chen po'i ngang skabs de'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rang khyim rang bdag byed pa'i dmangs gtso'i 'tsho ba spyod tshul skor gleng skabs khong gi bzhin ras kyi thog nas dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs rab tu rgyas shing / 'on te bod kyi ya nga ba'i gnas tshul skor gleng skabs yid skyo nas rang dbang med par spyan chab shor bzhin ma'o kru'u zhi mchog gis dmag dpung ched gtong ma gnang na nga tsho bod kyi mi rigs de rtsa med du 'gro la nye ba 'dug ces gsungs pa dang sku gzan gyis spyan chab phyis thog shar phyogs su zhal gtad nas thal mo sbyar te smon lam btab song /skabs der krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i don du lha sa'i dbang 'dzin las khungs la pe cin du gros 6

mol byed rgyur 'thus mi gtong dgos pa'i brda tho thengs mang btang rung kho pa tshos mjug ma nam mkha'i dbyings su btegs te dbyin me btsan rgyal ring lugs dang phyi rgyal gyi log spyod shog kha'i ngan skyor la rgyab rten bcol te dmag don gyi stobs shugs thog nas nga tshos bod du bcings 'grol dpung skyod byed pa 'gog rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa red/ dge rtag sprul skus lha sar kha ta slob gso byed par 'gro rgyu'i re ba bton pa ltar ser skya'i 'thus mi mi sna 'ga' zhig sne khrid de dar cha dmar po zhig bsgrengs bzhin du rdog thon gyis gar slebs sar mi dmangs srid gros kyi thun mong rtsa 'dzin nang gi mi rigs srid jus dang rang dmag gi sgrig khrims dam po yod lugs sogs dril bsgrags byas/khong chab mdor slebs ma thag log spyod mi sna'i mgo skor gyi dra rgya'i nang tshud cing / log spyod pa tshos zhi drag gnyis spyod kyis khong phyogs gcig nas bzang btson du 'jog pa dang phyogs gcig nas dbyin ji'i gsang myul phu'u the zer ba ngo mas dge rtag sprul skur sne len gyis khong la gung khran tang ni chos lugs rtsa med gtong mkhan red ces khas len du bcug rung / de'i lan du dge rtag sprul skus ngas shes pa la gung khran tang gis mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi 'dod tshul 'dzin pa dang / chos dad rang mos la srung skyob/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshes la brtsi 'jog bcas byed kyi 'dug de ni lo bcu lhag tsam gyi gong la'ang 'di 'dra red ces gsungs/ sprul skus bka' mol dngos don gsungs pa dang drang bden gsung stabs mthar dug ster nas bkrongs pa red/ don de rgyal yongs su grags rjes bod kyi mi dmangs dang rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi khong khro ha cang chen po bslang ba red/ de'i rjes su slar yang 'khrug rkyen gsar pa zhig byung zhing / nga tsho'i dpung sde khams byang /7

phyogs kyi rdzogs chen sa khul du slebs skabs nye 'khor gyi dgon pa zhig nas glo bur du cong sgra bsgrags ma thag lus la phyu pa dmar po dang mgo la wa zhwa gyon pa'i mi khyu zhig go mtshon dang bcas rta bzhon nas ri sgang gcig gi steng du 'dzegs thog dung 'bud bzhin grwa pa dang mang tshogs mang por ngan slong byas nas nga tshor kha gtad de me mda' brgyab byung / 'thab 'dzing pa tshos sa mtho'i steng gi stag rgod ltar gang mthug po'i khrod nas mchongs phyin te gzan dmar po gyon pa'i bkod 'doms byed mkhan 'go pa de gson bzung gis 'khrid yong skabs kho ni mtho rim bla ma'i chas gos cha tshang gyon yod na'ang /don du mes rgyal nang sa'i hri ca krong gi rgya mi zhig yin pa dang go min tang gi gsang myul 'go gtso khren li phu'i blos thub cig red 'dug cang ce hres lho nub sa khul chen po bcad bzung byed pa'i gnyid lam skyid po de thor grabs yod skabs khams bod du rjes 'brangs jag pa khag gcig ched gtong gis sa gnas de ga'i mtho rim gyi log spyod stobs shugs dang ngan 'brel byas nas nges med rgol 'thab kyi rten gzhi zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa ma zad/chab mdo dang lha sa sogs sa gnas su go min tang dmag ud gsang myul las khungs kyi yan lag babs tshugs kyang btsugs pa red/ bod ming la ga'aphrin chen zer ba'i nges med rgol 'thab ru khag gi si ling de'i ngos len byas par gzhigs na /949lo'i dgun dus nas a ri ba dang dbyin ji ba khag gcig lha sa'i dbang sgyur las khungs kyi zhi chas sprad pa'i drag chas mi sna'i srung skyong 'og kha ba dang rlung chen gyi khrod nas 'khyar re 'khyor re ngang 'bri chu brgal nas 'byor yod pa red/ kho pa tsho dgon pa'i nang yib tu bcug ste dgon pa'i rnga dang cong sgra la brten nas mang tshogs ngan skul gyis rang re'i dmag dpung /8

bod skyod kyi 'gro lam bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i las 'gan bkod sgrig byas 'duga'on kyang nga tshos yang dag pa'i srid jus la brten nas mdun skyod kyi 'gro lam bshang stabs dgra bo'i lkog g.yo ngan jus pham nyes su phyin pa red/ 949lo'i dbyar khar bod kyi log spyod shog khas dbyin a btsan rgyal ring lugs dang nyin thu'i ne ru srid gzhung gi ngan skyor 'og gung rgol byed par khag btags nas bod du yod pa'i rgya mi rnams phyir 'bud byas/ de nas bzung bod kyi log spyod shog khas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi thad ku'i jus bkod 'og dmag dpung rgya skyed btang ba dang dmag grabs hur thag byas shing / sngar yod mda' dpon gyi dmag sgar bcu bzhi yod pa nas mda' dpon gyi dmag sgar bcu bdun bar rgya che ru btang ba ma zad/ phyi rgyal nas mtshon cha 'bor chen dang / a ri rlung 'phrin 'phrul chas nang 'dren dang dbyin ji'i dmag don dge rgan ched 'bod kyis sa gnas khag gi bod dmag skong 'then dang dmag sbyong byas pa ma zad/ dgon de khag la rang dmag la dmigs nas gtor rgyag rgyag pa'i bka' rgya yang btang / nga tsho dpung skyod byed pa'i gom sgra bsgrags pa na kho pa tsho sngar bas brel tshub chen po langs nas gsang brda bskur ba dang bkod 'doms 'brel gtugs byas nas bod dmag khag gcig mnga' ris dang nag chu sa khul du bzhag pa phud/ dmag rgyag rgyur blo khog dang 'jon thang yod skad dang dbyin me'i drag chas spras pa'i ga dang /ta dang / tha dang sogs mda' khag bdun gyi dmag sgar yongs rdzogs dang de min mda' khag gsum gyi dmag sgar cha shas bcas chab mdo'i rgyud du bkrams te rang byung gi btsan 'gag 'bri chur brten nas rang dmag dpung skyod kyi gom stabs de gar spo mtshams 'jog tu 'jug dgos bsams pa red/ /9

nai ba'i gros mol byed pa'i rgya sgo de log spyod shog khas dam por brgyab rjes thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i dmag don gyi bya spyod cig ste chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed ni g.yol thabs med par gyur/gnyis/chab mdo ni bod ljongs shar ngos kyi 'gag sgo lta bu dang rang re'i dmag dpung bod skyod byed pa'i dbugs lam zhig yin la mes rgyal sa mtho'i steng gi dmag jus rang bzhin ldan pu'i mdo 'gag cig kyang yin gshis/ snga dus nas dmag don thog gi brtson len bya yul zhig red/ dgra po'i dmag don gyi jus bkod la gzhigs nas rang dmag gis phul byung gi dmag shugs gcig sdud kyis phyogs bzhi nas dgra bo'i mtha' bskor te yongs rdzogs rtsa med bzo ba las dra ba nas gcig kyang mi shor ba byed dgos pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i mdzub khrid kyi rtsa don gzhir bzung nas dpung sde khyon yongs tshogs khag gnyis su bgos te bya spyod spel zhing / dpung tshogs byang ma de hri lnga bcu nga gnyis pa dang / cun gyi myul zhib ying / me skyogs ying / de bzhin nub byang dmag khul gyi rta dmag yan lag ru khag bcas las grub pa zhig yin pa de ni rang dmag gi gtso shugs tshogs pa yin/ rta dmag yan lag ru khag de dang rkang dmag thon gcig gis ri bo che mtha' bskor nas dgra bo'i g.yon ngos rgyab dpung gtor rgyu dang / rngan mda' bzung ste nub phyogs brgyud phyir bros byed mkhan dgra bo'i 'gro lam 'gog rgyu/ dmag dpung thon gzhan gnyis kyis 'dan khog nas gsang thabs kyis 'bri chu brgal te shar rgyag chab mdo len rgyu dang / myul zhib ying dang me skyogs ying gnyis kyis 'bri chu'i mdun ngos nas 2()

phar rgol bya rgyu'i las 'gan 'khur rgyu byas/ dpung tshogs lho ma ni hri lnga bcu nga gsum pa dang yun nan dmag khul gyi dpung sde'i thon gcig la sa grub yod cing / gtso shugs kyis pa an nas 'bri chu brgal te sma ra khams dang thun mdo brgyud dgra bo'i g.yas ngos rgyab dpung gi mtha' bskor rgyu dang / sgom mda' bzung ste dgra bo lho nub nas lha sar bros pa'i 'gro lam 'gog rgyu ma zad/rdza yul du 'bros sa'ang 'gog rgyu red/ yin na'ang bod ljongs sa mthor gnam gshis dang / sa bab khor yug dgra bo'i gnas tshul sogs dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul sna tshogs yod pa phud/ dgra bo'i 'gog srung bi lam thig gcig pur cha mtshon rung 'bri chu'i mdun ngos nas le dbar chig stong lhag tsam gyi sa yod cing / 'bri chu'i 'gram nas chab mdo bar la'ang le dbar bdun brgya lhag tsam gyi 'gro lam yod pa red/ lung pa gzhi rgya chen po 'di lta bu yod pa dang dgra dmag la sa dbyibs rgyus mnga' yod pa'i thog 'gro rgyugs 'pher po yod pa des rang dmag ni stag gis sbrang bu bzung ba ltar dgra bo 'gog bzung bya rgyu khag po yod/ der brten lho nub dmag khul khang bi gtso 'dzin gyis phyi phyogs thag ring nas mtha' chen po bskor te dgra bo bzung thub na rgyal kha 'thob rgyu yin pa dang mgyogs myur bskyod thub na dgra bo bzung thub ces mdzub ston gnang byung / chab mdo'i g.yu la 'gyed ni bod ljongs bcings 'grol gtong bar thag gcod kyi don snying ldan pa'i dmag 'thab cig yin zhing / nga tshos dpung sde khag la dgra bor tshor snang mi yong ched gsang thabs kyis mdun du skyod dgos pa'i bka' btang ba yin/ mdun ngos nas phar rgol gyi las 'gan 'khur mkhan rang re'i dngu nga sdes dmag rgyag 'bo tshugs zin na'ang dgra bo ni da dung rmi lam gtong bzhin yod/ kho pa tsho'i 3/

bsam par rang re'i dmag dpung lam thag ring po nas 'ongs pas ngal dub chen po yod pa dang / sa chu ma 'phrod pa sogs kyi rkyen pas gshog pa yod kyang 'bri chu nas thar mi thub bsam nas kho pa tshos dbyin ji'i zangs dung rol cha 'bud bzhin par 'bri chu'i rgyud la 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byed/ rang dmag gis mdun ngos nas dgra bo hril po'i do snang bya yul 'khrul du 'jug phyir tshur 'then pas khag bgos kyis dgra bo rub gtor bya rgyur dus tshod thob thub pa byung zhing / 'on kyang dus tshod ni sngar bzhin ha cang dza drag yod pas 'gag sgo 'ga' shas dang lhag par du lho nub kyi 'gag sgo de myur 'gog byed ma thub na dgra dmag gi gtso shugs de ga dus yin rung bros su shor srid/der brten 'bri chu brgal zin pa'i rang re'i dpung sde khag gis ngal dub gang la'ang ma 'dzems par shugs drag chen pos rjes 'ded gtong ba dang mgyogs myur du snyeg rdung byed dgos kyi yod/ dpung sde khag gis nyin rer le dbar brgya dang nyi shu nas brgya dang bdun bcu'i bar nyin mtshan med par shugs drag chen pos rjes 'ded btang / la las phyogs gcig nas dmag rgyag pa dang phyogs gcig nas rjes 'ded btang zhing / la las phyogs gcig nas rjes 'ded gtong ba dang phyogs gcig nas dmag brgyab/ la las rbad de dgra bo bskyur nas thad mar dgra bo'i rgyab phyogs su 'dzul ba red/ sa mthor skabs re bu yug 'tshub cing skabs re char 'bab rlung ldang sogs gnam gshis 'gyur ldog che ba'i khar/ mkha' rlung srab pa dang nyi 'od 'tsher che ba'i khrod dpung sde rtag tu rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre bzhi stong yan gyi gangs dkyil du rgyugs dgos pa dang / gangs ri 'jogs shing / rtswa thang sgrol ba/'khyags rom thebs pa'i gtsang chu brgal ba/ nags tshal stug po dang grog 22

rong brgyud pa/ brag ri'i 'phrang lam sogs su bskyod de dmag yongs nas dgra bo zungs shig dgra bo skor cig gcig kyang bros su ma 'jug cig ces gcig gyur gyis 'bod sgra sgrog bzhin chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha yongs su 'thob rgyur brtson len byed kyi yod pa red/rang re'i dpung sde khag gis le dbar stong gi mtha' bskor chen po'i dpung skyod byed ring gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig gi 'og tu yang dang thog mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus la bsam blo gtong thub pa byed dgos pa'i skor gyi ma'o kru'u zhi dang dmag khul gtso 'dzin gyi mdzub ston sems la brtan por bcangs bzhin yod/ dpung 'jug gi lam bar du rang re'i dpung sde khag gis bu yug chen po'i nang dang / gnag cing thibs pa'i smag rum gyi khrod dam/ yang na ser bas mgo dang gdong par brdung ba dang char pas lus yongs rlon kyang bzos pa'i skabs su'ang dgon pa dang mi dmangs kyi sdod khang nang du mi 'dzul ba dang / mang tshogs kyi rtswa shing rkang gcig dang khab skud gcig kyang len gyi med/ 'thab 'dzing pa tsho grod pa ltogs dus gro zhib rngos ma phor pa gang mi kha shas la bgo bsha' brgyab nas zos pa dang gangs chu hub gang do re 'thung ba las mang tshogs kyi sa nas 'bru rigs til 'bru tsam yang len gyi med pa red/ rang dmag gis grong tsho gang du slebs rung sngon la yul gyi goms srol skad cha 'dri ba dang / sa gnas gang du 'byor rung brtag dpyad zhib 'jug dang chab srid dril bsgrags byed kyi yod/bod rigs mi dmangs kyi dar lcog dang / mchod rten/ gnas ri/ lha shing /rdo phung sogs dang / chos lugs kyi skrun dngos yod tshad dang yul srol goms gshis la srung brtsi dang srung skyob byas pas bod rigs mi dmangs tsho'i mdun 2 ṭwāṃ

du gnam sa gsar pa zhig btod pa red/ khong tshos mi rabs nas mi rabs bar mthong thos ma myong ba'i rgya mi gsar pa 'byor rjes ri khug tu bros phyin nga/'i bod rigs spun zla rnams gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis log yong ba dang rang dmag ni brel 'tshab kyi sgo nas khong tsho dang kha gyes te mu mthud mdun du skyod skabs sems rtsa 'khol zhing bsam pa rnam dag gi spun zla bod rigs pho mo tshos dpung sde'i rjes su snyeg ste la las lha dmag lha dmag ces dga' 'bod byed pa dang / la la sa re 'dun bton nas rang 'gul gyis nga tshor lam 'khrid byed pa/ la las jag dmas gis gtor bshig btang ba'i zam pa dang 'gro lam nyams gso byed rogs byed pa/ da dung khong tshos mgo skor 'og tshud pa dang / btsan khrid byas pa'i rang dmag la dgra 'dzin byed myong ba'i bod rigs bu phrug rnams 'tshang kha shig shig gis tshur 'bod pa so gas byas pa red/ pho rgod gcig gis 'gan srung na/ dpa' bo khri phrag thar pa dka' zhes pa ltar la rtse dang btsan 'gag bzung ste rang dmag mdun du skyod par bkag 'gog byed mkhan ser dmag mang pos gcig rjes gnyis 'brangs kyis dpung pa'i steng gi me mda'i kha sar spubs nas phyir log yong ba red/ khong tshos rgya gsar pa de 'drar me mda' brgyab na lha'i bka' chad phog gi red ces zer/ mi rnams kyis bden don su'i phyogs su yod med mthong thub pa ma zad 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam yang mthong thub pa red/lho ngos nas yong mkhan rang re'i dpung sdes sngo chu gtsang 'gram gyi brag g.yab tu thengs gcig la kho tshos mgo skor dang btsan khrid byas pa'i yul dmag yin zer ba'i mi grangs lnga brgya lhag tsam zhig gi mgo btags blangs pas mtshon nyin bcu lhag tsam nang yul dmag dang ser dmag sum stong lhag tsam go 2/

mtshon dang bcas pa mgo btags zhus song / los spyod shog khas dang thog yul dmag dang ser dmag 'bor chen zhig bed spyad de rang dmag 'bog rgyu dang thor zhig tu gtong dgos snyam pa'i re ngan de rbad de thal ba'i rdul du brlags pa red/ dus bab de 'dra'i 'og 'bri chu'i sma da rgyud du sa srung bi las 'gan 'khur ba'i ta dang mda' dpon sde dbe skal bzang dbang 'dus kyis smar khams su 'os langs bya rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas pa dang rang re'i tang gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i 'bod skul la brda lan zhus te btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi dar cha'i 'og tu 'khor ba red/rang re'i tang gi mi rigs mthun sgril gyi srid jus dang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i phyogs la gzhigs nas nga tshos dmag 'thab nang bzung ba'i bod dmag gi mgo dmag tshor de bas gu yangs kyi srid jus las len bstar zhing / bzung dmag rmas mar dus thog tu sman bcos byas pa'i thog sems gso dang 'grel bshad brgyab pa dang / grongs pa rnams bod rigs kyi goms srol la gzhigs nas 'das mjug byas pa yin/ rang re'i dpung sde'i tshad bkag yod pa'i bza' 'bru nas bzung dmag tshor bgo batha' brgyab pa ma zad/ khong tsho dang mnyam du yod pa'i bza' mi bu phrug tsho la 'ang de dang gcig mtshungs kyi lta rtog kyang byas pa yin/ lhag par du khong tsho'i ske la yod pa'i ga'u la thug thug gtong mi chog pa der do snang byas yod cing /de bzhin rim bzhin yan gyi dpon rigs tshor rta drel gnyis re (rim pa lnga par rta re)sprad pa ma zad/ mi sger gyi me mda' phyir sprod kyis khong tshor dus bab dang srid jus sogs kyi slob gso brgyab pa dang / glod 'grol btang ba'i bod dmag gi 'go dmag tshor da dung lam gron yang sprad pa bcas la brten 26

khong tshos log 'gro ba'i lam bar dang khyim du slebs rjes mang tshogs la rang re'i tang gis grangs nyung mi rigs la 'dzin pa'i srid jus dril bsgrags hur thag byed pa dang / ma'o kru'u zhi'i dmag mi ni rgya gsar pa sems pa bzang po'i mi red ces bsngags brjod byed kyi yod pa red/chab mdor yod pa'i dgra bo'i bsam par gangs ri dang drag tu rgyug pa'i chu bo ni dpung chen khri tsho bcu las lhag pa yod snyam rung / kho pa tsho gnyid skyid po khug pa'i skabs su rang re'i gdong len dmag dpung 'phur ba ltar chab mdor 'byor ba red/ chab mdo sa khul srung mkhan bod dmag gi dmag spyis mda' dpon bzhi dang sa dbang gi sku srung ru khag sne khrid nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin zhogs par brel 'tshub ngang chab mdo nas phyir 'then gyis lha sa'i phyogs su bros phyin/ 'on kyang kho pa tsho gom pa gang phyi drags pas rang re'i nub byang rta dmag yan lag ru khag gis nyin de rang la rngan mda' bzung zin pa dang le dbar brgya lhag tsam yod pa'i mi med lung stong gi rtswa thang chen po 'phred bcad zin khar rang re'i sngon 'gro'i thon de yang snga rjes su ri bo che dang rngan mda' sogs gal che'i grong rdal du 'byor nas nub ngos su bros mkhan dgra bo rnams tshar bcad/ lho ngos kyi sgo chen de yang mgyogs myur bkag zin pas nga tshos phyogs bzhi nas dgra bo rbad de dkyil du bcug pa dang mda' khag bcu'i bod dmag nang nas zhung shas bros shor phud/de byings tshang ma rang dmag gis bkod sgrig byas pa'i dra ba chen po'i nang du tshud song / chab mdo'i dgra bo ri bo tsung dbyer bros rjes mtha' skor chen po'i nang mtha' skor chung bas dam por bskor yod stabs kho pa tsho gshog pa yod na'ang 'phur dka' ba zhig bzos stabs mtshon cha bzhag nas zhi bas 26

thag gcod byas pa red/tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus yang dag pa'i ngang lag len bstar ba de ni chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha thob par thag gcod kyi don snying ldan pa'i lhu tshigs shig yin pa dang / chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha thob pa de ni bod kyi gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i 'gangs che'i gom stabs shig yin pa bcas nga tshor ngos 'dzin gting zab byung / nga tshos lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams der phyir mig blta skabs srid jus ni srog rtsa zhig yin pa'i don snying de de bas zab tshor yong gi 'dugazla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu nyin log spyod dbang sgyur pas lo mang ring bdag srung byas pa'i gna' bo'i grong khyer chab mdo'i mkha' dbyings su skar lnga'i dar dmar lhab lhub tu g.yo zhing / mi khri stong mang pos dga' 'bod byas pa red/ chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed de zla /0 tshes 7 nas dngos su 'go tshugs te dmag 'thab che chung thengs grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig brgyab pa brgyud dgra bo lnga stong bdun brgya lhag tsam rtsa med btang ba red/ gnam lcags thog 'bab lta bu'i dmag don thog gi rdung rdeg des bod kyi mtho rim dbang sgyur ru tshogs de chab srid thog mgyogs myur phyogs khag gnyis la gyes su bcug cing /dus bab de lta bu'i 'og bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mtha' mjug tu rang re'i krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i rlabs chen mi rigs srid jus kyi mi sems 'gul ba'i 'bod skul dang len gyis nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtsos pa'i zhi gros tshogs pa pe cin du gros mol byed par btang zhing chab mdo brgyud nas /95/ lo'i zla ba bzhi par pe cin du 'byor/27

tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i thad ma'i dbu khrid 'og zla ba gcig ring gros mol dang gros bsdur byas mthar zla 5 ba'i tshes 3 ) nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bi 'thus mi dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung sga 'thus mi so sos thun mong thog )〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun sil ming rtags bkod pa red/ming rtags bkod pa'i nyin de'i phyi dror nga tshos ma'o kru'u zhir las don snyan seng zhu skabs kru'u zhi mchog bis dgyes tshor chen po'i ngang yag po byung song / don chen zhig bsgrubs pa red/ de ni rgyal kha chen po zhig red/ 'on kyang de ni bom pa dang po spos pa tsam yin pas gom pa gnyis pa de nga cho'i 'bad brtson la brten nas gros mthun mngon du 'gyur ba bya rgyu de red ces gsungs byung / kru'u zhi mchog bis nga tsho dpung sde'i bsam blo dang 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul zhib cing phra ba'i sgo nas bka' 'dri gnang rjes nga tsho lha sar gang mgyogs dpung skyod byas te don tshan bcu bdun sgo kun nas mngon du 'gyur rgyur 'bad brtson byed dbos pa'i blang bya bton gnang ba ma zad/ nga tshor khyed tshos bod du slebs rjes gnad don gang 'dra zhig la bsam blo gtong dus dang thog mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi don gnad de gnyis bsam blo gtong thub pa byed dgos la las don mtha' dag nges par du gzab nan brtan skyong byed dgos zhes mdzub ston yang gnang byung / kru'u zhi mchog gis da dung krung bo gung khran tang bod las don u yon lhan khang sgrig 'dzugs kyis gcig gyur gyi sgrig 'dzugs dang / gcig gyur gyi 'bo khrid/ gcig gyur gyi bkod 'doms bcas byed dbos pa'i mdzub ston gnang ba ma zad/ blo mthun krang cin wu yis sku tshab tshogs pa'i mi sna sne khrid kyis mtsho thog nas 28

bskor te gro mor 'gro rgyu dang de nas sngon dus lha sar skyod de mi sems brtan gnas yong thabs byed pa'i gtan 'bebs kyang gnang ba red/ nga dang chab srid u yon than kon san sogs kyis dpung sde'i sne khrid nas 'gro lam khag bgos kyis lha sar dpung skyod byed pa dang chabs cig sngon 'gro'i yan lag dmag dpung mngag gtong gis sngon du dog thon byas/ nub byang dmag khul gyis kyang snga rjes su dpung sde khag gnyis btang ste gcig nag chu brgyud de lha sar 'gro rgyu dang dpung sde gcig shos kyis shin cang gi lho phyogs nas mnga' ris la dpung skyod bya rgyu red/ chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed nang zhugs mkhan sbyan nan dmag khul khongs kyi dpung sde de rdza yul du bca' sdod byas yod pa —da/bod kyi mi dmangs dang rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshos 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ming rtags bkod par dga' 'bod byed pa'i skabs der bod kyi mtho rim ru tshogs nang gi log spyod pa khag gcig gis pe cin la ming rtags bkod pa de nga tshos khas len gyi min zhes skad cor rgyag gi yod la kho pa tshor rgyab rtsa byed mkhan btsan rgyal ring lugs pas kyang de'i nang dbyen sbyor dkrug shing rgyag gi yod/ chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed mjug 'gril ma thag a ri rgyal don blon chen a'e chu shun gyis hwa hreng tun du gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi sne len tshogs 'du'i thog mngon sum 'dzem med kyi sgo nas krung go mi dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi mnga' khongs bod ljongs bcings 'grol gtong ba'i bya spyod de btsan 'dzul byas pa zhig red ces dma' 'bebs btang thog da dung a ri ngos 'dzin du de ni ches bkra mi shis pa dang ches tshabs che ba'i don gnad 29

cig red ces gang byung du bshad pa red/ rang dmag 'bri chu'i rgyud du dpung skyod byed bzhin yod skabs a ri srid gzhung gis bod kyi log spyod shog khar thad ma'i dmag don gyi rogs skyor byed kyi yin zhes skad cor brgyab pa ma zad/ phyi rgyal gyi log spyod shog kha dang bod kyi btsan nye kha bral ring lugs par ngan skul gyis rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi dmag 'khrug cig slong rtsis byas pa red/ nyin rdu srid gzhung gis /950lo'i zla /0tshes 2/ dang / zla 0tshes 28/ zla // tshes / nyin bcas so sor rang rgyal srid gzhung la springs yig thengs gsum btang ste krung go'i dmag dpung gis bod ljongs su btsan 'dzul byas pa de thabs sdug shig yin par ngos 'dzin mi byed ka med red ces sogs bshad nas rang rgyal gyi nang srid la mngon sum 'dzem med kyis the jus byas pa red/ mi rnams kyis dri ba 'don rgyur nyin rdu srid gzhung gis kyang rang rgyal gyi bod ljongs la dga' mdog kha po 'di lta bu byed dgos don gang yin nam/ de ni kho tsho'i de ring gi byed stangs de la bltas na kho tshos kha sa gang zhig byas pa shes thub ces lan brgyab chog gi red/gsum/chab mdo bcings 'grol thob rjes lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang lho nub dmag khul khang gis bod la dpung skyod byed rgyu'i skor gyi srid jus khag bkrams pa de rang dmag bod skyod byed pa'i byed phyogs dang srid jus rnams gom gang mdun spos kyis rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs tshos yongs khyab kyi sgo nas mthong thub pa byung ba red/ krung dbyang gis grangs nyung mi rigs sa 30

khul du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi rtsa don lag len bstar rgyu'i gtan 'bebs la gzhigs nas chab mdo sa khul mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang btsugs pa yin/ bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang de dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang dang mi 'dra la sa khongs rang skyong srid gzhung ngo ma dang yang mi 'dra bar de ni bod ljongs mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong mngon du 'gyur rgyu'i thog ma'i srid dbang gi rtsa 'dzugs shig red/ sgrig 'dzugs der rang re'i tang gi 'go khrid 'og bod kyi las rigs khag dang rim gras khag gi 'thus mi zhugs yod par brten btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi 'thab sa de rgya che ru phyin pa red/ rtsa 'dzugs de'i nang bya ba thams cad gros mol gang legs byas nas mos mthun dang gcig gyur byung rjes gzhi nas gnyer gyi yod pa de thog mar rang re'i tang gi mi rigs mthun sgril gyi srid jus dang bod rigs mi dmangs kyi sa khongs rang skyong gi dbang char srung brtsi zhu gi yod pa gang legs mtshon thub/ bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang tshugs ring gi las don hril po de thog nas rang re'i tang gis lag len bstar ba'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi gzhi rtsa'i srid jus kyi dgongs don gcig sdud kyis mtshon thub cing / nga tshos skabs de dang de rjes kyi las ka thams cad kyang dgongs don der gzhigs nas lag len bstar ba red la srid jus de rigs kyi dgongs don gyi skul 'ded 'og skabs de'i las don khag tshang ma bod du bcings 'grol gtong rgyur dpung skyod byed pa'i rtsa ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen der phan thogs yong ba byas pa red/ der brten bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang des slad phyin lha sar dpung skyod byed rgyu dang bod ljongs hril po bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i thad nus shugs ha cang chen po bton pa red/ 3/

/ )da/ lo'i zla ba bdun par nga tshos de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhi ba'i gros mol gyi 'thus mi tshogs pa'i mi sna kha shas dang mnyam du chab mdo nas rdog thon byas shing / de nas lha sa bar da dung le dbar nyis stong sum brgya tsam yod pa dang / bar du gangs ri bcu tsam dang 'phred bcad ri bo chen po brgal dgos par le dbar brgya phrag lon pa'i ri chen rnams kyi thog tu gangs ha cang mthug po yod pa ni rgya mtsho chen po ltar mu mtha' mi mngon pa dang / de khul du dud tshang gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug mi la lto chas dgos pa dang rta la gzan chas ster dgos stabs chab mdo nas thon rjes mkho sprod dngos po dbor 'dren byed rgyu'i gnad don de mu mthud dpung skyod byed pa'i nang gi dka' ngal tshabs chen zhig tu gyur pa red/ dka' ngal de dpung skyod byed 'go tshugs skabs nas yod pas dmag khul gyi gtso 'dzin tshos snga sa nas bod du dpung skyod byed par gyon chas dang / bza' bca'/ sdod gnas/'gro skyod bcas tshang ma ni gnad don gsar pa sha stag yin rung de'i nang nas bza' 'bru'i gnad don ni don chen ang dang po red/ dngos po mkho sprod byed rgyu'i gnad don de rang yang srid jus kyi gnad don zhig yin pas de skor thag gcod yag po byed thub min ni srid jus la rgyal kha thob thub min rag 'u sa sa yin zhes mdzub ston gnang ba ma zad/ chab srid ni dmag don las gal che bar brtsi rgyu dang dngos po mkho sprod bya rgyu de dmag 'thab las gal che bar brtsi rgyu'i 'bod tshig kyang bton pa red/ lo gcig lhag tsam ring dpung skyod byas pa'i lag len dngos kyi thog nas gong gsal gyi mdzub ston de dag yang dag pa yin pa ra sprod thub cing / lhag par nga tshos brjed par dka' ba zhig ni blo mthun tshos rtag tu shod pa'i dkar mdzes su bsdad pa'i )3

zla ba gcig zer ba de red/ skabs der nga tsho'i byang ngos kyi sngon 'gro'i dpung sder bza' 'bru chad pa'i gnas tshul tshabs chen 'phrad de rtswa dang sngo tshod za ba dang tha na a bra bsad de grod pa rgyag thabs byed dgos byung bar brten blo mthun tsho'i sha rid pa dang gdong ser por gyur te 'thab 'dzing pa mang che ba'i lus stobs nyams zhan du gyur pa red/ mu mthud nas mdun du skyod thub min ni gtso bo grod pa rgyag thub min la rag lus yod/ skabs der log spyod pa'i ham sems je cher 'gro ba dang chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed byed grabs yod pas dpung sde 'gul skyod ma byas gong / 'bru rigs gzan chas sngon la gtong / zhes pa'i dpe ltar 'bru rigs gra sgrig bya rgyu de ni g.yul 'gyed ma byas gong gi gra sgrig las don gyi gtso gnad cig tu gyur ba red/ nga tshos mang tshogs kyi las don dang mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna brtson len byed pa'i las don byas pa brgyud nas g.yag chig khri lhag tsam dang 'bru rgya ma khri tsho bcu phrag nyo sgrub byas pa'i khar/ bod rigs mang tshogs tsho'i rgyab skyor la brten nas dbor 'dren sgrig 'dzugs kyang byas pa yin/ lam bar du babs tshugs btsugs stabs dpung sde gang du slebs na'ang mang tshogs kyi las don der slebs thub pa byas pa dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las don der slebs thub pa byung bar brten dpung sde'i grod pa rgyag pa dang 'gro skyod thub pa'i 'gan srung byung ba red/ srid jus de dag lag len bstar bar grub 'bras thob pa des chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha thob rgyur gal 'gangs che ba'i 'gan len gyi nus pa thon pa red/ nga tshos chab mdo nas lha sa bar gyi de bas dka' tshegs che ba'i thag ring gi dpung skyod nang dus mtshams gong mar srid jus thog la grub 'bras thob pa'i nyams myong de rang bed spyad pas mdun skyod 33

byed pa'i lam bar thog gi dngos po mkho sprod bya rgyu'i thad kyi dka' ngal 'phrad tshad khyad bsad thub pa byung ba red/phyogs gcig nas dpung skyod byed pa dang phyogs gcig nas 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i mdzub ston la gzhigs te skabs der mtsho bod gzhung lam bzo 'go tshugs zin pa dang khams bod gzhung lam de ri chen dang btsan 'gag mang po brgal nas dkar mdzes su mthud zin cing khro la ri bo bshang ched nyin mtshan med par 'thab 'dzing byed bzhin yod pa red/btsan rgyal ring lugs dang phyi rgyal log spyod shog khas 'dzam gling gi rtse mor gzhung lam gsar bzo bsam pa ni/ mi srid pa zhig yin la de ni stong bsam zhig red ces nga tshor 'phya dmod byed myong yod/ kho pa tshos 'phya dmod byed pa'i dmigs yul ni ha cang gsal po red/ 'on kyang gzhung lam ni rnam par rgyal ba'i sgo nas bzo bzhin mdun du skyod pa dang lam bzo'i dpung sde'i bkod 'thab pa tsho dang las bzo tshang mas 'dab chags kyang 'phur dka' ba'i gangs lam thog dka' sdug sna tshogs khyad bsad byas pa dang krung go mi dmangs kyi zhum pa med pa'i dmag 'thab kyi snying stobs dar spel btang ste khams bod mi dmangs kyi bde skyid lam chen bzo skrun thub pa red/ rgyab phyogs kyi rlangs 'khor dpung sdes nyin mtshan kun tu rlangs 'khor btang nas dngos zog 'bor chen dbor 'dren byas na'ang dpung skyod kyi gom stabs shin tu mgyogs par brten mkho sprod dngos pos da dung rjes mi zin/ nga cho'i mkha' dmag dpung sdes khams bod sa mtho'i mkha' dbyings kyi bkag rgya las brgal te bar snang gi sprin tshogs dang 'gyur ldog mang po'i gnam gshis sogs kyi dka' ngal sna tshogs las rnam par rgyal nas dkar 34

la dga' bsu zhus shing / khong tshos yang steng du bsangs btang ba'i du ba sngo 'khyur rer 'phyur ba de ni bod rigs mi dmangs tshos thag ring nas yong ba'i gnyen bshes la dga' bsu zhu ba'i mtshon byed cig red/ khong tshos ja bsrubs ma rlangs pa 'tshub 'tshub btegs nas nga tshor byams brtse'i 'tshams 'dri gnang byung / nga tsho'i sked rnga ru khag khrom lam du 'khrab bzhin skyod skabs dga' bsu zhu mkhan mang tshogs kyi khrod nas glo bur du rgya bza' phebs byung / rgya bza' phebs byung / zhes dga' spro dpag med skye bzhin 'bod sgra bsgrags pa red/ bod rigs mi dmangs mang tshogs dus yun ring po'i nang mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang lhag par du rgya rigs mi dmangs dang ches dam zab kyi spun zla'i 'brel ba de thang rgyal rabs kyi thog ma'i dus skabs nas btsugs yod cing / sngar thang rgyal rabs kyi thog ma'i dus nas rgya nag bong ma thang tha'e tshung gis rgyal rgyud sras mo wun shing kong jo chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bag mar ster ba dang yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma shan tsung gi skabs bod ljongs dngos su krung go'i mnga' khongs su gtogs nas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi khongs mi zhig tu gyur pa red/ khong tshos rlabs chen gyi mes rgyal gsar gtod byed pa dang 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i nang gzi brjid kyi legs skyes phul yod cing / rang dmag 'byor gyin yod pa de mi tshos snga sa nas shes yod/ chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed rjes glod 'grol btang ba'i bod dmag gi 'go dmag dang tshong pa'i sa nas tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i mi rigs dang chos lugs srid jus/ rang dmag gi sgrig khrims dam po dang mang tshogs la gnod 'tshe spu tsam yang mi gtong ba sogs kyi byas rjes mang po shes rtogs byung bas nga tsho ni ma'o kru'u zhis gtong gnang mdzad pa'i dmag dpung 36

yin pa dang lo mang po'i ring smon lam btab te re sgug byed pa'i lha dmag de yong ba shes pa red/ des khong tshor mun nag gi khrod du glo bur dwangs gsal gyi nyi 'od 'phros pa mthong ba ltar yid la dga' tshor skye ba dang sems 'gul mi thebs pa ga la srid/ 'on kyang nga tshos btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi bod rigs mi dmangs dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba'i g.yo khram can gyi gdong ris kyang mthong byung ba ni/ khang pa'i thog steng du langs sdod pa'i log spyod pa 'gas dga' bsu zhu mkhan gyi mi tshogs dang dpung sder kha gtad de rdo gzhu ba dang / thu lud 'debs pa/ nga tsho'i sked rnga ru khag ni gdon 'dre red ces dmod pa 'debs kyi yod pa red/bcings 'grol dmag slebs pa dang / don tshan bcu bdun 'byor ba/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa bcas ni krung go'i mi rigs khag gi khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi bkra shis pa'i don chen zhig yin gshis/ btsan rgyal ring lugs dang phyi rgyal gyi log spyod shog kha/ de bzhin kho pa tsho'i rgyug khyi'i ngos nas bshad na de ni skyo snang skye dgos pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ der brten kho pa tshor dngangs skrag ches cher skyes nas smyo tam chen pos lha sa'i skyid chu'i g.yas g.yon du mda' khag bzhi'i dmag sgar bkrams ste 'dzing rags bzo ba dang / me mda' dang me skyogs ang bsar byas te rdzig jig ngar ngar gyi sgo nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun med pa bzo gi yin zhes skad cor brgyab ste nga tshor 'jigs snang dang po bskul byung / lkog tu yib pa'i jag tshang nas log spyod kyi dkrog gtam yang gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyi sgo nas thon te/ gung khran tang gis chos la dad pa byed mi 'jug pas chos nub rgyu red ces dang / bcings 'grol dmag slebs na grwa pa rgan pa /7

gsod pa dang grwa chung chur g.yug gi red/ 5pho brang dmar po'i rgyal ba byams pas spyan chab gtong gnang gi 'dug ces sogs mi bshad rgu bshad byas pa dang chabs cig bod dmag gis mngon sum 'dzem med du mi gsod pa dang / btsan g.yem byed pa/ 'phrog bcom bcas byas nas rang re'i dmag dpung gi mgo la g.yogs te nag thigs bzo gi yod pa red/ skabs der rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas nga tsho ni rnyog 'dzing dang dka' ngal gyi gnas su gyar zhing / nga tsho'i sngon 'gro'i yan lag dmag dpung lha sar 'byor skabs mi grangs brgya dang brgyad las med pa dang de'i nang nas gsum cha gcig yan ni zhi ba'i las ka byed mkhan yin pas mi res nyin bdun 'dang ba'i 'bru rigs las 'khur med/ nga dang chab srid u yon than kon san gyis sne khrid pa'i gtso shugs dpung sde /95/ lo'i zla /0tshes 26 nyin lha sar 'byor rung dus yun ha cang ring po zhig gi nang nga tshor yang 'bru rigs kyi dka' ngal ha cang chen po 'phrad pas las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa tshang mas grod pa ltogs rung sdug rus byas nas skabs 'gar nyin gcig la 'bras thug thengs gnyis las 'thung rgyu rag gi med pa red/ log spyod shog khas nga tshor dka' ngal 'phrad pa de ha cang dga' po byung zhing / kho pa tshos mngon gsal dod po'i sgo nas bcings 'grol dmag la 'bru rigs btsong mi chog ces mang tshogs la 'jigs snang bskul te nga tsho sdug shi dang ltogs shi thebs su bcug gi yin zer skad cor rgyag gi yod pa red/tang krung dbyang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi/ lho nub dmag khul gyi gtso 'dzin bcas kyis nga cho'i gnas babs la thugs 'khur ches cher gnang zhing / nyin gcig la rlung 'phrin thengs 'ga' shas btang ste bza' 'bru dang / gzan rtsa/ 38

'dzing rags sogs gra sgrig gi gnas tshul tshun chad zhib bo'i bka' 'dri gnang gi 'dug krung dbyang gis da dung skyel 'dren stobs shugs sgrig 'dzugs byas nas lha sar 'bru rigs dbor te mkho 'don gyi dka' ngal thag gcod gnang zhing / ma'o kru'u zhis rlung 'phrin nang nga tshor nges par du 'bad brtson gang thub kyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la srung skyob byed dbos pa dang / log spyod shog kha'i 'khrug rkyen slong bar nga tshos me mda' dang po mi rgyag pa'i byed phyogs lag len bstar te rjes rgol gzhan 'dul gyi thog nas gzhan gyis rang la ma gnod na/ rang gis gzhan la gnod mi byed pa'i rang srung gi rtsa don mtha' 'khyongs byed dgos pa dang dus mtshungs gra sgrig gang legs kyang yod pa byed dgos shing / gros mthun gyi dgongs don dang da yod kyi gnas tshul mi dmangs rnams la gsal por rtogs su 'jug dgos zhes mdzub ston gnang byung / rnyog 'dzing che ba'i bod kyi chab srid kyi rnam par tshan rig dang mthun pa'i dbye zhib dang gzigs rgya che ba'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i mdzub ston de rgya mtsho'i steng gi 'od stong 'bar ba'i lam ston sgron me ltar nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod kyi lam la gsal por 'phros pa red/nga tshos bod du las don byed pa'i dus rim hril po'i nang ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' slob der brtsi srung zhu bzhin du gom pa re re byas te mdun du skyod pa yin/smin tshogs nag pos grong khyer mnan te grong khyer thor zhig tu 'gro la nye ba'i skabs su nga tshos phyogs gcig nas lho kha sa khul du bca' sdod byed pa'i dpung sde zhig mgyogs myur ngang lha sar yong dgos pa'i bka' btang ba dang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas skabs de'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang dngos su 'dzin mkhan srid tshab klu khang pa dang blo bzang bkra shis btsal rnyed 39

byung zhing / btsan nye kha bral ring lugs pa de gnyis ni g.yo sgyu shin tu che la gdug rtsub ha cang che ba'i mi ngan zhig dang / bod kyi zhing bran bdag po'i 'go gtso yin la/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod byed par bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i re ngan bcangs mkhan gyi ches mtho'i dbang 'dzin pa cig kyang red/ klu khang pas nga tsho mthong ma thag skad cha dang por krang si ling lags/ grod pa ltogs pa de dmag pham pa las dka' las che ba mi 'dug gam zhes zer byung / ngas kho par bod zhi bas bcing 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun mthong byung ngam zhes dris par khos dpung pa dkrug tsam dkrug tsam byas te g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i dpon rigs tshor blta bzhin du spyang bi'i mig lta bu gdug rtsub kyi rnam pa ston bzhin ci yang bshad ma thub/ nga tshos mu mthud nas kho par gros mthun ni phyogs gnyis ku'i sku tshab kyis dpal dang gzi brjid ldan pa'i sgo nas ming rtags bkod ga 'ag yin pa dang / de'i thog bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung skyod byed par rogs ram hur thag byas te rgyal sung sra brtan du gtong dgos pa gsal thing thing 'khod 'dug kyang khyed tshos bya spyod gang 'dra zhig spel gyi yod dam zhes dris pa dang chabs cig ngas rjes 'brang mi sna zhig la bod yig gi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun de kho pa'i mdun du bkram bcug pa yin/ mi tshang mas mig sdig nas blta ba'i 'og jag gtso des gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gyi deb de blangs te lag nang me rdog blugs pa ltar 'dar 'dar mig sig ngang klog bzhin du glo bur na tsha phog pa lta bus khyod kyis bod du dmag dpung 'khrid nas yong ba ham pa che zhes skad ngan brgyab song / kho pa'i skyug bro ba'i byed stangs mthong nas nga tsho dbang ()

med du gad mo shor byung / yang snying de ni gnyid lab brgyab ste sems nang gi skad cha ngo ma gsal rjen du phyir thon pa rang red/ cong ma brdung na sgra sgrags mi srid/ sgrog tse gzhan gyis ma spos na rang bzhin gyis 'gro mi srid pa'i dpe ltar phyags ma rgyag ran pa'i tshe na rgyab rten bcol yul btsan rgyal ring lugs la blos 'gel mi thub par gyur pa dang zhing bran lam lugs kyi rmang gzhi de'ang thor zhig tu 'gro la nye bas gong gsal de dag rang nyid kyi tshe srog tu brtsi mkhan klu khang ba'i gras sems kyi gting nas 'jigs snang mi skye ba dang smre ngag mi 'don pa ci la srid/ mi dmangs kyi dmag dpung med na mi dmangs la gang yang thob mi srid ces pa'i gsar brje'i bden don de log spyod shog khas ldog phyogs kyi thog nas ra sprod byas pa red/ skabs der hin rdus dbyin ji'i rjes shul bzung nas lha sar bca' sdod sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso hreng hru'u me zer bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon gyi gas lha klu la khyed tshos gros mthun la ming rtags bkod na 'grig kyang bcings 'grol dmag bod la yong du 'jug rgyu med ces bshad nas klu khang pa dang glu gzhas kyi gdangs (bye /tsā :go/rngo1 zerdo rtse((snorethejo :te spyorag ga pa ga nga da pa da/ /95/ sa la na rdu' dmag dpung gis nga tshos bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas me khe ma hung sa thig gi lho nas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud bar gyi rang rgyal gyi rgya che'i sa khul la nang 'dzul byas shing / nyin dmag gi btsan 'dzul gyi spyod ngan de dag gis hreng hru'u me'i gong gsal gyi skad char zur mchan gsal thag chod cig bkod pa red/log spyod shog khas ngo rgol byed sa de ni mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu zhu ba zhig red/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du bca' sdod byed pa de ni

zlas ri mekhrimasashigam cings 'grol dmag la sprad pa red/ 'thab 'dzing〉ltachochu kai stod thung char pas rlon pa chags pa'am lcang ma'i yag mkhakhon795ral ba rnams bod rigs bud med tshos 'tshang ga brgyab ste skasacug khyed pa dang 'tshem bu rgyag rgyur 'khyer 'gro gi yod pa red/dus ring ba'i nang du bcings 'grol dmag la dga' zhen dang thathicas 'grol dmag la rgyab skyor byed pa'i tsha rlabs shig chags shing / rngam rngam brjid brjid kyi khal ma'i ru khag nang ming la bkra shis zer ba'i bod rigs rgad po gcig dang khong gi phru gus khal ma khyu zhig ded nas ri bo thang lha rgyab skabs glo bur du rlung 'tshab langs pa dang drag char babs te ri nyil nas khong gi phru gur rbab rdo thebs te 'gyel na'ang khong gis phru gur kha ya ma byas par sngon la 'bru rigs skyob par phyin pa red/ gos po des mjug tu rogs pa tshor phru gu shi bar nga sems pa ha cang skyo po byung yang bcings 'grol dmag gis bod du dpung skyod byas nas 'phar spyang phyir skyod thub na nga dga' po yong ba 'dug ces bshad pa red/ de ni dga' gus 'os pa'i bod rigs bgres song gi 'dod blo mtshon pa zhig ma red dam/ rang gi mes rgyal te krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab khyim tshang chen po'i nang mgyogs myur phyir log byed pa'i 'dod blo chen po de bod kyi mi dmangs tsho'i khrod du rgya khyab tu gnas yod la 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod pa ma zad/ mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna mang po'i khrod du'ang snga sa nas gnas pa dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro gi yod pa red/khong tshos gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun lag tu son rjes nor bu byung ba bzhin gang sa gang du 'khyer te khyab gdal du gtong ba'i thog nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi gnas tshul 'don sprod kyang byas byung / log spyod shog khas 3

nga tshor 'bru rigs bkag sdom nan po byed bezhi demasame tshog jodang rgyal gces mi sna mang pos mtshan mor 'bru do rgya chonasa'adzothatsho'i sgar sar skyel ba dang / la las do po'i sgang la rgya 'dang khaladamag lags/ mi dmangs kyi sems pa khyed tsho dang ji srid phamekhukhulolda'i0rdzoganas rgyu yin pas 'phar sbyang btsan rgyal ring lugs mthar bkrodocha akhya7rogs gnang zhes bris yod pa red/ bod mi dmangs kyis rang nyid brtsi yo'agrol thob re byed pa'i gsar brje'i rlabs rgyun ni 'gog thabs med par sabarten bod mi dmangs dang mes rgyal mi dmangs mthun sgril 'thab rtsod kyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dbral bshig gtong mkhan log spyod shog khar gnad du 'phigs pa'i rdung rdeg gtong rgyu nyag cig red/ nga tshos btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi mthun sgril dar cha chen por sgrengs nas mthun sgril byed thub pa'i rgyal gces stobs shugs yod tshad la mthun sgril byas te mig snga'i gtso bo'i dgra bo gtor pham gtong dgos kyi red/ skabs de'i dbang cha yod tshad mtho rim dbang sgyur gral rim gyi lag nang dam por bzung yod pa dang mi dmangs rnams ya nga ba'i dbang sgyur 'og tshud yod pas nga tshos mang tshogs la mthun sgril byed pa dang slob gso rgyag pa'i las don khag tshang ma nges par du 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don la brten nas gnyer dgos kyi yod pa red/ dbyin a btsan rgyal rings lugs dang phyi rgyal gyi log spyod shog khas gnas tshul de skor gsal por rtogs yod stabs nga tshos lha sar bca' sdod byas rjes gros mthan lag bstar byed pa dang gros mthan dbral bshig gtong dming dming ba de lte gnas su byas pa'i 'thab rtsod dza drag po zhig spel dgos byung zhing /'on kyang skabs der bod kyi mtho rim mi sna mang pos zhi ba'i gros mthun dang

mkha'aji jasakho sa thogarnasarnogag cho snyom las ṣita 'kho tshularṣa ga 'a.i sto zhu nyamasagatson hosri thoganya bsgo nga lam brtsormachen da'akho70napo ༄ rgyu de gikyi ga ba ne ༄jole'i la rṇa/ṇḍaṃ zla/khro ḍa larngo ṇa1 khyenalorang 7 77khyadala'i batshon kha'i bras ma tshashasarnas rnam bar snubatardog tsā nanachotopho chos nyadagyis ba 'og gyi 6 rgya mche la sa lagokho sgrona.iṇarkosañtsa da lha'i phod ṇa skyu khya༅kha bakhojatsho bza'azlotshos ga gis slo tsho gyi khya mi g.yo klu khabazla'ikhokhokhoracha saṭhatsho rjemigasus ḍalasakhol/snya la0bas rta me rgya skyon dachu ba'i rtsog skosagatshimarto ḍa la rto du gnas po'ajaphal rdzi nga khosgo go tu sgrol rig nga chos bzhugo0byol la samatshoXṭa rdzo la phros 'gro byed pa/ ci sgros jogargya ja'athigernastims rnama'i sa pa sna tshogs pa spyad de56 7sa mi ṭha rtogs sad rgyur ngang sgug byedaṣṭha nopho la 4 lhags da kher rkyang du bzhag pa red/ yam gyi ba yulachu la gzhigs nas khong tshor rang dmag sgo nasardzi ba'i gros mthun nang gi gtan 'bebs khag cu jom rna cha btsan rgyal ring lugs dang go min tang gi dbol tsho nyamathorkoṇḍa

mkha sdurnamatshosakhusgro khritshogang bcadagye gtor bzhig/6gle matso tshe chu sos)loste 80lnga snotsa wibyib cu rdzi zhe4 skosal〉locho amakha chubahā sa yas bsnyosgo sgo tshul de thos rjes la lamatha ma tshomadzaṭha kha tshos ḍi memagotshoṭha 2lasamalirko la tocasapo yin rdo 'byugasurab tso'i lha dasna ma rdzo dam ma zugs las na mchusaji/4 9 mtshoms kyi chu/ḍi mi phabasgonatswa 70'khyokhukhu ma sa khu lanags hphu zhu rgyukho khamanyal sgo spre mcho dgo' brtsa byurdzinazhesanyo garsāmmu ikholasaṣkajomo'ajobaka khru gag cho mas the tan da'aphro 'khoṣṭha༅da khomakhadzin skyarme yo' yosakho ji sa tshwa mi golho 7 rdzordzo phyo rdzasagakho༄tsha'ibazos :sku mkho /las tagagyichod la 0skyong dang don wo bcu kha rnarasatswakho dzesal bya zla tha' gcig tu ba spyo0777kyi mitsho'i ser skya mi dmangs nyanyama'akho 4kho zabadamar po dang lha sa'i gdan sazasam tso sa zhu dang /'gyed gtong ba/ kho ta khyo bod la ha lam mi dmangs hril pos sngo lta rgodam rdzo tshos dgon sde khag la gnas mjal zhus pa de'atshangs latshosardzing sa gnas khag la khyab pa red/ der brten 6

log spyod shog khas bzos pa'i po ta la'i rgyal ba byams pa spyan chab sil gyi 'dug zer ba sogs kyi dkrog gtam de dag lam seng med par gyur pa red/'bras spungs dgon pa'i mkhan po zhig gis rang re'i dmag la zur mig yun ring bltas mthar don dngos gsal rtogs byung nas nyin gcig khong glo bur du nga'i sdod gnas su yong ste nga la khyed tshor rgyal kha thob nges red/ ces bshad byung / ngas khong la ga re gzigs byung ngam zer dris par/ de'i lan du ‘ don gnad gcig las shod kyi min/ sngar nas da bar ngas mthong ba'i dmag mi tshang ma ni mi ser la brdab bsig gtong mkhan sha stag red/ 'on kyang kho tshos khyed tshor rdo gzhu ba dang / thu lud 'debs pa/ dpung zur rgyag pa/ nyes rdung gtong ba sogs byas na'ang khyed tshos 'khon lan mi slog pa de thog nas rlabs chen mi rigs mthun sgril gyi srol rgyun gang legs mngon pas kha rgyun du bzang ba la bzang lan dang ngan par ngan 'jal zhes grags pa ltar khyed tshor rgyal kha thob nges red ces shod kyi 'dug mkhan po des bya dngos la blta zhib byed dus rang shugs gral rim gyi phyogs zhen ldan rung don dngos kyis khong la skad cha drang po shod du bcug pa red/ mkhan po de dang 'dra ba'i mi mang po zhig byung nas nga tsho'i phyogs su langs mkhan je mang du song zhing /la las dus bab 'phel phyogs kyi dbang dang nga tshos bsam pa rnam dag gis mthun sgril byed par sems 'gul thebs te rang 'gul ngang nga tsho btsal te snying gtam shod pa dang btsan rgyal ring lugs dang log spyod shog kha'i mthil brtol ba bcas byas pa ma zad/ tha na rang gi mi rabs gsum gyi gnas tshul yang shod kyi yod pa red/ khong tshos rang phyogs su langs pa'i rjes da dung so so'i spun mched dang grogs po'i sar skul slong du 'gro gi yod pa red/ de 7

min mi 'ga' shas la log spyod kyi bsam blo gting zab yod par brten btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi chings sdom las thar khag po byung zhing / da dung mi la las nyin mor nga tsho'i skad cha nyan pa dang log phyin nas mtshan mor log spyod pa'i skad cha nyan te phyogs gnyis su yam yom byed pa de ni rno ngar che ba'i chab srid kyi dmag 'khrug rgyag pa dang 'dra po red/ bod kyi gnas tshul ni rnyog 'dzing chen po zhig yin pas nga tshos de bas blo rig gsal ba zhig yod pa byed dgos/bod kyi mtho rim mi sna brtson len byed pa dang 'brel nga tshos mang tshogs la mthun sgril dang shugs rkyen bzang po thebs su 'jug pa sogs bod kyi mi rigs hril por mthun sgril byed pa'i las don la shugs snon chen po brgyab pa yin/ chab mdo nas lha sa bar gyi la ma du dpung sdes cha rkyen yod tshad bed spyad de sdug bsngal myong mkhan bod rigs spun zlar sman bcos byed pa dang /shegs skyob/ khang pa rgyag pa/ chu bed bzo ba/ zhing bun dang zhing las yo byad sprod pa sogs byas pa'i khar bod du dpung skyod byed par sa gnas de nas lto mi za ba'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i mdzub ston la gzhigs nas lam bzo dang dngos po mkho sprod kyi las don la thugs snon hur thag brgyab ste dpung sde'i mkho sgrub dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i mkho byed 'gan len byas pa yin/phyogs mtshungs rang nyid kyis lag pa sgul te sa sbol thon skyed byas nas 'dzam gling gi rtse mthor 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i thon legs len thub ste rgyal khab kyi nor srid 'gro song nyung du gtong ba dang dpung sde'i 'tsho ba legs 'gyur byung ba ma zad/ bod mi dmangs kyis 'tsho ba gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i yid ches la skul lcag kyang thebs su bcug pa red/nga tsho dang log spyod pa'i bar 'thab rtsod byed bzhin pa'i skabs der mtsho /8

sngon nas thon pa'i nub byang dmag khul gyi spun zla'i dpung sde zhig ri bo khu nu dang / ri bo gdang la brgyab ste 'bri chu sgrol ba dang le dbar stong gi rtswa thang brgyud nas bshar rer nag chur bskyod de 95/ lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes shar la lha sar 'byor nas nga tsho dang rgyal kha'i ngang 'dzoms 'dus byung bas 'thab rtsod kyi zin shugs che ru phyin yod la nga tsho'i stobs shugs kyang ches cher 'phel yod pa red/ spun zla'i dpung sde gzhan zhig gis shin cang nas rdog thon gyis bu yug 'tshub bzhin pa'i ri bo khu nu'i ri brgyud nas mi med lung stong gi rtswa thang chen po las brgal mthar mnga' ris sa khul du 'byor ba red/ nga tsho'i dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar la 'od stong ldan pa'i skar lnga'i rgyal dar de lha sa dang / nag chu/ sgar/ gzhis rtse/ rgyal rtse/ gro mo bcas dang / nga tsho'i rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi ri bo hi ma la ya'i rtse mo bcas su btsugs pa red/ rgyal kha'i ngang dpung skyod kyi las 'gan legs sgrub thub pa dang dus mtshungs rang re'i dmag gis srung skyob byas pa'i 'og paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mtsho sngon nas lha sar phebs pa dang de nas khong gi gzhis dgon bkra shis lhun por phebs pas rgyal gces stobs shugs la shugs snon thebs pa red/nga tsho'i mdun la rnyog 'dzing ha cang che ba'i 'thab rtsod gnas yod pa dang / dka' ngal du ma dang gnad don mang po gnas yod rung nga tshos sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas rgya che'i rgyal gces stobs shugs la mthun sgril byed pa dang mang tshogs la dam zab brten te re re byas nas khyad bsad dang thag gcod byed thub/ phyogs mtshungs sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i nang lhungs pa'i bod kyi mi dmangs tshos gzugs po'i thog lcags sgrog bcag ste rang dbang 9

dang —bcings 'grol mthar phyin pa 'thob rgyu nges can red/ nga tshos dmangs gtso dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod ljongs gsar pa zhig gis mi rnams la g.yab g.yug rgyag bzhin yod pa mthong byung /(/962lo'i zla 8par/)

bod du dpung bskyod byed skabs dge stag sprul sku'i skor thos rtogs byud ba'i gnas tshul phran bu/dbang ku'e/dge stag sprul sku ni si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul (de snga'i dar rtse mdo)dkar mdzes rdzong be ri dgon pa'i spyod lam bzang zhing snyan grags ldan pa'i rgyal gces kyi sprul sku zhig yin 'dug /950lo'i zla 8 par/ rang re'i cun bco brgyad pa bod du dpung bskyod bya rgyu'i sta gon byed bzhin pa'i skabs der dge stag sprul skus bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i ched du bod phyogs su phebs skabs stabs ma legs par chab mdor bgrongs pa red/ lo ngo bzhi cu phyin pa'i rjes la khams bod sa khul du gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba lta bu'i 'gyur ldog phyin yod/ spyi tshogs rnying par dbang bsgyur gral rim gyis mi rigs la mthong chung byed pa'i srid jus khyab spel btang khar phyi rgyal gyi dkrug shing rgyab pa'i rkyen gyis rgya bod mi rigs dbar la 'gal zlar gyur pa de da cha rnam pa gsar rkyang yin pa'i mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril mdza' grogs kyi 'brel ba zhig tu gyur pa dang gcig gyur dang yang dag pa'i lam phyogs dang bral ba'i kha 'thor rang bzhin gyi skabs su gzhan gyis rang snang gang shar gyi brnyas bcos byed pa'i phyed mi 5/

ser spel yul dang phyed bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi krung go rnying pa de sngar byung myong med pa'i gcig gyur dang brtan snying / rang btsan/ stobs 'byor ldan pa bcas kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi krung go gsar pa zhig tu gyur zhing bod mi dmangs rnams dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po de'i nang 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod la sngar bas mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi phyogs su dpa' ngar cher skyed kyis mdun bskyod kyang byed bzhin yod pa de ni dge stag sprul sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi thugs 'dun 'ba' zhig yin pa de dag mngon 'gyur byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i skabs su nga tshos sprul sku mchog dag pa'i zhing khams su thugs bde bar bzhugs shig ces gus btud dang bcas zhu rgyu yin/ 'on kyang bod kyi kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas shig gis sngar bzhin phyi rgyal gyi dgrar 'dzin stobs shugs kyi rgyab skyor 'og mes rgyal la gnod 'tshe dang mi rigs mthun sgril la gtor bshig gtong ba'i nag nyes che ba'i byed sgo spel bzhin yod cing / lha sar bslangs pa'i zing cha thengs mang nang kho pa tshos mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la mtha' gcig tu brtsi bkur dang srung skyob gnang mkhan phul byung gi bod rigs blo mthun yon hre hran sogs bsad pa de dang lo ngo bzhi bcu'i gong ya nga ba'i sgo nas dge stag sprul sku bkrongs pa ni gcig rgyun gcig 'dzin byas pa zhig rang red/ rang nyid de snga bod bskyod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi sngon bskyod dmag dpung gi khongs mi zhig dang dge stag sprul sku bkrongs pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul la thad kur myul zhib dang shes rtogs byed myong mkhan zhig gi ngos nas don dngos dran gso byas te yig lam du bkod nas bod kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug gnang rgyu'i dpyad gzhir 'bul dgos nges 'dug snyam/ 52

dam zhing drang ba'i sgrig khrims des dge stag sprul skur sems 'gul thebs nas bod rigs spun zla tshor gung khran tang dang dmar dmag gi dge mtshan lhag bsam rnam dag gis dril bsgrags gnang ba dang sbrags be ri dgon gyi gsog 'jog 'bru rigs dang zan rtsa bton nas dmar dmag gi dka' ngal sel rgyur rgyab skyor gnang yod/ dmar dmag byang bskyod byas rjes dkar mdzes dang brag 'go rta'u sogs sa khul du rmas ma dang nad pa 'bor chen zhig lus par go ming tang srid gzhung gi dmag mi dang sa khul de ga'i log spyod stobs shugs kyi dmar gsod mi 'phog pa'i ched du dge stag sprul skus khong rang nyid dkar mdzes sa khul du chos lugs thad mtshan snyan chen po yod pa'i gnas babs bed spyad nas hur brtson gyis sa gnas khag gi dgon pa sogs la 'brel ba gnang nas nad pa dang rmas ma de dag kha 'thor du gnas sdod bya rgyur 'gebs srung bkod sgrig gnang bar brten dar mdo'i byang ngos kyi bod rigs khul du gyar ba'i dmar dmag rnams gson por gnas thub pa byung 'dug 950lor nga tsho dkar mdzes su 'byor skabs kyang skabs de'i mas dmag de'i gras da dung kha shas bsdad 'dug pa de'i khongs su pha yul si khron nas yin pa'i rus ming kru'u zhes pa'i dmar dmag zhig yod pa de dkar mdzes su las rigs skra bzhar ba byas nas bod rigs bud med cig dang gnyen sgrig kyang byas 'dug khong gnyis la phru gu bu zhig yod pa de lo na bcu gsum las son med kyang kru'u lags ngo mas dmag mi'i nang du 'jug par phebs pas nga tsho myul zhib kho'o yi 'phrin skyel par las bgos brgyab pa red/zha'o kru'u chung dus nas bod skad dang rgya skad gnyis ka shes kyi yod pas kho'o nang du 'phrin skyel gyi las 'gan legs sgrub thub pa phud da dung skad bsgyur 5

chung chung zhig kyang yin/ nga tshos zha'o kru'u mthong rim bzhin dge stag sprul skus nyen kha che ba'i khor lug nang du zha'o kru'u yi pha la sogs pa'i dmar dmag rmas ma dang nad pa de dag la thugs 'khur dang gzigs skyong gnang ba de ni dngos 'brel las sla po zhig gtan nas min pa dbang med du dran gyi 'dugasngon bskyod yan lag dpung sde dkar mdzes su 'byor rjes gzhung lam rbad de bzo thub med stabs rgyab phyogs mkho sgrub pas phyugs rigs kyi nus shugs la brten nas dbor 'dren byed skabs lam thag ring bas dus thog mkho sprod mi thub pa'i rkyen gyis dmag dpung gi 'bru rigs 'bor chen zhig mi lding ba'i dka' ngal phrad kyi yod/ wu krung hre'i krang gis dmar dmag rgyang bskyod lta bu'i snying stobs bcangs nas dka' ngal khyad bsad byed dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang ba ltar nga tsho tshang mas sngo tshad za ba dang da dung thon 154nang gi lan tus 'ga' zhig gis a bra dang bya byi'u yi sha zas nas grod pa rgyag thabs byed kyi yod/ skabs de dus dge stag sprul sku lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang dar rtse mdo mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon par bsko gzhag gnang zin pas khong gis de snga dmar dmag dkar mdzes sa khul brgyud skabs dang 'dra bar slar yang nga tsho sngon bskyod yan lag dpung sde'i 'bud shing dang zan rtswa sogs khal g.yag thog dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i thad la rgyab skyor byed dgos pa'i skul slong gnang ba des rang re'i dpung sder 'bru rigs dkon pa'i dka' ngal sel rgyur dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa thon yod/ dge stag sprul sku dar rtse mdo'i byang ngos sa khul gyi bod rigs mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna'i nang nyin bzhin mngon gsal dod pa'i mtshon 55
