gnas srid gzhung la pe cin du gros mol byed par 'thus mi mngags gtong dgos pa'i brda tho btang ba sogs krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs ni rbad de yang dag pa zhig red/ gang yin zhe na skabs de dus rang re'i dmag dpung gis rgyal yongs khyon du ri 'gul mtsho 'khyom lta bu'i dpung 'jug byed bzhin yod pas log spyod kyi stobs shugs sna tshogs bye phung rlung gis gtor ba ltar 'thor zhing rgya che'i bod rigs rgyal gces mtho rim mi sna tshos kyang rang re'i dmag dpung bod skyod byed par srung brtsi zhu yi yod pa sogs dus bab de 'dra'i 'og bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur brtson len byed thub pa'i rang bzhin yod pa ma zad/ lo rgyus thog rgya bod mi rigs 'gal zla chags pa dang skabs der rang re'i tang gi las ma'i mong gzhi med pa'i mtha' mtshams kyi grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i thabs shes lag bstar bya rgyu de ni mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon dang rgyal khab phyi nang du shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs rgyu nyung du 'gro ba/ rang re'i tang gi shugs rkyen bzang po rgya cher gtong rgyu bcas la phan pa yod pa lag len gyi thog nas ra 'phrod byung stabs bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i brtson len byed thub pa ma zad/ byed dgos nges shig kyang red/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong skabs dmag rgyag dgos pa'i rang bzhin de'ang dor rgyu med khar de las thog ste dmag don stobs shugs kyis rgyab rten byas te kha gtad phyogs kyis gros mol bya rgyu khas ma blangs tshe 'thab rtsod kyi bya thabs spyad nas rnam pa gsar gtod byas na gzhi nas kha gtad phyogs kyis gros mol bya rgyur khas len byed pa'i cha rkyen bskrun thub/ de'i skor krung dbyang dang lho nub cus kyis bka' slob gsal po gnang yod pa ltar gong rim gyis nga tshor brgyud bsgrags 57

gnang byung / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong thub pa'i brtson len bya rgyu de dka' sdug dang rnyog 'dzing shin tu che ba'i 'thab rtsod cig red/ gang lags she na mtho rim log spyod stobs shugs kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung btang 'dzin byed bzhin pa de tshos mes rgyal kha bral gtong rgyu dang dzibod rang btsan yong rgyu'i rmi lam mngon 'gyur ched phyi rgyal gyi dgrar 'dzin stobs shugs kyi rgyab skyor 'og bod dmag gi gtso shugs rnams 'bri chu'i brgyud du bkram ste drag shugs la brten nas rang re'i dmag dpung bod bskyod bya rgyur bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i re stong bcangs te pe cin du 'thus mi mgyogs po ma btang ba red/bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang gros mol byed pa'i 'gro lam bshang ched dang krung dbyang gi bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skor gyi mdzad phyogs don 'khyol yong ched lho nub cus dang cun tang ud kyi bka' slob la gzhigs nas sngon bskyod yan lag dpung sde'i 'go khrid blo mthun dang 'brel yod tshan pas phyogs mang po'i thad nas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas te bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang 'brel ba byed thub pa dang 'phros mol byed thub pa'i mi sna 'tshol zhib byas pa red/skabs der dbu khrid wu krung dang sangs rgyas ye shes sogs kyis dge stag sprul skur krung dbyang gi bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skor gyi mdzad phyogs gsungs par dge stag sprul skus 'phral ma nyid du srung brtsi zhu rgyu'i rnam pa bstan gnang ba dang sbrags rang mos kyis bod du blo 'gug gi phyag las gnang bar phebs rgyu'i 'dod tshul gsungs pa red/ sngon bskyod yan lag dpung sde'i 'go khrid kyis cun la dge stag sprul sku'i hur brtson gyi rnam 'gyur 58

'dzin lugs snyan seng zhus shing / de rjes dge stag sprul skus spyi khyab si ling kru'u te la glog 'phrin thog nas bod du bslab bya rgyag par 'gro rgyu'i re ba bton gnang ba red/ tang krung dbyang gis dge stag sprul sku'i rgyal gces kyi sems shugs la bsngags brjod chen po gnang nas khong bod du phyag las gnang bar phebs rgyur mos mthun gyi 'phrin lan btang gnang ba red/ dge stag sprul sku lha sar phebs rgyur bkod sgrig gnang ched sangs rgyas ye shes dang li'i hphan sogs dbu khrid kyis slar yang be ri dgon du phyag las dang zhib phra'i byed sgo'i 'char gzhir zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs pa red/gsal bshad byed dgos pa zhig la/ skabs der nga rang cun myul zhib kho'o yi lta sbyong tshan mo'u zhig yin rung lo na shin tu chung bas/ kho'o nang gi dge stag sprul sku bod du bslab bya bskyon par phebs rgyu sogs kyi gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i gsang ba'i rang bzhin de rigs nga tsho spyir btang gi las byed par brgyud bsgrags byed mi srid stabs las don de'i nang thad sgar zhugs mkhan gyi 'gan 'khur tshan mo'u nyung shas kyis ma gtogs shes kyi med pas wu krung dang sangs rgyas ye shes/ li'i hphan sogs dbu khrid blo mthun dang dge stag sprul sku'i dbar bka' mol dang las don gnang skabs nga rang dngos su med pas zhib phra'i gnas tshul shes kyi med kyang rjes su li'i hphan dang sangs rgyas ye shes sogs dbu khrid tshos nga tshor zhib phra gsungs thog nga rang gis kyang 'brel yod dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs 'ga' bltas nas shes rtogs byung ba zhig yin rung gsham la bshad pa yongs rdzogs nga rang gi dngos su myong ba'i lo rgyus yin pas de dag yag po zhu thub ched gong du dbu khrid tshos gnang ba'i phyag las dang dge stag sprul skus rang mos kyis bod du bslab bya skyon par phebs 59

pa'i gnas tshul rnams sngon 'gro'i tshul du zhu dgos nges 'dug snyam ste 'dir bkod pa yin/ nga tsho myul zhib kho'o yis dkar mdzes su zla gcig lhag tsam las ka byas rjes gong rim gyi bka' ltar kho'o yongs kyi las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa'i thog hre 52pa'i myul zhib lan bcas tshang ma bsdoms mi grangs /00lhag tsam yod cing cun tshan mo'u khru'u yi khru'u krang shole ho dang myul zhib kho'i yi kho'o krang li'i hphan/ kho'o krang gzhon pa ku'o ji'i zhang bcas kyi sne khrid 'og zla 6zla dkyil du dkar mdzes nas thon pa yin/ nyin dang por/ nyin phyed ka las dpung bskyod ma byas par be ri dgon gyi nye skor grong tsho zhig tu sgar btab/de nyin sa srib mtshams li'i hphan kho'o krang gis gtsang zhing gra 'grig la 'khrus nas tshos mdog 'gyur ba'i dmag chas shig bzhes nas 'gan 'khur tshan mo'u dang skad bsgyur/ sku srung bcas dang lhan du kha btags dang 'bul rten bsnams nas be ri dgon du dge stag sprul skur 'tshams 'dri zhu bar phebs song / nyin gnyis par/ nga tsho be ri dgon nas mu mthud bod bskyod byas pa yin/ rong pa tsha dang sung ling kha'u/ yid lhung / tung tha'e sogs kyi babs tshugs brgyud skabs/ zla drug pa yin na'ang gangs rlung 'tshub pa'i khrod du khro la brgyab nas shi'i tha'e dang 'khor lo mdo sogs kyi bab tshugs brgyud zla drug pa'i zla smad du 'bri chu'i rgyud kyi sde dger 'byor byung / nga tsho sde dge rdzong du 'byor skabs sa khul de ga'i bod rigs spun zla dang li'u lun hu'e yi 'os langs byas pa'i rjes su sngar bzhin sa khul de gar bca' sdod go min tang sde dge rdzong gi las byed pa tshos gzhung lam 'gram du gral bstar bsgrigs po'i sgo nas dar cha 'khyer zhing 'bod sgra sgrogs bzhin par rang re'i dmag dpung la 60

dga' bsu zhus byung /sde dger sdod ring nga tsho'i kho'o yi las 'gan gtso bo chab mdo sa khul du bskyod rgyu'i 'gro lam thog gi dmag mi dang sa cha'i gnas tshul la brtag dpyad 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig bcas bya rgyu/ 'bri chu'i nub ngos kyi bod dmag dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'gul bskyod sogs 'brel yod gnas tshul shes rtogs kyis khong du chud pa byas te rjes su dmag dpung chab mdor bskyod rgyur gnas tshul mkho 'don thub pa'i 'gan len byed rgyu de yin/ kho'o nang gi phyi bskyod tshan mo'u yis phyir bskyod brtag dpyad dang nang sdod tshan mo'u yis yig cha legs sgrig byed pa/ gnad che'i gsang ba'i las byed mi sna dang zhabs zhu bas glog 'phrin bsgyur nas cun la gtong ba bcas kyi las ka ha cang brel tshabs chen po yod/ nga tshos shes rtogs bya yul ni sde dge rdzong khren kon grong brdal nas 'bri chu'i nub ngos la 'gro mkhan gyi bod rgya grong mi phud 'bri chu'i nub ngos nas shar ngos su yong mkhan dang dar rtse mdo dang ya an khul du tshong gnyer byed par yong mkhan/ rta drel ded nas ja dbor 'dren byed mkhan tshong pa dang drel pa sogs yin zhing / khong tshor skad cha 'dri skabs ga dus yin na'ang gnas tshul gsar pa mang po shes thub kyi 'dug rjes la nga tshos 'bri chu'i nub kyi bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'jo mda' rdzong gi rdzong dpon nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang 'jo mda' rdzong du bca' sdod bod dmag tha dang mda' dpon shag byang zur pas sde dge brgyud du myul ma (mang che ba sa khul de ga'i bod mi yin)mngags nas rang re'i dmag dpung gi gnas tshul myul zhib byed lugs shes stabs myul ma kha shas 'dzin bzung byas pa de'i khongs de sngon nga tshos bzung myong ba yang 'dug khong tshor 'dri zhib byas rjes 6/

glod 'grol btang zhing / dga' snang dang skrag snang zung snye stel mi de tsho brgyud nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang shag byang zur par 'bul rgyu'i dril bsgrags dngos po bskur nas phyir slog byas shing / khong tshor dril bsgrags dang slob gso'i las ka byas pa des skabs der gnas tshul 'ga' shas bshad byung ba ma zad/ rjes sor gnas tshul 'tshol bsdu byed sa'i 'byung khungs shig tu'ang gyur pa red/ skabs der nga tsho'i kho'o dang byang ngos ldan khog rdzong du 'byor ba'i thon 154 pa'i ying 2pa de sngon bskyod dpung sde'i nub ngos kyi babs tshugs mdun ma'i gdong mchongs ru khag gnyis yin zhing / cun 18pa yongs kyi bod bskyod byed par dmag don dang chab srid la mkho ba'i gal che'i gnas tshul gyi yongs khungs shig yin/dus skabs shig ring sta gon byas pa brgyud dge stag sprul skus lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi phyag bris bsnams te/ zla 2tshes /0nyin be ri dgon nas zhal gyes te bod bskyod gnang ba red/ dge stag sprul sku ldan khog dang sde dge'i bar gyi mkhar gsum mdo gru kha nas 'bri chu brgal te chab mdo brgyud lha sar phebs rgyu'i dgongs bzhes yod pa red/ khong be ri dgon nas phebs 'phral/ cun pu'u nas nga tshor glog 'phrin btang gnang don nga tsho'i kho'o yis dge stag sprul sku bod sa khul du bskyod pa'i 'brel yod gnas tshul mtha' dag la nan tan gyis shes rtogs dang do snang ha cang chen po byas te dus thog tu snyan seng zhu dgos pa'i bka'alob gnang ma thag khru'u krang zho'i ho dang kho'o krang li'i hphan gnyis kyis nga tsho tshan mo'u tshor brgyud bsgrags gnang byung / nga tsho phyi la las ka byed par bskyod skabs don chen de sems la brtan por bzhag ste lhod g.yeng spu tsam med pa'i sgo nas dge stag sprul sku 'bri 62

chu brgal rjes kyi 'brel yod gnas tshul shes rtogs thub pa byed kyi yod/gnas tshul der shes rtogs bya rgyu khag po yod la/ nga tshos bsdu rub byas pa'i gnas tshul yang mang po med/ gang lags she na dge stag sprul skus sde dge'i mdun ngos kyi skam thog gru kha nas 'bri chu brgal te thang phu (rong gsum)dang 'jo mda' brgyud chab mdor bskyod de lam chen nas phebs med par byang ngos mkhar gsum gru kha'i lam chung nas phebs stabs skam thog nas 'bri chu brgal te yong mkhan tshong pa dang drel pa sogs kyis lam bar du dge stag sprul sku dang mjal med/ ha lam zla 8pa'i zla dkyil tsam du nga tshos 'bri chu'i nub ngos nas yong mkhan drel pa zhig gi sa nas shes rtogs byung ba ste/ (/)dge stag sprul sku 'khor bcas mkhar gsum gru kha nas g.yu chu dang rdo lha mdo sogs brgyud nas chab mdor phebs zin 'dug (2)go thos la dge stag sprul skus skabs de'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab mdor bca' sdod spyi khyab dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba red/ (3)dge stag sprul sku chab mdor bzhugs pa las lha sar phebs thub med/sde dge ni 'bri chu'i nye 'gram gyi skam thog gru kha dang bar thag le dbar 60tsam yod pa dang lcang ra zer ba'i grong tsho de dkyil du gnas yod pas skam thog nas thon te shar phyogs su yong mkhan tshong pa dang drel pa tshos nyin byed na'i bgrod lam tag tag 'khel bas ngal gso dang / tshwa phogs rgyag sa'i sa cha zhig yin/ nga tsho phyi bskyod kyis gnas tshul brtag dpyad byed skabs rgyun du sde dge rdzong khyen kon grong brdal dang nye skor gyi grong tsho 'ga' zhig la bya ba sgrub pa phud skabs 'gar lcang ra grong tshor yang bya ba spel gyi yod/7zla 8pa'i zla smad kyi nyin zhig la/ zhogs zas zos rjes nga tsho'i kho'o dang 63

gi tshan mo'u rnying pa lu'i khra'o nged gnyis kyis kho'o nang gi dkar mdzes nas dmag mir zhugs mkhan bod rigs 'thab 'dzing pa chung ba wun hra'o hwa (zha'o kru'u dang 'dra bar rgya bod skad rigs khag gnyis shes kyi yod pas skad sgyur nyung tsam byed thub kyi yod)'khrid de sde dge nas lcang ra'i phyogs su gnas tshul gsal rtogs byed par bskyod cing / nged gsum sde dge chu bo'i 'gram nas bskyod skabs dbyar dus kyi sde dge lung gzhung sngo thing nger gnas shing ri ldebs su thang shing gis khengs pa dang ri gsham lam bu'i 'gram du ri skyes g.yer ma sdong po sogs yul ljongs ha cang mdzes la 'gro lam kyag kyog dang 'bar 'bur yin rung nga tsho bya 'phur ba ltar gyi gom stabs la brten nas ha lam chu tshod gnyis tsam la lcang rar slebs byung / lcang ra grong tshor slebs nye'i mdun gyi spang steng du rta drel bcu phrag tsam 'ded pa'i drel pa tsho gcig bab nas rta drel sgal steng gi do po ma phab par dril bus ting ting gi sgra sgrog bzhin par rtsa za ba dang khams pa'i drel pa bdun brgyad tsam gyis spang steng du dkyil krung byas nas bsdad pa'i mdun du rdo thab cig btsugs nas ja skol te skad cha shod bzhin 'dug nga tsho bod khul du slebs nas zla shas ring gi nyams myong ltar na kho tsho ni 'bri chu'i nub ngos nas yong ba'i tshong pa de gar ngal gso rgyag bzhin yod pa shes byung / drel pa de tshos nga tsho dmag chas gyon pa'i gzhon pa mi gsum mthong skabs snang ba mi 'jog pa'i ngang tshul la bltas na kho tshos phal cher dmag mi mthong myong la rang dmag la shes rtogs phran tsam yod bzo 'dug nged gsum gyis kho tsho'i 'gram du mdzum mdangs dang sbrags 'phros sol byas nas bsdad/ blo mthun lu'u khra'o yis khong tshor tha mag rkang re sprad de kho tsho dang skad cha shod res byed skabs lu'u khra'o nged gnyis bod skad 64

slob sbyong byas ma thag yin la lha sa'i skad lugs las ma shes stabs kho tsho'i khams skad mi go bar brten skad sgyur chung ba wan hra'o hwa yis nga tsho'i skad sgyur byas pa red/nga tshos khyed tsho ga nas yong ba yin/ gang du 'gro mkhan yin zhes dris par chab mdo nas yong ba yin dar rtse mdo dang ya an la 'gro mkhan yin zer/ngas khams skad thog mar dzidaka' a des zhes dris par kho pa tshos dka' ma des7zer yang / nga tshos de ring snga dro ga nas yong ba yin zhes dris par khong tshos skam thog nas yong ba yin zer/ nga tshos skam thog tu bod dmag gis zhib bsher byed kyi 'dug gam dris par kho tshos bod dmag gis do por zhib bsher byed pa dang da dung khral bsdu gi 'dug zer/ nga tshos da dung 'jo mda' dang / thang phu rgyud kyi bod dmag tha dang dmag dang mda' dpon gyi gnas tshul 'dri skabs drel pa tshos mthong tshul rnams spyir btang thog lan 'debs byas byung / blo mthun lu'u khra'o yis thog mar dzikhyed tshos dge stag sprul sku'i skor go thos byung ngam :zhes 'dri skabs drel pa tshos skad cha 'di go ma thag tshang ma'i ngo mdog 'gyur bzhin phan tshun lta res byed pa las lan rgyab ma byung bas blo mthun lu'u khra'o yis wan hra'o hwa la yang bskyar 'dri ru bcug skabs drel pa'i nang gi lo na rgan pa des dal po'i ngang ‘ dge stag sprul sku dgongs pa rdzogs zin pa red zer go thos byung zhes zer bar nga tshos skad cha 'di thos pa tsam gyis hang sangs pa dang 'brel lam seng slos cha gang du dgongs pa rdzogs pa red ces 'dri skabs kho pa tshos yodage stag sprul sku chab mdor dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang da lta chab mdo'i mi tshang mas shes gsal red ces zer/ 65

nga tshos yang gang 'dra byas nas dgongs pa rdzogs pa red dam zer 'dri skabs kho tshos shes ma byung zer/ blo mthun lu'u khra'o yis nga la dziganas tshul 'di lam seng kho'o la snyan seng zhu dgos pas mgyogs myur sde dger log 'gro7gsungs byung bar ngas de ga rang red zhus pa yin/ nged gsum spang steng nas yar langs te drel pa tsho dang kha bral nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gnyis tsam bskyod nas sde dger 'byor ma thag lam seng khru'u krang zho'i ho'o dang /kho'o krang li'i hphan/ kho'o krang gzhon pa na'o chi'i zha'ang bcas la snyan seng zhus pa yin/ dbu khrid tsho hang sangs nas zho'i khru'u krang gis kho'o nas dkar mdzes bcings 'grol dmag mdun phyogs bkod 'dom pu'u la gnas tshul de dza drag gi glog 'phrin brgyud snyan seng zhu dgos gsungs pa red/bcings 'grol dmag mdun phyogs bkod 'dom pu'u yis 'phral mar tar lan gnang nas nga tsho'i kho'o yis dge stag sprul sku dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul mu mthud zhib rtsad dgos pa ma zad 'brel yod gnas tshul mtha' dag shes rtogs gting zab dgos rgyu'i mdzub ston gnang ba red/nyin shas nang gnas tshul 'di 'bri chu'i g.yas g.yon gyi bod rigs sa khul du khyab pa dang / kho'o nang gi phyi las tshan mo'u yis kyang dge stag sprul sku dgongs pa rdzogs zin pa shes rtogs byung gshis/ bcings 'grol dmag mdun phyogs bkod 'doms pu'u yis gzhan ngos nas dge stag sprul skur gnod 'tshe btang ste dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul shes rtogs byung 'dugadage stag sprul sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs rang dmag la rgyab skyor dang gces spras gnang ba rnams bsam bzhin du nga tshor sems sdug ha cang chen po byung /de'i snga rjes su/ nga tsho'i kho'o yis chab mdo sa khul du bod dmag kha snod 66

byas pa dang / da dung masho star lho gsumatsho(chab mdo'i nub ngos kyi sho pa mdo dang / dpal 'bar/ lho rdzong gsum gyi spyi ming )gyi yul dmag mda' dpon gsar 'dzugs byas pa ma zad da dung lha sa nas mtshon cha 'bor chen dpor 'dren byas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul shes tshor byung ba dang dus mtshungs krung dbyang dang gros sol byed par bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi ma btang ba sogs kyi thog nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis zhi ba'i gros mol byed 'dod med la drag shugs kyi thog nas rang dmag bod bskyod bya rgyur 'gog rgol byed pa'i sems thag bcad zin pa'i ra 'phrod byung ba red/spyi zla dgu pa'i tshes shar la khru'u krang zhe'e ho'o yis kho'o nang gi tshan mo'u tshor las don skor gyi gnas tshul bshad rjes sgam brling gi sgo nas yodage stag sprul sku bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bkrongs stabs nga tshos dmag dpung btang nas drag 'dul byed chog7ces hran shi'i yul skad kyi thog nas nga tshor gsung ma thag bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dge stag sprul sku sdug rtsub chen pos lkog gsod byas pa'i thog nas kho tshos zhi ba'i gros mol bya rgyur ngo rgol byed pa'i rnam pa bstan pas na nga tshos bod dmag dang dmag rgyag rgyu ni gcig nas mi rgyag ka med yin pa dang gnyis nas g.yol thabs med pa zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin thob pa bzhin kho bos skabs 'di'i bsam tshul bzhin shis cang yu'i snyan tshig khag gcig brtsams pa de da lta ngo bshus bya rgyu gsham gsal/dge stag sprul sku rkyen lam shor ba yis//khams bod sa mtho'i steng du rlabs 'gul 'khrugs//sprin nag lang long 'phyur zhing nam mkha' 'gebs//nam zhig nam mkha' dwangs nas dro skyid 'ochar// 67

glo bur gnod 'tshes gtam bzang med par gyur//zhi ba'i gros mol sgo mo de gar bkag/sgo 'di phye ba'i brtson len byed snyam tshe/rnon po'i mtshon gyis phan tshun 'thab dgos so//dmag grabs kyi las don khag nga tsho'i kho'o nang du dza drag ngang spel bzhin yod/ spyi zla dgu pa'i zla mjug nas bzung cun pu'u nas nga tsho'i kho'o la sde dge dang / lcang ra/ skam thog bcas kyi brgyud du gnas skabs drel pa dang tshong pa 'gro 'ong bya rgyu bkag sdom byed dgos pa'i bka' phabs pa red/zla ba dgu pa'i zla mjug la/ kho'o nas cun gyi dbu khrid dang dmag rgyag dpung sde sde dger phebs rgyur dga' bsu zhu rgyu'i gra sgrig byed dgos lugs brgyud bsgrags byas shing / spyi zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig ste krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo ngo gcig 'khor ba'i nyin mor/ kho'o krang li'i hphan gyis nga tsho ri la 'khrid de thang shing gi yal ga mang po bcad nas sde dger dbor ba dang / sde dge grong rdal gyi rgya lam du dar tshon gyis rgyan pa'i sgo gnyis bzos pa gcig gi steng du ‘ gtsang po brgal ba'i sgo dang gzhan zhig la 6 rgyal kha'i sgo zhes yi ge chen po bris yod/ zla bcu pa'i zla stod la cun bco brgyad pa'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa blo mthun wang chi me'i yis cun pu'u yi las byed khag gcig dang cun thad gtogs nyul zhib ying / las dmag ying / de bzhin gre 54pa'i me skyogs lan bcas khrid de rngam brjid ldan pa'i ngang sde dger bskyod pa red/ chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang lags dang cun pu'u yi blo mthun rnams nga tsho'i kho'o dang mnyam du khreng ko'an grong rdal slob grwa chung ba'i nang mnyam du bsdad pa dang / myul zhib dang / las dmag ying 68

gnyis kyi le'ad khag sde dge dang lcang ra/ skam thog bcas kyi lho byang rgyud du bkram pa red/myul zhib ying dang / las dmag ying / hre 54 pa'i me skyogs len bcas ni chab mdo g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi dngos zhugs dpung sde'i gras shig yin/ dmag don thog gcig gyur bkod 'doms byed mkhan ni myul zhib ying gi ying krang su'u thung cing yin pa dang khong da dung nga tsho'i kho'o nang du skam thog nas 'bru chu brgal te dmag 'khrug jus gzhi zhib 'jug dang bkod sgrig byed par yong skabs kho'o krang li'i pho'an dang kho'o krang gzhon pa na'o chi'i zha'ang gnyis kyis nga tsho tshan mo'u tsho'ang zur nyan du zhugs su 'jug gi yod/ nga tshos snga sa nas gra sgrig byas zin pa'i bye bzos sa dbyibs 'jog sa'i gzhong pa'i mdun du su'u ying krang gis skam thog lho byang gi sa dbyibs dang bod dmag tha dang mda' dpon gyi dmag shugs bkod sgrig bya lugs sogs kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang ba zhib tshags nyan 'jog byas rjes sngon gtan 'khel ba'i dmag rgyag gi 'char gzhir bzo bcos byas pa dang sbrags ying dang le'an gyi las byed par dmag rgyag lugs zhib phra'i gsal bshad dang tshar gcod dmag 'thab kyi gnas don yang yang nan bshad byas pa ma zad/ rim pa khag gi las byed par nges par du tshar gcod dmag 'thab rgyag rgyu'i bsam blo 'dzugs dgos pa'i blang bya'ang bton pa red/zla 10tshes 7nyin gyi tho rengs la 'bri chu drag brgal bya rgyu'i dmag 'thab 'go tshugs pa red/ myul zhib dang las dmag ying gnyis kyi hre 54pa'i me smyogs le'an gyi 'gog srung dang bod rigs ko dpon gyi rgyab skyor 'og skam thog la nyin gcig ring gi dza drag dmag 'thab byas pa brgyud mtshan mor 69

rgyal kha'i ngang 'bri chu brgal thub pa dang sbrags 'ded thung byas pa red/ thang phu dang / 'jo mda' khul bstud mar rnam par rgyal te tha dang mda' dpon gtor pham btang rjes skyor gzhung (da lta'i chu gnyis mdo dmag mi'i babs tshugs)gi nub ngos bar ded nas tshar gcod dmag 'thab yag po zhig brgyab pa dang bod dmag tha dang mda' dpon dang ga dang mda' dpon gnyis gzhi rtsa'i cha nas rtsa gtor btang ba red/myul zhib dang / las dmag gi ying gnyis pos 'bri chu brgal nas dmag 'thab byas pa dang dus mtshungs byang lam gtso shugs dpung sde hre 52pa'i tho'an gsum dang mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag lho lam hre 53pa'i tho'ad 157pa yun nan dmag khul khag gi thongan 126pa sogs kyi dpung sdes kyang sngar gyi dmag don 'char gzhi ltar rgol rdung byas shing / dpung sde so sos dka' ngal khri stong khyad bsad kyis drag po'i dpung skyod dang dmag 'thab rabs dang rim pa byas pa brgyud chab mdo sa khul gyi bod dmag gtso shugs gzhi rtsa'i cha nas rtsa gtor btang ste zla 10tshes 19nyin sngon skyod dpung sdes chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba dang zla 10tshes 24 nyin nga tsho bcings 'grol dmag mdun phyogs bkod 'dom pu'u chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi me'i yi sne 'khrid 'og chab mdor 'byor ba red/de rjes 'dzin bzung byas pa'i bod dmag dpon dmag dang dbyin ji'i myul ma hphu'u the (bod sa gnas srid gzhung chab mdo spyi khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi tha'e krang yin pa)bcas chab mdor bskyal ba red/ kho'o krang li'i hphan gyis nga rang dang skad sgyur khrid de hphu'u ther 'dri rtsad thengs gcig byas shing / mig sngo la skra ser ba/ lo na nyer brgyad la son pa'i dbyin ji ba des 70

nga tsho mthong skabs dngangs skrag chen po byed kyi 'dug li'i kho'o krang gis kho par bzung dmag la 'dzin pa'i gu yangs gtong ba'i srid jus 'grel bshad yang yang byas kyang kho pa'i dngangs skrag 'jags thub kyi mi 'dug rjes su dge stag sprul sku chab mdor bkag bskyil dang 'brel bkrongs pa de yang hphu'u the dang 'brel ba nges can yod pa gzhi nas shes tshor byung / 195/ lo'izla 11 pa'i nyin zhig la chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi me'i yis chab mdor dge stag sprul sku'i mya ngan tshogs chen gtso skyong gnang ba dang nga tshos kyang sems sdug tshad med ngang tshogs chen la zhugs pa yin/ mya ngan zhu ba'i rol sgra'i khrod du hre 52pa'i rig rtsal ru khag gi bud med blo mthun tshos gangs ltar dkar ba'i mya ngan gyon chas spras te dge stag sprul sku 'das po'i sku par mdun mya ngan zhu skabs tshogs rwa yongs su mya ngan gyi rnam pa shugs cher mtshon pa red/chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi me'i yi gsung bshad gnang skabs dge stag sprul sku ni mi gzhan gyis gsol ja'i nang dug brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis sku gshegs pa dang / gshegs rjes sku lus yongs kyi sha mdog nag por gyur pa'i gnas tshul gsung skabs tshogs zhugs blo mthun tshang ma khong khro me ltar 'bar zhing dbang med ngang mig chu lhung lhung du shor ba red/lo rgyus kyi 'khor phyogs ni sgyur thabs bral ba red/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong thabs skor gyi tang krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs des mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag rgyur skom pa chu 'dod lta bu'i re ba byed bzhin pa'i rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs thun mong gi re 'dod mtshon par byas pa red/ bod kyi kha bral stobs shugs kyis dge stag sprul sku bgrongs pa'i rkyen gyis zhi ba'i gros mol brtson 71

len bya rgyur skabs shig ring bar chad byung na'ang chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed nang dmag don gyi thog nas bod dmag la brdung rdeg nan po btang ba dang rang re'i tang dang dmag gapung / gzhan yang bod kyi las rigs khag gi rgyal gces mi snas mu mthud 'bad brtson byas pa dang / tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi mi sems g.yo ba'i 'bod skul 'og bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mthar nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtsos pa'i zhi ba'i gros mol 'thus mi tshogs pa pe cin du btang ste krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi tshogs pa dang gros mol byas mthar /95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin gal che'i lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i 〈 krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod de bod 'dir zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob nas mes rgyal gyi pang du log thub pa red/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo bzhi bcu 'khor zin pa'i dus 'dir phran bod du dpung skyod byed par zhugs myong la rjes sor bod du las ga'ang rgyun ring byed myong mkhan zhig gis dus rtag tu mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang / rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur dang mi rigs kyi bde skyid ched du sku srog dor ba'i dge stag sprul skur dran gso dang yid smon gus bkur zhu bzhin yod/dge stag sprul sku ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi dpa' bo yin/72

ngas dmag dpung khrid de 'os langs byas pa'i rgyud rim/sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus/spyi lo 1943lo g.yu thog bkra shis don grub ngo las mdo smad spyi khyab tu skyod skabs nga rang yang mdo spyi'i las bya rim bzhi'i las tshab tu bsko gzhag byas byung / skabs der mdo smad khul sa srung du bod dmag ga dang / nya dang /ta dang / tha dang bcas dmag sgar khag lnga'i thog mdo spyi'i sku srung kha dang brgya khag gcig bcas yod/ spyi lo /946lo'i lo mjug tu ta dang mda' dpon ra sa rgya rgan pa 'phos tshab tu/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung bka' shag gis mdo spyi g.yu thog par bkod rgya btang don/ mdo spyis bka' phab pa ltar nga la ta dang mda' dpon gsar du bsko gzhag dang 'brel gsar mjal snyan thog nas 'phral zhu dgos pa'i bka' bsgyur phebs byung / de dus ngas sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan thog nas mda' dpon gyi gsar mjal mjal dar phul ba dang / mdo spyir gsar mjal zhus thog skabs der ta dang dmag sgar brag g.yab khul sa srung du yod mus sar las 'gan rtsis len du rdog thon byas pa yin/

'grol dmag 'thab shugs je cher 'gro ba'i gnas tshul gang sar khyab pa dang /phyogs gcig nas phagung khran tang gis mi drag dma' sar 'beb pa dang / 5chos lugs gtor bshig byed pa/la margan 'khogs gsod pa 7bcas kyi dkrog gtam sna tshogs spel bzhin du 'dug nga rang smar khams su slebs nas dus yun ring po ma song bar mdo spyi g.yu thog 'phos tshab lha klu gsar du phebs zin song /mtha' srung gnas babs dza drag je cher gyur pa/spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 4pa'i nang dkar mdzes khul du bcings 'grol dmag dngos su 'byor skabs bya rgod stobs ldan de snga sde dge tshang gi blon po yin zhing nga dang 'brel 'dris yod stabs khong gis nga la yi ge zhig btang ba'i nang gung khran tang dkar mdzes su 'byor zin song / gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni rgyal yongs la bcings 'grol gtong rgyu de red/ de sngon dmar dmag rgyang skyod byed dus kru'u tsung si ming dkar mdzes khul la phebs dus nga la bka' drin chen po gnang byung / da cha nga ni pe cin du skyod de kru'u tsung si ling ngo mjal yong rgyu'i re 'dun yod ces bkod 'dug khong gis nga la yi ge de 'dra gtong don ni/ gung khran tang gi dmigs yul ngan pa min la/nga tsho'i gras la'ang sdug po byed kyi ma red zer ba'i don du yin pa gsal po red/ de nas dus tshod ring po ma song bar bcings 'grol dmag mi 'ba' khul du 'byor ba dang / 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal (phun dbang pu'u krang )lags nas nga'i dga' nye 'ba'i sman pa byang chub brgyud lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi yongs bsgrags rtsa tshig gcig dang / sgrig chen gsum 75

dang do snang brgyad kyi nang don dril bsgrags yi ge bskur byung / de dang dus mtshungs su ngas dar mdo dang / ya an sa khul du mkho sgrub tu btang ba'i tshong pa dge skyabs kyang phyir 'khor byung nas kho pas ya an sa khul dang dar mdo'i lam bar du bcings 'grol dmag dang / go min tang gi dmag lhag 'thab 'khrug byed pa dang thug nas nga tsho'i kha drel gcig kyang mdel yar phog nas shi god song ba ma zad/ bcings 'grol dmag mi dngos su 'phrad par bod mi yin lugs bshad skabs ha cang dga' mdog byed pa dang / nga tshos go min tang gtor ba las khyed tshor gnod pa byed kyi ma red ces srung skyob dang 'brel bod la bde bar slog byung zhes bshad kyi 'dug skabs der ngas gong gsal yi ge 'byor tshul dang / lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi rtsa tshig ngo ma dang / mkho sgrub tshong pa dge skyabs kyi brjod bab bcas mdo spyi lha klur dus thog snyan zhu btang bar 'byor lan bka' rgya tsam las/dmigs bsal don lan gang yang btang ma byung / de rjes tsha kha lho ze'u 'bru dgon gong dkar bla brang gi mdzod pa bu rdo ched mngags nga'i sar yong nas kho par (bka' shag dang mdo spyi su yin dran min)bka' rgya zhig 'byor ba nga la mig ston byung ba'i nang don du 5rtse phyag thub bstan rgyal po dang / rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa pe cin du zhi mol byed par btang bas gnas skabs mdo smad khul sa mtshams su snga rgol thal char gyur gzhi ma thon pa dgos rgyu 'khod 'duga'on kyang nga la de skor bka' rgya rtsa ba nas ma 'byor ba ma zad/ sa mtshams su sbir gtam je cher gyur gshis/ ngas mdo spyi lha klur snyan zhu zhig btang ba'i nang deng skabs sa mtshams khul sbir gtam je mang du 'gro ba dang / go thos su rtse phyag thub bstan rgyal po dang / rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa gnyis pe cin du zhi 76

mol du gtong gnang mdzad skad bden tshe zhi mol dang drag rgol dus gcig yong thabs med par brten gal te sa mtshams su zhi ba'i mthun sne gtugs dgongs yod tshe mi 'gror rang nyid 'gro dgos phebs rung bskyod chog pa dang /ci ste zhi ba'i mthun sne gtugs rgyu'i dgongs bzhes med na sa mtshams rgya cher da yod sa srung nas rgol nus med nges la dmag snon gtong gnang mdzad 'os ji 'gab bka' lan yong ba zhes bkod pa yin/ skabs der nga rang gi bsam gzhi ni/ 1945lo rang nyid rgyal nang ri 'gog dmag 'thab rgyal kha thob par g.yul rgyal bkra shis bde legs zhu mi zhes pa'i tshogs pa zhig de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rgya gar brgyud chu thog nas mes rgyal nang sar btang ba'i tshogs par yig skyel du lha sa bka' shag nas mdo las gcig dar rtse mdo brgyud gtong dgos bka' dgongs ltar mdo spyi g.yu thog pas nga rang btang bar brten skabs der rgyal nang du go min tang grong gseb khul pham nyes byung khar grong khyer nang yang phyogs gang thad nas nyams nyes su 'gro ba'i gnas tshul mthong gsal khar/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi stobs shugs rgyud yod yin pa ma zad/ drag po'i dmag 'thab byas te gung khran tang la rgol ba'i spobs pa bral ba shes gsal red/ lhag par dmag don thad nus stobs ha cang zhan pa dper na/ ta dang dmag sgar la cha bzhag na mda' dpon gcig dang / ru dpon gnyis/ brgya dpon bzhi/ lding dpon bcu/ dmag dkyus bcas dmag mi lnga brgya yod pa de yang lo na mtho zhing / dmag rtsal zhan pa/drag chas ni mi rer lag mda' dbyin ji kha rdum re dang / spyi thog sbag sbag kha shas las med cing / 'go dmag mang che bar bza' zla bu phrug mnyam khrid bcas dmag sgar tshang ma'i gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul ni de 'dra zhe cig yin pa 77

bcas la brten sa mtshams su dmag 'thab byas tshe nga rang gi srog dang /dmag mi bza' zla bu phrug bcas par 'chi rmas thog khul de'i dgon sde bla grwar nyams nyen dang / mi ser la'ang 'chi god tshabs che'i ngang 'pham rgyu las gzhan gang yang yong rgyu med cing / de bas zhi ba'i mthun sne zhig gtugs na gzhung sger tshang mar dge mtshan che nges snyam par brten snyan zhu de ltar btang ba yin/ 'on kyang snyan zhu der lan gsal ma byung mur mdo spyi gsar pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med chab mdor phebs skabs ngas lam seng sngar srol ltar mdo spyi ngo mar mjal phyag tu bcar 'thus snyan zhu btang ba dang chabs cig bka' drung mtsho sgo par mdo spyi nga phod mjal phyag tu bcar 'thus snyan zhu zur 'bul ltar don smin yong ba'i snyan 'jags gnang 'os yod pa'i zur yig gcig kyang btang bar bka' lan ma 'byor ring dngos su mjal thub pa'i go skabs yol song /nga dang bcings 'grol dmag dngos su mjal ba/spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 10pa'i nang bcings 'grol dmag 'bri chu brgal te ta dang dmag sgar sa srung du sdod khul smar khams khangs spyi srung sgang dang /gru pa rong phyogs khag gnyis brgyud yong dus spyi srung sgang gi sa srung brgya dpon kun dga' btsan rjes dmag sgar lte gnas sgar thog tu bang mi ched gtong gis nga la gnas tshul btang ba'i nang gru pa rong sa mtshams su bcings 'grol dmag mi slebs nas rang sa srung ma thub pa'i gnas tshul lhag 'dug zhes bkod pa 'byor byung / de dus ngas dmag sgar gyi ru dpon mgon po sogs 'go byed rnams tshogs skong gros mol gyis gru pa rong sa srung ma thub pa'i gnas 78

tshul chags na spyi srung sgang du de ltar ma byung gong spyi srung sgang gi sa srung 'a go dmag rnams lam seng sgar thog lte gnas su phyir 'then bya dgos zhes gnas lan ched skyel rta dmag gcig btang ba yin/ nyin de'i dgong dro nyi ma ma rgas tsam la dmag sgar gyi drung yig zhal ngo rdo rje ha las pa'i sgo nas nga'i sar yong nas zu da cha spyi srung sgang gi dmag mi yang tshur log yong gi 'dug pas sa mtshams de yang shor ba thag chod/ nga tsho 'di mur bzhugs blos bzod e yong 7zer bar ngas dzide nyin yi ge btang ba'i lan ma 'byor bar sgrug dgos/lam seng dza drag de 'dra byed dgos don med lab par/ kho pas lags so zhes phyin song / de'i sang zhogs zhal ngo rdo rje rtsa ba nas mthong yas mi 'dug bros pa 'dra byung zhes nga la snyan seng 'byor byung / ngas ru dpon mgon po bskong ste zhal ngo rdo rje'i skor skad cha dris par ru dpon gyis kho med thag chod red nga yang snyan seng du yong grabs yod zer skabs/ smar khams rdzong sdod rma bya pa nga'i sar phebs byung ba khong dang nga gnyis gnyen nyer brten khong gis nga la phagacen po/ da cha nga tsho bros thabs byas na mi legs sam zer byung bar ngas sna gcung po/ bros na rtsa ba nas 'grig gi ma red lab par/ khong nas lags so zhes skad cha'i mjug ma brkyang gong lam seng phyin song ba ni khong gi bsam blor ngas dmag 'thab byed dgos zer rgyu red bsam pa 'dra/ de'i sang zhogs nga'i g.yog po dge shag yong nas smar khams rdzong rma bya pa bros phebs 'dug zer byung / ngas lam seng ru dpon mgon po bskong ste smar khams rdzong sdod kyang bros phebs zin 'dug lab skabs ru dpon nas a tsi a tsi zer ba ma gtogs gzhan bshad yas mi 'dug skabs der gong dkar bla brang gi mdzod pa a mchog lags nas rta shad ched btang gis nga la yi ge cig btang 79

ba'i nang / tog kha dmag sgar yang rdung tshar 'dug ces 'khod 'dug der yig lan slog long med par smar khams phu lag sa khul gyi 'go pa rta dpon byang chub nga'i sar yong nas da cha rgya dmag ga sa gar slebs yod tshod la 'di mur bzhugs blos mi bzod pas lam seng phebs rogs zhes nan gyis shod kyi 'dug de lan ngas smyo da lta 'gro dgos don med/ sa srung khag la dmag mi bkram yod pa tshos gnas tshul gang yang ma 'byor bas de tsho'i gnas tshul nyan dgos zhes pa'i skad cha shod bzhin skabs spyi srung sgang sa srung brgya dpon kun dga' btsan rje dang / yig skyel dmag mi/ sa srung dmag mi bza' zla bu phrug dang bcas rim pa bzhin slebs byung zhing / brgya dpon kun dga' btsan rjes nga la phyag 'tshal nas zer rgyur che gru pa rong du me skyogs 'phen pa'i gnas tshul dza drag can mthong dus nga tsho sa mtshams srung nas sdod thabs mi 'dug sku ngo mda' dpon mkhyen zer byung / de dus ru dpon mgon po nga'i sar yod mus thog dmag sgar gyi 'go byed gzhan rnams bskong nas dza drag gi gros mol byas pa yin/ gros mol skabs brgya dpon kun dga' btsan rjes 6 da ni gang dga' ci legs sku ngo mda' dpon nas thag gcod kyis gsung rogs/ khyed kyis bka' gang gnang nga tshos byed kyi yin zer ba dang ru dpon mgon pos kyang de bzhin bshad kyi 'dug 'go byed byings tshor ni gros 'go gang 'don mi 'dug skabs der ngas 4 nga tsho ni gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang pa'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba yin pas dus la bab na srog blos gtong dgos kyang zhabs 'degs sgrub thabs byed dgos/ 'on kyang da lta gnas tshul la bltas na zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu'i thabs shes ni mi 'dug nga tsho 'bro bsam kyang 'bro sa med la/ 'dzing bsam yang kha gtad gcod thub 80

thabs med/ nga tsho bros na kha blta sa ni lha sa dang chab mdo las med/ lha sa phyogs 'gro bar bkra shis rta gzum brgyud dgos pa de ni tog kha dmag dpon sa shor zin pas da mtshams phal cher zla chu brgyud lam bkag nas thar sa yod kyi ma red/ chab mdor 'gro bar smar khams sa cha chung chung 'dir yang rgya dmag gis phyogs gang sa nas bskor dus chab mdor de bas dmag sgar che la mang bas skor rgyu thag gis chod/ gal te nga tsho chab mdor kha bltas nas phyin kyang nga tsho ma 'byor sngon la chab mdo tshar rgyu gtan 'khel red/ ma gzhi nas nga tsho ni dmag mi dang bud med bu phrug dza dzor mang bas bros nas thar re ga la yod/ da cha gang la bsam rung mthun lam gyi byed thabs bzung rgyu las 'os pa mi 'dug 'on kyang khyod tsho 'dod blo mthun dang mi mthun bsam blo thongs lab pa yin/ de lan du brgya lding sogs 'go byed tshang mas 6 ji 'gab sku ngo mda' dpon mkhyen mthun lam byas na mthun sne gtugs par su bskyod pa legs sam zer bar/ ngas ‘ de skor khyod tsho sems khral mi dgos/ gal te mthun thabs bya rgyur blo gros mthun tshe sne gtugs par nga rang ngo ma phyin chog lab nas nga 'gro rgyur gtan bkal ba yin/ skabs der 'gro stangs thad nga tsho mi hrag bsdus kyis 'gro dgos par nga'i mnyam du mdun g.yog lha bkra dang /nyi ma tshe ring / dmag mi o pad ma bcas yong dgos/ khyod tshos me mda' ma 'khyer bar rang srung ched thung mda' re am phrag nang 'khyer shog rta sga rgyobs zhes lab nas rbad de thon chas bsgrigs pa yin/ skabs der nga'i bsam par bod kyi gtam dper/ dzidagra lag 'og tu 'tshud na bu las byams7zer ba yod cing / bcings 'grol dmag yag po yod skad kyang go rgyu yod/'on kyang dngos gnas ga 'dra yod da dung mi shes/ gcig byas na rgyal nang 8/

du gtong ba'am yang na 'ba' khul 'jog srid/ dka' ngal 'phrad na bod dngul yod kyang gzhan yul du 'gro rgyugs mi byed/ de bas phan thabs su nga rang la gla rtsi rta sgro gnyis yod pa de 'khyer nas rdog thon byed skabs rta dpon byang chub yong nas mda' dpon khyed mthun sne gtugs par rtsa ba nas ma phebs/ gal te 'gro dgos na nga tshos phyin chog zer bar/ ngas skyon med/mthun lam byed par phyin par nyen kha med ces bshad pa yin/ nga thon khar ru dpon mgon po kho pa yang mnyam du yong rgyu zer don ngas khas blangs/skabs de dus sngon dbyin ji'i mi sbeg zer ba zhig 'ba' nas sa mtshams su yong ste bod brgyud kho pa'i rgyal khab tu log chog pa zer bar ngas de don chog min mdo spyir snyan 'bul zhus par lha sar bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dgongs skor bka' lan ma byung bar de gar sgug sdod dgos lugs phebs pa ltar sa gnas srid gzhung gi chog mchan sgug nas sdod pa zhig yod pa kho pas ngas rgya skad shes kyi yod pas khyed kyi skad sgyur du yong na 'grig gam zer byung /nga'i bsam par kho pa phyi rgyal bar brten mnyam khrid byas na dogs gnad med pa yong gi red snyam pa ltar kho yang khrid de nga tsho sgar thog nas thon te rgya dmag gar thug sar 'gro rgyur dog thon byas pa yin/ nga tsho sgar thog nas thon te sgar thog gi thang gsham du slebs dus mkhan pa lung dgon pa'i rdzi pa bla ma thug byung ba khong gis sku ngo gar phebs rgyu yin zer bar ngas rgya dmag la mthun sne gtugs par 'gro rgyu yin lab 'phral nga'i rta kha nas bzung ste sku ngo khyed 'di 'dra byas phebs na sku srog gi nyen kha bzod kyi ma red/ 'gro dgos na nga tshos phyin chog ces nan tan zer rung ngas ma nyan par da res nga ngo ma 'gro dgos bshad/ de nas la zhig 'dug pa brgyab ste mar bab nas 'gro dus 82

nang bzhin byed dgos lugs bshad pa ma zad/ srid jus dril bsgrags kyang byas song / nga dang / ru dpon/ dbyin mi sbeg sogs nga tsho mi ser gyi sdod sgrig byas sar zhag sdod byas/ thos langs kyi gros mol dngos su byed pa/nga tsho 'gu shod grong tsho'i mi ser nas sdod sgrig byas sar tshugs bab zin nas dgong dro sa srub khar krang ku'u krang dang / skad sgyur skal bzang phun tshogs nga sdod sar yong nas khyed da lta sgar sar phebs rogs zer byung don/nga dang / ru dpon mgon po/ dbyin mi sbeg kyang mnyam du yong ba bcas phyin nas dmag sgar ang /57pa'i thon gyi chab srid u yon ran zhan hring gur nang mjal 'phrad zhus pa yin/ ran chab srid u yon nas nga la zhi dul bag dang ldan pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi ngang nas yar phebs bzhugs gdan 'jags gsung byung / skabs der gur nang nga tsho mnyam du sgor mo gral du 'khod thogachab srid u yon nas nga la de ring khyed 'dir phebs nas don gang gsung rgyu yin nam gsungs/ ngas de ring nga tsho 'dir yong nas zhi ba'i mthun sne gtugs par yong ba yin zhes bshad pa skal bzang phun tshogs nas rgya skad la bsgyur song ba dang dbyin mi sbeg nas kyang bskyar bzlos kyis tshig re zung bshad song / de mtshams ran chab srid u yon nas dbyin mi sgeg la khyed gang yin nam/ nga tsho nang khul gros mol byed par khyod zhugs pa'i dgos pa med pas tshugs sar log dgos gsungs song bar sbeg gis lags so zhes lam seng log phyin song / de nas ran chab srid u yon gyis nga tshos mthun gros bod skad kyi thog nas byed dam/ dbyin skad kyi thog nas byed gsungs/ 84

ngas bod skad kyi thog nas byed kyi yin bshad/ de nas nga tsho mthun lam 'brel sne gtugs pa'i gros mol dngos su 'go btsugs pa yin/ ngas ran chab srid u yon la zhus don/ nga ni ta dang mda' dpon yin/ ta dang dmag sgar ni bod srid gzhung gi mda' khag dgu pa de red/ deng skabs smar khams khul sa srung du bsdad yod/ da cha mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'bri chu brgal nas nga tsho sdod srung sa char dngos su phebs pa red/ nga rang gi ngos nas zhus na sa srung du bsdad pa ma gtogs/ rgyal khab la dmag 'thab bya rgyu'i nus pa med la bcings 'grol dmag mir ya lan 'thab ra byed rgyu'i 'dod blo yang med pas da lam zhi ba'i sgo nas mthun lam gyi 'brel ba'i sne gtugs par bcar ba yin/ da phan khyed tsho phebs pa'i lam 'khel sdod srung dmag nas me mda' brgyab ste rgol 'gog byas pa'i gnad don lhag 'dug pa'i thad bka' nyes gsung chad gang yod kyang 'gan yongs rdzogs nga rang nas 'khur dgos pa las su la'ang khag dkri bya sa med/ da cha bcings 'grol dmag nga'i dmag sgar lte gnas smar khams sgar thog la shar phebs gnang rogs gnang / ngas rgyal sgo rbad de phye yod zhus par/ chab srid u yon nas gsung gsal/ mda' dpon khyed ni ha cang yag po red/ khyed nas da dung nga tshor gsung rgyu'i re 'dun gang yod dam gsung par/ ngas/ nga la zhu bya mang po med/ nga rang bcings 'grol dmag mir mthun lam gros sne gtugs par bcar skabs nga'i dmag sgar khongs 'go dmag yongs rdzogs kyi bde 'jags 'gan srung thog kho tsho'i 'tsho gos 'gro 'dug thad dgongs bzhes gang legs yong ba zhu rgyu dang gcig nga rang nyid la phru gu gsum yod pa de tsho rgyal nang slob grwar gtong 'os sogs mdun lam phugs phan che thabs yong ba zhu rgyu dang 85

gnyis/ nga rang nyid da nas bzung mi ser dkyus ma zhig rang byas te bsdad rgyu yong ba zhu rgyu dang gsum bcas yin zhus par/ chab srid u yon nas/khyed kyi gsung stangs yag po 'dug do nub khyed bzhugs sar yar phebs/sang nyin nga tsho mnyam du sgar thog sa gnas su phebs 'gro gsungs/ ngas lags so brjod nas de nub rang gnas su log pa yin/ skabs der bcings 'grol dmag 'go dmag rnams lo na gzhon la zhi dul drang bden gyi spyod tshul ldan khar/ lhag par nga la nang ma 'dod gcig gi ngang tshul gyi thog nas dbyin ji rgyal khab kyi mi sgeg kho nyar yod par dogs snang 'dri tog tsam med thog da dung nga tsho nang khul gros mol byed par kho pa yong dgos don med pa bcas kyi gnas tshul dngos mthong dus/ de snga /945lor go min tang la g.yul rgyal bkra shis bde legs zhu mi bod sa gnas kyi tshogs par yig skyelta du skyod skabs kyi gnas tshul yid la 'khor ba zhig byung / ji ltar zhe na/ skabs der nga rang 'gro don ni zhi bder gnas pa'i dus shig yin rung / go min tang gis nga la gnam gru thang du bsu mi tsam ma btang khar/ gang ci'i thad 'brel gtugs spyod tshul ha cang ngan po yin pa de dang / da lta nga rang gung khran tang gi mdun du kha gtad kyi gnas bab 'og mgo btags nyams zhan gyi skabs su'ang 'di lta bu'i zhi 'jam mdza' mthun gyi spyod bzang 'dzin pa ni gung khran tang gi rmad du byung ba'i khyad 'phags rang bzhin la bsam bzhin dang ba 'dren zhing blo bde po byung / de nas bka' gros mtshams bzhag nas nga sdod gnas su skyel bar skad sgyur skal bzang phun tshogs ched gtong gnang ba khong gis kyang nga'i sdod mal sogs gang cir do 'khur lhag bsam rnam dag byas byung / de'i sang zhogs bcings 'grol dmag mi rnams snga po nas thon 86

'gro ba khong tsho ni rkang thang yin pa dang / nga tsho 'khor g.yog rnams rta bzhon nas bcings 'grol dmag mi 'gro sdod dang stabs bstun gyi ngang nas sgar thog la thon pa yin/ nga tsho sgar thog tu slebs ma thag ngas nga rang sdod gnas khang par bcings 'grol dmag gi ran chab srid u yon bzhugs rogs lab kyang rtsa ba nas ma bzhugs par mda' dpon khyed sngar ltar sdod dgos gsung nas khong rang ru dpon mgon po sdod gnas kyi 'gram khang pa zhig nang bzhugs pa red/ de nas sgar thog dmag sgar gyi dar cha phab thog rgyal dar btsugs pa dang / krang ku'u krang nas nga la da lta khyed tsho dmag mi'i go lag tshang ma yar bsdus thog gnas skabs ring dmag mi rnams la slob sbyong gi dus rim zhig brgyud rjes bcings 'grol dmag mi spyi mtshungs kyi go lag 'grems rgyu gsung ba ltar de 'phral dmag mi rnams kyi lag cha rnams bsdus nas rtsis phul ba yin/ de nas nyin shas song ba dang / nga dang ran chab srid u yon gnyis chab srid u yon bzhugs khang gi phyi rol du nyi mar don nas sdod dus ngas skad sgyur skal bzang phun tshogs skad btang nas chab srid u yon la da cha nga la nyes chad sogs gang gnang rgyu yin rung gnang nas thag gcod yong ba gnang rogs zhes zhus par/ chab srid u yon nas mda' dpon khyed rang de 'dra'i thugs ru gtum po gnang mi dgos/ khyed rang skor nga tshos gong rim la snyan seng zhus yod pas/ bka' lan phebs bstun bka' mol zhus chog gi red gsungs byung / de nas nyin kha shas song rjes nyin zhig skal bzang phun tshogs nas lag par tar yig cig khyer yong nas 'di ni lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi blo mthun li'u pe khreng gis khyed la btang ba'i 'tshams tar red ces zer byung / de'i nang 'khod don 4sku zhabs skal bzang dbang 87

'dus dang / khyed brgyud ta dang dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag yongs la/ khyed rnams kyis drang phyogs su langs te 'os langs kyi dar cha mthon por bsgrengs nas mi dmangs kyi phyogs su langs par brten smar khams sa khul zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob cing / mi dmangs kyi tshe srog dang rgyu nor la don med kyi gnod 'tshe dang gyong gun 'phog mi dgos pa byung ba red/ gnas tshul de thos pas ha cang dga' po byung stabs da lam ched mngags tar thog nas khyed la 'tshams 'dri zhu rgyu yin/ khyed tshos mu mthud mdun skyod byas nas rang nyid kyi dper 'os pa'i bya spyod la brten nas bod dmag gi 'go dmag gzhan dag tsho yang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i dang log rgyur 'bod skul dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la rgyab skyor hur brtson gyis bod bcings 'grol gtong ba dang / bod rigs spun zla btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan gnod las gang snga 'grol thabs byas te rim bzhin bod ljongs bde skyid ldan pa'i zhing khams shig tu 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu/ nub phyogs mtha' mtshams srung skyob sra brtan du gtong rgyu bcas kyi re ba yod ces 'khod 'dug nga'i bsam par de ni li'u pe khreng gi bka' ltar yin pas rdog rtsa phug nas grol ba red snyam ste ha cang dga' spro skyes shing lam seng thugs rje che zhu'i tar lan zhig kyang phul ba yin/ de nas mi ring bar hri 53pa'i dmag sgar gyi chab srid u yon me'o phe yi'i smar khams sgar thog dmag sgar du phebs byung / khong phebs dus nga'i dmag sgar gyi dmag mi thug tshad la zhal 'dzum bag ldan pa'i ngang nas lag pa'i mthe bong ker te yag po red ces pa'i lag brda ston bzhin phebs kyi 'dug ces dmag mi tshos shod kyi 'dug khong gis nga la khyed kyis 'os langs byas pa yag po yin pa'i bstod 88

bsngags dang mu mthud mdun skyod dgos pa'i skul ma gnang byung / skabs der nga la snga rjes su paṇa chen dang sgang gi cis 'jigs med dang / blo bzang tshe dbang / bya rgod stobs ldan/ 'ba' pa skal bzang ye shes sogs ngo shes grogs po rnams kyis ngas 'os langs byas par bsngags brjod dang / khong tsho yang dga' po byung ba'i tar dang yi ge rim par 'byor yong gi 'dug de 'dra'i khrod du nga rang yang bcings 'grol bya gzhag la 'bad pa byed blo skyes shing skabs bstun bya ba sgrub ched ngas brag g.yab bla brang spyi mdzod la bcings 'grol dmag gi spyod bzang ngo sprod dang / dgon sde bla grwa mi ser tshang mar bcings 'grol dmag gis lta skyong las gnod 'tshe gang yang mi byed pa'i gnas tshul dngos bkod pa'i nang yig btang bas bla brang spyi mdzod mkhar sgo sprul sku sgar thog tu ched phebs kyis me'o chab srid u yon mjal 'phrad dang 'brel bcings 'grol dmag dang 'brel mthud yag po byed thub pa byung ba red/chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang du las ka byed skabs/spyi lo /950lo'i zla /2nang 'ba' thang nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags dang / bcings 'grol dpon dmag nyung bsdus bcas smar khams brgyud chab mdor phebs skabs nga dang mjal thog khong gis kyang ngas 'os langs byas pa ni yongs su yang dag pa yin pa'i bstod bsngags dang 'brel mu mthud 'bad brtson byed dgos pa'i skul ma gnang ste chab mdor thon pa red/de nas mi ring bar nga rang yang chab mdor yong dgos pa'i brda tho 'byor don 89

nga rang chab mdor sngon la skyod pa dang / de skabs nga skyel bar bcings 'grol dmag pan gcig ched gtong mdzad byung / nga'i dmag sgar smar khams su mu mthud bsdad pa red/ nga chab mdor slebs nas cun bco brgyad pa'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi ma'e mjal ba dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mdo smad mnga' khul bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang dngos su gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i tshogs 'du'i thog mdo smad mnga' khul bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin u yon wang chi ma'e nas nga rang la mdo smad mnga' khul bcings 'grol bya gzhag nang la byas rjes bzhag lugs bsngags brjod mdzad pa ma zad/ nga rang bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa dang / rgyab skyor rogs ram spyi 'doms u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gcig lcogs bsko gzhag gnang byung / /951 lo'i lo stod nang ta dang dmag sgar 'go dmag yongs rdzogs smar khams nas chab mdor spos te thang dkar steng du bsdad pa red/ de rjes krang go hwa cun krang dang / than kon san kreng ud/ tshan mu'u krang dren ming yid/ tshan mu'u krang gzhon pa li'i 'jo'e/ chab srid pu'i kru'u rin li'i kren go sogs cun bco brgyad pa'i bkod 'thab pa rnams chab mdor phebs 'byor byung song /de rjes nyin gcig ta dang 'go dmag yongs rdzogs chab mdor ched 'bod gnang ste bsil thob thang tshogs khang rnying par li'i 'jo'e tshan mu'u krang gzhon pa ched phebs kyis ta dang 'go dmag tshor gzigs rtogs gnang ba dang / tshogs chen thog bka' slob gsung bshad gnang ba ma zad/ dmag mi tshor rjes brtse chen pos gnang sbyin yang stsal song / skabs der ta dang dam ga khongs nas dgongs pa zhu ba dang / lha sa sogs su khyim du log rgyu'i re 'dun 90

zhumakhan nyung shas khar/ re zung bros byol du 'gro ba'i gnas tshul skor li'i 'jo'i tshan mu'u krang gzhon pa nas nga la gsung bar/ gnad don de 'dra yong srid/ der gnad skyon med/ de snga nga rang nyid kyang go min tang gi dmag dpon yin pa dang / go min tang gi dmag mi bcings 'grol dmag khongs mnyam sgril byed dus kyang de 'dra byung song yang / 'gro mkhan phyin rjes bsdad pa'i mi de bas yag pa rnams lhag pa ma zad/ khong tshor ha cang yag po chags rgyu'i go skabs byung ba red ces gsungs byung / nyin zhig nga dang li'i 'jo'e tshan mu'u krang gzhon pa rta zhon te ta dang dmag mi yod sar 'gro skabs lam bar ri bong rgyugs 'gro bar li'i 'jo'e phu'u tshan mu'u krang gzhon pas me mda' brgyab song / me mda' brgyab rjes nga la de me mda' brgyab na mi ser nas ga re zer gyi red dam gsung par/ ngas mi ser gyis dga' po byed kyi ma red/ dpon po chen pos ri dwags rngon gyi 'dug zer gyi red lab pa yin/li'i 'jo'i yis lam seng me mda' rgyag mtshams bzhag song / de dus bcings 'grol dpon dmag tshos nga tshor mi ser tshos gang la dga' po byed min dang / yul goms srol lugs gang 'dra yin pa sogs skad cha 'dri ba dang / nga tshos kyang gnas lugs ngo sprod zhu ba/ nga tshos gang zhus la bcings 'grol dpon dmag tshos yid 'jog chen po byed pa ma zad/ khong tshos rang gi bya spyod kyi blang dor tshad gzhir bzung gi yod pa ni rgyun ldan bya ba chung tsam gyi nang du'ang rtag tu mthong rgyu yod pa zhig red/1951 lor nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med pe cin du gros don bzhag par phebs pa dang / chab mdor yod pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhi drag dpon rigs tshang ma lha sar phyir log bya nye'i skabs ngas nyin cig mdo smad 91

bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin u yon wang chi ma'i la nga rang yang lha sar log 'dod yod tshul zhus par/ wang chi ma'e kru'u rin gyis khyed rang da res lha sar phyin na mi 'grig gnas skabs 'di gar mu mthud las ka byas te bsdad na legs gsung ste phyag g.yas pas khong rang gi 'gram par bzhu tshul mdzad de lha sar rnyog 'dzing gsung nas gsung 'phro bcad song / de ni nga la gzigs bskyangs thugs 'khur gnang ba zhig tu tshor te ngas dang len zhus pa yin/ de rjes nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med pe cin du 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ming rtags bkod grub ste yar lam chab mdo brgyud phebs te krang cun krang sogs lhan cig lha sar phebs nyer nyin zhig cun krang krang go hwas nga la ched mngags mjal 'phrad cig gnang byung ba de dus khong gis nga la gsung don/nga tsho lha sar 'gro mkhan yin pas khyed nas mu mthud las don khag hur brtson gyis sgrub dgos/ nga cho'i las don rnams ma'o kru'u zhis mkhyen rtogs yong gi yod pa ma zad/ khong gis rtog zhib kyang gnang gi yod pa red ces slob gso skul mngags kyi bka' mol gnang byung / de nas krang cun krang dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs lhan du lha sar phebs thon gnang song / krang go hwa cun krang sogs chab mdo nas lha sar thon gnang ba'i lam bar lho rdzong nas nga la phyag bris shig gnang ba'i nang chab mdor las don khag mthud ma shor bar 'bad sgrub dgos pa'i skul lcag gnang ba ma zad/ nga rang mdo smad mnga' khul bde srung si ling pu'u yi si ling yon gzhon par bsko gzhag gnang 'dug pa dang / da rjes rim bzhin chab mdor nga tsho ta dang 'go dmag yongs rdzogs mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la dngos su bsgyur nas ta dang 92

'go dmag rnams chab srid dang go mtshon sogs bcings 'grol dmag dang gcig mtshungs khar/ ru brgya lding dpon sogs 'go byed tshor gnas bab de rang dang mtshungs pa'i bcings 'grol dmag nang bkod 'doms pa'i gras su bkod sgrig gnang zhing dmag dkyus rnams la'ang bcings 'grol dmag mi'i thob cha smos med khar kho tsho'i bza' zla bu phrug yongs la zla re'i 'tsho snon thob thang sogs ma khyab pa med pa'i thugs 'khur gzigs skyong gnang song /spyi lo /952lor bod ljongs sa gnas rten 'bul tshogs pa rgyal sa pe cin du 'gro dus gzhung bla'i thon krang sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa dang /thon krang gzhon pa sding bya rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang nang sgang gi bstan pa rab rgyas bcas yin zhing / mdo smad mnga' khul gyi thon krang nga rang dang / thon krang gzhon pa dkar ru dpon tshe dbang rdo rje dang byams pa ye shes kyis byas te rten 'bul tshogs par 'gro dus rgyal sar ma'o kru'u zhi dang / li'u phu'u kru'u zhi/ kra'u tsung li/ kru'u tsung si ling sogs tang dang rgyal khab kyi 'go khrid rnam pas nga tshor mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ ma'o kru'u zhi sku ngo mas nga tshor bka' slob gnang ste gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun lag bstar byed rgyu dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas rtsa med bzo rgyu/ mi rigs srid jus dang chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag bstar gnang rgyu sogs gsung mol zhib lhug tu gnang byung / de nas rten 'bul zhu sgo dang / nang sar blta skor zin rjes nga tsho mdo smad khul gyi 'thus mi rnams yar lam khrung cing brgyud phyir log skabs lho nub dmag khul khang gi si ling yon ho lung sogs 'go khrid rnam pas mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang nga rang gcig pu zur du lho nub dmag khul khang gi 'go 93

khrid blo mthun tshos mjal 'phrad gnang thog ta dang dmag gi gnas tshul bka' 'dri gnang ba dang / dka' ngal dang re 'dun 'dri rtogs gnang ba/mu mthud mdun skyod kyis las don yag po byed dgos pa'i skul lcag slob ston gnang ba ma zad/ ta dang dmag tshor rnga dang dung / rol cha bcas bstsal ba ngas mnyam du 'khyer nas chab mdor ta dang 'go dmag tshogs skong gis stsal dngos rnams sprad thog bka' slob kyi dgongs don brgyud bsgrags byas/ spyi lo /954lor bcings 'grol dmag la bcings 'grol rtags ma sprod skabs chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi ma'e yis rgyal srung pu'u'i tshab gnang ste nga la bcings 'grol byas rjes gnyis pa'i gzigs skyong rtags ma gnang ba ma zad/de rjes ta sha'o yi go gnas kyang gnang byung /ngas chab mdor sdod rgyun nang khron bod rlangs 'khor gzhung lam gsar skrun gyis rgyab phyogs mkho sgrub skyel 'dren gyi las don dang / mdo smad bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang khongs gtogs sa ngan dang / go 'jo/ 'jo mda' bcas kyi rdzong u yon lhan khang gsar 'dzugs kyi las don sogs la zhugs pa yin/ngas 'os langs byas pa der 'go dmag mang ches yid smon brtsi bkur byed pa las/ ma 'dod pa'i bya spyod dang shod tshul med cing / spyi tshogs thog mi ser mang che ba dang mtho rim gang 'tshams pas bya ba de ni lugs mthun 'os babs su khas len pa dang / yang mtho rim mi nyung ba dang / mang tshogs nyung shas nas de ni dpa' dang la rgya shor ba'i bya ba mi legs pa zhig tu brtsi ba/ches nyung shas nas mgo gnyis ma dang / lta log spyod log gi bya ngan zhig yin par shod pa bcas lta stangs dang shod tshul ci rigs mchis kyang / dngos don 94

yang snying ga 'dra zhig red dam zhe na/ de ni krung go gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i rtsa ba'i srid jus yang dag pa yin thog bod skyod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi bkod 'thab pa tshos mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur yong bar byed pa dang / bod rigs spun zlar bcangs pa'i brtse sems bla med kyis 'chi bar mi 'jigs pa dang dka' bar mi 'dzems pa'i sgo nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad ji ma ji bzhin lag bstar byas pa'i zil shugs dang spyod bzang la brten nas nga tshos 'os shing rig pa'i drang phyogs su langs thub pa zhig yin/nga tsho'i bya ba de ni rgyal yongs mi rigs yongs dang lhag par bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi khe phan dang yongs su mthun pa'i las don bzang po zhig yin zhing / nga rang gis mtshon pa'i ta dang 'go dmag yongs kyi ngos nas bshad kyang dus de nas bzung nga tsho bza' mi bu phrug dang bcas par bde skyid kyi sgo 'phar yongs su phye ste phugs don legs par bsgrub pa'i don chen bkra shis bde legs shig yin pa dang / da phan mi lo sum cu'i ring gi bod ljongs gsar pa'i dngos yod spyi sger gang thad kyi gnas tshul nas myong tshor gsal por byung ba ma zad/ deng dus de bas gting je zab tu 'gro bzhin 'dug pa ༵༵༵ 'os ngas kyi bya rim dngos byung gang dran shar mar bris pa dge legs 95

nga mdo spyi'i las byar skyod skabs kyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhigacin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/phran rgyal mtshan phun tshogs ni de sngon sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse mgron zhig yin zhing / spyi lo 947lo mdo spyi lha klu'i las byar bsko gzhag byas pa dang / 1950lo mdo spyi gsar pa nga phod pa'i las byar mu mthud sdod dgos byung ste de lo'i zla /0 pa'i nang chab mdor mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dpung 'byor skabs kyang sdod mus yin pas de bar gyi rang nyid kyi myong ba dngos dang / mthong chos rnams mdo tsam gleng rgyu yin/spyi lo 1949lo rgyal yongs bcings 'grol gtong ba'i dus skabs der bod kyi srid skyong stag brag gis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang khyi spyang lag sbrel gyis bod dang mes rgyal kha phral gtong rgyu'i thabs ngan sna tshogs spel te dmag don thad bod dmag sngon yod thog grong drag dmag sgar bskyar 'dzugs kyis mes rgyal la kha gtad nas dmag gra bsgrigs pa dang / chab srid thog pho zad mo la thug kyang 'thab rtsod bya rgyu yin zhes rlung 'phrin sogs kyi thog nas skad cor tshod med brgyab ste bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyur bkag 'gog byas nas mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur kha bral gtong rgyu'i ngan sems mtha' gcig tu bcangs kyi yod pa red/ —/950lor mdo spyi lha klu chab mdor bzhugs skabs lo de'i zla 3 par 96

bcings 'grol dmag gis bod bskyod gnang 'go tshugs pa nas mdo spyi gsar rnying bka' blon lha nga gnyis kyi dgongs tshul ji yod dngos mthong du gyur pa ni cun bco brgyad pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dpung khag gcig dar mdo dang / dkar mdzes/ dar dgon/ sde dge/ yun nan/ sa tham/rgyal thang / li thang khul sogs la 'byor skabs ldan khog tu yod pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi glog 'phrin gtong byed de dag bcings 'grol dmag gis 'phrogs pa'i dus skabs dang bstun skye mdo'i rgya dpon zhes pa sa gnas 'go dpon zhig gis sde pa gzhung la gung khran tang la ngo rgol bya rgyu'i thad da lta'i gnas skabs su bcings 'grol dmag la bod kyi sa mi'i rgyus mnga' med skabs 'di dang bstun nas par rgol byas na legs tshul yi ge btang ba ltar lhe sa bka' shag gis gzim chung lha mor zan brtag phul don dgra ngo mtho bas gong lo'i zla 3 tshes shar la phar rgol byas na bzang lugs phebs skor mdo spyi lha klur 'brel ba byas te lha sa nas cha dang dmag sgar khongs kyi me skyogs sgrig chas rang sgrig khag cig chab mdor btang 'byor byung zhing / ri bo che dang /nang chen phyogs nas skye mdor bod zla 7nang phar rgol byed ched ser tsha nas rgyal rtse dmag sgar 'go dmag dang / ri che rang nas ja dang 'go dmag karma g.yul rdzong khul nas spo pa dang brag g.yab yul dmag gdong rdzong gru kha nas gzhis rtse ga dang 'go dmag bcas kyis gra sgrig zin lugs mdo spyi lha klus sde pa gzhung la rlung 'phrin brgyud mol bsdur zhus par skabs der lha sa bka' shag gis phar rgol gyis sa bzung thub na gang legs yong rgyu yin gshis/ rgyun du sa srung sogs rang sar 'gal rkyen mi 'byung ba'i 'gan len thub rgyur dgongs bzhes gang gzab dgos lugs kyi tar lan 'byor ba red/ yang 97

mdo spyi lha klu'i dgongs tshul gzhan zhig ste/ mdo spyi gsar pa nga phod phebs skabs dmag 'khrug gi skyo ma g.yos te rtsis 'bul zhus pa lta bu'i gzigs phyogs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i thugs dogs yod mur mdo spyi gsar pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med chab mdor phebs pa dang / mdo rnying lha klu lha sa phyogs su phyir thon gnang zhing / skabs der mdo spyi gsar rnying gnyis thabs jus 'dzin stangs thad dgongs gzhi mi 'dra ba byung ba ste/ gsar pa nga phod nas zhi mthun rang la dgongs bzhes kyis mdo spyi ngo las bka' bsdur dang 'brel gros sne mthud par smar khams rgyud ri che bla gnyer rtse drung las tshan ye shes dar rgyas dang spom mda' bu rab dga'/ ldan khog phyogs su las tshan g.yul dga' bcas gtong gnang mdzad song /spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 9tshes /0bar la chab mdo'i sa mtshams ri bo che dang / ldan khog sde dge dang 'jo mda'/ smar khams sogs sa gnas khag la bod dmag ched 'dzugs sa srung yod mus thog sho star lho gsum dang / go 'jo/ brag g.yab bcas nas yul dmag bsdu rub byas te mda' tshab drung rigs ser skya ched bskos kyis gong gsal sa gnas so sor khag bgos dpung snon du gtong rgyu sngon gtan 'khel yod pa ltar btang ba red/ de lo zla /0pa'i zla dkyil du bcings 'grol dmag gis shugs che'i sgo nas dpung 'jug byas par brten gnas tshul dza drag je cher gyur cing / skabs de'i dus tshod ni rnam kun chab mdor yod pa'i mdo spyi ngo las rnams lo ltar spro chen zhes nyin bdun phrag gcig tsam gling gtong byed pa dang 'khel zhing / thog mar sa mtshams khag nas snyan zhu 'bul 'byor skabs sngar srol yi ge'i 'beb dang /lteb cigs/ rgya ma/ thel snon sogs gang sar srol rgyun gtan 'bebs rgyas 98

dpyad ltar byed kyang / gnas tshul de bas dza drag je cher gyur stabs snyan zhu'i yi ge spyir btang nang tshags 'dra mnyam nang bzhin bris te rta la er kha yang 'dogs long med par rta shad gnas snyan gcig mjug gnyis mthud du 'byor zhing / gong zla'i tshes /7 dgong mo sa srib tsam la mdo spyi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis chab yod las bya yongs rdzogs skong tshogs gnang ste sa mtshams gang sa nas 'gog srung mi thub pa'i dza drag ci che'i gnas tshul rnams khyab bsgrags gnang rjes da cha rang re'i thabs jus ji ltar 'dzin na legs zhes lan bcu grangs tsam gsungs pa'i mdo don snying po bcings 'grol dmag dang zhi ba'i 'phros sne mthud rgyu'i dgongs gzhi shugs che 'dug kyang /dmag 'thab drag po'i las sbyor 'gangs cher brten brgya kha gcig gcod kyi bka' 'bebs rang bzhin mdzad bde byung ma song / 'on kyang de skabs rang nyid kyang tshud pa'i mang che bas lha sa phyogs su bros rgyu'i bsam 'dun 'ba' zhig la brten tshes /8nam langs lag ris gsal la ma gsal mtshams su ma bros 'gro skabs mdo spyi ngo las khag gcig lha sa phyogs su zhal gtad nas phebs pa dang / bu phrug dza dzor mang po yod mkhan khag gcig lho pa kha stod phyogs su kha gtad nas bros shing / mdo spyi ngo las gnam mtsho la brgyud phebs skabs las bya shod drung kho nang pa'i rta drel rtsa gsor bskyod pa ri bo che nas phyir log yong ba dang thug pa de dag la 'dri zhib byas pa'i lan du la gong lnga mdor bcings 'grol dmag dpung bgrangs kyis mi langs pa 'byor zin lugs bshad par brten nga phod chibs las bshol te slar yang der yod las bya rnams la bros lam thob re bral ba'i gnas tshul 'di lta bur thug skabs rang re gcig pu'i chags 'jig gi gnad don tsam min par rdzong gzhis khag gi sne 99

sdod mi sna tshang ma'i bde rtsa 'gangs cher brten nga tshos bsam gzhigs nan tan byed dgos gsungs kyang / der yod tshang mas mu mthud bros rgyu kho na ma gtogs nga phod kyi dgongs gzhi ltar ji dge'i bsam gros 'don mkhan ma byung khar/ de 'phral rang mgo gang thon gyis kha 'thor nas bros shing / nga rang dang shod drung rma bya tshe dbang 'gyur med gnyis chab mdor phyir log bya rgyur mos mthun byung yang gsang 'phrin gtong mkhan hphu thes ngos gnyis gar 'gro'i mnyam du yong bas gang ci'i stabs bde ma gyur gshis lkog tu g.yog por hphu the mgo skor gtong bas mngags te kho pa nags gseb brgyud yar tsam 'gror bcug rjes nged gnyis sems thag gtsang bcad kyis slar yang chab mdo phyogs su log yong ba yin/ de nub lam bar chab mdo 'phags lha'i mgron gnyer bkra rnam gyi khyim tshang ngom sa gong tshang du gnas sdod skabs nam phyed tsam la bcings 'grol dmag glo bur du 'byor nas nged gnyis 'dzin bzung dang 'brel chab mdo ni drag po'i bcings 'grol btang ba zhig yin pas khyod tsho'i go lag dang rta drel gang yod rtsis 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / gser dngul sogs dngos rigs gzhan dag gzhung len byed srol med pas khyod gnyis nas bcol nyar gang rung byas chog gsungs byung / de ni rang nyid kyis bcings 'grol dmag mi mthong ba'i thog ma de yin/ de nas nyin gnyis song mtshams nga phod nyen g.yol gnang yul gru gu dgon pa bcings 'grol dmag mis mtha' skor zin lugs go thos byung ba ltar nyin shas song mtshams nga phod chab mdor phyir phebs gnang song ba de dang chabs cig gsang 'phrin gtong mi hphu the yang mnyam khrid gnang 'dugachab mdor bcings 'grol dmag thog mar 'byor skabs rang nyid la 100

gung khran tang gi srid jus kyi go rtogs med khar/ de sngon btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bkram pa'i 'chal gtam sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas dogs 'char che gshis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la yid ches med par lha sa phyogs la kha gtad de gnam mtsho la brgyud nyin mtshan gnyis tsam gyi lam bar nags gseb tu byol sdod myong ba'i mi zhig ring por ma thogs par mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la mgo btags zhus rjes tang gi mi rigs srid jus dril bsgrags dang / slob gso yang yang thob pa'i 'og dus skabs de rang la mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mkho byed bza' rtsam 'thag las dang /rgyus mnga'i babs kyis rta khal mi gsum go sgrig bya rgyu sogs kyi las don bkod sgrig gnang ste rgyab skyor zhabs zhu'i las ka byed mkhan zhig tu gyur cing / de nas nyin bcu tsam song mtshams chab mdor phebs mkhan mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go khrid gtso bo wang chi ma'e dang / mdo spyi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gnyis bka' bsdur gnang skabs nga phod kyi dgongs 'char ltar lha sar snyan 'bul mi 'gro phran rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang/ bka' mgron bsam gling pa phun tshogs rdo rje gnyis ched du mngags gtong mdzad pa ltar tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' shag lha ri 'gor bzhugs pa'i mdo spyi rnying pa sa dbang lha klu bcas so sor snyan zhu 'bul bar chab mdo nas lha sa bar mi ser rta 'ul gtong mkhan yod rigs sar skul 'ded dang /med sar rta nyo ba/ rta 'ar chad thebs pa'i gnas tshul 'og skabs re rta sga rgyab 'khur gyis don du nyin mtshan bcu drug thog chab mdo nas lha sar 'byor ba yong / yar lam lha ri 'gror sa dbang lha klu'i sar 'bul snyan dang sbrags ngo bcar zhus shing / skabs der ser dmag ces se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 101

drag chas spras pa'i grwa pa khag gcig lha ri 'gor bsdad 'dug pa re zung mig mthong skabs khro bo'i rnam pa lta bu 'dug pas de tshor don med rnyog dra yong gzhir bsam 'brel gdugs ma byas/ de bzhin rgya mda' rdzong khongs ci mda' mi ser gyis lha ri 'go nas dar 'drog dmag sgar 'di phyogs yong rtsis mi 'dug gam zhes nged gnyis la 'dri rtsad byas byung bar shes rtogs ma byung zhes lan btab(dar 'drog dmag sgar zhes pa ni nub gong la'i la rtse'i dar lcog mthong bar bcings 'grol dmag mi slabs 'dug snyam pa'i dogs 'drog byung tshul la zer)de skabs lha klus lha ldan bka' shag la glog 'phrin gtong gnang mdzad tshod gang lags she na/ phran gnyis kong po ba la'i tshur ngos rin chen gling du 'byor skabs lha sa nas bka' shag gis rta shad ched rdzong mdun yig chung btang 'byor byung don du phran gnyis la bkra shis bde legs kyi 'tshams 'dri dang 'brel khyed gnyis nam nyin ltos med kyis lha sar 'byor thub pa dgos rgyu dang / lha sar 'byor skabs rang khyim du phyogs chas brje ba sogs 'gro bskyod ka kor med par bka' shag tu 'phral bcar dgos lugs 'khod 'dug lha sar 'byor 'phral bka' shag tu skyod skabs sa dbang phud pa'i bka' shag 'khor bcas dang / bzhin rta nyar sgug byed mkhan zla gras rnams gsung rar bsdad 'dug cing / skabs der mang tshogs khrod nas ston pa'i rnam 'gyur la dga' skyo gnyis ldan 'char snang gcig mtshungs shig byung ba ni/ khag gcig gis thag ring chab mdo nas nam nyin ltos med yong ba'i ngal dub sogs gang cir sems gso byed cing / khag gcig gis 'di tsho bskyal mgo ril red ces tshig mtshon 'debs mkhan yang byung / bka' shag tu bcar skabs de nyin bka' blon ram pa dang / zur khang / bka' tshab 102

thub bstan rab yangs gsum bzhugs 'dug tā la'i bla ma mchog la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu dang / bkag shag la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu bcas 'gro lugs ltar phul zhing / de skabs bka' shag gi rnam pa sngar rgyun ltar snang yang / mi 'dra sa zhig la nged gnyis la 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur ni mgon sbyin lta bu'i lhug mol gnang ba dang / chab mdo'i gnas tshul gang mgyogs gsan thub rgyur thugs 'tshab gnang ba/ gzhan yang bcings 'grol dmag mi'i byed stangs dang /khyon 'bor ji yod sogs 'dri zhib gnang byung / phran gnyis nas bcings 'grol dmag mi'i grangs 'bor zhib cha zhu rgyu med/ byed stangs ni mi dmangs la phan pa kho na las gnod pa spu tsam mi bskyel ba dang / sgrig lam kun spyod thad la'ang mi rnams kyi gus bkur byed 'os pa zhig 'dug la/ nyin gnyis gsum nas 'byor ran 'dug ces thos pa'i nub mo de rang la glo bur du 'byor thub pa'i dmag rtsal gyi blo rtse yang sgrim nus mkhan zhig 'dug ces zhus pa yin/bka' blon ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gyis a gi sa gi pha rol po lcags lta bu zhig dang / rang re spag lta bu bya long byed long med pa 'di 'dra khyad mtshar po/ khyad mtshar po zhes dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis chab mdor yod pa'i mdo spyi ngo las tshang ma'i bde gnas 'dri ba dang / sa dbang nga phod la thugs khag med pa'i sku ngal byung ba red ces dang / da lam glo bur 'geb g.yogs kyi ngang tshul 'dir gnas skabs byed thabs gang yang med pas sdug 'khur bya rgyu las ma 'das rung slad 'dzam gling du'ang 'gyur ldog yong srid pa zhig red/ nga tsho'i lha dmag de tsho de 'dra'i skyob la ang / da lam sku zhabs khyed gnyis sku bsnyel po zhe drag byung song /bka' blon nga phod kyi snyan zhu dus thog 'byor thub pa gang legs byung bas nyin /03

shas thugs lhod por ngal gso gnang dgos gsungs byung / snyan zhu 'byor ma thag tshogs 'du hrag bsdus skong tshogs kyis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang gros mthun 'jog rgyu dang / gros mthun 'jog mkhan mi 'gro yang gtan 'khel byas gshis de rjes phran gnyis la bzos sgo mar dang / rtsam pa/ gro zhib/snam rigs sogs bskyel bar rtse shod phyag nang btang gnang byung / de nas ring por ma song ba'i bod zla // tshes // zhogs pa snga po phran ma langs gong bka' mgron bsam gling pa phran gyi sar phebs nas a tsi da lang gi min nam/dpe bsags zhag da zhogs snga po rgyal ba rin po che gro mor phebs tshar 'dugad cha nged gnyis chab mdor phyir log byas na gnad don de khyod gnyis kyis bzos pa red ces bshad mi yong ngam/ 'gro blos bzod dam zhes gsungs byung ba'i lan du/ nged gnyis la rgyal ba rin po che mjal ni ma byung / gnad don de nged gnyis dang 'brel ba ci la yod ces bshad pa yin/ de nyin gang 'tshams shig na rtse nas bka' shag gis ches 'bod brda tho btang 'byor bzhin bskyod pas gong sa mchog gnas skabs gro mor nyen g.yol du chibs bsgyur bskyangs lugs dang / 'dir srid tshab blo bzang bkra shis dang / bde mkhar ba gnyis bsko gzhag gnang lugs/ bka' shag tu bka' tshab thub bstan rab yangs dang / shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rje gnyis nas 'khur bzhes gnang rgyu/ krung dbyang dang gros mthun mdzad rgyur thugs gtan 'khel gshis 'thus mi sa dbang nga phod kyi phyag rogs su dmag spyi dza sag khe smad pa dang /mkhan drung thub bstan bstan dar gnyis chu thog brgyud pe cin du phebs rgyu dang / mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / rim bzhi bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub gzhung lam brgyud phebs rgyu yin pas mar lam sa babs rgyus /04

mnga' sogs gang ci'i rogs ram dang sbrags khyed gnyis 'phral thon bya dgos zhes bka' phab pa dang mar lam bzhon rta nyo byed mi rer dngul ṭam rdo drug brgya re gnang byung ba slar yang chab mdor bskyod gtan 'khel zhing / de nas srid tshab klu khang pa'i sar mjal dar a she gcig dang / dngul srang lnga bcu'i 'bum gcig khyer te 'gro lugs 'byor zhur bcar skabs klu khang pas sngon la bka' mol ma gnang bar kha stong pa la gros ma byed ces ja 'dren du bcug de mtshams chab mdo'i gnas tshul rob tsam zhus/ klu khang pa'i skad cha'i 'go nas mjug bar khyed gnyis bstan pa'i don du chab mdor phyir log bya dgos yang yang gsungs shing de min gnas skabs khag mi 'dug sa tsi a tsi rgya dmar gyi de 'dra'i dbang yod/ da res khyed gnyis nas sku tshab mkhan rim gnyis phebs lam bde bgrod kyis chab mdor gdan 'dren zhu dgos zhes yang nas yang du gsungs byung / skabs der sa gnas srid gzhung gis mdo smad khul du yod pa'i drung rigs ser skya dang / dmag mi'i 'go byed brgya dpon yan la rgud skyob mtshon byed bod dngul ṭam rdo drug cu tham pa re bskur byung ba de rnams chab mdor bskyod 'byor gyis khungs so sor sprad/ de dus khams khul du yod pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag dang / 'go dmag bcas par bcings 'grol dmag gis kyang lam gron zur bstsal gyis phyir slog gnang sgang 'khel gshis nga rang gi bsam tshul la'ang chab mdor nyin shas ngal gsos rjes lha sar phyir log bya rgyu'i brtsi gzhi yod/ 'on kyang bod gzhung gi zhi gros 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi bka' 'brel rang nyid gros mthun 'jog mkhan 'thus mi rnam pa'i las bya'i zhabs zhur rgyal sa pe cin du thog mar bskyod rgyu'i go skabs bzang po de /05

thob byung / chab mdo nas pe cin du bskyod lam dkar mdzes bar rlangs 'khor bgrod lam med stabs rta khal la brten nas bskyod cing / de nas sde dge rdzogs chen nas dkar mdzes bar mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi lam bzo'i sne zin te skyel 'dren byed pa'i rlangs 'khor sogs la brten nas skyod skabs cun bco brgyad pa'i 'go khrid gras ka chab mdo nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags dang dkar mdzes nas a lu'u pu'u krang gnyis kyi phebs rogs 'og sa gnas gang du slebs kyang sa khul tang srid dmag bcas kyis go sgrig sne len gzab rgyas mdzad kyi 'dug de ni sus kyang bshig thabs med pa'i rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mdza' brtse'i mthun lam zab mo kho bo'i mig lam du 'char thengs dang po yin/ khrung chin du 'byor skabs lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi chab srid u yon ting zha'o phing sogs dbu khrid rnam pas gnam gru 'bab thang du ngo phebs kyis bsu ba gnang thog rgyud 'jam ngang ring gi sgo nas 'tshams 'dri dang / tang gi mi rigs srid jus dril bsgrags 'grel bshad gnang zhing / da dung gnam gru thang du bsu ba zhu bar phebs mkhan gras su go min tang gi dmag dpon li'u wun hu'e yang 'dug pa khong gis gsung bshad gnang song / skabs der nga'i bsam blor tang gi lam phyogs srid jus kyi rjes su mtha' gcig tu 'brang ba yin na skad grags yod pa'i dmag shed can li'u wun hu'e lta bu la'ang chab srid kyi lta skyong bkod sgrig mdun lam bzang po 'di 'dra gnang 'dug snyam pa'i tang gi chab srid la yid ches kyi blo sgo shin tu yangs pa 'byed thub pa'i 'go tshugs song /spyi lo 1951 lo'i zla 4 tshes 22nyin bod kyi zhi gros 'thus mi rgyal sa pe cin du 'byor skabs me 'khor 'bab tshugs su dga' gus 'os pa'i mi 106

dmangs kyi tsung li yag po kra'o yen les nga tshor spro sems 'khol ba'i bsu ba gnang bar ngo phebs gnang byung /zla 6tshes / rgyal spyi'i ngal rtsol dus chen gyi nyin der ngas mjal bar rings pa'i bsam tshul 'chang bzhin par gnam bde sgo mo'i yang steng du rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi sku stobs rgyas shing brjid rlabs che ba'i ngang mdzad gzigs su phebs nas dngos mjal thub pa de ni nga'i mi tshe gcig la brjed par dka' ba'i dus tshod bzang po zhig red/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa rmis wu'u han dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gnyis nas dbu bzhugs gnang ste phyogs gnyis ma'i 'thus mi tshos gros mol rim par gnang mthar spyi lo /95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun〉la ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas dang 'brel dngos su ming rtags bkod pa red/ de nas bzung rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi'i dgongs pa'i 'od zer bod ljongs sa mthor 'phros te bod 'di btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul 'ching thag las grol zhing krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam mthun sgril dang / mdza' brtse rogs res bcas yin pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang rbad de log thub pa byung ba dang bod mi dmangs rnams mun nag sdug bsngal gyi khrod nas 'od gsal bde skyid ldan pa'i phyogs su bskyod pa'i gom pa dang po spos pa red/zla 5tshes 24 dgong mo ma'o kru'u zhis nga tsho 〈 gros mthun〉'jog /07

mkhan ngo las la gsol ston gshom gnang gis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel mdzad cing / de dus nga rang yang gsol sgrog gsum pa'i gral star du 'khel bas ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku 'gram du slebs byung / ma'o kru'u zhis bzhes rag pi tse 'degs gnang gis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la ming rtags bkod pa dang / rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi mthun sgril chen po/ bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril bcas la rten 'brel gnang zhing / ma'o kru'u zhis lo ngo brgya phrag kha shas ring krung go'i mi rigs khag dbar mthun sgril med pa dang / lhag par rgya rigs dang bod rigs dbar mthun sgril med la/ bod mi rigs sa khul du'ang mthun sgril med pa de dag gi 'byung rtsa log spyod man ju srid gzhung dang / cang ce hri log spyod srid gzhung gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin la/btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rang re mi rigs kha bral du gtong rgyu snying la brnags te dbyed sbyor dkrug shing byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig kyang yin/ da cha tshang mas 'bad brtson gyis mthun sgril 'di lta bu byung ba ni krung go'i mi dmangs kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / rgyal nang log spyod dbang sgyur gtor pham mthar phyin btang bar brten gzhi nas mngon du gyur pa red/ nga tsho'i mthun sgril 'di ni phan tshun brtse sems ldan pa'i spun zla'i mthun sgril zhig las/ mthun sgril kha khyer gyis phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan zhig la gnya' gnon byed pa zhig min pas/ slad mthun sgril zab mo'i rmang gzhi'i thog nga tsho mi rigs khag tshang ma'i chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung /08
