bcas gang cir yar rgyas dang gong 'phel yong rgyu red ces mdzub ston gnang byung / gsol ston grol rjes ma'o kru'u zhis nga tsho 〈 gros mthun〉'jog mkhan 'thus mi ngo las rnams slar yang ltad mo lta bar ched 'bod gnang ba sogs de lta bu'i byams brtse'i bka' slob dang thugs 'khur gnang ba des nga tshor sems 'gul mi thebs pa ci la srid/ de sngon bod 'dir btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul bran bkol gyi lkog g.yo'i thabs ngan rim spel gyi lo rgyus rang shugs su dran gsos pa dper na bod kyi kha bral ring lugs pa ches nyung shas de tshos btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang ngan 'brel byas te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba'i skabs de dang bstun nas tā la'i bla ma mchog gro mor gdan zhu byas thog de nas phyi rgyal du gdan zhu byas te bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol la gtor bshig gtong rgyu'i re ngan bcangs/ rkyen 〈 gros mthun 〉lag len bstar thub min dang / bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong thub min thad da dung dza drag che ba'i 'thab rtsod gnas pa'i 'gag rtsa'i skabs der krung dbyang nas blo mthun krang cin wu'u bod du bca' bzhugs krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i sku tshab tu bsko gzhag gis bcings 'grol dmag gi bod du sngon bskyod yan lag dmag dpung las zla ba gcig yas mas kyi sngon la rgya gar brgyud gro mor phebs shing / skabs der tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la bros phebs dang / yang na lha sar phyir log gnang rgyu'i thad sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che gras nang khul bsam 'char gcig gyur ma byung ba'i mtshams der blo mthun krang cin wu'u yis ma'o kru'u zhis bskur gnang ba'i phyag bris dang / ma'o kru'u zhis tā la'i bla mas bod kyi 'thus mi pe cin du btang ste /09

〈 gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod pa'i rgyal gces kyi rnam 'gyur der bstod bsngags gnang lugs brgyud bsgrags gnang ba ma zad/ 〈 gros mthun〉gyi dgongs don dang / tang gi mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi srid jus dril bsgrags dang 'brel rgyal gces kyi stobs shugs rnams 'gugs thabs kyis khong tsho btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi 'od zer ldan pa'i lam chen thog bskyod rgyur skul lcag gnang stabs tā la'i bla ma lha sar phyir log phebs thub pa byung ste 〈 gros mthun 〉lag len bstar ched gom pa dang po spo thub pa byung ba red/'on kyang bod du yod pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dga' nyer bsten mkhan stobs shugs kyis smyo ham chen pos 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉dbral bshig gtong rgyu'i re ngan bcangs te lha sar mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bca' sdod byed par mkho sgrub thad dka' ngal yod pa de dang bstun nas ‘ grod khog ltogs pa de dmag pham pa las bzod dka' ba zhig red ces mngon gsal dod pos skad cor brgyab pa dang / skabs der krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis sa stong gsar sbol dang phyi phyogs nyo tshong byed pa/gzhung lam bzo ba bcas kyi bya thabs spyad nas dgra bo'i lkog g.yo gtor pham btang ste rkang pa brtan por 'dzugs thub pa byung ba red/skabs der bod kyi mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis ngan sems zur bcangs kyi sgo nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi ngan jus 'og spyi lo /952lo'i zla 3 tshes 3/ nyin 6 mi dmangs tshogs 'du nyardzus ma skong tshogs byas te mi dmangs 'thus mi zer ba'i ming btags shing / zla lo tshes / nyin gyi mtshan mor mi grangs chig stong lhag tsam bsdu rub byas nas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cin wu'u bzhugs yul sa 'du tshang gi mtha' bskor //0

ba dang / mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i 'bod tshig gang byung bton pa/ bcings 'gro dmag bod nas phyir 'then byed dgos/ bod kyi lam lugs la 'gyur ldog gtong mi chog :zer ba sogs smyo ham chen pos skad cor brgyab nas spyi tshogs su zing cha bslangs te 〈 gros mthun 〉lag len bstar rgyur ngo rgol byas pa red/ skabs der rang nyid ni bod las don u yon lhan khang dang /bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi sne shan yin/ rang gi shes tshor byung ba ni/dza drag che ba'i skabs der krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab blo mthun krang cin wu'u dang / bod dmag khul khang gi 'gan bzhes blo mthun krang go hwa/ blo mthun tha'an ga'on sa'an bcas kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon dang / drung rtsis gdan zhu gnang ste rgyu mtshan yod la/phan pa yod pa dang / mtshams tshigs yod pa bcas kyi rtsa don la brten nas tshur 'gugs thabs kyi slob gso rim pa gnang ba ma zad/ lkog tu jus 'god byed mkhan sa gnas srid gzhung gis lam seng bkag 'gog byed dgos pa'i mdzub ston kyang nan po gnang bar brten ‘ mi dmangs tshogs 'du rdzus ma'i lkog g.yo'i mthil brtol ba dang / 'thab rtsod de'i mtha' mjug tu tā la'i bla mas 6 mi dmangs tshogs 'du rdzus ma med pa bzo rgyu'i bka' phab thog lkog tu jus ngan 'don mkhan srid tshab klu khang pa dang blo bzang bkra shis gnyis gnas dbyung btang stabs mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs la rdung rdeg tsha nan phog pa dang / bod yongs kyi las don bya rgyur rmang gzhi yag po zhig 'ding thub pa byung ba bcas/(/98/ lo'i zla 6lha sar/)

bod don zhi gros dang de'i snga rjes kyi gnas tshul skor/phun tshogs dbang rgyal//949lo'i zla 10tshes / nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa de ni krung go'i gsar brjer thob pa'i dus rabs dbye ba'i rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha zhig yin pas de nas bzung krung go'i mi dmangs rnams yar langs thub pa byung zhing / kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis gzi brjid ldan pa'i ngang ‘ krung go'i mi dmangs la da nas bzung rang nyid kyis krung dbyang srid gzhung byung ba dang srid gzhung 'di nyid kyis thun mong rtsa 'dzin gzhir bzung krung go'i mnga' khongs su mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i srid dbang sger 'dzin lag bstar gyis krung go hril por bcings 'grol btang ste gong bu gcig gyur gyi rlabs chen bya gzhag sgrub rgyu red ces khyab bsgrags gnang yod/1950lor krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis do zla med cing gzhan gyis 'gog shugs bral ba'i ngang bod dang tha'e wan phud kun su'u dang /mtsho sngon/ si khron/ shis khams/ yun nan bcas kyi bod rigs sa khul tshud pa'i krung go yongs kyi zhing chen dang sa khul ches mang che ba bcings 'grol btang ba red/ bod ljongs mgyogs myur bcings 'grol btang ste mes rgyal skam sa chen po gcig gyur yong ched bod kyi gnas tshul dngos la gzhigs nas 112

krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bcings 'grol dmag la bod du dpung skyod bya rgyu'i bka' rgya btang ba dang dus mtshungs bod sa gnas srid gzhung la gros mol byed mkhan 'bus mi pe cin du gtong dgos rgyu'i brda tho gcig min gnyis min btang ste bod ljongs 'di nyid zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang rung btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi ngan skul 'og bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis nyan 'jog lta ci/ chab mdo sa khul du bod dmag phon chen btang nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyur bkag 'gog byas shing / gnas bab 'di lta bu'i 'og bcings 'grol dmag gis /950lo'i zla /0tshes 6 nyin nas 'go btsugs te 'gro lam kha shas brgyud 'bri chu brgal nas bod kyi shar phyogs chab mdo sa khul bcings 'grol btang ba red//950lo'i zla 0tshes /9 nyin chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba dang de rjes wang chi ma'e yis hru'u ci gnang ba dang nga dang hu'e dbyi ran gnyis kyis hru'u ci gzhon pa byas shing / khren cin po dang sha krung yon rnam gnyis kyis u yon gnang ba'i krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang chab mdo yan lag las don u yon lhan khang btsugs pa red/ krung dbyang dang lho nub cus kyi mdzub ston ltar nga tshos nus shugs yod rgu bton nas bod don zhi gros yong ba'i brtson len mu mthud byas pa yin/stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis srid skyong dgongs pa zhus te tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos lugs gnyis thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes rjes bka' shag gis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang zhi gros gnang rgyu'i thag gcod dang 'brel chab mdor yod pa'i nga phod ngag //3

dbang 'jigs med kyis 'thus mi gtso bo gnang rgyu gtan la phab thog de min ser skya dpon rigs re mngags te chab mdo nas pe cin la bskyod rgyu dang /de rjes slar yang ser skya'i 'thus mi re 'phar ma btang ste rgya gar dang shang kyang brgyud de pe cin du bskyod rgyu byas/ gong gsal 'gro lam khag gnyis nas zhi gros 'thus mi khyon mi lnga yong ba red/1951 lo'i zla 3pa'i zla smad du ngas krung dbyang lho nub cus dang krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi bka' slob ltar bod don zhi gros 'thus mi tshogs pa pe cin du bskyod rgyur phebs rogs zhu ba'i 'gan 'khyer ba yin/zla 3tshes 27nyin nga tsho ngo 'khor chab mdo nas rdog thon gyis pe cin la bskyod cing / bod kyi 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi gtso bo ni bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med yin pa dang 'thus mi gzhan gnyis po ni sne mgron thub bstan legs smon dang bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub yin/ da dung mnyam bskyod gas su nga phod kyi sku zla dang rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs sogs yod/ skabs der khron bod gzhung lam dkar mdzes bar ma gtogs bzo thub med stabs nga tsho ngo 'khor rta bzhon nas ri mtho g.yang gzar brgal ba dang kha rlung 'tshub po'i khrod du bskyod rgyu las ma 'das/nyin bcu lhag tsam dka' ba spyad rjes de snga'i shis khams zhing chen khongs kyi dkar mdzes rdzong mkhar du 'byor zhing khul de ni bod du dpung 'jug byed mkhan gtso shugs dmag dpung dmag sde cun bco brgyad pa'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u yi gnas gzhi yin pas nga tsho der 'byor skabs dmag sde cun bco brgyad pa'i dbu khrid dang sa gnas de ga'i tang srid de bzhin las rigs khag gi 'thus mi tsho bcas kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu thob pa dang /14

byams brtse ldan pa'i sne len gnang byung / bod kyi 'thus mi tshos gnas tshul de rigs gzigs rjes dro skyid bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba zhig tu brtsis kyi yod pa red/dkar mdzes nas rdog thon byed skabs bod las don u yon lhan khang gis las don u yon lhan khang gi gzhung las khang gi kru'u ren blo mthun lu'u yus hung 'phar ma mngags te nga dang mnyam du 'thus mi tshogs par phebs rogs zhus/ de nas bzung nga tsho gzhi nas rlangs 'khor la sdod rgyu byung /dar rtse mdo dang / ya an/ khren tu'u bcas brgyud khrung ching la 'byor zhing / skabs de'i khrung ching ni teng zha'o phing gis hru'u ci gnang ba'i krung dbyang lho nub cus dang / li'u po khren gyis kru'u zhi gnang ba'i lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang / ho lung gis si ling yon gnang ba'i lho nub dmag khul si ling pu'u bcas kyi gnas yul yin pa dang / yun nan dang ku'e kro'u/si khron/ shis khams/ bod bcas zhing chen dang sa khul lnga la 'go khrid byed pa'i lte gnas red/lo gcig gi gong khrung ching bcings 'grol btang ma thag nga la spyi khyab si ling kru'u tes btang gnang ba'i glog 'phrin zhig 'byor te nga tshos bod sogs la sa 'og gi las ka byas par 'tshams 'dri gnang ba ma zad/ 'phral du khrung ching la yong nas li'u po khren sogs 'go khrid la las don snyan seng zhu dgos pa'i bka' phab byung / der brten ngas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i bod rigs sa khul nas khrung ching du bskyod de gtso 'dzin li'u po khren dang / teng zha'o phing / ho lung bcas ngo mjal gyis nga tshos lo rabs bzhi bcu'i dus 'go nas bzung bod dang de min bod rigs sa khul du gsar brje'i bya ba spel //5

lugs dang bod kyi phyogs gang ci'i gnas tshul skor sogs snyan seng zhus pa dang / snyan seng zhus rjes ngas blo mthun zha'o phing gi mdzub ston ltar bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skor gyi 'brel yod gros 'go kha shas bton pa yin/ nga rang lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi u yon la bsko bzhag gnang byung / lho nub cus su blo mthun zha'o phing gis cun krang krang go hwa la nga rang mtshams sbyor gnang rjes blo mthun go hwa nged gnyis mnyam du gnam grur bsdad de dmag sde cun bco brgyad pa'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u gnas yul shin cin rdzong du bskyod pa yin/ ngas lho nub bod skyod dpung sde'i tang ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khyer bar brten de sngon ngas ngo sbyor byas pa'i 'ba' thang khul gyi sa 'og gung khran tang gi bod rigs las byed pa pon chen de dag de nas bzung nga dang mnyam du bod la dpung 'jug byed pa'i las don nang zhugs pa red/ des na nga bskyar du khrung ching la slebs skabs byams brtse'i tshor snang de bas chen po yong gi 'dug ngas lho nub cus kyi 'go khrid blo mthun la deng sang gi chab mdo'i g.yul sa'i gnas bab dang bod don zhi gros 'thus mi'i gnas tshul snyan seng zhus rjes 'go khrid blo mthun tshos 'thus mi tshogs pa phebs 'byor zin par spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhus gnang ba dang sbrags blo mthun zha'o phing gis 'thus mi rnam par thugs snang gshin po'i sgo nas mjal 'phrad dang dus yun ring po'i bka' mol gnang stabs khong tsho'i dogs 'char mang po sel thub pa'i khar bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong phyogs skor gyi krung dbyang gi byed phyogs srid jus sngar bas shes rtogs thub pa byung ba red/ /16

nga tsho khrung ching du 'byor skabs dpyid zla bzhi pa'i nang yin gshis mi tshang ma dbyar chas gyon 'dug kyang blo mthun lu'u lus hung nga gnyis kyis gyon pa'i dmag chas ni sngar bzhin chab mdo'i g.yul sar gyon pa'i mthug cing btsog pa'i tsha ru'i dmag chas de yin pas lho nub dmag khul gyi si ling yon gzhon pa li ta yis gzigs rjes de 'phral nged gnyis la 'go snam gyi dmag chas sa mdog gsar rkyang zhig brje ru bcug gnang byung /zla me tshes 20nyin ched gtong gnam grur bsdad de rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshos bsam pa phyogs sa'i rgyal sa pe cin du bskyod cing /skabs der nga tsho ngo 'khor so so'i bsam tshul gcig pa min pa ste bod don zhi gros 'thus mi tshos zhi gros byed ring 'phrad srid pa'i gnad don dang de bzhin zhi gros byas pa'i mjug 'bras la brno bsam gtong ba dang / nga dang blo mthun lu'u yus hung gnyis ni sngar na med pa'i sems 'gul dang dga' spro dpag med skyes kyi 'dug gang lags she na/ yun ring mjal 'dod byed pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi dang spyi khyab si ling yon kru'u te rnam gnyis mgyogs myur mjal grabs yod bsam pa dang zhi gros la grub 'bras phun sum tshogs po 'thob rgyu'i yid ches brtan po yod pas red/ nga tsho gnam grur bsdad de lam phyed tsam la slobs skabs pe cin nas glog 'phrin zhig 'byor byung ba de'i nang krung dbyang gis pe cin me 'khor babs tshugs su bod don zhi gros 'thus mi tshogs par dga' bsu zhu ba'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas shig spel rtsis yod pas khyed tsho yud tsam zhi an du babs nas me 'khor du bsdad de pe cin du yong dgos zhes 'khod 'dugazhi an gnam gru thang du nub byang mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang //7

gi kru'u ren dbang sprung sogs nga tsho bsu bar phebs byung zhing de nyin dgong mor dga' bsu zhu ba'i gsol ston bshams pa dang mgron rogs phebs mkhan gras su da dung bod rigs kyi mi sna grags can dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho'ang phebs yod/ phyi nyin nga tshos ched gtong me 'khor la bsdad de zhi an nas dog thon byas pa yin/zla 4 tshes 22nyin pe cin gyi me 'khor babs tshugs su tsung li kro'u en la'e dang / tsung li gzhon pa ku'o mo ru'o/ drung yig chen mo ba lin po chus/'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi pu'u krang li wu'e han sogs krung dbyang 'go khrid dang / las rigs khag gi mi sna/ de bzhin pe cin du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla dang spun zla'i mi rigs khag gzhan dag gi 'thus mi brgya phrag kha shas kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu thob byung / bod kyi 'thus mi tshos tsung lir mjal dar phul zhing mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal sar slebs nas gzab cing rgyas pa'i dga' bsu 'di ltar thob pas khong tshor sems 'gul tshad med thebs pa dang mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs cho'i spun zla lta bu'i mdza' mthun gyi myong tshor zab mo byung ba red/nga tsho pe cin mgon khang du bsdad cing / skabs der mgron khang de ni pe cin gyi mgron khang legs shos yin la/ 'tsho ba'i thad kyang gzigs skyong ma khyab pa med pa bkod sgrig gnang 'dug pas skyid po zhe drags byung /zla 4tshes 26nyin rgya gar dang shang nang brgyud phebs mkhan bod don zhi gros 'bus mi gzhan rnam gnyis kyang rgya gar du bca' sdod rang rgyal gyi gzhung tshab chen mo'i las shag gi dpon rigs tshan tsan hreng can gyi phebs rogs 'og pe cin du phebs 'byor gyis nga tsho mnyam du pe cin mgron khang la bzhugs /18

shing / khong tsho ni dmag spyi khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / drung yig chen mo ba thub bstan bstan dar/ rgya skad kyi lo tsā ba yab gzhis phun tshogs bkra shis/ dbyin skad kyi lo tsā ba sa 'du rin chen bcas red/zla 4 tshes 28nyin kro'u tsung lis gsol ston bshams nas bod kyi zhi gros 'thus mi tshogs pa'i khongs mi yongs la sne len gnang ba dang gsol ston la gzhug mkhan gras su krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa li ce hrong dang / srid don khang gi tsung li gzhon pa na'o mo ru'o dang hong yan phe/de bzhin krung dbyang 'brel yod sde tshan gyi 'gan 'khur ba bcas yod cing /gsol ston thog thugs snang gshin po'i mdza' grogs kyi rnam pas khengs pa dang bod kyi 'thus mi tshogs pas tā la'i bla ma'i tshab zhus te kro'u tsung li dang ma'o kru'u zhi rnam gnyis la mjal dar dang 'bul tshan phul song /zla 4 tshes 29nyin tsung li kro'u en la'e yis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis dbar gyi zhi ba'i gros mol gyi tshogs 'du thengs dang po de gtso skyong gnang zhing / tsung lis dang thog krung dbyang phyogs kyi 'thus mi gtso bo ni li wu'e han yin pa dang / 'thus mi'i gas su krang cin wu'u dang / krang go hwa/ sun kri yon bcas yin pa khyab bsgrags gnang thog blo mthun lu'u lus hung nged gnyis tshogs 'dur zur zhugs bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel yang gnang byung / bod phyogs kyi 'thus mi gtso bo ni nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med yin pa dang 'thus mi'i gras su khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / thub bstan bstan dar/ thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas red/ de rjes kro'u tsung lis tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang de bzhin bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong 1/9

rgyu'i skor gyi byed phyogs srid jus gsal bshad gnang ba ma zad/ da dung krung dbyang dang bod kyi 'thus mi tshor phan tshun bsam pa rnam dag dang 'bad brtson cher bskyed kyi zhi gros la grub 'bras phun sum tshogs po 'thob pa byas te 'di mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i pang du log nas thun mong thog krung go gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa'i lhag bsam zol med kyi re 'dun bton gnang ba red/de rjes tshogs 'du rim 'tshogs nang phyogs gnyis nas 'brel yod gnad don tshang ma bton nas phyogs so so'i lta tshul dang bsam 'char rgyas bshad byas shing / krung dbyang gi 'thus mi gtso bo li wu'e han gyis tshogs 'du 'tshogs rim bzhin du krung go gung khran tang gi mar khe si ring lugs kyi mi rigs lta tshul te mi rigs che chung la ma bltos par tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod ljongs tshud pa'i rang rgyal gyi mi rigs khag la btsan 'dzul dang gnya' gnon byed par nga tshos ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byed kyi yod la krung go rnying pa'i rgyal rabs rim byung gi dbang sgyur gral rim dang lhag par du go min tang log spyod shog khag gi rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi mi rigs gnya' gnon srid jus la'ang ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byed kyi yod lugs yang yang nan bshad gnang ba ma zad/ krung go gsar pas lag bstar byed pa'i mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam dang / mthun sgril/rogs res/ mnyam sgrub/ thun mong thog gra rgyas stobs ldan du 'gyur ba'i srid jus de dang rgyal rabs rim byung gi log spyod dbang sgyur pas lag bstar byed pa'i stobs che bas nyams zhan la brnyas bcos gtong ba dang / che bas chung bar gnya' gnon byed pa'i mi rigs mthong chung dang / dbang du 'dul 120

ba/ gnya' gnon/ rang 'drar 'gyur ba bcas kyi log spyod kyi srid jus dbar gyi mi 'dra sa'i ngo bo rgyas bshad gting zab gnang ba red/ khong gis krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mi rigs khag mthun sgril gyis shig ’ces pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i 'bod skul la gzhigs nas rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshos mthun sgril dam zab dang / phan tshun rogs ram byas te thun mong thog mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu de rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tsho'i rtsa ba'i khe phan dang mthun yod ces nan tan gyis mdzub ston gnang ba red/ blo mthun li wu'e han gyis krung go gung khran tang ni krung go'i mi rigs khag gi ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan gyi tshab byed mkhan srid tang zhig yin pas sa bdag chen po dang 'byor ldan gral rim chen po'i khe phan gyi tshab byed mkhan go min tang log spyod shog khag dang ngo bo'i thog nas khyad par yod cing / mdor na/ mi rigs shig gis mi rigs gzhan zhig la dbang sgyur dang gnya' gnon byed pa ni gung khran tang gi rtsa don dang mthun thabs gtan nas med pa zhig red ces gsal bar bton gnang ba red/bod kyi zhi gros 'thus mi tshogs pa'i phyogs nas lo rgyus dang da yod kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs dang lhag par du dus yun ring por phyi phyogs dang 'brel ba mi byed pa'i rnying zhen bag khum gyi rkyen pas khong tshos blo mthun li wu'e han gyi gong gsal rgyas bshad gnang ba'i rtsa don dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi dus bab la dgos nges kyi shes rtogs dang go ba len ma thub par rang phyogs kyi lta tshul dang dgos 'dun drangs skabs krung dbyang gi dgongs don dang dgos 'dun bar he bag ha cang chen po yod pa red/ bod kyi 'thus mi re zung gis chab /21

mdo'i g.yul 'gyed rjes dang de bzhin pe cin du slebs pa'i dus mtshams de'i nang khong tsho'i bsam blor ngos 'dzin gsar pa dang blo sgo gsar pa phye thub pa byung yod kyang 'thus mi tshogs pa'i khong mi'i ngos nas bshad na/ khong tshor bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis bkod mngags byas pa'i lta ba dang dgos 'dun de dag gros mol byed skabs 'gyur ba med par rgyas bshad byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ de ni zhi gros thog mar byed skabs 'phrad pa'i gzhi rtsa'i dka' gnad de yin zhing / don der gzhigs nas tshogs 'du'i phyi nang gang yin la kro'u tsung li sogs krung dbyang 'go khrid pas bka' mol thengs mang gnang ba dang lhag par du blo mthun li wu'e han gyis ngang rgyud ring pos gsal bshad gnang ba red/ khong gis sba gsang med pa'i sgo nas rgyal rabs rim byung gi krung dbyang srid gzhung gi mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi srid jus lag len bstar stabs bod phyogs kyis da lta bar dogs zon cher bskyed byed pa'i rnam 'gyur dang dogs 'char sna tshogs skyes pa ni thugs khag gtan nas med pa zhig red/ 'on kyang nga tshos gung khran tang gi srid jus khag gsal bshad byas pa ltar da lta'i krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi krung go rnying pa'i krung dbyang srid gzhung gi nor 'khrul de dag gtan nas skyar zlos byed mi srid pa de'i thad slad phyin gyi lo zla'i nang lag len dngos kyis ra sprod byed kyi red ces mdzub ston gnang song / krung dbyang gi 'thus mi tshos lhag bsam zol med kyi bka' mol thengs mang gnang rjes bod kyi 'thus mi tshos krung dbyang gi dgongs don la rim bzhin ngos 'dzin thub pa byung ste thog ma'i lta stangs 'gyur nas dngos yod gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bsam 'char de dag mu mthud u tshugs brgyab med pa red//22

gnas tshul la gzhigs te blo mthun li wu'e han dang sun kri yon rnam gnyis kyis gnad don 'dir 'dzin pa'i nga tsho'i rtsa don te/ rgyal rabs rim byung gi dbang sgyur pa ltar bod nang khul du chos srid gnyis kyi gtso 'dzin dbar gyi 'gal zla bed spyad de rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur gyi dmigs yul sgrub thabs gtan nas byed kyi ma red ces 'grel bshad gnang ba ma zad/ paṇa chen rin po che'i go bab dang dbang cha slar gso byed dgos zhes pa ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng dgu pa rnam gnyis thugs mthun po yod skabs kyi go bab dang dbang char zer gyi yod pa gsal bshad kyang gnang ba dang de bzhin chab srid kyi go bab thad tā la'i bla ma bgres pa gnang rgyu dang / paṇa chen rin po che gzhon pa gnang rgyu de lugs mthun gyi sgo nas gtan 'bebs gsal po gnang ba red/ yang nas yang du gsal bshad dang 'grel bshad gnang stabs mthar de'i thad bod phyogs kyi 'thus mi tsho'i dogs pa rtsa ba'i cha nas sel thub pa byung song / 'on kyang bod du dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i gnad don thad phyogs 'gal ha cang chen po thon zhing / blo mthun li wu'e han gyis gnad don der gros mol ma byas gong de'i thad 'thus mi gtso bo nga phod dang bka' mol gnang yod kyang tshogs 'du'i thog bod kyi 'thus mi gzhan dag gis ngo rgol bya rgyu'i bsam 'char bton pa red/ khong tshos dmag don u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu de ni 6bod srid gzhung gi gnya' thog tu slar yang mi zhig bzhon pa dang gnyis su med pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pas de'i thog nas zhi gros 'byung thabs thor nyer thug pa red/ ngas gnad don gyi 'byung rkyen dang go nor shor ba'i rtsa ba shes rjes nga la sems 'tshab ha cang chen po skyes byung / der brten ngas bod 124

kyi 'thus mi so sor dpes bton gyi 'grel bshad dang gsal bshad byas te bod la de ltar yin pa ma zad/ rgyal yongs kyi zhing chen dang ljongs gzhan dag tshang mar yang bar brgal rang bzhin gyi dmag srid u yon lhan khang btsugs lugs bshad pa yin/ 'on kyang kho tsho'i dogs gnad sngar bzhin sel dka' zhing mtha' mjug ngas gal srid bod kyi dmag srid u yon lhan khang ni bod gzhung sga gnya' thog tu bzhon pa'i mi zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod na mi de ni gzhan dag min par bod gzhung gi gtso 'dzin tā la'i bla ma mchog rang red/ gang yin zhe na/ dmag srid u yon lhan khang de'i kru'u zhi tā la'i bla ma mchog gis gnang rgyu dang / paṇa chen rin po che dang krang go hwa rnam gnyis kyis kru'u zhi gzhon pa gnang rgyur krung dbyang gis dmigs 'dzugs gnang rgyu yin pa pu'u krang li wu'e han gyis gsal thag chod gsung myong ba red ces dang da dung ngas don der ngo rgol shugs che shos byed mkhan khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang thub bstan bstan dar gnyis la 6 'o na mi gcig gis rang gis rang gi gnya' thog tu bzhon srid kyi red dam zhes par 'dri ba bton pa yin/ tshogs 'du ma 'tshogs pa'i bar gseng la zhib tshags shing ngang ring gi 'grel bshad brgyab rjes mthar kho tshos bod kyi dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi gnas bab dang / ngo bo/ 'gan dbang bcas gsal po shes thub pa byung ba red/rnyog 'dzing che ba'i rgyal phyi rgyal nang gi log spyod stobs shugs sna tshogs kyis the jus byas rkyen mjug 'bras ngan pa thon srid nyen la gzhigs nas gnad don khag gcig don dngos thog bod sa gnas srid gzhung la glog 'phrin thog nas tshig bsdus por 'grel bshad rgyag dka' zhing lhag par du /25

'phrin gtong gi cha rkyen zhan par brten bod kyi 'thus mi tshogs pas don dag yod tshad dus thog tu dgongs skor zhu thub kyi med pa red/ dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul de rigs 'og lo rgyus la 'gan 'khur ched dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i zhi gros kyi 'thus mi rnams kyis rang nyid kyi 'gan dbang lag bstar yag po byed ched gros don gyi zur gtogs yig cha tshud pa'i dgos nges kyi thugs thag bcad gnang ba red/mdor na/ bod bcings 'grol gtong ba dang mes rgyal gcig gyur yong ba ni dus bab kyi 'phel phyogs dang mi sems gtad phyogs shig yin la krung dbyang gis gtan la phab zin pa'i byed phyogs kyang yin zhing / gzhi rtsa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen de'i 'og bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur brtson len thub na krung dbyang dang yang sgos bod la phan thogs ha cang chen po yod pa der ngos 'dzin dang go ba len rgyu de ni gal 'gangs shin tu che ba zhig yin/'gag gnad la thug pa'i gnad don thag gcod bya rgyu de mi su 'dra zhig gi rnam 'gyur mtshon tshul la rag las pa zhig ma yin par de ni skabs de'i gsar brje'i lo rgyus hril po'i 'phel rim ldog med du slebs yod pas red/ der brten bod kyi 'thus mi nang rnying zhen gyi mi re gnyis yod rung don dngos kyi mdun du zhi gros tshad nges can zhig tu slebs skabs khyon yongs la lta thub pa dang dus bab ngos 'dzin byed thub pa byung yod pa red/zhi ba'i gros mol 'go nas mjug bar tshogs 'du'i phyi nang du gros mol yang yang byed dgos byung ba dang tha na skabs 'gar rtsod gleng drag po thug cing /'on kyang de ni ya mtshan gtan nas skyes mi dgos pa zhig red/ gang ltar mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang khul gyi don dag yin stabs tshang mas phan /26

tshun lhag bsam zol med dang kha gsal gting gsal bcas byas te ngos 'dzin gcig gyur byung mthar krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la gos 'cham byung ba red/zla 5tshes 23nyin krung nan ha'e yi cing krong tan zer ba'i tshoms chen du brjid chags shing lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i gros don la ming rtags bkod pa'i mdzad sgo 'tshogs shing / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u te dang li ci hreng dang / srid don khang gi tsung li gzhon pa khren yun/ kro'u tsung li sku gzugs bde po med pas khren yun gyis tshab gnang ba bcas kyis gtso skyong gnang ba red/ mdzad sgor phebs mkhan gras su tung pi wu'u dang / pheng kren/ hong yan pha'e/ khren hru'u thung / nya'e rung kren/ wu'u lan phu'u/ phu'u tsu'o dbyi/ lung yun/ sa'e phu'u teng / li'u ke phing / ma shu'i lun/ khu'i te hong / kru'u zhu'e glen sogs 'brel yod 'go khrid yod pa red/ nga dang blo mthun lu'u lus hung gis gros mol gyi zur zhugs mi sna'i ngos nas ming rtags bkod pa'i mdzad sgor zhugs pa yin/krung dbyang dang bod kyi 'thus mi so sos ming rtags bkod rjes 'thus mi gtso bo li wu'e han dang nga phod rnam gnyis kyis smon tshig gsungs pa dang / de rjes kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u tes gsung bshad gnang / ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo mjug bsgril 'phral mi brgya phrag kha shas zhugs pa'i gros mol legs grub byung bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i bzhes rag tshogs 'du gzab rgyas shig 'tshogs shing / 'di ni dus rabs gsar pa phye ba'i don snying ldan pa'i nyin mo zhig yin/ de nas bzung bod mi dmangs rnams btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi 127

btsan 'dzul 'ching rgya las gtan du bral te mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i pang du log nas bod kyi lo rgyus le'u gsar rkyang zhig 'byed thub pa byung ba red/blo mthun li wu'e han gyi 'go khrid dang rgyab skyor 'og ngas zhi gros kyi don la las ka phran bu byas rkyen 〈 gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel zhu ba'i bzhes rag tshogs 'du'i thog blo mthun li wu'e han gyis nga la ched du bzhes rag bkyag gnang ste khyed kyis byas rjes chen po bzhag song zhes gzengs bstod gnang byung / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus ni bod kyi zhi gros 'thus mi tshogs pa'i khrod kyi gal che'i mi sna zhig yin pa dang khong ni skabs de'i bod kyi dmag spyi yin pa ma zad/ bka' shag nang dbang cha chen po yod pa'i bka' blon zur khang (dbang chen dge legs )kyi a khu yang red/khong gis kyang bzhes rag tshogs 'du'i thog bzhes rag pi tsi btegs nas nga lo 6 lo gnyis kyi gong nga tsho bka' shag gis khyed rang bod nas phyir 'bud byas song yang khyed kyis da res kyi zhi gros nang lhag bsam rnam dag gi phyag las gnang stangs yag po des thog mar nga tshos khyed rang la bcangs pa'i dogs pa de rbad de sel thub song / nga tshos khyed kyis bod rgya gnyis mthun lam yong ba'i ched du nus pa ha cang chen po bton pa dngos mu mthong byung zhes bshad byung / lhag par du ngas brjed par dka' ba zhig ni ma'o kru'u zhis krung dbyang gzhung las thing gi blo mthun thung zha'o hphung nga la 〈 lag len rnam bshad 〉ces pa'i deb cig skyel bar gtong gnang mdzad 'dug deb 'di'i rgyab sha'i steng kru'u zhis 5blo mthun phun tshogs dbang rgyal la ma'o tse tung nas 7zhes spu smyug gi yig gzugs shugs drag chen po zhig bris gnang 'dug cing /thob par dka' ba'i rtsa che'i phyag bris bstar ma de ngas da lta bar dran rten /28

dngos por brtsis nas nyar tshags zhu bzhin yod/zla 5 tshes 24 nyin ma'o kru'u zhis ho rin thang tshoms chen du bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob par rten 'brel zhu ba'i gsol ston gzab rgyas nang zhugs pa gnang zhing gsol ston gyi gong tsam la blo mthun lu'u lus hung nged gnyis la ho ren thang gi sgo ra'i nang yun ring mjal 'dod chen po byed pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi glo bur mjal byung bas nged gnyis kyis mgyogs myur sku mdun du bcar te blo mthun lu'u yus hung gis 'phral du dmag mi'i gus lugs zhus pa dang sbrags ma'o kru'u zhir nga ngo sprod zhus song / ma'o kru'u zhis nga'i lag pa dam por bzung gnang ba dang 'dzum dmul dmul ngang ‘ a las blo mthun phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags yin pa red/ ngas khyed rang rgyus yod mices gsungs rjes thugs dgyes tshor chen po'i ngang nga'i phrag par bcag bcag gnang bzhin du /gzhon nu dpa' cha thang mdog kha po 'dug ang 7zhes gsungs byung /gsol ston thog ma'o kru'u zhi dang / paṇa chen rin po che/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ khren hru'u thung /li wu'e han/ ma dbying khru'u/ nga rang bcas gsol sgrog dang por yod pas ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' mol yang ngas thos thub byung zhing / gsol tshigs bzhes ring ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku gzugs thang nyams dod pa dang gsung mol bzhad gad tsha ba bcas ha cang mnyes tshor chen po gnang gi 'dug khong gis thugs dgyes nyams ldan pa'i ngang krung go'i lo rgyus thog rtag tu rgyal kha len mkhan dmag dpon zhu'e rin ku'e zhes pa zhig yod pa de thu sgod kyi dmag dpung gis pham nyes su btang ba'i skor dang / da dung thu lhad dmag dpung gis khrang /29

yen bar dpung 'jug thengs gnyis byas lugs gsungs nas bod rigs ni rlabs che zhing stobs shugs che ba'i mi rigs shig yin pa gsal bshad kyang gnang song /ma'o kru'u zhis smon tshig gsung skabs lo brgya phrag kha shas ring krung go'i mi rigs khag dbar mthun po med la bod rigs nang khul du'ang mthun po med/ de ni rgyal rabs rim byung gi log spyod shog khag gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin la/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis nang khul du dbyed sbyor dkrug shing brgyab nas bzos pa zhig kyang red/ da cha krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'go khrid stobs shugs dang tā la'i bla mas 'go khrid gnang ba'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi stobs shugs/ paṇa chen rin po ches 'go khrid gnang ba'i stobs shugs bcas tshang ma mthun sgril byed thub cing mthun sgril de rigs ni spun zla lta bu'i mthun sgril zhig yin pa las/ phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan zhig la gnya' gnon byed pa zhig min la/ phyogs tshang mas thun mong thog 'bad brtson byas pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig kyang yin pas/ mthun sgril byas te thun mong thog mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po 'dzugs skrun dang bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed dgos zhes gsungs/ de rjes ma'o kru'u zhis bzhes rag pi tsi btegs nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob par bzhes rag mnyes thag bzhes rogs zhes gsungs pa dang / tshogs rwa yongs kyis spro sems 'khol ba'i thal mo'i deb sgra'i khrod du phan tshun bzhes rag btegs nas bkra shis bde legs zhus shing / ngas kyang ma'o kru'u zhir bzhes rag bkyag pas kru'u zhis byams brtse ldan pa'i ngang slokhyed tshos dus yun ring po'i nang bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol gtong chen sku las bskyon /30

yod pas 'o brgyal che song 7zhes gsungs byung /nyin der ma'o kru'u zhi dang / li'u hra'o chi/ kru'u te/ kro'u yen la'i sogs krung dbyang gi 'go khrid dang de bzhin 'brel yod phyogs kyi 'gan 'khur ba bcas mi grangs nyis brgya lhag tsam gsol ston la phebs yod pa dang mthun lam gyi rnam pa shin tu ldan pa de'i thog nas krung dbyang gis bod la byams brtse'i thugs khur gnang lugs mtshon thub pa dang / bod kyi zhi gros 'thus mis kyang mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i dro skyid de zab tshor thub pa byung ba red/zhi gros kyi brgyud rim hril po'i nang krung dbyang dang bod phyogs so sor skad bsgyur byed mkhan yod rung skabs der zhib phra'i gnas tshul la krung dbyang gi srid jus dgongs don stangs 'dzin legs par byed dgos pa ma zad/'brel yod gnad don la bab bstun gyi dus thog tu dgos nges kyi 'grel bshad rgyag dgos pa sogs kyis rkyen pas kro'u tsung li dang blo mthun li lu'e han gyis nga la gal che'i tshogs 'du'i skad bsgyur dang 'grel bshad rgyag pa'i las ka bkod sgrig gnang byung /nga rang krung dbyang 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'brel yod tshogs 'dur zhugs dgos pa phud/ da dung ngas tshogs 'du grol rjes bod kyi 'thus mi tshor dgongs sel zhu rgyu dang / dogs gnad sel rgyu/ chab srid kyi tha snyad sna tshogs kyi go don bsgyur rgyu sogs kyi zhib phra'i las ka yang byed dgos kyi yod la/de min nyin re blo mthun li lu'e han gyi sar las don snyan seng yang zhu dgos stabs rtag tu nam phyed bar las ka byed dgos kyi yod/ma'o kru'u zhi dang kro'u tsung li'i thad ku'i 'go khrid 'og blo mthun li wu'e /3/

han gyis nyin mtshan med par nan zhing zhib tshags dang khur sems chen po bcas kyi sgo nas rgyun las 'bor chen gnang yod cing / ngas rtag par mtshan mor khong gi phyag las gnang yul du nyin re'i gnas tshul snyan seng zhu bar 'gro skabs skabs 'gar mtshan mo'i chu tshod dang po bar 'gor gyi 'dug khong gis ga dus yin na'ang zhib tshags ngang gsan pa dang de rjes zhib phra'i mdzub ston yang gnang gi yod/ zhi gros kyi dus mtshams mjug mar 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun bod yig la bsgyur zin pa'i skabs der blo mthun li wu'e han gyis rgya yig thog nas tshig 'bru re re bzhin ljags klog gnang ba dang /nga la bod yig tu bsgyur bcug rjes mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi blo mthun gdan 'dren zhus nas yang skyar mnyam du zhib bsher zhus dag btang ste bod kyi 'thus mi tshogs par nan tan gyis bsgyur yig bzo bcos rgyag bcug gnang ba red/ yig cha'i spus tshad 'gan len byed ched khong gis nga la bod yig nas rgya yig la phab bcug ste yig 'bru re dang tshig 'bru re byas nas klog tu bcug gnang byung / 6mi dmangs zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di gcig phur cha mtshon na/ khong gis 'brel yod mi sna skong 'du byas te bsam blo yang skor skyar skor btang nas bsgyur stangs mi 'dra sa kha shas nang nas mthar ngas bsgyur ba'i /mi dmangs zhes pa der mos mthun gtan 'khel gnang ba red/khong gis las don gyi ched du zas brjed gnyid bral dang khral sel sla bcos spu tsam med pa'i las ma'i rnam 'gyur des nga la brjed par dka' ba'i bag chags zab mo bzhag byung /nga la bag chags zab shos shig ni bod kyi dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i skor nas zhi ba'i gros mol thor la nye ba'i nyen kha byung ba de dag /32

sel thub rjes ngas srid don khang du blo mthun li wu'e han la snyan seng zhu bar 'gro skabs khong shin tu mnyes po byung ste lam seng sgrog tse'i steng yod pa'i kha par blangs nas ma'o kru'u zhir zhal par thog kru'u zhi/ nga lu'o man yin/ blo mthun phun tshogs dbang rgyal phebs byung / khong gis sang nyin zhi ba'i gros mol bya rgyu slar gso byed chog pa yod zer gyi 'dug :ces zhus gnang song /nam phyed rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la ngas ma'o kru'u zhi'i hu'u nan gyi yul skad dam po'i gsung de thengs dang po gsal thing thing thos byung la lu'o man zer ba de khong (li wu'e han)yin pa gzhi nas ha go byung /zhi ba'i gros mol byed skabs blo mthun li wu'e han nged gnyis snga dgong mnyam gshib kyis gleng mol zab mo byas pa brgyud khong ni yon tan can dang chab srid kyi nyams myong phun sum tshogs po ldan pa'i 'go khrid blo mthun zhig yin la/ dge rgan nan po zhig dang / grogs po mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par tshor snang zab mo skyes byung /khong gi kha ri kha thug gi gshis ka ni nga tsho khams pa dang 'dra po yod cing /zhi ba'i gros mol la grub 'bras thob pa de ni blo mthun li wu'e han gyis 'bad brtson chen po gnang ba dang kha bral thabs med/ don de'i ched du khong gis sems nus ha cang chen po bton lugs da lta'ang mig gi 'dun du lham mer 'char gyi 'dugazhi ba'i 〈 gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod rjes krung dbyang gi blo mthun krang cing lu'u bod sdod krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi la gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang don ltar zla 6tshes /3nyin pe cin nas gnam grur bzhugs te nyin rdu brgyud bod la phebs /33

pa dang phebs rogs su kru'u ren lu'u yus hung dang blo mthun phun bkra sogs yod pa red/ khe smad sogs bod kyi 'thus mi tsho'ang 'bus mi krang cing wu'u dang mnyam du bod la phyir log byas/ zla gatshes /4nyin 'thus mi krang cing lu'u krung nyin sa mtshams su yod pa'i rang rgyal gyi gnad che'i grong rdal gro mor phebs 'byor zin nas de gar tā la'i bla ma dang mjal 'dzoms zhus te ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag ltar ma dang 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun gyi 'dra ya par ma bcas phul bas tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag srid gzhung gi dpon rigs yongs rdzogs zla 8tshes /7nyin gro mo nas lha sar phyir phebs gnang ba red/zla 6tshes 2nyin ngas nga phod sogs 'thus mi la phebs rogs zhus te pe cin nas lha sar thon cing / nga tsho ngo 'khor khrung ching du 'byor ba'i nyin der mang tshogs khri tsho bcu phrag kha shas kyis shog sbag spar zhing lag tu me tog 'phyar te spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang zhi gros 'thus mir dga' bsu zhus pa dang /teng zha'o phing sogs 'go khrid blo mthun grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su phebs nas bsu ba gnang byung / nga tsho khrung ching du sdod ring blo mthun zha'o phing gis 'thus mi tshogs par mjal 'phrad gnang zhing / de rjes nga tsho khreng tu'u dang /dar rtse mdo/ dkar mdzes bcas brgyud de chab mdor 'byor skabs de ga'i tang srid dmag dang ser skya mang tshogs brgya phrag kha shas kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu thob byung /nga tsho chab mdor slebs rjes lha sar dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i gra sgrig las don byed 'go btsugs pa yin/ si ling yon krang go hwa dang chab srid u yon than kon san gyis thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i dmag sde cun bco brgyad pa'i spyi /34

khyab bkod 'doms pu'u yang dkar mdzes nas chab mdor spo bsgyur byas te lha sar dpung 'jug byed pa'i sngon skyod dpung sde sgrig 'dzugs kyis blo mthun wang chi ma'i yis hru'u ci gnang ba dang / ling le'ang dang / zhu'e tan lu'u/khren cing po/ lu'o ca ma'o dang nga bcas kyis u yon byas pa'i krung gung lha sa'i sngon skyod dpung sde'i tang u yon lhan khang btsugs pa dang / cun tang ud kyis nga rang yul mi'i skyel 'dren pu'u yi pu'u krang la bsko gzhag gnang byung /zla 3tshes 25nyin sngon skyod dpung sde chab mdo nas lha sar thon pa dang 'thus mi nga phod sogs kyang nga tsho dang mnyam du phebasashing / chab mdo nas lha sar dpung 'jug byed pa'i lam bar dka' tshegs shin tu che zhing / mtho tshad smi lnga stong drug stong yod pa'i shar gangs la dang nub gangs la yod pa ma zad/ rang byung gi cha rkyen zhan pa'i dka' ngal khyad bsad byed dgos thog da dung bsam yul las 'das pa'i rnyog 'dzing can gyi gnad don thag gcod kyang byed dgos kyi yod/ gzhan yang nga tshos lam bar gyi bod rigs mang tshogs la bsam blo'i las ka byas nas khong tshos gung khran tang dang gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la rgyus mnga' dang rgyab skyor yong thabs byed kyi yod/195/ lo'i zla gatshes 8nyin nga tsho tshal gung thang du 'byor dus gzhi nas gser 'od chem chem 'phro ba'i pho brang po ta la'i rgya phibs mthong gi 'dug ngas zu nga tsho lha sar slebs song zhes blo mthun wang chi ma'e sogs la bshad ma thag tshang ma spro ba rab tu 'phel song / nga tsho lha sa skyid chu'i 'gram du slebs rjes ko grur bsdad de skyid chu brgal zhing chu'i pha rol du slebs ma thag gram thang /35

thog sgar btab ste nyin gnyis rang ngal gso legs sgrig gis de nas grong khyer spyang bskyod rgyu dang lha sa'i mi dmangs dang thug 'phrad bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas pa —na/bka' shag nas btang ba'i ser skya dpon rigs kha shas skyid chu'i 'gram du dga' bsu zhu bar yong ba dang blo mthun krang cing lu'u yis kyang blo mthun lu'u yus hung nga tsho bsu bar btang gnang 'dugang phod sku 'khor rnams nga tsho dang mnyam du skyid chu ma brgal bar skyid chu'i shar ngos kyi shang ma'i gzhis mar nyin gsum bzhugs shing pe cin du bzhugs skabs khong gis lcang lo bregs yod pa der bka' shag gi 'dod par babs min gyis khong la snga lam bzhin skra lcog brgyab thog gos tshad phyu pa gyon nas tā la'i bla mar 'byor phyag zhu bar bcar dgos rgyu'i bka' btang ba red/phyi nyin zhogs pa nga tsho tshang mas gtsang zhing gral 'grig pa'i dmag chas gyon pa dang khur po dang / bza' chas/ 'phyid bdar 'od thing nger btang ba'i go mtshon bcas 'khyer te skyid chu'i 'gram nas lha sar thon cing / grong nang ma 'dzul gong bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis bka' blon mdo mkhar ba dang sha zur gnyis mngags te lam zur gyi spang gshong steng gur phub thog nga tshor dga' bsu zhus byung / nga tsho 'gan khur blo mthun kha shas kyis gur nang 'dzul ma thag khong tsho dang phan tshun mjal dar bsgron res byas te lam seng grong khyer nang 'dzul ba yin/skar lnga'i dar dmar gyis dpung sde'i sne khrid pa dang / 'phred gdang sbyar yig dang dar tshon bsgrengs pa'i ru star gyi rjes su ma'o kru'u zhi dang spyi khyab si ling kru'u te rnam gnyis kyi sku par bris ma chen po btegs nas 'khyer /36

yong ba/ de ga'i rjes su rig rtsal las don mi sna bcu phrag kha shas las grub pa'i dmag mi'i rol cha ru khag dang sked rnga ru khag yod/ sngon skyod dpung sdes gom stabs 'grig po spo ba dang dmag glu len bzhin du grong nang 'dzul ba dang nga dang blo mthun wang chi ma'e sogs dpung sde'i mdun rkyang du phyin pa yin/grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs nas grong khyer nang khul du brgyud skabs 'tshang ga shig shig gi mang tshogs tshos 'gro lam gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis la bsdad de mthong myong gtan nas med pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la bsu ba zhu ba dang ltad mo blta gi 'dug grong khyer lha sa'i sbra nag zhol gyi khri smon gzim shag mdun du slebs skabs sngon la lha sar phebs 'byor zin pa'i krung dbyang gi sku tshab krang cing wu'u sogs thog kha'i steng bzhengs bzhugs pa mthong byung bas nga tsho phan tshun thugs snang gshin po'i ngang lag brda byas te gus tshul zhu res byas/ thog ma'i 'char gzhi ltar nga tshos mi tshogs kyis khengs pa'i bar skor la bskor ba gcig brgyab rjes sdod nas dmag sgar gsar par sgrig bkod byas yod pas der bskyod de bsdad pa yin/sngon skyod dpung sde grong khyer nang 'dzul ba'i mdzad sgo de 'go nas mjug bar brjid chags ldan la mdza' grogs kyi rnam pa'i khrod du byas gshis/ lha sa'i las rigs khag gi mang tshogs cho1re bsam blo'i nang bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag pa red/dmag sgar gsar pa ni bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis sngon tshud nas nga tsho'i sdod gnas ched du bkod sgrig byas pa zhig red/ bka' shag gis khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa gnyis sngon skyod dpung sder sne len byed mkhan du btang bas nga tsho lha sar thog mar /37

slebs skabs las ka yod tshad khong gnyis brgyud de sa gnas srid gzhung dang 'brel ba byed dgos kyi yod/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bod sdod sku tshab blo mthun krang cing wu'u yi 'go khrid 'og lha sar thengs dang po 'byor ba'i krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dmag sde cun brgyad pa'i sngon skyod dpung sde dang de'i tang gi u yon lhan khang gis ma'o kru'u zhi'i ca bod kyi gnad don gang 'dra zhig la bsam blo btang rung dang thog mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi don dag gnyis po bsam blo 'khor ba byas te las don thams cad brtan brling gzab skyod byed dgos zhes pa'i mdzub ston la gzhigs nas ma bskul dang blangs dang hur brtson chen pos dang thog bod kyi mtho rim mi sna dang las rigs khag gi 'thus mi tshor 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don spel ba dang / 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun dang / tang gi mi rigs chos lugs kyi srid jus/mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad bcas dril bsgrags byas pa yin/ blo mthun wang chi ma'e nged gnyis dang de bzhin 'brel yod phyogs kyi blo mthun mnyam du mjal dar dang / 'bul tshan/ ma'o kru'u zhi dang spyi khyab si ling kru'u te rnam gnyis kyi sku par bcas 'khyer nas srid tshab gnyis dang / bka' blon bka' tshab brgyad/drung yig chen mo bzhi/ rtsis dpon bzhi/ gzhan yang dza sag dang tha'i ji bcas dang / de bzhin rim bzhi dang se 'bras dga' gsum/ gling bzhi'i mkhan po/ da dung srid zur stag brag rin po che sogs la 'tshams zhu dang bcas chab srid kyi lta ba dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'dzin mkhan mtho rim mi sna dang las rigs khag gi 'thus mi tsho dang thug 'phrad dang po byas pa dang / nga /38

tshos mthun sgril byed thub pa'i spyi tshogs kyi stobs shugs mtha' dag brtson len byas te btsan rgol rgyal gces kyis 〈gros mthun 〉la brtsi bkur zhu mkhan rgya khyab kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur cig 'dzugs rgyu'i las ka byed 'go btsugs pa yin/1951 lo'i zla 9tshes 24nas tshes 26bar bka' shag gis slobod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa 7'tshogs te nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs zhi gros kyi 'thus mi lngas tshogs 'dur 〈gros mthun〉don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i brgyud rim snyan seng zhus pa dang sbrags 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi ma yig tshogs chen la bstan nas tshogs 'du de'i thog gzab nan gyis gsal bsgrags spel don/ 〈 gros mthun 〉gyis tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin bstan srid dang / chab 'bangs mi ser gyi bde rtsar phan slebs byung yod na phyag bzhes gnang rgyu dang / phan thogs byung min 'dug na nga tsho mi lnga'i lus srog longs spyod thog bka' nyes gang gnang rung 'gyod pa med ces gsungs/tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyis gros bsdur byas mthar 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa de gong sa chen po'i mdzad 'phrin dang / bstan pa chab srid/ chab 'bangs/ dpal 'byor sogs gang cir phan slebs 'di lhag yong thub min 'dug pas 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la brtsi srung dang lag len zhu rgyu yin zhes tshig tho spyi tham bzhi sbyar bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla mar phul ba red/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi snga lam ltar na/ tā la'i bla mar mtha' ma'i thag gcod gnang dbang yod pa bzhin zla 10tshes 24nyin khong gis ma'o kru'u /39

zhir 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i glog 'phrin zhig phul gnang ba dang ma'o kru'u zhis kyang khong la 'phrin lan btang gnang ste gzengs bstod skul lcag gnang ba red/zla /0tshes 26nyin bod skyod dpung sde'i gtso shugs dmag lha sar 'byor ba dang lha sa'i nye 'dabs kyi shar ngos su dmag gzigs sding cha btsugs nas brjid chags ldan pa'i ngang dmag gzigs kyi mdzad sgo spel te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi gtso shugs dmag dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dmag dpung la gzigs zhib gnang zhing / dmag gzigs stegs bu'i thog bod sdod krung dbyang gi sku tshab krang cing wu'u dang / cun bco brgyad pa'i gtso 'dzin krang go hwa/ than kon san/ wang chi ma'e/ li cu'i/li'u kren go zan rang bcas dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon khri pa ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs dang / bka' tshab sha zur 'jigs med rdo rje/ dam po ma' rab dbang phyug dga' brang blo bzang rig 'dzin/ dmag spyi khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus sogs yod pa dang / lam g.yas g.yon du ltad mo blta mkhan mang tshogs kyis khengs yod pa red/ dmag gzigs 'bul mkhan dpung sde'i gral star 'grig cing brjid chags pa/ sgrig khrims dam srung sogs gzab rgyas kyi rnam pa ni sngar na med pa zhig yod stabs lha sa'i mi dmangs la bag chags zab mo bzhag pa red/zla /2tshes / nyin blo mthun hphan ming gis gtso bo gnang ba'i nub byang rang tshugs yan lag ru khag kyang lha sar 'byor zhing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su dpon rigs btang ste bsu ba zhus pa /40

dang / blo mthun lu'u yus hung dang / zhus tan lu'u/ khren cing po/ ngos rang sogasabasu ba zhu bar phyin pa yin/ rang tshugs yan lag ru khag gi rta dmag rnams bar skor du bskor ba thengs gcig brgyab song //952lo'i zla ska tshes 28 nyin paṇa chen er te ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan rin po che mchog dang paṇa chen nang sgang gi dza sag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med/ dza sag lha smon ye shes tshul khrims sogs mtsho sngon nas nag chu brgyud lha sar phebs 'byor byung zhing / krung dbyang gi gtan 'bebs ltar blo mthun hphan ming dang yā han krang rnam gnyis kyis khong rnam pa bod du phebs skyel zhus pa red/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog bod du chibs bsgyur gnang ba thengs dang po yin gshis/ bka' shag gi dpon rigs yongs rdzogs grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs rkyang thang na ga bar bcar nas phebs bsu zhus pa dang / grong khyer lha sa'i mi rigs khag dang las rigs khag gi ser skya mang tshogs dang mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag gis kyang grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs la spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhu bar bskyod yod pa red/ de nyin phyi dror 'od stong rab tu 'phro ba'i po ta la'i pho brang gi gzims chung nyi 'od nang bod kyi sngar srol ltar tā la'i bla ma mchog dang paṇa chen rin po che mchog rnam gnyis mjal 'dzoms gnang zhing / de ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu pa rnam gnyis lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i mjal 'dzoms shig yin la/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i dbu khrid 'og rin po che rnam gnyis kyis de snga'i 'gal ba dor nas gru gcig nang du bzhugs pa lta bu'i mtshon rtags shig kyang red/ de nas yun ring ma song bar paṇa chen rin po che mchog bde blag ngang bkras lhun dgon du chibs bsgyur bskyangs//4/

krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' slob la gzhigs nas bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid blo mthun krang go hwa sogs tā la'i bla ma dngos su mjal bar 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel byas pa dang 'brel mjal 'phrad zhu ba'i tshes grangs kyang bka' mol zhus pa red/mjal 'phrad zhu ba'i nyin der dmag mi'i rol cha ru khag gi rol cha'i sgra'i khrod du nga tshos rtsa che'i 'bul tshan 'khyer ba dang rta bzhon te nor bu gling kha'i spyan gzigs pho brang du bskyod cing / bka' blon yongs dang ser skya dpon rigs brgya skor gyi drung ja grol rjes 'jal 'phrad kyi mdzad sgo 'tshogs pa red/ nga tshos gral ltar bsgrigs nas pho brang nang slebs rjes dang thog blo mthun krang go hwa yis bod rigs kyi gus srol ltar bzhugs khri'i thog yod pa'i tā la'i bla ma mchog la mjal dar dang maṇḍal rten gsum phul ba dang / de rjes las don u yon lhan khang gis gtan 'bebs gnang ba bzhin ngas sku phyag phul rjes mjal dar dang maṇḍal rten gsum phul ba yin/ blo mthun gzhan dag tshos kyang sku mdun du bcar te mjal dar phul song / tshang ma gdan la 'khod rjes nga tshor gsol ja dang gro 'bras bkyag byung / skabs der khong tshor ya mtshan zhig skyes pa ni bod rigs kyi gung khran tang gi 'gan 'khur las byed pa zhig gis ser skya dpon rigs mang po'i khrod du spyir btang gi bod mi dang 'dra bar tā la'i bla mar sku phyag phul ba de red/ de thog nas gung khran tang gis bod rigs mi dmangs kyi chos la dad pa dang yul srol goms gshis la dngos 'brel brtsi 'jog byed kyi yod pa tshor snang byung yod pa dang /skabs der don des lha sa'i las rigs khag gi mang tshogs tsho'i khrod du bag chags bzang po zhig bzhag pa red/ /42

mjal 'phrad grub rjes tā la'i bla ma mchog gis gzims chung 'chi med mchog 'khyil du krang go hwa sogs 'gan 'khur blo mthun rnams la zur mjal yang gnang song /krung dbyang gi mdzub ston la gzhigs nas krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dang nub byang bod las don u yon lhan khang gnyis zla bsgril btang rjes gcig gyur yin pa'i 'go khrid las khungs gsar pa zhig btsugs shing /krung dbyang gis krang cing lu'u yis hru'u ci gnang ba dang / krang go hwa dang /than kon san/ hphan ming bcas kyis hru'u ci gzhon pa gnang ba/ blo mthun gzhan dag bdun gyis u yon gnang ba'i krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang btsugs/ nga ni u yon bdun po'i nang bod rigs gcig kho na yod pa de yin/ bod las don u yon lhan khang gis tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i thad ma'i 'go khrid 'og dka' tshegs shin tu che zhing rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas tshul 'og lo rgyus kyi 'khur po ljid po 'khur te las don khag spel 'go btsugs pa red/rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshos krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og yun ring gi mi rigs dmangs gtso'i gsar brje byas par lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha thob ste krung go mi dmangs de nas bzung btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dang gnya' gnon las grol ba ma zad/ go min tang log spyod shog khag gi rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi gnya' gnon lam lugs rtsa med kyang bzos pa red/ mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi rmang gzhi gsar pa'i 'og mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs shing / mi rigs 'dra mnyam bya rgyu ni rang rgyal gyi mi rigs 'brel ba'i rtsigs gdan dang /43

gzhi 'dzin sa zhig red/ mi rigs 'dra mnyam dngos 'brel 'dzugs thub tshe gzhi nas mi rigs mthun sgril dngos 'brel de mngon 'gyur yong thub pa dang /mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril chen po byung tshe gzhi nas dar rgyas stobs 'byor ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi krung go gsar pa bde blag ngang 'dzugs skrun byed thub kyi red/ gong gsal gyi snying don de ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi ngo bo zhig yin la 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i slob ston bsam blo yang red/ gzi brjid yin bsam dgos pa zhig ni rang nyid bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i brgyud rim hril po'i nang zhugs par brten dus rabs dbye ba'i don snying chen po ldan pa'i 〈 gros mthun sminang zhugs mkhan zhig yin la lo rgyus dus mtshams de'i dpang po zhig kyang yin pa de red/dus kyi 'khor lo 'gro mgyogs shing / yud tsam zhig la lo ngo bzhi bcu 'das/ tang krung dbyang gi 'go khrid 'og bod la gnam sa bla 'og tu bsgyur ba lta bu'i 'gyur ldog byung yod/ de sngon g.yon gyi bsam blo'i 'gog rkyen 'og kyag kyog dang nor 'khrul shor myong yod mod/ 'on kyang khyon yongs nas brjod na/ chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig slob/ 'grim 'grul/'phrod bsten sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad mig ldan kun gyis gzigs thub pa'i grub 'bras chen po thob yod pas dar zhing mnga' thang rgyas pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byed rgyur mdun lam yangs shing rgya chen po zhig yod pa red/'byung 'gyur la bltas na/ las 'gan lci zhing lam bu ring ba yin/ nga tshos blo mthun cang tse min gyis gtso bo gnang ba'i tang krung dbyang gi mtha' /44
pa dam za sum tshobazab bya da

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i sngon rjes su/lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar/lo sum cu'i gong gi zla 5tshes 23nyin la krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa de dpyid kyi 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar le dbar khri yi sa mthor yongs su grags nas bod kyi mtho rim dbang sgyur ru tshogs la g.yo 'gul thebs shing / mtsho ltar zab la me ltar tsha ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gnas su gyar ba'i bod kyi zhing bran khri tsho brgya rmongs gnyid las sad pa dang sbrags btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs mthar skrod byas pa nas bzung bod kyi lo rgyus de 'go gsar pa zhig 'tshugs par gyur/ skabs der ngas gros mthun 'jog mkhan 'thus mi yi gras su zhugs thog pe cin du gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod mi dmangs la bya ba bzang po zhig bsgrubs pa yin la nged rang gi 'tsho ba'i nang bde skyid che shos shig kyang yin pas/ da lta gros mthun ming rtags bkod pa'i snga phyi /6

dran gso byed rgyu gsham gsal/skyug bro ba'i pharang btsan gyi zlos gar la brten nas bcings 'grol dmag bod du skyod rgyur bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa/spyi lo /949lo'i lo smad du tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i dbu khrid 'og rang rgyal gyi skam sa chen po gzhi rtsa'i thog bcings 'grol thob pa dang 'brel krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa nas bzung skar lnga'i dar dmar mes rgyal gyi mkha' dbyings su lhab lhub tu g.yo bar byed/tang krung dbyang gis rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas bod ljongs kyi mi dmangs rnams bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po'i gnya' gnon bshu gzhog dang / phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul the byus bran bkol 'og sdug bsngal gyi me 'ob tu lhung ba las skyob phyir bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur gtan 'bebs gnang ba dang 'brel 'dzam gling yongs la khyab bsgrags gnang / bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyis gtam bzang de go ma thag spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i ngang dga' 'bod byas pa dang skom pa chu 'dod ltar bcings 'grol snga tsam 'thob rgyu'i re sgug byas/'on kyang srid skyong stag brag gis gtso bo byas pa'i bod kyi mtho rim btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyug khyi nyung shas zhig gis lha sdod nyin thu'i gzhung tshab dbyin ji'i mi re car san dang ngan 'brel byas nas 6 bod rang btsan ’byed rgyu'i byus 'god byas pa red/ skabs der re car san gyis bod ljongs 'di nyid dzirang btsan rgyal khab 7yin zer bsdad na 'grig thabs med pas /47

mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs la yi ge 'bul dgos pa'i ngan bslabs byas pa ltar bod rang btsan yin khul khungs lung med pa'i yig rigs shig bka' shag nas zin bris bkod par dbyin ji'i re car san nas bzo bcos byas pa de dbyin yig tu bsgyur bris byas pa ma zad/ rgya lo don grub dang / rtsis dpon zhwa skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gnyis mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs su zhu gtugs byed par gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas/ da dung re car san dang / a ri'i gsang myul lo ye thor ma si/ srid skyong stag brag bka' shag sogs mtho rim nyung shas bcas ngan gros thog khrims 'gal gyi phu mdza' mthun tshogs pa zer ba zhig btsugs nas a ri dang / dbyin ji/ hin rdu/ ne pa la bcas rgyal khab bzhir rgyab skyor skyabs 'jug zhu bar 'thus mi tshogs pa re gtong rgyu byas te a ri dang nyin rdur 'gro mkhan 'thus mi mkhan chung thub bstan sangs rgyas dang / rim bzhi lding bya rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dbyin jir dza sag g.yu thog bkra shis don grub dang / mkhan chung thub bstan mkhyen rab/ ne pa lar tha'i ji tshes gsum phun khang dang / mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal bcas la bsko gzhag byas te khong tshor sbug dam dang srid tham lag khyer bskur yod pa de'i nang / gung khrang tang gis rgya nag gi zhing chen phal cher blangs tshar gshis/bod kyi nye mtshams btsan 'phrog byed nyer ya lan slog rgyu'i dmag 'khrug byed phyogs slob ston thog dmag chen gnyis pa'i 'khrul chas mtshon cha spus g.yar dang / gnam gru dang 'khor lo'i lag len yod pa'i mi sna gnas skabs g.yar po/ a sgor gang thon snga g.yar yong ba/ bod rang btsan rang gnas kyis 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i nang zhugs rgyu'i re 'dun don 'bras yong ba'i rogs ram yod pa sogs 'khod yod/ gong gsal 'thus mi khag gi sngon 'gro'i mi sna /48

rgyal rtser 'byor skabs krung go'i phyi 'brel pus gnas tshul der rgol gtam skyon brjod spel bar brten a ri dang dbyin ji rgyal khab sogs kyis bka' shag la 'thus mi tshogs pa phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i tar 'byor bas mi sna phyir bskong mi byed thu med kyi gnas su gyur/skabs der yang re car san gyis bka' shag gi phyi 'brel las khungs zer ba'i do dam dza sag sne shar thub bstan thar ba dang / dza sag zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan gnyis la/ gung khran tang gi mi sna mang po lha sar yod pas phyir 'bud ma byas na ngan pa rgyus yod kyis bod la bcings 'grol dmag mi yong nges bshad par dza sag gnyis nas sems tshabs chen pos nga tshos gung khran tang gi mi sna lha sar yod pa rtsa ba nas shes ma byung bas gar yod dris par/re car san nas mi ming sdod khang bshad par dza sag gnyis nas thugs rje che zhus pa dang 'brel phyir 'bud byed rgyu'i khas len yang byas thog gong gsal gnas tshul bka' shag la snyan gseng zhus stabs srid skyong stag brag dang /bka' shag gros bsdur gyis lam seng bya spyod spel te gung khran tang gi mi sna zer ba khag gcig dang / go min tang gi lha sdod don gcod khru'i las byed pa bcas dus bkag gis bod nas phyir 'bud byas pa de ni ming ngan kun tu grags pa'i 4rgya 'bud dus zing zer ba de yin no//mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug la rgyal yongs su rgyal kha gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis thob ste mtsho sngon dang / zi khron/ yun nan sogs zhing chen khag snga phyir bcings 'grol btang bas/ btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan kha bral ring lugs pa rnams dngangs skrag tshad med skyes/ re car san dang srid skyong stag brag sogs nas mi dmangs bcings /49

'grol dmag bod skyod bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i re ngan bcangs nas brel 'tshab ngang phyogs gcig nas bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag mi bdun stong skor 'bri chu'i nub rgyud dang / chab mdo'i mtha' skor gyi 'grul lam gal cher 'gog srung byed du btang ba dang / phyogs mtshungs dmag shugs rgya skyed dang dmag 'thab gra sgrig la shugs snon rgyag ched bkod 'doms las khungs gsum btsugs pa/ bod kyi phyi 'brel las khungs zer ba'i spyi khyab tu bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / drung yig che mo chos 'phel thub bstan/rtsis dpon klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan (de dus srid tshab kyi go gnas su spar med )bcas yin pa dang / dmag spyi las khungs su bka' blon mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas/ drung yig che mo ngag dbang rnam rgyal (/950lor spyi mkhan du 'phos tshab nga rang thub bstan bstan dar yin/) rtsis dpon rnam gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med bcas yin/ dmag phogs bsdu 'god las khungs zhes pa red/ bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang /drung yig che mo ngag dbang grags pa/ rtsis dpon khe smad tshe dbang don grub bcas bskos te zhi drag las don gang ci thad kur thag gcod chog pa'i dbang cha sprad/dmag shugs rgya skyed thad nag chu khul du byang spyi'i srung dmag ja dang dmag gi 'go dmag brgya tham pa yod mus thog dpung snon du ca dang mda' dpon brag 'jun pa dang 'go dmag lnga brgya tham pa btang ba dang / dmag phogs su gtsang khul rdzong gzhis khag gi bka' 'bru 'bru khal 'bum gcig 'don 'dren gyis nag chu bsdu 'jug byas/ skabs de'i byang spyi mkhan chung nga rang dang / rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub gnyis nas byang sdod sa /50

srung 'go dmag gi dmag rtsal nus pa gong mthor gtong ched ja dang dmag khongs dmag mi brgyad me mda' sbag sbag rgyag stangs dang / bshig sgrig slob sbyong byed par lha sar ched gtong byas pas gong gsal dmag mi slob sbyong thon mtshams bka' shag nas me mda' sbag sbag gsum dang / mde'u bcas byang spyir rtsis sprod byas byung /bka' shag gis bod dmag gi drag shugs rgya skyed gtong ched grong drag dmag sgar 'dzugs rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas nas dbus khul rdzong gzhis khag nas grong drag dmag bsdu skong byed par ser skya dpon rigs gnyis re khag bgos ched gtong gis dmag mi chig stong tsam bsdus thog mda' dpon mkhar sna mkha' khyab bde chen dang / mda' tshab sgog mkhar bar bsko gzhag byas te dmag rtsal sbyong brdar byed bcug pa sogs drag shugs la brten nas bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod la bkag sdom byed rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/stag brag sogs btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan stobs shugs kyis /949lo'i ston khar ‘ rgya 'bud dus zing slong ba dang chabs cigade sngon gyi 'phrin skyel glog 'phrin de bed spyad nas /bod kyi glog 'phrin khang zer ba zhig btsugs thog bka' shag gis rgya bod gnyis mchod yon gyi 'brel ba yod pa tsam las/ bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs min pa'i khungs med kyi lo rgyus bzos te bcings 'grol dmag bod sar btang na lta spyod tsha grang ya 'gal mthun thabs rtsa ba nas med pas drag po'i dmag 'thab pho zad mo la ma thug bar bya rgyu sogs log spyod kyi brjod tshig 'khod pa zhig gong gsal glog 'phrin khang nas bod skad thog rim bzhi ra sa rgya rgan phun tshogs dbang rgyal nas bshad pa dang / rgya skad yab gzhis phun tshogs bkra shis dang //5/

dbyin skad phog sa heb nas rgyang bsgrags thog bshad/phyogs mtshungs bka' shag gis/ bod 'di rang btsan yin pa'i khung skyel dang / bod sa sngon shor rgya khongs su gyur rigs rim pas bka' mol zhu rgyu/ gung khran tang nas bod du dmag dpung skyod gtong mi yong ba sogs 'khod pa'i yi ge zhig krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la ched 'bul zhu mkhan rtse phyag mkhan chung thub bstan rgyal po dang / rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gnyis rgya gar brgyud pe cin du skyod rgyu yin rung / khong gnyis bod nas thon te nyin rdur 'byor rjes pe cin du thon rgyu'i gnam gru'i spa se thob min sogs ka kor sna tshogs bshad de pe cin du ma bskyod par btsan rgyal a dbyin gnyis la skyabs zhu'i re stong bcangs te bsdad pa red/chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba yongs su bsgrags pa dang / tā la'i bla ma ngo mas srid dbang bzung ba/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis mes rgyal gcig gyur la srung skyob dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ched/ glog 'phrin thog krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs srid byus gsal bshad gnang ba ma zad/ thabs lam sna tshogs brgyud bod kyi gnad don zhi bas thag gcod byed rgyu'i skor bka' shag dang / bod kyi mtho rim mi snas bden don gsal shes kyis blo sgo phyes nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi 'ching thag las grol te mi rigs khag mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang log thub pa'i 'bad brtson yang gnang yod pa/ dang thog rgya rigs las byed pa gsum dang mtsho sngon stag 'tsher sprul sku bod du btang /52

gnang ba khong tsho nag chur slebs ma thag bka' shag gis ha go nas zhi ba'i gros mol byed par yong ba'i rgya rigs las byed pa de tsho lho khar bzung bskyal byas pa dang / rjes su dkar mdzes be ri dgon gyi dge rtag sprul sku ched gtong gis tā la'i bla mar mjal 'phrad zhus nas grol mol gnang rtsis yod kyang chab mdor 'byor rjes bzang btson du bcug pa ma zad/ yun ring ma song bar dbyin ji'i myul ma hphu thes dug btang nas dkrongs so//bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung skyod byed pa'i gnas tshul thos rjes srid skyong stag brag gis mdo spyi rnying pa bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje dang /mdo spyi gsar pa bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mnyam du chab mdo srung rgyu'i bka' bkod byas rung / mdo spyi gsar rnying gnyis ka chab mdor sdod rgyu des mi ser thog brdab bsig che bas mdo spyi rnying pa bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje lho rdzong du spos bsdad kyis rgyab phyogs brtan srung bya rgyur dpung snon du pha dang grong drag mda' dpon mkhar sna dang / mda' tshab sgog mkhar ba 'go dmag chig stong skor dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi ser dmag brgya dang lnga bcu skor/ mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod kyi las bya mkhan rim sogs las bya gsar bskos rnams dang / me mda' sbag sbag rgyag shes mkhan rtse drung shod drung mi bzhi bcas rim par btang ste/ 'gog srung la shugs snon brgyab rung / dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis dmag rgyag thengs gcig la 'bri chu khul gyi bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag mi stong phrag kha shas pham nyes su btang nas zla ba /0tshes /9nyin chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba red/chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba'i gnas tshul shes rtogaso byung ma thag /53

srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' shag sku bcar spyi mkhan/ drung rtsis/gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po bcas tshogs 'du tshogs te gang dga' ci legs gros bsdur rim pa byas kyang 'jog bzo thon pa'i gros 'go 'don ma thub stabs gnas chung chos skyong dang / dga' gdong chos skyong gnyis la ji legs lung zhu bya rgyu byas te tā la'i bla ma dang / srid skyong stag brag gi drung du gnas chung dang / dga' gdong chos skyong gnyis gzim chung spyan 'dren zhus thog bka' shag dang yig tshang nas/ slad bod kyi chos srid lugs gnyis mi nyams brtan srung thub ched zhi drag gi thabs shes gang 'gab dang / chos srid kyi thugs 'gan sus bzhes dgos kyi lung zhu phul bar/ dang thog gnas chung gis/ gsol mchod yag po ma byas tshe/ bstan 'gro'i bde thabs srung mi thub zhes pa'i lung gsal la ma gsal zhig brgyab nas lha sku yal ba dang / dga' gdong chos skyong sku yal grabs byed skabs drung yig che mo bzhis gros bsdur byas nas chos 'phel thub bstan gyis/ da res bod kyi bstan srid chags 'jig la thug pa'i skabs 'dir/ nga tsho chu lur mig can gyi rmongs pa yin stabs/ chos skyong ye shes spyan ldan gyis lung bstan gsal po gnang rogs zhes bshad par/ dga' gdong chos skyong gis lha 'cham brgyab pa lta bu byas rjes tā la'i bla ma'i drung du phyin nas 4slob dpon mthong ba don ldan nas chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes na bod khams bstan 'gro yongs la phan bde yong ba'i 7lung brgyab pa dang / srid skyong stag brag kha skyengs pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur thon stabs/ tshang mas yang bskyar gnas chung sku gsol zhus nas lung zhu byed rgyur gtan 'khel byas nas mi ched gtong byas te gnas chung chos skyong bskyar du spyan 'dren zhus par gnas chung chos skyong gis kyang dga' /54

gdong chos skyong gi lung bstan la rgyab skyor byas pas gong gsal lha gnyis kyi lung don gcig gyur byung bas nyin bcu grangs song rjes srid skyong stag brag gis 5mig snga'i dka' tshegs che ba'i skabs 'dir las 'khur dgongs zhu byed rgyu sems pham che rung / lha'i lung bstan thog tu 'khel bas dgongs 'khrol mi zhu thabs med la brten/ tā la'i bla ma mchog nas chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes cha yod pa zhes zhus shing / bka' shag la yang de don bshad par/ bka' shag nas bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bskong 'tshogs kyis gnas chung chos skyong dang / dga' gdong chos skyong gnyis kyi lung don bzhin/ stag brag srid skyong las 'khur dgongs pa gnang rgyu dang /tā la'i bla ma mchog nas chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bskyed bzhes yong ba gsol ba 'debs rgyu khyab bsgrags byas par/ tshogs 'dus tā la'i bla ma nyid nas lugs gnyis thugs 'gan bzhes rogs zhu ba'i tshig tho spyi tham bzhi 'byar phul bar tā la'i bla mas zhal bzhes gnang / skabs der bka' shag dang / spyi mkhan/ drung rtsis/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po bcas gsang ba'i gros tshogs kyis tā la'i bla ma lha sar bzhugs blos mi bzod pas re zhig phyi rgyal du gdan zhus kyis a dbyin sogs la rogs mgon skyabs bcol thog bstan srid mi nyams pa'i thabs shes bya rgyu mos mthun gyis tā la'i bla ma'i sku 'khor zhabs zhur thon mi sku drag ser skya dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus nang don gtan 'khel thog phyi rgya gsang ba dam po byas thog bka' shag tu las don lcogs min la bsnyad de mkhan chung thub bstan rab yangs dang / tha'i ji shan kha 'gyur med stobs rgyal gnyis la bka' tshab bskos te phyi rgyal la bros rgyu'i gra sgrig dngangs skrag zas bcud gnyid bral gyi skabs der /55

mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med nas las bya rtse mgron rgyalamatshan phun tshogs dang / bka' mgron bsam gling gnyis ched btang gdong krung dbyang gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur bod kyi 'thus mi pe cin du gtong dgos skor dang / gros mol thag chod ma byung bar mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag lha sar dpung skyod mi byed pa'i zhal bzhes thob pa dang /tā la'i bla ma'i sku 'phya mdzad 'phrin dang / mtho rim sku drag khag la gnod skyon rtsa ba nas mi yong ba nga phod ngo las ser skya bzhi bcu skor nas 'gan len zhu rgyur pe cin du bod kyi 'thus mi gtong gnang mdzad na dge mtshan che ba'i snyan zhu 'byor bas mtho rim ru tshogs blo bder gyur na yang / bka' shag nas nyin rdur skyod bsdad rtsis dpon zhwa skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan la chab mdo sa shor song bas tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal du phebs rgyur bzhugs yul sogs thabs shes byed dgos kyi glog 'phrin btang bar/ zhwa sgab pas ‘ tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la phebs na a dbyin gnyis nas rogs ram byed rgyu'i khas len dang / nyin rdu srid gzhung gis nyin rdu'i sa sne ma zin bar gzab gzab kyis phebs dgos/nyin rdu'i sa sne zin mtshams sku srung ched gtong gis rogs ram zhu rgyu'i khas len thob lugs/ bcings 'grol dmag gis bod sa mtha' skor byas na a ris ched gtong gnam gru lha sar btang nas tā la'i bla ma phebs bsu byed rgyur gnam gru'i babs thang gra sgrig byed dgos sogs 'phrin lan snga rjes 'byor ba ltar bka' shag nas po tā la'i rgyab tshes gsum thang du gnam gru babs sa'i brda rtags dkar rag kyang bkram du bcugalcags stag /950lo'i bod zla /0tshes 8 nyin tā la'i bla ma chos srid lugs gnyis kyi srid dbang 'gon bzhes byed sgo zin nyid/ tā la'i bla mas /56

bcas byas/zhi ba'i gros mol byed mkhan 'thus mi 'dems gtong byas nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa/bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin mkhan che blo bzang bkra shis dang / rtsis dpon klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan gnyis la srid tshab bsko gzhag gis chab srid las don byed sgo bka' mngags gnang thog tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dkyus chas kyis rtse po tā la nas phebs rdog thon te ljang du phebs mtshams ljang dgun chos tshogs mkhan se 'bras dga' gsum gyi grwa pas shes tshor gyis ljang mdar grwa dmangs rnams lam bar tā la'i bla ma bkag 'gog phyag 'tshal zhu bar yong yang / tā la'i bla ma na bza' dkyus chas bzhes yod pas ngo ma shes pa'i dbar lcags zam gru kha brgyud gam pa lar phebs thub cing /de nas rgyal rtse brgyud gro mor phebs/ skabs der gyin ju'i 'bras spyi blon chen brgyud hin rdu srid gzhung la tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor rgya gar du phebs rgyur gang cir rogs ram yong ba'i re 'dun bcol rung nyin rdu srid gzhung gis rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs 'og mngon sum 'dzem med kyis rgyab skyor byed bde med par gyur/ rang gi srog mgo thon ched phyi rgyal khag la nyen g.yol byed pa 'dzam gling spyi srol ltar tā la'i bla ma nyin thur phebs sdod chog kyang / dbang cha med pa'i mi 'khyams po'i gras la brtsi rgyu yin lugs tar lan 'byor bas 'gro sdod mi shes pa'i gnas su gyar/bka' shag gis 'dzam gling mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs la yi ge sngon phul /58

tshang chen po'i nang log dgos shod kyi red/ de khas ma blangs na skad cha 'grig gi ma red la 'dzam gling sa khra'i nang bod de krung go'i khongs su bkod yod pas khas len byed dgos/ gnyis pa ni/ bod kyi phyi 'brel thad krung gos gcig gyur gyi do dam bya rgyu de red/ de yang khas ma blangs na skad cha 'grig thabs med pas khas len byed dgos/ gsum pa/ bod la bcings 'grol dmag mi gtong sdod byed rgyu'i skor shod kyi red/ de khas len byas na rjes su bod la dka' las khag po yong rgyu dang / nga tsho nyin rdu dang bod sa 'brel yin gshis nga tshor yang nyen kha yod pas khas ma blangs par thabs shes bzang pos bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor don gnad dbang cha gang lon byed dgos las dmag brgyab na krung go brlag 'khel gyi ma red ces bshad byung /rgya bod gnyis dbar nyin rdu bar dpang la sdod dang mi sdod lan tshig gcig bshad kyi mi 'dugaskabs der nga tshos hin rdur bca' sdod rang rgyal gyi gzhung tshab chen mo yon tā hre mjal 'phrad kyis pe cin du thon rgyu'i gnam gru'i spa se 'phral thon rogs ram yod pa zhus par/ yon tā hres nyin rdu srid gzhung dang dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab dang 'brel ba byas te gnam gru'i spa se 'phral thon rogs ram gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob pa dang bcas 4ḍi na mi kri zer ba'i bod ljongs sku tshab yin pa'i spa se gnang byung / ka li ka ta nas gnam grur thon te shang lding du 'byor/shang gang nas me 'khor thog bskyod de spyi lo /95/ lo'i zla ska tshes 26la rgyal sa pe cin me 'khor babs tshugs su 'byor skabs kru'u tsung li dang /kru'u tsung si ling / las rigs khag gi mi sna stong phrag kha shas kyi dga' bsu /6/

thob pas nga tshor byams brtse dang dro skyid tshad med thob byung /de rjes pe cin du sngon phebs bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang ngo mjal zhus te tā la'is gnang ba'i tshig tho phyi nang gnyis phul ba dang bka' mngags gnang ba brgyud bsgrags zhus rjes nga tshos krung dbyang gi gtso 'dzin dang mjal 'phrad zhus pa dang 'brel tā la'i bla ma'i zhu yig 'tshams rten bcas phul/ rgyun ring ma song bar krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab dbang cha tshang ma yod pa li lu'i han dang / krang cing wu/ krang go hwa/sun kri yon bcas dang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skor la gros bsdur byed 'go 'tshugs/ phyogs gnyis mas mdza' mthun 'dra mnyam gyi gros bsdur byas pa brgyud mgyogs myur rtsa don rang bzhin gyi bsam 'char gcig gyur byung zhing / thog mar krung dbyang nas 'don gnang ba'i don tshan bcu la nga tshos dang len zhus pa dang nga tshos kyang don tshan dgu bton par krung dbyang nas yang dag pa'i phyogs khas len gnang ba dang 'brel lugs dang mthun min rigs la 'grel bshad dang slob gso gnang byung / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod byed rgyu'i skor khas len mi byed rgyu nga tshor bka' shag gis mngagase cha byas yod pas nga tshos dang thog khas len ma byas kyang krung dbyang nas btsan 'gel ma gnang bar tshogs 'du tshogs mtshams bzhag thog nyin gnyis blta skor spro 'cham byed du 'jug gnang skabs rang nyid nas bcings 'grol dmag bod la 'byor rjes ching gong ma'i dmag mi ltar bka' shag gi dbang cha yod tshad gzhan 'gan 'phrog sgrub byas mi yong ngam bsam pa dang / yang na 'di gar ngal gso byed skabs bcings 'grol dmag lha sar thad skyod byas mi yong ngam bsams nas blo tshabs chen po byung bas nga phod /62

btsal nas krung dbyang gi dgongs don 'dri brtsad gnang rogs zhus pa yin/der krung dbyang gi 'thus mi dang las byed pas bcings 'grol dmag gi dmigs yul dang spyod bzang ngo sprod gnang ba dang bcings 'grol dmag bod du skyod rgyu'i las 'gan dang dmigs yul 'grel bshad gnang ba ma zad/sngon chad kyi dpe don dang yig cha'i nang ching rgyal rabs skabs nas krung dbyang la bod du dmag dpung gtong rgyu'i dbang cha yod pa dang rgyal srung sra brtan du gtong rgyu de rgyal yongs mi rigs thun mong gi las 'gan yin pa/nga tsho btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi 'ching thag las grol te mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang log rgyu sogs kyi skor la lhag bsam zol med kyis blo sgo phye ba dang slob gso gtong gnang mdzad rkyen nga tsho'i blo dogs bsal nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod la hur brtson rogs ram bya rgyu'i skor la gros mthun byung / nga rang yig tshang khongs kyi 'thus mir brten chos lugs dad mos dang / chos gzhis yong 'bab skor la bsam 'char mang tsam zhus par krung dbyang nas mang che bar brda lan gnang stabs mes rgyal nang khul dgon sde dang chos lugs pa mi nyung ba'i thugs rje che zhes yi ge yang 'byor byung / nga tsho 'thus mi lngas slad gros mthun skor tā la'i bla mas dang len gsal rtog yong ched gnad don gros bsdur byed rim bzhin yab gzhis phun tshogs bkra shis der zhugs su bcug pa yin/nga tsho dang krung dbyang 'thus mi mnyam du zla ba 5tshes 23nyin 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod pa dang 'brel 'dzam gling yongs la khyab bsgrags kyang byas pa dang / phyogs mtshungs nga tshos tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag la gros mthun gyi snying don tar /63

thog snyan gseng zhus pa yin/zla 5 tshes 27 nyin ma'o kru'u zhis krung nan ha'e yi ho'e rin thang tshoms chen du mjal 'phrad gnang bar tā la'i bla ma'i zhu yig rten bcas phul/ nga tshor dus yun chu tshod gcig lhag tsam ring bka' slob gting zab gnang byung /de'i mtshan mor ma'o kru'u zhis gsol ston gnang ste bzhes rag pi tsi bkyags nas 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel dang / rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs mthun sgril chen por rten 'brel/ bod kyi mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril chen por rten 'brel zhu ba gnang skabs ma'o kru'u zhis gsungs don/ lo ngo brgya phrag kha shas ring krung go'i mi rigs khag bar gyi mthun sgril med pa dang / lhag par du rgya rigs dang bod rigs dbar mthun sgril med pa red/ de ni log spyod man ju srid gzhung dang cang ce hri srid gzhung gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin la btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig kyang red/ da lta tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen er ti ni gnyis kyis 'go khrid pa'i phyogs khag stobs shugs dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bar tshang ma mthun sgril byung ba de ni krung go'i mi dmangs srid gzhung bar tshang ma mthun sgril byung ba de ni krung go'i mi dmangs kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang rgyal nang gi log spyod dbang sgyur gtor pham btang rjes gzhi nas mngon du gyur pa zhig yin zhing / mthun sgril de rigs ni spun zla lta bu'i mthun sgril yin pa las/phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan zhig la gnya' gnon byed pa zhig ma yin/mthun sgril de rigs ni phyogs khag tshang mas thun mong thog 'bad brtson byas /64
