nga tshos ngo 'khyer byed rgyu yin/ gal te bka' shag nas gros mthun la mos mthun med tshe 'thus mi gzhan dag gtong gnang mdzad dgos las nged tsho sngon 'char ltar phyir log byed rgyu yin zhes bshad/de rjes yung ring ma song bar nga phod dang thub bstan legs smon sogs skam lam nas phyir phebs gnang zhing / nga dang khe smad kyis sku tshab krang cing wu yi phebs rogs zhus nas shang gang dang ka li ka ta brgyud de gro mor 'byor/tshur lam ka sbug tu slebs skabs/ hin rdur rgyun sdod zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis nga tsho gros mthun 'god mkhan nas gros mthun la brtsi srung rnam 'gyur ji yin tshod bgam byed du slebs byung / ngas gros mthun ni tā la'i bla ma dang bod mi rigs la phan thogs yod pas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis lag len bstar dgos lugs bshad pa dang / khe smad nas gros mthun la ming rtags bkod zin rung lag bstar byed min ni bka' shag dang bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyi lag tu yod tshul bshad yod stabs zhwa sgab pas nga'i sems thag gtsang bcad kyis lag bstar byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul de bsgyur nas khe smad kyi langs phyogs su langs dgos pa'i bslab bya byas pa ma zad/da dung lkog tu nga la bka' shag gros bsdur byed skabs bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs yod pa bsam shes thub dgos zhes bshad byung (khe smad ni zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyi a khu yin pas red)'on kyang ngas gros mthun lag bstar byed rgyu'i gnad don thad btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan de tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa byed 'dod med pas khong la zur khang khong tsho tshang ma yon tan can red/ nga ni gang yang mi shes rung rang nyid kyi bsam 'char rgyun 'khyongs byed kyi yin zhes bshad stabs zhwa skab pa dang nga /66

gnyis gleng mol de mi dga' ba'i rnam pa'i khrod du mtshams chod song / zhwa sgab pas nga la de lta bu'i sems 'khur che mdog byed pa ni mjug tu shes gsal ltar na nga tshos pe cin du ming rtags bkod pa'i gnas tshul gro mor khyab rjes dza drag che ba'i 'thab rtsod byung ba ni/ khri byang blo bzang ye shes dang /zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ blo bzang bsam gtan gyis gtsos pa'i mi khag gcig nas gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa des slad dka' ngal chen po yong rgyu dang don chen 'phyugs 'dug ces skad cor shugs chen brgyab pa dang 'brel dka' shag dpon rigs yongs kyi ming thog nas tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la gdan zhu bya rgyu'i snyan khra phul stabs/bka' shag gis gro mor yod pa'i gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus dang sku drag ser skya sum cu skor tshogs 'du bskong 'tshogs kyis gros mthun yag po byung mi 'dug pas tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la gdan zhu bya rgyu'i gros gzhi bton pa ltar rtsis dpon rnam sras gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med kyis gros mthun yag po ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad de tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal du phebs rgyu sogs nga tsho tshogs 'dus bka' gsung dang len bya rgyu'i tshig tho 'bul dgos zhes kha shugs chen pos bshad 'dug drung yig che mo chos 'phel thub bstan nas gros mthun legs po byung bzhag 'thus mi lnga drag 'dems kyis btang bas bstan srid chang phor gang dang tshong mi rgyag pa yid ches yod/ phyi rgyal la skyabs bcol da bar byas par phan 'bras ga re thon song ngam/ phyin chad kyang phan 'bras yong yag yog ma red/ tā la'i bla ma lha sa rang la gdan zhu bya rgyu las phyi rgyal la gdan zhu bya gi min sogs tshig rno don zab lan 'debs rtsod gleng skabs rtse phyag zhol khang don grub rdo rjes chos 'phel thub bstan la rgyab /67

skyor gyis gros mthun la che brjod byas te/ thog mar zhwa sgab pas hin thus dga' bsu gzab rgyas byed rgyu'i skor bshad rung nga tsho sgo 'gram du 'byor skabs bya spyod mthong yag med pa gang yin/ phyi rgyal la rgyab bcol byas na 'bras bu thob yag med/ de las mes rgyal la brten na dga' bas lha sar log gi yin zhes bsam 'char bton pas tshogs 'thus mang che bas chos 'phel thub bstan gyi bsam 'char la mos mthun byung bas rtsis dpon rnam gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med grogs med kher rkyang du lus shing kho par rgyab skyor byed mkhan mi de tshor rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu med stabs khong khro bza' nas chos 'phel thub bstan la rgyab 'dre rgyag grabs byas sdod pa las gzhan gyi bya thabs ma brnyed/ skabs der tshogs 'dus gros mthun 'grig nges byung 'dug pas tā la'i bla ma mchog lha sa rang la phebs gnang yong ba'i tshig tho spyi tham bzhi 'byar bka' shag brgyud phul bar tshogs 'du'i thog pham nyes byung ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan kha bral ring lugs pa tshos g.yo thabs gsar pa zhig bton te gzim chung lha mo gsung byon ma'i spyan sngar phyi rgyal du phebs dang / lha sar phebs pa 'phral phugs gang bzang gzan brtag zhus par yang lha sar phebs rgyu bzang phebs byung 'phral chos 'phel thub bstan sogs lha sar log rgyu'i 'dod blo yod mkhan tshos khri byang dang zur khang bcas kyi lkog g.yor blta zhib gzab nan byas te yang bskyar de dang mi mthun pa'i gzan brtag de dkar yol yu ring nang nas bsgrugs pa red/tshogs 'du dang gzan brtag gnyis ku'i thog nas lha sar phebs rgyu gtan 'khel byung bas btsan rgyal dga' nyer brten mkhan kha bral pa tsho'i lkog g.yo pham pa red/ bka' shag nas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab /68

krang cing wu'i phebs sgrig sne len zhu mi zhol khang sras bsod nams dar rgyas dang rtse mgon snang dkar ngag dbang tshe dpal gnyis gro mor sne len zhu mir bskos thog zhol khang sras ka spug tu phebs bsur yang btang ba red/nga tsho zla ba 7 pa'i zla mjug tu gro mor log rjes gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dang zur tho gnyis ka bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla mar phul zhing /bka' shag tu gros mthun skor snyan gseng zhib phra zhus/ gro mo dung dkar dgon du tā la'i bla ma dang sku tshab krang cing wu mjal 'phrad gnang / dung dkar dgon gyi mdun dbu gur nang bka' shag nas sku tshab krang cing wur phebs bsu'i gsol tshigs phul/ de'i sang nyin shar sing mar bka' shag gi sku tshab krang cing lu'i sar bcar te gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun brtsi srung zhu phyogs lha sar phebs mtshams se 'bras dga' gsum dang drung rigs ser skyar go bsdur gyis lan gsal phul chog pa dang / tā la'i bla ma dang krung dbyang sku tshab lha sar lhan phebs gnang rgyu lam bar bzhugs yul cha rkyen zhan pas snga rting gis chibs bsgyur yod pa sogs zhus par sku tshab krang cing wu nas ngang rgyud ring pos zhal bzhes gnang ste zla 8 tshes 8 dang tshes /7 so so lha sar phebs gnang ba red/lha sar phebs 'byor rjes srid tshab gnyis dang bka' shag nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la srung brtsi zhu min ka kor nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed kyi 'dug par brten/ gros mthun 'jog mkhan nga tsho 'thus mi mi lnga nang gros kyis bka' blon nga phod nas bka' shag tu gros mthun skor mdzad dka' 'dug na bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bskong tshogs yod pa nas tshogs 'du'i sar gnas lugs zhib phra zhu gi yin zhes gsungs pa ltar bka' shag /69

nas bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bskongs te se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po las sne dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya/ gling khag dmag sgar gyi ru brgya/'ju lang gzhung sog 'go pa/ lto gzan drung gtogs yan mi grangs sum brgya lhag tsam tshogs thog nga tsho 'thus mi lnga gdan thob zur rgyab la bsdad de bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 'jog stangs kyi gnas lugs dang / gro mo nas gnang ba'i lag khyer phyi nang gi dgongs don sogs zhib phra chu tshod gcig dang phyed ka tsam ring snyan gseng zhus te gros mthun gyis tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin bstan srid dang / chab 'bangs mi ser gyi bde rtsar phan slebs byung yod na phyag bzhes gnang rgyu dang /phan thogs byung mi 'dug na nga tshos dgongs bskor ma zhus par thag gcod byas par nga tsho mi lnga'i lus srog longs spyod thog bka' nyes gang gnang rung 'gyod pa med ces gsungs pa dang / ngas kha snon kha shas zhus don sngar srol phyi bskyod las don sgrub mi tshur log rjes bya dga' gzengs bstod gnang gi yod rung / da lam nga tshos gros mthun bzhag pas tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin bstan srid la phan na 'grig pas nga tshor gzengs bstod gnang rgyu'i re ba med/ gal te gnod 'gal byung yod tshe lus srog thog khrims gcod gnang na 'grig tshogs 'dus gros bsdur zhib nan dang 'brel skyon brjod gnang bde'i ched nga tsho 'thus mi lnga phyir log zhu rgyu yin zhes tshogs 'du nas phyir log byas pa yin/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms gros bsdur byas mthar tshig tho spyi tham bzhi 'byar bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla mar phul ba'i snying don/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa de gong sa chen po'i mdzad 'phrin dang / bstan pa chab srid/ chos lugs/ dpal /70

'byor sogs gang cir phan rlabs 'di lhag yong thabs mi 'dug pas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun brtsi srung lag len zhu rgyu sogs 'khod yod pa red/tā la'i bla mas tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyi tshig thor gzigs rjes thugs mnyes po'i sgo nas ma'o kru'u zhir /95/ lo'i zla /0tshes 24 nyin tar phul bar/bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs rnams nas /95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod par mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis brtsi srung zhu rgyu dang / ma'o kru'u zhi dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi dbu khrid 'og mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod dpung sder gzhogs 'degs hur brtson byas te rgyal srung sra brtan dang /btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod nas mthar skyod btang ste mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bdag dbang la srung skyob byed rgyu sogs 'khod yod pa red/ nyin gnyis song rjes ma'o kru'u zhis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i gros mthun lag len bstar rgyur 'bad brtson gnang bar thugs rje che zhu ba'i tā la'i bla mar tar lan bstsal ba red/ de nas bzung bod ljongs bcings 'grol thob ste btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod nas mthar skyod btang ste mes rgyal gcig gyur mngon du gyur pa dang mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon byung ba/ tang gi srid jus kyi 'od zer bod ljongs sa mthor 'phros pa red/ spyi lo /954lo'i lo mjug tu khron bod dang mtsho bod/ shin bod bcas kyi gzhung lam shar gtong thub pa bzo skrun byas te phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la 'gro bde'i 'grim 'grul dra ba chags pa dang / bod du sngar med kyi bzo grwa mang po gsar rgyag byas pa/ slob /7/

grwa 'bring chung mang po 'dzugs gnyer byas pas zhing bran gyi bu phrug rnams la slob sbyong gi go skabs bzang po byung zhing / bod rigs gzhon nu khri stong mang po mes rgyal nang khul du slob grwar btang nas mi rigs las byed pa 'bor chen 'tshar longs byung ba dang / sman yon mi dgos pa'i sman bcos byed rgyu yod stabs mi dmangs bde thang la 'gan srung thub pa sogs de nas bzung bod mi dmangs rnams 'tsho ba gsar pa zhig 'go tshugs pa red/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rjes kyi lo sum cu'i lo rgyus kyi thog nas bod 'di mes rgyal mi rigs khag gi khyim tshang chen po'i nang du log pa de ni dus kyi 'khor phyogs dang / mi sems kyi gtad phyogs/ lo rgyus kyi chos nyid bcas yin pa'i ra sprod byung bas phyin chad kyang rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang mnyam du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam thog bskyod na bod mi dmangs rnams phyug po dang / dar rgyas/ bde skyid bcas yong rgyu nyag gcig yin pa dang / gal te de las ldog tshe gces par 'os pa'i bod ljongs sa mtho 'di nyid btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mi ser spel yul du lhung rgyu las gzhan gang yang med/ ngas 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags 'god par bzhugs nas mes rgyal dang bod mi dmangs la bya ba bzang po zhig bsgrubs pa ni nga'i tshe gang ring gi gzi brjid che shos yin/ slad nga mi yul dang gtan bral byas rjes nga'i ming de gros mthun dang 'brel te mi rabs rjes mar brgyud bsgrags byed nges red/ ngas sngon chad kyi snyan grags dang gzi brjid la gces spras ldab brgya byas nas sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas mi dmangs kyi don du las ka hur thag byas te mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed /72

bod skyod thog ma'i dus kyi 'tshams 'dri'i byed sgo zhig dran gso byas pa/dbyin hpha thang //949lor rang re'i rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi mnga' 'khongs mtha' yas pa'i thog dmangs gtso gsar brje'i rlung rlabs rgyal yongs khyon la 'phyur zhing /krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug la gzhi rtsa'i rgyal kha thob nas mi rigs khag mdza' 'grogs mnyam las kyi khyim tshang chen po ste krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa red/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod nas myur du phyir bskrad de bod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dang / mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams sra brtan/ de bzhin mes rgyal skam sa chen po gong bu gcig gyur bcas yong ba'i 'gangs che'i bya gzhag gi don du tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i dmag jus bkod sgrig gzhir bzung dang / dmag sde cun bco brgyad pa'i tang ud dbu khrid tsho'i thad rka'i dbu khrid 'og nga tsho hri nga gnyis pas chab mdo'i dmag 'khrug brgyud rjes kyi /95/ lo'i zla 5 pa'i zla mjug tu bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong thabs kyi 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉lag bstar don 'khyol gyi byed sgor zhugs nas lha sar dmag skyod byed 'go tshugs pa red/ nga tsho'i thon ang /54 pas /74

mu mthud nas gdong skyod kyi las 'gan khur te lha sar 'byor rjes thad kur rgyal rtse dang / gzhis ka rtse/ gro mo sogs mtha' khul gnad che sar bskyod nas skar lnga'i dar dmar hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud du btsugs/ nga dang blo mthun gren tse kro gnyis kyis thon ang 55pa 'khrid de kong po rgya mda' dang de'i shar phyogs sa khul du dmag dpung ngal gso bcos sgrig byas pa dang sbrags bka' sgug nas bsdad pa yin/ nga tshos/ gangs ri brgyab pa dang 'khyags chu brgal ba/ rtswa thang bgrod pa bcas byas te le dbar chig stong lnga brgya lhag gi dmag skyod chen po byas nas kong po rgya mdar 'byor zhing / ring po ma song bar dmag sde nas nga tsho'i hri de dril bsgrags 'tsham 'dri tshogs pa zhig tu bsgyur te lha sa'i shar lho'i ngos kyi nyang chu dang / yar klung gtsang po'i bar rgyud/ gtsang 'gram gyi kong po dang dwags po sa khul gyi rgya mda' dang / zhol kha/ jo mo/ rtse sgang / skyem stong / snang rdzong / rgya tsha/ sku rab rnam rgyal/lha gsol sogs rdzong khag dgu'i bod rigs mi dmangs la 'tshams 'dri dang 'brel ( gros mthun 〉rgya khyab tu dril bsgrags byed pa ma zad/ gros mthun lag bstar mthil phyin byed rgyu/ bod rigs mi dmangs la 'tshams 'dri byas pa brgyud tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis bod mi dmangs la byams brtse chen po'i thugs 'khur gnang lugs khyim tshang khri stong mang por dril bsgrags byas te rang re'i tang dang dmag gi chab srid kyi shugs rkyen rgya cher gtong rgyu/rgya bod mi rigs bar dang dmag dmangs bar gyi mthun sgril je zab tu btang nas dmag rgyag grabs gsog gi las 'gan bde blag ngang bsgrub par skul 'ded gtong dgos pa bcas gtan la phab pa'i mdzub ston lag son byung /de 'phral blo mthun hpheng lun kra'i dang / krang cun/ skad sgyur blo bzang rgan /75

pa sogs dang rig rtsal las don ru khag dang / glog brnyan ru khag sman bcos ru khag bcas yod pa'i 'tshams 'dri tshogs par nga dang blo mthun gren tse kre gnyis kyis 'gan 'khur sne 'khrid byas te /95/ lo'i zla / / tshes 23nas phyi lo'i gnam lo gsar tshes bar gong gsal sa khul khag la dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri'i byed sgo spel ba yin/ thengs 'di'i dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri'i byed sgo ni dus thung nyin bzhi bcu tsam las med na'ang / shugs rkyen ha cang che ba dang / nga tshor da bar brjed dka' ba'i bag chags gting zab cig byung /nga tshos snying thag pa nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la brtsi bkur byed pa/nga tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa nyang chu dang yar klung gtsang po'i bar rgyud kyi gtsang 'gram du 'byor zhing / gtsang po'i kha rgya yangs la chu rlabs dal bur g.yo zhing / ko ba dang sdong rdzing phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed kyi 'dug ri 'debs dang ri shur rnams shing nags stug pos khebs shing / phyugs rigs dkar nag khyu dang khyu 'tsho bzhin pa ma zad/ rgyab ljongs dgung sngon sprin dkar gyis brgyan pa'i yul ljongs mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i sa khul de ni sa mtho'i steng gi 'bri chu'i lho khul yin pas gnam gshes dro grang snyom pa dang /thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa/ zhing 'brog thon las ci yang 'phrod pa'i bod kyi 'bru rigs thon khul grags can zhig yin thog shing 'bras star kha dang /mngar kham/ kham bu sogs thon 'bor chen po yod/ khul 'dir 'dus sdod byed mi mang zhing de'i nang bod rigs spun zla ma zad/ bod kyi grangs nyung mi /76

rigs lho pa rigs kyang yod pa red/ ri shur gcig nas gcig la bskyod pas ri shur re re'i nang dud tshang mthong rgyu 'dug pa dang / la nyag gcig nas gcig brgal dus la nyag re re'i sgang grong pa thug rgyu 'dug blo mthun tshos thengs 'di'i las 'gan la 6 'bri chu'i lho khul du chab srid kyi dmag skyod byed pa )zer gyi yod/sa khul de'i mang tshogs kyis bcings 'grol dmag rtsa ba nas mthong myong med pa dang / rang dmag ji yin rgyus mnga' med pa ma zad/ 〈 gros mthun 〉bzhag pa de bas shes kyi med pa red/ log spyod pas skabs dang bstun nas dgrog gtam bshad de bsam blo zang zing rnyog 'dzing bzos pa bcas kyi rkyen pas nga tsho sa khul der slebs ma thag tu dka' ngal mi nyung ba 'phrad byung /skabs der ‘ rgya mi bod du slebs pa ni bkra ma shis pa'i snga ltas yin pas chag sgo yong nyer yod pa dang rgya mir 'bru rigs bza' rgyu med gshis bod khul du 'bru rigs bcom par yong ba red zer ba dang / 6 rgya mis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snub kyi red mi rgya dmag ni gdon 'dre yin pas mig spu dmar po dang mig ljang gu red/ kho tshos 'bru rigs dang gzan rtswa'i khral bsdu ba dang 'u lag skul ba/ bud med gzhon nu btsan 'phrog mi la nyes rdung dang dmar gsod gtong ba/ phru gu za ba sogs byed kyi red mices dgrog gtam ji snyed bzos shing / sa khul der sa yom gyis dgon pa zhig thor zhig song stabs mi ngan gyis 6 de ni lha klu khros pa dang tā la'i bla ma'i mthu stobs mngon nas phu rgyag thengs gcig la dgon pa thor zhig tu phyin pa red ces slar yang dkrog gtam bcas bzos pa'i dbang gis nga tsho sa khul der thog mar 'byor skabs bod rigs spun zla tshos nga tsho mthong 'phral dogs pa the tshom dang sdod bzod mi /77

bde bar gyur cing / grong tsho la la'i nang gi bod rigs spun zla mang po bros byol du phyin 'dug de bzhin sdod khang stong pa yin na'ang nga tshor g.yar po mi gtong ba dang / gzan rtswa dang 'bud shing yang mi 'tshong ba sogs bsam pa'i 'du shes thad cis kyang mthun thabs med par snang rung / gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og nga tsho'i blo mthun tshang mas de ni lo rgyus thog gi krung go'i log spyod srid gzhung dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs gnyis kyi byas nyes tshabs chen la brten nas rgya bod mi rigs bar yun ring 'gal ba chags pa'i 'bras bu ngan pa yin khar/ bod kyi mtho rim pa'i nang gi log spyod mi nyung shas kyis dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas stabs sngar yod 'gal ba de bas gting zab tu song ba yin gshis/ nga tshos tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol nan tan dang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gting zab byed dgos pa dang / dmangs sems rtogs thub pa byas nas gom pa rim bgrod kyis 〈 gros mthun〉lag bstar byed dgos pa ma zad/ bya spyod ngo ma'i thog nas bod mi dmangs la blo gcig sems gcig gis zhabs 'degs bcas zhus na ma gtogs/ log spyod pa'i dkrog gtam ther 'don dang / 'gal ba rim sel/ de bzhin rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi brtse dungs zab tu gtong rgyu bcas 'grub thabs med pa'i tshor gnang gsal po byung /nga tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa sa gnas gang du slebs kyang bod kyi lo rgyus dang / spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs/ mi rigs kyi 'brel ba/ yul srol mi gshis/de bzhin yul goms gshis lugs sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad brtag dpyad nan tan byed dgos pa ma zad/ da dung snying rus chen pos bod skad sbyong /78

mthun〉gyi skor la gleng mol byed kyi yod/ skabs re nga tshos khong tsho mgron 'bod dang / skabs re kho tshos nga tsho mgron du 'bod pa sogs gnas babs de rigs ni gros mthun dril bsgrags byed pa'i go skabs bzang po zhig yin pas nga tshos dus rtag tu kho tshos sems 'khur che shos byed pa'i gnad don gleng ba dang tang gi mi rigs 'dra mnyam mthun sgril gyi srid jus dril bsgrags byas nas kho tsho'i blo sgo phye kyi yod/ nga tshos da dung glog brnyan ston pa dang / 'khrab ston byed pa/ dril bsgrags kyi bod yig yig rigs 'grem spel byed pa sogs kyi thabs lam sna tshogs la brten nas gros mthun dril bsgrags byas pa yin/gros mthun rgya khyab tu dril bsgrags byas pa dang chabs cig tu kho tshor da dung rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i slob gso gtong rgyu gtso bor bzung nas rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi rnam pa dang / skabs de'i a 'gog khra'o rogs kyi rgyal kha rlabs chen/ de bzhin krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes rjes bya 'phur ba lta bu'i grub 'bras dang / mes rgyal stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi ngo bo dang / dmigs yul/ las 'gan bcas kyi skor bshad nas log spyod pa'i dgrog gtam sna tshogs ther 'don byas te kho tsho'i dogs gzhi sel ba dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs dang nye ba'i bsam blo sel nas rgyal gces kyi bsam pa spel thub pa byung yod/ skabs de'i dngos yod gnas tshul la bsam te nga tshos 〈gros mthun 〉dril bsgrags byed skabs gtso bo bod ni kha bral gtong thabs med pa'i krung go'i mnga' khongs kyi cha shas shig yin cing / bod rigs mi dmangs ni rang re'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i khongs mi yin pas rgya bod mi rigs khyim tshang gcig yin pa dang / rang re mthun sgril byas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs /80

bod nas phyir bskrad de mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i gcig gyur mngon du 'gyur dgos lugs dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang bod mi dmangs kyis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod byed par gzhogs 'degs hur thag byas nas rgyal srung sra brtan gtong dgos pa/ nga tshos mi rigs 'dra mnyam mthun sgril gyi srid jus dang chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len bstar nas bod mi dmangs kyi chos dad dang / yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog dgon sde khag la srung skyob bcas byed rgyu ma zad/ tā la'i dang paṇa chen gnyis kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag rgyu/ bod kyi dpon rigs tshos btsan rgol rgyal gces byas pa tsam gyis go ming sor bzhag thog 'os shing 'tshams pa'i chab srid kyi go gnas sprod rgyu dang / tshul mthun gyi dpal 'byor khe phan la srung skyob byed rgyu yin pa bcas kyi gtso gnad dam por bzung ste nan bshad byed kyi yod/ nga tshos da dung rang 'gul gyis mtho rim mi sna dang grogs po bsgrigs nas kha zhe gnyis med dang lhag bsam zol med kyi 'brel gtugs byed cing / skabs der khul de'i rdzong khag dgu'i ser skya dpon rigs dang gnad che'i mtho rim pa mi re ngo rer 'tshams 'dri byas te phan tshun kha btags dang lag rtags sprod res byas thog gtam gleng lhug por byas pa dang / da dung gnad che'i dgon khag gi bla ma mjal 'phrad thog dge 'dun par dngul sgor gsum re'i 'gyed brgyab pa bcas brgyud shugs rkyen bzang po thebs tshul rnams dran gyi 'dug lag len gyi thog nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉ni srid jus kyi rang bzhin che zhing / bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo mtshon pa yin la bod mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan dang yang mthun pa zhig yin stabs srid jus /8/

kyi blo 'gug nus pa chen po thon pa ra 'phrod pa red/ mtshan snyan che ba'i mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med ni hur brtson gyis 〈 gros mthun 〉lag bstar don 'khyol byed pa'i sngon thon gyi tshab mtshon pa zhig yin cing / nga tsho'i dpung sder 'bru rigs mkho sprod byed pa'i dka' ngal che shos kyi dus su khong sku ngo mas gnyer par 'bru khang nas 'bru rigs 'don sprod byed du bcug nas rang dmag bza' 'bru'i dka' ngal las sgrol rogs gnang ba red/ nga tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa nga phod grong tshor 'byor skabs rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyi dga' bsu thob pa de ni nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi shugs rkyen dang kha bral thabs med pa los yin/ snang rdzong ni tā la'i bcu gsum pa'i tsha bo srid zur glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug gi gzhis kha yin zhing / khyim tshang de yang bsam shes thub mkhan zhig yin pas nga tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa snang rdzong du 'byor skabs khong tshos snga sa nas nga tshor bsu ba byed pa'i gur sogs brgyab ste sne len gzab rgyas gnang ba dang /da dung snang rdzong gi thon khungs dang / sa rgyus/ mi gshis/ de bzhin mang tshogs kyi bsam tshul sogs ngo spyod kyang gnang byung / nga tshos snang rdzong du rdzong dpon gtso drag gi tshogs 'du gza' 'khor gcig tsam bskong ste gros mthun dril bsgrags lag bstar byas par kho tshos sdod khang gra sgrig dang gzan rtswa 'bud shing grabs gsog gi rogs ram hur thag byas thog rdzong dpon gtso drag gi ming gzhung 'don sprod dang tshang ma tshogs 'dur skong rogs byas nas kho tsho khyim tshang gcig gi rgyab skyor 'og rdzong dpon gtso drag sogs bsdoms mi grangs bdun cu brgyad cu 'dzoms shing / tha na rgya tsha dang skyem stong rdzong khag gnyis kyi rdzong dpon gtso drag kyang tshogs 'dur slebs yod pa red/ tshogs /82

'du 'tshogs pa'i nyin der tshang mas dus chen gyi nyin mo ltar zab mchor spras te dga' spro'i rnam pas khengs shing / nga tshos da dung glog brnyan bstan pas spro sems de bas 'phel ba dang tshogs 'du'i ring tshang mas nan tan gyis gtam bshad nyan pa dang gros bsdur gleng mol hur thag byas thog gros mthun lag bstar don 'khyol byed pa'i zhib bo'i bya thabs 'don gyi 'dug rdzong dpon gtso drag tshos slo rang re'i rgyal khab ni mi rigs mang ba'i rgyal khab yin zhing / rgya rigs spun zla tshos dka' ngal la mi 'dzems par sa thag ring po nas nga tsho bod rigs spun zla 'phel rgyas yar thon yong phyir rogs ram gnang bar phebs stabs/ nga tshos mthun sgril byas nas thun mong thog bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ga la yod ces bshad pa dang / yang sa gnas la la'i rdzong dpon gtso drag gis nga tsho'i gnas tshul rgyus mnga' de tsam med par the tshom gyi rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / nga tsho bod bka' shag srid gzhung gi mnga' khongs yin pas gros mthun gyi don tshan mig gis mthong ma byung la bka' shag gi bka' rgya yang 'byor ma byung zhes bshad de g.yol thabs byed pa dang 〈gros mthun 〉lag bstar hur thag byed kyi mi 'dug mi de'i rigs la nga tshos sngar bzhin slob gso brtson len gyi byed phyogs bzung ste sun snang med pa dang sha tsha rnam dag gis 〈 gros mthun 〉la 'grel bshad byed pa dang / zur du brtson len gang thub byed pa sogs kyi las ka yang nas yang du byas mthar kho tsho sems 'gul chen po thebs nas rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ldog kyang byung ba red/ de nas nga tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa rgya mdar 'byor rjes snang rdzong gi tshogs 'du'i gzhi rgya las che ba'i 6 dwags gong sa khul gyi las rigs khag gi 'thus mi'i tshogs chen bskong 'tshogs byas te gom gang mdun /83

spos kyis gros mthun dril bsgrags lag bstar shugs chen byas pa yin/thengs 'dir tshogs chen nyin dgu 'tshogs pa dang / tshogs 'du zhugs mkhan ser skya dpon rigs dang / rdzong dpon gtso drag drug cu re brgyad tsam zin cing gra rgyas kyi rnam pa de lta bu sngar byung myong med/ kho tshos dus bab skor gyi gtam bshad nyan pa dang / 〈 gros mthun 〉la zhugs mol gros bsdur byas pa/ zlos gar glog brnyan bltas pa sogs brgyud slob gso gting zab thebs pa dang / rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam pa mngon gsal dod po 'phel te 〈 gros mthun 〉lag bstar mthar phyin byed pa'i rang rtogs rang bzhin che ru phyin pa dang 〈 gros mthun 〉don 'khyol byed phyogs zhib 'jug gtan 'khel byas pa red/ kho tshos 6de snga kra'o er hphung dang go min tang gis nga tshor brnyas bcos gnya' gnon btang thog btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mgo skor dkrug shing brgyab stabs btsan rgyal la nye ba'i bsam pa byung ba red/ gtam bshad nyan rjes rang re'i mes rgyal la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba dang stobs 'byor rgyas shing / btsan rgyal ring lugs ni shog bu'i stag yin pa tsam las skrag dgos don med pa shes shing / bcings 'grol dmag ni nga tshor bcings 'grol gtong rogs gnang mkhan yin pa las de snga'i rgya dmag dang mi 'dra bas nga tshos nges par du bcings 'grol dmag gi phyogs su langs nas 〈 gros mthun 〉lag bstar nan tan dang khyi sbyang btsan rgyal ring lugs mthar skyod gtong gi yin zhes dang / ‘ gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og tu ma gtogs nga tsho 'phel rgyas yong mi thub pa dang / ma'o kru'u zhi'i rjes su 'brangs na ma gtogs bde ba 'thob mi thub cing / rgya rigs spun zla'i rogs ram med na nga tshor 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs pa yong mi thub ces bshad pa ma zad/ mes /84

rgyal nang khul nas bod du gzhung lam mthud nas mes rgyal nang khul gyi dngos zog 'bor chen bod 'dren byas na 'tsho ba legs su gtong ba'i cha rkyen 'dzom rgyur kho tshos yid ches byed pa dang / bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i sems shugs skyed pa dang 'brel re ba chen po byed kyi 'dugang tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pas mtho rim 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don byas pa dang chabs cig da dung mang tshogs la shugs rkyen thebs pa'i las ka 'bor chen byas pa ste bod rigs spun zlar chu len rogs dang / 'bud shing gcod pa/ gad rgyag pa/ nyo tshong drang bzhag rnam 'gyur 'jam zhing mi la nyes rdung dang gshe gshe gtong ba/ ster thang ngam yang na gur nang sdod pa las mang tshogs kyi blo mos ma 'thob par mi dmangs kyi sdod khang du mi sdod pa/bya dang byi'u mi gsod pa/ nya mi 'dzin pa/ mang tshogs kyi 'dzem bya'i rigs las mi 'gal ba/ dar lcog dang / gnas ri/ gnas shing / rdo phung sogs la srung skyob/ dgon pa che chung khag la srung skyob/ bud med blo mthun dgon par mi 'gro ba bcas kyi sgrig khrims dam srung byas pa red/ bod rigs spun zla 'tsho ba ha cang dbul bas sman bcos 'phrod bsten gyi mthun rkyen ni shod thabs bral stabs nad kyis mnar tshe lha bla mar brten pa las gzhan gyi thabs med la spyir btang du bcos thabs mi byed par bzod sgom byed mkhan mang /'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i sman bcos ru khag gis sa gnas shig tu slebs 'phral dar dmar bkal te las ka byed 'go btsugs nas bod rigs spun zlar rig gnas dang tshan rig 'phrod bsten bcas kyi shes bya dril bsgrags dang / sman bcos zhib tshags byas te nad mnar gyi dka' sdug las sgrol thabs byed kyi yod/ rtse sgang rdzong gi gzhon nu zhig gi rkang par shu ba thon par /85

sman bcos byas shing / rma ras gnyis pa brje bar yong dus am phrag du sgo nga nyi shu rtsa grangs shig blugs te sman par phul rung sman pas 'jam bshad tshig drang gi sgo nas ma blangs pas khos rkang pa drag skyed byung rjes bcings 'grol dmag la rogs ram byas nas skyel 'dren gyi las don sgrub rgyu'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug snang rdzong du ming la tshe ring dbang mo zer ba'i bud med gcig gi stod sgal na ba'i nad gzhi drag rjes mos slobacings 'grol dmag mi sems pa bzang la sman yang phan po 'dug ces dga' tshor chen pos shod kyi 'dugad dung nga tshos mang tshogs kyi tshogs chen skong 'tshogs byas te rgya che'i mang tshogs la gros mthun dril bsgrags byed skabs sa thag le dbar bcu grangs sam brgya phrag tsam sar yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla dang lho pa rigs kyi spun zla yang tshogs 'dur 'ongs pa dang / tshogs 'du grol rjes mtshan mo me bskong gi khrod du mtshan tshogs 'tshogs gnas mang tshogs la zlos gar 'khrab pa dang /glog brnyan bstan nas mang tshogs dang lhan du dga' 'dzoms byed kyi yod/rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis zlos gar dang glog brnyan mthong ba ni don dam thengs dang po yin pas brjod kyis mi lang ba'i dga' spro chen po byed kyi 'duga'atshams 'dri tshogs pa'i glog brnyan ru khag gis mang tshogs de las mang bas ltad mo blta thub pa yong ched du 'phrul chas lci po 'khur rgyu dang nyin ltar rgyang skyod le dbar bdun cu tsam byed par dpung khag gi rjes su mi lus pa byed cing / glog brnyan gyi 'phrul chas lhu sgrig bshig bsdu dang / rgyang bsgrags 'dzugs rgyu/ 'phrul 'khor nyams bzo byed dgos pa sogs rtag tu nam phyed bar 'gor gyi yod rung / khag 'dogs sun snang spu tsam med thog glog brnyan ston skabs bod skad kyi thog nas 'grel bshad bcas byas stabs ltad mo bas /86

nang don phal cher go thub cing / mang tshogs rnams kyi mthong rgya che ru 'gro ba dang shes yon 'phel ba/ rig gnas kyi 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs su phyin pa bcas kyi thog la da dung mang tshogs tshor rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i slob gso gtong ba'i slob gzhi gson rjen yag po zhig kyang byung ba red/〈 bcings 'grol thob pa'i krung go 〉zhes pa'i glog brnyan par gzhi des mang tshogs la slob gso dang shugs rkyen chen po thebs shing / bod rigs spun zla tshos ras gzhi'i thog nas ma'o kru'u zhi dang krung dbyang gi gtso 'dzin gzhan dag de bzhin dpa' mdzangs brtul phod kyi mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag mes rgyal nang khul 'dzugs skrun byas pa'i grub 'bras/ mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi mi sems dbang med du 'phrog pa'i mi rigs khag bar gyi mthun sgril mdza' brtse'i rnam pa/ mes rgyal nang khul gyi mi dmangs tsho'i las ka dang 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul bcas dngos su mthong ba ma zad/mes rgyal 'di nyid sa rgya che la thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa dang / mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i yul ljongs bcas mthong rnos tshang ma'i spro ba 'phel ba dang /skul lcag gting zab thebs nas mes rgyal 'di nyid mdzes sdug ldan zhing /'byor ba rgyas la stobs shugs chen po yin pa'i snang ba 'char te skabs 'gar bsngags brjod byed pa dang / skabs 'gar dga' sems 'khol ba'i gtam gleng byed pa/ skabs 'gar thal mo sbyar te rang re'i rlabs chen mes rgyal nyin bzhin dar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu ba bcas kho tshos mes rgyal la dga' zhen byed pa'i 'du shes de bas zab tu song ba red/ nyin zhig nga tshos gtso drag zhig gi khyim du lho pa rigs kyi bran g.yog bcu grangs shig bcug yod pa mthong nas gtso drag de dang gros mol byas te mos mthun thob pa /87

ltar kho tsho glog brnyan blta bar glod dus kho tshor dga' snang tshad med skyes pa dang sems 'gul chen po thebs bzhin par mi'i 'tsho ba ngo ma longs su spyod rgyu byung ba red/'tshams 'dri tshogs pa dka' spyad snying rus kyis las don khag gcig byas pa brgyud rmang gzhi nges can zhig tshugs te mtho rim mi sna nas gzhi rtsa'i mang tshogs bar yongs khyab tu nga tsho'i tang gi srid jus yag po yin pa dang /〈 gros mthun 〉mngon du 'gyur rgyu de bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs la phan pa las gnod pa med nges yin pa'i ngos 'dzin thub te kho tsho tshang mas 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la snying thag pa nas brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'duga'adi lta bu'i zlos gar yag po da phan mthong ma myong /bod mi rigs ni rang rgyal mnga' khongs kyi lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ bod mi dmangs ni las la brtson zhing bab chags pa dang shes rab ldan la dpa' ngar che ba/ glu gar la mkhas pa bcas yin/ khong tshos bod kyi mna' rabs kyi ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rig gnas gsar skrun byas yod/ 'tshams 'dri tshogs pas dngos su 'brel gtugs byas pa brgyud bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs kyis kyang gsar brje'i nang don ldan la mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa'i rig gnas gsar par dga' zhen byed kyi yod pa ra 'phrod byung yod/ rig rtsal gyi rnam pa'i thog nas mi rigs mthun sgril dang /mi rigs srid jus/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi ngo bo bcas dril bsgrags byas pa dang / log spyod kyi dkrog gtam ther 'don byas par mang /88

tshogs kyis ha cang dga' po byed pa dang phan 'bras kyang che tsam thon pa red/'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i rig rtsal las don ru khag gis shārig rtsal gyis bzo zhing dmag la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa'i slob ston dang byed phyogs la brtsi srung byas te 'khrab ston byed skabs sa mtho'i khyad chos dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos/ mang tshogs kyi rang bzhin bcas ldan gang thub yong thabs byas thog mang tshogs la 'khyab ston byed skabs mi mang nyung la ma bltos par 'khrab ston byed pa dang / 4grong tsho gcig kyang ma lus pa dang / mang tshogs gcig kyang ma chad pa byed rgyu'i 'bod tshig bton pa red/ gal te bod rigs spun zla gcig la 'khrab ston byed na'ang bod rigs spun zla de bod mi rigs kyi tshab tu rtsis nas ltad mo ba mang por 'khrab ston byed pa bzhin gzab nan tan tig dang hod rgyug lhod g.yeng gtan nas med pa byed kyi yod/ kho tshos 'khrab ston byed skabs rtag tu mtha' yas dgung sngon rgyab yol du brtsis pa dang sngo ljang thang shing gis rgyab ljongs byed pa/ ne'u gsing ngam g.yul kha gar stegs su brtsis pa bcas thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan yod/ sked rnga ru khag gi rtag tu sked rnga brdung bzhin du rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas sar bskyod pa dang /mtshan mo 'khyab ston byed skabs glog bzhu med gshis/ phres pa'i pags pa dang sgron me shing bsgrugs ste me bskong gnyis tsam spar ba dang / gur ras 'ga' zhig gis yol ba bskor nas grang ngar che ba'i rlung po'i khrod du 'khrab chas spras te slogar stegs mithog 'khrab ston byed kyi yod/ pi wang dang og gnon gtong mkhan tsho 'khyags te mdzub mo yang yang rengs por gyur kyang /mer bsro tsam byas nas mu mthud gtong ba dang / blo mthun la la nad kyis mnar te gdong pa spang ba dang khrag skyug na'ang 'khrab ston mtha' 'khyongs /89

byed kyi yod/ 'khyab ston gyi las 'gan de lta bu phal cher nyin ltar thengs re yod cing / thengs gcig kho tsho mtha' khul gyi grong tsho zhig tu 'khyab ston byed par song bas phar lam tshur lam khyon spyi le bdun cu 'gro dgos pa dang /nam phyed tsam nas thon te lam bar 'khyab ston thengs gsum byas pa ma zad da dung la chen po gcig brgal ba dang rab rib zla ba'i snang ngor brten nas bye stong ring po zhig brgal ba red/ 'on kyang blo mthun tshos las 'gan de ni ‘ chab srid kyi gdong mchongs byed par rtsis te dka' bar mi skrag pa dang ngal bar mi zhum par 'go nas mjug bar sems shugs cher skyed kyis las 'gan gzengs su thon pa'i ngang nas bsgrubs pa red/ rig rtsal las don ru khag gi blo mthun tshang ma ni lo na bcu drug yin/ khong tsho lo na phra rung sa mtho'i rig rtsal gsar gtod byed pa'i 'os 'gan lci po khur du babs yod/ khong tsho'i 'khrab tshan rnams ni mi rigs kyi glu gar dang / zlos gar thung ngu yin thog gang thub ci thub kyis bod skad tshig gzhi'i glu gzhas gtong ba dang /bod rigs kyi zhabs bro 'khrab pa/ de bzhin gtam brjod zlos gar rnams bod skad thog shod kyi yod/ khong tshos snying rus chen pos bod rigs kyi glu gar slob sbyong byed pa dang / slob sbyong byed skabs thog mar bod rigs spun zlar glu len pa dang gar 'khrab tu bcug nas gzhas gdangs 'god pa da nga/gar stabs tho bkod rjes nang sbyong byas te 'khrab ston byed kyi yod/ bod skad mi shes na dka' spyad snying rus kyis sbyong ba dang rgya yig gis sgra bris nas ngag skyor byed pa ma zad/ phyogs gcig nas dmag skyod byed pa dang phyogs gcig nas slob sbyong byed cing / dmag skyod nam yin gyi thon khar yang tshig 'ga' shas sbyangs nas sgra dag gsal po yong rgyur brtson len byed kyi yod/ bod /90

rigs kyi glu gar 'khyab ston byed pa der mang tshogs kyis bod mi rigs la brtsi 'jog byas par brtsis nas dga' bsu tshad med zhu ba dang shin tu dga' po byed cing / yu gur rigs dang sog po'i zhabs byor ha cang dga' po byed pa ma zad/ sgor gzhas dang ras par de bas dga' po byed kyi 'dug snang rdzong du rig rtsal las don ru khag gis gsar sbyong gsar sgrig byas pa'i bod rigs kyi glu gar 〈 snam bu 'thag pa〉zhes pa zhig 'khrab ston byas te bal 'breg pa nas/ rgyu yog pa dang / thags 'thag pa/ phyu pa bzos te lus la gyon pa bcas bar gyi las lugs byed stangs mngon sum dang rol dbyangs 'chom po byung bar brten mang tshogs kyis bltas rjes shin tu dga' po byung nas yang skyar thengs gcig 'khyab rgyu'i re 'dun 'don gyi 'dug 'khyab ston byas pa'i mtshan mo gcig la lho pa rigs kyi spun zla zhig me bsro bzhin par 'khyab tshan khag blta gin 'dug par khos o lon khrun rigs kyi 〈 rngon pa'i zhabs bro〉bltas rjes spro sems 'phel nas yar langs te rang gi sgal pa nas mda' gzhu phab ste nga tshor mda' rtsal bsten byung / bod rigs spun zla tshos bod skad kyi thog nas btang ba'i khams glu 〈 bod rigs spun zlas bcings 'grol dmag la glu dbyangs len 〉zhes pa de nyan rgyur shin tu dga' po byed kyi yod/thengs gcig nga tsho grong tsho zhig tu 'byor skabs bod rigs spun zla rnams dkrog gtam la yid ches nas mi phal che ba bros yib byas 'dug par 'gug thabs thad/ nga tsho grong tsho der 'byor rjes kyi las ka dang po ni bod rigs spun zlas phyir glod pa'i ba phyugs dang ra lug tshur bskongs nas rwa bar 'jug pa dang / bya de tshang du 'jug pa/ bod rigs spun zla'i sgo dang sge'u khung legs por rgyag pa bcas kyi las mjug sgril mtshams su rig rtsal las don ru /9/

khag gi blo mthun tshos gar stegs 'os pa'i sa cha zhig bdams te ras yol gyis ra ba bskong nas 'khyab ston gyi gra sgrig byas kyang ltad mo ba med stabs rnga spub shugs chen yun ring brdung nas mi 'khor thabs byas par bod rigs spun zla rnams ya mtshan dang snang 'jog byung zhing / ma gzhi nas bod rigs spun zla tsho grong tsho nas thag ring por bros med pa dang / rgan khog la la nye 'gram du yib nas blta zhib byed kyi yod cing / kho tshos 4rgya dmag de dag gi sgrig khrims dam pa dang / ngo mdangs spyi mtshungs las mig spu dmar la mig 'bras ljang gu min pa mthong nas skrag snang rim gyis chung du phyin te thog mar mi kha shas kyis mgo bo brkyangs nas blta tsam byed pa dang / de nas rim bzhin rgad po dang / phru gu/ bud med sogs kha shas thon yong stabs blo mthun tshos bsu ba byed pa dang khong tshor ja yang blugs rjes 'khrab ston byed 'go tshugs pa red/ glu dbyangs 〈 shar phyogs dmar 〉dang 〈 bod rigs spun zlas bcings 'grol dmag la glu dbyang len pa〉/ rgya rigs dmangs khrod kyi bro gar/ mi rigs khag gi glu gar/ dmag dmangs mthun sgril gyi bro gar/ 〈 gros mthun 〉skor gyi gzhas ma gtam sogs 'khrab tshan re re bzhin 'khrab ston byed dus/ 'khrab tshan re gnyis 'khrab mtshams su phyir bros pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams rim pas ltad mo blta bar yong ba dang skrag snang mi byed par da dung 6 bcings 'grol dmag gi 'khrab tshan de dag dngos 'brel yag po 'dug 'di lta bu'i zlos gar yag po da phan mthong ma myong ’ zhes shod kyi 'duga'akhrab ston byed ring 'khrab tshan 'ga' shas 'khrab rjes bar mtshams bzhag te rig rtsal las don ru khag gi blo mthun krang cun gyis skad sgyur la /92

brten nas mang tshogs la 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉dril bsgrags byas par bod rigs spun zla tshos rna ba rtse gcig gis nyan pa dang / ( gros mthun 〉gyi rtsa ba'i nang don rtogs te bod ljongs 'di nyid krung go'i mnga' khongs nas kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas yin pa dang / bod mi dmangs rnams mthun sgril byed dgos pa/ rgya bod mi dmangs mthun sgril byas te btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod nas phyir bskrad de mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong dgos pa dang / bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs mes rgyal gyi pang du log thog mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang rang khyim rang bdag gi dbang cha longs su spyad de bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba skyel dgos pa bcas kyi skor gleng mol byed cing / lhag par du 〈 gros mthun 〉nang bod kyi gnas tshul dngos gzhigs nas bod kyi zhing 'brog bzo tshong las rigs rim bzhin 'phel rgyas btang thog mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba legs su gtong rgyu dang / bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yong thabs byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs kha gsal 'khod lugs bshad skabs tshang mas mgo bo 'jog 'jog gis 6 de rang red/ de rang red/ ces zer ba dang / bcings 'grol dmag ni gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhis btang gnang ba'i dpung sde yin pas dpon dmag 'dra mnyam dang / mi ser la nyes rdung brnyas bcos mi byed pas dmag dpung rnying pa dang rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba yin lugs bshad skabs/ kho tshos go ba lon pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas the bong ker te slobacings 'grol dmag mi yag po 'dug yag po 'dug zer ba dang / da dung bod rigs rgan mo la las slong tsho lo na chen po 'di tsam son rung dmag dpung yag po 'di 'dra ba mthong ma myong la bcings 'grol dmag /93

ni dmag dpung rnying pa dang rtsa ba nas 'dra sa mi 'dug mices zer gyi 'duga'akhyab ston mjug sgril rung bod rigs spun zla rnams da dung 'bral mi phod par sdod kyi yod stabs rig rtsal las don ru khag gi blo mthun tshos kho tshor zhabs bro rgyag rogs zhes re 'dun bton par thog ma mi re gnyis kyis zhabs bro brgyab pa dang / rgyag gin rgyag gin pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas zhabs bro brgyab pa ma zad/ rig rtsal las don ru khag gi blo mthun tshos kyang mnyam du zhabs bro brgyab te lag gdang sbrel nas sgor sgor chen po zhig chags pa dang / tshang mas phyogs gcig nas zhabs bro 'khrab pa dang phyogs gcig nas glu len bzhin par mi rigs mthun sgril dang dmag dmangs mthun sgril snro mdza' brtse'i glu sgra bod ljongs sa mtho'i bar snang du gsang por bsgrags pa —da/bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la phyi nyin snga dro blo mthun tsho mal 'a sa langs te gur gyi phyir thon skabs phyi rol gyi sa stong du 'bud shing phung po chen po zhig bskyal 'dug pa mthong nas tshang ma ya mtshan skyes shing / de ni spyir btang gi 'bud shing phung po zhig ma yin par bod rigs spun zlas bcings 'grol dmag la 'tshams 'dri zhu ched du mdangs nub ched mngags bskyal te bod rigs spun zla tsho'i rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam mtshon par byed pa zhig red/ bod rgya spun zla khyim tshang gcig dang 'dra ba'i mdza' brtse 'di lta bu ni nga tsho'i bya gzhag la rgyal kha thob nges yin pa'i mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi sra brtan 'gyur med cig red/ /94

khyed tsho ga dus log phebs kyi red dam/nga tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pas rdzong khag tu byed sgo spel ring tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉rgya khyab tu dril bsgrags byas stabs rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis gros mthun gyi don tshan khag rtogs pa ma zad/ 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i tshogs mi yongs nas kha bshad lag len gyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu bya spyod ngo ma'i thog nas gros mthun lag bstar mthil phyin byas pa ma zad/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang /chos lugs srid jus/ sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad bcas lag len gzengs su thon pa bstar ba dang / bod mi dmangs kyi chos dad dang yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog bod mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag zhus nas bya ba bzang po mang po bsgrubs stabs bod rigs spun zla'i go rtogs mtho ru phyin pa dang shes bya 'phel te kho tshos rang shugs su gung khran tang dang / krung go'i lo rgyus thog gi log spyod srid gzhung / de bzhin btsan rgyal ring lugs dang mtho rim log spyod pa bcas kyi bar tshad bsdur byed cing / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la bltas nas kra'o er drung dus kyi 5rgya dmag dang bod dmag gnyis kyi bar tshad bsdur byed kyi yod/ tshad bsdur byas na gzhi nas dbye ba 'byed thub pas bod rigs spun zlas bsdur tshad brgyab mthar bden don brnyed de sems kyi gting nas gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi ni bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs kyi mgon skyabs chen po yin pa dang bcings 'grol dmag ni 5rgya gsar pa 7dang 4lha dmag 7red la bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol dang / /95

bde skyid skrun mkhan gyi bu phrug dmag red ces bsngags brjod byas te/ 5gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag bod la phebs pa'i dus 'di ni dkon mchog gi thugs rjes gzigs pa'i bkra shis pa'i nyin yin gshis/ dus de nas bzung nga tshor bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba yong rgyu'i re ba yod ces zer mthar thug bod rigs spun zlas nga tshor rnam 'gyur 'dzin stangs 'gyur ldog byung ste som nyi'i gnas nas yid ches kyi gnas su gyur pa dang / ring du g.yol ba nas nye bar mthun thabs kyis khang pa legs pa bton nas nga tsho sdod du 'jug pa dang / nga tshor sgo srung blta rtog dang / nad par blta skyong byed pa sogs brtse dung shin tu che zhing / da dung bod rigs spun zla la las mtha' mtshams kyi gnas tshul dang dgra bo'i gnas tshul snyan seng zhu bar yong gi yod/ thengs gcig rig rtsal las don ru khag phyir 'khrab ston byed par 'gro skabs rgad po zhig gis nam phyed nas yar langs te rig rtsal las don ru khag la lam sne 'khrid nas phar lam tshur lam khyon spyi le lnga bcu tsam gyi sar bskyod pa red/kho tshos bcings 'grol dmag la rgyab skyor byed phyir hur brtson gyis 'bru rigs btsongs nas rgyal gces kyi spro sems dang bcings 'grol dmag la dga' zhen gyi bsam pa mtshon par byed kyi yod/ 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa slebs pa'i sa khul kho nar mtshon na'ang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis dmag dpung la 'bru khal khri gcig gi rtsam pa mkho 'don gnang ba ma zad/bod rigs spun zlas nga tshor 'bru rgya ma khri nyi shu lhag tsam dang / mar rgya ma brgyad stong lhag tsam btsongs byung / thengs gcig rgya tsha rdzong gi 'bru rigs skyel 'dren byed pa'i khal ma ldeng min gyi rkyen pas bod rigs spun zla sum brgya sgrig 'dzugs byas te dka' ngal la ma 'dzems par ri 'dzegs la brgal gyis /96

'bru rigs rgya ma chig khri nyis stong lhag sgal par 'khur te rgya tsha nas rgya mdar bskyal ba red/ 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i blo mthun tshos bod kyi yul ljongs brjid chags pa dang / thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa/ bod rigs mi dmangs ni las la brtson zhing dpa' stobs ldan pa/ blo rtsa brtan la spobs sems ldan pa bcas dngos su mthong nas bod la dga' zhen dang bod mi dmangs la dga' zhen gyi 'du shes de bas gting zab tu phyin te tshang mas bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun yun ring byed pa dang / mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob/ bod mi dmangs dang lhan du thun mong thog bod ljongs 'di nyid srung skyob dang mes rgyal nang khul ltar mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba zhig tu 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu bcas kyi chod sems btsugs pa red/ rig rtsal las don ru khag gi blo mthun tshos nges par du ma'o kru'u zhi'i rig rtsal gyi mdzad phyogs la brtsi srung byas te gsar brje'i nang don ldan la mi rigs kyi rnam pa yod pa'i rig rtsal gsar pa'i sa bon mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams sa khul yongs la btab nas mdzes sdug bkrag mdangs rgyas pa'i me tog bzhad thub pa byed rgyu'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dugang tsho 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa sa gnas de dag nas kha gyes skabs bod rigs spun zla tshang ma dga' skyel du yong zhing / bod rigs rgan mo la las brtse dung zab mo'i ngang nga tshor dzi.o tsho da dung tshur phebs kyi red dam/ o tsho ga dus log phebs sam zhes 'dri brtsad byed par/ nga tshos ‘ gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag ni ji srid bar bod mi dmangs dang mnyam du sdod mkhan yin zhes nan tan gyis lan btab pa dang / kha gyes khar bod rigs spun zla tshos 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i blo mthun gyi phrag par 'jags 'jags /97

gtong ba dang lag pa 'jus te yang nas yang du blta bzhin 'bral ma phod par mchi ma lhung lhung du 'bab pa dang gnyen bshes kha gyes pa ltar sems sdug tshad med byas te nga tsho rgyang thag ring po'i bar skyel ba ma zad lag pa rgyun mi chad pa g.yugs nas nga tsho nges par du yang bskyar yong rgyu'i re ba byed kyi 'dug(/98/ lo'i zla 5lha sar/)

gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa dang lag len bstar rgyu'i skor gyi gnas tshul/lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar/bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la /95/zla 6tshes 23nyin dngos su ming rtags bkod nas nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs nga tsho bod kyi 'thus mi rnams khag gnyis byas te snga rting thog bod du 'byor nas tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag la gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod lugs snyan seng snga rjes su zhus pa dang / gros mthun nang gsal bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs sna tshogs la rim bzhin bsgyur bcos bya rgyu'i skor la gros sdur yang yang byas pa brgyud mthar legs bcos las khungs zer ba zhig gsar 'dzugs kyis des gros mthun gyi nang don rnams lag len bstar rgyu byas pa red/ /99

nas bka' shag la mdzad dka' yod na bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bsdu bskong yod pa de'i thog 〈 gros mthun 〉skor zhib phra'i snyan seng zhu rgyu yin zhes re 'don gnang mdzad don ltar/ nyin zhig mi grangs sum brgya lhag tsam yod pa'i tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms skong tshogs byas shing / rnam kun tshogs 'du sogs rtse shod so so'i gdan thob ltar sdod dgos rung bkod mngags ltar de nyin nga tsho 'thus mi lnga la zur gdan brgyab 'dug pa nga tsho der 'khod thog bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis ‘ nga tshor gnang ba'i spug dam lag 'khyer nang ma'i nang bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs yin pa khas len byed chog pa gsal 'khod 'di dag nga tshos gtso gnad du bzung thog tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin dang bstan srid mi nyams pa/ mi dmangs kyi bde rtsar phan thabs skor rang nyen la ma ltos par skabs 'phral nga tsho 'thus mi tsho gros bsdur byas nas thag gcod byas pa las/ zhib phra'i gnad don rnams skabs mtshams dgongs skor dus 'gyangs zhu blos bzod min byung ba ma gtogs ster sbyin rjes 'brangs kyis g.yo lhad byas rigs med cing / nga tshos byas pa'i las ka des tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin dang / bstan srid mi nyams pa/ ser skya mi dmangs kyi bde rtsar phan thabs byung 'dug na de gas 'grig pa las sngar lam gzhung don gal che'i las 'gan sgrub mkhan la byas rjes gzengs bstod thob pa ltar nga tshor byas rjes thob rgyu'i byas yud gtan nas zhu rgyu med lugs sogs gcig nas gnyis su drangs te dus yun chu tshod gnyis tsam ring gnas tshul gsal bshad dang 'brel zhib rgyas snyan seng zhu gnang mdzad song zhing / nga rang nas bka' blon nga phod mchog nas gsung don ltar nga tsho'i las don 'grig pa zhig 'dug na byas yud zhu sems med khar/20/

gal srid mi 'grig pa'i byas nyes su gyur yod na lus srog longs spyod thog bka' nyes ji stsal 'gyod sems rtsa ba nas med gshes tshogs 'dus nga tshor bka' 'dri stsal 'os sogs bka' gros zhib bsdur gyis dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa ngos tsho yod sar skyon brjod kyi bka' bsdur gnang bde min yong rgyur tshang ma'i dgongs 'char gsal po yong ched de'i ring nga tsho phyir thon zhus chog pa brjod de 'thus mi rnams tshogs 'du nas phyir thon pa yin/ de rjes tshogs 'dus zhib bsdur gyis 〈 gros mthun 〉la brtsi srung zhu rgyur thag bcad pa'i tshig tho spyi tham bzhi sbyar bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla ma mchog la phul 'byor byung don tā la'i bla ma mchog nas kyang 〈gros mthun 〉la brtsi bkur gnang rgyu'i skor ma'o kru'u zhir glog 'phrin 'bul gnang mdzad don/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung mchog la/ 'di lo bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs mi lnga ched gtong byas nas /95/ lo'i zla 4pa'i zla smad du pe cin la 'byor nas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi ched bskos dbang cha tshab ma yod pa'i 'thus mi dang mnyam du zhi ba'i gros mol byas shing /phyogs gnyis ma'i 'thus mis mdza' mthun gyi rmang gzhi'i thog /95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin 〈bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod zin pa red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs rnams nas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis brtsi bkur zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma'o kru'u zhi dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'go khrid 'og hur brtson chen pos mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod bskyod dpung sder mthun 'gyur rogs ram zhu rgyu dang / rgyal srung sra brtan du 202

gtong ba/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas mthar skyod kātang ste mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bdag dbang gcig gyur la srung skyob bya rgyu —na/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung tā la'i bla mas /95/lo'i zla /0tshes 24bod lcags yos zla 8tshes 24la gus pas/phul/ do zhes 'khod pa der ma'o kru'u zhis tā la'i bla ma mchog la tar lan stsal can/4sku zhabs tā la'i bla ma la/ khyed kyis /95/ lo'i zla /0tshes 24nyin btang ba'i glog 'phrin lag 'byor byung / khyed kyis 〈bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun 〉lag len bstar rgyur 'bad brtson gnang rgyu yin pas ngas thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ sems kyi gting nas bkra shis bde legs kyang zhu rgyu yin/ma'o tse tung gis 95/ lo'i zla /0tshes 26la/7zhes 'khod/〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉lag bstar bya rgyu gtan 'khel byung nyid snga 'phros 〈gros mthun 〉nang gsal bod bskyod bcings 'grol dpon dmag la 'bru rigs spus 'don bya rgyu sogs sa gnas kyi 'os bab mthun 'gyur rogs ram zhu rgyu rnams nar 'gyangs med pa 'phral 'phral thag gcod yong ched tā la'i bla ma mchog gis bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / bka' tshab bla ma dom po ba mkhyen rab dbang phyug bka' tshab shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rje gsum la las bya bka' drung mtsho sgo don grub tshe ring dang /203

bka' mgon bsam gling phun tshogs rdo rje gnyis dmigs bkar bsko 'dzugs gnang ste thog mar gtsug lag khang gi lho rgyud zur ljongs su zur ljongs bka' shag ces pa zur du btsugs pa red/legs bcos las khungs gsar 'dzugs byas skor/〈 gros mthun 〉nang gsal bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs rim bgrod kyis bsgyur bcos bya rgyu sogs la gong 'og blo mos gcig gyur bde blag tu 'grub ched tā la'i bla ma mchog gis bka' shag dang / sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan por drung rtsis la gros bsdur dang 'brel 'char gzhi 'bul dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar bka' shag dang spyi mkhan nas 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉lag bstar bya rgyu gtan 'khel bas 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi nang don khongs bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs la rim bzhin bsgyur bcos byed dgos pas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur sogs dang da lta'i bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa he bag che bas gom pa rim bgrod kyis bsgyur bcos bya rgyu gong 'og blo mos gcig gyur bde blag tu lag bstar thub ched drung rtsis la go bsdur gyis legs bcos las khungs zhes pa gsar du 'dzugs rgyu dang las ka byed phyogs thad don tshan bdun 'khod pa'i 'char gzhi zhig tā la'i bla ma mchog la phul te chog mchan thob pa ltar tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bskong 'tshogs kyis drung rtsis nas khyab bsgrags byas shing / tshogs 'dus mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis mos mthun byas pa ltar/ /952lor legs bcos las khungs zhes pa gsar du btsugs pa red/legs bcos las khungs kyi gtso 'gan bzhes mi dang / de min gyi mi 204

'gro'i thad tshogs mi mang che bas bka' blon gcig phebs dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bton pa dang / nyung shas kyis bka' blon gnyis phebs na legs lugs bshad pa'i 'dod tshul khag gnyis byung zhing / bka' blon gcig ces pa nga phod phebs rgyur yid ches byed pa dang / bka' blon gnyis zhes pa zur khang yang tshud re byas pa zhig yin pas rtsod gleng phran bu byung ba der dmigs yul nges par ldan yod pa zur bltas leb mthong la brten tshogs 'dus legs bcos las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin bka' blon gcig gnyis gang 'os bka' bsdur gyis phebs gnang yong ba zhes zhus don ltar bka' shag nas nga phod dang / zur khang gnyis ka phebs rgyur thag gcod byas pa red/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs legs bcos las khungs kyi gtso 'gan len mir tshud re byed pa de ni phyi nang ngan mthun yod pa zur bltas leb mthong yin cing /'on kyang legs bcos las khungs kyi gtso 'gan bzhes mi ni bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med la bsko gzhag gnang ba red/bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtso 'gan bzhes 'og drung rtsis khongs nas mkhan drung tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang dang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan/ nga rang (mkhan drung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar)/mkhan drung ngag dbang don grub/ rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa dpal 'byor 'jigs med/ rtsis dpon khe smad sras tshe dbang don grub/rtsis dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub bcas dang / rtse shod drung rigs las tshan dang gdan sa gsum gyi tshogs 'thus mi 'gro'i thad rnam kun yin na rtse skor yig tshang dang / shod skor rtsis khang nas 'char phul bsko gtong byed srol yang / skabs der rtse shod 'bus mi dmangs gtso'i thabs 205

shes kyis las tshan sde khag so sos 'dems shog 'phang ba ltar/ rtse skor dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang mkhan che ngag dbang grags pa/ rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ dmag spyi mkhan chung blo gros skal bzang / mkhan chung mkhyen rab dngos grub/ rtse mgron snang dkar thub bstan tshe dpal/ rtse mgron ngag dbang skal bzang / rtse drung las tshan bstan ma lcog rtse drung las tshan ye shes lhun grub/ rtse drung dkyus ma thub bstan rig grol/ klu khang rgya 'u'i zhabs sdod bcas dang / shod skor rim bzhi bla phyag sman stod blo bzang dbang 'dus/ rim bzhi tshes gsum phun khang pa skal bzang dbang phyug bka' drung mtsho sgo sras don grub tshe ring / yab gzhis stag lha sras phun tshogs bkra shis/ las tshan bka' drung ldum ra ba bstan 'dzin chos bzang rtsis pa bar mtsho ba tshe ring dpal 'byor/ drung 'khor dkyus ma rtsis khang yig tshags 'byor rgyas pa rdo rje dbang 'dus/ shod drung byang thang bkras gling pa phun tshogs dbang 'dus/ 'bras spungs mkhan 'thus 'dul ba mkhan po thub bstan tshe ring dang / grwa tshang bzhi'i 'thus mi re/ se ra mkhan 'thus stod pa mkhan po dang / grwa tshang gsum gyi 'bus mi re/dga' ldan shar byang gnyis kyi 'thus mi ab ra ba dang / de min gcig bcas khyon mi grangs 38bdams thon byung zhing / gong gsal 'thus mi rnams rgyun du rtag mtshon ma dgos par rdzong gzhis khag gi yong 'bab rtsis bsher bsdu dam bya rgyu sogs kyi rgyun las lta bur drung yig che mo chos 'phel thub bstan dang rtsis dpon rnam gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med/ las bya yig tshags ser skya dang / gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas mi grangs bco lnga tsam gtan 'khel byas pa red/206

legs bcos las khungs dngos su tshugs rjes kyi gnas tshul/‘ legs bcos las khungs :des thog mar 'char gzhi don tshan bdun gyi nang don ltar spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i skor sogs rtsa ba'i 'char gzhi don tshan bdun gyi khongs nas rdzong gzhis gzhung 'dzin dang / sku drag ser skya gzhung don du phyogs thon byed skabs bo/ gnas kyi rim par gzhigs pa'i gzhung g.yog zer ba dang / rta khal bskul gtong nyung 'phri byas pa sogs 'char 'phar lam yig rgyas bsdus dang / rdzong gzhis gzhung 'dzin gyi mi 'gro dang lha sdod sku drag ser skya la 'bru dngul phogs thob bzos pa rgya khyab mi ser la bun chag btang ba sogs bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i thabs lam gyi rmang gzhi yag tsam zhig bting ba red/ 'on kyang me bya (/957)lor smad phyogs nas mi khag gcig gis dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug dngos su slong 'go btsugs te mi mang po bod phyogs yul gyar lhags 'byor byung bar brten skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang /mtshur phu kurma pa rin po che/ rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang nas spom mda' stobs rgyal/ las bya bla phyag sman stod pa blo bzang dbang 'dus dang / las tshan ldan bya tshang pa rdo rje rab brtan bcas chab mdor bde 'jags khyab jus gnang sgor phebs dgos byung ba nas bzung bka' blon nga phod dmigs bsal mdzad brel che bas legs bcos las khungs su rtag phebs thub min khar/ rgyun las drung rtsis gnyis kyi nang nas rtsis dpon rnam gling pa ni zing slong khams rigs kyi 'go khrid a 'brug tshang dang ngan 'brel yod 207

mkhan zhig yin pa sogs kyis gang ltar legs bcos las khungs kyi gal che'i las don gros tshogs kyang de tsam 'tshog rgyu ma byung ba ma zad/ rgyun las drung rtsis gnyis nas kyang legs bcos las khungs kyi 'char gzhi nang gsal las 'gan bsgrub rgyu'i 'phros pa tsam med par de las ldog ste zing slong la dngos shugs kyi ngan rgyab gang thub byas thog rdzong gzhis gzhung 'dzin byas pa'i 'bab 'phar dngul rnams bstan srid zhabs rim la khag btags te gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi dgos dngul thog btang ba'am/ rgyun las ngo 'khor gyis g.yar bed spyad pa/ rgyun du sger don gyod gzhi khag la nye dga' phyogs lhung sogs kyi las kur mgo 'khor nas bsdad de las khungs khag gi 'char can yong 'bab chag pa dang / legs bcos kyi 'char gzhi nang gsal las don bsgrub rgyu lta ci/ de las ldog ste gsar brje dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la bkag 'gog byed pa'i lam du bskyod pa red/sa khyi (/958)lor smad phyogs nas khams rigs mang po bros 'byor byung ba rnams lho kha khul du rub 'dzoms kyis yas mas gang sar zing 'khrug slong shugs je cher 'gro bar brten skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin bka' shag nas krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang brgyud khams zing bde 'jags kyi thugs 'gan krung dbyang rang nas bzhes cha yod pa zhu gnang mdzad rung / krung dbyang nas gsar brje'i las khungs khag dang / slob grwa khag gzhung lam khag bcas par tshur rgol byung na de lan bslog rgyu las rtsa ba'i bde 'jags sa gnas rang gis 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i bka' lan phebs stabs de 'phral tā la'i bla ma mchog nas bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/ gdan sa'i mkhan 'thus dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya'i 208

khongs nas las tshan (las tshan nam/ las tshan yan gang yin ma nges)rnams nor gling gzim chung rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang du bskong 'du gnang ste phakrung dbyang dgongs pa dwangs pa dang / khams rigs kyi zing cha 'jags thabs 7skor thabs jus lag bstar 'phral du thub pa dgos rgyu'i bka' slob zab nan bstsal cing / skabs der tshang ma gros bsdur gnang ste bde 'jags las 'gan 'di skor thugs gal ha cang che bas legs bcos las khungs kyi 'thus mi sngar yod thog gsar du gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus dang /gzhung zhabs ser skya/ dmag sgar khag gi ru brgya/ drung tog yan bcas kyi sde tshan so so'i 'thus mi 'dems bsko byas te khyon 'thus mi mi grangs 66tsam las grub pa'i tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa zhig legs bcos las khungs su 'tshog rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas don ltar 'tshogs te tshogs 'du de'i thog nas tshogs 'du'i 'go khrid du lha rab bka' shag lhan rgyas dang / de min sa dbang rnam pa gcig chibs bsgyur yong ba zhes snyan seng zhus par sa dbang tshang mas nga phod ni legs bcos las khungs kyi dbu bzhugs yin mus la brten rang 'jags chibs bsgyur yong thabs nan gsung gnang yod tshod kyang /nga phod kyis nga rang la khams rigs tshos krung dbyang phyogs kyi khongs mi zhig tu brtsi ba'i lta tshul gang yod tshang mas mkhyen gsal la brten da res kyi las don 'di skor rang nas bsgrub thabs rtsa ba nas med lugs kyi dgongs zhu mtha' bkag mdzad pas mthar bka' blon zur khang la tshogs 'du'i 'go khrid gtan 'khel byas pa red/zur khang gi 'go khrid 'og mu mthud tshogs 'du 'dzoms skabs legs bcos las khungs de de bas ngan phyogs su 'gyur te dang thog gdan sa gsum 209

gyi 'thus mis krung dbyang nas tā la'i bla ma rin po che mes rgyal nang khul du gdan zhu bya rtsis yod 'dug pas da lta tā la'i bla ma mchog lha rams mtshan bzhes mdzad rgyur brten rgya nag la phebs na rtsa ba nas 'grig gi ma red ces pa'i gros 'go bton cing / bka' blon zur khang gis don gnad 'di shin tu gal 'gangs che bas thabs shes gang drag byed dgos bshad par pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan gyis legs bcos tshogs 'du'i skad cha lam seng phyi la gyar gyi 'dug pas sgo'i them pa brgal te bshad mi chog pa'i lus srog longs spyod 'ba' btsugs gan rgya sa yig 'byar ma blangs na zhes bshad cing / tshang mas de'i kha shugs su 'brangs te gan rgya 'ba' can bzos bris kyis ming rtags bkod pa red/de nas tshogs chung khag bzhir bgos shing / tshogs chung dang po'i tsu'u krang bka' blon zur khang dang / tsu'u krang gzhon pa mkhan drung tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang dang rtsis dpon khe smad tshe dbang don grub can mi bcu drugatshogs chung gnyis par mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan dang / rtsis dpon rnam sras gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med can mi bcu drug tshogs chung gsum par nga rang dang / rtsis dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub can mi bcu drug tshogs chung bzhi par mkhan drung thub bstan byang chub dang / rtsis dpon mtsho sgo don grub tshe ring can mi bcu drug bcas khag bgos kyis gros bsdur byed du bcug cing / skabs der pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan tshogs chung gsum pa'i tshogs mi'i khongs yod gshes kho pas tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal nang khul du gdan zhu blos 'gan mi bzod pa dang / chu bzhi sgang drug ni rang srog blos btang gis rgyal bstan chab srid srung skyob dang bod mi dmangs la bde 2/0

rtag par de 'dra gsungs na 'grig e yong zhes bshad song bas tshang ma gad mo shor dgos pa byung song / don du gros tshogs des tā la'i bla ma'i bka' dgongs bde 'jags kyi las don skor phan nus gang yang ma thon pa ma zad/de las ldog ste phan med gnod 'gyur gyi 'ur zing ngang grol ba sogs mdor na/legs bcos las khungs zer ba de de lta bu'i sgo nas mtha' ma tang dang mi dmangs la rgyab gtod byed pa'i log spyod kyi sgrig 'dzugs shig tu ngan 'gyur song ste mjug sgril ba bcas/

gros mthun gzhir bzung bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs gang ci legs bcos bya rgyu'i skor bka' shag nas rdzong gzhis khag la bkram pa'i rtsa tshigargya khyab rdzong gzhis khag gi spyi khyab dang / rdzong gzhis sne sdod mnga' khul gtso drag dang rgan dmangs kyis gtsos gzhung sger chos bcas lha sde mi sde mtha' dag nas nges dgos/ spyi nor gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas bka' slob zab mo spyi phebs dgongs don bod ljongs chos srid gnyis ldan gyi zhing 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che de 'dzin dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa dar rgyas yun gnas dang / gzhung sa'i chab srid kyi dpal yon mtha' dag yar rgyas/ chab 'bangs mi ser rnams la brdabs mnar med par bde bar 'tsho thabs/ rgya bod gros mthun gzhir bzung bod kyi las lugs sna tshogs legs bcos byed rgyu bod sa gnas srid gzhung rang nas bskyangs dgos bcas la brten legs bcos spyi tshogs zur 'dzugs bskyangs don spyi tshogs nas bsam zhib kyi bsam 'char tshig tho dang 'brel bod ljongs spyi tshogs rgyas par go bsdur gyis snga 'phros legs bcos gnang 'os tshig tho spyi 2/3

tham bzhi sbyar phul don ltar gong sa skyabs mgon chen por 'char 'bul phyag rtags dgongs don gzhung rdzong gzhis rnams gna' dus gzhung 'dzin gyi rdzong yong bkar gsum rtsis zhu byed stangs rtsis khang du deb ther yig rigs rnam grangs zhib gsal yod pa ltar rtse shod phyag mdzod kyis mtshon las khungs khag la 'bab deb nang gsal phyag 'bab lo lo dus thog chad med gtsang 'bul dang / chos rgyun khag gis mtshon mi 'gro'i phogs thob sogs phyi 'gro rnams sngar lam nyams med sprad 'phros gzhung 'bab ji yod sa gnas su bkar 'jug sogs rje 'bangs gnyis dge'i sgrig srol bzang po 'chol med yod 'dug kyang / bar skabs shig nas rtsa 'dzin deb ther yig rigs la ma gnas pa'i gzhung bsam mig ltos rim lad kyis bkar 'jug dang / las khungs khag gi sgrig 'bab lo re nas lo re chad 'jog gang thub/ chos mthun 'gro cha'i rigs kyang nyams chag ci cher gtong ba dang / mi ser thog 'bam spus sogs brdabs mnar gyis rje 'bangs lcags brdar mnyam zad du 'gro gzhi'i dge skyon byung ba gsal mthong la brten shing rta nas bzung rdzong yong chabs cig gzhung 'dzin gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel khongs sger khag la phyir chod rdzong gzhis dang le lag rdzong skyong sogs dbye zhib phyir bzhes gnang rgyu phud/da phan rtse shod drung rigs ser skya'i 'gro khungs dang thab rten khag lo dus rtsal rigs bcas phul bzhes zla bsgril gyis mi 'gro ser skya nyis sbrel dang / ser skya 'gro res mos snyoms bsko gzhag gis gzhung 'dzin mdzad par brten rdzong sdod mi 'gro so so nas rtse shod phyag mdzod kyis mtshon las khungs khag gi deb gsal sgrig 'bab snga sor chud de zur du phyag 'bab 'phar ma gzengs thon yong ba dang / mchod rgyun sngar lam gang yod rnams kha yod lag med du ma 2/4

song ba'i nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel/ gzhan yang phyi 'gro sngar rgyun dgos nges rigs kyang nyams med/ chab 'bangs mi ser thog brdabs bsigs med par 'go 'don 'tsho skyong gang zab thub pa dgos rgyu bcas gzhir bzung gis spyi sgrig rtsa 'dzin dgos rgyu'i don wo dang po/ rdzong gzhis mi 'gro ser skya ngo ma so so las rgyun ring bka' 'brel gzhung don gal cher ngo ma bcar dgos kyi ngo tshab bzhag 'bus bka' khrol rigs dang / rtsis zhur bcar rgyur ngo tshab do chod 'dzugs 'jog chog pa las/ de min rnam kun sa gnas su gtan sdod kyis lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi srol bzang khrims 'doms gang che dgos rgyu dang / mnga' khul mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang dang / ris med dge 'dun gyi sde dgon rnams nyams chag med cing / dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang thos bsam bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'gyur ba'i mjug gnon rgyun bsrings thog dgon sde khag gi bla ma las sne rnams nas kyang chos khrims byed sgo rang lugs bca' khrims dang / gzhung rtsal bka' rtsa rim pa'i 'bru don 'gal med rang don rang gces kyis sgrig khrims gnon bsdoms tshul bzhin dgos rgyu ma zad/ mi sde rnams nas kyang 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims srol bzang po'i nyams len 'gal med thogakhral khrims 'khri 'khur dgos nges kyi rigs la ngan brgal gang thub mi byed par sgrub 'khur tshul bzhin dgos rgyu dang / khrims 'gal byed mi'i rigs la sne sdod nas gcod rgya gtong skabs 'gal nyes che chung la gzhigs pas rgyal khrims kyi che 'degs dang lam bzo sogs yul spyir sman pa/ sngar srol mgur mo'i grangs bcad/ nyes can rigs la lus steng rtsa ra gcod 'os bcas kyi 2/5

nyes bkod babs bstun blos dpyad byed cing / yul grong dang / la phrang sa khul gang cir bcom 'phrog chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa ming tsam mi grags pa'i 'jigs skyob 'dzugs 'os sogs khrims bdag khrims gces mjug gnon rgyun bsring bgyis te mi gsod thal cha byung rigs kyi lag dmar dang / rku 'phrog chom rkun byed po dngos 'brel gang yin btang shor med pa'i 'dzin bzung dang / srog thal min pa'i lus steng rnag thog rtsag 'khel rtsa ra nan 'doms dang / byed gte so so'i rgyu dngos kyi thob cha dngos 'brel ji yod bcas gzhung len gyis drang 'brel khrims 'doms blos dpyad thag gcod byas 'thus las/ nag med nang mi spyi byings bde rtsar gnod gzhi'i thag zhor 'breng drud mkhar dbang rgyu dngos rtsa 'phrog rigs dang / dga' min zhe bzhag gis yo khyog rigs nam yang mi chog pa'i khrims 'doms dang 'brel gleng med dgos rgyu'i thog lag dmar ngo mar nyes chad slad lam 'doms ched khrims 'doms zhu phyogs 'char gzhi thad 'bul zhus 'thus dang / rku ma rkun thog dang / 'dzin bzung byed skabs bcas par srog skyon byung rigs la brda 'ded rtsad gcod med pa bgyis rgyu/ don tshan gnyis par/ rdzong gzhis yong sdud dang bcas pa gzhung 'dzin gnang bar brten gzhis son rtsa sprod 'bru yod rigs nas son 'deng min dang / sprod 'bru med rigs la son rtsa/smos mdzo/ shol lcags/ lud gsog ra lug sogs dgos nges rdzong gzhis mi 'gro so sos thabs 'khos kyis 'debs las phyis skyon med pa dgos rgyur son rtsa dang phyi 'gro rtsag rtsig sogs ji song he bag med pa tho 'god thog dus bzhi'i so nam byed sgo gnyer phos len gyi sla bcos ma yin pa'i ston 'bras thon 'bab gong 'phel 'byung thabs ru nga tshags tshud bgyis te thon 'bab ji byung 2/6

dang / yong sdud deb gsal 'bab rigs chad khums med pa bsdu tshags sde tshan ma 'dres pa'i tho 'god byung steng nas 'char can sa gnas su bkar 'jug dang / rtse shog phyag mdzod/ mkhan khongs kyis mtshon gzhung las khungs che phrar sngar 'khri gzhung 'bab gang yod chad med dus 'bul thog sa gnas su mchod rgyun 'gro cha yod rigs sngar lam nyams chag med pa dus sprod gleng med dang / gzhung 'dzin gnang ba'i dgos don 'phar ma'i gzhung 'bab zal thon rtsis zhu thub pa bgyis te byung song rtsis khra khams dwang dang /'char can gzhung 'bab bkar 'jug zhus zin dang / kha lhag zal thon rtsis zhu zhu rgyu yod pa'i 'bru rigs kyi 'bru tshad las dam sbyar ma bcas zla /2tshes 30tshun nges 'bul thub pa dgos rgyu dang / rdzong gzhis khongs gzhis lag yod rigs la son rtsa gtong dmigs dang / so nam zhing g.yog dmigs bsal bskul yul med pas rdzong sdod rang nas 'debs 'khos bgyis dgos/ gzhung gnod kyi phyag 'bab che ba med rigs kha 'dzin yig rigs gtong thal med par mnga' khul sa zhing 'debs las dang / bog ma dus 'bul thub nges la bog gtong / phyed shas gang 'os rdzong thog so so'i ring gzhung sar phyag 'bab gang che yong ba'i thabs rtsal blos dpyad chog rgyu/ byang rigs mnga' khul rdzong gzhis so sor mgo brtsi 'di bzhin gzhung 'bab dang / mi ser nang khul khral 'khri mos snyoms 'byung ba'i bde don gal cher brten da phyin mgo brtsi byed mtshams skabs 'khel thog gzhung gnas su dgongs skor 'char 'bul ma dgos par rang rang rdzong 'go so sos 'khur len 'go'adzin gyis gtso rgan/mnga' khul mi ser byings nas spyi mos drang bden 'os tho 'dems sgrugs bgyis pa'i 'thus mi do chod gsum re bcas mnyam sbrel go bsdur thog nas 2/7

dgon sde khag gi mchod rtsa dang / grwa zog sems can la rtswa rin blangs te mgo brtsi nas phud lam ji yod sngar gnas kyi de byings khral zog sems can dkar nag gang yod sbas bkung sbug 'dren med pa'i mna' gan mtha' 'doms dang 'brel lag bzhag gi mgo brtsi bgyis te khral gzhung 'dra gnyis gsar bkod kyis 'dra ya snyan 'bul thog slad kyang lo bzhi re'i mtshams so sor gong bzhin mgo brtsi bgyis te khral rigs gang ci mgo bde dran 'phrul gyi khral khyog snyon 'gel rigs med pa'i drang mos nges snyoms gleng med kyis gzhung 'bab chad med dus 'bul bcas blo rtsal lhag bsam zab 'bung dgos rgyu/ da lam rdzong gzhis tshang ma gzhung 'dzin mi 'gro bsko mngags byas par brten rdzong 'go gzhis sdod rnying pa rnams nas sprod 'bru rigs dang / rmos mdzos mtshon sprod rigs che phra gang ci chad 'jog tu gtan nas bzhag mi chog cing / mnga' khul 'byor ldan rnams kyang 'di lo'i ring gzhung 'dzin thog mar brten mthun 'gyur gang zab dgos rgyu/ don tshan gsum par/ rdzong gzhis gzhung 'dzin bskyangs pa 'di thad chos sbyin gyi mnga' bdag gzhung gi phyag rdzas 'phel thabs dang / chab 'bangs bde bar 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul bcas rje 'bangs gnyis dge'i dgongs bzhed kyi mi 'gro so sor shing rta lo 'khor gcig ring sa thag ring thung la gzhigs pa'i phogs thob zur du rtsal ba dang / shing rta lo 'khor byung song rtsis zhu zhus mtshams nas rang rang gzhung bsam byas rjes rnam dbye'i thog nas phogs thob spar cha rtsal rgyu thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar 'dod chung chog shes kyi gtso bor rdzong yongs khral 'bab bsdu gtong gang sar blo lhad kun rdzob phra mo tsam med pa rtsis khra khams dwang 'god 'bul dgos rgyu smos ci/ gzhung sgor chos bcas mi ser thog rdzong gzhis ngo g.yog su thad nas 2/8

lam ngan sgrig 'dzin gyi rang don 'bam tshong spus bsgyur dang / re bcol sogs ming thog 'dra sbyar gyis dngos shugs nas tshong 'khos thabs len/rdzong gzhis 'ga' shas la ra slong lug slong / bal slong / mar slong zer ba sogs khungs med btsan len byed pa'i lam ngan rigs dang / lhag par gzhung sger chos bcas kyi mi ser khongs yul 'brog gang sar khyim tshang nang kha gshin min gyis tha dad byed skabs rdzong gzhis sne sdod dang / sgor chos dpon 'go so sos bgos phud bcu zur zhes pa len srol yod 'dug pa da nas bzung mi ser gyi bde rtsar gnod gzhi'i bgos phud bcu zur zer ba ming tsam sprod len gtan nas mi chog khar/ rdzong sdod ser skya ngo g.yog nas rang don sger gyi sa zhing 'debs bskul nam yang mi chog pa bcas gzhung 'bab kyis mtshon lhag bsam byas rjes thon rigs la phogs 'phar dang / go ming gnas spar/gzhung 'bab la g.yo zol he bag btang rigs dang / chab 'bangs thog 'phar brdabs tshul min byas par gsal 'phrod rnams la mig ltos 'doms pa'i nyes chad skabs 'phral gcod rgyu/ yul gru 'ga' shas la skya sngo'i chu thob thad spyi sgrig chu khra sogs rtsa 'dzin med par chu bdag nas btsan shed kyis mi ser khyer dman sogs kyi zhing lo zhing chu bkag 'gog byed kyi yod 'dug pa da nas bzung chu bde skyid kyi rtsa bar song tshang mar mos snyoms kyis gtong ba las/chu bdag yin tshul gyis bkag 'gog rigs gzhung sgor chos bcas su thad nas dngos shugs su mi chog par gzhung phyag 'debs kyis mtshon khral zhing /chos gzhis/ gsar sbol bcas par dpon 'go mi ser bcas mos snyoms gtong 'grems bkod khyab byed cing / sger chos khag nas nar khral bskul 'ded rigs la'ang rkang 'gro rta khal zhing g.yog sogs mtshams tshod med pa'i 2/9

mi ser bde rtsar bsam med 'ar 'ded btsan bskul rigs dang / rang 'og mi ser la nang rdung srog rkyen du gtong ba sogs khrims 'gal rigs gtan nas mi chog khar/ gzhung sger chos bcas tshang mas len sprod 'bo rgya gang ci gtan tshig mkhar ru dang / mkhar rgya tshad 'pher rang la rtsa 'dzin dgos rgyur mnga' khul du sprad len 'bo rgyar g.yo zol yod rigs rdzong gzhis so sos skyon sang gis 'bo rgya gsar zhu dang / g.yo zol can gyi 'bo rgya phyir bsdu byed 'os bcas drang zhib mjug gnon dgos rgyu/ rdzong gzhis dang / sger chos gzhis khag so so'i btsas ma rnga 'dren ma zin bar chab 'bangs mi ser gyi ston 'bras rnga 'dren mi chog pa dang / re 'gar rnga 'dren chog 'thus dgongs zhu byed lam gyi srol ngan sna tshogs yod 'dug pa da nas ston 'bras la sad ser chud zos 'gro bzhin de rigs mi chog par yul lung so so'i gnas lugs la gzhigs pa'i mchog dman tshang mar sman sleb gang che'i srol gsar bzo dgos rgyu ma zad/ lhag par gzhung 'bangs gnyis dge'i khral khrims sgrub 'khur sogs don gal che rigs kyi legs bzo bskyar bcos byed 'os rdzong gzhis sne sdod dang / mnga' khul 'go byed gtso drag rgan dmangs bcas nas bsam gros zhib bsdur gyis spyi sman legs che'i 'char gzhi 'am/ gnas lugs snyan zhu gang 'os rim 'bul thub pa dgos rgyu/ don tshan bzhi par/ da phan gzhung sa'i mi sna 'grul bzhud khag la sa shenas so so'i gtso rgan nas sa mjal zhes pa sha'am sran chag nga 'bras sne sel re sprad blangs kyis nang khul 'du khongs rtsis rgyag skabs ma song song tshul phon che rtsis sar khyer te bar zos ji snyed cig yod 'dug pa da nas gzhung sa'i mi sna 'grul bzhud che phrar sa gnas 'jal zhu zer ba ma dgos pa ma zad/ 'du khongs rtsis rgyag thad lo mang 220

sdebs rdzob kyi khral sri rgyugs gun che bar gyong 'khri sogs mi ser nang khul mos mi snyoms pa'i kun rdzob che gshis da nas bzung lo ltar zla tshes dus bkag krig car gyis rdzong 'du dang / rta khal 'khri khungs tshang 'dzoms thog nas 'du rtsis khams dwang rgyab ste slog sprod byed 'os kyang 'phral 'phral byed pa las sngar lugs kyi zom rigs nam yang mi chog mnga' khul so sor gzhung sger chos bcas kyi bu phrug rnams la lugs gnyis kyi blang dor 'byed pa'i mig lta bu yi ge 'bri klog pher ba'i slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis rang rang blo dang 'tshams pa'i yig rtsis slob sbyong gang thub dgos rgyur de yang mi ser la 'phar rdabs mi 'byung ched dge rgan dang / slob phrug rnams la lto phogs 'deng nges dang / meg chas rtsis sprod thub pa'i 'bab dmigs shig zur du thabs shes go sgrig zab 'bungs dgos rgyu/ mnga' khul so sor da phan bed med du bzhag pa'i sa stong yod rigs la gzhung sgor chos bcas mi ser dud chung dang bcas pa su 'os nas rang rang thabs 'khos la gzhigs pa'i gzhung 'bab bcu zur spyi mtshungs sgrub 'khur zhus te sa zhing 'phru 'dul dang / tshal zhing gsar 'debs/ shing 'dzugs sogs la gzhung 'bab babs mtshungs 'gel bkod kyis yul lung yar rgyas dge bod gsar thon gyi las 'gul rigs bgyis par mkhreg bzung snyad rtsod rigs su thad nas dngos shugs su byas mi chog rgyal pad dbang gsum khul zhib gzhung brjod gsal gzhung rgyugs rnams khral 'tsho khungs stong mi 'byung ched mnga' khul sgor khag la glang ske bel btags kyis 'gel dkri gnang ba de dag dus phyis khral 'tshor phan thabs med pa'i khral rkang stong rkyen gyi 'phar brdabs ci che yod 'dug pa da phyin khul der glang ske bel btags ma dgos par khral rkang rang 'tsho 'dzin thub thabs 'tsho phan ji 22/
