'os go bsdur gyis rje 'bangs gnyis dge'i bsam 'char gnas snyan zhib 'bul dgos rgyu/ don tshan lnga par/ deng dus sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rgya bod spun zla mi rigs mthun sgril dang / bod rigs nang khul mthun lam gcig sgril dgos pa'i lam gsar du phye ba'i skabs 'dir sa gnas so sos krung dbyang dpon dmag yod rigs la mthun sgril zab nan dang 'brel phan tshun gcig phan gnyis grogs thog bod rigs nang khul mthun lam rdog rtsa gcig bsgril yong ba bcas la tshang mas 'bad brtson lhod med dgos rgyu dang /gzhung gnas nas chab 'bangs ris med bde rtsar 'tsho gzigs kyi sbug tham/srid tham/ bka' tham bcas kyi bka' rtsa snga phyir rim rtsal dgongs don 'gal med lta zhib mjug gnon rgyun bsrings dang / mnga' khul gzhung rgyugs stong rkang rigs gzhung sger chos bcas nas kha 'dzin gyis khral rigs ngos rgyugs med par mi spyir khral dod dang / zhing bog sne sel tsam re sprad de sger bed byed mi 'ga' shas yod 'dug pa de rigs stong rkang ji yod da lam rdzong gzhis so sos mnga' khul du rtsa zhib bcad de gnas lugs 'di dang 'di 'dug gnas snyan kha gsal dgongs bde nges 'bul dgos rgyu dang / phyi rgyal sa mtshams 'khel yul khag nas bar lam sa sde dbang rigs la 'thus shor byung yod med rtsad zhib kyis 'thus shor byung yod na sngar gyi sa mtshams gang yin dang / dbang cha ji yod/ bar lam 'thus shor song stangs bcas kyi gnas lugs phra zhib snyan zhu 'phral 'bul thog slad sngar gyi sa mtshams nas sa sde dbang rigs phra mo tsam the gu sne shor ma song ba srung 'doms bdag gces zab nan lhod med dang / nges med gsar spros rigs shar na skabs 'phral so sor gnas lugs snyan zhu 'phral 'bul dgos rgyu/ sa gnas spyi khyab 222

dang / rdzong 'go gzhis sdod so sos rtsa khrims phyogs 'gal gyi gzhung 'bab la bsam med he bag dang / chab 'bangs thog 'phar brdabs mnar gcod rigs byas pa byung tshe mnga' khul lha sde mi sde mchog dman tshang mas rje 'bangs gnyis dge'i skyon bsang thad kur brjod pa'am/ gnas lugs snyan zhu thad 'bul zhus chog pa yod cing / skyon bsang brjod mi dang / snyan zhu thad 'bul zhu mir spyi khyab rdzong 'go gzhis sdod nas dga' min zhe 'khon gyi do dam btson 'jug nyes bkod sogs bsun gtser rigs gtan nas mi chog lhag par snga lo 'bru dngul bun 'bab sprod 'jal dang / gsar gtong byed sgo'i bkod rgya par ma sngon song 'gal med dam pos dam bcings don du chab 'bangs mi ser bde skyid kyis 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul lhur len thog rdzong gzhis khag nas sa gnas spyi khab kyi ngag bkod dwang len bgyis thog gtso bor gzhung sa'i phyag 'bab tshags tshud kyi rtsis zhu dus thog tu dgongs gzhi dgos pa don ldan du 'gyur ba dgos gal che ba bcas lo 'khor so so'i nang rdzong yongs kyi gtong yong gong ltar rtsa 'dzin lag len du bstar te lhag bsam zal thon gyi gzhung 'bab rtsis zhu ji yod lo rang bkag so sor thub pa dgos rgyur de yang rdzong gnyis so sos lo 'khor byung song zhib gsal rtsis khra bkod de sa gnas spyi khyab par sprad thog spyi khyab pa nas sa gnas so sor rdzong gtso rgan 'thus thun mong sar rtsis zhus zhib nan btang ste byung song khums lus ji yod skyon 'don gyis he bag med pa gtan la phab pa'i rtsis khrar spyi khyab pa nas rtsis khrar he bag med ces 'gan len sa yig tham sbyar 'god 'bul gyis rdzong gzhis ngo ma so so rgyal khab tu bcar te slar legs bcos tshogs 'du nas rtsis khrar rtsis zhus nges nan gtong 'jug rgyur lhag bsam byas byung dang / gzhung 'bab 223
/cas kyi rnam dbye 5ba pa bgyi rgyu bcas zla // tshes /7la

krung dbyang sku tshab krang cin wu'u bod la thog mar phebs skabs ngas sne shan du bskyod pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhigazhol khang bsod nams dar rgyas//90lor mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod skabs mdo smad sa khul du bod dmag pham nyes byung rjes tā la'i bla ma mchog gro mor phebs pa dang / /95/lo'i zla par rgyal sa pe cin du 'thus mi btang ste bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod zin don ltar krung dbyang gi sku tshab dmag dpon chen po krang cin wu'u sku 'khor nyin rdu brgyud bod phebs gnang rgyu yin pas ka lon spug tu phebs bsu zhu ba dang sbrags lha sa bar phebs lam gyi sne shan du gro mo nas gzhung zhabs gcig gtong dgos shing / bkras mthong sras stobs 'byor lags ka sbug tu sdod mus ma zad/ rgya skad kyang shes pa dang bcas gro mo bka' shag nas khong gtong rgyur tā la'i bla mar snyan zhu dang 'brel thog mar khong la bka' rgya zhig btang 'dug kyang khong gzugs babs bde min gyis 22

dgongs pa zhus stabs phun khang sras mgon po tshe ring lags ka sbug tu bod kyi tshong don las byar yod pas khong la bka' rgya btang rung dgongs pa zhus pa /nga / de bzhin rtse mgron thub bstan tshe 'phel gyis kyang dgongs pa zhus pa spyod/skabs der nga rang phag ri rdzong sdod yin mus thog tā la'i bla ma mchog gro mor yod stabs mkho sgrub kyi las don bgyid mus yin zhing / mthar nga rang gro mo bka' shag nas slokhyod rang krung dbyang sku tshab kyi phebs bsur ka sbug bar 'phral du thon rtsis byed dgos pa dang / byed sgo thon khar zhib mngags byas chog ces bka' phab byung / nga'i bsam par mi tsho tshang mas dgongs pa zhu yi yod pa dang / lhag par nga rang gung khran tang 'gog rgol byed ched hin rdu nas me mdel dbor 'dren nang hur brtson gyis zhugs myong bas/ da cha krung dbyang gi sku tshab phebs bsur gang 'dra byas te 'gro nus sam/ 'bras ljongs dang ka sbug sogs la gnyen nye ngo shes mang dag yod pas de dag la'ang gang 'dra byas te gdong bstan nus sam snyam pa dang / lhag don gung khran tang gis bla ma dang dpon po tshang ma gsod kyi red zer ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i dril bsgrags la yid ches kyis dogs skrags dang som nyi'i gnas su lhung ba'i skabs der nga'i skyed byed rtse phyag gi las 'khur thog gro mor tā la'i bla ma'i chibs zhabs gras su yod mus yin pas khong gis 5nga tshos legs nyes ga re yong gi yod na rgyal ba rin po che bod la phyir log phebs rgyu kho na'i sems thag bcad yod pa las phyi rgyal la phebs rgyu min gshis da cha mtha' mtshams su dus babs 'di 'dra zhig la gyar dus tshang mas dgongs pa zhus na rgyal ba rin po che thugs pham yong rgyu ma zad/ rang gzhan tshang ma 'di phyi 226

gnyis med 'gro rgyu dang lhag par 〈 gros mthun 〉yang bzhag zin pas gcig byas na sdug po rang e yong / khyod rang gis dus skabs so sor bsam gzhigs byas te snga 'phros phyin pa dga' gi red ces gsungs pa dang / de'i thog la mdo smad khul du dza drag gi gnas tshul yod rkyen lha sa nas mi mang po nyin rdu sogs la bros byol 'gro mus skabs nga rang phag rir bsdad yod cing /nga'i gcen po thub bstan nyi ma kong po rgya mdar phogs dpon mkhan chung gi las tshab yin pas khong gi yi ge zhig 'byor don yonga'i go thos su lha sa nas mi mang po phyi rgyal la bros byol 'gro yi yod tshod kyang / gung khran tang ni khyi dang spag 'phrad pa ltar de 'phral za mkhan zhig e yin nam/ khyod rang gnas skabs phyi rgyal sogs la ma phyin pa dga' gi red/ ma gzhi gcig byas na nga rang yang ring min lha sar yong rtsis la de mtshams skad cha byas chog7ces gsal ba ltar de dag la cha bzhag nas ngas krung dbyang sku tshab kyi phebs bsur 'gro rgyur sems thag bcad de bza' zla bu phrug phag rir bzhag nas nga rang gro mo bka' shag la thon phyag zhu bar phyin pas bka' blon khri pa ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen nas dzikhyed rang ka sbug la shad skyod kyis krung dbyang sku tshab phebs sgug zhus thog gcig byas na khe smad dza sag bsod nams dbang 'dus sngon tsam la phebs rgyur khong la phebs sgrig zhu phyogs go bsdur zhu dgos pa dang /bod kyi sa mtshams nas sku srung mtshon byed phag rir rgyab srung rgya sbyong dmag ru bzhi pa bsdad yod pas de'i khongs nas brgya dpon gcig dang dmag mi 25'bras ljongs sa mtshams sna thod la rtser gtong rgyu yin gshis de dag gi byed sgo ma gzhi brgya dpon la'ang zur mngags bya rgyu yang / don snying khyod rang gis bkod 'doms thog krung dbyang sku tshab ngo 'khor la lam bar nye zho med par 227

byed sgo 'thus tshang dgos rgyu dang / gro mo nas lha sa bar khyod rang dang / las sbrel rtse mgron chos chang thub bstan sna lam gtong rgyu yin mizhes bkod mngags gnang don ltar dang len zhus/ka sbug tu krung dbyang sku tshab kyi phebs bsur dngos su bskyod pa//95/ lo'i zla 6 tshes 27tsam la gro mo nas thon te ka sbug tu 'byor zhing /gzhi rkang ka sbug dbyin ji'i za khang hi ma la ya'i ho kral zer ba de stabs bde po yod kyang / bshad srol la de'i nang rgyun du gsang myul yod pa'i thog tshags par las rigs tsho yang de gar sdod mus yin stabs nga rang yang blo bde po rang ma byung bas rjes su ka sbug dur dzin ri rgyud du rgya gar ba zhig gi sgor khang ghi hin wu kru li zer ba'i khang pa khe gtsang gcig 'dug pa der nyin bdun gcig gi khang gla sprad de gnas g.yar byas/ khang pa de yag po 'dug kyang khang srung mi gcig dang / shing khrog kha shas tsam ma gtogs thab chas dang / za snod dkar yol sogs gang yang med pa'i khang stong yin cing /skabs der spom mda' rim bzhi yar 'phel lags ka sbug tu bzhugs mus yin stabs khong dang / sa 'du tshang gi rogs ram gang yang gnang byung bas phebs sgrig zhu gra 'grigs tsam byung song /zla ga tshes 7 tsam la rdi li nas rang rgyal gzhung tshab pa'i drung yig gzhon pa dang / las bya gnyis phebs 'byor byung zhing / khong tshos dziphebs sgrig zhu rgyu'i thad la rogs ram gang byed dgos sam gsungs byung bar ngas gzigs zhib gnang ste skyar sgrig zhu dgos 'dug na dgongs 'chan gsung grogs zhus 228

par khong tshos gzigs skor gnang rjes thugs mgu po'i ngang 6 yag po byung 'dug nga tsho 'di gar sngon la slebs ma thub par khyed rang sku ngal byung 'dug pas dgongs pa ma 'gal zhes gsungs byung / ngas nga ni gro mo bka' shag nas phebs sgrig sne shan la ched mngags btang ba zhig yin pas nga'i 'os 'gan red ces zhus/ de nas khong tsho dgong mo de rang la phyir log phebs song / ka sbug tu phebs sgrig zhu yul gyi bzhugs gnas ri ldebs la yin pa dang / sku tshab sku 'khor ma phebs gong nas lho rgyud ri ldebs kyi shing nags khrod du ka spug bde sung las bya kha shas kyis zhi chas gyon te lkog blta byed bzhin yod pa red/tshes 9nyin phun khang sras mgon po tshe ring lags dang nga gnyis mu mthud phebs sgrig zhu bzhin pa'i skabs der ka sbug bde srung 'go byed shar pa rigs yin pa (ming nges kyi mi 'dug)kho pas lag par 'khar rgyug cig khyer nas mi kha shas dang mnyam du bshar rgyag nang la yong ste 6 lhan gnyis phebs sgrig gnang gi yod dam/ rogs ram zhu dgos mi 'dug gam zhes zer bar ngas thugs rje che lam tsam 'grigs song zhes bshad/ kho pas ‘ 'di gar ga tshod bzhugs rtsis yod dam zer/ ngas da lta shes ma song zhes bshad pa dang /ngas phun khang sras la khong su red dam zhus pas/ bde srung 'go byed bha buramo red gsung gi 'dug ngas bha bu lags/ ri ldebs nas mi kha shas kyis 'di gar lkog blta byed kyi 'dug pas de dag gang red dam zhes bshad pas/kho pas 6 thugs dogs mi dgos/ khyed rnam pa'i bde 'jags kyi ched du red mices zer gyi 'dug de nas kho pa tsho phyir log cing / rjes su go thos la mi de dag gis nga tsho'i sar 'grul bzhud thug 'phrad mi sna su yin dang mi grangs tho 229

'god byas pa red zer gyi 'dug bha bu de de snga dbyin ji'i skabs la ka spug tu las ka byed myong ba dang / nyin rdu rang btsan byung ba'i rjes su nyin thus btson khang la'ang bcug myong zhing / de rjes ka spug bde srung 'go byed byas pa red zer gyi 'dug krung dbyang sku tshab ka sbug nas gro mor phebs pa//95/ lo'i zla 7mas /0nyin krung dbyang sku tshab krang cin lu'u dang /a lu'u pu'u krang / skad sgyur phun tshogs bkra shis lags/ las bya tar gtong mkhan gcig dang / sku srung zhabs zhu gzhon nu gcig bcas kyi thog rdi li nas rang rgyal gzhung tshab kyi las bya gnyis kyis phebs rogs zhus te ka spug la nyin gung chu tshod dang po tsam la phebs 'byor byung zhing / grong gsham du bod kyi tshong don sku tshab mkhan chung blo bzang tshe dbang dang zur khang rim bzhi dbang chen tshe brtan gnyis dang / ka sbug tu gtan sdod rgya bod tshong rigs che khag ka sbug krung hwa slob grwa'i dge slob bcas dga' bsu zhu bar bcar te slob phrug gis me tog chun po phul ba dang / bod rigs tshos kha btags phul/ngas phebs sgrig zhu khang gi sgo 'gram nas phebs bsu zhus te mjal dar phul rjes nang la phebs 'phral gsol ja zhal dkar dang po mchod zin 'phral sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis nga la 4gro mor tā la'i bla ma mchog sku khams bzang po 'dug gam/ khyed rang sku bsnyel ma song ngamatshogasungs par/ ngas 5tā la'i bla ma sku khams bzang po yin/ nga dka' ma byung 7zhes zhus/ de'i dgongs dro gyi ma la ya'i za khang du bod kyi tshong don sku tshab gong gsal gnyis dang / rim bzhi spom mda' yar 'phel sogs bod kyi tshong rigs che khag tshos dga' 230

bcu'i gsol tshigs phul ba der phebs shing / ka spug tu yod pa'i bla phyag phreng ring 'jigs med sum rtsen sogs gzhung zhabs kha shas dang / ka sbug pho brang 'brug pa'i sras sros kyang gsol tshigs la gdan zhu byas 'dug tshong don sku tshab tshos gtam bshad byas song yang / krung dbyang sku tshab la dga' bsu zhu ba'i tshig don tsam gyi thog nas bzhes rag bkyag pa las 〈gros mthun 〉skor la gang yang shod mkhan byung ma song / de rjes sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis 〈bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod par bkra shis bde legs kyi shis tshig dang / mi rigs mthun sgril sogs kyi skor nas gsungs te bzhes rags bkyag gnang song /de rjes mi so sos phan tshun bzhes rag bkyag res byas te sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas kyang bzhes rags gang 'tshams mchod rjes dgong dro'i chu tshod 9 30la gsol ston mjug sgril nas log phebs skabs tshong spyi gnyis nas sgo 'gram bar phebs skyes zhus pa dang / ngas bzhugs gnas bar phebs skyel zhus te slar yang khong tsho'i sar phyin pa yin/ de dus mi mang che ba bsdad 'dug pas skabs re ḍan se brgyag pa dang / skabs re mi re gnyis kyis gzhas gtong gi 'dug nyi ma la ya'i za khang gi sbyin bdag meg kron sab (dbyin ji'i mi khongs)zer ba kho pa lo na 80yas mas tsam slebs shing / bod kyi skad yig kyang shes pas kho pas bod skad thog nas gzhas tshig tu phanor bu rang la yod dus/ nor bu'i nor nyams mi chod/ nor bu mi la shor dus/snying rlung stod la 'tshang song 7zhes btang ste mgo bo sprug pa dang / lag pas kho pa'i brang rdung bzhin par zhabs bro brgyab song bas der yod mi rnams gad mo dgod bzhin par lag pa brdabs pa tsam las ga shod 'di shod byung ma song / 23/

don dngos thog 〈 gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod nas bod 'di mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i pang du log stabs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa snying rlung stod la 'tshang nges yin pa de dag mngon sum gson rjes gyis 'khyab ston byas pa zhig red/meg gron sab ni dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod la btsan 'dzul byed sgo tshugs pa'i skabs nas the jus yod mkhan zhig yin pa dang /de snga lha sar yong myong ba ma zad/ gro mo dang rgyal rtse bcas la tshong don sku tshab byas te yun ring sdod myong bas bod kyi skor la rgyus mnga' che tsam dang dbus gtsang sku drag che khag dang yang 'brel 'dris chen po yod mkhan zhig yin 'dug gang lags she na/ kho pas nga la ‘ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar la phebs dus nga rang sne len zhabs zhu'i khongs su yod/ nga rang ni las sla po zhig min par blon chen bshad zhol chang (bshad sgra dang / zhol khang /chang khyim/)gsum la thod pa gtugs myong mkhan bsod nams can zhig yin zhes bshad byung /tshes // zhogs pa/ ka spug krung hwa slob grwas dga' bsu'i tshogs chen 'tshogs pa dang 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel zhus shing / krung hwa slob grwa'i zha'o krang gis tshogs chen gtso skyong byas pa dang / tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan bod kyi tshong don spyi khyab gong gsal mkhan rim gnyis dang / rwa spom sa gsum (ra sgreng dang spom mda' tshang / sa 'du tshang )gyis gtsos rgya bod tshong rigs che khag slob grwa'i dge slob dang bcas khyon mi grangs /00skor yod tshod/tshong spyi dang / tshong rigs so so'i 'thus mis gsung bshad gnang ba ma zad/232

de rjes rang mos kyi gsung bshad gnang skabs 〈 gros mthun〉skor la mang che bas rnam 'gyur gang yag bton pa dang / sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis gsung bshad gnang zhing / mjug tu ka spug bod yig tshags par gyi rtsom sgrig pa khu nu mthar phyin gyis thog mar krung dbyang sku tshab la dga' bsu zhu rgyu'i rtags mtshan bstan pa dang / de nas 〈 gros mthun 〉skor la 'tshod la ma 'tshod mang dag cig bshad rjes bod kyi btsan po'i dus bod dmag drangs te rgya yi gong ma khri thog nas lan gsum phab zer ba sogs dang sa gzhi ril mo skor ba rgyag bzhin yod pas su'i khongs gtogs su zer ba sogs 〈 gros mthun 〉la mi 'dod pa'i skad cha gsal la mi gsal mang dag cig bshad song / kho pa ni de snga dbyin ji'i gsang myul red zer srol yod/ tshogs 'du grol rjes ka sbug du gtan sdod rgya rigs tshong pa tshos sger tshong shin je tshang gi gzim shag la nyin gung gsol ston phul zin 'phral ka sbug bka' brgyud dgon par gzigs skor la phebs pa dang zhor du dbyin le bcu pa'i khrom gzhung rgyud du'ang gzigs skor gnang zhing / dgong dro'i chu tshod she pa tsam la ka sbug nas phebs rdog thon te 'bras ljongs su phebs pa red/de skabs ngas gung khran tang la yid ches byed kyi med kyang / krung dbyang sku tshab sku 'khor gyi bde 'jags dang / 'tsho ba'i thog sems 'khur byed myong ba dper na/ lam bar zhal lag sogs yag po yong ched bod srid gzhung gi bka' 'brel la ma ltos par ka spug nas bod rigs rgya zas ma byan bkra shis dpal 'bar zer bar nyin gla nyin rdu'i ru pi bcu re sprad de lha sa bar khrid yong ba yin/a lu'u pu'u krang ni mjal ba'i nyin mo de rang nas yun ring gshibs 233

pa'i grogs po ltar 'dzems bag med la/ zhal thag sangs shing / nga'i sems la dogs gnas yod par gzhigs nas ngang ring gi slob gso dang / lhag par du tang gi srid jus dang 〈 gros mthun 〉skor la yang yang 'grel bshad gnang gi 'dug 'bras ljongs su slebs rjes thengs shig a lu'u pu'u krang gis su'u lan gyi skor gsungs par ngas skad sgyur phun tshogs bkra shis lags brgyud su'u lan zer na u ru su dmar po ma red dam/ u ru su dmar po zhes pa ni mig dkar po red zer gyi 'dug nga tsho ni mig nag po yin pas mig dkar por bod pas dang len rtsa ba nas byed kyi ma red ces bshad/ de'i go don u ru su dmar po'i las lugs bod pas dang len byed kyi ma red zer ba de red/'on kyang go don de khong gis go ba lon yod med mi shes kyang / skad cha de sku tshab krang cin wu'u la zhu skabs tshang ma bzhad mo chen po bzhad de bzhugs pa las lan gsungs ma byung /tshes /2nyin 'bras ljongs nas thon te dbyin le nyi shu'i sar 'bras ljongs sa khongs mtsho 'go zer bar bzhugs zhag gnang zhing / der bod rigs tshong pa ngo shas 'ga' shas slebs 'dug pa khong tshos nga la rtsam pa ster bas dgong dro'i zhal lag sgo'o sgor sar ngas spag zas stabs sku tshab rnam pas slong tsho yang rtsam pa za dgos 7gsung gi 'dug ngas nga tsho de snga rgya la nyin shas tsam bsdad de phyir log skabs rtsam pa za thengs dang por grod pa bshal gyi 'dug pas/ khyed rnams de bas lam bar sku ngal bzo gi red ces zhus te ma phul/ sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis 2 nga tsho bod rigs kyi 'tsho ba slob sbyong byed dgos pas nges par du za gi yin zhes u tshugs bskyon gyi 'dug kyang ngas 'gan blos mi bzod bod la phebs nas mchod na yag gi red ces zhus te rtsa 234

ba nas ma phul/ a lu'u pu'u krang gis ku re dang sbrags gad mo dgod bzhin par nga'i phor pa'i nang nas spag ril chen po gcig mchod song bas de'i sang nyin grod pa bshal ba red/ dgong dro sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis dgyes nyams chen pos phasang nyid nga tsho rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bod kyi sa mtshams sna thod la rtser slebs rgyu red ces gsung gi 'dug ngas gro mor tar btang zin pas la rtser bod dmag nga tsho'i phebs bsur bcar rgyu red ces zhus/tshes /3nyin mtsho 'go nas thon te la rtser slebs skabs bod dmag phebs bsur slebs mi 'dug pas nga rang yang blo dogs dang sems 'tshab byung / la rtser sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis chibs las bshol te spro nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas phyogs bzhir gzigs shing phad cha nga tsho mes rgyal gyi sa sne zin pa red ces gsungs 'phral a lu'u pu'u krang gis phun bkras lags brgyud bzhad gad dang 'brel 6 bod dmag phebs bcur slebs mi 'dug pas ga re byas pa red dam gsungs byung bar ngas zhu tshod ma theng bar 'char gzhi byas na de ltar yin rung gang byas pa yin nam zhes zhus/ la rtse nas dbyin le phyed tsam babs zin mtshams chu 'bi'i gsog lam zhig yod pa de brgyud nas sku srung rta dmag nyi shu rtsa lnga brel tshub kyi ngang rgyugs yong ste sa bab phran bu'i bde sa zhig tu bod dmag rnams nas dmag lugs gus 'dud zhus par sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis gus lan gnang / de nub chu 'bi zhes pa'i la sked du bzhugs zhag gnang / dgong dro dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus kyis sku srung brgya dpon la la rtser dus 'byor med pa phyis 'gyangs byas skor nan 'dri byas par brgya dpon nas la rtser nyin gung tsam la ma gtogs phebs 'byor mi thub pa'i rmongs tshod kyis 'gyangs pa las rang bzhin brtsi med zhus 235

pa rtsa ba nas min nges zhes dgongs pa dang thabs zhus/zla 7 mas /4 nyin chu 'bi nas thon te la gsham du 'byor mtshams gro mo bye thang du bka' shag gi thab bsu'i sar bka' blon ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen sogs dang / gzhung zhabs khag cig tā la'i bla ma rin po che'i sku srung dpon dmag bcas nas sbrang ban zhus te dbu gur nang phebs nyid mjal dar phul zhing / rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan gyis tā la'i bla ma rin po che'i sku tshab zhus te 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar phul bar krung dbyang sku tshab nas 'tshams lan mjal dar gnang / rtse gsol thab pas gsol ja btegs rjes mdzad sgo grol te de nas phebs thon gyis gro mo shar gsing ma'i grong dkyil du phebs sgrig zhus 'dug pa der bzhugs/zla 3tshes /5 nyin sku tshab krang cin wu'u yi bzhugs mtsher la bka' blon ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ bka' blon mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas/ bka' blon bkra shis gling pa (dom po)mkhyen rab dbang phyug bcas mjal 'phrad la phebs pa dang sbrags sang nyin sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis tā la'i bla ma rin po che mjal 'phrad la phebs skabs bzhugs gdan sgron phyogs skor sogs bka' bsdur yang gnang ba red/tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / krung dbyang gi sku tshab gro mor mjal 'phrad thog mar byung ba/zla 3 tshes /6 nyin snga dro bka' blon ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gyis shar gsing mar sku tshab krang cin lu'u gdan zhur phebs te de nas chibs thon 236

gyis ri spun sgang gi la gsham du phebs skabs der gzhung zhabs tshos phebs bsu'i sbrang ban zhu bar phebs pas/ sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis chibs las bshol nas tshang mar phyag btang ste 'tshams 'dri gnang / tā la'i bla ma dung dkar dgon par bzhugs yod pas dgon pa'i mdun phyogs su dbu gur kha nub blta byas te phub 'dug pa der bka' blon rnam pas sku tshab krang cin wu'u la sne len zhus te sku ngal phran bu gsos rjes bka' blon tsho'i phebs rogs dang 'brel sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad du phebs shing /skabs der ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris dang / 〈 gros mthun 〉〉gyi ma yig 'dra bshus ngas 'khyer yod pas gzim chung sgo 'gram nas khe smad dza sag bsod nams dbang 'dus nas blangs te gzim chung du phebs skabs tā la'i bla ma rin po che zhabs stegs thog nas babs gnang ste phan tshun phyag gtong res gnang rjes zhabs stegs so sor bzhugs/ ngas gzim chung sgo 'gram nas bltas pas tā la'i bla ma'i zhabs stegs khri'u shing gi 'og shing gi gdan khri mtho gang tsam zhig la sa gdan g.yogs yod pa dang / sku tshab krang cin wu'u dang /a lu'u pu'u krang gi zhabs stegs 'og sa gdan las shing gi gdan khri mi 'dug pas mtho dma' phran bu 'dug gsol ja bzhes 'bras btegs rjes/ tā la'i bla ma mchog dang sku tshab krang cin wu'u sogs phan tshun gsung mol gnang ste mdzad sgo grol/ nga rang gam bcar med stabs bka' mol gyi nang don zhib gsal thos ma byung /zla 3tshes /7nyin/ gro mor gtan sdod hin rdu'i tshong don spyi khyab pa ra'e bha dur bsod nams stobs ldan dang / drung yig rgan pa rgya mtsho bha bu gnyis sku tshab krang cin lu'u la mjal 'phrad 'tshams zhur slebs song / khong 237

gnyis ni 'bras ljongs pa yin gshis/ nga'i bsam par khong tsho mjal 'phrad la bcar skabs nga rang yang mnyam sdod byas na cung bka' mol gnang stabs mi bde ba med dam/ rang gi las 'gan ni phebs lam sne shan dang / sku srung gi las 'gan tsam ma gtogs med pas khong tsho bka' mol gnang sar rang nyid sdod dgos don mi 'dug snyam te khong tsho gzim chung nang gdan zhu ngo sprod zhus nas nga rang phyir don phyin pa yin/ chu tshod gcig tsam nas ngas phyir log yong skabs sgo 'gram nas sku srung bod dmag gcig gis sku ngo khyed rang da lta skad sgyur phun bkras lags kyis 'tshol gyi 'dug zer/ ngas sbug la phyin pas/ sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis nga la skad sgyur brgyud dzin lta nyin rdu'i mi de dag yod dus khyed rang yang 'di gar sdod dgos kyang gang du phyin pa yin nam gsung gi 'dug ngas rang re gros mthun 〉bzhag zin pas bka' mol gang 'dra gnang rung gcig gyur yin pa ma gtogs nga la dmigs bsal zhu yas med stabs sdod dgos yas med pa red ces zhus/ sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis thugs gshis 'jam po'i sgo nas 5de 'dra yin pa smos ci dgos/'on kyang gnad don ngo ma ni phyis 〈gros mthun 〉lag len bstar skabs mnyam du las ka byed dgos stabs khyed tsho lo na gzhon pas las don goms 'dris yong rgyu'i ched du phyi 'brel mi sna yong dus nges par du rang re mnyam du sdod dgos zhes gsungs/ de 'phral a lu'u pu'u krang gis skad sgyur brgyud 5khong tsho tshong donaspyi khyab yin rung / ngas gro mor nyin thu'i tshong pa mi grangs ga tshod yod med dris par shod yas mi 'dug 'o na them dud ga tshod yod dam zhes dris par de yang nges gtan shod yas mi 'dug der gzhigs na khong tshor tshong don las lhag pa'i bod la las 'gan zhig yod bzo red ces 238

gsungs te bzhad mo bzhad kyi 'dugazla 7mas 8dgong dro/ sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus gnyis nas sku tshab krang cin lu'u yi sku mdun la bcar te slobaka' shag gi bka' 'brel bzhin ngos gnyis 'di gar bcar don ni da phan nga tsho'i rlung 'phrin las bya dbyin ji'i mi khongs phog sab kho pa bod du las ka byas te yun ring phyin khar/ kho pa'i bza' za'ang bod rigs yin pa'i thog da cha phru gu'ang gnyis tsam 'brel yod stabs phyis 'byung phyir log mi dgos par mu mthud las don hur thag byas te bsdad chog pa zhes re 'dun zhus 'dug pas de skor bka' shag nas ngos gnyis la sku tshab krang cin wu'u la snyan zhus kyis bka' khrol yong thabs gsung gi 'dug na de don dgongs bzhes yong ba zhes zhus song bar/ sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis 6 kho pa ni dbyin ji'i mi yin gshis ma gzhi nas btsan rgyal ring lugs pas thog mtha' bar gsum la bod du dkrug shing dang / mes rgyal kha bral gyi spyod ngan kho na ma gtogs byed myong med cing / 'on kyang kho pa bod la rgyun sdod bya rgyu'i thad kho pa'i bya spyod la gzhigs te phyis 'byung bod mi dmangs kyis thag gcod bya rgyu ma gtogs da lta ngas shod mi shes zhes gsungs song / de rjes tā la'i bla ma lha sar phebs 'phral phog sab zhed thag chod nas ka spug la bros phyin pa red/gong tshes nyin sne'u shar dang khe smad gnyis kyis tā la'i bla ma'i bka' 'brel ltar bka' shag brgyud chibs ra spug nas sku tshab krang cin lu'u dang / a lu'u pu'u krang gnyis la chibs rta rkyang po spus legs cha gcig phul song bas der sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis tā la'i bla ma rin po che dang bka' shag la thugs rje che zhes brgyud zhu gnang grogs ces gsungs song /239

tā la'i bla ma mchog dang krung dbyang gi sku tshab snga rting thog gro mo nas lha sar phebs pa//95/ lo'i zla 2 tshes 2/ nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog lha sar phebs thon gnang bar sku tshab krang cin wu'u sogs kyis phebs skyel du rud phungs sgang la phebs/ de nas gro mo shar gsing mar phyir log mdzad/tshes 23 nyin krung dbyang gi sku tshab rnam pa gro mo nas phebs thon gyis gro mo sgab la bzhugs zhag gnang / tshes 24 nyin phag rir 'byor/ tshes25nyin sku tshab krang cin wu'u sku gzugs phran bu bde min gyis phag rir bzhugs pa yin rung / snga dro phag ri rdzong la gzigs zhib tu phebs shing / rdzong khang gi 'khor yug tshang ma gyang gog yin pas sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis ‘ de dag ga re byas pa red dam zhes bka' 'dri gnang byung / ngas 'di dag shing 'brug lo dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul byed skabs gtor skyon btang ba ma zad/mi'ang mang po bsad pa'i lo rgyus yod lugs zhus pas de dag la gzigs nas yun ring dgongs pa bzhes te bzhugs/ de nas phyir log phebs skabs rdzong gi sgo 'gram la rta lcag sogs khrims chas mang po bkal yod pa de tshor gzigs te nga la khyed rang gis 'di dag bed spyod gtong gi yod dam zhes gsungs/ngas de snga 'brug pa gcig gis bod mi bsad pas kho la rta lcag /50btang ba ma gtogs de min bed spyod gtong rgyu ma byung zhus pas/ khong tsho tshang ma bzhad mo chen po bshor ba dang / sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis tsa phyis 'byung 'brug pa tsam ma zad mi su la'ang rta lcag gtong mi rung / zhes gsung gi 'dugadagong dro phag ri sho bsher mkhan chung chang khyim pa thub bstan tshe 'phel dang /rim bzhi gsum mdo rgyal mtshan yon tan/ phag ri rdzong sdod gnyis bcas 240

nas sho khang du phebs ston gsol tshigs phul zhing / gsol ston thog rdzong khongs che btsan khag dang / rwa spom sa gsum gyi tshong pa gtan sdod/ phag rir gtan sdod 'brug 'bras sku tshab bcas yod gshis sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis bka' slob gsung bshad mdor bsdus gnang song /zla 3tshes 26nyin phag ri nas phebs thon gyis dud sner 'byor/ de nas ka la dang / khang dmar/ sa phud sgang / rgyal rtse bcas so sor bzhugs zhag re gnang zhing / skabs der de snga dbyin ji'i dus nas zhag sa rer 'grul khang stabs bde dang 'brel ba'i sbrag khang re yod pa de dag la bzhugs/sa gnas so so'i mi ser tshos rgan po brgyud mjal dar dang gsol ja/ mchod chang stabs bde re phul ba dgyes bzhes kyis khong tshor ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par rtags ma re dran rten du gnang /zla 3tshes 29nyin rgyal rtse rdzong khongs sa phud sgang gi zhag sar phebs skabs mi ser tshos mjal zhur gsol ja dang mchod chang / bya 'bras/ gsol dkrum/ chibs chag sogs gzab cing rgyas pa 'bul gyi 'dug pas de dag la phran bu thugs blo mi bde tsam byung ste sku tshab krang cin wu'u yis ngang rgyud ring po'i thog nas 66khyed tshos nga tshor gnang skyes de 'dra gnang bar nga tsho ha cang dga' po byung / 'on kyang nga tsho'i srid jus la de 'dra mi chog cing / mi ser la phar zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa ma gtogs mi ser nas tshur khab skud tsam yang blangs mi chog ces tang gi srid jus skor nas bka' slob dang 'brel de dag tshang ma phyir slog gnang song / skabs der rgan po dang mnyam du mi ser lnga tsam 'dug pas de'i nang nas bgres song gnyis kyis sku tshab krang cin wu'u yi phyag nas dam por 'jus te smyo de ni nga tshos mjal rten sems khyad tsam yin 24/

pas chen po med rung dgyes bzhes gnang grogs ces nan zhus bgyis kyang bzhes ma song / der khong tshos sems 'gul thebs bzhin par thugs rje che zhus te log phyin song / mi ser tsho phyir log rjes a lu'u pu'u krang gis bzhin mdangs phran bu log pa'i thog nas skad sgyur phun bkras lags brgyud dzikhyed rang ni nga tshor lam bar sne shan gnang mkhan yin pas rgyus babs dang 'brel bas mi ser tshor gsal bshad gnang ste nga tsho'i srid jus dang mi mthun par mi ser gyi lag nas mjal zhu de 'dra bsdu ru 'jug mi rung 7zhes gsung gi 'dugangs nga la sne shan tsam du ma zad/ sku srung gi las 'gan yang yod pas lam bar mi sna gang byung mjal 'phrad gtong rgyu de nga rang yang blo bde po mi 'dug kyang / mi ser rnams kyis mjal 'dod byas na ma btang na'ang mi 'grig la/ma gzhi nas mjal zhu bsdu dgos zhes ngas bshad pa min cing / da phan dpon rigs 'grul bzhud tshang mar bod la goms gshis de 'dra yod pas red/da dung lha sar phebs dgos stabs lam bar de 'dra yong srid pas ga 'dra byed dgos sam zhes zhus/ sku tshab krang cin lu'u yis 5de 'dra yin na khyed rang la'ang khag mi 'dug 'on kyang nga tsho'i srid jus dang mi mthun pa'i gnas tshul de dag khyed rang nas mang tshogs la gsal bshad yag po byas te phyis 'byung srid jus la shugs rkyen ngan pa mi thebs pa byed dgos zhes gsung gi 'dugazla 3tshes 30nyin rgyal rtser 'byor zhing skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog kyang dpal 'khor chos sder bzhugs mus thog lha sar phebs rdog thon gtan 'khel med pas sku tshab krang cin lu'u yang tshes 3/ nyin rgyal rtse skyid lar bzhugs zhag sku ngal gsos/ de nyin bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge 242

legs dang / dom po ba mkhyen rab dbang phyug gnyis phebs te 〈gros mthun 〉skor khong gnyis kyis sku tshab krang cin wu'u la stod res sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉gyi 'dra bshus cha tshang bsnams phebs yod stabs nga tshos gsal shes thub pa byung zhing / des na gong sa mchog lha sar phebs 'phral gnas tshul tshang ma snyan seng zhu rgyu ma zad/ nga phod nas kyang 〈gros mthun 〉ma yig bsnams phebs rgyur brten de mtshams lag len bstar phyogs skor gros bsdur bya rgyu yin zhes zhus song / de nyid rnam 'gyur phran bu yag tu phyin yod pas sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas dgyes nyams chen pos de rang byas 'bus tā la'i bla ma mchog la 'tshams 'dri brgyud zhu dang / phebs lam la sku gzugs thugs lcag gnang dgos pa'i bka' lan yang gnang ba red/zla 8tshes nyin rgyal rtse rdzong nas phebs thon gyis rgyal rtse rdzong khongs phreng ring gzhis su gsol tsha gnang ste sgo bzhir bzhugs zhag gnang zhing /rgyal rtse phan chod la rgya gar ba'i sbrag khang dang 'brel ba'i 'grul khang la gtsang spra dang yo byad cha tshang yod stabs bzhugs bag pheb la nga tsho'ang stabs bde yod kyang de gar mi ser gyi khang pa legs gras shig gi nang du de snga sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che khag la phebs sgrig zhu gsol ltar khri rgyab khri lcog sogs bsgrigs gshoms byas 'dug pas sku tshab krang cin wu'u phebs 'phral bzhugs khri'i thog bzhugs nas bzhad mo chen po zhig bzhad pa dang sbrags slodar rgyas lags/ bla ma bzhugs sa dang 'dra ba 'di 'dra gang 'dra red dam7zhes gsung gi 'dug ngas dzi'adi ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che khag la phebs sgrig zhu srol ltar yin kyang / da cha da phan gyi 'grul khang ltar 243

med thog mi ser gyi khang pa'ang yag po med pas sang nyin nas rtswa thang thog gur phub ste phebs sgrig zhus na dga' ba med dam zhes zhus par sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas ‘ khyed tsho ca sing de 'dra byed mi dgos/ nga ni mi ser gyi nang la mi ser dang mnyam du sdod rgyu byung na de bas dga' po yong ba 'dug pas sang nyin nas mi ser gyi nang la nges par sdod dgos pa ma zad/ gdan yang 'di 'dra rgyag mi dgos shing stabs bde zhig byas na 'grig gi red ces gsungs/de 'phral mi ser tshos phebs mjal phul bar sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas mchod chang phud stor gnang ba tsam las/ tshang ma phyir slog thog dran rten du ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par brang rtags sogs gnang /zla 8tshes 2nyin ra lung la bzhugs zhag gnang ba dang / zla 8tshes 3nyin sna dkar rtser phebs 'byor skabs sna dkar rtse rdzong rtse drung ye shes smon lam dang / shod drung stag na zur pa bkra shis tshe ring gnyis nas so so'i rdzong khongs kyi sa mtshams bar phebs bsur bcar 'dug pas sku tshab krang cin wu'u sogs kyis chibs las bshol te mjal dar sne sprod stsal/ rdzong bkar khang thog khar phebs sgrig gzab rgyas zhus 'dug cing / rdzong gnyis kyis gtsos gtso drag dang / las drung / rgan po/ mi ser bcas nas phebs mjal du bcar skabs sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas chos lugs dang / mi rigs kyi srid jus skor dril bsgrags bka' slob zab rgyas dang don tshan bcu bdun skor la'ang gsal bshad gnang /zla 8tshes 4 nyin sna dkar rtse nas phebs dog thon pa dang / rdzong gnyis nas so so'i rdzong gi sa mtshams bar phebs skyel zhus te pad dir bzhugs zhag gnang / tshes byazhogs pa pad di nas phebs thon gyis sku tshab krang cin wu'u 244

sku 'khor dang / sku srung dmag bcas sngon tsam la phebs pa dang / ngas mi ser tshor phebs sgrig gla cha sogs rtsis rgyag dgos pas rjes tsam la thon zhing /nga rang la rtser slebs skabs mar tsam la khong tsho sku 'khor dang bcas pa'i khrod du zang zing long long bya gi 'dug pas ngos rang sems 'tshab bzhin par rta po yob rdung gis bskul te der slebs dus bod dmag sku srung gis khams rigs drel pa gnyis kyi lag g.yas g.yon nas bzung 'dug pa ga re byas song ngam zhes dris pas/ sku srung dmag mis bshad don/ kho pa tshor rta drel bkag dgos pa'i lag brda byas kyang drel pas ma bkag stabs lam phrang la sho thug brgyab ste a lu'u pu'u krang chibs nas lhung ba'i gnas tshul byung 'dug sa lu'u pu'u krang gis yar bzhengs te smyo nga rang rta drel gyis 'bud rgyag 'argyab ste rta las lhung ba ma gtogs khong tshos gang yang byas med pas khong tsho rang dgar gtong dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar de 'phral kho tsho glod cing / u lu'u pu'u krang gis par chas shig bsnams yod pas des sgal tshigs dprag nas snyun zug phran bu btang ba ma gtogs skyon cher byung mi 'dug de nub nya sog gru khar bzhugs zhag gnang /zla 8tshes 6 nyin nya sog nas ko grur zhugs te yar klung gtsang po brgal zhing / de nas tsha rong gi gzhis ka chu shur skya kha shar du bzhugs zhag gnang skabs sa gnas sne sdod khag nas phebs mjal gsol ja mchod chang phul ba dang / dza sag tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul gyi gcung mo tshe sgron lags kyi sku zla sras gzhis sdod sku zhabs tshe rnam lags nas phebs mjal zhus rjes gsung sgyur phun bkras lags dang gleng mol gnang zhing / tshe rnam lags nas gsungs don smyo bcings 'grol dmag phon che bod la 'byor na mi ser gyi 'tsho 245

ba khag po yong tshul dang / chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus skor la da lta brtsi 'jog gnang lugs skor gsungs pa de dag yag po yin rung / rjes su 'gyur ldog yong gi ma red dam zhes dang / de bzhin khams khul gyi dgon sde'i gnas tshul kha shas skor dang 'dzam gling dmag chen gsum pa'i skor sogs kyang gsung gleng byung song /zla 8tshes 7nyin chu shur nas phebs thon gyis mnyes thang la 'byor zhing /mnyes thang sgron ma lha khang du phebs sgrig zhus 'dug pa der bzhugs zhag gnang ba dang / de dus sgrol ma lha khang gi sku gsung thugs rten tshang ma sngar bzhin yod pas sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas gzigs skor gnang skabs de'i dkon gnyer gyis jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i lo rgyus phran bu zhus pa gsan rjes yag po 'dug ces gsungs/zla 8tshes 8nyin mnyes thang nas phebs thon gyis chu tshod bzhi tsam phyin rjes pho brang po ta la'i rgya phibs nas gser 'od 'phro ba mthong 'phral sku srung bod dmag rnams kyis rta thog nas dmag dung gtong bzhin zhwa mo phud de gus 'dud zhus/ de nas yar tsam phebs rjes bod la bcings 'grol ma btang gong tsam du zhi mol bya rgyu'i 'brel gtugs gnang bar bod la phebs pa'i blo mthun khre yu'i ru'i phebs bsur phebs 'dug pas khong dang 'tshams 'dri gleng mol gnang / 'bras spungs skye ri'i zur la slebs mtshams bka' shag gi yig sgyur las tshan mā yu'i ku'i (bod ming la nor bu tshe ring )gsung sgyur dang sbrags phebs bsur phebs 'dug pas khong gis mjal dar phul/ skyid tshal klu sdings su sa gnas srid gzhung gis thab bsu'i dbu gur zhes phebs bsu gra sgrig gzab rgyas zhus 'dug pa'i sar srid tshang klu khang pa tshe dbang rab brtan 246

dang / srid tshab blo bzang bkra shis gnyis nas 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar 'bul bar shod mgon gcig dang / gsol thab pa bcas btang 'byor thog bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje dang bka' tshab shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rje/dza tha'i rim bzhis gtsos ser skya dpon rigs mi nyung ba zhig phebs nas dbu gur nang go babs kyi phebs bsu'i mjal dar phul/ kha dang mda' dpon gyis gtsos 'go dmag 500tsam dang / lha sa'i bde srung (pu li si)dmag bcas nas ru sgrig gus 'dud zhus/ rkyang thang na kha'i thog lha sar sdod pa'i rgya rigs tshong pa khag dang de min rgya rigs tshos dbu gur phubs te phebs bsu'i gra sgrig zhus 'dug pa der ching khra dang / tan shin sogs sgrig gshom gyis dga' bsu zhus/ de'i sar lha sa'i mang tshogs gzab mchor spras pa mang pos 'tshang kha brgyab ste sku tshab krang cin lu'u mjal 'dod byas rung / dbu gur chung bas ma shongs stabs gur gyi 'dabs cha'ang ral pa red/ de 'phral sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas zhabs stegs thog 'dzegs pa gnang ste tshang mar phyag g.yab g.yob gnang ba dang sgrags slokhyed tshos nga la gzigs 'dod gnang ba dang / dga' bsu tshad med gnang bar sems kyi gting nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / ngas kyang khyed rnam pa mjal thub pas dga' spro tshad med byung /da cha nga tsho bod la gtan sdod bya rgyu yin stabs rjes su lhod mjal zhu rgyu yin/ zhes gsungs par drag char babs pa lta bu'i thal mo'i deb sgra grags/ de nas rim pa byas te nyin rdu dang / ne pa la'i tshong don sku tshab kyang dga' bsu zhu bar phebs 'dug skabs der lha sa'i bye rags rgyab nas grong khyer nang ma slebs bar gzhung lam g.yas g.yon du gzab mchor spras pa'i mang tshogs kyis gral star bsgrigs te dga' bsu gzab rgyas zhus shing / de nas lha sa grong 247

khyer shar ngos khri smon gyi gzim shag la phebs sgrig zhus 'dug pa der bzhugs pa red/zla 8tshes /6nyin a lu'u bu'u krang nas phun bkras lags brgyud casang nyin tā la'i bla ma lha sar phebs 'byor gnang rgyur brten dga' bsu'i mdzad sgo'i sar sku tshab krang cin wu'u phebs rgyu yin kyang bzhugs gdan sgron phyogs thad sa gnas kyi krung dbyang la brtsi bkur mtshon par byed dgos lugs nga tshos da phan bsam 'char dang / gsal bshad mang po byed myong ba ltar krung dbyang dang sa gnas bar gyi 'brel ba'i babs thob ma log pa zhig dgos rgyu'i skor khyed rang nas bka' shag la zhib lhongs zhus te bka' shag gi dgongs 'char gang yod de ring rang byed bde'i lan gsal byed dgos zhes gsung don bzhin de 'phral bka' shag la bcar skabs de nyin bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje dang / bka' tshab shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rje gnyis phebs 'dug pas khong gnyis la gnas tshul zhib lhongs zhus pa dang 'brel 'os 'tshams dgongs bzhes gnang 'gab che min bka' lan phebs sgug zhu rgyu yin zhes zhus par bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rjes de skor bka' shag drung rtsis dang bcas pas zhib gros kyis srid tshab gnyis la snyan zhus thog bzhugs gdan sgron phyogs srid tshab gnyis kyi bka' slob ltar thugs gtan 'khel ba bzhin a lu'u pu'u krang la kha nyin nas zhus zin cing / gzhi rkang gro mo rang nas bzhugs gdan sgron phyogs thad la phran bu 'grig mi 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / bka' tshab shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rjes 5de rang red/ gzhi rkang khyed rang yang de snga bka' mgron byed myong bas de tsho'i skor la rgyus babs dang bcas krung dbyang sku tshab dpon rigs tshor gsal bshad zhu dgos kyi red 248

pā / 'on kyang nga tsho gros bsdur gnang rgyu yin pas khyed rang dgong dro 'di gar bka' lan zhu bar yong dgos ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar dgong dro lha sa'i chu tshod gnyis par bcar skabs mgron brgyud bka' lan bzhag don ‘ srid tshab gnyis kyi sar snyan zhur bcar te byed bde'i bka' lan gnang rgyur khyed rang dgong dro shan kha'i gzim shag tu bka' lan zhu bar yong dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar lha sa'i chu tshod bzhi pa'i snga rjes su thengs gnyis bcar ba yin rung phebs mi 'dug mthar sa srib mtshams su phebs 'dug pas bka' lan du sang nyin phebs bsu'i sar bzhugs gdan sgron phyogs thad yab gzhis sku 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su phyi 'brel dpon rigs gzhan dag gi gral 'gor gdan 'phar brgyag rgyu zhes pa kho na nyag rkyang ma gtogs krung dbyang sku tshab kyi dgongs gzhi dang mthun pa zhig med la de nub sa'ang rub zin pas sku tshab krang cin lu'u la snyan seng zhu bar bcar rgyu ma byung /tshes /7 nyin snga dro lha sa'i chu tshod drug pa tsam la sku tshab krang cin wu'u bzhugs sar bcar te mdang nub bka' shag gi lan gsal rnams zhus pas sku tshab krang cin wu'u nas yode 'dra yin na krung dbyang dang sa gnas bar gyi brtsi bkur dang / go babs ma 'dzol ba zhig byung yod pa ma red/ khyed rang gis bltas nas tā la'i bla ma'i phebs bsur phyin pa dga' 'am/ ma phyin na dga' zhes gsung gi 'dug pas nga rang nas ‘ de 'dra yin na a lu'u pu'u krang sku tshab la phebs na de gas 'thus pas khyed rang ma phebs na dga' gi red/ ces zhus pa ltar sku tshab krang cin lu'u yi sku tshab tu a lu'u pu'u krang gis tā la'i bla ma'i phebs bsur phebs rgyu gtan 'khel gnang don de nyin a lu'u pu'u krang dang / phun bkras lags sogs la nga rang nas phebs rogs sne shan 249

zhus te skyid tshal klu sdings thab bsu'i bzhugs sgar la tā la'i bla ma'i phebs bsur phebs pa red/skabs der nga rang phag ri rdzong sdod kyi las 'khur zhu mus la brten tā la'i bla ma mchog lha sar phebs rjes nga rang las gnas su phyir log bya rgyur dgongs te sne shan gsar pa rtse drung las tshan g.yung dgon ye shes dar rgyas dang / lha sding sras bsod nams dpal 'byor gnyis la bsko bzhag bstsal ba bcas/

bod kyi mi rigs dang mi dmangs 'od zer bde skyid kyi lam du bskyod pa/krang cin wu'u//95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung thun mong nas 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod pa des bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi lo rgyus dang / lhag don bod mi rigs dang mes rgyal dbar gyi 'brel ba'i lo rgyus la dus rabs phyi ba'i 'gyur ldog rlabs po che khyer yong zhing /dus de nas bzung bod mi rigs dang bod ljongs mi dmangs ji srid bar btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dang 'ching rgya las grol ba dang mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi sdug bsngal las thar te krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mes rgyal khyim tshang chen por phyir log thub nas spun zla'i mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang ji snyed longs su spyad de thun mong thog mes rgyal gyi khyim tshang chen po 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rlabs chen gyi gsar brje'i bya gzhag nang 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi dgongs don gzhir bzhag rim bzhin bod sa khul dang mi rigs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas slob gso bcas kyi bya gzhag gong 'phel du btang ba dang / mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur sra brtan dang spun zla'i mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril mngon du gyur pas/ bod mi rigs dang bod ljongs mi dmangs rnams 'od 26/

zer 'phro ba dang bde skyid kyi lam du bskyod thub pa byung ba red/da phan lo gsum nang 〈 gros mthun 〉lag bstar byed pa'i thad gal che'i grub 'bras mang dag thob yod/ thog mar rgya bod mi rigs dbar dang bod mi rigs nang khul gyi 'brel ba yag tu ches cher phyin pa ma zad da dung je yag tu 'gro bzhin du yod/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis snga rjes su dpon rigs dang / chos lugs mi sna/ bzo tshong las rigs kyi 'thus mi/ gzhon nu'i tshogs 'thus sogs las grub pa'i rten 'bul tshogs pa dang / lta skor tshogs pa/ sku tshab tshogs pa sogs ched gtong gis ma'o kru'u zhir gus 'dud zhus pa dang sbrags krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur dang yid ches zhus pa'i rtags mtshan bstan zhing krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang ma'o kru'u zhis bod mi rigs la byams brtse che ba'i gces skyong dang thugs khur gnang ba sngar las kyang shes rtogs byung ba ma zad/ mes rgyal gang ci'i thad kyi 'dzugs skrun la lta skor byas pa brgyud rang nyid kyi myong tshor ngo ma'i thog nas krung go gung khran tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus dngos su nyams len yang byas pa red/ bod du yong ba'i krung dbyang gi las byed pa dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' dgongs srung brtsi lag bstar dang / 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉don 'khyol/ bod mi rigs kyi yul goms gshis lugs dang chos dad bcas la brtsi 'jog dpe thon gyi bya spyod spel stabs bod mi rigs dang bod kyi mi dmangs tshos sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas tang krung dbyang gi mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril gyi srid jus de yang dag pa dang rlabs chen yin pa ngos 'dzin gting zab thob cing / krung go gung khran tang gis mi rigs khag dang 252

chos lugs grub mtha' khag nang gi gtso 'dzin mi sna dang dmangs gtso'i mi snar yun ring mthun sgril dang yun ring mnyam las byed pa'i byed phyogs 'dzin gyi yod/ ma'o kru'u zhis mdzub ston gnang don mgung khran tang gis chos lugs la srung skyob kyi srid jus 'dzin gyi yod/ chos la dad pa byed mkhan dang chos la dad pa mi byed mkhan/ chos de la dad pa byed mkhan dang chos gzhan la dad pa byed mkhan tshang mar srung skyob dang brtsi 'jog bya rgyu yin/deng skabs 'di ltar yin la phyin chad kyang de ltar yin mizhes gsungs pa de dag ni nga tshos bod kyi las don thog srung brtsi zhu ba'i gal che'i rtsa don yin/gong gsal rtsa don yod pa dang rgya bod mi dmangs thun mong gi 'bad brtson byas par brten nga tshor grub 'bras de lta bu thob thub pa byung ba red/phyogs mtshungs mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon thebs pa dang sra brtan du phyin par brten krung dbyang dang bod sa gnas dbar gyi 'brel ba dam zab dang yid ches che ru song zhing / de'i thad kyi gtso bo'i mtshon rtags ni phyi don skor yin/ sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dziphyi rgyal las khungs zhes pa de 1953lor krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 6 sku tshab phyi don las rogs don byed khang ’ la zla bsgril ba des 〈 gros mthun /〉gyi don tshan bcu bzhi pa'i nang gsal 6 krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bod sa khul gyi phyi phyogs gnad don mtha' dag thag gcod gcig gyur byed khar/ 'dra mnyam dang / phan res/ mnga' khongs bdag dbang la brtsi 'jog byed res byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog khyim mtshes rgyal khab dang zhi bde mnyam gnas bya rgyu dang / drang bzhag gi tshong don 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyu dang de 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu 7zhes pa'i gtan 'bebs de don 'khyol legs par mtshon pas mes 253

mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur dang bod rgya mi rigs kyi mthun sgril sra brtan du gtong ba'i gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i grub 'bras shig kyang yin/gzhan yang bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bya gzhag sogs gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i thad/ da phan lo gsum ring grub 'bras kyang ha cang mang po thob yod/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis 6 legs bcos las khungs mizhes pa gsar btsugs kyis rgya khyab ngang bun chag dang / khral 'ul chag yang gtong rgyu sogs 'char gzhi yag po bting ba dang mu mthud legs bcos kyi bya thabs gros bsdur byed bzhin yod pa/ de bzhin sa gnas khag gi ser skya dpon rigs 'gan 'khur bas slob sbyong gi sgrig 'dzugs btsugs te 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi nang don dang / krung dbyang gi srid jus khag rgyal khab phyi nang gi gal che'i skabs don sogs slob sbyong byed bzhin yod pa de ni chab srid thog yar rgyas 'gro re byas pa zhig yin pas slad bod ljongs 'di nyid 'phel rgyas ches cher 'gro rgyur med du mi rung ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig yin la/ da dung sa gnas khag tu gzhon nu dang bud med rgyal gces mthun grogs tshogs pa snga rjes su btsugs nas rgyal gces btsan rgol dang mthun sgril yar rgyas kyi dar cha'i 'og shes bya sna tshogs slob sbyong byas te rgyal gces kyi lta ba dang chab srid kyi go rtogs nyin bzhin gong mthor 'gro bzhin yod pa de dag slad bod ljongs 'di nyid gong 'phel ches cher 'gro rgyur med du mi rung ba'i srog shing gi stobs shugs shig kyang red/bod du yong ba'i krung dbyang gi las byed pa dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis da phan lo gsum ring sa gnas khag la dngul khang dang nyo tshong kung si btsugs shing / dngul khang gis zhing las skyed med bun dngul 255

dang tshong las dang lag shes bzo las la skyed chung bun dngul btang ba dang bod skyod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis sa sbol brgyab ste thon skyed byas khar bod rigs mi dmangs la rogs ram gyis chu bed gsar bzo dang zhing 'brog tu tshod lta'i rwa ba 'dzugs gnyer gyis cung sngon thon gyi zhing las yo byad dang zhing rmo bya thabs spyad de thon skyed lag rtsal gong mthor gtong ba dang phul byung gi zhing las thon dngos sna tshogs tshod lta byas pa sogs de dag gis bod khul gyi dngul rdza'i gong thang brtan du gtong ba dang / phyi nang gi tshong don gong 'phel du gtong ba/ bod kyi zhing 'brog las dang lag shes bzo las 'phel rgyas su 'gro rgyur rogs skyor/ mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho thag gcod bya rgyu bcas kyi thad la gal che'i phan nus thon yod/lhag par du hur brtson ngang bzo skrun byed bzhin pa'i khams bod dang mtsho bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam gnyis ni slad phyin bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung slob gso bcas kyi bya gzhag gong 'phel du 'gro rgyur de bas gal che'i don snying ldan yod/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod rigs mi dmangs la rogs ram byas te lha sa dang / gzhis rtse/ rgyal rtse sogs la bod rigs rang nyid kyi slob grwa chung ba gsar du btsugs par brten bod rigs bu phrug khri stong mang por slob sbyong gi go skabs thob pa dang / krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis da dung bod rigs gzhon nu mang dag cig pe cin dang khren tur slob sbyong byed par btang ba de dag gis bod kyi skad yig dang slob gso'i bya gzhag gong du spel rgyu dang / bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso sbyong bya rgyu/ gzhon nu dang lo chung byis par slob gso gtong rgyu bcas kyi thad la 'go yag po zhig 'dzugs thub pa 256

byung ba red/lo gsum ring lha sa dang gzhis rtse sogs la mi dmangs sman khang dang sgo bsten sman khang btsugs te mang tshogs la rin med sman bcos byas pa dang skor skyod kyis sman bcos byas par brten rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi nad mnar gyi sdug bsngal chung du btang ba'am/ yang na med pa bzos te mi dmangs kyi bde thang la 'gan srung thub pa byung zhing / sdom rtsis ltar na /954 lo gcig pur sa gnas khag gi mi dmangs sman khang dang sgo bston sman khang gis bod rigs mang tshogs nyis 'bum lnga khri cig stong tsam la rin med sman bcos byas 'dug da lta 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin yod pa'i dwangs khrag bzo grwa dang phyugs nad sngon 'gog gi las don sgrig 'dzugs des bod rigs mi dmangs kyi phyugs zog bde srung la bde skyid kyi 'phrin bzang 'khyer yong ba sogs mdor na gong gsal las don thog gi thog ma'i grub 'bras de dag gis slad sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas slob gso bcas gong 'phel 'gro rgyu dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba je legs su 'gro rgyur gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i nus pa thon rgyu nges can yin/gong gsal gal che'i grub 'bras de ni krung go gung khran tang dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung / ma'o kru'u zhi bcas kyis mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i 'go khrid gnang ba dang / mar khe si dang le nyin ring lugs kyi mi rigs gnad don skor gyi rtsa ba'i rtsa don bed spyad de yang dag pa'i sgo nas bod du mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril rogs phan gyi srid jus lag len bstar ba/mthun sgril dang / yar thon/ sngar bas gong 'phel bcas kyi mdzad phyogs don thog tu bskyal ba/ bod rgya mi rigs gnyis kyi mthun sgril dang / tā la'i 257

bla ma dang paṇa chen er te ni rnam gnyis kyi mthun lam/ bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sbyor bcas la nyin bzhin shugs snon thebs pa dang sra brtan du phyin pa/ bod mi rigs kyi 'go 'dzin mi sna dang rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi chab srid go rtogs gong mthor phyin pa dang rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam pa shugs cher phyin pa/ rgya rigs las byed pas lhag bsam zol med ngang 〈 gros mthun〉lag bstar byas pa dang hur brtson gyis las ka bsgrubs pa/ mes rgyal gyi spun zla'i mi rigs khag gis mdza' grogs kyi rogs ram dang rgyab skyor gnang ba bcas kyi 'bras bu red/ 'ong kyang gong gsal grub 'bras de dag ni nga tshos bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun dang mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams sra brtan gtong rgyu'i gzi brjid yin la dka' tshegs che ba'i bya gzhag gi 'go tshugs sa tsam yin pas slad phyin las ka de bas mang ba dang / 'bad brtson de bas che ba byed dgos pa 'dugang tshos nges par du ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa ni/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs pa'i nyin mo nas bzung / nga tsho'i mes rgyal 'di nyid rim bzhin 'od zer bde skyid ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su bar brgal byed pa'i dus skabs gsar par slobs shing / bar brgal dus skabs 'di'i nang nga tsho'i mi rigs las don thad kyi spyi'i las 'gan ni/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur dang mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril sra brtan du btang ste thun mong thog mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu dang gcig gyur gyi mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang mi rigs khag khe dbang thad kyi 'dra mnyam 'gan srung bya rgyu/ mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag len bstar rgyu/ mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i thun mong gi bya gzhag nang rim pas mi rigs khag gi 258

chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas gong 'phel gtong rgyu/rim pas lo rgyus thog nas lhag lus su gyur pa'i mi rigs khag dbar don dngos thog 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i gnas tshul med par bzos te rjes lus thebs pa'i mi rigs rnams sngon bskyod kyi mi rigs gras su skyod rgyu dang rim bzhin spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su bar brgal bya rgyu bcas red/ spyi'i las 'gan de dag ni bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs kyi khe phan dang yongs su mthun stabs bod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs rnams 'od zer bde skyid kyi lam du bskyod rgyu'i lam ston sgron me red/rang re'i mes rgyal 'di nyid spyi tshogs ring lugs su bar brgal byed pa'i dus mtshams 'dir mi rigs gnad don skor gyi spyi'i las 'gan la gzhigs nas slad phyin nga tsho'i bod kyi zhib phra'i las don khag ni/ sems thag gtsang bcad kyi sgo nas krung dbyang gi srid jus khag lag bstar bya rgyu dang chabs cig bod kyi zhib phra'i gnas tshul dang rgyal gces 'go 'dzin mi sna dang mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo la bstun nas rim pas 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉mngon 'gyur mthar phyin bya rgyu dang gzab nan brtan skyod kyi mdzad phyogs lag len byed dgos pa dang / mes rgyal gyi gong bu gcig gyur dang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi mong gzhi'i thog nga tshos nges par rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i lhag 'phro khyad bsad byed dgos la bod mi rigs nang gi sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs kyi phyogs lhung yang sngon 'gog byas te mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril la shugs snon dang sra brtan du gtong dgos pa/ rgyal gces btsan rgol gyi stobs shugs sra brtan dang rgya cher btang thog sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas dril bsgrags slob gso'i las don spel te rgya che'i mi dmangs 259

kyi go rtogs gong mthor gtong dgos pa/ las don dngos dang slob sbyong sna tshogs byas te bod rigs las byed pa gso sbyong shugs chen bya rgyu dang /〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun〉gyi dgongs don gzhir bzung bod kyi las don rnams mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi tshad gzhir slebs pa byas te bod mi rigs rang khyim rang bdag gi khe dbang spyod rgyu de mngon du 'gyur ba byed dgos pa/ rim bzhin bod mi rigs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / slob gso bcas kyi bya gzhag gong du spel rgyu dang mi dmangs kyi dngos po'i 'tsho ba dang rig gnas 'tsho ba je legs su btang nas bar brgal dus skabs kyi spyi'i lam phyogs dang spyi'i las 'gan gyi 'od zer 'phrod pa'i 'og gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed ched star brtson gyis las ka bya rgyu dang brtan brling ngang mdun du bskyod rgyu bcas —na/nga tsho'i phrag steng du babs pa'i dka' tshegs che zhing gzi brjid che ba'i las 'gan rnams legs sgrub yong bar 'gan srung byed ched nges par du mu mthud nas mthun sgril rogs res dang mdza' grogs mnyam sgrub kyi snying stobs dar spel gtong rgyu dang / mdun lam thog tu yod pa'i lag rdo bshangs pa/las don thog gi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul rnams yo bsrang nan po byed dgos/lhag par du dogs zon cher skyes kyis dgra gnyen gyi dbye mtshams gsal po 'byed rgyu dang dus dang rnam pa kun tu btsan rgyal ring lugs dang log spyod phyogs khag gi lkog g.yo ngan jus mtha' dag ther 'don byas te gtor bshig gi spyod ngan thal ba'i rdul du rlog dgos/ de bzhin rgyal gces ring lugs dang rgyal spyi ring lugs zung 'brel byed pa'i slob gso rgyag rgyur shugs snon 260

sngar las lhag pa brgyab ste krung go gung khran tang dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung / ma'o kru'u zhi bcas kyi mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i 'go khrid 'og tā la'i bla ma mchog dang paṇa chen er te ni mchog rnam gnyis mdza' brtse mthun lam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng du bod mi rigs dang bod ljongs mi dmangs mthun sgril gyis mes rgyal nang sa'i mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang /lhag don bod bskyod krung dbyang gi las byed pa/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mdza' mthun rogs ram 'og nga tshos nges par du 6 mthun sgril yar rgyas dang de bas 'phel rgyas kyi mdzad phyogs mngon par gyur te bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun dang / mes rgyal lho nub mtha' mtshams sra brtan du gtong rgyu'i rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag nang grub 'bras de bas che ba 'thob nges yin pa ma zad/ gom pa brtan spos kyi sgo nas bod mi dmangs kyi sne khrid de 'od zer bde skyid kyi 'gro lam thog tu skyod thub rgyu'ang nges can yin/mi rigs khag mdza' grogs mnyam las kyi khyim tshang chen po krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab khri lor brtan par shogames rgyal spun zla'i mi rigs khag dbar gyi mthun sgril chen po khri lor brtan par shogabod mi rigs dang bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol thob pa khri lor brtan par shogakrung go gung khrin tang khri lor brtan par shogami rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi sku tshe khri lor brtan par shog 261

paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs la srung skyel zhus pa'i dran gso/yā han krang /〈 krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉nang gi don tshan lnga pa ste 5paṇa chen er te ni'i sngar yod go gnas dang dbang cha rang 'jags gnas dgos pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs gzhir bzung / krung dbyang gis skabs der mtsho sngon rje sku 'bum du bzhugs yod pa'i paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng bcu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang khong gi sku 'khor mi sna yongs rdzogs bkra shis lhun por phyir phebs gnang rgyur nub byang dmag dpung gis srung skyel zhu dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs mdzad cing / nub byang cus dang nub byang dmag khul khang gis krung dbyang gi gtan 'bebs 'di gzhir bzung ste nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang nas hphan ming sku tshab tu bsko gzhag gnang ba dang kho bo sku tshab las rogs su bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar thun mong thog paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad rgyur srung skyel zhu ba'i las don gyi 'gan 'khur zhus pa yin/ slad phyin bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus rtsom 'bri bya rgyur yid rton rung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs phran bu yong ched dran gso'i rtsom yig 'di'i nang krung dbyang gi gtan 'bebs dang nub byang cus kyi mdzub ston gzhir bzung paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad skabs srung skyel 262

zhus pa'i brgyud rim rnams don dngos ltar rgyas bshad byas yod/lo rgyus la phyi mig blta ba/paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad skabs srung skyel zhus pa'i skor gsal po zhu dgos na sngon la nges par du gnad don de'i yong stangs yong lugs rnams klog pa por dgos nges kyi ngo sprod zhu dgos kyi red/ paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gtsang gi bkra shis lhun po dgon du bzhugs kyi yod pas gtsang khul du sa zhing dang mi ser/ dgon sde sogs rgya che bdag dbang du gyur cing cing rgyal rabs kyi yung krong dang / chan lung dus nas bzung thog mtha' bar gsum du ching rgyal rabs srid gzhung gi bsko gzhag stsal ba'i bod bzhugs am ban gyi thad na'i 'go khrid dang du len dgos pas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 6 bka' shag dang gnas bab 'dra mtshungs yin/ lcags phag lo'i gsar brje byung rjes bod bzhugs am ban phyir 'then byas pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas bka' shag srid gzhung gis tā la'i dbang bsgyur la bkra shis lhun pos brtsi 'jog zhu dgos pa'i btsan bshed byas pa ma zad/ spyi lo 1914lo'i (krung hwa min go khri lo gsum pa)dgun khar gzhis rtser spyi rdzong zhugatsang khul gyi spyi khyab)mi gnyis snon bsko byas te gtsang khul gyi rdzong (mes rgyal nang khul gyi shan dang phal cher mtshungs)bcu drug dang / paṇa chen gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i rdzong bzhi/ rdzong dang ha lam mtshungs pa'i sger tshugs gzhis ka sum cu lhag tsam bcas kyi spyi khyab byas/ bka' shag srid gzhung gis paṇa chen khongs su gtogs pa'i sa khul du bar ma chad par 'bru dngul dang zhi drag khral rigs mang dag 'phar 'gel byed kyi yod rung bkra shis lhun po ni 263

sngar lam du gnas pa zhig las gsar 'phar khur po 'khur 'dod med stabs tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs gnyis kyi bar 'gal ba rno ngar chen po byung zhing /paṇa chen phyogs nas khral rigs khag bsgrub mi dgos pa'i re ba yang nas yang du zhus kyang bka' shag srid gzhung gis de las ldog ste spyi lo 1921 lor bkra shis lhun por bod dmag yongs kyi dmag phogs kyi bzhi cha gcig sgrub dgos pa'i las 'gan 'phar snon byas pa red/ bka' shag srid gzhung gi gnya' gnon tshabs che de lta bu'i 'og paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pas gnas tshul mi legs pa gzhan mi yong ched sku 'khor nyung shas lhan khrid gnang ste bod nas mes rgyal nang khul du gsang phebs mi gnang ka med byung ba red/paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang khul du phebs 'byor skabs lho byang gi dmag gshed can khag bar 'khrug rtsod byed pa'i sgang yin pas de'i skabs kyi mes rgyal la bod kyi gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i nus pa med/der brten gnas skabs gcig ring khong nang sog dang / byang shar/ hwa pe sogs sa khul du dka' tshegs che ba'i yul byol gyi 'tsho ba skyel dgos byung zhing /nan cing du go min tang srid gzhung btsugs rjes tā las sku tshab mngags te nan cing du don gcod khang btsugs pas paṇa chen gyis kyang spyi lo 1929lo'i zla 2par go min tang srid gzhung gi chog mchan thob pa'i 'og nan cing du don gcod khang btsugs pa ma zad/ 6 lo rgyus dang sa bab chags tshul gyi 'brel ba mang dag la bsam gzhigs byas na bod kyis krung go las kha bral te sger tshugs byed pa ni rtsa ba nas yong thabs med pa zhig yin zhing / krung go'i phyogs nas bshad kyang gal te bod 'di dor na 'khor lo'i gzhogs 'degs kyi dngos po skyur ba dang 'dra bas/ 4mnyam du gnas na gnyis nar phan pa 264

yod pa dang / kha gyes na tshang mar gnod pa ni bston med kyi gnas lugs shig yin zhes bsgrags gtam spel gnang mdzad/ spyi lo 1931 lo'i zla byapar gdan zhus ltar paṇa chen gyis go min tang srid gzhung gis bskong 'tshogs byas pa'i rgyal dmangs gros tshogs la bzhugs gnang mdzad cing / spyi lo 193/ lo'i zla 3tshes 1 nyin go min tang srid gzhung gis paṇa chen la / rgyal khab skyong ba'i dge rgan chen mo thams cad mkhyen pa mizhes pa'i mtshan bzos dang / 'ja' sa/ g.yang ṭi'i tham ka bcas phul ba ma zad/ lo re'i gsol phogs sgor khri tsho bcu gnyis re dkrig car du 'bul rgyu'i gtan 'bebs kyang byas/ spyi lo 1932lo'i zla 12par go min tang srid gzhung gis slar yang paṇa chen nan cing du gdan drangs te bod kyi gnad don dang paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad phyogs skor gros mol byas pa dang dus mtshungs paṇa chen la 4nub phyogs skyong ba'i dge rgan chen mo mizhes pa'i mtshan gnas dngos su phul/ paṇa chen gyis 6 nub phyogs skyong ba'i dge rgan chen mo zhes pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes rjes bod du phyir phebs mdzad phyogs skor tā la'i dang gros mol byed mkhan gyi sku tshab lam seng lha sar mngags gtong gnang zhing paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad rgyu'i grabs gshom gnang ste /936lo'i zla /2par mtsho sngon skye rgu mdor phebs 'byor skabs bka' shag phyogs nas mngags pa'i gdan zhu'i mi snas kyang 4rgya'i phyogs kyi dpon rigs lhan khrid ma mdzad par stabs bde'i thog nas phebs dgos7zhes bshad pa dang / dus mtshungs chab mdo'i phyogs kyi 'go gtsos kyang zu 'di phyogs kyi 'u lag sogs tshang ma grabs gshom zin kyang nye lam bod gzhung nas gros mol legs po ma byung gong mkho sprod byed mi chog ces bka' phebs pas gnas skabs ring nub phyogs su phebs thal 265

med pa mkhyenami zhes pa'i 'phrin yig phul/ de'i skabs ri 'gog dmag 'khrug langs zin stabs go min tang srid gzhung la bod kyi gnad don thag gcod byed khom ma byung bas paṇa chen phyir phebs ring gi gnas skabs las khungs dang srung skyel thad kyi ched bskos do dam par kho tsho bod du 'gro mtshams bzhag na legs zhes mdzub ston byas/ de rjes slar yang gros mol byas kyang paṇa chen phyogs kyis nges par du 6 lha sa'i srid gzhung gi bka' la nyan dgos pa dang /paṇa chen srung skyel zhu mkhan gyi 6 rgya dpon dmag migacig kyang bod du 'khrid nyar mi chog ces bka' shag gis u tshugs mtha' 'khyongs byas par brten spyi lo /937lo'i zla 10tshes / nyin paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pas srung skyel zhu phyogs thad kyi ched bskos do dam par phyag bris phul te gnas skabs ring bod la mi phebs rgyur mos mthun mdzad/ khong gis phyag bris de'i mjug tu slogadan sa gsum dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas glog 'phrin 'byor ba'i nang go rgyu shin tu mang la dga' bsu zhu rgyu'i zol med kyi rnam pa spu tsam yang med par de las ldog ste paṇa chen dang krung dbyang bar 'brel thag bcad nas kho tsho'i bkod par nyan du 'jug rtsis byed kyi 'dug na paṇa chen phyogs nas rang nyid blos btang ba dang khyon yongs la bsam gzhigs kyis gnas skabs ring nub phyogs su ma bskyod par sgug rgyu yin7zhes gsungs yod/ de ltar paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod du phyir phebs mdzad phyogs skor bka' shag srid gzhung gis dka' ngal bzos pa dang bkag 'gog byas mthar phyir phebs ma thub/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod du phebs rgyur bkag 'gog byung rjes bsnyun gzhi lci mo bzhes nas spyi lo /937lo'i zla 12tshes / nyin mtsho sngon skye rgu mdor yod pa'i dgon pa zhig gi gzim chung nang zhing du gshegs shing de'i skabs dgung lo lnga 266

'bras bu mi legs pa yong rgyu yin pas bod kyi gnas tshul thag gcod ma byung gong paṇa chen bod du srung skyel zhu rtsis med ces bshad/spyi lo /949lo'i dpyid mar nang sgang gis cis 'jigs med kong kro'u du mngags te go min tang srid gzhung gi tsung thung las tshab li'i tsung ren la paṇa chen gyi yang srid la chog mchan dang gser bum dkrug mi dgos pa'i gcig thog gtan 'khel gyi zhal bzhes yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ spyi lo 1949lo'i zla 6tshes 3nyin go min tang srid gzhung gis mtsho sngon nas rtsad gcod zhus pa'i yang srid mgon po tshe brtan ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas shing mkhyen rab kyi 'od stong 'bar ba bcas kyi thog nas paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng dgu pa'i sku skye yin par ra 'phrod byung bas gser bum dkrug 'don mi dgos par rgyud 'dzin gyis paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng bcu pa yin par ched du chog mchan sprad pa yin mizhes bka' rgya bkram/ spyi lo 949lo'i zla 8tshes /0nyin mtsho sngon rje sku 'bum du paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par khri gsol zhus nas khrims srol ltar ngos 'dzin byed pa'i byed sgo rnams yongs su grub/spyi lo 1949lo'i zla 9par mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis mtsho sngon ham bzung byed mkhan dmag gshed can ma' pu'u hphang gtor pham btang ste mtsho sngon bcings 'grol btang bas paṇa chen gyis mi gtong gnang mdzad de bcings 'grol dmag dang 'brel ba zhus pa red/ zla 10tshes / nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags byed skabs paṇa chen gyis kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang spyi khyab si ling kru'u ter gus 'dud zhu ba'i glog 'phrin phul te krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu dang / bod la bcings 268

'grol gang mgyogs thob rgyu'i re ba yod ces zhu gnang mdzad pa dang glog 'phrin nang zu paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon la sngar nas bzung rgyal khab kyi sku drin dang dmigs bsal gzigs skyong che thob byung mod/ lo nyi shu lhag tsam ring bod kyi mnga' khongs bdag dbang gcig gyur ched re 'bod zhu bar gang sar song ste lhod g.yeng spu tsam yang ma byas rung da bar 'bras bu gang yang ma thob pas blo pham chen po byung zhing / da lta'ang mtsho sngon du sdod mus thog bod du phyir log bya rgyu'i bka' sgug bzhin yod/ spro bar 'os pa ni khyed rnam pa'i dbu khrid 'og nub byang bcings 'grol byung ba dang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs zin pas snying stobs ldan pa tshang mas mgrin gcig tu bstod glu len 'os/ slad phyin mi dmangs bde skyid thob nges yin la rgyal khab gong 'phel yar rgyas 'gro bar yang re ba yod pa dang / ring min bod kyang bcings 'grol gtong nges yin pas ngos paṇa chen nas bod 'bangs yongs kyi tshab zhus te khyed rnam par bla na med pa'i gus 'dud dang lhag bsam rnam dag gis brtsi bkur dga' gus zhu rgyu yin zhes bkod yod/ spyi lo 1949lo'i zla 1/ tshes 23nyin kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang spyi khyab si ling kru'u tes paṇa chen la 'byor lan glog 'phrin bstsal te skul ma dang 'tshams 'dri gnang zhing glog 'phrin nang yobod kyi mi dmangs ni rgyal khab la dga' zhing phyi rgyal gyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed mkhan zhig yin pa dang / kho tsho go min tang log spyod srid gzhung gi srid jus la yi rangs med par gcig 'gyur dang /dar rgyas stobs ldan/ mi rigs khag dbar 'dra mnyam gyi mnyam las byed pa bcas kyi krung go gsar pa'i khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi grub cha zhig tu 'gyur 'dod yod pas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang krung go mi dmangs 269

bcings 'grol dmag gis bod mi dmangs kyi re 'dod 'di mngon du 'gyur ba byed nges yin/ des na sku zhabs khyed dang bod kyi rgyal gces mi sna yongs kyis mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril byas te bod kyi bcings 'grol dang bod rgya mi dmangs bar gyi mthun sgril ched 'bad brtson 'thab rtsod gnang rgyu'i re ba yod ces 'khod yod/spyi lo /95/ lo'i zla 4 par paṇa chen dang nang sgang gi dpon rigs yongs pe cing du phebs 'byor gyis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la khong tsho'i re 'dod dang re 'dun rnams zhus pa red/paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad rgyu dang bod la bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i gnad don gnyis ni kha bral thabs med pa zhig yin pa dang / bod la bcings 'grol gtong ba ni paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad rgyu'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen zhig yin pas gsham du nga tshos bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang ba'i brgyud rim la dran gso phran tsam ma byas na ga la 'grigapaṇa chen bod du phyir phebs ma mdzad gong gi bod kyi dus bab/spyi lo /949lo'i dpyid mar rang re'i rgyal nang du gzhi rtsa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba ste/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpa' dmag khri brgyas nyen che'i 'bri chu brgal te nan cing dang hrang had bcings 'grol btang bas go min tang srid gzhung rtab rtab por kong kro'u phyogs su bros pa dang krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol gyi rlabs chen bya gzhag de gnam lcags thog 'bab ltar du mes rgyal sa gzhi chen po'i steng du 270

mgyogs myur ngang mngon du 'gyur bzhin yod/ bod ni rang re'i mes rgyal gyi kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas shig yin stabs btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi brnyas bcos myong ba'i bod mi dmangs skyob rgyu ni krung go khyon yongs bcings 'grol gtong ba'i dgos nges kyi grub cha zhig dang ldog med kyi 'gro phyogs shig yin/ 'di lta bu'i dus bab ha cang bzang po'i skabs su bod kyi btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan dang kha bral ring lugs pa tsho dngangs skrag skye bzhin du nyi ma skyel dgos byung bas 'ur 'ur rgyug pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo de phyir ldog bya rgyu'i re ngan bcangs/ spyi lo 1949lo'i zla7mas 8nyin kho tshos glo bur du 4rgya mi phyir 'bud kyi dus zing mibaslangs nas lha sar bca' sdod go min tang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang la dzidamar por mi 'gyur ba'i ched du dgos nges kyi bya thabs dgos kyi 'dug na khyed tsho dang khyim mi tsho lam seng lha sa nas kha bral te rgya nag tu phyir log bya rgyu'i gra sgrig gnang rogs zhu zhes pa'i brda tho btang ba dang / dus mtshungs lha sa'i rlung 'phrin khang btsan bzung byas pa ma zad/ bod sdod go min tang gi las khungs dang de'i las byed mi snar lta srung byed mkhan dmag mi btang ste kho tshor mgyogs myur thon dgos kyi tsha 'ded byas/ kho pa tshos 'di ltar byed pa'i dmigs yul ni gnas tshul der brten nas krung go dang bod gnyis 'brel ba med pa'i rnam pa bzos te rjes su krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod mi thub pa'i 'gog rkyen bzo rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa zhig red/thengs de'i dzirgya mi phyir 'bud kyi dus zing 7skor shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gis spyi lo 1949lo'i zla 9tshes 2nyin ched brjod spel ba dang / 4mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par gyis kyang zla 9tshes7nyin ched brjod spel te 271

phyogs gcig nas bod gzhung phyogs kyi byed stangs de ni ha cang nor 'khrul yin par skyon brjod byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas krung go mi dmastas kyis bod mi dmangs la rogs skyor byas te bcings 'grol thob pa bya rgyu ni dus kyi 'khor phyogs dang mi sems gtad phyogs kyi bya ba zhig yin pas log spyod stobs shugs gang 'dra zhig gis kyang bkag 'gog byed thub kyi ma red ces khyab bsgrags byas/'on kyang bod kyi btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan tshos don drang tshig nan gyi bslab bya de tshor ma nyan par mu mthud kha bral gtong rgyu'i bya ba byas pa red/ bod gzhung phyogs nas 6 bod rang btsan miyin par gsal kha gtod ched 4 mdza' mthun sku tshab tshogs pa zhig khag bgos kyis a me ri ka dang / dbyin ji/ rgya gar/ ne pa la/ pe cin sogs sa gnas su gtong rgyu red ces spyi lo 1950lo'i zla dang por a me ri ku'i dmangs mnyam gsar 'gyur khang nas gong gsal gnas tshul spel ba de ni a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bshams pa'i lkog g.yo gzhan zhig yin zhing /de'i dmigs yul ni dbyin ji dang a ri gnyis kyis the jus bya rgyur bod gzhung nas re ba zhus te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod dang bca' sdod bya rgyur bkag 'gog byed ched red/ spyi lo 1950lo'i zla / tshes 20nyin shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gis rang rgyal phyi 'brel pu'i mgrin tshab pa'i gtam bshad spel nas lkog g.yo der ther 'don dang dgag pa nan po brgyab pa red/ bod gzhung phyogs nas lha mdza' mthun sku tshab tshogs pa gtong rgyu'i gsar 'gyur de paṇa chen nang sgang gis thos rjes spyi lo 1950lo'i zla / tshes 3/ nyin bod kyi rgyal gces mi dmangs kyi tshab zhus nas krung dbyang mi dmangs 272

srid gzhung la glog 'phrin phul te lha sa gzhung phyogs kyis mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed pa'i bya spyod der ngo rgol byas shing glog 'phrin nang 4bod lha sa'i log spyod srid gzhung gis ’ tsamadza' mthun 〉gyi ming thog nas dbyin ji dang a ri sogs rgyal khab tu tshul dang mi mthun pa'i sku tshab mngag rtsis kyis 2bod rang btsan yin pa'i rnam pa bzo ba dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngan 'brel dang mi dmangs srid gzhung la 'gog rgol byas te mes rgyal las kha bral rgyu dang bod phyir 'tshong bya rgyu'i re ngan 'chang gi yod pa red/ bod ni krung go'i mnga' khongs yin pa 'dzam gling yongs kyis khas len byed la bod yongs kyi mi dmangs nas kyang rang nyid krung hwa mi rigs kyi gras shig yin par ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ lha sa gzhung phyogs kyi byed stangs 'di ni rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs bdag dbang gcig gyur gtor bshig gtong ba dang / bod mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang rgyab 'gal byed pa'i bya ba zhig yin par brten nga tshos bod mi dmangs kyi tshab zhus nas re ba zhu rgyur/ mgyogs myur drang bden gyi dmag dpung gtong gnang mdzad de bod bcings 'grol gtong ba dang /log spyod mi sna rtsa med bzo ba/ bod du yod pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs phyir 'bud byed pa/ lho nub kyi rgyal srung sra brtan gtong ba/bod mi dmangs bcings 'grol gtong ba bcas don 'khyol yong ba dang /rang re'i nang sgang gis kyang bod kyi rgyal gces mi dmangs kyi sne 'khrid pa dang bod mi dmangs kyis bcings 'grol dmag la gzhogs 'degs bya rgyu'i re 'bod byas te mi dmangs dang mes rgyal la lhag bsam sri zhu byed ched 'thab rtsod mtha' 'khyodas bya rgyu'i dam bca' 'jog rgyu yin zhes bkod yod/skabs der krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis kyang bod gzhung la dgag 273

pa skyon zhing mtha' tshig kyang bsgrags pa dang / bod kyi rgyal gces mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas rkyen bod gzhung gis btang ba'i sku tshab tshogs pa de dbyin ji dang a ri sogs rgyal khab tu pharang btsan miyin zhes shod par 'gro nus med/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i gom stabs de mgyogs su gtong ba dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung bar gros mol gang mgyogs yong ched krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis spyi lo /950lo'i zla 2tshes 10nyin shis khams zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dge rtag sprul sku bod du bslab bya bskyon par gtong gnang mdzad/ zla 2tshes 24 nyin dge rtag sprul sku chab mdor 'byor ma thag dbyin ji'i myul ma hphu thes bod dmag la ngan bskul gyis khong bod du phebs rgyur bkag 'gog byas pa ma zad/ zla 8tshes 2/ nyin dge rtag sprul skur dug blud cing / khong la dug phog rjes zhal nas chu ser don pa dang shangs nas khrag 'dzags bzhin nyin gnyis par zhing du gshegs/ zhing du gshegs rjes sku gdung nag rkyang du gyur nas lag pas reg tsam byas ma thag sha lpags lhung 'gro gi yod pa red/ de rjes khong gi sku 'khor mi sna yang rgyab 'ded sbrags nas lha sar bskyal/btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod du de lta bu'i smyo ham byed kyi yod pa krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gzigs rjes bod kyi gnas tshul gsal po yong ba dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas phyir 'bud byed ched mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod byed 'go 'dzugs rgyu'i bka' phab/ btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan bod kyi kha bral ring lugs pa tshos bod dmag la bkod 'doms kyis chab mdor drag 274

shugs la brten nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod bya rgyur bkag 'gog byas rung de ni rta lam grog mas bkag pa lta bu'i bya ba zhig yin pas spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 10tshes 19nyin mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba ma zad/ bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag gtor pham mthar phyin btang ba red/chab mdo bcings 'grol btang rjes bod kyi dbang bsgyur ru tshogs nang khul du g.yo 'gul dang zing cha chen po byung zhing srid zur stag brag gis gtso bo byas pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan dang gzhan yang kha bral ring lugs pa tshos sku na gzhon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa btsan khrid kyis gro mor bros pa ma zad/ da dung phyi rgyal du'ang 'gro rtsis yod stabs kho pa tsho'i byed stangs der bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs tshos ngo rgol byas pa'i thog bod kyi chab srid 'tsho ba'i nang gnad 'gag ha cang che ba'i gdan sa gsum gyis kyang yi ma rangs pa'i rnam pa drag po bstan pa dang / de bzhin tā la'i sku 'khor gyi mkhan po dang bka' blon gyi nang du'ang mi nyung ba zhig gis tā la'i phyir bros gnang rgyur 'dod mos med par krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang gros mol bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod pa red/dza drag ha cang che ba'i 'thab rtsod byas mthar spyi lo 1951 lo'i dpyid kur srid skyong stag brag khri las babs pa dang bod kyi rgyun srol ltar dgung lo bco brgyad son pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pas lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes shing / de rjes kyi spyi lo 1951 lo'i zla 2par dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas kyi 'thus mi mi lnga pe cin du krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang gros mol byed par mngags gtong mdzad/ 275
