dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas kyi 'thus mi khyon bsdoms mi lnga yod pa'i nang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med 'bus mi gtso bo yin pa phud de byings mi bzhi ni khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / thub bstan bstan dar/ thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas yin zhing / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / thub bstan legs smon/bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub sogs chab mdo dang / dar rtse mdo/ ya an/shis an sogs sa gnas brgyud zla 4tshes 22nyin pe cin du 'byor ba dang /khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang thub bstan bstan dar gnyis rgya gar dang shang kyang sogs sa gnas brgyud zla 4tshes 26nyin pe cin du 'byor/dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams rgyal sar 'dzoms rjes krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis lam seng li'i wu'i han dang / krang cing wu/ krang go hwa/ sun kro yon bcas mi bzhi po dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mir bskos shing de'i nang nas li'i lu'i han gyis 'thus mi gtso bo gnang ba'i 'og zla 4tshes 29nyin dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dang mnyam du mdza' mthun gyi rmang gzhi'i thog gros mol byed 'go btsugs shing / dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi mi rigs srid jus dang bod sa gnas kyi gnas tshul dngos gzhir bzung nas rang 'gul gyis bsam 'char rabs dang rim pa bton pa dang dus mtshungs dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi'i dge mtshan ldan pa'i bsam 'char yang bsdu len dang nyan gang thub byas stabs gros mol la thogs pa ma byung bar zla ba gcig kyang ma 'gor bar krung 276

dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhud dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis kyis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bgrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la gros 'cham byung ba dang / gros mol de zla 5tshes 21 nyin mjug bsgril te tshes 23nyin 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo 'tshogs/ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo de pe cin krung nan he chin kreng ten tshoms chen du gzab rgyas ngang tshogs shing / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u te dang / kru'u zhi gzhon pa li'i ci hren/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung srid don khang gi tsung li gzhon pa khren yun (tsung li kru'u en le sku gzugs mi bde ba'i rkyen gyis tsung li gzhon pa khren yun gyis tshab zhus)bcas kyis gtso skyong gnang ba dang / ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgor bzhugs mkhan gras su tung pi wu'u dang / ko mo ro'o/ hong yan be/ khren hru'u thung / nye rung kren/ pheng kren/ ma' zhud lun/ krang po cun/ then phing hran/ krang zhi ro'o/ zhu'i te hong / lan kung wu'u/ krang kre dbrang / lung yun/ hren yan ping / u'u lan hphu'u/ phu'u tso dbyi/ li'i hru'u khreng / li'i si kong / ye cis krong / kru'u zhole hphan/ li'u ke dzin/ ho khreng / sa'i hphu'u teng sogs dmag srid kyi dbu khrid dang de bzhin dmangs gtso tang shog gi dbu khrid mi sna yod/ de min da dung paṇa chen er ti ni'i 'thus mi lha smon ye shes tshul khrims dang / cis 'jigs med/ ngag dbang sbyin pa sogs yod/ mdzad sgo 'go tshugs rjes sngon la dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi bzhis ming rtags bkod pa dang / de rjes dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 277

'thus mi lngas ming rtags bkod rjes 'thus mi gtso bo li'i wu'i han dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gnyis kyis snga rting thog gsung bshad gnang ba dang de'i mjug tu kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u tes gsung bshad gnang /〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la rten 'brel zhu ched krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis zla 6tshes 24 nyin gyi dgong mor gsol ston rgya che bshams/ gdan zhus ltar gsol ston la phebs mkhan gras su mtsho sngon nas pe cin du phebs pa'i paṇa chen er ti ni dang / paṇa chen gyi yongs 'dzin sku gzhon pa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku/ de bzhin paṇa chen nang sgang gi 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo'i gras lha smon ye shes tshul khrims dang / cis 'jigs med/ ngag dbang sbyin pa/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ dam chos yar 'phel/ gros mol nang bzhugs mkhan gyi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ thub bstan bstan dar/ thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas yod pa dang / gdan zhus ltar mgon rogs phebs mkhan gras su krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u te dang / li'u hra'o chi/ li'i ci hren/ srid don khang gi tsung li gzhon pa tung pi wu'u/ khren yun/ ko mo ro'o/ hong yan be/ krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros mol tshogs 'du'i kru'u zhi gzhon pa khren hru'u thung / mi dmangs gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi sku tshab spyi khyab tshan mu'u krang nye rung kren/ dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi li'i lu'i han dang / krang cing wu/ krang go hwa/ sun kre yon/ pe cin grong khyer gyi hri krang pheng kren/ de 278

bzhin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi pu'u khag dang / tshogs pa khag u yon khag hru'u khag sogs kyi 'gan 'khur mi sna/ pe cin du bca' sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mtho rim bkod 'doms pa/ dmangs gtso tang shog khag dang mi dmangs tshogs pa khag gi 'gan 'khur mi sna sogs khyon bsdoms mi grangs brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa yod/gsol ston gzab rgyas 'di'i thog sngon la kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis smon tshig gsungs pa dang / de rjes paṇa chen er ti ni dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gnyis kyis kyang gsung bshad gnang ba red/ ma'o kru'u zhis smon tshig gsungs don/ 66lo brgya phrag 'ga' shas kyi ring krung go'i mi rigs khag bar mthun sgril med pa dang / lhag par du rgya mi rigs dang bod mi rigs bar mthun sgril med la bod mi rigs nang khul du'ang mthun sgril med pa red/ de ni log spyod kyi man ching srid gzhung dang cang ce hre srid gzhung gnyis kyis dbang bsgyur byas pa las byung ba'i ngan 'bras shig red la btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas pa las byung ba'i ngan 'bras shig kyang red/ da lta tā la'i bla mas dbu khrid gnang ba'i stobs shugs dang /paṇa chen er ti nis dbu khrid gnang ba'i stobs shugs/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bcas bar tshang ma mthun sgril byed thub pa byung ba 'di ni krung go mi dmangs kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang de bzhin rgyal nang gi log spyod dbang sgyur gtor 'gyel btang rjes gzhi nas byung ba zhig yin/ mthun sgril 'di rigs ni spun zla ltar gyi mthun sgril yin pa las phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan zhig la gnya' gnon gtong ba zhig min pa dang / mthun sgril 'di rigs ni phyogs tshang mas thun mong thog 'bad brtson byas pa las byung 279

ba'i 'bras bu zhig kyang red/ slad phyin mthun sgril 'di'i rmang gzhi'i thog nga tsho mi rigs khag gi bar phyogs gang ci'i thad dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor/rig gnas sogs phyogs tshang mar 'phel rgyas gong 'phel yong rgyu red/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la dga' gus dang thugs rje che zhu ba'i dgongs pa mtshon ched/ tshes 24 nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod bzhi par paṇa chen er ti nis nang sgang gi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur dpon rigs rnams kyi sne khrid mdzad de krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung la gus 'dud zhus/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa li'i ci hren dang / srid don khang gi tsung li gzhon pa tung pi lu'u/ khrin yun/ hong yan be/ rgyal yongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa khren hru'u thung sogs dang /de bzhin tshan pa khag gi 'gan 'khur ba mi brgya lhag tsam bcas mdzad sgo gzab rgyas der bzhugs gnang mdzad/paṇa chen gyis ma'o kru'u zhir mjal dar dang mjal rten phul zhing rten chas kyi nang du rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyi thog nas/ snye krung go'i mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi mgon skyabs chen po zhes 'khod pa'i gos chen mtshal kha'i dar cha gcig dang / smon tshig bkod pa'i gos chen ser po gcig yoma'o kru'u zhi khri lo brtan pa shog ces pa'i yig 'bru bskos pa'i gser gyi sam ṭa gcig bkras li'i tshe dpag med kyi snang brnyan gcig bod bzos dngul gyi maṇḍal cha tshang gcig bcas dang / de min bod kyi rtsa che'i thon rdzas grags can gos chen bkral btags gser gzhi ma dang / shwa rwa/ bdug spos/ kha che sha kha ma/ pags rigs rtsa che/ spu phrug gyon gos dang rgyan cha'i rigs dang de bzhin lo lnga bcu'i sngon bod kyi 'thab 'dzing pas dbyin ji btsan 280

gyis shin cang nas mi gtong gi red/ rang skyong ljongs ma btsugs gong gi bar brgal gyi nus pa thon ched bod ljongs dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i gra sgrig byed dgos shing / krung dbyang gi dbu khrid gcig gis dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gcig lcogs bya dgos pa dang / tā la'i paṇa chen dang krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'khur bas kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i las 'gan 'khur dgos/ paṇa chen dang nang sgang gis gtsang khul kho na do dam byed 'dod yod pa dang skabs der gro mor yod pa'i tā la'i phyi rgyal du mi phebs pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/ tā la'i nas srid 'gan bzhes pa ni bod du zhi bas bcings 'grol phal cher yong rgyu'i mtshon rtags cig yin pas nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gis kyang tā la'i tshur 'gug thabs la do snang bya dgos/ paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nang du krung dbyang nas sku tshab mngags na tā la'i phyogs la phog thug shor sla bas nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gis sku tshab mngags na 'tshams/ paṇa chen la sku srung ying gcig gtong dgos pa dang / bzhugs sgar nang du de snga go min tang gis btang ba'i myul ma yod pa rnams phyir 'bud byed dgos/ paṇa chen nang sgang nang khul du chab srid bsam blo'i las ka yag po yong ched de rjes krung dbyang gi chog mchan thob pa ltar hran shis nas blo mthun le'ang zhon zhan 'then nas nang sgang gi drung yig chen mo gzhon par bsko gzhag byas pa dang drung yig chen mo ngo ma de sngar bzhin lha smon ye shes tshul khrims yin/spyi lo /95/ lo'i zla / tshes 31 nyin tsung li kra'u en les nga tshor mjal 'phral gnang ste gal che'i mdzub ston mang po gnang byung / kra'u tsung lis gsungs don/ nub byang dmag khul khang gis thag gcod byed dgos pa'i 282

las don khag lnga de'i skor khyed tshos glog 'phrin gyi zin bris shig bris rjes krung dbyang nas gsham la btang ste nges par du thag gcod byed dgos/ krung dbyang gis paṇa chen la khas blangs pa'i las ka ste/ las byed pa dang sku srung dmag gtong rgyu sogs zla ba gsum pa'i sngon la tshang ma tshar ba byed dgos/slad phyin bod du bskyod skabs khyed tsho khag bgos kyis rim pas phyin na legs shing / da lta nges par du khal rta dang 'bru rigs gzan chas sogs lam seng gra sgrig byed dgos zhes dang / skye rgu mdo nas chab mdo brgyud lha sar phyin na 'grig gam zhes hphan ming gis zhus pas kra'u tsung lis de mi 'grig lam de'i thog lho nub dmag khul khang gi dmag mi khri tsho 'ga' yod pas 'grim 'grul dog pa'i khar khyed tshor da dung nag chu sa khul bzung rgyu'i dmag jus kyi gzhogs 'degs las 'gan yang yod bcas gsungs/ yang hphan ming gis mtsho bod gzhung lam bzo mtshams bzhag na dbor skyel thad gnad don 'dug ces zhus pas kra'u tsung lis gsungs don/ krung dbyang gis gzhung lam de bzo gi min zhes bshad med par nub byang phyogs kyis lam kha'i gnas tshul la brtag dpyad kyis lam bu gang bzo bde shos yin pa dang / khyon yongs la ring tshad ga tshod yod med/ mi shugs dang rgyu cha ga tshod dgos min/ dus tshod ga tshod 'gor min bcas brtag zhib byed dgos kyi yod pa red ces dang /yang kra'u tsung lis khyed tsho bod bskyod kyi 'go brtsams rjes lho nub bod bskyod dmag dpung bar glog 'phrin thog nas 'brel ba byed dgos pa dang blo mthun yung hrang khun btsal te gsang ba'i tar deb cig blang na 'grig bod du bskyod 'go btsugs rjes thon rim dang po de cun bco brgyad pa'i bkod par nyan dgos pa dang rjes su bod du slebs rjes phal cher gcig gyur gyis lho nub 283

cus kyi khongs su gtogs kyi red/ krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis mi nyis stong lhag tsam yod pa'i las khungs 'dzugs rtsis byed pa de ni ha cang che drags pa red ces gsungs byung ba dang / kra'u tsung lis khyed tsho'i las don u yon lhan khang de gang na btsugs yod ces bka' 'dri gnang bar phon ming gis len kraladu yod ces zhus/ blo mthun li'i wu'i han gyis rjes su khyed tshos len kra'u dang sku 'bum sa gnas gnyis su las khungs 'dzugs dgos/ gal te las don u yon lhan khang de len kra'u du btsugs na yā han krang sku 'bum du song na 'grig ces gsungs byung /kra'u tsung lis yang mdzub ston gnang don/ phyi 'brel las byed pa'i thad rjes su nyin rdur bca' sdod gzhung tshab che mo'i las khungs nas bod du las ka byed mkhan mi gcig 'then na 'grig pa dang (de rjes gzhung tshab che mo'i las khungs de nas blo mthun snang kung su'u 'then te bod kyi phyi don khru'u yi khru'u krang du bsko gzhag byas)dril bsgrags slob gso'i las ka byed mkhan gzhan nas 'tshol dgos shing / mtha' mtshams su las ka byed mkhan gyi las byed pa'i thob thang thad zhib 'jug byas nas gtan 'bebs gsar pa byed dgos ces dang / blo mthun dbang rlung gis su'u lan gyi shis po li ya'i las byed pa'i thob thang de su'u lan dbus khul las ldab gcig gis mtho ba 'dug ces zhus par kra'u tsung lis nga tshos de 'dra byed dgos kyi ma red/ dgos mkhor gzhigs nas gtan 'bebs byas na 'grig pa dang lho nub phyogs la glog 'phrin thog nas skad cha 'dri ba'am yang na nub byang cus kyis bsam 'char zhig bston na 'grig las byed pa'i khyim mi rjes su bod du bcings 'grol btang rjes bskyel chog gra sgrig gi las ka rnams zla ba gsum pa'i zla mjug gi 284

sngon la tshar ba byed dgos pa dang de'i 'gan nub byang cus dang nub byang dmag khul khang la dkris nas rjes su sgrub mi 'dug na kho tshor 'dri rtsad bya dgos zhes gsungs byung /tsung lis da dung mdzub ston gzhan khag mang po gnang byung ba tshang ma gting zab la zhib tshags pa dang / 'phral thag chod la gnad 'khel ba bcas kyi thog nas nga tsho'i las don la kha phyogs gsal po bstan pa gnang byung /krung dbyang dang kra'u tsung li'i mdzub ston ltar nga tshos paṇa chen phyir phebs mdzad rgyur srung skyel zhu ba'i gra sgrig gi las ka dza drag ngang byas pa yin/las byed pa bsdu skor dang / 'gro gron len pa/ dngos po khag mkho sgrub byed pa/ mtshon cha dang rdzas mdel gra sgrig byed pa/ sman bcos ru khag dang /'phrin gtong dang glog brnyan ru khag sgrig 'dzugs byed pa sogs gnad don 'di dag tshang ma krung dbyang gi 'brel yod las khungs khag dang gros bsdur gyis lhan du thag gcod byed dgos kyi yod par brten de'i ched du blo mthun li'i wu'i han gyis tshogs 'du thengs mang bskong 'tshogs gnang ste 'brel yod las khungs khag dang gros bsdur gnang mthar kra'u tsung lir snyan gseng zhus te krung dbyang nas thag gcod mdzad pa red/ bod du bskyod mkhan gyi nga tsho'i dmag dpung 'di'i nang khyon bsdoms mi nyis stong lhag tsam yod cing sa cha gzhan nas bskong 'then byas pa'i las byed pa tshos kyang dmag chas gyon dgos pa dang / paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi mi sna'i nang dpon rigs dang /khyim mi/ sku srung dmag sogs tshud pa'i khyon bsdoms mi bzhi brgya lhag tsam yod cing / sman bcos ru khag gi em chi dang nad g.yog sogs krung dbyang 'phrod bsten pu'u nas gtong gnang mdzad pa dang / glog brnyan par rgyag ru 285

khag rig gnas pu'u nas gtong gnang mdzad byung zhing 'phrin gtong yo chas ni nub byang dmag khul khang nas gnang byung /de'i skabs gzhung lam de mtsho sngon dkyil khul gyi shang sde (deng skabs kyi tu'u lan shan)bar du las ma grub par de rjes khal mar brten dgos stabs g.yag dang / rta/ rnga mong sogs 'bor chen dgos kyi yod/ des na kun su'u zhing chen sogs shan khag gi zhing 'brog sa nas rnga mong sum khri lhag tsam glas te rnga mong skyel 'dren ru khag chen po zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas pa dang /mtsho sngon gyi tu'u lan shan sogs sa gnas kyi sog rigs dang bod rigs 'brog pa'i sa gnas g.yag brgyad stong lhag tsam glas pa yin/ de bzhin dmag rta bzhi stong lhag tsam bskong 'then gyis mi tshang mar bzhon rta yod pa ma zad/ lam thag ring po'i sar dmag bskyod byed dgos stabs mi rer rta gnyis re sprad pa dang / gzhan yang ched mngags byams khri 'khyer byed drel nyis brgya lhag tsam gra sgrig byas yod/lam 'di nas bod du bskyod pa ni sa mtho la grang ngar che ba'i sa khul du 'gro bskyod byed pa zhig yin stabs grang ngar 'gog ched kyi ca dngos ni gal che'i gnad don zhig yin pas ngas ched mngags then cin du skyod de pags pa'i tā yi dang / pags pa'i stod thung / pags pa'i dor ma/ pags pa'i lham/ zhwa mo/ lag shubs/ rlung 'gog mig shel sogs gyon gos dang yo chas 'bor chen mngags bzo byas te mi tshang mar sprad pa yin/ gur dang / dmag spyod nyal khri/ dmag spyod sgrog tse/ rkub stegs sogs phon che dgos pa rnams hrang had dang then cin nas mngags nyo byas pa dang / za khang gi yo chas len kru'u dang zi ling sogs sa gnas nas nyos shing / za 'bru dang / gzan chas/ 286

'bud shing / zhor zas sogs kun su'u dang mtsho sngon gnyis nas nyos pa yin/khal ma dang ca dngos sna tshogs grangs 'bor chen po 'di lta bu dus tshod thung ngu'i nang gra sgrig 'thus tshang yong ba ni las sla po zhig rtsa ba nas min pas de'i thog nas mes rgyal mi dmangs kyis phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas nga tshor brtse sems chen pos thugs khur gnang ba mtshon thub/gong gsal gyi dgos mkho mtha' dag zi ling nas shang sde bar rlangs 'khor gyis dbor 'dren byas pa dang / rnga mong dang / rta/ khal g.yag drel sogs shang sder rub bsdus kyis gong gsal dngos po rnams sa gnas de nas bod du dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/srung skyel ru chen mo thon gong la nang sgang gi sku tshab dza sag jis 'jigs med dang / hphan ming / mu'u hreng krung (de snga'i nub byang dmag khul chab srid pu'u yi mi dmangs 'grim 'grul pu'u krang)bcas kyis mi khag gcig sne khrid kyis sngon bgrod dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas te zi ling nas lha sar sngon la thon/ kho tshos spyi lo /95/ lo'i zla 8tshes 28nyin shang sde nas rta thog thon pa dang lam bar du nyin ltar glog 'phrin thog nas nga tsho dang 'brel ba byed kyi yod cing / zla /2tshes / nyin kho tsho lha sar slebs nas krang cing wu dang /krang go hwa/ than gon san bcas dang mnyam 'dzoms byung ba red/cis 'jigs med sogs lha sar slebs rjes paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad skor dang lhag par du gtso bo paṇa chen gyi dbang cha dang go gnas bskyar gso byas te de snga khong gi khongs su gtogs pa'i sa khul phyir slog bya rgyu'i gnad don skor la lam seng bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang gros mol byas/ de la tā la'i bla mas ched mngags glog 'phrin phul te dga' bsu zhu gnang mdzad 287

pa ma zad/ paṇa chen dang srung skyel dmag dpung bod kyi sa mtshams zin rjes lam bar du bod sa gnas kyi rdzong khag gis rta 'ul dang khal ma btang ste 'grim 'grul gyi gnad don thag gcod bya rgyur mos mthun mdzad/ der paṇa chen gyis glog 'phrin btang ste thugs rje che zhes zhu gnang mdzad pa dang dus mtshungs paṇa chen nang sgang gi ming thog nas de snga paṇa chen khongs gtogs kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang mnga' khongs lha sde mi sde rnams la glog 'phrin btang nas kho tshos paṇa chen ring min bkras lhun du zhabs sor 'khod skabs dga' bsu zhu ba'i las don khan hur brtson gyis byed dgos pa'i re ba bton gnang mdzad cing / kho tshos gra sgrig gi las don byed pa'i nang sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs dang mthun sgril yag po byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul yang gnang /de'i skabs nga tshos zi ling du ma thon gong gi gra sgrig rnams byas zin nas thon chog ang bsar ngang bsdad pa yin/ zi ling nas thon pa/spyi lo /95/ lo'i zla /2tshes /8nyin blo mthun zhis krung zhun gyis kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi tshab zhus nas ched mngags zi ling du paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs dog thon gnang rgyur dga' skyel zhu bar phebs/ zing ling du dga' skyel zhu ba'i mdzad sgo zab rgyas tshogs pa dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi kra'o hra'u hran dang / kru'u zhi gzhon pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ ma' phu khreng / zhing chen tang ud kyi hru'u ci krang krung li'ang / zhing chen dmag khul khang gi si ling 288

yon le'o han hreng sogs dga' skyel zhu ba'i mdzad sgor zhugs pa red/paṇa chen bzhugs sgang nang du bca' sdod nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi sku tshab las rogs sogs kyis srung skyel zhus pa'i 'og paṇa chen dang / khong gi khyim mi/ de bzhin bzhugs sgar gyi dpon rigs yongs rdzogs bcas bzhugs sgar rlangs 'khor che chung sna tshogs kyi nang du khag bgos kyis bzhugs te zi ling nas shang sder dog thon mdzad cing / paṇa chen bzhugs sgar khongs kyi dpon rigs tsho'i khyim mi rnams snga sa nas shang sder slebs yod/paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nang du bca' sdod sku tshab las rogs sogs las sgrub pa'i don gcod las khungs cig sgrig 'dzugs byas te bod bskyod lam bar gyi 'brel yod las don mtha' dag thag gcod byed pa dang / rnga mong sum khri lhag tsam yod pa rnams thon rim kha shas bgos nas rim pas thon zhing /rta dang / drel/ khal g.yag sogs skyel 'dren ru khag kyang thon rim gong ltar byas pa red/nga tsho shang sder slebs skabs lugs rnying gi lo gsar pa shar nye'i skabs yin zhing / spyi lo /952lo'i zla / po'i zla stod la shang sder gangs chen po thengs 'ga' babs song bas skabs der dkrog gtam zhig khyab yong bar da lo kha ba gzhi khyon chen po babs stabs gdang la'i la lam kha bas bkag nas 'grul pa thar gyi mi 'dug ces zer/ gnas tshul de paṇa chen nang sgang gi bzhugs sgar nang du yod pa'i sku tshab par snyan seng gis mu mthud mdun du bskyod min bka' 'dri gnang byung bas ngas nub byang cus dang krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang la glog 'phrin thog nas 'gro dgos min dgongs skor zhus pa yin/ 289

de ni skabs de'i 'gag rtsa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnad don zhig yin stabs tsung li kra'u en le dang pu'u krang li'i wu'i han rnam gnyis kyis kyang pe cin nas nga tshor glog 'phrin stsal te gom gang mdun spos kyis gnas tshul bka' 'dri gnang byung ba ma zad/ gal te la lam kha bas dngos 'brel 'gag 'dug na gnas skabs shang sder sgug bsdad de rjes su gangs bzhur mtshams gyi dbyar dus su thon dgos zhes mdzub ston gnang byung / 'on kyang gal te nga tsho 'dir lo phyed bsdad na 'bru rigs dang gzan chas sogs 'dang min gyi gnad don chen por gyur gyi red la lhag par du dus tshod ring po 'di lta bu bsdad na go skabs bzang po shor nyen yod stabs de ni ha cang gal che'i gnad don zhig tu gyur pa red/ gzhan yang 'di nas gdang la'i lam thag ha cang gi ring ba dang phar tshur khyon bsdoms zla ba kha shas kyi dus tshod dgos stabs mi btang ste rtog zhib byed thabs bral bas ri'i steng gi gnas tshul ngo ma yang shes thabs dka'/gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing chen po 'di lta bu'i 'og nga tsho dang nang sgang lhan du zhib 'jug thengs mang byas pas nang snang gis gdang la bskor nas /tsho pa sum cu so dgu (sa gnas kyi ming )brgyud phyin na lam du zla gcig lhag tsam gyis lam 'gor che ba yod rung gang ltar bod la slebs thub kyi red ces bshad byung / mthar nga tshos byed thabs 'di spyod rgyu gtan la bkal nas gal srid gdang la'i mtshams su slebs te la lam kha bas 'gag pa mthong na ‘ tsho pa sum cu so dgu brgyud 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel ba dang / kha bas 'gag skyon mi 'dug na la de rang brgyab nas 'gro rgyu'i bsam blo'i gra sgrig byas pa yin/ des na phyogs gcig nas paṇa chen gyi mtshan thog nas kra'u tsung li dang pu'u krang li'i 290

wu'i han la glog 'phrin phul nas dgongs bskor zhus pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas ngas krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang la glog 'phrin phul bas byed thabs 'dir gong gsal phyogs gsum gyi dbu khrid tsho'i chog mchan mgyogs myur thob ste nga tshor mu mthud mdun bskyod byed dgos pa'i bka' phebs byung /spyi lo /952lo'i zla / po'i zla dkyil tsam la nga tsho shang sde nas rim par rdog thon gyis mtsho sngon rtswa thang gi phyogs su skyod pa yin/ nga tsho'i 'grim 'grul du spyod byed ni rta yin pa dang / mkho rdzas dang drag chas sogs dbor skyel byed mkhan ni rnga mong dang / khal g.yag drel bcas khri phrag 'ga' yod pa de rnams yin/ sems can khri phrag 'ga' shas 'di nyin ltar rtswa bza' dgos pas nga tsho thengs der bod du bskyod skabs don dngos thog phyed dmag bskyod dang byed rdzi bo'i 'tsho ba skyel dgos byung ba de yang nyin ltar nyin phyed lam du zhugs pa dang nyin phyed sems can 'tsho dgos pa de red/ nyin re nam ma langs gong nas yar langs te snga dro'i lto chas bzos rjes gur gtibs pa dang rta sga brgyab nas lam seng ru bsgrigs te thon gyi yod pa dang / de ltar nyin dgung bar du song rjes rtswa chu yod la lci ba skam po yod pa dang / nyi mar kha gtad pa'i ri ldebs sam thang sder du tshugs babs te lto chas bzo gi yod/lto chas bzo bar las ka chen po gnyis yod pa gcig ni skabs der dgun dus su slebs nas chu rnams 'khyags yod stabs 'khyags pa dang gangs bzhur te lto chu byed dgos pa dang / gzhan gcig ni 'bud rdzas su spyod byed rtswa thang steng gi 'brong rtsi skam po rnams sgrug dgos pa de red/ de gnyis ka las ka nyung nyung zhig min pas ha lam mi yod tshad nas lag pa 'gul te byed dgos 29/

kyi yod/ 'brong lci skam po ni rang byung khams kyis nga tshor mkho 'don byas pa'i 'bud rdzas yag po zhig yin rung 'brong khyu tsho dang 'phrad skabs ci nas kyang thag ring du g.yol dgos pa las gang byung du me mda' rgyag rgyu med/'brong 'di rigs kyi gzugs stobs g.yag las ldab gcig tsam gyis che ba yod la shugs kyang ha cang che ba'i thog brgya phrag stong phrag khyu tsho byas nas rtswa thang steng 'gro gi 'dug gal te gnad che sar me mda' ma phog na 'brong de rigs kyi lus thog tu mde'u mang po phog kyang 'gyel rgyu med khar de las ldog ste smyo ba ltar khyod la rwa cos brdung gi red/ der brten 'brong de rigs kyi mgo bor mde'u ma phog na nges par du me mda' sum cu bzhi bcu brgyab mtshams gzhi nas gsod thub pas spyir btang mi rnams kyis de la rdzog thug mi 'gro ba byed gal che ba red/dgung zas bzos rjes ched du mngags pa'i mis sems can mang po de rnams 'tsho dgos pa dang / gzhan tshang mas dgong zas dang nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs zas bzo phyir lci ba sgrug par 'gro dgos/dmag bskyod kyi lam bar du yin na'ang dril bsgrags tsho chung gis blo mthun tshos sngar bzhin dgongs ltar krung dbyang rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi gsar 'gyur rlung 'phrin nyan pa dang 'dems sgrig byas nas nyin gnyis pa'i dgung zas bzos rjes ngag thog nas tshang mar brgyud bsgrags byas te bod dang / rgyal yongs/ rgyal spyi bcas kyi don chen rnams tshang mas shes rtogs yong ba byas te chab srid dang kha mi bral ba byed kyi yod pa de ni skabs der chab srid bsam blo'i las ka gtso che ba zhig yin/srung skyel dmag dpung nang gi tang yon tshor gnas skabs kyi tang ud 292

yod pa dang / thon yon tshor gnas skabs kyi thon ud yod cing / gza' 'khor re rer so so'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'tsho ba thengs re bskyal te mi bzang don bzang la bstod bsngags dang / rang skyon rang brjod dang gzhan skyon ther 'don byed pa bcas lam lugs de thog mtha' bar gsum du rgyun 'khyodas byas pa red/ nga tsho nyin ltar dmag bskyod byas te gza' nyi mar yang ngal gso rgyag gi med/ lam bar du snga rting thog rang rgyal gyi chu bo chen po gnyis kyi chu 'go ste rma chu'i chu 'go dang 'bri chu'i chu 'go brgyud pa dang / 'bri chu'i chu 'go'i khar slebs skabs chu bor dar chags 'dug pas nga tsho ru bsgrigs te 'khyags pa'i thog bskyod stabs rnyog dra nyung la drag tu bzhur ba'i chu bo brgal skabs kyi nyen kha de las kyang g.yol thub pa byung /gdang la brgyab pa/nga tshos grang rlung ldang ba'i sa mtho'i steng la brgyab chu brgal byas te zla ba gcig lhag tsam bskyod rjes spyi lo /952lo'i zla 2pa'i zla mjug tu gdang la'i la gsham du slebs shing / mtho la gzar ba'i ri chen po 'di kha bas 'gag med pa mthong byung / ri steng du ma gzhi kha ba mthug tshad khre tse gcig lhag tsam 'dug kyang 'grul bzhud byed mi thub pa med gshis lam bskor mi dgos par tshang mas thad kur la de brgyab pa yin/gdang la ni mtsho sngon dang bod bar phred du chags nas yod cing / nga tsho bskyod sa'i gdang la'i la ni mtho shos su rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre lnga stong brgyad brgya tsam zin gyi yod/ ri steng gang sar kha bas khengs shing grang ngar shin tu che bas lhag par du rkang pa gnyis bzod dka' ba 'khyag gi 'dug ri 293

mthon po'i steng du gso rlung 'dang gi med stabs mi tshang ma mgo yur 'khor ba dang mgo bo gas grabs yod pa lta bu'i na zug rgyag pa ma zad/ brang khar rgya ma stong gi ljid tshad kyis mnan pa lta bu'i dbugs rngub gtong dka' ba dang rkang pa gnyis 'dam gyi nang du tshud pa ltar 'degs dka' ba'i gnas su gyar ba dang / sems can rnams kyang gso rlung ma 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis brag khog shugs chen brdabs nas dbugs gtong ba dang / kha nas wu ba dkar po don bzhin khyar khyor du gom pa spo mi thub pa'i thog gangs ri'i steng du rtswa za rgyu med stabs 'khyags ltogs gnyis nas mnar te lus shugs zad gron shin tu che zhing / rnga mong dang khal rta mang po 'gro gin 'gro gin glo bur du 'gyel nas nam yang langs thub kyi mi 'dug mkha' dbyings su lding skor dma' po rgyag bzhin pa'i bya glag tshos rnga mong 'gyel ba mthong tshe mar lhung ba ltar du 'phur yong ste sngon la rnga mong gi mig 'bras bkog pa dang de rjes khyu tsho byas te 'phur yong nas rnga mong hril po bza' gi 'dug de ltar gdang la rgyag ring gi nyin kha shas de'i nang rnga mong dang / rta/ khal g.yag sogs mang dag cig rang byung khams kyi khor yug sdug po de lta bu'i nang du shi song ba dang / lam bar du g.yag dang / rta/ rnga mong bcas kyi phung ros tshom tshom du bar mtshams med par lus te gdang la brgyab pa'i dka' tshegs che ba'i 'grul lam gyi lam rtags lta bur gyur song / ri steng du gzan rtswa med la grang ngar che zhing gso rlung 'dang gi med stabs yun ring po 'gor na mi 'grig cing / ji tsam 'gor yun ring ba de tsam gyis nyen kha'ang che ba yod stabs la rgyag ring nyin ltar zhogs pa nas dgong mo'i bar myur bskyod myur brgal byas pa yin/dgong mo tshugs babs skabs phur ba 'khyags pa mkhregs po'i nang du zug mi 294

thub paso gur rnams rdos mnan nas sdod pa dang ri gsham nas sgrug yong ba'i lci ba skam po phran bu der brten nas lto chas bzo gi yod/ de ltar tshang mas lus srog blos btang byas stabs nyin drug las ma 'gor bar rang grub 'gag btsan gdang la de myur bar brgal thub pa byung /la brgyab rjes nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang / krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang / de bzhin blo mthun zhis krung zhun sger gyi mtshan thog bcas nas glog 'phrin stsal 'byor gyis rgyal kha dang bde 'jags ngang gangs ri chen po de brgal bar spro sems 'khol ba'i rten 'brel zhu gnang mdzad byung bas des mi tshang mar skul ma chen po thebs song / de ni bod bskyod lam bar du rang byung khams dang 'thab rtsod byas pa'i nang gi dka' tshegs che shos shig yin rung nga tshos de las brgal ba dang rgyal kha thob mod/'on kyang de'i ched du rin dod kyang ha cang chen po btang ba dper na/ rnga mong khrid mkhan gyi mang tshogs bcu lhag tsam tshe las 'das pa dang / las byed pa yang 'ga' shas grongs song ba bcas tshang ma snying khams kyi nus pa zhan pas lus po skrangs te 'chi ba dang / rnga mong khri gcig lhag tsam dang / rta dang khal g.yag kyang gang 'tsham bcas shi song / drel ni gzugs stobs thang po yod la dka' sdug 'khyogs pa'i sems can zhig yin pa'i thog nyin ltar gzan chag ster ba'i rkyen gyis gcig rang las shi ma song /gdang la'i la kha de brgal mtshams bod kyi sa cha zin cing / de nas nyin 'ga' song rjes a mdo smad ma'i skyes spo tsho pa zhig gi sa khongs su slebs nas tā la'i dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mngags pa'i dga' bsu zhu mkhan dpon rigs dang 'phrad byung / kho tsho'i nang mkhan chung gcig dang rim bzhi 295

gcig gis sne khrid pa'i khyon bsdoms mi bcu lhag tsam 'dug cing / kho tshos paṇa chen la mjal dar phul rjes tā la'i dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi tshab zhus phebs bsur yong ba yin zhes zhus song ba dang / de nas yar bskyod skabs kho tshos lam bar gyi 'brog pa tshos khral 'ul rgyugs dgos pa'i bka' btang ste paṇa chen dang srung skyel dmag dpung la mdun du bskyod rgyur rogs skyor byas byung / de nas 'go tshugs te lam bar du gang mtshams gang mtshams sar bod rigs 'brog pa'i gur dang phyugs khyu yod pa nga tshos gzhi nas mthong gi 'duganag chur bsdad pa/bod kyi sa cha zin rjes nga tsho thog mar slebs sa'i grong brdal ni nag chu red/ de ni rtswa thang steng gi grong brdal zhig yin zhing / skabs der dud tshang brgya phrag 'ga' shas 'dug pa dang dgon pa yang gnyis yod pa'i nang gcig ni zhabs brtan dgon pa yin zhing / de'i nang dge 'dun grangs lnga brgya lhag tsam 'dug pa dang / gcig ni a ṇi'i dgon pa yin zhing / de'i nang du btsun ma nyis brgya lhag tsam 'dug grong brdal nang tshong khang chung chung yang kha shas yod pa de tsho'i nang 'tshong rgyu'i dngos po ni mang che ba dbyin ji dang rgya gar gyi ca dngos sha stag red/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nag chur byang rigs spyi khyab ser skya mi gnyis bskos yod pa gnyis ka rim bzhi'i go gnas red/ kho tsho dang / sa gnas de'i bla ma/ dge 'dun pa/ de bzhin nye khor gyi 'brog pa sogs mi grangs mig stong lhag tsam dga' bsur 'byor ba dang / nag chu grong brdal 296

nang du nang pa'i chos kyi lugs ltar dga' bsu'i mdzad sgo 'tshogs/ ngas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi tshab zhus nas byang spyi mkhan rim gnyis la mjal 'phrad zhus pa dang bla mar mjal kha zhus pa ma zad/ khong tshor rgya bod shan sbyar gyi 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉dang de min gyi dril bsgrags dngos po/ gzhan yang ja sgam sogs mjal rten du phul ba dang / yang dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed rta yang re phul ba yin/ de rjes dgon pa'i bla ma tshos paṇa chen tshogs dbur gdan drangs song /nag chur sdod skabs nga tshor krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang nas glog 'phrin 'byor gsal/ skabs der lha sar chab srid 'thab rtsod tshabs che byung ba ste/ srid tshab gnyis (ser skya mi gnyis)kyi ngan bskul 'og mi dmangs brdzus tshogs cig sgrig 'dzugs kyis mi bzhi stong lhag tsam skong rub byas te krung dbyang gi sku tshab krang cing wu'u bzhugs gnas kyi mthar bskor nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod nas phyir 'then bya dgos pa'i log spyod kyi re 'dun bton pa dang / srid tshab kyis snang rtse shag gi mi dpon dang lha sa'i nye khor rdzong khag gi rdzong dpon tshor mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la sha dang za 'bru sogs bza' bca'i rigs dang lci ba sogs 'bud rdzas kyi rigs mtha' dag rtsa ba nas tshong mi chog pa'i bka' btang ba ma zad/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag phyir log ma phyin na kho tsho lha sar ltogs shi thebs su 'jug gi yin zhes lud shob de ltar bshad cing / nga tshos kyang kho pa tsho'i log spyod btsan nyams la dmigs nas 'thab rtsod mtha' gcig tu byas pa ste/ blo mthun krang cing wu sku ngo mas tā la'i mjal 'phrad gnang ste mi dmangs brdzus tshogs ni log spyod kyi sgrig 'dzugs shig yin pas 297

nges par du lam seng med pa bzo dgos zhes gsungs pa ma zad yol ba'i rgyab tu byus 'god byed mkhan srid tshab gnyis lam seng gnas dbyung gtong dgos pa bcas de'i skor nyin 'ga'i dus bkag bzos nas lan gsal dgos pa'i blangs bya bton pa dang / dus mtshungs krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod dmag khul khang 'dzugs rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas pa dang 'brel cun bco brgyad pa'i cun krang krang go hwa dmag khul khang gi si ling yon du bsko gzhag byas pa dang / cun bco brgyad pa'i chab srid u yon than kon san chab srid u yon du bsko gzhag byas pa/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med si ling yon gzhon par bsko gzhag byas pa bcas kyi thog nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi bde 'jags la srung skyob zhu ched dus skabs gcig ring khong dmag khul khang gi sgo ra'i nang du bzhugs dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ de bzhin krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis 'byung srid pa'i dus zing mtha' dag la kha gtad gcog ched dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig 'thus tshang bya dgos pa'i bka' btang / skabs der lha sar 'byor ba'i bcings 'grol dmag gi sngon bgrod ru khag la mi tshig stong lhag tsam las med rung kho tsho ni nyams sad yun ring thebs pa'i dmag dpung brtul phod can zhig yin pa dang 'thab rtsod kyi nus pa ha cang chen po ldan yod pas dus zing la kha gtad gcog rgyu'i spobs sems kyis khengs nas 'dugaskabs der krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gnasatshul 'di rigs lam seng tang krung dbyang dang kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung la snyan seng zhus pa na tang krung dbyang gis bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la dgongs bzhes gnang ste bod rgya mi rigs dbar gyi 'brel ba dang krung dbyang dang sa gnas 298

srid gzhung dbar gyi dza drag gi 'brel ba zhi lhod du gtong ched dang / bod bskyod dmag dpung bod du rkang pa 'dzugs thub par phan pa yong ched bod ljongs dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu dang bod dmag bcings 'grol dmag la sgyur rgyu gnyis gnas skabs phyir 'gyangs byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs mdzad/ dus mtshungs zi khron nas lha sa bar gyi khron bod gzhung lam thog gang mgyogs rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub par brtson len byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs mdzad nas cun bco brgyad pa'i bkod 'thab pa rnams lam bzo'i las grwar zhugs dgos pa'i bka' btang /krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gong gsal gnas tshul rnams re re bzhin nga tshor glog 'phrin thog nas brda sprod gnang byung zhing /glo bur 'jab rgol gyi gnas tshul mi yong ched nga tshos dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig gang legs byas pa dang / de skor nga tsho dang nang sgang lhan du dza drag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas bod las don u yon lhan khang gi mdzub ston brgyud bsgrags byas nas 'byung srid pa'i dus zing la kha gtad gcog rgyu'i zhib phra'i bya thabs khag bkod sgrig byas pa yin/ de bzhin tshogs 'du bskong 'tshogs kyis tshang mar lha sa'i gnas tshul dang bod las don u yon lhan khang gi mdzub ston brgyud bsgrags byas te tshang mar bsam blo'i gra sgrig dang dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig gang legs bya dgos pa'i re 'dun bton pa dang bod bskyod mi sna tsho mi gcig pur khrom la 'gro mi chog par nges par du mi lnga drug yan drag chas 'khyer nas mnyam du 'gro dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs kyang byas shing / gzhan yang nga tshos nag chu'i nye 'dabs su dmag don rlon sbyong byas te drag shugs ngom ched du sa gnas de ga'i byang spyi dang bla ma sogs gzigs bskor du gdan 299

lha sar 'byor ba/spyi lo /952lo'i zla 4 tshes /2 nyin nga tsho paṇa chen srung skyel zhus nas lha sar bde 'jags ngang 'byor byung /spyi lo 195/ lo'i zla /2tshes /8 nyin zi ling nas kha gyes pa nas brtsis na lam du zla ba bzhi ma zin tsam 'gor ba dang lam thag le dbar bzhi stong tsam song 'dugapaṇa chen lha sar ma phebs gong le dbar bdun cu don drug gi sar gnas pa'i ri skyar phebs skabs krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis mngags pa'i hru'u ci gzhon pa hphan ming dang / dmag khul khang gis mngags pa'i tshan mu'u krang gzhon pa li'i co'i sogs dga' bsu zhu bar phebs pa ma zad/ lha sar slebs rjes gzab grung byed dgos pa'i gnad don khag la mnyam du zhib 'jug mdzad/paṇa chen lha sar phebs 'byor skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha sa'i nye 'dabs su gur phub nas rgyun srol ltar dga' bsu'i mdzad sgo 'tshogs shing / bka' shag gi bka' blon sogs ser skya dpon rigs gtso che rnams kyis dbu gur nang paṇa chen la mjal dar phul nas dga' bsu zhus pa dang / de rjes bod dmag dmag mi'i rol cha tshogs pa'i sne khrid 'og grong khyer nang phebs te sngon tshud nas gtsug lag khang nang gra sgrig byas zin pa'i bzhugs gnas su gdan la 'khod/ paṇa chen phyogs su mkho ba'i 'bru rigs dang gzan chas sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mkho 'don byas pa red/nyin de rang la paṇa chen rtse pho brang du tā la'i mjal bar phebs paṇa 30/

chen sku phreng dgu pa dang tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i bar 'gal ba byung ba nas bzung paṇa chen mes rgyal nang khul du gsang phebs gnang ste lo nyi shu rtsa dgu (spyi lo /923 lo nas spyi lo /952lo'i bar )song ba dang da cha paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa dang tā la'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i thog khong gnyis kyi mdza' mthun 'brel ba slar gso byung ba de yang ma'o kru'u zhis bod ljongs mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril gnad don thag gcod thub pa de red ces gsungs pa ltar yin pa dang / de ni bod la cha bzhag na gal che'i lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i don chen zhig red/ hphan ming dang cis 'jigs med gnyis sngon du lha sar 'byor nas gros mol gnang stabs paṇa chen gyi sngar yod dbang cha dang go gnas slar gso bya rgyu'i skor dang tā la'i phyogs kyis bzung ba'i de snga'i paṇa chen gyi sa khongs tshur len rgyu sogs kyi gnad don rnams de'i sngon nas gros mol legs grub byung ste rnyog dra che rigs byung med/ paṇa chen lha sar zla gcig lhag tsam bzhugs rjes/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang rdog thon gyis bkra shis lhun por chibs bsgyur gnang /paṇa chen lha sa nas zhal gyes pa'i nyin mo der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis grong khyer nye 'dabs su gur phub nas dga' skyel zhus pa dang bka' shag gi bka' blon sogs ser skya dpon rigs gtso che rnams kyis paṇa chen la mjal dar phul nas skyel ma zhus/paṇa chen bkra shis lhun por phyir log phebs pa/paṇa chen lha sa nas zhal ma gyes gong krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis krung dbyang la paṇa chen bkra shis lhun por phyir phebs gnang rgyu'i gra 302

sgrig gi gnas tshul snyan seng zhus shing / krung dbyang gis paṇa chen bkra shis lhun por phebs 'byor ma byung bar nga tshos mu mthud srung skyel zhu dgos pa ma zad/ der gnas skabs gcig ring bsdad nas paṇa chen sogs la las don khag legs sgrub gnang rgyur rogs ram zhus rjes gzhi nas lha sar phyir log byed dgos pa'i mdzub ston gnang byung / dus mtshungs krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gzhis rtser yan lag las don u yon lhan khang (sa gnas tang ud dang mtshungs )btsugs te paṇa chen mnga' khongs kyi las don mtha' dag thag gcod byed rogs zhu dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs mdzad pa dang /blo mthun le'ang zhon zhan yan lag las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u cir bsko gzhag byas pa dang blo mthun me'o ci'u ru'e hru'u ci gzhon par bsko gzhag byas/nga tsho lha sa nas thon rjes chu shur rdzong dang / dpal di gzhis/ sna dkar rtse rdzong / pa snam rdzong sogs brgyud mthar gzhis rtser slebs byung zhing lam bar ha lam zla phyed tsam 'gor 'dug de'i skabs paṇa chen nang sgang la sngar bzhin mi bzhi brgya lhag tsam yod pa dang / paṇa chen sku srung ying la mi lnga brgya ma zin tsam 'dug skabs der nga tsho paṇa chen la srung skyel zhu mkhan mi mang po med stabs yan lag las don u yon lhan khang gi mi nyung shas kyis las 'gan de 'khur ba red/gzhis rtse yan lag las don u yon lhan khang rang la skabs der mi bcu phrag 'ga' las med rung sde tshan gzhan dag cha tshang yod pa ste/ sman bcos ru khag dang / rig gnas las don tshogs pa/ shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang /tshags par las khungs/ dngul khang / tshong don kung si/ yig zam cus sogs las khungs khag gi mi brgya tsam yod pa rnams mnyam du las ka byed par 303

bskyod pa dang / de dag nang du cun bco brgyad pa nas yong ba'i mi yod la mtsho sngon nas yong ba'ang yod cing / kho tshos paṇa chen mnga' khongs kyi sa gnas su las don khag spel nas rnam pa gsar du gtod rgyu red/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa gzhis rtse nas zhal gyes te lo ngo nyi shu rtsa dgu song ste da cha sku phreng bcu pa phebs skabs sa gnas khag gi mnga' khongs 'bangs mi khri lnga drug tsam phebs bsur yong zhing / kho tsho'i nang du mi kha shas le dbar bcu tsam gyi sa nas yong ba dang mi 'ga' shas ni le dbar brgya phrag 'ga'i sa nas bkra shis lhun por yong ba red/ 'brog pa la la ni g.yag ded pa dang sbra gur khyer te snga sa nas gzhir rtser slebs 'byor gyis zla ba gcig tsam sgug zin 'dugagazhis rtse'i grong khul gang sar paṇa chen phyir phebs gnang bar bsu ba zhu mkhan gyi pho mo rgan gzhon mang pos khengs nas 'dug cing nga tsho grong khul du bskyod skabs mang tshogs kyi spro sems rab tu 'khol ba dang mi la lar da dung sems 'gul gyis rkyen pas skad shugs chen pos ngu gi 'dug de dag gi thog nas mi rigs kyi brtse dungs zab mo dang lhag par du chos lugs kyi brtse dungs shugs chen mtshon pa bcas rnam pa de lta bu ni gzhis rtse'i lo rgyus thog de snga byung myong med pa zhig red/bkras lhun dgon gyi dge 'dun pa tsho dang gzhis rtse'i grong mi tshos rang 'gul ngang ras dmar po dang shog bu dmar pos skar lnga'i dar dmar mang po bzos shing grong khul gyi khyim tshang tshang ma dang dgon pa'i grwa shag tshang ma'i thog khar dar dmar lhab lhub tu g.yo gin 'dug dar dmar de dag steng gi skar lnga rnams che chung dang bzo lta 'dra min sna tshogs bzos te tshad gzhi dang rtsa ba nas mthun gyi mi 'dug kyang de ltar yin na de bas kyang sa gnas de ga'i bod 304

rigs mi dmangs kyi rang shugs su 'phel ba'i rgyal gces brtse sems de mtshon thub pas nga tshor sems 'gul chen po thebs byung /bkra shis lhun po'i mchod khang khag dang grwa tshang bcas tshang ma'i nang ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par mthon por bkal 'dug cing / sku par de dag tshang ma jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku 'dra 'jog sa dang gcig mtshungs kyi sar bkal 'dug pa de'i thog nas dgon pa yongs kyi rgya che'i dge 'dun pa tshos gung khran tang la thugs rje che zhes zhu ba'i bsam pa de gsal por mtshon thub/paṇa chen bkra shis lhun po'i nang phebs 'byor rjes nang pa'i chos kyi rgyun srol ltar mdzad sgo gzab rgyas 'tshogs pa dang / mdzad sgo de rigs snga rting thog zla phyed tsam 'tshogs song /de'i ring nga tshos gzhis rtse las don u yon lhan khang dang de min las khungs khag mgyogs myur btsugs pa dang / gzhis rtse'i tshags par dpar 'don byas pa yin/ tshags par de ni snum par brgyab pa'i gza' 'khor re'i tshags par zhig yin zhing / rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyi thog nas shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi gsar 'gyur 'god kyi yod/ sman bcos ru khag gis sman yon ma blangs par ser skya mang tshogs la sman bcos byed 'go tshugs pa dang dus mtshungs glog brnyan ru khag gis rin dod ma blangs par glog brnyan bstan pa dang / dngul khang gis grong mi dbul po dang grong brdal nye 'dabs kyi zhing 'brog dbul po tshor skyed med dngul bun btang ba sogs sman bcos dang / dngul bun/ glog brnyan bcas don chen gsum po der rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu thob byung /tā la'i nas gzhis rtser spyi khyab gcig btsugs yod pa'i nang du spyi rdzong 305

rim bzhi ser skya mi gnyis bskos yod pa de gnyis kyis paṇa chen gzhis rtser phebs 'byor skabs grong brdal nye 'dabs su gur phub nas dga' bsu zhus pa dang mjal dar phul/ gtsang khul du tā la'i mnga' khongs kyi rdzong khag bcu drug yod pa dang / paṇa chen mnga' khongs su rdzong khag bzhi dang rdzong dang 'dra ba'i sger tshugs gzhis ka sum cu lhag tsam yod/ gzhis rtse grong brdal gyi grong mi rnams tā la'i khongs su gtogs pa dang / bkras lhun dgon pa ni paṇa chen gyi khongs su gtogs kyi yod stabs gzhis rtser tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs gnyis mthun sgril yag po byed rgyu ni ha cang gal 'gangs che ba'i don chen zhig yin pas gzhis rtse yan lag las don u yon lhan khang gis tā la'i dang paṇa chen khongs kyi sa gnas khag dang las khungs khag la bsam blo'i las ka byed rgyu'i 'gan 'khur byas/ngas gzhis rtser phyogs gcig nas paṇa chen bkra shis lhun por phyir phebs gnang bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i byed sgo khag nang zhugs pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas yan lag las don u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa dang dus mtshungs tā la'i phyogs la 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka byas pa yin/ ngas gzhis rtse'i spyi rdzong sar ched bskyod kyis spyi rdzong gnyis la mjal 'phrad zhus pa dang khong tshor mjal rten dang dril bsgrags dngos po mang po phul zhing spyi rdzong gnyis kyis kyang tshur mjal 'phrad du phebs nas phyag btags gnang byung ba bcas phyogs gnyis kyi 'brel ba ha cang yag po yod/ngas gzhis rtser lo phyed tsam bsdad ring gtso bo paṇa chen la khong gi sngar yod go gnas dang dbang cha slar gso yong rogs zhus pa de'i nang gi 'gag rtsa'i gnad don ni spyi lo /923lor paṇa chen gtsang khul nas zhal gyes rjes tā 306

la'i phyogs kyis bzung ba'i rdzong dang gzhis ka rnams paṇa chen phyogs la phyir slog gis paṇa chen nas dpon rigs mngags te do dam byed rgyu de red/ zhi ba'i ngang nas rtsis sprod byed pa'i las ka 'di spyir na thogs med du sgrub nas dka' ngal che rigs 'phrad ma byung / gal che'i las ka gzhan zhig ni paṇa chen nang sgang nang khul du mes rgyal nas phyir log yong ba'i mi sna dang sa gnas de gar bsdad pa'i mi sna'i bar gyi 'gal ba 'dum sgrig byed rgyu de yin/gzhis rtser bsdad pa'i ser skya dpon rigs nang mi khag gcig gis tā la'i phyogs kyi ched du las ka byed myong ba de ni skabs de'i gnas tshul 'og de ltar mi byed rang byed yin rung mes rgyal nang khul nas phyir log yong mkhan tshos kho tshor gnad 'khel rdung rdeg byed rtsis byed kyi 'dug pas paṇa chen dang nang sgang gis mi de tshor gu yangs kyi srid jus 'dzin te sngar byas la rtsad gcod mi byed rgyur nga tshos go bskon byas pa yin/ skabs der paṇa chen phyogs kyis nga tsho dang go bsdur ma byas par mi de tsho'i nang gi 'go gtso zhig (rim bzhi)rang 'gar 'dzin bzung byas 'dug pas kho tsho'i bar du mthun sgril yag po yong ched nga tshos paṇa chen dang nang sgang la go bskon gyis mi de grod bgrol btang ba ma zad/ rjes su gnas tshul 'di rigs 'phrad skabs sngon la nga tsho dang go bsdur byed dgos zhes zhus pa yin/ mi de glod bkrol btang ba brgyud paṇa chen nang khul gyi phyogs khag gnyis bar du'ang mthun sgril yag po yong rgyur bskul 'ded byas song /spyi lo 1952lo'i zla 12par krung dbyang gi mdzub ston gzhir bzung nga lha sar krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi tshogs 'du'i nang zhugs par bskyod dgos stabs ngas paṇa chen bzhugs gnas su zhal gyes zhu bar 307

bcar zhing paṇa chen gyis kyang nga'i ched du ston mo bshams nas skyel ma mdzad byung / nga paṇa chen bzhugs gnas kyi sgo 'gram du slebs dus der dge 'dun pa gral star gcig 'dug pa der khyon bsdoms grwa pa mi grangs bcu phrag 'ga' yod la grwa pa re'i phyag tu me spar ba'i spos chag re bsnams pa dang zhal nas chos 'don gyin 'dug de ni nang pa'i chos lugs kyi bka' drin che zhes zhu ba'i rnam pa mtshon byed kyi mdzad sgo gzab rgyas shig red/'gro khar paṇa chen gyis nga la gzugs stobs che ba'i drel gcig dang rta sga 'khor cha tshang gsol ras gnang byung ba de ni lam bar du bzhon byed dang de bzhin dran rten du'ang nyar ched red/ nang sgang gis paṇa chen sku srung ying gi nang nas pan gcig ste khyon bsdoms mi bcu skong 'then gyis nga lha sar phyir log byed par srung skyel gnang byung /dog thon byed pa'i nyin der nang sgang gis grong brdal nye 'dabs su gur phub nas dga' skyel gnang ba dang / bod rigs kyi goms srol ltar nga tshor mjal dar gnang nas skyel ma byas byung zhing / gzhis rtser yod pa'i tā la'i phyogs kyi spyi rdzong gnyis kyis kyang gur phub pa dang mjal dar btang nas spro sems chen pos skyel ma byas byung ba ma zad/ kho tshos da dung bod rigs sbrags gnyer zhig kyang lha sa bar nga'i 'gro rogs su mngags te khos lam bar du tā la'i mnga' khongs rdzong khag dang 'brel ba byas nas nga tshor 'bru rigs dang / gzan chas/ sdod gnas sogs mkho 'don byed pa'i 'gan khur rgyu bcas khyon bsdoms nga tsho 'gro mkhan mi bcu grangs shig yod/thengs der gzhis rtse nas lha sar phyir log skabs byang gi gnas tshul shes rtogs yong ched ngas lho ngos nas ma phyin par byang brgyud de yong bas lam bar 308

du rnam gling rdzong sogs su slebs byung /rnam gling rdzong du slebs skabs rdzong dpon dang dgon pa'i mkhan po sogs mi bcu lhag tsam grong gi nye 'dabs su yong nas dga' bsu byas pa dang mjal dar gnang byung zhing / sdod gnas su slebs rjes ngas kyang phyag btags dang dril bsgrags dngos po phul ba dang / de bzhin sa gnas der dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig 'dug pa de'i nang gi dge 'dun pa lnga brgya lhag tsam tshang mar ngas sku 'gyed rda yang re phul ba yin/ stod lung bde chen rdzong khongs su slebs dus bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa zhig 'dug pa de'i nang du mtshur phu kurma pa bzhugs 'dug khong gi sku gong ma'i gras sde pa gtsang pa zer ba zhig gis phag gru'i srid dbang gtor ba dang gtsang pa sde pa'i srid dbang btsugs te bod yongs kyi rgyal po byas nas bod la dbang sgyur lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam (spyi lo /6/8lo nas spyi lo /642lo'i bar )byas pa'i rjes tā la'i sku phreng lnga pas dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang btsugs/ ngas dgon pa'i nang bskyod de bla ma tshor mjal dar mjal rten phul rjes dge 'dun pa sum brgya lhag tsam 'dug pa tshang mar sku 'gyed rda yang re phul ba yin zhing / de yang gung khran tang gis bod kyi chos lugs grub mtha' khag tshang mar lta stangs gcig pa 'dzin te chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len bstar gyi yod pa dang / grub mtha' gcig kho nar rgyab skyor mi byed par grub mtha' khag tshang mar brtsi 'jog byed pa sogs kyi mdzad phyogs mtshon ched du yin/ 309

sbyi lo /953lo'i bod kyi rgyal ston mdzad gzigs tshogs pa/nga lha sar log slebs dus spyi lo /953lo shar zin/ lo de ni rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo bzhi 'khor ba'i dus dran yin pas krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yis krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang nas tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs gnyis mnyam du yod pa'i gcig gyur gyi bod kyi mdzad gzigs tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs kyis pe cin du rgyal ston gyi byed sgor zhugs dgos pa'i mdzub ston mdzad/ phyogs gnyis dang grol mol byas pa brgyud kho tshos kyang gcig gyur thog sgrig 'dzugs bya rgyur mos mthun byas byung /tā la'i phyogs kyi dbu bzhugs 'thus mi ni bka' blon rag shag (mdo mkhar ba )yin pa dang / dbu bzhugs 'thus mi gzhon pa ni dmag spyi mkhan chung dga' brang yin zhing / gzhan yang de min 'thus mi bcu lhag tsam gyi thog dpon rigs gzhan dang / sku 'khor mi sna/ khyim mi sogs mi bcu lhag tsam yod/ paṇa chen phyogs nas dbu bzhugs 'thus mir tā bla ma ngag dbang sbyin pa mngags gtong gnang ba dang / de min 'thus mi dang / sku 'khor mi sna/khyim mi sogs mi bcu lhag tsam yod/ 'di ni paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs rjes bod yongs gcig gyur thog sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i rgyal ston mdzad gzigs tshogs pa dang po de yin pa dang / rag shag gis tshogs gtso gnang ba dang / ngag dbang sbyin pas tshogs gtso gzhon pa gnang zhing krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gtong gnang ltar kho bos khong tshor sne khrid dang phebs rogs zhus te pe cin du bskyod dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs mdzad/310

de'i skabs zi khron nas chab mdo bar ma gtogs khams bod gzhung lam khyon yongs su rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub kyi med stabs lha sa nas chab mdo bar rta bzhon dgos byung / des na bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lam bar rdzong khag gi rdzong dpon tshos mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i mi sna yongs kyi 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren dang / 'bru rigs/ gzan chas/ sdod gnas sogs kyi dgos mkho mtha' dag mkho 'don bya rgyu'i 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i bka' btang / nga tsho lha sa nas dog thon gyis rta bzhon nas zla ba gcig lhag tsam song rjes gzhi nas chab mdor slebs byung zhing / krung gung chab mdo yan lag las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci dang / chab mdo mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin/ bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yon gzhon pa bcas yin pa'i blo mthun wang chi ma'i yis mdzad gzigs tshogs par dga' bsu gzab rgyas dang spro sems 'khol ba'i sne len mdzad byung / chab mdo dgon gyi sprul sku 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal gyis dgon pa de'i mkhan po sku tshab tu mngags te chab mdo grong gi nye 'dabs su dga' bsu zhu byed gur phub pa dang bod rigs kyi goms srol ltar 'thus mi yongs la mjal dar phul nas dga' bsu gzab rgyas mdzad/chab mdo nas thon skabs chab mdor bca' sdod bod dmag khul khang gi dmag dpung gis rlangs 'khor chen po bcu phrag 'ga' btang nas mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i mi sna yongs rdzogs khren tur bskyal zhing der slebs rjes zi khron zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams pa dang de nas lho nub dmag khul khang gis gnam gru 'ga' btang nas mdzad gzigs tshogs pa khren tur nas u han bar bskyal byung / dbus lho dmag 3//

srid u yon lhan khang khongs mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin blo mthun krang kre dbye sogs kyis dbus lho dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi tshab zhus nas gnam gru thang du dga' bsu zhu bar phebs pa dang / dbus lho dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang dbus lho dmag khul khang gi dbu khrid pa blo mthun ye can dbying gis gsol ston bshams nas mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i mi sna yongs la sne len mdzad/ 'thus mi tshos u han du blta bskor spro 'cham gnang ba dang / de bzhin 'khrab ston pa grags can khren po hwa gis 'khrab ston byas pa'i han cud khrang zhi yang gzigs/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis bod kyi mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i phebs bsur sne len khru'u yi khru'u krang la sogs pa ched du u han du mngags gtong mdzad 'dug de nas mi sna yongs rdzogs me 'khor du zhugs nas pe cin du bskyod/bod kyi mdzad gzigs tshogs pa pe cin du phebs 'byor skabs krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi spyi khyab si ling bcas yin pa'i kru'u te dang / krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u pu'u krang dang mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gcig lcogs li'i wu'i han sogs mi bcu phrag 'ga' pe cin me 'khor 'bab tshigs su phebs nas dga' bsu'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas 'tshogs/mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i bzhugs gnas ni skabs der gsar du bskrun zin pa'i zhi bde mgron khang du bkod sgrig byas/ zla ba 9pa'i zla smad du blo mthun li'i lu'i han gyis pe cing mgron khang du gsol ston gzab rgyas 312

bshams nas bod kyi rgyal ston mdzad gzigs tshogs par dga' bsu zhu gnang mdzad/ zla /0tshes / nyin rgyal khab btsugs nas lo bzhi 'khor bar dran gso gzab rgyas byas shing / kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis gnam bde sgo mo'i yang steng nas krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la gzigs zhib gnang ba dang / bod kyi rgyal ston mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i mi sna yongs kyis mdzad gzigs stegs bu'i thog nas rgya che la spro sems 'khol ba'i rgyal ston khrom bskor la gzigs mo gzigs/rgyal ston rten 'brel tshar rjes nyin zhig gi tho rengs chu tshod gsum pa bzhi par nga tsho gnyid skyid pa'i skabs der glo bur du kru( dbyang mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang khongs kyi sne len khru'u yi blo mthun kha shas phebs nas nga tsho mgyogs myur rub 'dzoms kyis ma'o kru'u zhi mjal bar 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig byed dgos pa'i brda tho gnang byung ba ma zad/ de lo'i dpyid dus nas pe cin du phebs 'byor zin pa'i bod las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa dang dmag khul khang gi si ling yon gcig lcogs krang go hwa dang / —bod las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa hphan ming / de bzhin kho bo bcas chu tshod gcig snga bsnur gyis chin kreng ten tshoms chen du 'gro dgos pa'i brda tho gnang byung / nga tsho gsum chin kreng ten tshoms chen du 'byor skabs krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u pu'u krang gzhon pa dang krung dbyang mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa gcig lcogs blo mthun li'u ke phing sngar nas sgo khar bsgugs nas bzhugs 'dug khong gis nga tsho tshoms chen nang du yod pa'i khang pa zhig gi mdun du khrid rjes sgo phye nas nga tsho nang du gtong ba gnang byung / sgo nang du gzugs stobs ha cang che 3/3

ba'i mi zhig 'dug pa de ni blo mthun ma'o tse tung yin zhing / khong gis nga tsho mi re re bzhin dang phyag gtong gnang mdzad rjes nga tshos sgrog tse gru bzhi nar mo zhig gi mtha' bskor nas bsdad pa yin/ da dung der bzhugs mkhan gyi gras su kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u ti dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi drung yig chen mo ba lin po chus/ de bzhin li'i wu'i han sogs blo mthun gzhan dag kyang yod pa gzhi nas mthong byung /ma'o kru'u zhi dang krung dbyang gi dbu khrid blo mthun gzhan rnams bcas kyis nga tsho dang nang mol gnang zhing / ma'o kru'u zhis skabs de'i bod kyi gnas tshul dang / dus bab/ las ka/ de bzhin mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i gnas tshul sogs bka' 'dri gnang bar nga tsho mi gsum gyis re re bzhin bka' lan zhus pa dang / bka' mol zhu skabs tshang mas lhug por gleng ba las 'tsher snang byed kyi mi 'dug ma'o kru'u zhis gtam gleng gnang skabs dgod bro ba'i bka' mol mang po gsung ba dang blo mthun kru'u te sogs kyis kyang bar du bka' mol yang yang gsungs song / de'i skabs ma'o kru'u zhi dgung lo lnga bcu lhag tsam la phebs yod rung dbu skra dkar po rkang gcig kyang med par sngar bzhin dbu nag la snum pa dang / bzhin ras dmar mdangs rgyas kyi 'dug pas sku gzugs ha cang thang po yod bzo 'dug la sku'i gzhon sha yang dod po 'dug khong gis hu'u nan gsung thog nas nga tsho dang ha lam chu tshod gcig tsam ring bka' mol gnang byung /mdzad gzigs tshogs pa mjal 'phrad du 'byor skabs nga tsho tshang ma chin khreng ten tshoms chen nang gral star bsgrigs te langs nas bsdad pa yin/ ma'o kru'u zhi dkyil du bzhings bzhugs pa de'i gzhogs gnyis su blo mthun 3/4

kru'u te dang lin po chus gnyis yod cing / g.yas ngos kyi gral star ni blo mthun li'i lu'i han dang li'u ke phing gnyis yin pa dang / g.yon ngos gral star nang krang go hwa dang / hphan ming / kho bo bcas yod/ mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i tshogs mi ngo ma sum cu lhag tsam yod pa rnams gral ltar gcig bsgrigs shing tshogs gtso rag shag dang ngag dbang sbyin pa'i sne khrid 'og min kreng ten tshoms chen nang phebs byung / khong tsho mi re'i phyag na mjal dar a she re bsnams nas re re bzhin ma'o kru'u zhir phul song / mjal dar phul rjes ma'o kru'u zhi dang mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i tshogs mi lhan du nub ngos kyi tshoms chen du phebs pa dang tshang mas tshoms chen dkyil du sgrog tse gru bzhi nar mo chen po zhig yod pa de'i mthar bskor nas bsdad/ ma'o kru'u zhis der gsung bshad gnang ba gtso bo mi rigs mthun sgril gyi skor gsungs shing /khong gis rgya bod mi rigs chen po gnyis kyi mthun sgril yag po yong ba byed dgos la bod rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril te tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs gnyis kyi mthun sgril yang yag po yong ba byed dgos zhes yang yang nan tan du gsungs pa dang / khong gis da dung bod bskyod dmag dpung dang las byed pa tshos mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi srid jus lag len yang dag pa bstar dgos pa las gal te rgyab 'gal byed mkhan 'dug na khyod tshos ming bton rjes nga tshos kho tsho gnas dbyung dang brje len byas chog ces gsungs song /tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs gnyis kyi 'thus mis kyang ma'o kru'u zhir gnad don mang po zhus song ba gtso bo ni krung dbyang nas bod la rogs ram skyabs 'jug gis sa gnas de'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i gnad don red/3/5

thengs de'i mjal 'phrad gnang bar ha lam chu tshod gcig tsam 'gor song /ma'o kru'u zhi dang kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u tes mjal 'phrad gnang rjes krung dbyang mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis 'gan 'khur blo mthun zhig mngags te mdzad gzi gas tshogs pa'i mi sna yongs la phebs rogs zhus nas rgyal yongs kyi grong khyer che khag tu blta bskor 'tshams 'dri gnang bar phebs/nga ni krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yis bskong 'tshogs byas pa'i bod kyi las don skor gyi tshogs 'dur zhugs dgos byung stabs blta bskor gyi phebs rogs su 'gro ma thub/spyi lo /954 lo'i dpyid kur bod kyi mdzad gzigs tshogs pas rgyal yongs sa gnas khag tu blta bskor byed pa'i 'char gzhi legs sgrub byung ste pe cin du log nas bod la phyir log byed rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ blo mthun li'i wu'i han gyis tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs so so'i dbu bzhugs 'bus mi khag bgos nas btsal te byams brtse'i bka' mol gnang ba ma zad/ gsol ston yang gzab rgyas bshams nas mdzad gzigs tshogs pa'i mi sna yongs la phebs skyel zhu gnang mdzad/ mdzad gzigs tshogs pa phyir log skabs sngar bzhin kho bos sne khrid zhus shing sngon la me 'khor nang bsdad de u han bar yong ba dang / de nas gru gzings la brten nas khrung ching la bskyod/ lho nub cus kyi hru'u ci dang / lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ lho nub dmag khul khang gi si ling yon gzhon pa bcas yin pa'i ho lung dang lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang lho nub mi rigs don byed u yon 3/6

lhan khang gi kru'u rin gcig lcogs wang wu'e kra'u sogs 'gan 'khur blo mthun tshos khrung ching du tshogs mi yongs la mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang dga' bsu zhu ba'i gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams pa ma zad/ tshogs mi yongs sa gnas de'i 1954 lo'i lnga gcig dus chen gyi rten 'brel byed sgo'i nang zhugs par gdan drangs/lnga gcig dus chen btang rjes nga tsho me 'khor du bsdad de khren tur yong ba dang / de nas rlangs 'khor nang bsdad de chab mdor slebs rjes rta bzhon nas lha sar phyir log byas pa yin/ paṇa chen phyogs kyi 'thus mi tsho ni lha sa nas bkra shis lhun por phyir log mdzad/nga'i dran gso'i rtsom yig 'di 'bri mtshams 'di gar 'jog rgyu yin/dran gso'i rtsom yig 'di gzigs rjes klog pa por phan 'bras gang zhig yong gi yod dam zhe na/ ‘ byams skyong bas blta dus byams skyong du mthong ba dang /blo gros can gyis blta dus blo gros su mthong ba'i dpe ltar mi mi 'dra bar bsam tshul mi 'dra ba yong gi red na rgya che'i klog pa po rang nyid kyis dbye 'byed gnang rgyu red/kho bo rang nyid kyi myong tshor gting zab shos ni 'di lta ste/ mi rigs kyi las don ni rang rgyal las don khag nang gi gal che'i las don zhig yin stabs de ni yod na 'grig la med na'ang 'grig pa zhig ma yin par de las ldog ste nges par du legs sgrub byed dgos pa las lhod g.yengs su song na mi 'grigarang rgyal gyi mi rigs las don yag po yong ched blo mthun ma'o tse tung dang /blo mthun kra'u en le/ blo mthun kru'u te/ blo mthun lin po chus/ blo mthun li'i wu'i han sogs tshud pa'i nga tsho'i tang gi dbu khrid blo mthun tshos mi rigs 317

kyi las don la mthong chen dang / mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod gnang skabs zab brling gang 'dra gnang mi 'dug gam/ paṇa chen bod du phyir phebs mdzad skabs srung skyel zhus pa'i gnas tshul dngos 'di rang nas mthong thub par zhib phra'i gnad don mang po thag gcod byas pa tshang ma'i thad blo mthun ma'o tse tung / blo mthun kra'u en le/ blo mthun li'i wu'i han sogs sku ngo mas 'dri rtogs gnang yod/ de ni nga tsho'i tang gi mi rigs las don gyi srol rgyun bzang po zhig yin zhing / nga tsho'i mi rigs las don byed mkhan gyi blo mthun zhig yin phyin rgya rigs blo mthun nam grangs nyung mi rigs kyi blo mthun gang yin la ma bltos par tshang mas srol rgyun bzang po de nges par du rgyun 'dzin byas te nga tsho'i stobs shugs dang spyang grung blo gros yongs rdzogs tshang ma tang gi mi rigs las don thog spyod dgos/ mig sngar rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis nus shugs yod rgu bton te deng rabs can bzhi 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin yod cing tang gi mi rigs las don ni deng rabs can bzhi'i grub cha zhig yin pas tang gi mi rigs las don legs sgrub byed pa ni rang rgyal gyi deng rabs can bzhi'i ched du tan tan tig tig gi byas rjes bzhag pa zhig rang yin/ 318

bod mi rigs la bcings 'grol 'thob thabs kyi 'gro lam/li wu'e han//95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis kyis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉(gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun )la ming rtags bkod cing / de nas bzung bod mi rigs btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dang 'ching thag 'og las dus gtan du grol te krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam dang / mnyam 'brel/mdza' grogs/ mnyam las bcas kyi khyim tshang chen po'i nang du mthun sgril dang / yar thon/ 'phel rgyas bcas 'od zer ldan pa'i lam chen thog skyod thub pa byung ba red/ da res nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang bod dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel ba'i lo rgyus thog gi dus rabs dbye ba'i bya ba der dran gso gzab rgyas shig zhu skabs ngas dga' spro dpag med skye ba'i bsam tshul 'chang bzhin par bod kyi mi dmangs dang rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshor spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu dang bod kyi mi dmangs tsho dang mnyam du bod gsar srung skyob dang 'dzugs skrun byed ched shi gson la ma bltos pa dang / dka' spyad 'bad 'thab/ rlabs chen gyi 3/9

legs skyes 'bul ba bcas byed mkhan mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang mi rigs khag gi las byed pa tshor spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ gsham du ngas gnad don gsum zhu rgyu yin/dang po/ 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉ni bod kyi lo rgyus dang bod dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel ba'ilo rgyus 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i ldog tu med pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin pa/rang rgyal ni mi rigs mang ba'i rgyal khab cig yin pa dang da lta mi rigs khag lnga bcu lhag tsam yod cing / khyon yongs nas bshad na mi rigs de dag snga sa nas krung go'i sa gzhi chen po'i thog sdod pa dang rim bzhin rlabs chen krung hwa mi rigs chags pa red/ de'i rmang gzhi'i thog kyag kyog gi lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim brgyud gong bu gcig gyur gyi mes rgyal zhig chags mthar rlabs chen krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dang kha 'bral du mi rung ba'i cha shas shig yin pa dang bod mi rigs ni lo rgyus yun ring dang 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas ldan pa'i rang rgyal gyi mi rigs kyi gras shig yin pa des mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'dra bar rlabs chen mes rgyal 'di gsar skrun dang 'phel rgyas gtong ring rang nyid kyi gzi brjid kyi las 'gan 'khur yod/spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun par bod kyi mi rigs kyi dpa' bo dang /rlabs chen gyi chab srid mkhas can/ dmag don mkhas can bcas yin pa'i srong btsan sgam pos bod gcig gyur bzos pa ma zad/ thang rgyal rabs dang 320

'brel ba dam zab kyang btsugs pa dang lhag par du srong btsan sgam po dang wun shing kong jo gnyis gnyen sgrig byas pa des bod rgya mi rigs gnyis dbar gyi 'brel ba dang bod kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas gong 'phel 'gro ba bcas tshang mar rgyang ring gting zab kyi shugs rkyen thebs shing / de nas bzung bod dang thang rgyal rabs dbar 4 tsha zhang du gyur pa dang dzikhyim tshang gcig ltar mi gyi mdza' gcugs kyi 'brel ba chags 'go tshugs pa red/ thang rgyal rabs rjes kyi lo ngo brgya phrag 'ga' zhig nang yon dang min rgyal rabs brgyud pa dang lhag par du ching rgyal rabs kyi skabs su slebs dus bod dang mes rgyal dbar gyi 'brel bar de bas shugs snon thebs pa dang bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi thad la'ang gong 'phel byung ba red/ 179/ lor ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis bod du dpung chen btang ste bod kyi mi dmangs dang dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis dmag 'thab byas nas bod srung skyob byas pa dang mes rgyal gyi gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong byas shing / ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis da dung bod sa gnas dbang 'dzin las khungs dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsa 'dzugs dang / chab srid/ nor srid/ dngul rtsa/ dmag don/ phyi 'brel/ chos lugs bcas phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi lam lugs 'dzugs rgyu'i gros thag bcad pa ma zad/bod du bca' sdod blon chen gyis ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma'i srid gzhung gi tshab zhus te bod kyi las don bsgrub rgyur lta skul yang byed kyi yod pa red/ de'i thog nas bod sa gnas dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur yong ba bya rgyu de mtho tshad gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa mtshon pa red/nye rabs su slebs skabs krung gor btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 321

'dzul byung ste phyed mi ser spel yul dang phyed bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gnas su gyar zhing / ching rgyal rabs dus mjug gi srid gzhung dang / pe dbyang dmag shed can gyi srid gzhung / go min tang srid gzhung bcas kyis phyi ru btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul la mgo bsgur ba dang nang du mi rigs la gnya' gnon byed kyi yod stabs btsan rgyal ring lugs la btsan 'dzul gyi 'dre lag de bod sa khul du skyong rgyu'i go skabs byung zhing / dbyin go btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis snga rting du 1888lo dang /904lor bod la drag po'i tshur rgol thengs gnyis byas par bod kyi dmag dmangs tshos dpa' ngar chen pos 'gog rgol byas shing bod kyi dmag dmangs tsho'i dpa' ngar che ba'i 'gog rgol dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis po de ching rgyal rabs gong ma'i srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis rul sungs nus med kyis rkyen pas pham rung dbying go btsan rgyal ring lugs la 'byung 'os pa'i bslab bya thob par brten kho pa tshos drag shugs kho nar brten nas bod 'dul thabs med pa shes pa red/ der brten kho pa tshos bod kyi mtho rim dbang sgyur mkhan gyi nang du btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan stobs shugs gso skyong byas pa ma zad/ bod mi rigs kyis cing rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung dang / pe dbyang dmag shed can gyi srid gzhung / go min tang gi srid gzhung bcas kyi mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi srid jus la 'khon 'dzin byed pa'i bsam tshul de bed spyad de dbyen sbyor dkrug shing rgyag pa dang kha bral du btang nas rang re'i bod khyur mid du gtong rgyu'i rmi lam skyid po de dngos su sgrub re'ang byed kyi yod pa red/btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul des bod dang mes rgyal dbar gyi 322

'brel bar nyen kha tshabs chen bzos stabs bod mi dmangs la sdug bsngal ha cang chen po byung ba red/dang po/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod sa gnas kyi dbang sgyur ru tshogs nang gi btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan la ngan skul byas te bod dang mes rgyal dbar gyi 'brel bar gtor bshig gtong gang thub byas nas 6 rang btsan dang 6 rbad de rang skyong 〉zer ba'i ming khyer te bod mes rgyal nas kha phral te btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mi ser spel yul dang yang na zhor gtogs shig tu bsgyur rgyu'i lkog g.yo 'chang ba dang lhag par du lcags phag lo'i gsar brje'i dus skabs dang krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug la rgyal yongs su rgyal kha 'thob nyer yod pa'i skabs der btsan nye mkhan de tshos mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed pa'i kha bral gyi spyod ngan spel shugs che shos su slebs pa red/gnyis pa/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs de rim bzhin byed mi ser spel yul zhig tu sgyur thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar bod ni de snga chos srid zung 'brel gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs shig yin zhing / mi 'bor gyi brgya cha lnga'ang zin med pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung dang / sku drag mtho rim grwa pa bcas mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis sa zhing yongs rdzogs dang phyugs rigs ches che ba bzung ba dang zhing bran dang bran g.yog tsho'i lus srog rgyu gsum bdag bzung byas yod cing / mi 'bor gyi brgya cha dgu bcu go lnga yan zin pa'i zhing bran dang bran g.yog tshor rtsa ba'i cha nas thon skyed rgyu cha med pa dang rang lus 323

la rang dbang gtan nas med stabs mnga' bdag gi sa bogs dang / khral 'ul/ skyed rtsi'i bu lon bcas kyi ya nga ba'i bshu gzhog myong dgos byung ba red/zhing bran bdag pos zhing bran rang snang gang shar gyis 'tshong ba dang / gta' mar 'jog pa/ lag btags su brtsis nas sprod pa/ brje res byed pa bcas byed chog cing / khong tshor rta lcag gzhu ba dang / mig 'bras 'don pa/ lag pa 'breg pa/ lha rtsa gcod pa/ pags pa bshu ba sogs mi rnams kyis thos pa tsam gyis hang sangs dgos pa'i nyes chad sdug po gcod kyi yod pa red/mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis rgya khyab mang tshogs kyi khrod du chos la dad shugs che ba de bed spyad nas dbang sgyur gyi lag cha zhig tu brtsi gi yod pa red/kho pa tshos phyogs gcig nas drag gnon byed pa dang phyogs gcig nas bsam blo'i dbang sgyur dang bsam blo sbrid thabs byas te bod kyi spyi tshogs de yun ring bar shin tu rjes lus thebs pa'i zhing bran lam lugs su 'phel med rang sor gnas su bcug par brten bod rigs kyi mi 'bor je zhung du 'gro gi yod cing /btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod la nang 'dzul byas rjes bod kyi zhing bran lam lugs la gtor bshig gtong rgyu lta bzhag lam lugs de srung skyong dang srung 'dzin byed gang thub byed pa ma zad/ rim bzhin mi ser spel yul du 'gyur gang thub kyang byed kyi yod pa red/ kho pa tshos bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi don du dpon rigs gso skyong byas pa dang / dmag dpung sbyong brdar dang rgya cher btang ba/ nyen rtog cus btsugs pa ma zad/ dbyin go btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi gsang myul gyis mda' dpon byas te bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi kha lo'ang sgyur gyi yod pa red/ kho pa tshos dpal 'byor thad kyang mnga' bdag chen po gsum la bod kyi bal phyir gtong sogs kyi phyi phyogs nyo tshong thad sger 324

sdom byed du bcug ste sa gnas srid gzhung dang / sku drag mtho rim grwa pa/tshong pa bcas bzhi po gong bu gcig tu 'gyur ba byed pa de ni don dngos thog rim bzhin phyir rten can du 'gyur ba byed pa zhig yin zhing / de dag thams cad kyis bod kyi mi dmangs tsho'i dmag gron dang dmag rgyags kyi khur po lci ru 'gro ba dang dpal 'byor thad bshu gzhog myong dgos byung ba red/gsum pa/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod kyi mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la gtor bshig gtong ba dang dang thog tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen er ti ni bar gyi mthun sgril la gtor bshig btang zhing / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol bya rgyu rgyun 'khyodas gnang ba dang mes rgyal la phyogs par brten btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan gyi gnya' gnon myong ba dang bod nas zhal gyes te mes rgyal nang khul du yun ring bar mi bzhugs ka med byung ba dang / tā la'i ru tshogs kyi nang khul gyi rgyal gces par yang gnod 'tshe phog yod/ 191/ lor lcags phag lo'i gsar brje byung rjes btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod sa gnas kyi dbang sgyur ru tshogs la ngan skul byas te bod du bca' sdod ching rgyal rabs kyi blon chen mthar skyod btang ba dang bod dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel bar gtor bshig btang ba dang chabs cig bod kyi chos lugs mi sna mtho rim dang sku drag nang gi rgyal gces par khrag dri bro ba'i dmar gsod btang ba dper na bstan rgyas gling gi ho thog thu dang / bka' blon tsha rong ba/ 'bras spungs dgon gyi mkhan chen yon tan sogs bkrongs pa red/ /933lor tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku gshegs rjes rwa sgreng ho thog thus rgyal tshab gnang ba red/rwa sgreng gis bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs kyi rgyal gces kyi re 'dod 325

mtshon par gnang nas 'bad brtson chen pos bod sa gnas dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon bskyon zhing / btsan rgyal ring lugs dang bod du btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan gyis rwa sgreng gi rgyal gces kyi spyod bzang la 'khon 'dzin ha cang chen po byed pa dang kho pa tshos dkrog gtam bzo ba dang / dma' 'bebs gtong ba/ nag med nyes 'gel bcas byas nas gnod 'tshe gtong ba sogs kyi tha shal gyi spyod ngan spel te sngon du 1941 lor btsan shed kyis rwa sgreng srid khri nas phab ste stag brag gis tshab byas pa dang de rjes 1947lor slar yang rwa sgreng 'dzin bzung byas te bkrongs pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i yab ni rwa sgreng dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa dang mes rgyal la blo kha phyogs stabs kho pa tshos dug ster nas bkrongs pa red/btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod sa gnas la btsan 'dzul byed pa der bod mi dmangs tshos 'gog rgol shugs chen bya rgyu nges can yin pa dang /bod mi dmangs tsho'i btsan rgol 'thab rtsod la rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tsho'i rogs skyor thob pa ni smos mi dgos pa ma zad/ krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid gnang ba'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshos btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol/ dpon ngan ma rtsa'i ring lugs la ngo rgol bcas byed pa'i dmangs gtso ring lugs gsar pa'i gsar brje dang gcig tu'ang 'dres rgyu nges can red/ der brten krung go'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje chen po dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug rgyal kha'i ngang 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang chabs cig bod kyi stobs shugs rigs gnyis bar dang las dbang gnyis bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyang je cher 'gro 326

ba ni ya mtshan rgyu spu tsam yang med pa zhig red/ phyogs gcig nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis btsan nye byed mkhan la ngan skul byas te 6 rang btsan dang dzigung rgol zer ba'i skyug bro ba'i spyod ngan sna tshogs spel ba ma zad/chab mdor bod dmag gi gtso shugs bkod sgrig byas te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpung skyod la 'gog rgol bya rgyu'i re ngan yang bcangs pa red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas krung go'i gsar brjer the wan dang bod phud pa'i rgyal kha thob pa dang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa dang 'brel krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis mi rigs gnya' gnon byed pa'i mnyam 'brel gyi srid jus khyab bsgrags byas pa dang lhag par du bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i byed phyogs gtan 'khel byas pa ma zad/ chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong ba dang zhi bas gros mol la skul ma gtong ba'i byed thabs lag len yang bstar rjes bod kyi mi rigs nang yun ring bar 'gog gnon phog pa'i rgyal gces ring lugs gong 'phel je cher 'gro thub pa byung ba red/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa er te nis kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang spyi khyab si ling kru'u ter glog 'phrin btang ste krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu ba dang bod de bcings 'grol snga tsam gtong rgyu'i re ba'ang zhus pa red/ bod rigs kyi grags can rgyal gces mi sna dge stag sprul sku bod du ngo phebs gnang ste bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ched gang sar 'brel gtug gnang skabs stabs mi legs par chab mdor dbyin go'i myul ma phu'u thes dug ster te bgrongs pa red/ bod rigs kyi skad grags yod pa'i mi sna dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho dang shar tshang gi sprul skus bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ched nus pa bton pa red/ rwa sgreng rgyal tshab skabs gyi gsol dpon ye 327

shes tshul khrims kyang zi ling du phebs nas rwa sgreng bkrongs pa'i nag nyes bgrangs pa dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la bod du dpung skyod bya rgyu'i re 'dun bton pa red/ bod nang khul du rgyal tshab stag brag gis gtsos pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nyer brten mkhan nyung shas shig gis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang ngan 'brel byed pa dang tā la'i bla ma gro mor bros rgyur rogs pa byas te khong phyi rgyal du 'khrid rgyu'i lkog g.yo bshams pa red/ kho pa tsho'i spyod ngan de rigs la bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs tshos ngo rgol byed kyi yod/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs kyi nang nas kyang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs kyis mtshon par gnang ba'i rgyal gces mi snas tā la'i phyi rgyal du bros rgyur ngo rgol byed pa dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang zhi ba'i gos mol bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ 'thab rtsod byas mthar /951 lo'i dpyid kur stag brag srid khri nas phab ste tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa sku ngo mas srid 'gan bzhes pa dang de ma thag tu bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs mi lnga dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mir bskos nas pe cin du gros mol byed par yong ba red/ 1951 lo'i zla ba 4pa'i zla smad du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi rnams pe cin du 'dzoms nas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi dang mdza' grogs kyi rmang gzhi'i thog gros mol byed 'go btsugs te bde blag ngang 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉bzhag pa red/〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉nang khyon bsdoms don tshan bcu bdun yod pa gtso che shos ste/ (gcig)btsan 328
