rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod nas mthar skyod btang ste bod de krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po dang gcig gyur yong ba byed pa dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung skyod byed par gzhogs 'degs hur thag byas nas rgyal mtshams sra brtan du gtong rgyu dang bod dmag rnams mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la rim bzhin bsgyur rgyu/ (gnyis)krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid 'og mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bya rgyu/ (gsum)bod kyi bcos bsgyur khag nges par du lag len bstar dgos shing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rang 'gul gyi sgo nas bcos bsgyur byed pa dang mi dmangs tshos bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'i re 'dun 'don skabs bod kyi 'go khrid mi sna dang gros mol byed pa'i thabs shes la brten nas thag gcod bya rgyu/ (bzhi)bod kyi mi rigs nang khul du mthun sgril gcig gyur yong ba byed par gtso bo tā la'i dang paṇa chen phyogs gnyis po'i bar gyi mthun sgril yong ba bya rgyu/ (lnga)chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len bstar rgyu dang bod mi dmangs kyi chos dad dang yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog bya rgyu/ (drug)bod kyi gnas tshul dngos la gzhigs nas rim bzhin bod kyi zhing las dang / 'brog las/ bzo las/ tshong las/rig gnas slob gso bcas gong 'phel gtong rgyu bcas red/nang don de dag gi thog nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun ni ha cang lugs dang mthun pa zhig yin zhing / des bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar bton pa'i dri bar lan yang dag pa brgyab yod pa dang de ni bod mi dmangs tsho'i khe phan dang bsam 'dun dang rbad de mthun pa zhig yin la rgyal 329

yongs mi dmangs tsho'i khe phan dang bsam 'dun dang rbad de mthun pa zhig kyang yin pa nga tshos gsal por mthong thub kyi red/kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉bzhag par rten 'brel zhu ba'i gsol ston thog dzilo ngo brgya phrag mang po'i ring krung go'i mi rigs khag bar la mthun sgril gtan nas med pa dang / lhag par du rgya'i mi rigs dang bod mi rigs bar la mthun sgril med pa/ bod mi rigs nang khul du'ang mthun sgril med pa de log spyod kyi ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung dang cang ce hri'i srid gzhung gnyis kyis dbang sgyur byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin la btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dbyed sbyor dkrug shing byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig kyang red/ da lta tā la'i bla mas 'go khrid gnang ba'i stobs shugs dang paṇa chen er ti nis 'go khrid gnang ba'i stobs shugs de gnyis dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bar tshang ma mthun sgril byung ba 'di ni krung go mi dmangs tshos btsan rgyal ring lugs dang rgyal nang gi log spyod dbang sgyur gtor pham btang rjes gzhi nas byung ba zhig red/ mthun sgril 'di spun zla lta bu'i mthun sgril zhig yin pa las gcig gis gcig la gnya' gnon byed pa zhig gtan nas min/ mthun sgril 'di ni phyogs thams cad nas 'thab rtsod byas pa'i 'bras bu zhig red/ slad phyir mthun sgril gyi rmang gzhi 'di'i thog nga tsho mi rigs khag bar du chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs gang ci'i thad gong 'phel dang yar rgyas yong bar nges 7zhes gsungs pa red/ kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gi bka' mol dum bu des bod rgya mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba'i lo rgyus 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar gnad la 'jigs pa'i phyogs sdom gnang ba dang / 〈 bod zhi bas bcings 330

bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la gdeng 'jog gang legs gnang stabs da cha klog skabs sngar bzhin byams brtse tshad med ldan pa tshor gyi 'dugaganyis pa/ 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉lag len bstar ba dang bod kyi gsar brje gong 'phel phyin pa'i bya rim/〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus gong 'phel 'gro ba'i dus skabs dbye ba'i kha phyogs 'gyur mtshams shig red/ 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉lag len bstar ba'i bya rim ni bod kyi mi rigs 'di nyid krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og dmangs gtso gsar pa'i ring lugs dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam brgyud mthun sgril dang /yar rgyas/ gong 'phel bcas 'gro ba'i rlabs che'i dpung skyod cig yin yang de ni shin tu rnyog 'dzing che ba dang kyag kyog ldan pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi bya rim zhig red/ de ni gung khran tang dang mi dmangs bcing 'grol dmag gis bod kyi mi dmangs dang rim bzhin zung 'brel byed pa dang bod rgya mi rigs gnyis bar rim bzhin 'gal zla bsal nas mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag pa'i bya rim zhig dang / bod kyi rgyal gces dmangs gtso'i stobs shugs rim bzhin 'phel rgyas dang stobs cher 'gro ba'i bya rim zhig btsan rgol rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gong 'phel btang nas mthun sgril byed thub pa'i rgyal gces stobs shugs mtha' dag la mthun sgril dang / bod mi rigs nang khul 331

gyi mthun sgril la skul ma gtong ba'i bya rim zhig bcas yin la srid dbang gnyis bar dang / lam lugs gnyis bar/ 'gro lam gnyis bar bcas 'gran bsdur shugs chen byed pa dang su rgyal su pham gyi bya rim zhig kyang red/〈 bod zhi bas bcings bgrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod rjes tā la'i bla mas kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung la glog 'phrin btang nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi dmangs tshos 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhu rgyu'i rtags mtshan bstan pa red/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab cang cun krang cing wu'u dang / cang cun krang go hwa/ than kon san bcas kyis sne khrid gnang ba'i krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag mgyogs myur lha sar 'byor zhing de ni gros mthun lag len bltar 'go tshugs pa zhig red/ 'on kyang lo rgyus dang da yod kyi rnyog 'dzing che ba'i cha rkyen 'og lam seng gros mthun yong rdzogs lag len bstar mi thub cing nges par du gzab brling brtan skyod skor gyi krung dbyang gi byed phyogs lag len mtha' gcig tu bstar nas ngang rgyud ring pos sgug pa dang / las ka zhib tshags byed pa/ ltag log dang kyag kyog gi gom stabs brgyud pa bcas byas nas mang tshogs la bag chags bzang po 'jog pa dang / dbang sgyur ru tshogs nang gi mi mang che ba blo 'gugs byed pa/ cha rkyen bskrun pa bcas byas te rim bzhin gros mthun mngon du 'gyur ba byas thog khrag 'don mi dgos pa'i sgo nas lo cho mang nang rim bzhin chab srid dang dpal 'byor la bcos bsgyur byed pa'i dmigs yul de 'grub thub pa byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ byed phyogs der gzhigs nas gtso bo gsham gsal gyi las ka byas pa ste/332

(gcig)krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du bskyod nas bca' sdod byas te mtha' khul srung skyob byed pa dang rgyal srung sra brtan du btang ba/ 1954lo dang 1956lor rang rgyal srid gzhung gis snga rting du zhi bde mnyam gnas kyi rtsa don lnga'i rmang gzhi'i thog nyin rdu srid gzhung dang ne pa la srid gzhung gnyis dang krung go'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / nyin rdu/ne pa la bcas bar tshong 'grul dang 'grim 'grul skor gyi chod don la ming rtags bkod de btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis de snga bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i rjes shul gtsang sel byas thog krung go'i bod sa gnas dang mdza' grogs khyim mtshes rgyal khab bar gyi zhi bde'i mdza' grogs kyi 'brel ba btsugs pa red/zhuganyis)mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang bod skyod las byed pa tshos dpe bzang gi sgo nas sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad lag len bstar ba dang / dpe bzang gi sgo nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus lag len bltar ba/ mang tshogs tsho'i chos lugs kyi dad mos dang yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog byed pa/ blo gcig sems gcig gis bod mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dmigs yul sgrub pa/ bshu gzhog gral rim su 'dra zhig dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur gsar pa'i thog nas bod mi dmangs la lta stangs 'dzin pa bcas byas shing / gal te de dang rgyab 'gal byung tshe mgyogs myur zhib bsher dang yo bsrang byed pa (dper na 'bru rigs sogs kyi dngos rdzas nyo sgrub dang skyel 'dren byed ring mang tshogs tshor gyong gun nges can zhig phog yod pa shes 'phral skyin tshab sprad pa)dang dus mtshungs cha rkyen la dpags te gzhung lam 333

bzo ba dang / sman rin ma dgos par sman bcos byed pa/ skyed med zhing 'brog dngul bun btang ste zhing 'brog thon skyed la rogs skyor byed pa/ brin po med pa'i bal la rin gong mtho po sprad nas nyo ba/ rin gong 'bring tsam la brten nas ja mkho 'don byed pa/ spyi tshogs kyi skyob gso sprod pa/ gzhung gi 'gro gron btang nas slob grwa chung ba gnyer ba sogs byas yod/ 1954lor khron bod dang mtsho bod gzhung lam thog rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub pa dang /1957lor shin cang nas mnga' ris bar gyi gzhung lam thog rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub cing / da bar bod du khron bod dang / mtsho bod/ shin bod/nag chu nas mnga' ris bar/ lha sa nas gro mo bar/ lha sa nas rtsed thang bar bcas gzhung lam drug yod pa dang / 1956lor bod dang pe cin bar gyi mkha' lam thog tu'ang gnam gru shar gtong thub pa sogs gong gsal de dag tshang ma ni bod du sngar byung myong med pa'i bya ba bzang po chen po zhig red/(gsum)las byed pa gso skyong byed pa/ bod du zhing bran lam lugs dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi srid dbang sgor 'dzin sngar bzhin gnas pa'i gnas tshul 'og las byed pa gso skyong bya rgyur tshod 'dzin ha cang chen po phog gi yod/ yin na'ang zhing bran nang gi sngon thon pa mi nyung ba zhig dang rgyal gces gzhon nu gzhan dag gis 'gog rkyen gtor te las ka dang slob sbyong nang zhugs pa red/ /957lor pha yul bod nas yin pa'i las byed pa dang slob gnyer ba lnga stong lhag tsam yod pa dang / 1957lo'i ston khar bod kyi las byed pa ched mngags gso skyong byed ched btsugs pa'i bod ljongs spyi'i slob grwa dang bod ljongs sde tshogs slob grwa hra'an shis kyi zhan dbyang du slob 'go tshugs pa red/ 1957lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis par rgyal rtse sa khul 334

du zhing bran bdag pos kho pa tshor dus thog khral rgyugs med pa'i bod rigs slob gnyer bar nyes rdung drag po btang ba'i don rkyen thon rjes bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gis rgyal khab kyi las khungs la zhugs pa'i las don mi sna dang slob gnyer bas mi khral rgyugs mi dgos pa'i skor gyi gros chod la gros 'cham byas te las byed pa gso skyong bya rgyur phan yod kyi cha rkyen mkho 'don byas pa red/ 1959lor ngo log zing 'khrug snying 'jags dang bcos bsgyur byas rjes yar langs zhing bran dang bran g.yog gi hur brtson can gyi nang nas bod rigs las byed pa de bas 'bor chen zhig thon pa dang 'tshar longs byung ba red/(bzhi)btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gong 'phel gtong ba/ bod du cha bzhag na mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna 'gug thabs dang mthun sgril bya rgyur gal ha cang chen po yod pa red/skabs de'i cha rkyen 'og dang thog mtho rim pa 'gug thabs dang mthun sgril byas na gzhi nas 'bring rim la mthun sgril dang mang tshogs la shugs rkyen bzang po bzo rgyur phan thogs yod cing / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur de'i chab srid kyi rmang gzhi ni btsan rgol rgyal gces bya rgyu de yin pa dang / btsan rgol rgyal gces byed mkhan yar thon mi sna yod tshad la rogs skyor bya rgyu smos ci dgos/ blo gnyis the tshom byed mkhan mi snar yang 'gug thabs gang thub byed pa dang / de snga btsan rgyal ring lugs la nye po byed mkhan gyis gal te btsan rgyal ring lugs dang 'brel ba bcad pa dang gtor bshig dang 'gog rgol gyi spyod ngan ma spel tshe tshang mar mthun sgril byas nas sngar byas la rtsad gcod byed kyi med pa red/ mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna 'gug thabs 335

dang mthun sgril bya rgyu'i dmigs yul sgrub ched phyogs gcig nas khong tshor 'os 'tshams kyi chab srid kyi go gnas sprad de khong cho'i lugs mthun gyi dpal 'byor khe phan srung skyob byas pa dang 'brel 'byung 'gyur chab srid dang dpal 'byor thad bcos bsgyur byas rjes spyir btang byas na khong tsho'i chab srid kyi go gnas dang 'tsho ba'i chu tshad dma' ru mi gtong rgyu'i 'gan len yang byas pa red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas khong tshor 'bad brtson chen pos chab srid kyi slob gso btang ba dper na khong tsho sgrig 'dzugs byas te mes rgyal nang khul du lta skor dang 'tshams 'dri byed du bcug pa dang khong tsho sgrig 'dzugs byas te skabs don dang chab srid kyi slob sbyong byed du bcug thog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi rtsa 'dzugs kyi byed sgo sna tshogs nang zhugs su bcug pa red/bod kyi btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gong 'phel gtong ring tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen er ti ni'i bar gyi mthun sgril la skul 'ded gtong rgyur gal che'i rang bzhin ldan yod cing / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i gros mthun gyi dgongs don ltar paṇa chen er ti ṇi'i sngar yod kyi go gnas dang 'gan dbang bskyar gso byung ba dang dus mtshungs tā la'i dang paṇa chen bar gyi sngar yod kyi go gnas dang de bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi go gnas dang 'gan dbang la'ang bci 'jog gang legs thob pa red/ bod kyi srid 'dzin las don skor tshang ma bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sgrub rgyu'i 'gan khur ba dang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i gros mthun lag len bstar rgyu'i gal che'i don chen skor khong tsho dang gros mol byas khar las don mang po zhig gi thad la da dung ngang rgyud ring pos blo 'gug byas pa ma zad/ tha na dgos nges kyi bzod sgom yang byas pa red/336

gung khran tang dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod kyi mtho rim la byams brtse mthar son byas kyang bod kyi log spyod shog khas da dung 'phung dkrug slong ba dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis kyang kho pa tshor bod du pham nyes byung bar sdug nad theg gi med pa red/1952lo'i zla ba 3pa dang 4par log spyod kyi phami dmangs 'thus tshogs zer ba'i don rkyen byung ba red/ kho pa tshos bod dmag dang / grwa pa/'khyam po sogs khag gcig ngan skul dang sgrig 'dzugs byas te lha sar re zhu byas pa dang drag po'i zing cha bslangs nas krung dbyang sku tshab kyi sdod yul dang bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi sdod khang gi mtha' bskor te zhi bzhi gros mthun la ngo rgol byas khar mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du slebs nas yun ring ma song ba dang rkang pa brtan po 'dzugs long byung med pa'i go skabs dang bstun te rang dmag bod nas 'bud rtsis byas pa red/yin na'ang kho pa tshos byed rgyu thal drags nas rgyu mtshan gtan nas med pa chags stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang log spyod kyi 4mi dmangs 'thus tshogs zer ba de khrims dang 'gal ba zhig yin pa khas len mi byed ka med dang / rgyu mtshan yod pa dang / phan thogs yod pa/ mtshams tshigs yod pa bcas kyi 'thab rtsod byas pa brgyud tā la'i bla mas rtsa tshig bton nas log spyod kyi shāmi dmangs 'thus tshogs zer ba med pa bzo rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas pa ma zad/ lkog tu log spyod kyi 4mi dmangs 'thus tshogs zer bar ngan skul dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan srid tshab gnyis kyi 'gan dbang yang med pa bzos pa red/1956lo'i zla 4par bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dpal 337

dang gzi brjid ldan pa'i sgo nas btsugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa de ni bod du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong byed pa'i gal che'i gom stabs shig dang bod kyi phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi mi snas gros sdur dang gros mol yang yang byas nas gcig gyur byung rjes rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis chog mchan gnang ba zhig red/'on kyang gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs pa'i snga rjes su log spyod kyi /mi dmangs 'thus tshogs zer ba'i nang gzhug mkhan rnams kyis spyod ngan spel rgyu slar yang bskyar gso byas te gang sa gang du re 'bod zhu yig 'bul ba dang re 'dun zhus te rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyur ngo rgol dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya rgyur ngo rgol byas shing / 1956lo'izla 11 par nyin rdu srid gzhung gi gdan zhus ltar tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen er ti ni hin rdur ston pa shākya mu ne mya ngan las 'das nas lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba'i byed sgo'i nang zhugs pa red/ bod kyi log spyod pa nyung shas shig gis skabs de dang bstun te 'phung dkrug slong gi yod cing /kho pa tshos phyogs gcig nas lha sa sogs sa gnas su zing 'khrug slong rgyu'i lkog g.yo bshams pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas nyin rdur tā la'i bla ma'i mtha' bskor ba dang dbyen sbyor dkrug shing brgyab ste tā la'i nyin thur sdod du bcug thog 6 bod rang btsan zer ba'i spyod ngan spel ba de ni don dam du tā la'i mes rgyal dang bod kyi mi dmangs la rgyab gtod byed pa'i thar sa med pa'i 'gro lam du skyod rgyur 'bud 'ded btang ba zhig red/ de skor bod sdod mi dmangs bcing 'grol dmag gis de dang mtshungs pa'i dgos nges kyi gra sgrig byed pa dang sbrags bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'go khrid pa dang las rigs khag gi mi sna dang mnyam du log spyod par chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod byed pa dang 338

chabs cig tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis gal che'i thabs jus gtan 'bebs gnang ste lo lnga tshan 'char gzhi gnyis pa'i dus skabs te lo drug gi nang du bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur mi byed pa dang lo lnga tshan 'char gzhi gsum pa'i dus skabs su bcos bsgyur dgos min de'ang skabs de'i gnas tshul la bltas te gzhi nas gtan 'khel bya rgyu dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang mtho rim mi snar bsam gzhigs gang legs byed pa'i dus tshod yong ba byas te nga tshos bod kyi mtho rim mi snar chab srid dang 'tsho ba'i thad rim bzhin bkod sgrig yag po byed bde yong ba byed dgos la cha rkyen 'dzoms skabs zhi ba dang brtan po'i sgo nas bcos bsgyur byed bde yong ba byed dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags gsal po gnang zhing tsung li kra'u en la'e yis nyin rdur 'tshams 'dri gnang ba'i bya rim nang tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen er ti ni dang de bzhin khong gnyis kyi sku 'khor dpon rigs bcas la tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i gal che'i thabs jus gtan 'bebs de brgyud bsgrags gnang ba dang 'brel lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas khong tsho so sor ngang rgyud ring ba dang zhib tshags kyi las don gnang zhing / paṇa chen er ti nis blo thag chod po'i sgo nas bod du phyir log gnang ba dang de rjes tā la'i bla ma'ang bod du phyir log gnang ba red/'on kyang bod kyi log spyod pas de dag gis rkyen pas bshan gri mar bzhag med/ de rjes kho pa tshos chab mdo dang / steng chen/ nag chu/ lho kha sogs sa gnas su drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs nas 'khrug rkyen slong ba dang tha na lho kha sa khul du mngon sum 'dzems med kyis pharten gzhi btsugs shing / 1959lo'i zla gsum par bod du sgo kun nas drag po'i zing 'khrug 339

bslangs mthar bod kyi log spyod pa rtsa med du song ba dang bod kyi zhing bran lam lugs rbad de dur sar sbas pa red/1951 lor 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod nas 1959lor zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa'i lo brgyad brgyud pa de ni krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid gnang ba'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang bod skyod las byed pas blo gcig sems gcig gi sgo nas bod kyi mi dmangs la phan bde bskrun pa dang bod kyi zhing bran bdag po'i gtum drag gi dbang sgyur dang gdug rtsub che ba'i bshu gzhog phan tshun bsdur ba'i lo brgyad dang 'od zer ldan pa'i 'gro lam dang mun nag gi 'gro lam bar phan tshun bsdur ba'i lo brgyad red/ lo brgyad po de'i nang bod kyi mi dmangs tsho'i chab srid kyi go rtogs mtho ru 'gro tshad de sngar gyi lo bcu phrag kha shas dang tha na lo brgyad bsdur ba dang lo brgyad la lta zhib byas mthar khong tshos gung khran tang gis 'go khrid gnang ba'i bcings 'grol dmag dang bod skyod las byed pa ni yorgya mi gsar pa dang 6 lha dmag :yin pa dang rang nyid kyi gnyen bshes yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs ni mun nag dang gdug rtsub cig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas stabs bod kyi log spyod pas sgo kun nas zing 'khrug slong skabs krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'i bka' rgya gnang ma thag gsar brje chen po zhig spang ljongs sreg pa'i me chen ltar bod sa mthor myur du mched nas bod kyi zhing bran lam lugs de theg med du btang ba red/'dzam gling gi rtse mo'i zhing bran khri tsho brgyar mthar yar langs bcings 'grol 340

thob pa de ni bod rigs mi dmangs tsho'i gsar brje chen po dang bod mi dmangs rang nyid kyis rang la bcings 'grol gtong ba'i gsar brje zhig yin pas de ni krung go'i lo rgyus thog rlabs chen kyi dus 'gyur zhig yin pa smos med red/ gang lags she na des 'dzam gling gi lo rgyus thog tu'ang 'dzin 'os pa'i go gnas bzung bas red/zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi srid dbang sgor 'dzin gtor ba dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs med par bzos stabs rgya che'i zhing bran dang bran g.yog rnams la sngar byung ma myong ba'i rang lus rang dbang dang dmangs gtso'i khe dbang thengs dang po byung ba dang rang nyid la sa zhing dang / so nam yo byad/ phyugs rigs sogs byung ba red/ bod kyi mtho rim gyi nang nas zing 'khrug nang zhugs dang ma zhugs kyi dbye ba phye nas spyod tshul mi 'dra ba 'dzin zhing / zing 'khrug nang ma zhugs pa'i mtho rim la blu nyo'i srid jus lag len bstar ba dang / 'brog khul du zing 'khrug nang ma zhugs pa'i 'brog bdag la 'thab rtsod mi byed pa dang /rgyu nor mi bgo ba/ gral rim mi dbye ba/ 'brog bdag dang 'brog g.yog gnyis phan gyi srid jus bcas lag len bstar gyi yod pa red/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas rjes /961 lo'i zla 4par krung dbyang gis bod du brtan gnas yar rgyas kyi byed phyogs gtan 'bebs gnang nas lo lnga'i ring zhing las dang 'brog las kyi mnyam las khang mi 'dzugs pa (rogs res tshogs chung kho na 'dzugs rgyu)dang yar langs zhing bran rnams la ngal gso dang 'tsho gnas yong ba dang thon skyed gong 'phel gtong du bcug 341

cing / srid jus de ni rang nyid la sa zhing dang phyugs rigs yod pa'i yar langs zhing bran gyi bsam 'dun dang rbad de mthun pa zhig yin pas khong tsho'i thon skyed kyi hur brtson rang bzhin skul slong gang legs byung ba red/ de rjes kyi lo shas ring bod kyi zhing las dang / 'brog las/ lag shes bzo las bcas gong 'phel myur tsam byung zhing / bcos bsgyur ma byas gong gi 1958lo dang bsdur na /965lor 'bru rigs brgya cha brgyad cu gya brgyad dang grangs chung drug 'phar ba dang phyugs rigs brgya cha lnga bcu nga bzhi dang grangs chung gcig 'phar ba red/ zhing pa dang 'brog pa tsho'i 'tsho bar legs bcos mngon gsal dod po byung ba dang mi 'bor mngon gsal dod po 'phar yod pas bod kyi mang tshogs kyis dus skabs de ni 6 gser gyi dus skabs zhig red ces shod kyi yod pa red/ de ni dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa dang tang gi brtan gnas yar rgyas kyi byed phyogs lag len bstar ba las byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig yin la 〈bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉lag len bstar ba las byung ba'i g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bu zhig kyang red/ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba dang bcos bsgyur byed ring gsar brje mgyogs myur ngang gong 'phel phyin pa dang chabs cig phagayon gyi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul 'ga' zhig kyang byung yod/ 196/ lor brtan po'i ngang gong 'phel gtong dgos pa'i skor gyi krung dbyang gi byed phyogs de rtsa ba'i dgongs don ni dpal 'byor gyi srid jus dang / nor tshong gi srid jus/ spyi tshogs bcos sgyur byed pa'i srid jus/ mi rigs srid jus/ mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril dang bsgyur bkod byed pa'i srid jus sogs tshud pa'i bod du 342

'dzin pa'i srid jus yod tshad tshang ma slogayon ladang 'tshab 'tshub sngon 'gog byed rgyu de red/ 1962lor krung dbyang gis slar yang 〈rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi mnyam las mnyam sgrub kyi 'brel ba legs bcos byed rgyur shugs snon rgyag dgos pa〉dang / 〈las byed pa gso skyong dang slob gso gtong dgos pa〉 〈mu mthud nas chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len mthar phyin bstar dgos pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhig〉 〈mu mthud nas gsar brjer ngo rgol pa dang ngo log zing 'khrug pa thag gcod byed pa'i gtan 'bebs lag len mthar phyin bstar dgos pa'i bsam 'char〉sogs yig cha bzhir chog mchan bkod nas spel ba dang de tsho'i thad mu mthud dzigayon 7gyi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul yo bsrang byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ blo pham pa zhig la /962lo'i lo smad du'ang chagayon lhung gi bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun gyi deb gzhu phog nas yig cha bzhi po de lag len bstar thub med pa dang de snga gnas pa'i slogayon migyi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul sel ma thub pa'i khar skyon dang nor 'khrul gsar pa byung ba red/lo bcu'i god chag tshabs chen byung ba'i nang lin pe'o dang 6 mi bzhi shog khag 7gi gtor bshig gis rkyen pas dzigayon gyi nor 'khrul de mthar son zhig tu slebs shing de'i gtso bo'i mtshon tshul dper na/(gcig)ma nyes kha g.yogs dang / rdzun ma/ nor 'khrul bcas kyi gyod gzhi 'bor chen zhig bzos te las byed pa dang mang tshogs 'bor chen zhig la gnod 'tshe phog pa dang thag zhor 'breng drud byung ba dang /(gnyis)mi dmangs kung hre can du 'gyur ba dang ta kramar slob stong byed pa'i las 'gul dang bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la ma bltos par re ba 343

phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa de red/ de ni tang krung dbyang gi gal che'i 'thab jus kyi gtan 'bebs shig yin la krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don mtshon pa zhig yin pa dang lo bcu'i god chag tshabs chen byung rjes kyi bod kyi las don dang mi rigs kyi las don gyi rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog cig kyang red/ rgyal khab btsugs rjes nga tsho'i tang gis bod kyi las don dang mi rigs kyi las don thad mar khe si ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i rig pa dang krung go'i rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul dang mthun la spyad na nus pa thon pa'i srid jus cha tshang zhig lag len bstar te krung gor 'tshams pa'i mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i lam zhig gtod pa red/ 'on kyang de rjes dzigayon lhung gis bsam blo'i 'gog rkyen byung ba dang rtsis med du gtong ba'i gnod skyon phog pa dang lhag par du lin pe'o dang 4mi bzhi shog khag gi gtor bshig tshabs chen phog pa red/ da lta tang krung dbyang gis zang zing yo bsrang byas nas rang re'i tang gi spyad na nus pa thon pa'i de snga'i srid jus slar gso byas pa dang 'brel de 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang gong 'phel yang btang ba red/ lo gcig ring bod du krung dbyang gis bod kyi las don thad gnang ba'i mdzub ston lag len mthar phyin bstar nas las ka 'bor chen byas par grub 'bras ha cang chen po thob yod/ ma nyes kha g.yogs dang / rdzun ma/ nor 'khrul bcas kyi gyod gzhi 'bor chen zhig rtsa ba'i cha nas dag sel byung ba dang / tang gi srid jus khag rim bzhin don 'khyol byung ba/ mi rigs kyi 'brel ba ha cang legs su phyin pa/ zhing las dang / 'brog las/ lag shes bzo las bcas kyi thon skyed gong 'phel phyin pa/ 'bru rigs kyi thon tshad de rgya ma dung phyur dgu dang 346

khri tsho lnga stong lon pa/ lag yod phyugs rigs kyi mgo grangs khri tsho nyis stong sum brgya lhag tsam zin pa/ mnyam sdeb kyi zhor las dang hre yon khyim tshang gi zhor las 'phel rgyas ha cang chen po byung ba/ zhing 'brog mang tshogs tsho'i 'tsho bar legs bcos che tsam byung nas khong tsho'i lag tu 'bru rigs dang / snum/sha/ dngul bcas mang po yod pa bcas la brten rgya che'i bod rigs las byed pa dang mang tshogs tshos krung dbyang gi mdzub ston ni 6 dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byed pa'i gser gyi lde mig dang / 6 tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi nyi 'od de ༵ dā /skyar nga tsho'i mgo thog tu 'phros song zhes dga' spro'i ngang shod kyi yod gsum pa/ 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉gyi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don khag la lo rgyus kyi zhib bsher theg thub pa byung /lag len ni bden don la zhib bsher byed pa'i tshad gzhi 'ba' zhig red/lo sum cu'i ring bod kyi lag len nang tshad bsdur ha cang gsal po gnyis brgyud yod pa ste gcig ni gung khran tang dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag mi dmangs srid gzhung bcas kyis bod kyi rgyal gces dang gsar brje'i stobs shugs dang rim bzhin zung 'brel byas nas lhag bsam zol med ngang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi rtsa don khag lag len bstar ba de dang bod kyi log spyod phyogs khag gis thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas gros mthun la gtor bshig gtong ba gnyis phan tshun tshad bsdur byas pa 347

dang / cig shos ni bod du 'dzin pa'i tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus khag dang rjes su thon pa'i g.yon lhung gi srid jus gnyis phan tshun tshad bsdur byas pa de red/ drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs gnyis kyi tshad bsdur de ni zhib bsher khag gnyis yin zhing / de'i 'bras bu'i thog nas 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bgrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉gyi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don khag ni yang dag pa'i sgo nas bod kyi mi rigs bcings 'grol thob pa dang dar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba'i phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid mtshon thub pa zhig yin pa ra sprod byung yod/gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don de tsho 'di lta ste/(gcig)bod kyi mi rigs dang mes rgyal mi rigs dbar gyi khyim tshang chen po'i mthun sgril dang gcig gyur yong ba bya rgyu de ni nga tsho'i bya gzhag la rgyal kha 'thob nges yin pa dang bod kyi mi rigs mthun sgril dang / yar rgyas/ dar rgyas gong 'phel bcas yong ba'i rtsa ba'i 'gan len zhig red/ gros mthun gyi don tshan dang po'i nang du 6 bod kyi mi dmangs rnams mthun sgril byas te phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi btsan shugs bod nas mthar skyod gtong dgos pa dang bod kyi mi dmangs krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mes po'i khyim tshang chen po'i nang du log dgos zhes gtan 'bebs byas yod/ de ni ches rtsa ba'i rtsa don zhig red/ lo sum cu'i ring gi lo rgyus kyi thog nas bod kyi mi rigs la mthun sgril dang / yar rgyas/ gong 'phel bcas yong ba byed dgos na rtsa ba'i rtsa don de dang kha 'bral thabs gtan nas med pa zhig yin pa ra sprod byung yod/ 'on kyang bod kyi log spyod phyogs khag gis gros mthun la gtor bshig gtong ba'i ches rtsa ba ni bod dang mes rgyal dbar gyi gcig gyur la gtor bshig btang nas 6 bod rang btsan zer ba'i zing cha slong ba de yin 348

zhing / kho pa tsho'i 'gro lam de don dngos thog bod ljongs 'di btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mi ser spel yul dang zhor gtogs la 'gyur rgyu kho na red/ de ni lo sum cu'i ring gi lo rgyus kyi thog nas ra sprod byung yod la nye lam lo brgya lhag tsam ring gi lo rgyus kyi thog nas kyang ra sprod byung yod pa zhig yin pas kho pa tsho skyod yul ni mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed pa dang bod kyi mi rigs la rgyab gtod byed pa dang bod kyi mi rigs kha bral gtong ba'i 'gro lam zhig rang red/'gro lam der sngon chad skyod thub med la slad phyin ji srid bar yang skyod mi thub pa zhig red/(gnyis/) dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa dang de rjes rim bzhin spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsgyur bkod dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang thon skyed nus shugs la bcings 'grol gtong ba dang gong 'phel btang ba brgyud mi rigs dar rgyas yong ba byed pa dang lo rgyus thog shul bzhag byas pa'i mi rigs dbar don dngos thog gi 'dra mnyam med pa rim bzhin sel thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i zhing bran lam lugs de ni bod kyi mi rigs rnams dbul phongs rjes lus dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi gnya' gnon myong ba'i spyi'i 'byung rtsa zhig yin zhing / der brten bod du ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i gnad don ni gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas med pa bzos rjes rim bzhin spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsgyur bkod mngon du 'gyur ba byed dgos pa dang 'gro lam der bskyod na bod kyi mi rigs rnams gzhi nas rjes lus 'phel med kyi gnas nas thar te rim bzhin dar rgyas gong 349

'brel ngo log zing 'khrug nang ma zhugs pa'i mtho rim yod tshad la mu mthud blu nyo'i srid jus rgyun 'khyongs byas shing ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba dang bcos bsgyur byed pa'i dza drag che ba'i 'thab rtsod dang yam yom brgyud krung dbyang gis brtan po'i ngang gong 'phel gtong ba'i byed phyogs spyad de ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi kher rkyang dpal 'byor de dus skabs shig ring brtan po yong ba byas nas rang dbang dang thon skyed kyi rgyu chas thob pa'i yar langs zhing bran tsho'i thon skyed kyi spro sems skul slong gang legs byas te ha cang rjes lus yin pa'i bod kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel yong ba byas pa dang de snga ha cang dbul zhing phongs pa'i yar langs zhing bran tsho'i 'tsho bar legs bcos yong ba byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas pa de ni spyi tshogs ring lugs bsgyur bkod byed rgyur cha rkyen gsar skrun byas pa zhig red/ de tsho tshang ma ni rbad de yang dag pa zhig yin zhing / de rjes bod kyi cha rkyen la ma bltos par mes rgyal nang khul gyi / g.yon migyi byed thabs cha tshang ba zhig bod ljongs su zhwa dpe lham 'gebs byas pa des thon skyed nus shugs la gtor bshig btang ba dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin 'don spel byed rgyur 'gog rkyen bzos pa red/zhugasum/)krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gcig gyur 'go khrid 'og mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag len bstar ba de ni gros mthun gyi gal che'i rtsa don zhig yin la nga tsho'i tang gis krung go'i mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i rtsa ba'i srid jus shig kyang red/ mi rigs mang zhing rgya rigs mi 'bor gyis mang che ba zin pa'i nga tsho'i rgyal khab 'di lta bu zhig la nges par du grangs nyung mi rigs la mi rigs kyi sa khongs rang skyong dngos 'brel lag 35/

len gang legs bstar du bcug na gzhi nas mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi dbang cha sra brtan yong ba dang mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon thebs rgyur 'gan len gang legs byed thub/ bod ljongs sa gnas de lo rgyus thog cung dmigs bsal gyi go gnas ldan yod pa dang spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor cha rkyen dang sa khams kyi cha rkyen yang de bas dmigs bsal rang bzhin chen po yod pas krung dbyang gi gcig gyur 'go khrid 'og mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag len bstar ba dang rang skyong gi dbang cha gang legs longs su spyod rgyur de bas dgos mkho yod pa red/mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong zhes pa'i ches rtsa ba'i don snying gi ngos nas bshad na rang skyong lag len bstar mkhan grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa dang mi dmangs tshos mi rigs de rang gi rang skyong sa gnas kyi las don la rang khyim rang bdag byed dgos pa dang tang gi 'go khrid 'og rang nyid kyi rkang par brten nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam du skyod dgos pa de red/der brten grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong dang / gdam gses/gnas spar bcas byas nas rim bzhin las byed pa mi rigs can du 'gyur ba bya rgyur gal shin tu che ba'i rang bzhin ldan yod mod/ 'on kyang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong dang / 'tshar longs/ byang chub pa bcas yong ba byed par bya rim ha cang ring po zhig dgos pa dang lhag par du bod ljongs su de snga skye khungs zhing bran bdag po yin pa'i ser skya dpon rigs ma gtogs deng rabs kyi don snying ldan pa'i las byed pa rtsa ba nas med cing /bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang rjes nga tsho'i tang gis bod rigs las byed pa gso skyong byed 'go btsugs kyang skabs der rgya che'i zhing bran rnams da dung 352

ma mtha'i rang lus la rang dbang med pa'i gnya' gnon myong ba'i gnas su gyar yod pas ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang bcos bsgyur btang rjes gzhi nas khong tsho'i khrod nas las byed pa 'bor chen zhig 'tshar longs byung yod/ der brten bod ljongs su bod rigs las byed pa 'tshar longs yong ba byed pa dang chabs cig rim bzhin de bas mang ba'i bod rigs las byed pa tshor 'gan 'khri'i las 'gan 'khur du bcug na tang gi 'go khrid 'og rang a rang bdag yong thub pa dang 'brel de ltar byed thub nges kyang red/ blo pham pa zhig ni lo bcu'i god chag tshabs chen byung ba'i rkyen gyis bod kyi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong dang las byed pa mi rigs can du 'gyur ba'i 'phel rim der bar chad phog pa red/ na ning bod kyi las don thad gnang ba'i krung dbyang gi mdzub ston spel ba nas bzung bod kyi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong de rim bzhin 'thus tshang dang gong 'phel 'gro ba dang mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong dang gdam gses byed pa'i las kur shugs snon chen po thebs yod/ deng sang bod rigs las byed pa 'bor chen zhig gis bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rim pa khag gi tang srid las khungs nang 'go khrid kyi las 'gan 'khur gyi yod pa ma zad/ lo kha shas kyi nang bod rigs las byed pas thon skyed dang kha bral ba'i las byed pa'i khrod du gsum cha gnyis yan zin thub pa'i brtson len byed dgos/ nga tshos shod pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong dang las byed pa mi rigs can du 'gyur ba zhes pa ni rgya rigs las byed pa tsho'i rogs ram mi dgos pa zhig min pa smos ci dgos/ rgya rigs kyi lhag bsam rnam dag gi rogs ram med na bod kyi mi rigs kyi dar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro rgyu de ni dka' ngal yod pa zhig red/ de las ldog ste bshad na bod kyi dar 353

rgyas gong 'phel de ni rgyal khab dang / rgya rigs/ mi rigs gzhan dag bcas la rogs ram ha cang chen po byed pa zhig red/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi phan tshun gyi rogs ram de rigs ni rang rgyal gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mi rigs 'brel ba'i nang gi gal che'i khyad chos kyi gras shig yin/(bzhi)chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len bstar ba dang bod kyi mi dmangs tsho'i chos dad dang yul goms gshis lugs la bci 'jog byed dgos/bod ljongs su nang pa'i chos ni mang tshogs kyi khrod du dad pa gting zab yod pa dang chos lugs kyi gnad don dang mi rigs kyi gnad don mnyam du 'dres yod par brten chos lugs la yang dag pa'i lta stangs 'dzin rgyu ni gal che'i gnad don zhig yin la gros mthun nang gi gal che'i nang don zhig kyang yin zhing / chos lugs ni bsam blo'i dad gus shig dang 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi rigs shig red/ yin na'ang bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos shig ni dus yun ring po'i nang chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa dang / mtho rim grwa pa ni mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi gras shig yin pa/dgon sdes sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs/ zhing bran bcas 'bor chen bzung yod pa bcas red/ de 'dra yin pas bod kyi chos lugs kyi gnya' gnon bshu gzhog lam lugs de bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi srid dbang sger 'dzin dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi cha shas shig la gyur pas nga tshos nges par du phyogs de gnyis dbye ba 'byed dgos kyi red/bsam blo'i dad gus shig la cha mtshon na nges par du chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len bstar dgos pa ste chos la dad pa byed pa dang chos la dad 354

pa mi byed pa tshang ma rang mos yod pa las srid 'dzin gyi bka' 'bebs la brten nas chos lugs rtsa med gtan nas gtong rgyu med la btsan pos mi rnams la chos la dad pa byed du mi 'jug pa'ang byed rgyu med pa dang / btsan pos mi rnams la chos la dad pa byed du 'jug rgyu yang med pa ni smos mi dgos pa zhig yin zhing / lo bcu'i god chags tshabs chen byung ba'i nang rgyun gtan gyi chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel rgyu bkag 'gog byed pa dang dgon sde khag sgo rgyag pa dang med pa bzo ba'i byed stangs de rigs ni rbad de nor 'khrul zhig yin pas tshabs che'i ngan 'bras kyang yong rgyu red/'on kyang bod kyi chos lugs thad kyi gnya' gnon bshu gzhog gi lam lugs de chos srid zung 'brel gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi srid dbang sger 'dzin dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi cha shas shig yin par cha mtshon na nges par du bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa yin zhing / de ni bod kyi dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur hril po'i grub cha'i cha shas shig yin la bod kyi dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya rgyur 'dzin pa'i tang gi byed phyogs dang srid jus yin pas nges par du brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa ma zad/ de dang mang tshogs kyi chos lugs dad mos bar 'brel ba nges can zhig yod pas de'i thad kyi bcos bsgyur bya rgyur da dung sngar bas gzab nan gyi rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa dang brtan brling gi thabs shes spyod dgos kyi red/ de snga nga tshos rnam 'gyur dang thabs shes de rigs spyad de chos lugs nang gi gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog lam lugs la bsgyur bcos byas yod cing slad phyin nges par du bsgyur bcos kyi 'bras bu de rigs mu mthud sra brtan gtong dgos pa las chos lugs kyi gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog gi lam lugs de 355

rigs ro langs gtan nas rgyag tu 'jug rgyu med/mdor na chos dad rang mos dang / chos srid tha dad/ chos lugs kyis srid 'dzin dang / khrims 'dzin/ slob gso bcas la the gtogs mi byed pa bcas ni nga tsho'i thog mtho' bar gsum gyi srid jus shig yin pas nga tshos phyogs yongs nas srid jus de mtha' 'khyongs dang lag len bstar dgos kyi red/(lnga)rgyal gces kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gong 'phel btang nas mi rigs kyi mthun sgril chen po yong ba byed dgos/ bod la bcings 'grol btang rjes nga tshos ches rgya khyab che ba'i btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur lag len bstar te btsan rgol rgyal gces mkhan zhig yin phyin dmangs gtsor yi rang ma byas kyang mthun sgril byas te mthun sgril byed pa'i nang rim bzhin slob gso dang bsgyur bcos byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya khyab che ba'i rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur byas nas mtho rim la mthun sgril byed rgyu de dang mang tshogs skul slong byed pa dang der brten rgyu ni kha gtad du langs pa zhig min par phan tshun gzhogs 'degs byed pa zhig red/ skabs de'i cha rkyen 'og ches rgya khyab kyi sgo nas mthun sgril byed thub pa'i mtho rim mi sna yod tshad la mthun sgril byas pa yin na gzhi nas mang tshogs la shugs rkyen thebs pa dang skul slong bya rgyur phan pa yod pa zhig red/ mang tshogs yar langs thub pa dang bzo zhing mna' 'brel sra brtan dang gong 'phel 'gro thub na 'thab phyogs gcig gyur la de bas sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rmang gzhi dang sra brtan gyi dpung khag cig yong thub kyi red/ gsar brje 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang chabs cig bod kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur la'ang btsan rgol rgyal gces 356

kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur bar gong 'phel phyin pa dang de rjes slar yang da lta'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi ngal rtsol pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs la brtsi bkur byed pa'i rgyal gces pa/ mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rgyal gces pa bcas kyi rgya khyab che ba'i mna' 'brel la 'phel rgyas phyin yod pa de thog nas nga tsho'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus ni 'byor med gral rim gyi gral rim srid jus shig yin pa mthong thub kyi red/ 'byor med gral rim gyis mi'i rigs hril por bcings 'grol btang rjes gzhi nas mthar thug rang nyid la bcings 'grol gtong thob kyi red/ de ni 〈 gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam〉nang thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i rtsa ba'i bsam blo zhig yin pa dang en ke sis 1883lo'i te yig par gzhi'i 〈 bsgrags gtam/〉nang gi gleng gzhi'i nang de'i thad rgyas bshad ha cang gsal po gnang yod pa red/ nga tsho gung khran tang mis dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgya khyab kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gong 'phel btang nas mthun sgril byed thub pa'i mi mtha' dag mthun sgril byed pa de ni mar khe si ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i rig pa dang mi'i rigs kyi spyi snyoms chen po'i rgyang ring gi phugs bsam la dmigs pa zhig yin pa las skabs bstun gyi byed thabs shig gtan nas ma red/'di gar nga tshos tā la'i bla ma dang phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla mi dran thabs med red/ khong tshos thams cad rgyal khab gzhan la brten pa dang / mi gzhan la brten nas 'tsho ba skyes ba/ mes rgyal dang kha bral ba/ mi dmangs dang kha bral ba bcas ni rgyal gces kyi bsam pa yod mkhan zhig la 357

mtshon na sems nang bzod mi thub pa zhig red/ nga tshos khong tsho'i gnas bab de rigs la sems 'khur tshad med byed kyi yod/ nga tsho'i srid jus ni thog mtha' bar gsum du rgyal gces pa khyim tshang gcig dang rgyal gces byed par snga rjes med pa zhig yin pas lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas mes rgyal la phyogs pa'i mi zhig yin phyin mes rgyal gyi rgya sgo chen po de snga phyi bar gsum du phye nas bzhag yod/lo sum cu'i ring gi drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs gnyis kyi lo rgyus kyi nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas pa de thog nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i gros mthun gyi rtsa ba'i rtsa don khag ni mi rigs gnad don thad kyi ma'o tse tung dgongs pa'i mtshon byed cig dang bod kyi mi rigs la bcings 'grol gtong ba'i 'gro lam thog 'phros pa'i 'od zer zhig yin pa dang / gros mthun nang gi rtsa ba'i rtsa don khag mtha' 'khyongs byed pa ni don dngos thog spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam dang / mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i srid dbang sgor 'dzin/ gung khran tang gi 'go khrid/ mar khe si le nyin ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung dgongs pa bcas rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i snang tshul zhig yin pa dang / gros mthun nang gi rtsa ba'i rtsa don de tshor deng sang sngar bzhin gal che'i da yod kyi don snying ldan yod pa ma zad/ slad phyin yun ring bar de tsho'i nus pa mtha' 'khyongs byed thub pa bcas yin pa ra sprod gang legs byung yod/ mi su 'dra zhig gis kyang rtsa don de tsho gtor bshig gtong ba dang phyin ci slog mi chog pa zhig red/ tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don gyi mdzub khrid 'og rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi dang de bzhin bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros 358

mthun nang gi rtsa ba'i rtsa don khag mtha' 'khyongs byed pa dang bod mi dmangs tshos dka' spyad 'bad brtson byed pa dang mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril rogs las byas pa brgyud mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod gsar pa zhig 'dzam gling gi yang rtse'i steng du ke rer langs thub nges yin pa dang der rabs can gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu'i thad 'bul 'os pa'i legs skyes 'bul thub rgyur nga tshos yid ches byed kyi yod/

dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang /nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang ba des mes rgyal gyi skam sa chen po gcig gyur byed pa'i bya ba chen po zhig bsgrubs pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus gsar pa zhig 'go tshugs pa red/ deng skabs bod 'di bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su slebs pa de ni gnam sa mgo rting log pa lta bu'i 'gyur ldog cig red/bod kyi rlabs chen lo rgyus kyi 'pho 'gyur de ni /95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23 nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis kyis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod nas 'go tshugs pa zhig yin/〈 bod zhi bas bcangs bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉(gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun)nang bod ni krung go'i mnga' khongs sa cha dang kha 'bral du mi rung ba'i cha shas shig yin pa'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos de khas len gsal po byas yod/ gros mthun gyi don tshan dang po'i nang du 6 bod kyi mi dmangs rnams mthun sgril byas te phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi btsan shugs de bod nas mthar skyod gtong dgos pa dang / bod kyi mi dmangs krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab ste mes po'i rgyal khab khyim tshang chen po'i nang 360

du log dgos zhes gsal por bkod yod/ de nas bzung bod mi dmangs rnams btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dang 'ching thag las dus gtan du grol nas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang log ste mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang /mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi khe dbang phun sum tshogs pa longs su spyod thub pa byung yod/bod ni 'dzam gling gi rtse thog tu gnas pa dang / nga tsho'i rlabs chen mes po'i rgyal khab kyi lho nub mtha' mtshams su gnas stabs dmag jus kyi thad gal 'gangs shin tu chen po yod/ bod mi rigs ni rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i mi rigs kyi gras shig yin pa dang / bod mi dmangs ni las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar zhum med dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs dang rgyal nang gi log spyod dbang sgyur la ngo gol byed pa'i gsar brje'i srol rgyun ldan pa zhig yin khar/ rlabs chen mes rgyal gsar skrun byed pa dang 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas gsar gtod byed pa'i nang du'ang khyad du 'phags pa'i legs skyes 'bul myong yod/ bod 'di krung go'i khongs su gcig gyur byung ba de ni lo rgyus thog rim bzhin 'phel rgyas kyis byung ba zhig yin/ lo ngo chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam gyi gong du bod dang thang rgyal rabs bar 'brel ba dam zab btsugs pa ma zad/ yongs su grags pa'i bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po dang thang rgyal rabs kyi lun shing kong jo gnyen sgrig byas pa de ni bsngags brjod kyi gtam bzang zhig yin la bod dang thang rgyal rabs gnyis bar chab srid thog nye po yod pa mtshon pa ma zad/ rgya rigs kyi sngon thon thon skyed lag rtsal dar nas rgya bod gnyis dpal 'byor dang rig gnas spel res byed par yang skul ma thebs pa de mtshon yod/ de rjes btsugs pa'i thang bod dbu snyung 361

gi rdo ring de da lta yang lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi mdun du yod cing / de nas lo brgya phrag 'ga' zhig ring rim 'gyur dang 'phel rgyas byung nas da phan lo bdun brgya lhag tsam gong gi yon rgyal rabs su slebs skabs bod 'di mes rgyal gyi khongs su dngos su gtogs pa red/ 'on kyang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis krung go'i nang sar btsan 'dzul byas pa dang chabs cig nga tsho'i bod du'ang rim bzhin btsan 'dzul byas pa red/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs dang 'dra bar bod mi dmangs kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul la dpa' ngar zhum med kyis ngo rgol byed myong pa dper na/ /904lor bod kyi dmag dmangs tshos rgyal rtser btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi drag po'i btsan 'dzul la dpa' ngar chen pos 'gog rgol byas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs la rdung deg tsha nan btang ste dga' skyo gnyis ldan kyi dpa' bo'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ 'on kyang yun ring bar man ju srid gzhung dang / go min tang srid gzhung / bod sa gnas srid gzhung bcas ni glen zhing nus pa med pa dang / g.yo 'gul che la 'os med mthun thabs byed mkhan zhig yin pas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis btsan 'dzul gyi 'dre lag de rim bzhin bod du brkyangs pa red/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi 'brel bar dbyen sbyor dkrug shing brgyab pa dang / bod kyi log spyod pa zhung shas bed spyod kyis rang re'i rgyal khab kha bral du btang ste bod 'di kho pa tsho'i mi ser spel yul du sgyur rgyu'i ngan sems bcangs pa red/ 'on kyang bod mi dmangs dang / rgyal gces mi sna tshud pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis sems thag gtsang bcad kyi ngo rgol dang bkag 'gog byas stabs btsan rgyal ring 362

lugs kyi ham sems de snga phyi bar gsum du 'grub thub med/ krung go gung khran tang dang / mtho kru'u zhis mi rigs khag tshang mar bcings 'grol 'thob pa byed rgyu dang / thun mong gis rlabs chen gyi mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu'i byed phyogs mtha' 'khyongs gnang ste krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug la gzhi rtsa'i cha nas rgyal kha thob pa dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i dus bab ha cang bzang po'i 'og /950lor krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod sa gnas srid gzhung la rang gi 'thus mi pe cin du btang nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mol byed dgos pa'i bka' brda btang gnang ba red/ dang thog bod kyi mtho rim mi sna'i khrod kyi mi la lar dogs 'char sna tshogs yod pa dang / la las 'gog rkyen sna tshogs bzos stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dus thog tu thag gcod byed thub med kyang / mthar /951 lor chab mdo bcings 'grol btang rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nga rang 'thus mi gtso bor bskos thog khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / thub bstan bstan dar/thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas mi bzhi 'thus mir bskos nas pe cin du btang ste gros sol byed rgyur mos mthun byas yod/ pe cin du krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi gtso bo li wu'e han dang / 'thus mi krang cing lu'u/ krang go hwa/ sun kri yon bcas blo mthun gyis nan tan dang mdza' brtse chen pos nga tsho dang gros mol byas pa phud/da dung kra'u tsung li sku ngo mas nga tshor sne len gnang ba dang 'brel tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang srid jus khag gzhan dag skor nga tshor thengs mang gsungs pas nga tsho'i ngos 'dzin mtho ru phyin song / nga tshos bod mi dmangs 363

kyi tshab byas te ma'o kru'u zhi dang / kra'u tsung lir mjal dar phul nas bod mi dmangs kyis mi rigs mthun sgril la srung brtsi dang / mes rgyal gcig gyur la srung skyong byed pa'i chod sems mtshon par byas pa yin/ gros mol yang yang byas thog rgyal nang mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i tang gi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi byed phyogs dang / bod kyi dmigs bsal gnas tshul la gzhigs nas rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnad don khag thag gcod yang dag pa byas mthar blo mthun li wu'e han sogs kyis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi tshab byas pa dang / nga tshos bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi tshab byas nas 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod pa yin/ ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo'i thog kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u tes gsung bshad kyang gnang song / ming rtags bkod rjes da dung ma'o kru'u zhis ched du nga tshor mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang 'brel gsol ston bshams nas gal che'i bya ba der rten 'brel yang zhus gnang ba red/ ma'o kru'u zhi dang kra'u tsung lis nga la 6 nga tsho gung khran tang ni khyed tshor bod kyi rig gnas dang dpal 'byor gyi bya gzhag gong 'phel gtong rgyur rogs ram byed mkhan zhig yin pa las/ dpon po byed mkhan dang / bya ba ngan pa byed rgyu'i ched du min/ gal te rgya rigs las byed pas khyed tshor brnyas bcos byas na khyed kyis nga tsho 'tshol bar shog ces thengs mang gsungs pa de thog nas bod kyi mi rigs dang mi dmangs la byams brtse'i thugs 'khur gnang lugs mtshon pa red/ tang krung dbyang dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi dgongs bzhes 'ba' zhig ni bod mi rigs gong 'phel yong thub kyi rogs ram gnang rgyu de rang red/ der brten gros mthun gyi don tshan nang 'khod dgos pa'i 364

don tshan re re tshang mar bod kyi khyad chos dang / dngos yod gnas tshul bsam gzhigs dang lta rtogs gang legs gnang thog nga tsho'i bsam 'char bsdu len dang gsan bzhes yang yang gnang yod/ der brten gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun ni mes rgyal gcig gyur dang / bod mi dmangs kyi dgos mkho dang mthun la/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi re 'dun yang mtshon pa zhig red/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas bod kyi mi rigs la 'gro lam gsar pa zhig phye ba de ni krung go gung khran tang dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'go khrid 'og mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed rgyu dang / dgos nges kyi spyi tshogs bsgyur bcos byas te spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam brgyud gzab brling brtan skyod kyi sgo nas bod kyi chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ tshan rig lag rtsal sogs phyogs gang thad kyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag rnams hur brtson chen pos 'phel rgyas btang ste bod mi dmangs kyi dngos po dang rig gnas kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad rim bzhin mtho ru btang nas lo rgyus thog lus pa'i mi rigs khag bar don dngos thog 'dra mnyam min pa de rim pas sel rgyu de yin pas de ni 'od stong 'bar ba'i 'gro lam zhig red/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab dang / las byed pa/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bcas bod du bskyod rjes lhag bsam rnam dag gis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun lag len bstar zhing / khong tsho mtha' mtshams su bca' sdod kyis mes rgyal srung skyob byed pa dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka shugs chen byas pa/ rim gras khag gi rgyal gces 365

mi snar mthun sgril byas te bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la skul lcag btang ba/ khams bod dang mtsho bod gzhung lam/ de bzhin bod nang khul gyi gal che'i gzhung lam 'ga' zhig bcas bzos te de sngon bod 'dir 'grim 'grul mi bde ba'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog chen po byung khar/ bod mi dmangs dang mes rgyal nang sa'i mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs bar gyi dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas spel res la shugs snon thebs shing / slob grwa btsugs nas las byed pa gso skyong byas pa dang / sman yon mi dgos pa'i sman bcos byas pa/ zhing 'brog khul du skyed med bun dngul btang ba/ rin med zhing chas sprad pa/ sa bon sprad pa/ cha rkyen 'dzoms sar da dung bzo las dang zhing las kyi 'dzugs skrun phran bu byas pa bcas kyi rmang gzhi'i thog /956lor srid dbang gi ngo bo ldan pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs nas bod du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed rgyur gal 'gangs che ba'i gom pa gang spo thub yod/ gong gsal de dag la bod rigs mi dmangs kyis bsngags brjod byas pa dang / lhag par du krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis thog ma nyid nas dmag 'thab ru khag dang / las don ru khag thon skyed ru khag bcas yin pa'i srol rgyun bzang po dar spel btang ste bod rigs mi dmangs la bya ba bzang po 'bor chen zhig byas yod/ der brten mi tshos brtse ba chen pos mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag ni ‘ rgya rigs gsar pa midang 4lha dmag red ces bstod bsngags gtong gi yod pa dang / bcings 'grol dmag dang bod mi dmangs bar nya chu ltar gyi brtse dungs dang 'brel ba dam zab cig chags pa red/'on kyang gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun lag bstar byed ring rno ngar che 366

la rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'thab rtsod kyang byung yod/ 'thab rtsod de ni mes rgyal gcig gyur la srung skyong byed min dang / chab srid dang dpal 'byor la bsgyur bcos byed min gyi rtsa ba'i gnad don 'di gnyis kyi thog nas gcig sdud kyis mtshon yod/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang zhing bran bdag po'i gral rim nang gi kha bral ring lugs pa dang don chen gsal rtogs mi thub pa'i mi kha shas kyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun lag bstar byed rgyur bkag 'gog shugs chen byas te phyogs gcig nas mngon sum mam lkog tu kha bral gyi spyod ngan bstud mar spel ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod la dgos nges kyi spyi tshogs bsgyur bcos byed rgyur thabs brgya jus stong gis bkag 'gog byas te chos srid gnyis ldan dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gis srid dbang sgor 'dzin byed pa'i zhing bran lam lugs ji srid bar rgyun 'khyongs byed rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa red/ dus yun ring po'i bar log spyod kyi zhing bran lam lugs de rigs kyis bod ljongs mi rigs 'phel rgyas dang phun sum tshogs su 'gro rgyur 'gog rkyen tshabs chen bzos stabs zhing bran khri tsho brgya phrag rnams sdug bsngal tshad med kyi nang du 'tsho ba skyel dgos byung ba red/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang bod la bcos bsgyur gtong rgyu'i byed phyogs gtan 'khel byas pa ste dang po ni bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa dang /gnyis pa ni zhi ba'i gros mol byed pa'i thabs lam la brten nas bcos sgyur byed rgyu de yin/ rgya che'i mang tshogs tshos gral rim gyi go rtogs rim pas mtho ru 'gro ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog bcos bsgyur gtong dgos pa'i re 'dun yang rim pas bton yod/ krung dbyang gis skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang zhib phra'i gnas tshul la gzhigs nas mang tshogs la go bskon slob gso byas te 367

1962lo'i gong du bcos bsgyur mi byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang yod/ yin na'ang zhing bran bdag po'i gral rim nang gi mi 'ga' zhig gis zhing bran mang tshogs nyin bzhin go rtogs brnyed pa dang / snga phyi tsam ma gtogs mthar bcos bsgyur byed rgyu yin pa mthong ste kho pa tshos lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun du skyod par bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i stong bsam bcangs te mthar 'dzems med nyen mchongs kyis /959lor gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa red/ ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa der rgya che'i zhing bran tsho khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar te khong tshos zhing bran bdag po'i gral rim la 'khon 'gras chen po bcangs te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la rgyab skyor dang gzhogs 'degs hur thag byas nas ngo log zing 'khrug mgyogs myur zhod 'jags btang ba dang chabs cig dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa red/bcos bsgyur byed skabs zing 'khrug nang zhugs pa'i zhing bran bdag por gzhung bzhes gtong rgyu'i srid jus lag bstar byas pa phud/ zing 'khrug nang zhugs med pa'i zhing bran bdag po dang mtho rim mi sna gzhan dag la zhi bas bcos bsgyur gtong rgyu'i mdzad phyogs sngar bzhin rgyun 'khyongs byas nas blu sto'i srid jus lag bstar byas yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la rgyal kha thob pa des zhing bran khri tsho brgya phrag la rang lus la rang dbang byung ba dang /sa zhing dang phyugs rigs thob pa ma zad/ ji srid bar bshu gzhog dang bran bkol gyi gnas las bral thub par brten khong tsho dga' mgu yi rang dang /spro nyams rgyas shing rgyal gces kyi sems shugs che ru phyin te mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob dang bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'thab rtsod nang sngar byung myong med pa'i hur brtson rang bzhin 'don spel byas pa red/ dmangs 368

gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas rjes bod kyi thon skyed dang 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas phyin zhing / zhing las dang 'brog las la lo bstud mar thon legs byung ba dang / 'grim 'grul dbor 'dren dang bzo tshong las rigs/ rig gnas slob gso bcas tshang mar 'phel rgyas che tsam byung khar rgya che'i zhing 'brog khul du tang dang sde tshogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs btsugs pa dang /bod rigs dang grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan dag gi las byed pa 'bor chen gso skyong byas pa/ rgyal gces mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril byas te rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur la shugs snon thebs pa bcas byung yod mod/de'i ring bod kyi las ka mang po zhig ni ma'o kru'u zhi dang kra'u tsung li sku ngo mas 'dri brtsad gnang ba'i 'og thag gcod gnang ba zhig red/ skabs der nga tsho'i zhib phra'i las ku'i nang skyon cha 'ga' zhig byung yod mod/ spyi yongs nas bshad na las ka ni brtan po yin pa dang / dus bab ni je legs su 'gro gi yod pa red/lo bcu'i pharig gnas gsar brje chen po'i mizang zing nang rang re'i rgyal khab la sngar byung myong med pa'i god chag chen po phog pa dang / bod kyang g.yol thabs byung med/ lin pe'o dang 4mi bzhi shog khag gis tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / las byed pa'i srid jus/ chos lugs srid jus/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus/ dpal 'byor srid jus bcas la gtor bshig tshabs chen btang stabs bod du'ang gegs chag che ba'i ngan 'bras bzos par brten bod mi dmangs kyis kyang rgyal yongs sa gnas gzhan dag gi mi dmangs dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos byung yod/ 4mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlags rjes krung dbyang gis bod kyi las kur 369

tshogs kyi khur po yang du gtong dgos pa/ tang srid las khungs kyi las ka dang rig gnas slob gso'i nang bod kyi skad yig gtso bo byed pa dang chabs cig rgya'i skad yig bed spyod gtong dgos shing / bod mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i rig gnas srol rgyun dar spel gtong dgos kyi red/ mdor na mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod ljongs gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ bod kyi las don skor gyi tang krung dbyang gi 'gangs che'i 'thab jus kyi thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i srid jus des bod ljongs kyi las ka de dus rim gsar pa zhig la slebs thub pa byung yod/krung dbyang gis bod kyi las don skor la gnang ba'i mdzub ston gsham spel byas nas lo gcig lhag tsam ring bod kyi las don khag la rnam pa gsar pa thon pa ma zad/ grub 'bras kyang gang 'tsham thob yod/ mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba legs bcos byung yod pa dang / mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong rim bzhin 'thus sgo tshang du 'gro ba dang 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin yod pa/ mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong dang gdam gses gnas spar gyi las kur shugs snon rgyag shugs che ru phyin yod/ da lta rang skyong ljongs kyi sa gnas dang / grong khyer/ shan bcas rim pa khag gi las byed pa'i nang bod rigs dang grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan dag gis gsum cha gnyis zin pa dang / sa gnas dang grong khyer drug gi tang srid 'go khrid pa dang po ni bod rigs las byed pas 'gan 'khur ba ma zad/ bod rigs las byed pa khag gcig gis rang skyong ljongs tang srid las khungs rim pa khag gi 'go khrid kyi gtso bo'i las 'gan yang 'khur yod/ 1980lor zhing las dang 'brog las la khyon yongs nas thon legs byung yod/ dpal 'byor srid jus lhug tu btang ba dang chabs 371

cig zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi lag tu 'bru rigs dang / snum/ sha/ dngul bcas mang du phyin pa ma zad/ khrom rwa 'khrug po yod pa dang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar yang legs bcos byung yod/ da lta bod kyi bod rigs kyi mi grangs de da phan lo sum cu'i gong las 607 'phar yod cing / bod sa khul du dbul bcos phyug 'gyur dang gra rgyas phun sum tshogs su 'gro ba'i 'go bzang po zhig tshugs yod/mjug tu/ nga tsho bod kyi mi dmangs khag gi mi dmangs tshos rgyal yongs mi dmangs dang mnyam du tang krung dbyang gi mtha' skor du de bas mthun sgril dam zab byas thog yid ches ldab brgya'i ngang nas mthun sgril dang / phyug po/shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod ljongs gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu dang /deng rabs can kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi stobs che'i mes rgyal zhig 'dzugs skrun byed ched 'bad 'thab byed dgos/372

bod kyi mi rigs dar rgyas yong ba'i rlabs chen gyi kha phyogs 'gyur mtshams/paṇa chen er ti ṇi chos kyi rgyal mtshan/bod ni nga tsho'i rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi kha bral du mi rung ba'i cha shas shig yin pa dang / bod rigs ni gcig gyur dang mi rigs mang ba'i rang rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi khongs mi zhig yin zhing / dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim nang bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang mnyam du thun mong thog rang rgyal gyi yangs shing rgya che ba'i mnga' khongs sa cha gsar du gtod pa dang / dpal 'byor gong 'phel 'gro rgyur skul spel gtong ba/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas gsar skrun byed pa bcas byas nas nga tsho'i rlabs chen mes rgyal gsar skrun dang 'phel rgyas gtong ched rang nyid kyi gzi brjid kyi 'gan khur yod pa red/ 'on kyang bcings 'grol ma btang gong bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'ching thag gis shugs chen bcings pa dang / krung go rnying pa'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyis mi rigs mthong chung dang mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi log spyod srid jus lag len bstar ba/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dang /'phrog bcom/ dbyen sbyor dkrug shing bcas kyis rkyen pas yun ring bar 373

bod sa khul 'di shin tu dbul zhing rjes lus kyi gnas su rgyar ba dang / bod kyi mi dmangs rnams 'tsho ba ha cang skyo po skyel dgos byung la/ bod sa gnas dang krung dbyang bar gyi 'brel ba dang / bod rgya mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba/de bzhin bod nang khul gyi 'brel ba bcas la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung ba red/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs rjes rang rgyal gyi mi rigs 'brel bar rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog byung zhing / krung go gung khran tang gi mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi srid jus kyi khrid ston 'og rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams kyis rmang gzhi gsar pa'i thog mi rigs mthun sgril chen po dngos su byed thub pa byung ba red/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs mthar skyod btang nas mes rgyal gcig gyur yong ba'i bya gzhag chen po sgrub pa dang bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol gtong ched tang krung dbyang dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung /ma'o kru'u zhi bcas kyis bod kyi lo rgyus dang / mi rigs/ chos lugs sogs gang ci'i thad kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gal che'i thabs jus gtan 'bebs gnang zhing /dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas mthar btsan rgyal ring lugs dang log spyod shog kha'i 'gog rkyen dang gtor bshig pham nyes su btang nas /95/ lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la ming rtags bkod pa red/ de nas bzung bod kyi mi dmangs rnams btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi 'ching thag las grol te mes rgyal gyi pang du log nas mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang sa khongs rang skyong gi dbang cha longs su spyod rgyu byung ba de ni bod kyi mi dmangs rnams kyis lo mang ring re sgug chen po byed pa zhig 374

yin pa dang / de ni nga tsho bod kyi mi rigs nyams rgud nas dar rgyas kyi phyogs su skyod pa dang / rjes lus nas yar thon gyi phyogs su skyod pa/ kha bral nas mthun sgril gyi phyogs su skyod pa/ mun nag nas 'od zer ldan pa'i phyogs su skyod pa bcas kyi gal che'i kha phyogs 'gyur mtshams shig red/ de ni mi rigs dbar gyi 'brel bar legs bcos gtong ba dngasna dzi mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur la srung skyong byed pa/ bod nang khul gyi mthun sgrirme la shugs snon rgyag pa/ bod mi dmangs kyi dar rgyas gong 'phel la skul 'ded gtong ba bcas kyi ngos nas bshad na gal che'i lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan yod pa red/lo sum cu lhag tsam ring bod kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun la grub 'bras ha cang chen po thob yod cing / tang krung dbyang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi/kra'u tsung li bcas kyis bod kyi las don la mthong ha cang chen po gnang ba dang bod kyi mi dmangs la thugs 'khur ha cang chen po gnang ste mi rigs gnad don skor gyi mar le ring lugs kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa dang bod kyi don dngos la gzhigs nas bod kyi las don thad gal che'i mdzub ston mang po gnang ba dang yang dag pa'i byed phyogs dang srid jus rabs dang rim pa gtan 'bebs gnang ba red/ byed phyogs dang srid jus de dag gi mdzub khrid 'og bod kyi rgya che'i las byed pa dang / mang tshogs/ bod sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi bkod 'thab pa yongs rdzogs bcas kyis dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byas pa brgyud bod sa khul la gnam sa bla 'og tu 'gyur ba lta bu'i 'gyur ldog byung zhing / ngan rgu tshang ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs mgo rting bslogs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs btsugs pa dang bod kyi mi dmangs la yar langs bcings 'grol 375

thob ste spyi tshogs kyi bdag por gyur pa red/ bzo las 'grim 'grul dang /rig gnas slob gso/ sman bcos 'phrod bsten/ tshan rig lag rtsal sogs 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag khag med pa nas yod pa dang chung ba nas che bar gyur te rim bzhin gong 'phel 'gro ba dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar de dang mtshungs pa'i legs bcos yong ba/ bod rigs kyi mi 'bor cung 'phel mgyogs pa bcas byung ba red/ lo sum cu'i ring bod kyi 'phel rgyas dang yar thon ni de snga'i lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gang zhig las kyang che ba yod pa de don dngos la brtsi 'jog byed mkhan tshang mas khas len byed kyi yod cing / phyogs gzhan zhig ni bod kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag gi 'gro lam de'ang 'khon thogs med pa zhig min zhing / tshang mas shes gsal ltar /959lor mi rnams blo pham dgos pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug gi dus zing langs stabs rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs rnams sdug bsngal tshad med myong dgos byung ba dang / zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba dang bcos bsgyur byas rjes skabs shig ring bod kyi las don thad 4 g.yon lhung bsam blo'i 'gog rkyen byung ba dang lhag par du lin pe'o dang 4 mi bzhi shog khag gi lo bcu'i god chag byung skabs tang gis bod du lag len bstar ba'i mdzad phyogs dang srid jus khag dang lhag par du mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus la gtor bshig tshabs chen byung bar brten rgyal yongs mi dmangs dang 'dra bar bod kyi mi dmangs la sdug bsngal ha cang chen po byung zhing / des tang dang mang tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba dang / dmag dmangs bar gyi 'brel ba/ rgya bod bar gyi 'brel ba bcas la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen btang khar nga tsho'i las don nang gi nor 'khrul dang las 'dzol gyis rkyen pas bod kyi gsar brje dang 376

'dzugs skrun bya gzhag skyon bral ngang gong 'phel 'gro rgyur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin 'don spel gang legs byed thub med pa dang / las don khag la 'thob 'os pa'i grub 'bras thob med pa/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar dgos nges kyi legs bcos byung med pa bcas red/6 mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlags rjes dang lhag par du na ning krung dbyang gis tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don gzhir bzung ba dang bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun te bod kyi las don la ched mngags zhib 'jug gnang nas 〈 bod kyi las don skor gyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i gnad bsdus〉la chog mchan bkod de 'grems spel gnang ba dang 'brel blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang dang dban li sogs bod la rtog zhib gnang bar dngos su phebs pa ma zad/ gal che'i gsung bshad kyang gnang ba red/ de nas bzung bod kyi las don de dus rim gsar pa zhig tu slebs shing / lo rgyus gsar pa'i cha rkyen 'og bod 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i skor gyi krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs dang / srid jus/'bad 'thab kyi dmigs yul bcas ni bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang rbad de mthun pa dang bod kyi mi dmangs kyi kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi re 'dun dang rtsa ba'i khe phan gang legs mtshon yod par brten zu g.yon thal gyi shugs rkyen gtsang sel mthar phyin byed pa dang / rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi hur brtson rang bzhin skul slong byed pa/ bod kyi dbul zhing rjes lus kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog gtong ba'i myur tshad mgyogs su gtong ba/ mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snod rgyag pa/ mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur sra brtan du gtong ba/ spyi tshogs 377

ring lugs kyi deng rabs can gyi rgyal khab stobs chen zhig 'dzugs skrun byed pa bcas kyi ngos nas bshad na shin tu gal 'gangs che ba'i don snying ldan yod pas bod kyi rgya che'i las byed pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' 'bod dang brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu thob pa red/ lo gcig ring bod du krung dbyang gi mdzub ston lag len mthar phyin bstar bar grub 'bras che tsam thob pa dang bod kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog ches cher byung zhing /bod mi dmangs kyis gcig gyur thog tang krung dbyang gi mdzub ston ni bod mi dmangs tshos dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byed pa dang dar rgyas dang stobs 'byor ldan pa'i bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i gser gyi lde mig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa red/ dus mtshungs krung dbyang gis srid jus de dag bod tsam du ma zad/ bod rigs sdod khul gzhan dag la'ang so so'i dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs te lag len mthar phyin bstar dgos zhes kyang mdzub ston gnang bar brten rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rgyal gces kyi spro sems dang thon skyed kyi hur brtson rang bzhin ches cher 'phel ba dang khong tshor mes rgyal gyi dro skyid dang tang gi dro skyid byung ba red/ na ning nga mtsho sngon sogs sa khul du lta zhib byed par skyod skabs mdzad phyogs dang srid jus de dag mi sems su zug pa ma zad/ bod rigs sdod pa'i sa khul gyi mi dmangs la zhing las dang 'brog las la thon legs byung ba dang dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhad pa ltar gyi rnam pa thon pa de mthong skabs skul lcag ha cang chen po thebs byung / slad phyin nga tshos blo brtan 'gyur med dang yun ring gi sgo nas mdzad phyogs dang srid jus de dag lag len bstar na gzhi nas slomathun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed 378

ba dang dar rgyad ji yong phan tshun brten res byed kyi yod pas sha rus 'dres pa ltar gyi brtse dungs zab mo yod pa red/ lo sum cu'i ring bod kyi grub 'bras yod tshad ni tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i 'go khrid 'og las thob pa zhig yin la rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang lhag par du rgya rigs mi dmangs kyis rogs ram shugs chen byed pa dang kha bral thabs med pa zhig kyang red/ lag len dngos kyi thog nas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du mi rigs che chung gang zhig yin rung tshang ma 'dra mnyam byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog mthun sgril dam zab dang phan tshun rogs ram byas na gzhi nas rang rgyal gyi mi rigs khag la 'tsho gnas dang gong 'phel yong ba dang / bcings 'grol dang rang dbang thob pa/ dar rgyas dang bde skyid kyi phyogs su skyod thub pa bcas ra sprod byung ba red/ mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur srung skyong dang mi rigs khag bar gyi 'dra mnyam gyi mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag pa de ni bod rigs mi dmangs dang rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi thun mong gi re 'dun dang rtsa ba'i khe phan zhig red/ zang zing yo bsrang dang dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byed pa'i deng skabs su nga tshos sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas rgyal gces ring lugs dang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi snying stobs dar spel btang khar de rang nyid kyi bsam blo dang gtam spyod kyi tshad gzhi zhig tu 'gyur ba dang / mi dmangs la slob gso gtong ba/ mi dmangs la skul lcags gtong ba/ dka' ngal khyad bsad byed pa/ dgra bo las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byed pa/ dar rgyas phun sum tshogs po yong ba bcas byed pa'i bsam blo'i mtshon cha dang skul shugs chen po zhig tu 'gyur ba byed dgos kyi red/ 380

gnyis pa/ bod kyi khyad chos la lta rtogs gang legs byas te las don mtha' dag bod kyi don dngos dang bstun dgos pa de ni gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang du mtshon pa'i rtsa don zhig yin la tang krung dbyang gis bod kyi las don skor la gnang ba'i mdzad phyogs dang srid jus khag gi rtsa ba'i gzhi 'dzin sa zhig kyang red/ nga tshos rtsa don der gzhigs te lo sum cu'i nyams myong dang bslab bya phyogs sdom nan tan byed dgos pa dang lhag par du g.yon thal gyis rkyen pas nga tsho'i las don la byung ba'i yid skyo ba'i bslab bya blangs te tang krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus kyi dgongs don gyi ngo bo go ba gting zab lon thub pa byas nas bsam blo dngos 'brel bcings 'grol btang ste 6 g.yon gyi dug rgyun dang shugs rkyen gtsang sel mtha' gcig tu byed dgos pa dang sbrags nor 'khrul gyi phyogs lhung gzhan dag sngon 'gog dang med par bzo rgyur do snang byas thog bod kyi las don thad kyi srol rgyun bzang po dang spyod tshul bzang po bskyar gso dang dar spel byed dgos shing /bod mi dmangs la phan thogs yod pa'i bya ba zhig yin phyin sgrub dgos pa dang phan thogs med pa rnams bsgrub rgyu med cing / rang shed dang / phyogs re ba/spyir btang ba/ gris btub pa'i byed stangs/ btsan shed bka' 'bebs/gzhan 'gan 'phrog sgrub bcas byed pa'i 'go khrid kyi spyod tshul dang las don gyi byed stangs gtan 'gog byed dgos/ mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril dang /dka' spyad 'bad brtson/ tan tan tig tig gzab brling brtan skyod bcas kyi sgo nas krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus sgo kun dang yang dag pa lag bstar don 'khyol yong ba byed dgos pa dang / bod kyi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong rim bzhin 'thus tshang yong ba/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs 38/

skrun gyi bya gzhag gong 'phel mgyogs tsam yong ba/ mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang tshan rig gi chu tshad mtho tsam yong ba bcas byas te mi dmangs mang tshogs gang mgyogs phyug po chags pa byed dgos kyi red/gsum pa/ nan tan gyi sgo nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol byed pa dang / mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag len bstar ba/ bod mi dmangs kyi rang skyong gi khe dbang la brtsi 'jog gang legs byed pa bcas byas nas bod mi dmangs rnams dngos 'brel rang khyim rang bdag yong ba byed pa de ni gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang du mtshon pa'i rtsa don gzhan zhig yin la mi rigs gnad don thad kyi tang gi rtsa ba'i srid jus shig kyang red/mi rigs mang po 'di lta bu yod pa'i nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi nang du tang gi gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid 'og mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi khe dbang bed spyod gang legs byas na gzhi nas mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril chen po dngos 'brel yong thub pa dang mi rigs khag gzhi nas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang 'cham mthun mnyam gnas yong thub pas bod sa khul la rang skyong khul gzhan dag dang 'dra bar rang bdag dbang cha gang legs shig yod dgos shing / rang nyid kyi khyad chos la gzhigs te lag len du 'khyol thub pa'i zhib phra'i srid jus gtan 'bebs byas te rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi hur brtson rang bzhin skul slong byas nas dngos 'brel rang nyid kyi rkang par rten nas gom pa rgyag shes pa byed pa dang chabs cig mi rigs rang nyid kyi las byed pa gso skyong shugs chen byed dgos pa dang de dag gis rgya che'i mang tshogs dang 'brel 'dris dam zab byed pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi re 'dun lhag bsam rnam dag gis mtshon par byed thub pa dang 'brel mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang /382

mi rigs gcig gyur la dga' zhen/ bya spyod tshang ma tang la 'gan 'khur ba/mes rgyal la 'gan 'khur ba bcas byed pa dang sbrags mi rigs rang nyid la 'gan 'khur ba dang / bod kyi mi dmangs la 'gan 'khur te dngos 'brel tang dang mang tshogs bar gyi zam pa lta bu zhig tu 'gyur ba byed dgos shing /mi rigs khag gi las byed pa dang mi dmangs bar phan tshun yid ches dang /phan tshun brtsi 'jog rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed ched thun mong du 'bad brtson byed dgos kyi red/bzhi pa/ tang gi chos lugs srid jus don 'khyol nan tan byas te rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi chos dad rang mos kyi dbang char 'gan srung byed dgos shing / chos dad rang mos ni tang gi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi srid jus yin/ de ni gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang gi rtsa ba'i rtsa don gas shig red/ ha lam dmangs yongs kyis chos la dad pa byed pa'i bod lta bu'i mi rigs sa khul du chos lugs kyi gnad don dang mi rigs kyi gnad don bar 'brel ba dam zab yod pas chos lugs kyi las don yag po sgrub thub min ni mi rigs kyi las don dang / mang tshogs kyi las don/ brtan nying mthun sgril/ rgya bod bar gyi 'brel ba bcas kyi thad la thad kur shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyi red/ der brten tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus sgo kun nas lag len bstar ba'i gal che'i rang bzhin dang dgos nges kyi rang bzhin la dngos 'brel ngos 'dzin byed thub pa byed pa dang tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus la go ba yang dag pa len pa dang lag len mtha' gcig tu bstar nas chos la dad pa byed mkhan mang tshogs kyi lugs mthun gyi khe dbang de srung skyob byed dgos kyi red/ lo bcu'i god chag byung skabs len pe'o dang mi 383

bzhi shog khag gsar brjer ngo rgol ru tshogs kyis chos lugs kyi yun ring rang bzhin dang / rnyog 'dzing gi rang bzhin/ mang tshogs kyi rang bzhin/ mi rigs kyi rang bzhin/ rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin bcas rtsa ba nas khas mi len par btsan shed kyis mi rnams lugs mthun gyi chos lugs byed sgo spel mi chog pa bzo ba dang dgon pa 'bor chen zhig bshigs nas tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus rbad de gtor bshig btang stabs ngan 'bras tshabs chen byung ba red/ nye lam lo shas ring tang dang srid gzhung gis gal che'i byed thabs rabs dang rim pa spyad de g.yon gyi dug rgyun dang shugs rkyen gtsang sel byas nas tang gi chos lugs srid jus rim bzhin bskyar gso dang don 'khyol byung bas chos la dad pa byed mkhan rgya che'i mang tshogs blo bde po byung nas deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun nang hur thag gzhug gi yod pa red/'on kyang sa gnas la lar tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi sri jus da dung don 'khyil byung med pa dang chos la dad pa byed mkhan mang tshogs kyi lugs mthun gyi chos lugs byed sgo yang 'gan srung byung med pa/ tha na sa gnas la lar tang gi chos lugs srid jus dang rgyab 'gal byas nas mang tshogs kyi lugs mthun gyi chos lugs byed sgo the gtogs byed pa'i gnas tshul yang byung ba red/da lta g.yas las g.yon dga' ba dang / ji tsam g.yon yin pa de tsam gyis yag pa/ g.yas las g.yon nyen kha chung ba sogs kyi bsam blo de rigs kyis blo mthun 'ga' zhig gi bsam blo'i nang da dung mu mthud nus pa thon gyi yod cing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sa gnas la lar mi re zung gis chos lugs bed spyad de khrims 'gal nyes gsog gi spyod ngan spel ba'i gnas tshul byung ba de ni rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims kyi nang du byed mi chog pa zhig yin pa dang chos 384
