kyi gzhung dang yang rgyab 'gal byed pa zhig yin pas dogs zon cher skyed byed pa dang rdung rdeg mtha' gcig tu gtong dgos kyi red/ chos la dad pa byed mkhan mang tshogs kyis chos lugs la dga' zhen byed pa de dang mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang / tang la dga' zhen/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la dga' zhen bcas byed rgyu de rang rtogs kyis gcig gyur yong ba byed dgos shing / chos la dad pa byed dang mi byed gnyis kur dogs 'char med pa dang nyen kha med pa'i 'char snang yod pa byas te phan tshun brtsi 'jog dang blo gcig sems gcig gis thun mong gi khe phan dngos su 'grub ched lag gdang phrel nas thun mong du mdun skyod byed dgos kyi red/nga tsho bod rigs mi dmangs ni las la brtson zhing bab chags pa dang /blo gros ldan la dpa' ngar che ba/ mes rgyal dang gung khran tang la dga' zhen bcas byed mkhan zhig yin zhing / bod rigs mi dmangs kyis lo rgyus thog krung hwa mi rigs hril po chags pa dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar gal che'i nus pa 'don myong ba red/ bod kyi mi rigs khag gi rgya che'i las byed pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis tang dang rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi yid ches dang re 'dun chud zos su mi 'gro ba byas te tang krung dbyang gi mtha' skor du mthun sgril sngar las dam zab byed thub nges yin pa dang rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi mtha' 'khyongs dang mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur dang mi rigs kyi mthun sgril mtha' 'khyongs byas te tang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus kyis bstan pa'i kha phyogs brgyud gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gyis btod pa'i 'gro lam thog mgo 'phang mtho zhing gom zheng chen pos mu mthud mdun skyod byas te bod gong 'phel dang yar rgyas yong ba dang mes rgyal dar rgyas dang stobs 'byor ldan pa 385
/ra las che ba 'dra

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod ljongs yar rgyas dang mi dmangs la bde skyid yong 'go tshugs pa yin/bsam gling bsod nams stobs rgyas/tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog kha bral dang / kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de dus skabs so so'i cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i 'og rnam pa 'dra min gyis gnas dang gnas bzhin pa ni rgyun mthong gi gnas tshul zhig red/ dngos don ni bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs bsnyon med cig yin pa lo rgyus kyi dngos dpang mang pos ra 'phrod khungs btsan sus kyang 'khyog bshad byed thabs med par brten krung go gung khran tang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi'i mkhas mdzangs yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og /5/nyin zla 6tshes 3nyin rgyal sa pe cin du krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dang /de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi phyogs gnyis mdza' brtse mthun 38

sgril dam zab kyi sgo nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags dngos su bkod thub pa der bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi dga' bsu thob cing de ni bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams mthun sgril dang / yar thon/'od zer 'phro ba'i bde skyid kyi lam du bskyod pa'i kha phyogs 'gyur mtshams shig dang / dus rabs phye ba'i rlabs chen gyi 'gyur ldog cig yin pa smos ci dgos/ skabs der bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan khag mngon 'gyur yong ba bya rgyu ni lte ba'i las don zhig yin/zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rjes ma'o kru'u zhis 6bod kyi las don gang 'dra zhig la bsam blo gtong dus dang thog mi rigs dang / chos lugs kyi gnad don de gnyis la bsam blo gtong thub pa byed dgos pa dang / gzab nan brtan bskyod byed dgos zhes nan tan gyis mdzub ston gnang yod pa ma zad/bod bskyod las byed pa dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go dmangs tshang mas ma'o kru'u zhi'i mdzub ston la brtsi srung zhus te lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas gros mthun gzhir bzung nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas mthar skyod btang ba dang / mes rgyal mtha' mtshams srung skyob/ 'thab phyogs khag gi las kur shugs snon/ khron bod dang mtsho bod gzhung lam gyis gtsos bod nang khul gyi gal che'i gzhung lam dang /gnam gru 'bab thang khag bzos te 'grim 'grul stabs bder gyur stabs rgya bod mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas spel res la shugs snon thebs pa dang / slob yon dang sman yon ma dgos pa'i slob grwa dang sman khang gsar btsugs/ zhing 'brog la skyed med bun gtong / rin med zhing las yo chas rgyab skyor/ khang pa rgyag pa/ chu bed gsar bzo gegs skyob sogs spyi 388

tshogs dang mi dmangs la phan bde'i bya ba bzang po 'bor chen bsgrubs yod pa dper na/ spyi lo 1951 lor rgyal rtse khul nying ru'i phu nas mtsho rdol chu log tshabs chen thon nas khul de'i mi dmangs dang / chu lam 'khel yul rgyal rtse/pa rnam/ gzhis rtse khul gyi dud tshang mang po'i khyim gzhis rtsa 'thor gyis 'gro sdod mi shes pa'i gnas su gyur skabs krung dbyang nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis chu skyon byung khul mi dmangs kyi dka' ngal sel ched krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang nas de 'phral skyob gso'i bka' bkod khang btsugs te sdod gur bzo byed kyi ras dang / gyon chas/ nyal chas/ 'bras bcas khyon che dang / lhag par skyob gso'i ched tā sgor khri brgyad cu tham pa stsal ba bcas la brten gnod 'tshe 'phogs yul mi dmangs rnams dka' dub kyi sdug bsngal las grol te rang rang gi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed bde bar byed thub pa ma zad/rgyal rtse khul du chu log gis grong khul khang pa mang che ba brdibs khyer dang / skye bo pho mo mang po chus khyer skabs dpa' bo bcings 'grol dmag gis rang srog gtong bar mi skrag pa'i snying stobs kyis chu rkyal brgyab ste mi mang po'i tshe srog skyabs thog ched mngags sman khang btsugs nas sman bcos gnang ba sogs mi dmangs kyi tshe srog dang 'tsho gos kyi sdug bsngal myur skyob gnang yod pa red/spyi lo 1956lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs nas mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed rgyu'i gal 'gangs che ba'i rmang gzhi bting ba sogs mi sems 'gul ba'i bya spyod dngos kyi thog nas bod mi dmangs la 'tsho ba gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i yid ches la skul lcag ches cher thebs te dmag dmangs nya chu'i brtse dung zab mo rang shugs su chags shing ‘ rgya rigs gsar pa nga tsho'i spun mched yin zhes pa'i skad cha de 389

bod mi dmangs kyi khrod du khyab pa dang bod mi dmangs rnams yar langs bcings 'grol thob rgyu'i re ba byed shugs je cher 'gro ba dang / phyogs mtshungs btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi dar cha'i 'og rgyal gces stobs shugs yod tshad la rgyab skyor dang / 'phel rgyas gtong ba/ mthun sgril byed thub pa'i mi mtha' dag la mthun sgril dang slob gso/ brtson len bcas gnang bar brten bod kyi mtho rim mi sna mang che bas rmongs gnyid bsad de tang dang mi dmangs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rgyal gces yar thon gyi phyogs su langs thub pa byung yod/ 'on kyang de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po'i khongs nas log spyod pa ches nyung shas kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po'i 4lha yul rtsa gtor gtong rgyur ma bzod par thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas mi ngan nyung shas bsdu rub ngan bskul gyis 6 mi dmangs 'thus tshogs padang 4chu bzhi sgang drug tshogs pa mi zer ba'i mi dmangs brdzus tshogs kyi don rkyen bzos te kha bral gyi spyod ngan bstud mar spel ba dang / bod la dgos nges kyi spyi tshogs bcos bsgyur bya rgyur bkag 'gog byas nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs ji srid bar rgyun 'khyongs byed rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa mngon gsal che ru 'gro ba dang dus mtshungs rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi go rtogs je mthor song ste bcos bsgyur gtong dgos pa'i re 'dun chen po yod pas bcos bsgyur gtong ba dang bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i bar gyi 'thab rtsod mtshon pa'i dus rim du krung dbyang gis skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang / zhib phra'i gnas tshul la gzhigs te mang tshogs la go bskon slob gso gnang ba dang 'brel spyi lo /956lo nas lo drug ring bcos bsgyur mi byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang nas 390

kha bral par ngang ring gi slob gso btang na'ang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang /zhing bran bdag po mi ngan nyung shas kyis lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun du bskyod par bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i stong bsam bcangs te mthar 'dzems med nyen mchongs kyis spyi lo 1959lor gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa red/ ngan rengs kyi rtse mthor son pa'i dus mtshams der krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan srung skyob byed ched zing slong rtsa med gtong dgos pa'i bka' phab ma thag mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod rigs mang tshogs kyi gzhogs 'degs la brten nas de 'phral zing slong dgra bo thal ba'i rdul ltar brlags ste ji srid bar mi nub pa'i rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha blangs pa red/zing 'khrug nang zhugs med pa'i mtho rim mi snar bcos bsgyur skabs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi mdzad phyogs sngar bzhin rgyun 'khyodas gnang nas blu nyo'i srid jus lag len bstar ba dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur brgyud bod kyi zhing bran khri tsho brgya phrag la rang lus rang dbang thob thog sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs thob pa ma zad/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi lo rgyus mjug 'gril te mi dmangs rnams ji srid bar bshu gzhog dang bran bkol gyi gnas las thar bar brten thon skyed nus shugs la bcings 'grol thob ste zhing 'brog thon skyed bstud mar lo legs byung bar ma zad/ 'dzugs skrun gyi myur tshad kyang mgyogs su phyin pa dang / de bzhin bzo tshong las rigs 'phel rgyas byung ba/ lhag par rig gnas slob gso'i las don gong 'phel byung stabs bod rigs gtso bor byas pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa 'bor chen gso skyong byed thub cing / mi dmangs kyi 39/

'tsho bar mngon gsal dod po'i 'gyur ldog byung ba dang chabs cig rgyal gces mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril gyis 'thab phyogs gcig gyur la shugs snon thebs pa bcas mdor na bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig slob/'phrod bsten/ tshan rig mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba sogs sgo gang sa nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi dus skabs dang bsdur thabs bral ba'i rnam pa gsar rkyang zhig tu gyur pa mig ldan kun gyi mthong chos yin pa dang / bar skabs 6 rig gnas gsar brje'i zang zing nang rgyal yongs dang 'dra bar bod la'ang ‘ g.yon thal lam phyogs kyis tang gi mi rigs dang /chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs kyi srid jus la gtor bshig dang / mi dmangs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar gnod pa'i rgyal 'phung dmangs gnod kyi bya ba tshabs chen des yar rgyas la bar chad che tsam byung rung tang gi dbu khrid yang dag pa'i 'og ‘ mi bzhi shog khag mithal ba'i rdul ltar brlag ste zing bcos yo bsrang gis rgyal yongs spyi dang / lhag par bod la dmigs bsal gyi thugs 'khur zab mo gnang zhing / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i lam phyogs dang srid jus zab mo'i khrid ston 'og krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'u yis bod kyi las ma'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du snga rjes bskong 'tshogs gnang ste lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar pa'i nang bod kyi las ku'i mdzad phyogs dang / srid jus/ las 'gan bcas gtan 'khel gnang ba dang 'brel krung dbyang gi dbu khrid blo mthun bod kyi las don la gzigs zhib gnang bar rim phebs thog bod ljongs dar rgyas yong ba bya rgyu'i don du gal che'i bka' slob rabs dang rim pa gnang ba'i 'bras bur bod ljongs khyon yongs la mi rnams dga' ba skye 'os pa'i chab srid 392

dang / dpal 'byor/ 'dzugs skrun/ lhag par mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar sngar bas lhag pa'i dngos 'brel kha yod lag yod kyi yar rgyas ci che dang / spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa gang sar sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'gyur ldog dang / rlabs chen gyi grub 'bras thob pa ni mig gis bltas na mthong rgyu yod pa dang / lag gis stob na bzung rgyu yod pa red/ gzhis rtse sa khul gyi rnam par 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i 'phel rgyas byung ba'i don dngos nas bshad na dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud thon skyed rgyu chas spyi la dbang ba'i lam lugs su bsgyur ba dang / lhag par thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs bzos te sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs khyim dud la 'gan gtsang sprod pa'i mi 'gyur ba gnyis kyi srid jus 'don spel gnang ba ma zad/ dpya khral chag yang dang / cha gses las 'gan med par ngal thebs 'tsho gnas kyi mdzad phyogs bzang po lag len gnang stabs zhing 'brog mang tshogs tshos blo mos yid spro'i thon skyed kyi sems shugs ldab brgyar 'phel nas hur brtson gyis nus pa 'don spel gang legs byas pa dang / rgyal khab nas zhing las la ma dngul 'bor chen ched stsal gyis chu bed dang / rdzas lud/ zhing sman/tshan rig lag rtsal/ son bzang khyab gdal sogs sgo gang sar rgyab skyor gnang ba bcas la brten lo bstud mar lo legs byung ste khyim tshang nyung shas phud/ mang che ba 'bru rigs rang mkho rang 'dang thub pa dang / khag gcig phyug po'i gnas su slebs nas rlangs 'khor dang / 'drud 'then 'khor lo/lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo sogs nyos pa dang / thog brtsegs ldan pa'i khang pa gsar rgyag dang 'brel 'dzin chas sna tshogs gsar bzo dang lhag par sgra sdud sgra phab dang gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin gyis gtsos deng rabs can 393

gyi 'dzin chas sgrig shoms byed kyi yod pa bcas gang sa gang du 'tsho ba gsar pa'i rnam pa bzang po mngon par bkra zhing / mi rnams yid tshims pa'i gnas tshul rgya khyab tu mngon rgyu yod/ 'brog las thad phyugs rigs dang / rtswa za'i 'gal ba legs sgrigs 'os 'tshams dang phyugs nad 'gog bcos/ gzan chas rgyab skyor byung ba bcas la brten phyugs phrug gson tshad mtho la 'chi tshad dma' bas phyugs rigs che chung mgo grangs lo re nas lo re 'phar ba dang /lhag par 'brog las tshong zog thon skyed rim 'phar byung bas/ 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mngon gsal dod pos yar rgyas byung yod pa ma zad/ 'grim 'grul thad sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i stabs bde yod stabs 'brog pa mang che ba'i khyim du 'bru rigs gsog 'jog tshags tshud yod pa dang sngar gur nang du sdod pa nas khang pa gsar rgyag gis 'brog pa'i khang khyim grong tsho gsar chags kyi rnam pa gsar pa gang sar thon yod/grong khyer gyi 'dzugs skrun thad la rgyal khab nas gron dngul 'bor chen 'don sprod gnang ste gzhis rtse grong khyer nang du snum nag bting ba'i gzhung lam khag mang gsar skrun byas pa dang g.yas g.yon du srid 'dzin sde khag dang /khe las sde khag slob grwa khag sogs bzo bkod mdzes pa'i khang chen bstar bsgrigs gsar skrun byas yod la/ khyim tshang sger gyi sdod khang dang tshong khang yang gcig las gcig yag legs bskrun gyis da cha gzhis rtse'i grong khyer yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa gsar rkyang zhig la 'gyur yod pa dang / de dang chabs cig rdzong khag la'ang 'dzugs skrun mang po byas yod/ rig gnas slob gso'i bya gzhag la mthong chen byas nas grong khyer dang / grong gseb gang sar slob grwa khag mang po gsar 'dzugs dang 'phel rgyas byung stabs spyi tshogs kyi rim 394

gras khag gi bu phrug slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i lam chen bshangs te yig rmongs sel rgyur phan 'bras thob pa ma zad/ slob gso'i spus tshad rim bzhin je yag tu song ste mtho rim slob grwa dang / 'bring rim ched las slob grwa sogs la bskyod mkhan lo re las lo re mang du 'gro ba dang / dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun lte bar byed pa'i 'thab phyogs khag tu 'jon thang yod pa'i las ka byed mkhan bod rigs gzhon nu pho mo 'bor chen gso skyong gis 'tshar longs yong bzhin yod pa/ lhag don mes rgyal nang du bod kyi 'dzin grwa ched btsugs thog slob phrug bsdu len gso skyong byed mus yin pa des slad bod kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag dang / mi rigs mthun sgril sra brtan gong 'phel 'gro rgyur dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa thon nges red/ mdor na bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas da bar lo ngo bzhi bcu'i ring gzhis rtse sa khul gyi slob gso'i las kur thob pa'i grub 'bras ni sngar lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa zhig red/ sman bcos 'phrod bsten thad bod lugs sman khang dang / krung dbyi'i dang phyi lugs sman khang bcas nad pa so so'i nad bab dang blo mos ltar sman bcos bya rgyu yod pa ma zad/ mang tshogs la sman rin sprod ma dgos pa'i sman bcos bya rgyu yod pa/ nad rigs spyi dang / lhag par ma bu bde grol gyi las kur grub 'bras chen po thob nas mi dmangs kyi tshe srog bde thang la 'gan srung byung ste spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin gang legs mngon yod pa dang / de bzhin bza' bca'i 'phrod bsten zhib bsher tshan pa ched btsugs kyis rnying pa dang / rul lhad/ phyugs nad phog pa'i sha rigs sogs bkag 'gog nan po byas pa dang / grong khyer gyi khor yug gtsang sbra ru khag 395

ched btsugs kyis gtsang sprar dam 'dzin byas par brten mi dmangs kyi bde thang la phan thogs chen po byung yod/ gzhan yang bzo tshong las rigs dang /'grim 'grul skyel 'dren thad khrang krang dang cing li 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas pa des bdag po'i 'khur sems che ru phyin stabs khe las kyi gson shugs je mthor phyin te thon tshad dang tshong zog gi rnam grangs 'phar snon dang las bzo'i zhabs zhu'i rnam 'gyur legs su song bas mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho skong thub pa byung yod la dpal 'byor gyi phan 'bras kyang gong mthor song yod/ mi rigs kyi lag shes bzo las grangs tshad dang / spus tshad gnyis ka lo re bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / mi rigs kyi srol rgyun ldan pa'i lag shes bzo las lag rtsal nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel byung yod/ kha gdan bzo grwa khag nas btags pa'i bal khe gtsang las grub pa'i bod rum thon 'bor che la brin kha rgyugs pa/ de min mnyam sdeb dang / sger bcas kyi lcags rigs thon rdzas dang / zangs bzo/ mdzes rtsal bzo skrun/ shing bzo lha bris sogs sgo gang sar 'phel rgyas kyis spyi sger yong 'bab lo re bzhin 'phar snon byung yod pa dang / phyi phyogs su sgo mo 'byed pa dang / nang khul 'khrug tu gtong rgyu'i mdzad phyogs kyi khrid ston 'og khrom ra dar rgyas phun sum tshogs par gyur yod/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus ni/ ma'o kru'u zhi dang / tsung li kro'u en la'e sku ngo mas gsar gtod dar spel gnang ba'i gsar brje'i nor bu chen po gsum gyi ya rgyal zhig yin na'ang / bar skabs 4 mi bzhi shog khag migis rgyal yongs khyon dang 'dra ba bod ljongs su'ang gtor bshig tshabs chen btang ste rgyal gces mi sna mang che bar rdung rdeg 'khel bar tang krung dbyang 396

nas thugs 'khur tshad med kyis 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don bskyar gso dang srid jus don 'khyol gnang ba ma zad/ krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'i sku tshab las don tshogs pa bod du rtog zhib mdzad par phebs skabs nga tsho'i gzhis rtse sa gnas su'ang le lag sku tshab tshogs pa ched phebs bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog bsam gros bsdu len dang 'brel rin bral bka' slob mang po gnang thog gzhis rtse sa gnas tang ud kyi thad ma'i dbu khrid 'og 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka gong 'phel chen po byung ba dper na/ sa gnas chab srid gros tshogs kyi rgyal gces mi sna las byed ngo mar 'pho 'gyur gtong gnang gis phogs rim bzos pa dang 'brel lo na cung zad gzhon la shes ldan khag cig srid 'dzin kung hru'u dang / cus khag slob grwa khag sogs kyi nang las 'gan bkod sgrig gnang ba dang srid gros rang khungs su kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang / drung che gzhon pa/ rgyun las u yon dang / u yon bcas 'bor chen 'phar snon bkod sgrig gnang thog bar skabs rgyal gces mi sna khag gcig la ma nyes khag g.yogs byung ba'i gyod gzhir dkar 'don dag sel dang 'brel sngar yod go phogs rang 'jags gnang ba dang / 'das grongs phyin pa tshang mar sa gnas tang ud kyi dbu khrid ched phebs kyis mya ngan zhu gnang mdzad thog shul mir sems gso 'tshams 'dri gnang zhing / khongs mi 'das gson mang po'i rgyu dngos khang pa phyir gyar byung rigs la nan tan gyis srid jus don 'khyol gnang yod pa bcas spyi lo /959lo'i zla 12tshes 6nyin gzhis rtse sa khul chab srid gros tshogs thog mar gsar btsugs byed skabs u yon mi grangs 36yod pa nas rim bzhin rgya cher 'phel rgyas kyis da cha u yon mi grangs 247yod pa/ phyogs mtshungs zing 'khrug khongs ma zhugs pa'i mnga' 397

bdag mnga' tshab kyi thon skyed rgyu chas la blu nyo'i srid jus lag bstar gnang rgyu bar skabs mtshams chad pa de dag kyang don 'khyol slar gso gnang ba ma zad/sa gnas tang ud dang / srid 'dzin kung hru'u yis 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don lomathong ha cang chen po gnang bar brten rgyal gces mtho rim mi sna rnams nas tang dang / srid gzhung / mes rgyal bcas par sngar las lhag pa'i dga' zhen gyis sa gnas tang ud kyi 'go khrid 'og mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis rang bab las 'gan la hur brtson thog tang gi srid jus dang /bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dril bsgrags zhu sgos mtshon bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi bya bar legs skyes dang / lhag par phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla tang gi srid jus dang / bod ljongs gsar pa'i rnam pa/ rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba bcas don dngos ji bzhin dril bsgrags byas stabs phyir sdod bod rigs spun zla mang pos tang gi srid jus dang bod kyi don dngos la shes rtogs byed tshad gong mthor song yod/chos lugs srid jus skor dzirig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gna' rabs kyi rig rdzas dang phul byung gi rig gnas/ dgon sde khag bcas la gtor bshig dang / lugs mthun chos byed mi snar rdung rdeg tshabs chen phog pa de dag la tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis mdzub ston 'og ljongs tang ud dang / sa gnas tang ud kyis bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun pa'i mi rigs srid jus dang / chos dad srid jus slar gso gnang bar brten gtsang khul du mtshon na gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dang / sa skya dgon pa/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde/ zhwa lu dgon bcas kyis gtsos ris med dgon sde khag mang nyams gso'i mthun rkyen du rgyal khab nas mi dmangs 398

shog sgor khri brgya phrag mang po stsal gnang gis chos dad ser skya mi dmangs kyi re 'dod yongs su skong ba'i srid jus don 'khyol byed bzhin yod/ grags can dgon sde khag slar gso byung bar brten nang sa'i kun su'u dang / mtsho sngon/ zi khron zhing chen khul gyi bod rigs dang / de bzhin dbus gtsang khams gsum dang / byang 'brog sogs kyi chos dad mi dmangs khyon che dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis chos mjal zhu bar yong mi je mang du 'gro bzhin pa des mi rnams kyis tang gi chos lugs srid jus mngon sum don 'khyol gnang bar ha cang blo yid tshim po'i sgo nas dga' mgu yi rang zhu gi yod pa sogs mdor na gong du zhus pa'i 'thab phyogs khag la thob pa'i grub 'bras rnams dpe mtshon tsam ma gtogs zhib phra brjod kyis mi lang zhing / mdor bsdus na bod la zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa nas da bar dus yun lo ngo bzhi bcu song ring gi bod ljongs kyi don dngos la gzu bo'i blos dpyad tshe bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod ljongs yar rgyas mi dmangs bde skyid kyi 'go tshugs pa zhig yin/ lag len gyi thog nas bod ljongs kyi chab srid brtan snying dang / dpal 'byor dar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba byed dgos na thog mtha' bar gsum du gung khran tang gi 'go khrid mtha' 'khyodas dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs mtha' 'khyodas byed dgos pa don dngos kyis gsal bshad gang legs byas yod/lo bzhi bcu'i ring krung go'i gung khran tang gis bod la ma khyab pa med pa'i thugs 'khur tshad med kyis dmigs bsal mdzad phyogs dang / srid jus bzang po rabs dang rim pa gtan 'bebs dang phyag bstar gnang bar brten bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun/ mi dmangs kyi 399

'tsho ba sogs gang cir yar rgyas byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i rlabs chen gyi grub 'bras de dag skye bo kun gyi mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur par brten mi rnams kyis tang gi srid jus bzang po'i thugs rje bka' drin la snying khung rus pa'i gting nas dga' gus dang bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor bzhin yod pa red/ lhag par du snga lo spyi khyab hru'u ci blo mthun cang tse min sku ngo ma bod du ched phebs kyis sa gnas khag la rtog zhib dang 'brel gal che'i bka' slob dang / bod kyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag la thugs 'khur rgyab skyor bla med gnang ba des brtan snying gi bsam pa dang / 'phel rgyas kyi re ba/ phyug gyur gyi dgos 'dun bcangs pa'i ljongs yongs kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams la skul ma ha cang chen po thebs yod pas rgyal khab phyi nang gi dgra bos thabs ngan yod rgu spyad de nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur dang / rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' brtse gting zab kyi mthun sgril la gtor bshig ji ltar byas kyang kho tsho sngar bzhin ngal ba 'bras med thog mu mthud pham nyes su 'gro rgyu kho na las ma 'das pa ni lo rgyus mdun du bskyod pa'i bden don gyi chos nyid yin/ngas sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas tang gi 'go khrid 'og ming don mtshungs pa'i rgyal gces pa zhig byas te langs phyogs brtan po dang / dar cha gsal po'i sgo nas rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi mtha' 'khyongs thog mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la srung skyong dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ tang dang mnyam las mnyam sgrub legs par byas nas bod gsar 'dzugs skrun nang rang nus gang yod legs skyes 'bul rgyur chod sems brtan po btsugs yod/ 400

1951 lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi gtsos bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnam pa pe cin du phebs te krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi li wu'e han gyi gtsos pa'i 'thus mi rnam pa dang zhi mthun bka' mol gnang ste/ 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉gtan 'khel zhing ming rtags bkod rjes/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cing u bod du phebs par kho bo'ang skad bsgyur du lhan bcar zhus te bod ljongs su 'byo skabs/ dge bshes mchog gis rgyang grags gsungs pa/ skabs der rgyang grags kyi yo byad zhan cing shugs chung stabs nyan mkhan gyis nang don gsal po thos mi 'dug kyang / khong gi gsung skad 'dzer tsam yod pa'i khyad chos der rgyus mnga' yod pa tshos skad ngo chod pa de'ang nyan mkhan tsho'i blo bag phab par phan thog byung 'dug de ni skabs der sgrog gtam sna tshogs shig gang sar khyab yod par/shes rab rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i skyes chen grags can rnams ha lam bzhugs med skad thos 'dug pa'i rkyen gyi red/ 'di ni rjes ma'i gnas tshul yin/skabs de nas bzung bod ljongs tsam las rgyal yongs skam sa chen po po yongs rdzogs bcings bkrol byung ba/ kho bo yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gang nyid kyi sku mdun nas dgongs pa zhus te/shar rgyag rgyal sa pe cin du bcar khar skabs legs pa zhig la skabs de'i krung dbyang mi rigs las don u yon lhan khang gi las kur tshud cing / bod ljongs zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi las don dngos sam brgyud nas bsgrub bzhin du bsdad/'dir bod zhi bas bcings 'grol byung ba'i gnas tshul kho po'i myong thog 403

tu gang byung ba mdor bsdus tsam zhu rgyur gsham gsal/dang po/ krung dbyang gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skul 'bod gnang ba/spyi lo 1949 pa'i lo mjug tu slebs skabs rang rgyal gyi skam sa chen po phal che ba bcings 'grol btang zhing krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su btsugs par 'dzam gling yongs la khyab bsgrags byas pa'i mtshams su bod ljongs gcig pu bcings 'grol gtong rgyur lus shing / bod sa gnas ni gong du gsal ba ltar dmig bsal gyi gnas tshul chen po yod pa'i gnas shig yin stabs zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skul 'bod rim par gnang yang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa nyung shas kyis nub phyogs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og zhi mthun bka' mol zhu ba'i 'thus mi mi gtong ba'i thog chab mdo sa khul gyi shar phyogs 'bri chu'i rgyud du bod dmag btang ste sa srung byed du bcugaskabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog rtsis dpon gyi las gnas thog nas bka' blon las 'phar (bod sa gnas srid gzhung rnying par bka' shag tu bka' blon bzhi yin par brten/nga phod mchog 'phar mar spar bar 6 las 'phar zhes byung skad)du spar zhing chab mdo sa khul gyi mdo smad spyi khyab tu bskos/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog zhi thug rgyud gzhungs spyan rgyang ring por gzigs thub par brten/khong gis skabs de'i rgyal khab phyi nang gi gnas tshul gang yin zhib dpyad 404

gnang bar/ krung go gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhis 'go khrid gnang ba'i krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis go min tang cang ce hre'i dmag dpung mi grangs khri brgya phrag kha shas yod pa de rnams kyang gtor te krung go ha lam yongs rdzogs bcings 'grol btang bar/ bod ljongs kyi dmag mi nyung la go lag kyang zhan pa des do ya byed thabs bral la byed kyang mi 'os pa yin stabs/ chab mdo sa khul du thon khar gsung don/ rang res krung go gung khran tang dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la ya lan byed thabs rtsa ba nas bral bas zhi mthun bka' mol gnang rgyu las thabs shes gzhan gang yang med stabs/ kho bo chab mdor 'byor rjes thad kur gung khran tang 'tshal te zhi mthun bka' mol gnang rgyu las ya lan byed rtsis med ces zhal sang nas gsungs 'dug/950lo'i zla bcu pa tsam la slebs dus bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis zhi mthun bka' mol zhu mkhan nyin shag dus 'gyang gis yong mkhan med par brten/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dpung 'jug 'char gzhi gtan 'khel zin don ltar lag len byed rgyu las yang yang 'gyang thabs bral bas/ ya lan byed mkhan bod dmag gtor te chab mdo'i sa khul drag pos bcings 'grol btang /skabs der nga phod pa mchog kyang bcings 'grol btang khongs su yod stabs/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag mdun skyod dpung sde'i bka' bkod pa dang chab srid u yon gcig lcog gnang mkhan wang chi men dang bka' mol gnang 'bras/ skabs der chab mdor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs bzhi bcu lhag tsam yod pa tshang mas thun mong du/ de sngar phyi 405

rgyal du bros 'gro rtsis yin yang 'gro ma thub par mtha' mtshams gro mor lus pa'i tā la'i bla ma dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' shag la yi ge bris par/ nang don zhi mthun bka' mol gnang rgyu las ya lan byed thabs med pa sogs 'khod cing / yi ge skyel mkhan yang khong gi zhabs gras dpon rigs do chod pa zhig btang bar/ skabs der tā la'i bla ma dang / der yod bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs rnams rtsod gleng zhib gros zab nan byas rjes/chab mdo'i spyi khyab las thog tu yod pa'i nga phod pa dang / thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas dang gzhan yang gro mo nas khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang thub bstan bstan dar gnyis bcas zhi mthun bka' mol gnang bar btang zhing / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang bcas pe cin 'byor du skabs tsung li kru'u en le sku ngo ma dang / dpon rigs gzhan dag khag gcig mang tshogs khag gcig dang bcas me 'khor babs tshugs su dga' bsur phebs/ de nas ma 'gyangs par khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / thub bstan bstan dar gnyis kyang rgya gar dang /shang nang brgyud nas pe cin du 'byor bar skabs der krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi pu'u krang dang / krung dbyang mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u rin gcig lcog yin pa'i li wu'e han dang / sngon la 'byor ba'i nga phod pa bcas me 'khor babs tshugs su dga' bsur phebs/ phyogs gnyis nas phebs pa'i bod kyi 'thus mi pe cin du 'dzoms rjes/ tsung li kru'u en les gsol stobs gzab rgyas bshams te khong tshor phebs bsu gnang zhing /gsol ston gyi rjes su /949lor rang re'i rgyal khab gsar du btsugs pa'i rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo'i glog brnyan par gzhi cha tshang bstan/ de dag grol 406

rjes tshang ma ngal gso'i khang du 'dzoms skabs bod kyi 'thus mi rnams la krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi li wu'e han dang / krang cin u/sun kri yon bcas ngo sprod gnang (krung dbyang gi 'thus mi'i khongs su krang go hwa yod kyang skabs der 'byor mi 'dug)nga phod pa sogs bod kyi 'thus mi rnams pe cin mgron khang du bzhugs shing / mgron bsu'i tshad gzhi mtho tsam yin 'dug zhi mthun bka' mol gnang yul/ mgron khang gi thag nye sar yod pa'i dung ca'o ming shang zhes pa'i sa'i khang chen zhig tu yin 'dugakho bo skabs der pe cin mgron khang du krung dbyang mi rigs las khungs kyi las byed pa bod kyi 'thus mir sne len zhu mkhan gzhan dang mnyam du bsdad de bod 'thus mir sne len dang skad bsgyur du bzhag kyang / skabs der kho bo a mdo'i yul skad las dbus gtsang gi yul skad ji bzhin bshad mi shes par brten/ zhi mthun bka' mol gnang skabs kyi skad sgyur ni de sngar lha sar bzhugs myong zhing dbus gtsang gi skad lugs mkhyen mkhan phun tshogs dbang rgyal mchog gis gnang / dbus gtsang yul skad dang / a mdo'i yul skad gtso bor skad mdangs kyi thog nas khyad par che tsam yod pa las yi ge'i thad gcig gyur yin khar/ ming tshogs kyang mang che ba gcig gyur yin stabs/yig bsgyur gyi thad kho bos byas/zhi mthun bka' mol ni zla 4tshes 29la gnang 'go tshugs khar/ de sngar lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gis khyab bsgrags gnang ba'i bod don skor gyi srid jus don tshan bcu po gzhir byas te gnang / phyogs gnyis nas bka' mol zhi lhug gnang mthar 〈 krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung 407

dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la gros 'cham byung zhing / zla 5tshes 23nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi las khungs tshugs yul krung nan he'i srid 'dzin tshoms chen du phyogs gnyis ma'i dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mis ming rtags bkod/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi ming rtags 'god mkhan 'thus mir li wu'e han dang / krang cing u/ krang go hwa/ sun kri yon bcas dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi ming rtags 'god mkhan 'thus mir nga phod nga dbang 'jigs med dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/thub bstan bstan dar/ thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan don 'grub bcas yin 'dug gros mthun thog ming rtags bkod pa'i mdzad sgo'i thad krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u de dang / li ci khrin/ srid don khang gi tsung li gzhon pa khrin lus bcas kyi gtso skyong gnang zhing / ming rtags bkod rjes li wu'e han dang / nga phod ngag dbanga'ajigs med rnam gnyis kyis snga phyir gsung bshad gnang ba dang / mjug tu kru'u des gsung bshad gnang /bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gyi gros mthun thog tu zla 5tshes 23nyin ming rtags bkod rjes/ tshes 24la ma'o kru'u zhis srid skyong tshoms chen du nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtsos pa'i bod kyi 'thus mi rnams la mjal 'phrad gnang zhing / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis ma'o kru'u zhir mjal dar dang / bod nas thon pa'i gser thum chung gcig bcas phul/mjal 'phrad gnang grub rjes ma'o kru'u zhi dang bod kyi 'thus mi rnam pa tshoms chen de ga'i ngal gso khang zhig tu phebs te bka' mol zhi lhod gnang / nga 408

phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis zhi mthun bka' mol gnang ba dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa'i gnas tshul snyan seng zhus rjes/ ma'o kru'u zhis thugs dgyes bzhin gsung don/ yag po byung bzhag khyod rang tshos las don chen po zhig grub nas 'dug gros mthun〉bzhag rjes de gzhir bzung mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang /las byed pa khag gcig bod ljongs su song rjes 〈 gros mthun 〉dang krung dbyang mi dmangs kyi srid jus khag rnams do khur nan pos lag len dang 'brel khyed tshor rogs ram byas te chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas pa'i bya gzhag khag gong 'phel du gtong dgos pa las/ man ju gong ma dang go min tang srid gzhung bcas pa nang bzhin gnya' gnon dang /bshu gzhog byed mi chog de ltar yin min thad khyed tsho blta chog pa red/ lo gcig gam gnyis gsum mam bzhi tha na lo brgyad dam bcu sogs rgyun ring tsam blta chog pa yin zhing / gang ltar nyin gcig khyed rnam pas gsal bar gzigs nges yin zhes pa la sogs pa'i bka' mol zhi lhod gnang / ma'o kru'u zhi bka' mol gnang skabs bzhes tha gcig mjug gcig mthud du bzhes par ma zad/ da dung sku bzhengs te de gar bzhugs mkhan gzhan la'ang re re bzhin gnang / bka' mol gnang rjes bod kyi 'thus mi rnam pa ha cang thugs mnyes po byung ste rang gnas su phyir log skabs/ khong tshos rlangs 'khor du 'gro bzhin gsung don/ de ring bka' mol de snyan shos byung / khyed rang gis kyang yag shos bsgyur te bka' mol gnang don tshang ma nga tshos ha go byung zhes ku re dang bcas te gsungs/ nyin de'i dgong dror ma'o kru'u zhis gsol ston rgyas po zhig bshams te bod kyi 'thus mi rnams sku mgron du gdan drangs shing / 409

gsol ston thog ma'o kru'u zhis gsungs don da nas bzung / tā la'i bla mas 'go khrid byas pa'i stobs shugs dang paṇa chen er te nis 'go khrid byas pa'i stobs shugs bcas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bar du mthun sgril byung zhing / de ni phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / go ming tang srid gzhung gtor pa'i rjes su byung ba yin khar/ mthun sgril de ni spun zla bar gyi mthun sgril yin pa las phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan la gnya' gnon byed rgyu de ma yin pa'i khar/ mthun sgril 'di bzhin phyogs tshang mas 'bad brtson byas pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin cing / mthun sgril 'di'i rmang gzhi'i thog rang re'i mi rigs khag gi bar chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas tshang ma gong 'phel du 'gro rgyu yin stabs bkra shis bde legs zhu 'os pa red/ rang re tshang mas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod par khrung dag gnang bar zhu'o zhes gsungs shing / gsol ston du phebs mkhan gras su paṇa chen er te ni sku 'khor yod khar/ kru'u zhi gzhon pa kru'u de dang / le'o hra'o chi khong rnam pa'ang mgron bsur phebs 'dug cing / gsol ston du phebs mkhan tshang ma dgyes mnyes chen po byung 'dugazla lnga pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin gyi 〈 mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par〉thog 〈 krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉cha tshang rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyis bkod pa ma zad/ tshags par de'i ched brjod cig dang / zhi mthun bka' mol gnang ba'i gnas tshul cha tshang yang bkod 'dug 4/0

zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang /thub bstan legs smon rnam gnyis zhabs grabs dang bcas 〈 gros mthun 〉yig cha bsnams te zi khron brgyud bod ljongs su phebs/zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bod skyod sku tshab krang cing u dang bcas 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi 'dra bshu zhig bsnams te shang nang dang rgya gar brgyud bod ljongs su thon/ krang cing u dang lhan du phebs mkhan bod kyi 'thus mi khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang /thub bstan bstan dar/ gzhan yang bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas yod pa dang / kho bo yang krang cin u'i skad bsgyur du btang zhing / 'gro khar 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi 'go khrid li wu'e han gyis kho bor bka' mol gnang don/ khyod rang las kur hur po 'dug cing zhi mthun bka' mol gnang ring 'go nas mjug tu yod pas gnas tshul tshang ma shes pa yin stabs/da res krang cing u bod du phebs te gro mor yod pa'i tā la'i bla mar lag rtags khag gcig 'bul rgyu dang sbrag tā la'i bla mar gros mthun gyi nang don rags tsam 'brel bshad rgyag rgyu'i thog ma'o kra'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag rtags ma gcig dang / gros mthun gyi 'dra bshu bcas 'bul rgyur/ de dag grub mtshams krang cing u slar yang rgya gar brgyud log phebs rgyu dang / khyod rang lo'o phu hun dang mnyam du lha sa bar 'gro rgyur/ lha sar 'byor mtshams khyod rang gi las 'gan yang grub zin stabs khams brgyud nas log shog ces gsungs/krang cing u dang bcas shang nang nas yob e mkha' skyod khe las kyi gnam grur bstad de seng ga pu'u brgyud rgya gar gyi ka li ka tar 'byor ba dang / 4//

de nas yang gnam gru chung ba zhig la bsdad de rgya gar byang ngos zhi re ku re la 'byor/ de nas rlangs 'khor 'jib bsdad de ka sbug bar du bskyod/ skabs der sa cha 'di'i rgyud du char zhod tshugs sgang yin pas sngar rgyun gyi 'gro lam du ma thar bar ri sgang bskor nas 'gro dgos byung bas/ lam thag ring tsam yin yang ri dang lung gi yul ljongs mang tsam mthong / de'i brgyud du ja zhing mang tsam 'dug khar yob rob pa mang po zhig lam brgyud du mthong rgyu 'dug pas mang che ba de dag gis bdag gnyer byed kyin yod tshod 'dug gzhan yang lam brgyud du gyon chas dang sdod kha sogs bod pa dang ha cang 'dra ba yang mthong rgyu 'dug par bod pa min nam bsams pa byung yang / de min 'dug nga tsho sdod pa'i rlangs 'khor thog kha lo pa'i las rogs pa gzhon nu zhig 'dug pa ga nas bltas kyang bod phrug 'dra ba zhig 'dug rung skad brda mi 'phrod pas bod phrug min 'dug phyis su rtsad chod dus de dag rgya gar byang gi ri brgyud du 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i 6 pa ras zhes pa'i mi rigs shig yin 'dugang tsho ka sbug tu 'byor skabs bod ljongs nas yong ba'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs zhol khang bsod nams dar rgyas kyis sne len byas/ nga tsho'i bsam tshod la chu thog gru gzengs na dbor ba'i lag rtags rnams 'byor rjes gro mor tā la'i bla mar phul de krang cing u de nas log phebs rtsis yin rung / gza' 'khor gcig tsam sgug bsdad kyang lag rtags rnams ma 'byor cing / de ga'i ngang du gro mo nas kha par zhig 'byor don tā la'i bla ma nye char lha sar log phebs rgyur gtan 'khel stabs/ sku tshab krang cing u mgyogs tsam phebs na gro mor mjal rgyu dang / ka spug tu da dung yang yun ring tsam bzhugs na lha sar mjal chog ces byung bar/ krang cing u dang bcas de'i 4/2

sang nyin rang du ka sbug nas thon cing / 'bras ljongs kyi bar rlangs 'khor tu chas te/ de nyin 'bras ljongs kyi rgyal sa sgang tog tu zhag sdod byas/'bras ljongs pho brang nas sngar lam ltar 'bras rtsa ra gang dang rtsam pa bcas bskyal byung / de'i sang nyin thon te mtsho 'go zer bar bsdad/ de'i sang nyin thon te he ma la'i ri sho sna thod la brgyab nas ri skod tsam la slebs dus/ bod dmag zhal ngo gcig gis rta dmag bcu grangs zhig gis ru bsgrigs bsu ba zhus shing / de nas bzung dmag mi de dag krang cing u'i sku srung gi tshod du lha sa'i bar du bskyal/ de nub chu 'bur thang du zhag sdod byas/ de'i sang zhogs chu 'bur thang nas rig sham du slebs skabs/ gro mor yod pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi sne'u shar gtsos dpon rigs khag gis mjal dar phul ba dang bcas bsu ba zhus shing / shar seng ma'i mi tshang che tsam zhig gi nang du sdod sgrig byas 'dug pa der bsdad/ de'i sang nyin gro mor yod pa'i bka' blon bla ma ram pa dang / zur khang bcas kha shas krang cing ur dga' bsu yin tshod du mjal dar phul bar yong bar krang cing u dang tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad gnang lugs skor bka' mol gnang bar/ dang por khong tsho'i bsam 'char la mjal 'phrad gnang skabs tā la'i bla ma bzhugs khri mthon por bsdad de krang cing u mjal dmangs gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar mjal dar phul na zhes bshad par krang cing us zhal 'dzum gnang ba las gtso bor cha la yod pa'i lo yu hung gis ma'o kru'u ni rgyal yongs mi dmangs yongs kyi rlabs chen gtso 'dzin pa yin dang / krang cing u ni rlabs chen gtso 'dzin gyi sku tshab yin bzhin du/ khong phebs skabs tā la'i bla ma phebs bsur bcar dgos pa las/ tā la'i bla ma mthon po'i khri la bsdad nas krang cing u spyir btang gi 413

mjal dmangs ltar mjal dar phul na lugs dang mthun pa zhig e yod na zhes sogs cung khros pa'i nyams kyis gsungs shing / de nas gang dga' ji legs kyi bshad res mang du byas mthar/ tā la'i bla ma rkub stegs cig la bsdad nas/ krang cing u phebs skabs rkub stegs nas langs te krang cing us ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris gtsos pa'i yig rigs rnams yar sprad rjes krang cing u yang rkub stegs cig tu bsdad de bka' mol gnang rgyur gtan 'khel te/ de'i sang nyin krang cing u/ lo yu hung dang kho bo bcas sdod gnas nas thon ste dung dkar dgon pa'i phyogs su thon cing / krang cing u la sogs pa gro mor 'byor pa'i sang nyin gro mor bca' sdod rgya gar srid gzhung gi 'thus mi 'tshams 'drir slebs shing / 'thus mi de 'bras ljongs pa zhig yin khar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi kho par rim pa bzhi pa'i go gnas shig kyang sprad 'dug la/ kho pa tshur bcar skabs mgo bor rim bzhi'i spa lcog cig brgyab 'dug par ma zad gos chen ser po'i rgyun chas shig gyon 'dug par bod skad kyang lha sa'i skad gtsang ma zhig shod par bod gzhung sku drag cig tu 'phrul snang byung /rgya gar 'thus mi'i sdod sar sku srung dmag mi bcu grangs shig yod par krang cing u bcas dung dkar dgon par 'gro skabs/ kho tshos lam zur du ru bsgrigs te gus dud kyang zhus song / de nas yar phebs dus/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung dmag mi mda' tshan gcig yod pa dung dkar dgon pa'i ri bsham du ru bsgrigs te gus dud dang bcas bsu ba zhus/ bod dmag gzhan rnams snam bu dkar po'i bod chas gon pa/ da res krang cing u yi sku srung du bod dmag bcu grangs de tsho'i gyon chas ji lta bu yin pa dang / sku srung dmag mi'i 'go khrid mda' dpon dang / dmag mi byings bcas dbyin ji'i lugs 4/4

kyi thar ma'i chas spras 'dugakrang cing u bcas dung dkar dgon par 'byor skabs/ dgon pa'i gzhung sgo bar du dpon rigs tsho'i phebs bsu'i dpung bsgrigs 'dug pa dang /de nas mgron gnyer chen mo tā la'i bla ma'i stod gnas bar du khrid/ tā la'i bla ma rkub stegs cig tu bsdad 'dug par yar langs te krang cing us ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma gcig dang / 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi 'dra bshu bcas sprad de zur gyi rkub stegs cig tu bsdad/ tā la'i bla mas sku tshab mchog sa thag ring nas phebs par sku ngal chen po byung yod shag dang / kho bo nyin shas rjes la lha sar log 'gro rgyur gtan 'phel nas kho bo sngon la 'gro'am sku tshab mchog sngon la phebs sam zhes par/ krang cing us tā la'i bla ma mchog lha sar log phebs rgyur gtan 'khel pa gang legs byung 'dug da res 'bul rgyu'i gras su ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma gcig tsam ma zad phyag rtags kyang mang po yod pa chu thog nas dbor bar da lta 'byor min la brten rjes su lha sar 'bul chog cing / sku nyid mchog sku 'khor dang bcas mang tsam yod stabs sngon la phebs na legs pa dang / kho bo mi nyung shas las med stabs rjes la yong ngo zhes lan du gsungs/de nas nyi gnyis tsam gyi rjes su tā la'i bla ma dung dkar dgon nas thon par kho bo dang / lo yu hung gnyis phebs skyel du bcar/nyin gcig gnyis tsam gyi rjes la krang cing u dang bcas kyang lha sa'i phyogs su thon cing / krang cing u bcas gro mor 'byor skabs sa gnas srid gzhung nas tā la'i bla ma'i chibs ra nas yin ces zhon rta sha shed legs pa gnyis bskyal yong ste gcig krang cing u dang / gcig lo yu tung gis lha sa'i 4/5

bar du zhon par ma zad/ /954lo'i pe cin du ma thon bar du de ga rang la zhon/gro mo sa bab cung dma' bas shing nags stug po yod pa dang / de nas rim gyis je mthor song ste phag rir 'byor skabs spyi khri bzhi stong lhag tsam yod tshod la skam shas che bar ma zad grang ngar yang cung zhig 'dug skabs der kho bo gzhon nu dar ma'i skabs yin stabs/ gro mo nas lha sar slebs slebs bar gdong nas pags pa rim pa re bud pa ma gtogs gzhan gyi dka' ngal cher ma byung /kho bo'i 'byung khungs gong gses zhing pa'i mi tshang nas yin stabs gang du 'byor sa de'i zhing pa'i khyim tshang la lta 'dod chen po byung ste lam brgyud du zhing pa'i khyim tshang mang po zhig la bltas/ gro mo grol nas rgyal rtse'i bar sa bab mtho la lhags pa tsha zhing grang ngar che tsam yod par mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'ang ha cang skyo bar brten skyes pho mo mang che ba stod hreng yin zhing nyin bstud mar phyi las byed dgos stabs/ ma gzhi bod rigs kyang e she ya'i khongs gtogs sha mdangs ser po'i gras yin kyang de rgyud kyi mi rnams sha mdangs nag po ha lam a phe ri ma'i mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug lhag par byis pa pho mo med par gcer bu yin par/ bza' btung ha cang zhan par brten tshang ma lto ba che la yan lag phra ba/ ha lam lha khang khag gi rtsigs ngos su bris pa'i srid pa'i 'khor lo'i dmyal ba'i yi dwags kyi bzo 'dra rkyang 'dug par/ de dag mthong tshe kho bo hang sang zhing skyi g.ya' bar byung / de rgyud kyi sdod khang gi gnas tshul kyang / sa cha rer slebs dus der lcags ri mtho ba'i khang khungs gru bzhi ma re yod par dang du 'dzul skabs khang pa che tsam zhig yod pa'i mi 4 6

tshang de'i 'dzin chas yag tsam dang / lto gos kyang yag tsam yod bzo 'dug na'ang / mang che ba ni khang chung nag po yar 'dzul sa'i sgo dang dkar cha yong sa'i khung bu gcig las med cing / khang pa'i dkyil du sog ma dang rtswa ras snam bu hril ro sogs spungs nas yod pa zhig 'dug par/ der yod pa'i mi sna zhig la khyed tsho'i nyal sa gang du yod ces dris par/ de ga rang yin zhes sog phung de la mdzub mo gtad byung bar de bas kyang hang sang pa zhig byung /kho bo'i pha yul kyang spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpon rigs kyi gnya' gnon bshu gzhog 'og lto gos skyo thag chod yin kyang 'di ga'i mi dmangs kyi lto gos nang bzhin skyo ba med stabs/ 'di ga'i mi rnams nyi ma 'khyol thabs ga 'dra byed kyi yod dam bsam pa byung /tā la'i bla ma dang 'khor bcas rgyal rtse'i dpal 'khor chos sder nyin shas chos phyogs kyi bya bar bsdad kyang / krang cing u dang bcas nyin gcig las ma bsdad par/ sngon la zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin lha sar bde bar 'byor/ krang cing u dang bcas lha sar 'byor skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha sa'i nub ngos skyid tshal klu lding du gur phub ste lha sar yod pa'i dpon rigs che khag phebs bsus yong 'dug pa dang / de nas phebs bsu'i mdzad sgo stabs bde tshar rjes lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs tshang mas kyang gur chen po zhig phub yod par der yang khyug tsam bsdad/ lha sa'i mang tshogs ha lam yongs rdzogs rgyan gos gzab spros dang bcas skyid tshal klu lding nas krang cing u'i sdod gnas khri smon shag bar gyi 'gro lam g.yas g.yon du dpung bsgrigs te bsdad 'dug de ni krang cing u dang bcas par bsu bar yong ba ma yin par/ de sngar gung khran tang skor gyi dgrog gtam mang po zhig go 'dug par/ 417

de yang snying ga 'dra yin min blta bar yong ba yin 'dug kha shas kyis 4gung khyad gung khran :zer ba ma gtogs rgya mi rang red 'dug ga zhes bshad mkhan yang byung 'dug skad phyis su thos/tā la'i bla ma dang 'khor bcas zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bdun la lha sar 'byor bar/ lo yu hung dang kho bo gnyis skyid tshang klu lding du bsu bar phyin/lha sa'i grong mi ha lam yongs rdzogs phyir don ste skyid tshal klu lding nas po ta la'i bar dpung bsgrigs yod par/ rgya rigs tshong pa'i dga' bcu'i gur med kyang / gdan sa gsum gyi ser phreng gdug rgyal mtshan sogs bsgrengs pa dang bcas po ta la'i bar du 'dugazla ba dgu pa'i tshes dgu la/ bod bskyod dmag sde'i mdun skyod dmag dpung de bka' bkod pa dang / chab srid u yon gcig lcog yin pa'i wang chi mad khrid de lha sar 'byor bar/ lha sa'i shar ngos su sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs khag gcig dang bcas pas bsu ba byas par/ lo yu hung dang kho bo gnyis kyang der bcar/krang cing u dang bcas lha sar 'byor rjes/ lha sar sdod mkhan dpon rigs che gas srid tshab blo bzang bkra shis dang / klu khang ba gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang gi thog sa gnyis pa'i khang khungs shig tu gsol ston bshams te mgron bsu byas par/ gsol ston grog rtse gru bzhi zhig la bsgrigs 'dug cing / srid tshab gnyis mtho sar bsdad pa dang / krang cin u dang lo yu hung gnyis dma' sar bzhag 'dug par ha cang ma 'os pa zhig 'dug stabs/sdod gnas su phyir log ste kho bos sa gnas srid gzhung gi sne shan ldan bya tshang la gong gi gnas tshul dag bshad cing / byed stangs de ni kho pa tsho'i snang 4/8

ngor rang nyid mtho sa dang gzhan dag dma' sa la bzhag ste che nyams byas pa'i tshod yin kyang / don la blun po'i tshul lugs dmar rjen du bstan 'dugagang lags zer na sku mgron gsol ston du gdan 'dren zhus par spyir btang gi lugs la sku mgron mtho sa dang / sbyin bdag dma' sar 'dzin dgos pa skye bo phal ba zhig gis kyang shes zhing / bod gzhung gi dpon rigs mtho gras kyis de tsam zhig kyang mi shes pa dang lhag par krang cing u ni rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku tshab yin par de bas gus zhabs byed dgos pa yin bzhin du blun rtags de 'dra dmar rjen du bstan par nga rang yang bod rigs yin pa'i lar rgya'i ngos nas ngo tsha po byung / zhes gang bsam snang med du bshad kyang / ldan bya tshang pa ni/ klu khang ba dang spun nye yin stabs de don klu khang par bshad 'dug de'i phyis su thengs gcig kho bo klu khang pa'i shag la 'gro dgos byung bar/ klu khang pa'i mgon khang du yar 'dzul skabs/ klu khang ba gdan nas yar langs te lo tswa ba chen po phebs bzhag yar phebs yar phebs zhes gus tshul che tsam bstan byung bar/ sku mgron la gus lugs byed dgos pa shes mdog bstan pa yin tshod 'dugaganyis pa/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun ji bzhin lag len byas pa'i skor/zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog sku 'khor dang bcas 〈 gros mthun 〉yig rigs ngo ma bsnams te lha 4/9

sar phebs byung bar/ sngon du phebs pa'i wang chi med dang bcas bcings bkrol dmag dpon dmag gang 'tsham zhig gis phebs bsu gang gzab zhus khar/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang sngar lugs ltar phebs bsu yod par ma zad da res dmigs bsal gyis phebs bsu'i sar bka' blon zhig kyang yod skad 'dug pa phyis su thos/zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer bzhi nas tshes nyer dgu'i bar bod sa gnas srig gzhung gi 'thus mi nga phod mchog dang bcas pas sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' shag dang / yig tshang / rtsis khang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus dang bcas pa mi ngo sum brgya tsam la krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mis zhi mthun bka' mol zhib lhug gnang mthar/ 〈 krung dbyangs mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la ming rtags bkod pa'i gnas tshul zhib par zhus shing / der 'dus pa'i dpon rigs rnams kyi gros sdur zhib par byas rjes mang che bas gros mthun ming rtags bkod pa gang legs byung 'dug khar/ dpon rigs kha shas kyis sngar lam ltar mdzad rjes bzhag mkhan la pha gzhis sprod rgyus mtshon pa'i gzengs bstod byed dgos zhes gros 'go bton kyang / nga phod mchog dang bcas pas de ltar dgos min yin tshul gsungs 'dugs gnas srid gzhung dang gros sdur byas rjes zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin krang cing us nor gling du ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku tshab zhus te tā la'i bla mar rtsa che'i phyag rtags rnams 'bul rgyur gtan 'khel zhing / ji ltar 'bul lugs skor la shod res cung zhig byed dgos byung yang / mthar sems gros gcig tu 420

mthun te/ mtho kru'u zhi'i sku par gyis mtshon pa'i phyag rtags rnams 'bul skabs/ tā la'i bla ma yar langs te zhu rgyu dang / de rjes tā la'i bla ma bzhugs khri'i thog 'khod rjes krang cing u sger gyis bod lugs la rtsis 'jog gis sku gsung thug rten dang mjal dar bcas 'bul rgyur gtan 'khel ba ltar gnang /de dag grub rjes tā la'i bla ma dang krang cing u gnyis gzim chung mjal 'phrad gnang skabs krang cing us/ 〈 gros mthun〉skor la khong nyid gyis krung dbyang la zhu tsam gnang dgos tshod 'dug ces par tā la'i bla mas/ kho bos ma'o kru'u zhir 〈 gros mthun〉lag len ji bzhin zhu rgyu'i glog 'phrin zhig 'bul rtsis rang yod ces gsungs/krang cing us zla bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nas zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis par 'bras spungs dang / se ra/ dga' ldan bcas gdan sa gsum dang / rgyud grwa stod smad/ sman rtsis khang bcas la 'bul ba phul ba dang / lha sa'i khrom gyi sprang slong la sbyin pa btang / sman rtsis khang du 'bul ba phul skabs/ bla sman pa mkhyen rab no bu dam pa sku ngo mas sne len zhus shing / rgyal dbang lnga pa'i skabs kyi sde srid bod kyi rig gnas kun la mkhas pa'i mnga' rnyed pa des bod kyi rtsa ba'i sman gzhung 〈 rgyud bzhi〉gzhir bzung mdzad pa'i bosngon gzhir bzung bris pa'i rgyud bzhi sman thang yongs rdzogs tshoms chen du bkal de spyan phab zhus par kho bos de sngon mthong rgyu lta ci/ thos kyang ma myong ba zhig mig lam du byung bar bag chags zab mo byung / phyis su rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i god chag byung ba'i skabs su rang re bod rigs kyi rig gnas gnad chen sman thang de nyid ga 'dra byung yod dam bsam pa'i sems khral chen po byung yang / stabs legs pa zhig la sman thang la god chag ma byung 421

bar 'dug pa thos pas dga' tshor chen po byung ba ma zad/ phyis su krung dbyang 'phrod brten las khungs nas mkhyen 'dug pa ma zad gso rigs la mkhas pa'i mi sna kha shas ched btang gis zhib 'jug byas khar/ cha tshang zhig par yang brgyab ste spyin shog bzhag 'dug cing / de dus nyin gcig 〈 dpyad gzhi'i tshags par 〉thog sngar su'u len gyi khongs gtogs sog po pu re thad par rgyud bzhi'i sman thang cha tshang zhig rnyed 'dug par/ de 'phral mo si kho'o su'u len krung dbyang srid gzhung la zhus shing / su'u len krung dbyang srid gzhung nas de ma thag mo si kho'o ru bzhes pa'i gsar 'gyur 'khod 'dug par/de ni rgyal ba bcu gsum pa'i skabs su sog po bu re thad pa ming la rdo rje zer ba zhig gis rgyal ba'i mtshan zhabs byas 'dug pa des 'dra bshu zhig phar khyer phyin pa yin tshod 'dug de'i dus su byams pa 'phrin las mchog gis bod ljongs sman rtsis khang gi thugs 'gan bzhes 'dug par de 'phral khong la gsar 'gyur de'i gras zhus par 〈 rgyud bzhi 〉sman thang de ma nyid la par skrun 'grems spel gnang song ba/ sman thang de nyid kyi par skrun bdag dbang rang rer yod par bstan la/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas rtsa chen de thor bshig tu mi 'gro ba'i dge mtshan byung / 'di ni lo mang po'i rjes kyi gnas tshul red/'dir skabs su bab par dga' ldan dgon par 'gyed btang ste lha sar log pa'i lam du bud med cig gis rta zhig khrid de 'gro bzhin 'dug pa zhib par blta dus/ mo ni pe cin du na bod rigs zhib 'jug 'dzin grwar mnyam du slob sbyong byed myong mkhan le'ang wu khrin zhes pa de yin 'dug mos kho bo mthong ba dang gzhan gang yang mi bshad par/ zla ba gsum gyi ring la gdong 422

yang bkru rgyu ma byung zhes bshad cing / don la yang mos dus rgyun mig shel brgyab par/ mig shel gyi grib snang 'khel sa sha mdangs dkar po dang / de min tshang ma sngon nag yin pa gdong ris khra bo byung 'dug pa bud med shes yon can zhig zi khron nas bod ljongs su rkang thang mar le bar stong phrag du mar zla ba kha shas skyod de bod ljongs bcings bkrol gyi ched du dka' ngal ci tsam myangs pa de nas shes thub/zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu bzhir tā la'i bla mas ma'o kru'u zhir glog 'phrin btang ste bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi dmangs tshang mas bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun la srung rtsis dang 'brel/ma'o kru'u zhis 'go khrid gnang ba'i 'og tu mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag bod ljongs su bskyod de rgyal khab kyi mtha' mtshams brtan por srung rgyur rogs ram zhu rgyu dang 'brel btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen bod nas mthar skrod btang te rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur la srung skyob zhu rgyu yin zhes 'khod 'dug cing / glog 'phrin yi ge ni bod shog dkar gtsang legs pa zhig gi thog sngar lam ltar shog 'gor stong cha che tsam gyi sar ris mo zhig kyang bris 'dug par/ kho bos de 'phral rgya yig tu bsgyur te krang cing us gzigs rjes glog 'phrin thog btang / tshes nyi shu drug la ma'o kru'u zhis tā la'i bla mar 'phrin lan 'byor par/ khyed tshos bod zhi bas bcings bkrol gyi gros mthun lag len thog 'bad brtson gnang bar snying nas thugs rje che ba dang bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin zhes 'khod 'dug par krang cing sus gzigs rjes kho bos de 'phral bod yig tu bsgyur te sa gnas srid gzhung la btang /zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu drug nyin krang go hwa dang / than gon san gyis 423

'go khrid gnang ba'i bod bskyod kyi dmag dpung lha sar 'byor bar dmag dpung gi ru bsgrigs la gzigs zhib dang bcas mdzad sgo gzab rgyas gnang bar sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon rnam pa dang / ser skya dpon rigs mang tshogs dang bcas mi grangs khri phrag kha shas kyi dga' bsu zhus/zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la nub byang ngos nas bod du bskyod pa'i dmag tshan bco brgyad pa'i yan lag dmag dpung zi ling yon phan ming dang / chab srid u yon mu hring krung gnyis kyis khrid de lha sar 'byor/ khong tsho dang mnyam du paṇa chen nang sgang gi sngon bskyod mi sna brgya skor zhig kyang lha sar 'byor bas/ sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs khag gcig dang mang tshogs gang 'tsham dang bcas pas dga' bsu zhus/gsum pa/ 〈 gros mthun〉lag len byed pa'i ngang du 'thab rtsod yang yang byung ba/〈 gros mthun〉lag len byed par thog mar 'phrad pa'i gnad don ni/〈 gros mthun〉gzhir bzung bod ljongs dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang /bod ljongs dmag khul khang 'dzugs rgyu'i skor yin 'dug krang cing u dang /krang go hwa/ phan ming bcas dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid tshab gnyis dang bka' blon rnam pa bcas lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi thog khang zhig tu lhan 'dzoms gros bsdur gnang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi mi snas bod ljongs dmag srid u yon lhan khang dang dmag khul khang 'dzugs rgyur dogs pa chen po 'dug stabs/ krang cing us gtsos de don skor la go bskon 'grel 424

bshad ngang ring byas kyang / dmag srid u yon lhan khang thad la bsam blo gcig mthun ma byung yang / dmag khul khang gi thad bcings bkrol dmag bod ljongs su 'byor cing mtha' mtshams sa gnas khag la skyod de bca' sdod byas zin stabs/ de dag la gcig gyur kyis bka' bkod byed mkhan las khungs shig med du mi rung ba yin stabs blo sems gcig tu mthun tsam byung song yang / dmag khul khang 'dzugs rgyu'i rten 'brel gyi tshogs chen la bod dmag kyang zhugs rgyur/ rgyal khab kyi skar lnga dar dmar bod dmag gis kyang ru sner 'phyar dgos rgyu'i thad/ klu khang bas sma ra dkar po byug bzhin du brjod don kho pa tshor chab mdor mgo bor brdungs nas dmar tshal dgu tshal bzos bzhin du/ da cha dar dmar de ru sner 'phyar bcug na nyan e yong zhes par/ krang go hwa shin tu khros te dmar tshal dgu tshal sus su la bzos pa red/ bod ljongs ni krung go mnga' khongs yin bzhin du krung go mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsrung ba'i ched du bod ljongs su bskyod par/ sngon thon myul zhib byed mkhan bcu grangs zhig bod dmag gis g.yo bzung dang 'brel grod pa bshags te nang cha phyi la bton pa sogs kyis sdug gsod tshod med byas par khyod klu khang bas mi shes sam/ zhes nan gyis gsungs (kho bo'i go thos su byung ba ltar na bod dmag gis gdug gsod btang ba'i gras su de sngar pe cin du bod rigs zhib 'jug 'dzin grwar slob sbyong gnang myong mkhan bod rigs gzhon nu brtson 'grus zhes pa skyes gzugs legs shing / rig pa gsal ba/ sems rgyud bzang ba/ kun la mthun pa zhig yod pa de'ang yod skad 'dug par/ 'di skabs sdug bsngal dang bcas sems la wal ler dran byung /) skabs 'dir 5mi dmangs 'thus mi yin zhes 425

pa'i rdzun 'bag g.yog mkhan log spyod kyi tshogs pa zhig lha sar byung 'dug pa de 'gog sdom bya dgos pa'i skor/ gros bsdur byas par yang blo sems gcig mthun ma byung zhing / 'di nyin gyi gros mtshams de gar bzhagade'i phyi nyin gtsug lag khang du mu mthud gros sdur gnang skabs phan ming gis gros 'go bton par klu khang bas 〈 gros mthun 〉lag len thad la bkag 'gog rkyang byed par sku tshab krang gis tā la'i bla mar bsam gros dang 'brel klu khang ba'i srid tshab kyi las 'gan phab par gnang zhes bsam gros bton par blo bzang bkra shis kyis kyang des na kho bo yang chabs cig tu go phab btang shog ces bshad/ krang cing us de don tā la'i bla mar gros 'go bton par/tā la'i bla mas kyang mos mthun byas te srid tshab gnyis kyi go gnas phab/〈 gros mthun 〉lag len gyi 'gag gnad bsangs pa'i rjes su zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la mi grangs khri phrag long ba'i tshogs chen zhig tshogs te krang cing us krung dbyang gi sku tshab gnang ste bod ljongs dmag khul btsugs pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang khar/ dmag khul bka' bkod khang gi bka' bkod pa krang go hwa dang / bka' bkod pa gzhon pa dang po nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ gnyis pa mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas/ gsum pa khrang pen ko'i bcas dang chab srid u yon than gon san/ gzhon pa phan ming /wang chi med bcas/ jus 'don pa li co'o/ chab srid pu'u yi kru'u rin le'o krin go/ rgyab phyogs dmag dpung gi bka' bkod pa dang chab srid u yon gcig lcog khrin ming yi bcas yin pa'i khyab bsgrags kyang gnang / bod dmag gis gangs seng gi ri mo 'khod pa'i dar cha dang / skar lnga dar dmar mnyam du bsgrengs te tshogs chen du slebs/ 426

zla ba gsum pa'i nang krang cing u bod ljongs su bzhugs rgyu krung dbyang nas gtan 'bebs gnang thog krang cing us krung gung bod ljongs las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci dang / krang go hwa dang than gon san phan ming hru'u ci gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i 'gan 'khur rgyu'ang krung dbyang nas gtan 'bebs gnang /srid tshab gnyis kyis bkag 'gog byas par brten rgyu mi dmangs tshogs pa zhes pa de thor rgyu lta ci kho pa gnyis kyis lkog tu ngan skul byed kyi yod pa je gsal yin khar/ zla ba gsum pa'i nang lha sar zing long zhig kyang bzos par ma zad/ kho pa tshos 〈zhu yig〉cig kyang bka' shag la phul zhing / zhu don gtso bor/ 〈 gros mthun〉la ngo rgol dang / mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag phyir 'then byed dgos pa sogs 'khod yod khar/ kho pa tsho khrom bskor du'ang phyin te lha sar zing longs che tsam byung stabs tshong khang rnams kyang 'khyug tsam ring sgo brgyab pa byung 'dug skabs der dkrog gtam sna tshogs shig gang sa nas 'khyar yong khar/ bod bskyod mi sna mang che bas bod skad ma shes par brten/ des kyang dkrog gtam mang ba'i rgyu zhig tu chags 'dug khar/ phan tshun skad brda mi 'phrod pa'i rkyen de rjes su'ang yang yang byung song /phami dmangs tshogs pa'i mizhu yig bka' shag nas krang cing u'i sar bskyal/kho bos rgya yig tu bsgyur/ krang cing us zhu yig de dang / gnas tshul gzhan rnams gzhir bzung tā la'i bla mar yi ge bsrings te 6 mi dmangs tshogs pa 'dzugs mi chog pa dang / zing longs zhod 'jag gtong dgos pa bcas sku nyid nas bka' shag la bkod khyab yod pa zhes pa'i yi ge kho bor thengs kha shas skyel bcug pa ma zad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i nang krang cing u sku ngo ma yang 427

zhabs zhu kha shas dang bcas po tā lar phebs te/ dzimi dmangs tshogs pa7zhes pa des gnod 'tshe byas rigs bkag sdom kyi rtsa tshig 'grem spel dang 'brel zing long zhod 'jags gtong dgos lugs bcas bka' mol gnang zhing /tā la'i bla mas kyang de don bka' shag la gnas tshul gtong rgyur khas len byas/zla ba lnga pa'i nang bka' shag nas ra mi dmangs tshogs pa mizhes pa de log spyod kyi tshogs pa yin pas bkag sdom bya rgyu'i rtsa tshig bkram pa red/

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa'i snga rjes kyi mthong thos thor bu/cin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang ba ni bod sa gnas dang mes rgyal dbar gyi 'brel lam gyi bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin zhing / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas lo lnga bcu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i dus 'dir blo yul gyi 'char sgo grangs las 'das shing sems kyi tshor ba sna mang ldan par gyur/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong thabs kyi 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ming rtags 'god mkhan 'thus mi'i las bya zhig dang /lhag bsam rnam dag gi rgyal gces mi sna zhig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams 'di'i dpang po zhig bcas yin pa'i cha nas zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo lnga bcu 'khor ba'i skabs 'dir/ ngas brjid rlabs ldan pa'i dus tshigs su rtsis te 'dir bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu dang sbrags de'i snga rjes kyi 'thab rtsod gnas tshul dang tang krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i khrid ston 'og da phan lo lnga bcu'i ring bod du yar rgyas byung ba'i grub 'bras skor rags tsam zhu rgyu yin/gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod mi rigs kyi chab srid 'tsho 429

ba'i nang gal che'i lo rgyus kyi don snying zab mo ldan pa'i bya ba zhig yin la rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi chab srid 'tsho ba'i nang gi don chen zhig kyang yin par ngas rtag tu ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod/ tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar/ bod ljongs 'di bzhin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas shig yin la rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi lho nub tu gnas pa'i chab srid dang dmag don gang cir rtsa 'gangs che ba'i rgyal sgo chen po zhig kyang yin zhing / bod mi dmangs la cha mtshon na'ang krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yin zhes the tshom med par bshad chogabod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas da bar gyi lo rgyus la dran gso byed dgos pa'i dmigs yul ni da lta'i mi rabs 'di tsam ma zad mi rabs rjes ma tsho la'ang lo rgyus shes su bcug nas bka' drin bsam shes thub pa bya rgyu ma zad/mi tshang mas gros mthun bzhag rjes kyi rgyal kha'i 'bras bu dang nyin bzhin je bzang du 'gro ba'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba dngos mthong skabs gsar rnying bsdur ba dang dgos nges kyi snying don shes su bcug nas bde sdug gi 'byung rtsa gting zab rtogs thub pa dang / tang gi 'go khrid dang bod bskyod mi rabs sngon ma'i mdzad rjes gsal shes thub pa bcas byas te lo rgyus la phyogs sdom dang da lta'i bde skyid 'tsho bar gces spras byed thub pa'i ched du yin/bod kyi las don byed phyogs thad tang krung dbyang gi bka' slob ltar thams cad bod kyi gnas tshul dang bstun dgos la spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can mngon 'gyur thub pa byed sgo'i skor mi so so'i phrag thog tu babs 430

pa'i las 'gan mang tsam sgrub dgos pa de yang mi rigs dang / chos lugs/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus/ mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang / yul lung gi cha rkyen sogs gang sar sla bcos su ma song bar ngos 'dzin gting zab byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog bya spyod mtha' dag don thog tu 'khyol dgos pa de red/ /959lo'i zla 3nas bzung bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs rtsa gtor btang nas 'thab rtsod rim pa brgyud mthar da cha bod ljongs hril por 'gyur ldog mngon gsal can thob pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal red/ rang nyid kyang spyi tshogs rnying pa nas byung ba'i mi zhig song tsang spyi tshogs gsar rnying gi 'phel 'grib byung stangs la rgyun du bsam blo 'khor bzhin pa dper na rang nyid /947lor mdo smad spyi khyab bka' blon lha klu dang nga phod rnam gnyis kyi las bya'i khongs su chab mdor sdod skabs rgyal nang du gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og mes rgyal skam sa chen po'i khyon la bcings 'grol gtong dus bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin srid gzhung gi 'go gtso stag brag dang mtho rim phyogs gtogs nyung shas kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang ngan 'brel byas nas mes rgyal kha bral gtong rgyu'i thabs jus spel te sngar yod bod dmag khag gcig dang / gsar 'dzugs grong drag dmag sgar thog ser dmag ces pa gra sgrig gis lha ri 'gor btang ba ma zad/ chab mdo khul du yul dmag bsdu rub kyi mda' tshab drung rigs ser skya ched bskos kyis mes rgyal la kha gtad gcog rgyu'i don du mdo smad ri bo che dang / ldan khog 'bri chu'i rgyud kyi sde dge skam thog dmar khams sogs sa gnas khag la dmag don gra sgrig dang sa srung btang ba sogs kyi gnas tshul lo na phran bu'i rgan tsam dang spyi tshogs 'phel sgrib la bsam blo gtong mkhan phal che bas gsal 43/

por mkhyen nges red/ mi kha shas la da lta'i bde skyid kho na las lo rgyus kyi 'thab rtsod la do snang dang shes rtogs bya rgyu mi 'dang ba'i zhan cha yod nges la brten ngas dus tshod 'dir dran gso zhu ba'i go skabs 'di spyad nas lo rgyus kyi dngos don phran bu zol med kyi sgo nas ngo sprod zhus na snyam pa byung /bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rgyu'i snga nub ste sa glang (/949)lor rgyal yongs skam sa phal mo cher bcings 'grol btang zin 'phral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis tang krung dbyang gi dgongs gzhi'i dgos pa'i don snying ste bod mi dmangs rnams yar longs shig da nas bzung krung go 'di bzhin phyed bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dang phyed mi ser spel yul gyi lcags sgrog las yongs su grol nas stobs che'i krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes zin zhing mi dmangs rnams rang khyim rang bdag dang / rang lus rang dbang / mi rigs 'dra mnyam/ rgyal khab kyi bdag po bcas su gyur zin zhes rlung 'phrin thog nas zhib cing phra ba brgyud bsgrags mdzad pas rgyal gces mi sna tshud pa'i bod mi phal che ba bsam brjod las 'das pa'i spro ba 'phel ba smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang skabs de'i bod kyi dbang sgyur mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas kyis krung gor dgrar 'dzin gyi phyi rgyal stobs shugs dang ngan 'brel gyis smyo pho zad mo la thug kyang rgol 'dzing bya rgyu yin zhes bshad de gung khran tang la ngo rgol byed ched sa khul khag la dmag gra sgrig byas te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la kha gtad gcog rgyu'i ngan jus bshams pa sogs 'gog srung gi shugs snon gzhi rgya gang che ba brgyab pa ma zad/ sa cha 'ga' shas su gdong gtugs kyi 'khrug zing yang byung ba red/'on kyang krung dbyang gis khong yangs dkyel che'i byams brtse'i thugs 'khur 432

gang zab kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung la go bskon blo 'gug gnang ste phyogs gcig nas mtho rim log spyod pa'i dzig nyams gcog thub pa dang mes rgyal gyi lho nub brtan srung ched mu mthud dpung 'jug mdzad pa dang / gcig shos nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ched sa gnas srid gzhung la go bskon slob gso gnang ba brgyud mthar krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i gtso bzhugs 'thus mi li lu'i han dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtso bzhugs gnang ba sogs phyogs gnyis ma'i 'thus mi tshang 'dzoms kyis zhi gros legs par gnang ba brgyud/ 1951 lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin 〈 gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la dngos su ming rtags bkod thub pa byung zhing /dus de nas bzung ma'o kru'u zhi'i dgongs pa'i 'od zer bod ljongs mthor 'phros te bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul 'ching thag las grol ba dang sdug bsngal mun nag gi gnas las thar te gzhi nas krung hwa mi rigs byings dang 'dra ba'i mthun sgril dang /mdza' grogs/ rogs res kyi sgo nas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du gzhi nas 'od gsal bde skyid kyi phyogs su bskyod 'go tshugs pa red/ gong zla'i tshes 24 nyin gyi dgong mo ma'o kru'u zhis 〈 bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel zhu ched nga tsho gros mthun 'jog mkhan tshor gsol ston zhig gshom gnang gis gsol ston thog mtho kru'u zhis gsung bshad kyang gnang song / nga rang lhan bcar las bya'i khongs mi yin pas skabs de'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung bshad nang don kha shas da lta'ang gsal por nges pa ste rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs 433

rnams mthun sgril byed dgos pa dang / bod mi rigs nang khul mthun sgril byed dgos pa/ lo ngo brgya phrag kha shas ring krung go'i mi rigs khag dbar mthun sgril med cing / lhag par du rgya rigs dang bod rigs dbar mthun sgril med pa dang / bod mi rigs nang khul mthun sgril med pa bcas byung ba ni log spyod man ju srid gzhung dang / cang ce hre srid gzhung gis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig red/ da cha krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og krung go'i mi dmangs kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang rgyal nang gi log spyod dbang sgyur gtor pham btang rjes gzhi nas rgya che'i mthun sgril mngon du 'gyur ba red/ mthun sgril de rigs ni spun zla'i brtse sems ldan pa'i mthun sgril zhig yin pa las phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan la gnya' gnon byed pa zhig ma red/ da lta mthun sgril gyi rmang gzhi'i thog mi rigs khag dbar chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs gang cir yar rgyas dang gong 'phel 'gro rgyu red ces mdzub ston gnang song //'on kyang 〈 gros mthun 〉rtsis med gtong rgyu'i re ngan 'chang mkhan mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas de tshos ngan gshis mkhregs bzung gis lha sar bca' sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mkho sgrub la dka' ngal bzos khar/ kha bral ring lugs pa'i 'go gtso srid tshab klu khang pas 6 grod khog ltogs pa de dmag pham pa las bzod par dka' ba zhig red mices mngon sum 'dzems med kyi tshig rtsub kyang brjod yod rung / skabs der krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gis sa stong gsar sbol sogs rang mgo rang thon gyi bya thabs la brten nas dka' ngal dang 'gog rkyen khyad bsad kyis rkang pa brtan por 'dzugs thub pa byung ba red/ rang nyid la cha mtshon na 1950lo'i 434

zla 10tshes 19nyin chab mdor bcings 'grol 'go dmag thog mar 'byor skabs gung khran tang gi srid jus mi shes pa dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i dkrog gtam sna tshogs kyi bag chags dbang gis gung khran tang la dogs 'char che zhing / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la'ang yid ches med mkhan zhig yin/ 'on kyang bcings 'grol btang tshun sgrig 'dzugs dang gsar brje'i blo mthun rgan rabs mang pos tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang gsar brje'i rgyu mtshan sogs gang ci'i slob ston 'og gzhi nas gsar brje'i bgrod lam thog bskyod 'go tshugs pa dang de nas bzung gsar brje'i sngon thon du ma'i mdzad rjes kyi ba spu tsam la'ang 'gran nus dben rung rang gi shes nus yod rgu spyad de sems chung ngang tang gi bka' don bsgrub rgyu'i chod sems 'dzugs thub pa'i mi zhig tu gyur ba ma zad/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis kyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 'jog skabs dbu bzhugs 'thus mi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog gi las byar rgyal sa pe cin du ngo bskyod zhu mkhan zhig yin zhing / de'i gong du chab mdo bcings 'grol btang nas nyin shas song mtshams chab mdor sngon bskyod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go khrid wang chi ma'e dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gnyis nas phran rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang bka' mgron bsam gling pa gnyis ming 'don mdzad de lha sa dar chab mdo'i bar gyi 'grul lam chad pa bskyar mthud yong thabs dang / nga phod mchog gis sa gnas srid gzhung la zhi ba'i sgo nas gros mol gnang na dge mtshan che lugs tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag la snyan 'bul zhu bar nyin mtshan ltos med rta rkyang byas nas lha sar ngo bcar zhu mkhan zhig kyang yin zhing / 435

lhag par gros mthun 'jog skabs kyi las bya yin tsang / skabs de'i gnas tshul thos pa tsam min par dngos mthong mi sna'i gras shig yin par bsnyen bden dbang mtshon phyir thos tshod long gtam tsam min par gang dran rags bsdus shig zhus na/ skabs der btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan jus 'og bod kyi mtho rim log spyod mi na nyung shas kyis ngan sems khog bcangs kyi sgo nas 1953lo'i zla 3tshes 3/ nyin mi dmangs 'thus tshogs brdzus ma skong tshogs kyis mi dmangs 'thus tshogs zer ba'i ming thog nas gong lo'i zla 4tshes 1 nyin gyi mtshan mor mi grangs brgya phrag kha shas bsdu rub byas nas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cin wu'u bzhugs yul sa 'du tshang gi mtha' bskor ba dang mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i 'bod tshig sgrog pa/bcings 'grol dmag bod nas phyir 'then byed dgos/ bod kyi lam lugs 'gyur ldog gtong mi chog zer ba sogs smyo ham chen pos skad brgyab nas spyi tshogs thog zing cha thengs dang po de bslangs shing / de'i skabs phran rang nyid kyis krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung bar gyi 'brel mthud sne shan gyi las 'gan 'khur yod pas skabs de'i 'thab rtsod kyi rgyud rim rnams mthong thos gsal por byung zhing dza drag ha cang che ba'i skabs der krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cin lu'u dang /bod dmag khul khang gi si ling yon krang go hwa/ chab srid u yon than kon san bcas nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon dang drung rtsis rnams la rgyu mtshan yod pa dang phan pa yod pa/ mtshams tshig yod pa bcas kyi rtsa don la brten nas go bskon blo 'gug gi slob gso thengs mang gnang ba ma zad/sa gnas srid gzhung nas mi dmangs 'thus tshogs brdzus ma'i bya ngan 'phral 436

mar bkag sdom byed dgos pa'i mdzub ston yang nan po gnang bar brten kho pa tsho'i lkog g.yo'i mthil brtol ba red/ lkog tu ngan jus 'don mkhan klu khang ba dang blo bzang bkra shis gnas dbyung btang stabs mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs la rdung deg tsha nan phog pa dang / bod kyi las don sgrub phyogs thad rmang gzhi legs tsam 'ding thub pa byung song / de nas bod kyi las don byed phyogs gang cir mtho rim mi sna dang zhib mol gyis lo drug bcos bsgyur 'gyangs rgyu ma zad/ slad kyang gong 'og tshang ma'i blo mos dang bstun nas bcos bsgyur byas 'thus sogs krung dbyang nas khongs yangs dkyel che'i dgongs bzhes bla med bskyangs rung / ma'o kru'u zhis 6 log spyod kyi rigs shig yin phyin gzhan gyis ma gtor na kho rang 'gyel gyi ma red ces gsungs pa ltar bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas kyis rang nyid pham par sdug 'khur ma thub par slar yang thabs brgya jus stong gis gtor bshig btang mthar/ 1959lo'i zla 3par bod ljongs su sgo kun nas drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs te bod mi dmangs kyi mdun du log spyod pa'i gdong ris dmar rjen du bton stabs kho tsho ni bod ljongs phyir tshong dang / mes rgyal kha bral/ kha dan rgyab bskyur/ mi gsod me rgyag mi chos dang bral ba bcas kyi ngo log pa nyung shas khag gcig yin pa bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams kyis gsal por mthong ba red/ skabs der rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas bka' phab pa ltar bod sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag nas bod mi dmangs dang dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis dus thung nang zing 'khrug snying 'jags btang stabs rgya che'i zhing bran rnams yar langs bcings 'grol thob pa dang /dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur gyi las don tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang spel thub pa byung ba 437

ma zad/ rgyal gces yar thon gyi mtho rim mi sna tshos kyang bcos sgyur byed par gong bkur yi rangs zhus pa sogs mdor na bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang bar log spyod dang yar thon dbar gyi 'thab rtsod ji rnyed cig byung yod pas de dag re re bzhin 'god du mi lang /bod sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang las don mi snas dka' tshegs che ba'i khor lug gang 'dra zhig la mi ltos par rgyun sring lhod med kyis mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi mthun sgril srid jus la snga phyi bar gsum du nan tan gyis srung brtsi zhus te lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun lag bstar byed pa dang / don dngos bya spyod thog bod rigs mi dmangs kyi yul srol goms gshis la brtsi 'jog dang / nyo tshong drang bzhag mang tshogs kyi lag nas khab skud tsam yang mi len pa/ chos dad mang tshogs la brtsi 'jog dgon pa dang rig dngos rjes shul la srung skyob bcas gnang yod cing / dka' dub dang ngal dub kyis dpung skyod byed skabs rang 'gul gyis phyi rol du nyal ba las dgon pa'i nang gnas mi bca' ba dang / bod rigs mi dmangs kyi khe phan la phran tsam yang btsan gnod byas med/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis dmag mkho'i mkho sprod mi 'dang ba'i skabs der bod sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi bkod 'thab pa tshos skad shugs chen pos grod pa ji tsam ltogs kyang nam yang srid jus dang sgrig khrims las mi 'gal ba bya rgyu yin /zhes brjod kyi yod pa red/ de ltar bod skyod dmag dpung gis sngo tshod bkog ste grod pa rgyag thabs dang / rwa co sgrug nas 'bud shing byed pa'i dka' ngal las brgal thub pa byed pa las bod kyi mi dmangs la brdab gsigs spu tsam yang gtong gi med/ dmag dpung gi sgrig 438
