khrims dam zhing drang ba dang / mig dper 'os pa'i sgo nas tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' slob lag bstar gnang bar brten bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyi tshad mtho'i bsngags brjod thob pa ma zad/ rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyis bcings 'grol dmag ni dzirgya rigs gsar pa mi zhig dang dzima'o kru'u zhi'i dmag dpung ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi mgon skyabs shig red ces brjod kyi yod/tang krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid dang bod kyi las don skor gyi zhib phra'i slob ston dang mdzub khrid rab dang rim pa'i 'og bod du chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ 'dzugs skrun sogs gang cir bsam yul las 'das pa'i yar rgyas gong 'phel byung yod pa dper na khron bod dang mtsho bod gzhung lam gyis gtsos nying khri sa gnas kyi me tog rdzong phud/ de byings lha sa lte bar byas pa'i bod ljongs kyi rdzong yongs su rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub pa dang / lha sa nas rtsed thang dang / gzhis rtse/ nying khri sogs grong khyer dang rdzong khag mang che bar snum nag gi rlangs 'khor 'gro lam gsar skrun byas yod pa red/ rig gnas slob gso'i thad la de sngon bod rnying pa'i skabs rgya che'i zhing bran gyi bu phrug rnams la rig gnas slob sbyong bya rgyu'i go skabs med pa dang zhing bran 907 yan yig rmongs yin pa de bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes dang lhag par ngo log zing 'khrug zhed 'jags btang rjes krung dbyang nas rang re'i slob gso'i 'thab phyogs thog dmigs bsal gron dngul sgor dung phyur mang po btang ste rigs 'dra min gyi slob grwa khag mang po btsugs nas rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi bu phrug gtso bor gyur ba'i bu phrug mang po zhig slob grwar zhugs pa'i go skabs thob pa ma zad/ de'i nang nas mang po 439

zhig chab srid kyi go rtogs ldan la deng rabs kyi shes bya yod pa'i mi rabs gsar pa'i shes ldan par gyur nas mig sngar bod ljongs kyi tang srid tshan pa'i 'go khrid kyi 'gan 'khur gyi yod pa dang / 'phrod bsten thog grong khyer dang /sa gnas/ rdzong / shang sogs gang sar mi rigs yongs la phan bde sbyin nus pa'i phyi lugs dang bod lugs sman khang gsar rgyag dang 'brel sman pa dang sman don mi sna gso skyong bsko 'dzugs dang sman rin mi dgos pa'i sman bcos byed pa/ bod sman rgya khyab tu dar spel btang nas sngon 'gog 'byung bcos zung sgrol byas par brten spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs skyob ha cang dka' ba'i mdze nad lta bu'i 'gos nad khag mang po zhig rtsa bcos thub pa dang mi dmangs kyi bde thang chu tshad gong mthor song yod/ lha sa dang chab mdo sogs sa khul du gzhi rgya che ba'i ar 'dam bzo grwa dang / ko pags bzo grwa/ sman rdzas bzo grwa 'dzugs gnyer gyis mkho chas 'don sprod byed pa/ lha sa lte bar byed pa'i sa gnas khag la nang sa'i zhing chen khag gis bod skyor byas te brjid nyams ldan pa'i 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs 'bor chen byas pa de dag gis rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rnams yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yod pa dang / zhing mkho'i 'phrul chas spyi dang rdzas lud mkho 'don gyis mtshon pa'i zhing las thon skyed gong 'phel gtong rgyur rgyal khab nas ma dngul 'bor chen gtong gnang mdzad pa des 'bru rigs dang / tshal rigs/ tha na rtswa sogs skye dngos thon 'phar shugs chen byung bas bza' bca'i dngos rigs yar rgyas kyi tshad gzhi gong mthor song yod pa/ lhag par du skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don lag bstar byas pa brgyud bar skabs rig gnas gsar brjes dgon sde khag dang de min chos lugs rig 440

dngos dang chos dad byed sgo gang sar gtor skyon phog rigs sor chud don 'khyol bya rgyur blo yul du mi gshongs pa'i 'gro gron btang yod/ gzhan yang mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong byas nas mi rigs rang nyid kyi mi dmangs kyis rang khyim rang bdag gi khe dbang longs su spyod dgos zhes pa des spun zla mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis phan tshun rogs ram dang / lhag par du rgya rigs mi dmangs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs khag la rogs ram byed pa ni mi rigs khag thun mong du yar rgyas dang thun mong du gra rgyas phun sum tshogs po yong bar med du mi rung ba'i mthun rkyen zhig red/ bod ljongs la cha mtshon nas bshad na gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag gong du 'phel ba dang / yar rgyas dang grub 'bras gang thob pa tshang ma rgya rigs kyis gtsos pa'i spun zla mi rigs khag gi rogs ram dang kha bral thabs med cing / lo bcu phrag kha shas ring bod du las don sgrub par phebs pa'i mi rigs khag gi las byed pa rnams ni rogs ram de dag dngos su byed mkhan dang dngos su mtshon mkhan yin zhing / mi mi nyung ba zhig gis bod ljongs yar thon yong phyir rang nyid kyi rtsa che'i lus srog kyang phul ba red/ bod ljongs ni mes rgyal lho nub mtha' mtshams su gnas yod la mes rgyal gyi lho nub sgo mo chen po yin pas 'thab jus kyi gnas bab gal 'gangs ha cang chen po yod par brten bod ljongs kyi mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang / nyen rtogs drag chas dpung sde/ spyi bde'i mi sna bcas tshang mas mes rgyal mtha' mtshams kyi bde 'jags srung skyob dang / mi dmangs kyi srid dbang srung skyob/ spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun srung skyob/ mi dmangs kyi bde 'jags srung skyob bcas bya rgyu'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i las 'gan 'khur yod/ nye char tang gi rim pa khag gi 441

'go khrid tshan pa dang 'go khrid las byed par 4snang chen gsum ’ gyi slob gso spel ba brgyud tang gi 'dzugs skrun dang las byed pa'i dpung khag gi 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon thob pa red/ phyi phyogs su sgo phye ba dang nang khul gra rgyas gtong rgyu'i rgyal jus lag bstar gyi bya rim nang phyi'i rgyal khab mang po zhig gis 'dzam gling gi rtse mthor gnas pa'i bod ljongs shes rtogs thub pa ma zad/bod ljongs su yul skor spro 'cham gyi byed sgo spel ba'i khe 'bab kyang mi dman khar/ krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs 'og bod ljongs yar rgyas song ba'i rnam pa gsal por mthong bas bsngags brjod byed mkhan mang po yod pa sogs mdor na bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa nas da phan lo lnga bcu'i ring tang krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i khrid ston 'og bod ljongs su phyogs gang ci'i thad yar rgyas gong 'phel song ba'i grub 'bras kyi gnas tshul bzang po brjod kyis mi lang /'on kyang nga tshos chab srid bsam blo'i lam phyogs thad dus dang rnam pa kun tu do snang chen po byed dgos pa las lhod g.yeng gi bsam tshul gtan nas 'chang mi rung / gang lags she na chab srid bsam blo'i las ka ni rang re'i tang gi srol rgyun bzang po zhig dang rang re'i chab srid kyi khyad 'phags stobs shugs shig spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bya gzhag khag yang dag pa'i lam srol thog skyod thub pa'i gal che'i 'gan len zhig yin pa red/ blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis de sngon lo shas ring nga tsho'i 'thus shor che shos ni bsam blo slob gso'i las don thad 'thus shor byung ba de rang red ces gsungs pa ltar bod kyi gnas tshul dngos 'ga' shas kyi thog nas gsung de rbad de yang dag pa zhig yin pa'i ra 'phrod byung yod/ 442

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo lnga bcu 'khor bar dran gso byed pa'i nyin mo 'dir ngas phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla tshor re skul 'ga' zhig zhu 'dod yid la 'char zhing / khong tshos gung khran tang gi 'go khrid dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam brgyud bod du gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba lta bu'i yar rgyas gong 'phel byung lugs kyi don dngos rnams mkhyen rtogs gsal po gnang rgyu dang / rang gi pha yul du snga tsam log phebs rgyur rang 'dod yod na sems bzang gi re ba zhu rgyu ma zad/ 6 bod rang btsan mi zer ba de ni phyi'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod du btsan 'dzul byas nas byung ba'i khungs lung spu tsam med la da cha bar rgyal spyi'i thog rgyal khab gcig gis kyang khas len byed mkhan med pa'i log spyod kyi gtam 'chal zhig dang /krung dbyang nas tā lar 'dzin pa'i srid jus ni yang dag pa dang kha gsal po zhig red/ 'on kyang 6 gros mol zhes pa'i dar cha 'khyer nas mu mthud du mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la gtor bshig btang tshe/ mthar gtugs kho pa bod rigs mi dmangs kyis mchil ma ltar 'dor rgyu red la/ bod ljongs 'di bzhin krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang spun zla mi rigs khag dang dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs 'gro lam thog bskyod rgyu yin pa dang / bod rigs mi dmangs mdun skyod kyi gom stabs de su zhig gis kyang 'gog mi thub/ 443

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas lo lnga bcu 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba dang chabs cig rang gi myong tshor zil thigs tsam gleng ba'i gtam/ye shes 'phrin las/rang re'i bod ljongs ni de snga mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs shig red/ de lta bu'i spyi tshogs nang mi ches nyung shas kyi pha tsha bu brgyud rnams kyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa las rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la srid dbang gtan nas yod pa ma red/ mi dmangs ni skad cha bshad shes pa'i dud 'gro lta bur brtsi bzhin yod/ dpal 'byor thad thon skyed byed pa'i rang dbang yod pa tsam las thon skyed kyi 'bras bu rnams mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis bed spyod byed pa dang / thon skyed byed mkhan mi dmangs la rtsa ba nas mi dbang ba ma zad/ khral 'ul sogs kyi mnar gcod sdug 444

bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos kyi yod/ spyi tshogs de 'dra'i khrod mtho rim mi sna'i nang du'ang btsan dga' kha bral stobs shugs dang rgyal gces pa'i stobs shugs dbar rno ngar che ba'i 'thab rtsod yod stabs btsan dga' kha bral stobs shugs kyis rgyun chad med par rgyal gces kyi stobs shugs la rdung rdeg byed kyi yod pa dper na/ rgyal gces pa rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rtse shar chen lcog la btson bcug mthar sku srog bkrongs pa dang /khong gi gcen po 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang mkhar mtho sprul sku 'dom gang gru bzhi'i nang tshe btson nyes chad btang ba/ rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho mes rgyal nang sar bros byol 'gro dgos bzos pa/ser byes grwa tshang dang / rwa sgreng dgon par bod dmag btang nas dmag rgyag pa sogs mnar gcod btang zhing / gos nom tshang mar sdod bzod mi bde ba'i gnas su gyar yod/skabs der mes rgyal nang sar ma'o kru'u zhis gtso bo gnang ba'i krung dbyang dbu khrid rnam pa'i yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og ri 'gog dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pas g.yul rgyal dga' ston byas/ go min tang gi khri dmag brgyad brgya rtsa med btang thog spyi lo /949 lor krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa dang / tshogs 'du'i thog ma'o kru'u zhis de ring krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes shing / dus de ring nas bzung krung go'i mi dmangs rnams yar langs zin par brten btsan rgyal ring lugs pas krung go'i mi dmangs la btsan gnon bya rgyu mjug sgril ba yin zhes dpal dang gzi brjid ldan pa'i ngang 'dzam gling yongs la khyab bsgrags gnang ba dang / skabs so so'i rgyal yongs srid gros kyi tshogs 'du'i thog rtsa khrims kyi 445

dod thub pa'i spyi mnyam rtsa tshig la mos mthun gyis grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul la rang skyong srid jus lag bstar bya rgyu dang / mi rigs so so'i yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog bya rgyu/ chos dad rang mos dang dgon par srung skyob bya rgyu sogs mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun dang 'tshams pa'i srid jus bzang por gong 'og tshang mas brtsi bkur zhu bzhin pa sogs bkra shis pa'i bya ba gcig thog nyis rtsegs kyi rnam pa bzang pos khengs bzhin yod/rgyal yongs bcings 'grol btang zin pa dang bod du bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i bka' brda 'byor skabs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang log spyod shog khag gis ched mngag rdzun bzo'i dkrog gtam bzos pa ste/ bcings 'grol dmag bod la yong na mi pho mo rgan pa tshang ma gsod kyi red zer ba/ rgyu dngos yod pa'i sa nas rgyu dngos 'phrog bcom dang / mi drag rnams sdod bzod mi bde ba bzo gi red zer ba/ mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang chos lugs rtsa med bzo gi red/ dgon pa grwa tshang med par bzo gi red zer ba/za rgyu yod kyang za long med pa dang / gon rgyu yod kyang gon long med pa'i spyi tshogs chags kyi red zer ba ma zad/ ri bo rtse lnga'i dge slong bsod nams rin chen gyi gnam yig zer ba sogs khungs lung med pa'i gnam yig mang po bton par brten gnas lugs mi shes pa'i mi mang po zhig zhed snang ngang 'tshabs langs nas gang du 'gro dgos sam snyam pa'i gnas su gyar nas yod/krung dbyang nas krung go'i skam sa yongs kyi khongs bod ma gtogs tshang ma bcings 'grol btang zin zhing / bod dang the dban bcings 'grol gtong rgyu thugs gtan 'khel/ bod ni mes rgyal mnga' khongs lho nub rgyud kyi gtso bo bod rigs khe gtsang rug 'dus sa khul yin par brten dmigs bsal dang 446

gzigs skyong / bab bstun gyi srid jus mang po bzos pa ma zad/ lhag par sbyad kyi mtho rim mi snar 'jam bshad blo 'gug gnang rgyu gal cher dgongs pa spyod/ 940lo'i nang gdan sa dga' ldan gyi sprul sku shar skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs ched mngag lha sar gtong gnang gis mi rigs dang / chos lugs/dgon pa srung skyob/ yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog gnang rgyu dang /zhi bas gros mthun yong rgyur bod bka' shag la gsung ste go skon slob gso gnang yang bka' shag nas khas len zhus med pa/ de rjes 'bras sgo mang stag 'tsher sprul sku nor bu rin po che gtong gnang gis lha sa'i bka' shag dang / gro mo'i bka' shag la gsungs par don 'bras gang yang son med pa/ de rjes 'bras sgo mang dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos rlung 'phrin brgyud don tshan gsum (bod krung go'i cha shas yin pa/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang chab srid 'brel thag gcod rgyu/ mtha' mtshams la bcings 'grol dmag bzhag rgyu)dang zhi gros skor lan mang gsungs par dang len zhu rgyu lta ci/ lha sar yang phebs mi 'jug par nag chu nas phyir log gnang dgos bzos yod/de nas dkar mdzes dge stag rin po che chab mdor ched phebs kyis mdo spyi brgyud zhi gros skor mdo spyis bka' shag la snyan 'bul byas pa'i lan du lha sar ma gtong / mar slog kyang ma gtong / zhes phab stabs mthar sku srog chab mdor bkrongs/yang a mdo phun tshogs bkra shis lags nag chu brgyud lha sar bka' shag la zhi gros skor yi ge 'bul thub tsam byung yang bka' shag nas kha gsal lan brgyab med/ 447

yang rgya rigs khren smis hru'u nag chur 'byor zhing / bka' shag la zhi gros skor yi ge 'bul rgyu yod lugs byang spyir zhus don ltar byang spyis bka' shag la snyan 'bul lan du/ kho rang lha sar ma gtong / lho khar khrid song zhes phab pa ma zad/ shod drung ldan bya rdo rje rab brtan ched btang ltar ldan byas khren smis hru'u phu mdo nas 'bri gung brgyud lho khar khrid skabs bka' shag la zhi gros skor yi ge zhig yod pas de nges par 'phrod pa dgos zhes yang yang bshad pa ma zad/ lag tu yi ge zhig yod pa der yang yang bltas nas lha sar 'gro sa'i lam ma red/ lha sa'i shar rgyud dang lho rgyud kyi lam red/ ces bshad kyang ma nyan par rtsed thang la khrid nas lho spyir rtsis sprad/ khong lho spyi'i sar yang yang yong mthar lha sa'i bka' shag la yi ge 'bul thub tsam byung yod/btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i shog sbub rlungs 'tshang 'og bod kyi mtho rim btsan dga' kha bral stobs shugs nyung shas de tshos bod nas phyi rgyal rgyal khab lnga la bod don rgyab skyor zhu bar ched mngag 'thus tshab btang ba dang rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa gros mthun byed mir bsko bzhag gis kho pa rgya gar du song zhing / skabs der phyi tshul tsam gyi gros mthun zhu mi zhwa sgab pa bskos pa las don dam du bcings 'grol dmag bkag 'gog ched mdo smad la shugs che'i dmag gra sgrig pa/ phyi rgyal rgyal khab lnga la bod don rogs ram zhu mi'i 'thus tshab btang ba/ bod kyi dben sde phal che bar skul slong gis gtor rgyag dang zlog thabs rim gro byed pa sogs byas yod/mdo spyir bkod mngags kyis bod dmag chig khri lhag tsam dang yul dmag chig khri tsam bskong nyar sa 'gag srung 'dom nan po byed pa/ a dbyin gyis bzos pa'i me mda' dang me skyog sogs dmag mkho'i yo chas sgrig pa/ 448

dbus gtsang nas dmag phogs 'bru khal cig 'bum tsam bsdu dbor byed pa/dgon sde yod tshad la dmag zlog gtor rgyag 'phen dgos lugs bshad pa/lhag par 1948lor lha sar smon lam 'phar ma tshogs bcug pa dang tshogs khro kha sbub pa/ smon lam gtor rgyag skabs rgya rigs kyi gsob 'ga' shas mer bsreg btang ba/ bla ma ral lcog zer bar dmag zlog gtor rgyag rgyag bcug pa sogs bya ba ngan pa yod tshad byas song / bla ma ral lcog pas mnga' ris khul gyi 'brog pa mang tshogs la mgo skor btang nas bca' dngos dang sems can mang po ham bzos byas shing kho pas rdzun bshad pa mang tshogs nas shes stabs rdo dang dbyug pa khyer nas nyes rdung gtong bar rtsom skabs kho rang yul byol du song ba red/ phyogs mtshungs spyi tshogs thog dkrog gtam mang ba dang gnam yig zer ba mang po yod khar/ srid gzhung nas tā la'i bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel zhal gtam zer ba stong phrag mang po par rgyag gis dgon sde dang rdzong gzhis khag la bkram yod/ zhi gros byed khul gyi ming khyer nas don dam du dmag rgyag sogs kyi byed thabs mang po lag bstar byas yod/ go skon slob gso la ngang sgug ji ltar byas kyang mi nyan pa'i gnas tshul 'og mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdo zhag shas las ma 'gor bar bcings 'grol btang ba red/ de rjes zhi drag dpon rigs rnams chab mdor rug bsdus dang / lhag par mdo spyi sku 'khor sogs tshang ma'i 'tsho ba dang bzhugs yul sogs gang cir gzigs skyong gang legs gnang zhing / mdo spyi'i bka' drung mtsho sgo don grub tshe ring gis lha sa'i bka' shag gi bka' drung la kha par brgyud chab mdo shor song / da cha thabs shes gang spel dgos dgongs skor snyan seng zhus lan du/ slobaka' blon rnam pa drung spyi gling khar spro gseng la 449

phebs stabs nyin shas nas ma gtogs bka' lan yong gi ma red ces brjod par mtsho sgo ba dmag dus la song / nga tsho'i mgo la me shor yang gsod khom med pa'i dza drag de lta bur sgug long ga par yong / khyod rang skyag pa zo a zhes khong khro chen pos lab pa yin zhes khong ngo mas nga la gsungs myong / de dus sku drag dang / 'byor ldan pa rnams dngangs 'tshab kyis phyi rgyal la 'gro rtsis kyis gser dngul brje ba dang / dngos chas gnad che bsdu gsog bcol rtsis byed pa sogs brel zing langs shing / gser dngul dza gong 'phar ba dang /ser 'bras kyi lam khar dngos dbor khal mas khengs yod/ dper na/ nga gcig pur mis bcol pa'i sgam 'khom 'bogs brgya yas mas zin gyi 'dugaskabs der sa gnas srid gzhung gis mi dmangs la mgo skor gtong ba'i ched lha sa'i bar skor phyogs bzhir brda khyab yi ge sbyar ba'i nang / chab mdo bcings 'grol dmag la shor 'dug 'on kyang nga tshos phyi rgyal rgyal khab lnga la sku tshab btang nas rogs ram yong rgyu'i re ba zhus yod stabs sems khral rtsa ba nas byed dgos med/ ces gsal bar brten phyi rgyal gyi rogs ram yod ces mngon gsal dod pos bshad pa ma zad/ lha sa tshes gsum thang du thad 'phur gnam gru 'bab thang bzos pa dang / byang yangs pa can nas sa dkar 'bo 'bum gsum yas mas dbor te gnam thang steng bting ba/ phyogs bzhir dar cha btsugs te bod dmag la srung bcug thog sa ri'i gnam gru lha sar babs nas chab mdo tshur len rogs ram byed kyi red ces bshad de re ltos sprad bzhin yod pa red/ 'on kyang gnam gru gcig kyang yong mkhan byung ma bang /re sgug stong zad song ba'i gnas tshul 'og spyi lo /950lo'i bod zla bcu 450

gcig pa'i nyin zhig gi tho rengs khar rtse pho brang nas tā la'i bcu bzhi pa dang /mtho rim dpon rigs nyung shas shig phyi rgyal la bros byol du song ba red/ de gong hin rdus bros byol rogs ram yong zhu'i re bar khas len byas 'dugaganas tshul ji bzhin krung dbyang nas mkhyen stabs li'u kru'u zhis drang nan gsal bsgrags spel stabs kho pa tsho dngangs 'tshabs langs thog gro mor tar 'byor gsal/ phyi rgyal du yong nas yul gyar srid gzhung tsam 'dzugs rgyu las de min gyi rogs ram byed dka' ba gsal stabs bya thabs zad nas gro mor lo gnyis tsam sdod dgos byung 'dug chab mdor wang chi ma'e yis mdo spyi nga phod par go skon gsed dkrol mang po gnang bar brten mdo spyis bsam gling pa dang rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs / ma nam a pho bcas snga phyir mi ched btang gis zhi gros bya rgyu'i skor lha sa dang gro mo'i bka' shag la zhus par dga' spros dang len gyis sngar med dmigs bsal ma nam a pho bka' shag nang bka' blon rnam pa dang mnyam sdod gnas tshul zhib dris byas 'dug(a phos nga la dngos su bshad byung) zhi drag gi bya thabs zad mthar gro mo'i bka' shag gis khe smad dza sag dang / mkhan drung thub bstan bstan dar zhi gros 'thus mir bskos pa/ lha sa'i bka' shag gis mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i sku tshab dang / snyan mgron thub bstan legs smon dang / bsam pho sras bstan 'dzin don grub gnyis bsko gzhag gis pe cin du gros mthun 'jog par phebs shing / bka' blon nga phod kyis dmigs bsal byas rjes bzhag gnang mdzad pa red/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod de lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa'i grub 'bras rlabs chen thob pa sogs skor 'dzam gling yongs la dril bsgrags gnang 451

ba red/skabs der gro mor zur khang pas gtsos pa'i mi khag cig gi blo la ma bab par phyi rgyal du 'gro rgyu'i gros 'go bton pa/ rtse phyag zhol khang pa sogs kyis lha sar log rgyu'i gros 'go 'don pa sogs gros mthun la lta stangs mi 'dra ba'i dbar rtsod gleng shugs chen byung mthar gzan rtags dril nas der gang babs la thag gcod bya rgyur thag bcad cing / gzan rtags nang lha sar log rgyu bzang babs stabs der thag bcad pa red/skabs der a rir dngangs 'tshabs chen po langs par brten rgya gar rdi li'i gzhung tshab chen mo'i las shag nas phyi 'brel dpon rigs gnyis nam nyin ltos med nyin rdu'i ka sbug tu sgom mda' yar 'phel sar btang ste/ phyi rgyal la phebs skor gro mor rtsod pa drag po rgyag bzhin yod 'dug der brten khyod rang gro mor lam seng song nas tā la'i bcu bzhi pa dang / mtho rim dpon rigs tshang ma phyi rgyal du phebs thub ched thabs shes gang yod byed dgos/ phyi rgyal du phebs thub tshe bod kyi yul rgyar srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs rgyur rogs ram bya rgyu dang / yul gyar srid gzhung de'i tsung thung tā la'i bcu bzhi pa bsko rgyu dang / tsung li khyod rang la bsko rgyu thag bcad zin/ lam seng nam nyin ltos med 'gro dgos zer ba bzhin khas blangs/ gnas tshul dza drag dgongs skor zhu sa med na gang byed dgos sam lab par/ blo bzang bsam gtan la bshad na gnas 'phrin 'phrod thabs khong gis byed kyi red ces bshad nas gro mor song / yar 'phel gyis gro mor bka' shag sogs gang la'ang ma song bar zur khang sar song gshes/ zur khang nas ha las dogs chokyis a pho yar phebs dang / sku don gang yod dam zer/ rdi li'i a ri'i 452

gzhung tshab khang nas btang lugs sogs nang don tshang ma bshad par/ zur khang pas a kha kha zer zhing 'gyod pa chen po byed cing / kha sang a pho phebs na yag po ga 'dra yong gi ma red pas/ lha sar phebs rgyur gzan rtags la phab nas thag bcad tshar song / zhes blo pham gyis bshad byung zer/ (yar 'phel srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon yin skabs slob sbyong sar gsung par rang nyid tsu'u krang la song stabs bstod bsngags kyang zhus pa dang / don de de dus ma gtogs tshang mas go mi 'dug)gong zhus las mthong thub par btsan rgyal ring lugs pas snga sa nas 'char gzhi bting ste yul gyar srid gzhung zer ba bzo rtsis byed kyi yod pa red/bcings 'grol dpon dmag bod du phebs nye'i mtshams ma'o kru'u zhis blo mthun krang cin u sogs la khyod tsho bod du las ka byed par nges par du mi rigs dang / chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs kyi srid jus lag bstar yag po dgos zhes nan du gsungs shing / yang si khron nas blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis blo mthun krang go hwa sogs la khyod tsho bod du las ka byed par mi rigs dang chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs kyi srid jus lag bltar yag po byed dgos/ de tsho yag po ma byas na khyod tsho bod du rkang pa yag po 'dzugs thub kyi ma red ces gsungs pa ma zad/ khrims tshan gsum dang / sems srung don tshan brgyad yag po lag bstar dgos pa'i bka' mang gnang yod/blo mthun krang cin u sogs dpon dmag rnams lha sar phebs ma thag ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun par thā yang dkar po'i sku 'gyed dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i rtags ma sogs gnang ba ma zad/ bla spyi so sor phyag rtags 453

dang 'brel gros mthun skor bka' 'dri gnang bar 'bras spungs mkhan po khri pa rgya 'byung gnas lags kyis gtsos tshang mas gros mthun nang 'khod chos dad dang dgon par sung skyob/ mi rigs kyi goms gshis la brtsi 'jog gnang rgyu sogs ha cang yag po 'dug ces zhus pa red/ khong rnam pas mi rigs dang chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs gyi srid jus khag lag bstar yag po gnang khar zhing par skyed med dngul bun btang ba/ sman rin mi dgos pa'i sman bcos/ slob yon mi dgos pa'i slob 'dzugs sogs dmangs phan bya ba mang po gnang ba/ lhag par khrims tshan gsum sems srung don tshan brgyad sogs kyi spyod bzang la tshang mas bsngags brjod zhu bzhin yod/bcings 'grol gtong nye'i mtshams btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang der dga' nye ston mkhan tshos dkrog gtam bshad pa rnams skyag rdzun yin pa bya ba ngo mas ra sprod byung stabs tshang ma blo bde'i ngang gnas yod pa ma zad/ gros mthun 'jog lugs 'jog stangs bod tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms sar gsal bshad byung nas tshogs 'dus mos mthun gyis tā la'i bcu bzhi pas ma'o kru'u zhir gros mthun la brtsi srung zhu rgyu'i tar yang phul yod/'on kyang srid tshab klu khang pa dang / blo bzang bkra shis kyis gtsos pa'i mtho rim nyung shas kyis gros mthun gtor bshig gtong ched 'bras sgo mang grub thob pa dang / dam chos bsod nams/ tsha ba drung yig blo gros phun tshogs sogs sgrig 'dzugs kyis mi dmangs 'thus tshogs zer ba btsugs pa dang / gros mthun gyi nang don la ngo rgol/ kung ud dang bka' blon nga phod kyi gzims shag la bod dmag dang grwa pa rdob rdob sogs kyis mtha' skor lan 'ga' byas yod/ kung ud nas bka' shag sogs la drang nan gsungs par 454

brten mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi 'go pa rnams bkag nyar dang / de 'og grwa pa rdob rdob rnams kyi sgrig 'dzugs med par bzo dgos pa'i bka' phab nas sgrig 'dzugs med par bzo skabs nga tsho'i smad tsha khams tshan las snes kho tsho bkar skabs bla spyi grwa tshang nas thag chod song zhes las sner skos zhing / nga rang nas bsam 'char bshad mthar job rdob sgrig 'dzugs med par bzos nas kho tsho dpe cha bar sgyur pa yin/ yang spyi lo 1954nang a lo chos mdzad kyis gtsos pa'i mi dmangs 'thus mi zer ba btsugs nas gros mthun la ngo rgol byed pa yang med par bzos pa red/ /957nang a 'brug tshang mgon po bkra shis kyis gtsos pa'i chu bzhi sgang drug zer ba'i log spyod sgrig 'dzugs btsugs thog lho kha gru gur a ris rgyab skyor gyis me mda' sogs lag cha mang po gnam gru nas dbyug pa sogs rgyal khab la gnod cing dmangs la rdab gsig che ba'i spyod ngan mang po bsgrubs yod//959lor bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas kyis drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug khyon yongs nas bslangs pa dang / kho pa tshos bod sger langs dang rang btsan byas pa yin zhes bshad pas don tshan bcu bdun mngon gsal gyis dbral bshig btang ba red/ma gzhi byas na zhi gros la ngo rgol dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur la rgol pa/ ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa ni bya ba ngan pa zhig red/ 'on kyang bod kyi mtho rim mi sna nyung shas kyis ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa ni rkyen ngan grogs shar gyi dpe ltar bya ba ngan pas bya ba bzang po khrid yong ba zhig byung yod/ gang yin zhe na/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang dmangs bcos dus gcig la byas shing / skabs der mnga' bdag chen po gsum mgo ting 455

slog pa dang bod kyi zhing pa bran g.yog rnams la srid dbang thob nas bod kyi bdag por gyur/ de ni bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob pa dang /dmangs bcos ma byas na de lta bu ga la yong srid/ de ni bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur gyi rlabs che'i chab srid grub 'bras yin/phyogs mtshungs thon skyed rgyu chas bzhi bcos sgyur gyis mi dmangs la bgo 'grems byung bar brten sa zhing dang / khang pa/ sgo phyug dngos chas sogs mi dmangs la thob nas mi dmangs rnams dpal 'byor gyi bdag por gyur yod/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob pa dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur ma byas pa yin na ji srid bar de 'dra ga la yong srid/lhag par tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa dang / blo mthun teng zha'o phing gi krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs rig pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs gzhung lugs kyi mdzub khrid dang / sgyur bcos sgo dbye lag bstar byas tshun bod la gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur 'dra'i grub 'bras thob pa dper na/ snga lo ljongs yongs kyi nor srid yong 'bab sgor dung phyur 105 61 dang / zhing 'brog mi re'i cha snyoms yong 'bab sgor1150(/258)du slebs pa/ grong khyer dang grong rdal gyi mi re'i cha snyoms yong 'bab sgor 5000 rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor lo rer brgya cha 10bcas khag gnyis ni rgyal yongs las mtho ba byung yod/ dpal 'byor gyi grub 'bras de lta bu ni de snga'i bod kyi lo gang 'dra zhig tu byung ma myong / mig snga'i grub 'bras kyang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob pa dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur ma byas pa yin na de 'dra ga nas yong thub bam/ de dag ni 456

blo mthun teng zha'o phing gi krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi mdzub khrid 'og sgyur bcos sgo dbye dang / krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid/ nang sa'i zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs khag gis sgor sems med pa'i rogs ram sogs las byung ba red/ gong gsal khag dang lhag par blo mthun zha'o phing gi krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs rig pa'i gzhung lugs ni nga tshor grub 'bras thob pa'i rtsa ba yin stabs slad kyang nga tshos rgyal kha'i rtsa ba de dag ma brjed par dam 'dzin byed dgos/phran rang nyid la mtshon na skabs der rtsom zhib las khungs kyis se ra dgon par tshags par dang / dus deb/ 'tshams shog sogs 'bul mkhan 'brel gtug par bkod mngag gi las ka dang / bsam 'char bsdu len byed pa'i las ka yod par brten gros mthun dril bsgrags dang bsam 'char bsdu bar yang yang skyod dgos/ skabs shig la se ra bla spyi'i sar gzims sde (srid gzhung gi sku tshab)dpal ldan lags kyis/ da nas bzung se ra dgon par tshags par dus deb skyel mi dgos zhes mngon sum 'dzems med kyis bshad byung / nga rang ha las nas khyed kyi bka' mol de nor ma song ngam zhes thengs gsum bshad par de rang yin bshad byung / ngas nga ni las khungs kyi ngo tshab dang las byed/ dgon par sgrig zhugs kyang yin stabs 'go khrid la dang len zhu dgos mod/ 'on kyang gsal bshad zhu rgyu'i 'os 'gan rang la yod stabs mi zhu thu med song / rtsom zhib las khungs kyi dus deb sogs ni gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gtso bor dri bsgrags byed phyir yin pa dang / bka' shag dang drung rtsis dpon rigs tshos dgon par dril bsgrags gang mang byed dgos 457

'go khrid rnam pas gsungs par/ nga tsho bod du mtha' mtshams brtan srung dang / bod nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen med par bzo ched yong ba dang / khyod rang mtha' mtshams kyi mir song thug 'phrad gnang ba yin gsungs te mthun sgril slob gso gnang ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog dge stag phyag mdzod lags nas rgyal yongs srid gros kyi spyi mnyam rtsa tshig dang / gros mthun/'brel yod yig cha sogs gnang zhing / lta klog gi myong tshor gtso bo ni tang gi mi rigs dang / chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs kyi srid jus yang dag pa yin pa'i yid ches dang / lhag par mi dmangs srid gzhung dang /mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag sogs tshang mar mi dmangs kyi ming sbyar ba ni chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung sogs tshang ma mi mang che ba'i ched du yin gsungs pa de chos phyogs nas byas na sems can gyi don yin zer ba dang / srid nas byas na mi dmangs bde la 'khod pa de yag po red bsam ste gsar brjer dga' zhen skyes pa dang / blo mthun krang cing u dang / than kon san/ rin khrang/ rlis tsa'o min sogs gsar brje'i rgan rabs pas mthun sgril dang slob gso gnang 'og gsar brje'i nang zhugs thub pa byung bar dga' spro byed kyi yod/nga tshos dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong rgyu gtso gnad du bzhag nas sgyur bcos sgo dbye mtha' 'khyongs bya rgyu dang / brtan brling dang 'phel rgyas kyi bya ba chen po gnyis bzung dgos/ brtan brling yong bar mi sems snying 'jags dgos gal che bas mi mang che ba'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang mthun par mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi las ka yag po byed dgos/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur ni mthun rkyen bskong 'then dang / 'gal rkyen mthun rkyen la 459

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa ni bod ljongs sgo kun nas 'phur mchongs ngang gong 'phel 'gro ba'i lam tshad rdo ring zhig yin/gling dbon pad ma skal bzang /spyi lo /95/lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gsham la gros mthun zhes brjod rgyu la ming rtags bkod pa de ni bod 'di lo rgyus kyi don dngos nang dkyus su zhugs shing / bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rim la rlabs che'i 'phur mchongs byung ba'i lam tshad rdo ring zhig yin la/ bod myongs sgo kun nas dar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro rgyu'i 'go tshugs sa zhig kyang yin/gcigabod rje srong btsan sgam po nas bzung bod rgya spun zla'i 'brel lam 6/

chags mus thog dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus 'go tsam la sog po go dan dmag dpung gis bod du dpung 'jug byas thog sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan sog yul du gdan drangs pa brgyud bod nas sog por 'dab nor sprod rgyu sogs kyi lam srol bzos nas bod 'di sog po'i zhor skyong lta bur gyur pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dus rabs de ga'i dus dkyil te 1260lo tsam la sog po hu pi li se chen han gyis krung go'i sung lho ma'i rgyal rabs gtor nas yon rgyal rabs kyi krung dbyang btsugs te krung go gcig gyur chen po bzo skabs bod ljongs 'di nyid kyang krung go'i mnga' khongs su rbad de gcig gyur bzos pa'i dril bsgrags shing / de nas bzung krung go'i gong ma rim byung gis dus yun ring mor bod 'di 'dzin skyong bsnyon med du byas pa'i lo rgyus don dngos bsub tu med pa de ltar red/ yin na'ang krung go'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ching gong ma'i srid gzhung de nyid dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus smad tsam du slebs skabs nyams rgud rul sungs su gyur rkyen phyi phyogs kyi btsan 'dzul la rgol lan sprod nus med par mgo 'dogs kyi bya thabs bzung ba'am/ mnyos chung nus med du lus pa dang / nang khul du mi rigs gnya' gnon dang /brnyas bcos/ mthong chung / btsan shed bcas kyi byed phyogs lag bstar byas/de rjes go min tang gis dus thung dbang sgyur byed skabs kyang de mur lus rkyen go skabs de dang bstun nas phyi phyogs kyi btsan dbang rgyal khab 'ga' shas kyis bod du sim 'dzul dang / mgo skor/ the jus/ dbyed sbyor/ ngan skul bcas byas pa'i 'og lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i dum bu thung ngu zhig gi nang 6 bod rang btsan zhes pa'i tha snyad gsar pa zhig kyang thon te bod kyi gnad don zer ba zhig byung / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus sked du krung hwa mi dmangs 462

spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes krung go gung khran tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i thabs jus mdzad phyogs 'og krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bod mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod yang dag par mdzad rgyu'i dgongs bzhes zab mo bcangs te de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang gros mol bskyang rgyu'i 'brel mthun gnang ba brgyud mthar/1951 lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la phan tshun gnyis mos kyi sgo nas ming rtags dngos su 'god thub pa byung zhing /dus de nas bzung bod 'di mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang slar yang gcig gyur byung ba ma zad/ de snga lo rgyus kyi dum bu thung ngu'i nang bod rgya mi rigs mthun sgril med pa'i snang tshul rbad de mjug 'gril nas mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang mi rigs mthun sgril chen po'i rnam pa bzang po zhig kyang rim bzhin btod thub pa byung yod/ 'di ni krung go gung khran tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyis mi rigs gnad don thag gcod yang dag pa byed pa'i rgyal kha'i mtshon dngos shig kyang yin/gnyis/rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba ltar byas na/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyi dus rim gong du 'phel tshul ni mi'i ngal rtsol gyi nus 'bras lhag ma bsags 'phel gyis rim bzhin gong nas gong du 'pho 'gyur 'gro ba de ltos med yongs khyab kyi chos nyid yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod gshis/ bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi dus rim 'phel rgyas thad kyang spyi'i chos nyid de las 'gal du med par ngos 463

'dzin dang khas len byed dgos la/ don dngos thad kyang dper na/ nye rabs su bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de'i spyi tshogs kyi dus rim rtser son pa'i nang zhing bran bdag pos rgya che'i zhing bran rnams la shugs che'i gnon bcir bzod par dka' ba btang ste rgya che'i zhing bran gyi ngal rtsol nus 'bras rtsa ba'i cha nas zhing bran bdag pos bsdu spyod byas par brten zhing bran bdag po nyung shas rnams sngar bas 'byor phyug ldan par gyur stabs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang rim bzhin ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor grub cha'i myu gu 'ga' zhig thon pa dang /dus mtshungs phyi phyogs 'gro 'ong dar ba'i shan shugs 'og bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag pos srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i chab srid lam lugs la'ang bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin mkhan gyi bsam blo gsar pa'i snang tshul yang thon pa ni dper na/ lung shar don rkyen lta bus mtshon thub la/ nye rabs su bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi spyi'i chos nyid bzhin rtser son nas nyams rgyad dang 'thor zhig tu 'gro ba'i phyogs su skyod 'go tshugs pa'ang mthong thub/'on kyang bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus dus rim ring mo'i nang chos srid zung 'brel gyi zhing bran bdag po'i srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i lam lugs thon pa der mi'i bsam blo dang chab srid thad nas gsar dar bya dngos la 'gog gnon byed pa'i nus pa'ang che tsam ldan yod stabs gal te gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byed pa'i gsar brje'i stobs shugs kyi rgyab brten med na bod kyi rgya che'i zhing bran rnams yar langs bcings 'grol mthar phyin pa zhig thob dka' zhing / bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi dus rim yang mu 464

mthud rjes lus rang gnas su yun ring sdod rgyu gdon mi za ba yin/ 〈gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod rjes kyang bod kyi mtho rim mi sna'i nang nas rnying zhen mkhregs 'dzin pa khag gcig gis mngon brtsi lkog 'gal gyi sgo nas phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab 'ga' zhig dang mu mthud ngan 'brel gyis 〈 gros mthun 〉lag bstar bya rgyur ka kor dang 'gog rkyen sna tshogs bzo ba'i jus bkod ngan skul 'og 1952lor 6 mi dmangs 'thus tshogs brdzus mas lha sar mi 'khyams sgrig 'dzugs kyis krung dbyang gi sku tshab krang cin u'i bzhugs gnas dang nga phod gzims shag gi mtha' bskor nas zing cha bslangs pa sogs 〈gros mthun 〉lag bstar bya rgyur 'gog rgol sna tshogs byas pa dang /lhag par du 1956lo tsam nas thog mar mdo smad khul du zing 'khrugs slong ba'i 'go brtsams te mthar 1959lor bod kyi phyogs yongs nas drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrugs dngos su bslangs/ 'on kyang krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid dang krung dbyang gi mkhas mdzangs 'thab jus yod pas/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis mgyogs myur zing 'khrugs snying 'jags su btang thog de snga'i zhing bran bdag po'i srid dbang sger 'dzin yongs su mgo rting slog nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang spel stabs gzhi nas rgya che'i zhing bran rnams rang lus rang dbang dang rang khyim rang bdag byung ba dang dus mtshungs bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi dus rim kyang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i chos nyid bzhin mdun skyod thub pa ma zad/ rim bzhin 'phur mchongs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas da cha spyi tshogs ring lugs dma' rim gyi dus rim du slebs thub pa byung yod/ des na 〈gros mthun 〉ni bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya rgyu sngon gtan 'khel ba'i rtsa 'dzin yin la/ bod kyi spyi 465

tshogs dus rim 'phur mchongs byed pa'i gal 'gangs che shos kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yang yin/gsum/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don rnams thog mtha' bar gsum du phyag bstar rgyun 'khyodas gnang ba ma zad/bod kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos la bstun nas de bas khong yangs dkyil che'i gzigs skyong gi srid jus mdzad phyogs rabs dang rim pa gtan 'bebs phyag bstar gnang stabs da lta'i bod ljongs sgo kun nas dar rgyas gong 'phel gyi rnam pa ches bzang po 'di dag mngon du 'gyur thub pa byung yod/ de yang 〈 gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun nang skabs de'i thad ku'i gnad don thag gcod mdzad thabs skor gyi nang don 'ga' zhig phud/ 4thun mong rtsa 'dzin gyi mi rigs srid jus gzhir bzung krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gcig gyur 'go khrid 'og bod mi dmangs la mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang / 5thun mong rtsa 'dzin nang thag bcad pa'i chos lugs la dad pa rang mos byas chog pa'i srid jus lag bstar byas te mi dmangs kyi chos lugs kyi dad pa dang yul goms gshes lugs sogs la brtsi 'jog bya rgyu 7 4bod kyi gnas tshul dngos gzhir bzung ste/rim gyis bod rigs kyi skad dang yi ge slob grwa'i slob stong gong 'phel gtong rgyu ‘ zhing 'brog bzo tshong rnams gong 'phel btang nas mi dmangs kyi lto gos je legs su gtong rgyu 7sogs 'khod pa'i gzhi rtsa'i dgongs don bzhin 466

1965lor bod mi rigs kyis rang skyong gi khe dbang longs su spyod pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs te bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su btsugs pa ma zad/ rang skyong lag bstar byed phyogs kyi khrims srol yang rabs dang rim pa bzo gnang mdzad/ lhag par du 1980lo dang /989lo so sor spung dbyang gis bod kyi las don skor gyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du thengs dang po dang gnyis pa skong tshogs gnang thog krung dbyang dbu khrid rim pa bod kyi las don la gzigs zhib dang mdzub khrid gnang bar ched phebs kyis mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong mngon 'gyur bya rgyu'i rtsa ba'i nang don gzhir bzung bod du bod rigs las byed pas gtso bor byed ched mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong dang sbyong brdar byed phyogs skor dang de 'brel bod kyi skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum mngon 'gyur bya rgyu sogs mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bya rgyu'i rtsa ba'i nang don sngar bas 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu'i mdzad phyogs srid jus zhib phra rabs dang rim pa bzos gnang ba dang / de bzhin gron dngul ched btang gis 4rig gsar skabs g.yon thal gyis gtor brlags btang ba'i dgon pa mang po nyams gso gnang ste rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyi lugs mthun chos dad byed sgo'i dgos mkho bskong ba/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang srung skyob/dar spel/ bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i slob grwa rgya cher gnyer ba/zhing 'brog bzo tshong gi thon skyed dang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas gong 'phel yong ched dmangs phyug srid jus mdzad phyogs rabs dang rim pa bzos gnang ba/ lhag par sgyur bcos sgo dbye'i nang bod kyi spyi tshogs la sgo kun nas sngar bas gong 'phel yong thabs su krung dbyang nas shugs che'i thugs khur gnang bzhin thog /994lor bod kyi las don gyi bzhugs mol tshogs 467

'du thengs gsum pa skong tshogs gnang ba brgyud krung dbyang gis sngar bas byams brtse'i thugs khur gzigs skyong dang rgyal yongs kyis bod la shugs che'i rgyab skyor byed pa'i mdzad phyogs bton nas bod kyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun thog la'ang mi rnams dga' 'os pa'i yar rgyas kyi rnam pa bzang pos khengs bzhin yod pa sogs mdor na/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo ngo lnga bcu'i dus rim brgyud krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og da cha bod ljongs 'di nyid sgo kun nas dar rgyas gong 'phel gyi rnam pa bzang pos khengs yod pa 'di dag ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi rlabs chen rgyal kha yin la/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis 〈 gros mthun 〉gyi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don phyag bstar rgyun 'khyongs thog bod du 'dzin pa'i dmigs bsal srid jus dang mkhas mdzangs thabs jus mdzad phyogs bzang po rabs dang rim pa spel ba'i rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha'ang yin/( 468

bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor bar dran gso zhu/lcags kha blo bzang dam chos/spyi lo /99lo'i zla /0tshes nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes shing / spyi lo /95/lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bod zhi bas bcings bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod de bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas da lta lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor ba red/ rang nyid nas lo rgyus la phyi mig lta ba dang bod kyi rnam pa gsar par spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i ngang nas bod ljongs dang khyad par du gtsang ljongs khul gyi spyi tshogs la 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba'i don dngos dang zung 'brel gyis dran gso'i tshul du rags tsam zhus na/ 69

gcig bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi sbyi tshogs/spyi tshogs der thams cad zhing bran bdag pos bdag tu bzung zhing /thog mar khrims lugs thad mi la 'dra mnyam med pa dang / bud med la skyes pa dang 'dra ba'i pho mo 'dra mnyam med pa/ 'gal 'dzol byung rigs la ngo bo'i thog khyad par med rung nyes chad gcod skabs mi rnams kyi rigs rus la mtho dma' dbye zhing nyes pa lci yang gi rim pa mang du yod pa/ gnyen sgrig la rang dbang med pa/ bud med kyi ngag la mi nyan pa sogs rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gang yang med pa'i snang tshul mang po yod/btsan po'i dbang cha dang / khyo bo'i dbang cha/ rus rgyud kyi dbang cha gsum khrims kyi thog gtan la phab pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang bran g.yog rnams kyis bran g.yog bdag por gyen ldog byed mi chog par bran g.yog bdag po'i bka' la nyan dgos pa dang /rang gi bza' zlas khyo bo'i ngag la nyan nas brtsi bkur byed pa de ni bud med mdzangs ma'i yon tan brgyad kyi gras su brtsi ba sogs rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor dang steng gi bkod pa 'brel ba chags pa'i spyi tshogs der bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag pos gtan la phab par yodagos nges khral dang bogs ma yang mi 'jug gsod gcod nges par byed la snying ma chung zhes bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de'i khrims srol las 'gal rigs byung na mi gsod dgos pa'i rigs la snying ma chung ba dang dgos nges kyi 470

rgyal po sa la dbang ba'i dpya khral dang bogs ma rnams la chag yang gtong mi rung bar zhing pa bran g.yog rnams la 'gel dkri byed pa/ zhing bran bdag por ker leb skur (ker mi dang / leb sa steng / sgur phyugs rigs kyi don/)gsum gyi bdag dbang yongs rdzogs yod pas/ 'khor 'bangs mi ser rnams nas mi la mi bogs len pa dang / zhing bran bdag po phan tshun dbar bran g.yog brje tshong byed pa/ dbang shed la brten nas bran g.yog mi ser la chad pa gcod pa/ dper na nyes 'dzol phran bu byung tshe yang bar dpal 'byor gyi chad pa lci yang gang rung gcod pa dang / de las lci bar lus steng rta lcags gtong ba dang tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste btson du 'jug pa/ rlung rtse nang 'jug pa/ lus la smyug gzer rgyag pa/ mig ril 'don pa/ rkang lag gcod pa/ rgyang 'bud gtong ba sogs ya nga ba'i khrims gcod byed kyi yod/phyogs mtshungs zhing pa bran g.yog mi ser rnams la 'tsho rten du sprad pa'i sa zhing bsdu 'bab kyi drug zur gcig zhing bran bdag po la dbang ba'i phud kyi dpya khral du bsgrub 'bul zhu dgos la/ de khrod drug cha lnga'i gsum cha gcig gzhung rgyugs pa yin phyin rdzong khongs su gtogs pa'i phyi khral rta khal mi gsum sogs sgrub rten/ gsum cha gcig nang khral gzhis g.yog ces rdzong las rim pa gcig gis dma' ba'i zhing bran bdag por nang khral gzhis g.yog rgyugs rten/ gsum cha gcig khyim tshang bza' 'tsho bu phrug gi za son dang / phyugs gsos bcas kyi 'tsho rten yin pa/ gzhung rgyugs min pa sger khongs kyi mi ser yin phyin bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po de rang gi khongs su sa mi gnyis ka bdag tu bzung ste khral rigs bsgrub 'bul dang bran g.yog bkol spyod gang ci bran g.yog bdag po rang nyid kyis gang 'dod ltar byed chog pa 471

dang / chos gzhis pa yin na phyi nang khral rigs yongs rdzogs khar chos bogs lci yang sna tshogs bsgrub 'bul dgos pa de yang gzhung sger chos gsum gyi khral rigs la lci yang sna tshogs yod pa red/zhing 'brog sa khul gyi phyugs 'tsho ba'i rtswa ra dang / ri klung gi rtswa kha la rtswa mar zhes mar khral bsdu ba dang / ra lug la rgyab dod ces bal khral dpya khral/mar la ko cha bco lnga zur dang / 'degs spyir byed par 'degs bca' bcu zur/ 'bru rigs la skam bca' bcu zur/ khyim tshang kha gyes tha dad du song na mgo phud bcu zur zhes dngos rigs ji yod kyi bcu cha gcig 'bul dgos pa sogs mdor na ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyi khral rigs sne mang zhig zhing bran bdag por 'bul dgos/dud rten yod pa dang rten med ces khral rten gang yang med rung lag gnyis la brten nas dud khral rgyugs dgos/ zhing bran bdag po gzhung sger chos gsum gyi lag nas sa zhing bogs mar blangs tshe 'bab bogs 'jal sprod bya dgos la chad 'gyangs byas na 'gyangs chad lci yang sna tshogs btsan 'gel byed pa dang / sgrub ma thub tshe lus steng rta lcags gtong ba dang nyes chad sgrub 'bul byed dgos/ mi ser tha zhan khag cig slogayul thon pags chad ces yongs su grags pa'i zhing pa rnams ston zhing las zin ma thag 'bru rigs rnams khral dang / bogs ma/ skyed lci'i bu lon sogs la sprad de rtsam pa za rgyu med par zas kyis grod pa mi rgyag pa dang / gos kyis lus po mi drod pa sogs dka' ngal gyis mnar zhing / zhing bran bdag por g.yar ba'i bu lon dus thog sprod ma thub tshe skyed ka de'i ngo bo'i thog tu brtsegs nas skyed la skyed ka sprod dgos/ khral dang bu lon rgya 'ub ma bsdus pa'i mtshams su bran g.yog 472

rnams yul gyar du 'gro dgos pa sogs bshad mi tshar ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos kyi yod/ da dung dmag phogs dang dmag mi bsdu ba/ lam 'khel rta khal mi gsum sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis dmag khral sprod dgos/'brog g.yog rnams la cha mtshon na zhing bran bdag pos she gdan zhes pa'i sems can thog mar rtsis sprad pa rnams skyes med 'chi med ces skyes 'phel med pa/ 'chi rgyu'ang med pa lo brgya phrag song yang lo ltar khral mar sgrub dgos kyi yod/ de min 'brog g.yog la bzhag pa'i 'bri g.yag ra lug gang yin yang skyes 'phel gso skyong tshang ma 'brog g.yog gis byas te khe phan 'brog bdag gis bzung nas ma rtsa ring lugs pas rin thang lhag ma ma rtsa'i bdag pos bzung ste bzo par bshu gzhog gtong ba dang cha mthun pa ma zad/'brog g.yog rnams rang lus la rang dbang sogs gang yang med par gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog myong dgos kyi yod/bod kyi zhing pa bran g.yog rnams kyis zhing bran bdag po'i gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog myong dgos kyi yod par brten zhing pa bran g.yog rnams 'u thug nas 'bangs gyen log dang / rdzong dpon dang gzhis dpon la 'ur bcom/ dmar gsod byed pa'i lo rgyus mang du yod pa red/bod kyi lo rgyus thog bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag pos zhing pa bran g.yog rnams la gdug rtsub chen pos gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog btang ste mthar mi shi khyim stong dang / dka' ngal bzod thabs med pa myong dgos kyi yod pas 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog ches gdug rtsub dang ches rjes lus bcas yin pa'i ser skya sku drag gis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs shig yin 473

cing / des na zhing bran rnams la rang lus rang dbang med par 'gro ba mi'i thob thang zhes pa gtan nas brjod thabs bral ba red/gnyis/ bod zhi chos bcings 'grol btang ste dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas nas mi dmangs la srid dbang thob pa/spyi lo /951 lo'i zla 5 tshes 23 nyin gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa des bod mi dmangs rnams btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul dang 'ching thag las grol te krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khyim tshang chen po'i nang du log nas mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang / mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi khe dbang longs su spyod chog pa'i rmang gzhi bting ba dang / rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs rnams bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs gdug rtsub kyi spyi tshogs las yongs su grol te spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su 'pho 'gyur thub pa byung yod/mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod sa gnas su 'byor thog krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid 'og tshar du dngar ba'i las don mang po bsgrubs te bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su 'dzugs rgyu'i gra sgrig gi las ka 'bor chen zhig gnang ring du'ang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og mtho rim log spyod mi sna zhung shas nas gros mthun rtsis med kyis tang dang mi dmangs dmag dpung la kha gtad gcog pa'i gra sgrig byed pa dang dkrog gtam 'grems pa/ ngan skul byed pa/ mi ngan bsdu rub byed pa/ rgya bod mi 474

rigs kha bral bzo ba/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro bar bkag 'gog 'dra min sna tshogs bcas byas yod/ dper na/ mi dmangs 'thus tshogs brdzus ma 'dzugs pa dang / dkrog gtam gtor bshig ji snyed gcig bkram pa/ mi rigs kyi 'khon slong ba dang / mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi dar cha bsgrengs nas mi dmangag khe phan dang spyi tshogs yar rgyas yong bar 'gog rkyen bzo ba/yar thon mi snar rdung rdeg dang dmar gsod btang ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod pas 'dir dpe mtshon tsam gleng na/ dbyin ji bas bod la btsan 'dzul skabs paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pas ngas mes rgyal la rgyab gtod mi byed ces drang nan gyi tha tshig sgrog pa gnang bar brten kho pa tsho 'dod blo ma khengs par btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dga' nyer brten mkhan bod kyi mtho rim mi sna nyung shas la ngan skul 'og paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod la bzhugs bzos mi bde ba bzos stabs chu phag bod zla // tshes 13nyin mes rgyal la zhal gzigs te phebs dgos pa dang / phebs mjug la bod kyi bka' shag srid gzhung gis bod dmag mda' dpon mtsho sgo ba btang rung phebs rjes ma zin pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pas krung dbyang la snyan seng zhus pa dang 'brel 'bri chu'i g.yas g.yon nas btsan rgyal ring lugs par drang nan gyi gsal bsgrags spel gnang ba sogs skabs phral gyi bzhed don bsgrubs te me glang lo bod la zhal gzigs te sga skye dgu mdor phebs skabs sa gnas bga' shag srid gzhung gis paṇa chen sku phreng dgu par chibs zhabs su rgya'i dpon dmag gcig kyang mnyam 'khrid mi gnang rgyu'i sbug tham sbyar ma'i gan rgya bzhag gnang dgos zhes bshad rkyen paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa skye mdo'i rlung zhu dgon par phyir log phebs te bod kyi mtho rim mi sna nyung shas la mi dgos pa'i mi de nga red ces 475

thugs dgongs pham pa'i ngang nas glo bur du me glang bod zla /0tshes 20nyin dgongs pa rdzogs pa ni sa gnas sde pa gzhung gis bsad par ngos 'dzin mi byed thabs med red/ gophyogs mtshungs rab byung gtsug phud mkhan po rwa sgreng sku gong ma pho brang po tā lar dkrongs pa/ mkhar thos gtsos tse nya sogs bla sprul skyes chen dam pa khag cig la rwa sgreng don rkyen thog bsnyad de lus la rta lcags gtong ba dang / rlung tse'i nang 'jug pa/ tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste sdug gsod btang ba/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa'i rjes su'ang spyi lo /958—/959lo'i nang rgyal gces mi sna 'phags pa lha mkhan chung dmar gsod btang ba/ gam pa rdzong stod nang sgang las tshan smon skyid rang lo 72la son pa bgres song sems bzang de lta bu'ang bod rum thag khrir rkang lag bzhi bsdams 〉te lus la gri btsugs nas gung khran tang gi phogs za mkhan zer ba sogs dri ba mang po byas mthar lus phyed bshags btang ste ya nga dang snying rje gang yang med par rdung rdeg dmar gsod gtong ba sogs bya ba sdug rigs ngan tshad ji rnyed cig spel yang / tang krung dbyang gis bzod sgom dang ngang brgyud ring po'i go bskon blo 'gug gi slob gso dang 'brel rgya bod mi rigs dbar dang / bod nang khul gyi mthun sgril la shugs snon dang / mthun pa che gras mnyam sdeb/ mi mthun pa chung gras sor bzhag gis bya ba bsgrub dgos pa dang / spyi lo /954lor tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen sku 'khor dang bcas rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po'i thog zhugs pa dang 'brel ba'i mi sna khag cig nang sar lta skor slob sbyong dang / tang krung dbyang gis bod kyi mtho rim gtso bo'i mi snar byams brtse'i thugs khur dang bla na med pa'i gzigs skyong 'og bod rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la shugs snon 476

rgyag dgos pa dang / bod rang skyong ljongs 'dzugs rgyu/ bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya rgyu lo drug ring dus 'gyangs gnang ba ma zad/ ga dus go rtogs sad pa dang cha rkyen 'dzoms mtshams bcos bsgyur byas na'ang 'grig pa bcas bod kyi las don skor la dgongs bzhes bla na med pa gnang yod/phyogs mtshungs rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tsung li sku gzhon khren g.yi nas gtso bo gnang ba'i krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa bod la ched phebs kyis bod kyi las don thog gzigs skor dang 'brel bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs gnang ba dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs gom gang mdun spos ngang yar rgyas 'gro rgyur skul ma thebs pa red/ de'i snga rjes su tang krung dbyang gi byams brtse'i gzigs skyong 'og bod kyi dbul phongs zhing bran mang tshogs rnams la skyed med bun gtong dang rgyad skyob dngul 'bor chen btang gnang yod/ bod kyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong dang sman bcos 'phrod bsten btsugs gnang ste mi dmangs kyi gzugs gzhi bde thang yong bar 'bad brtson gnang ba/ rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi mtho rim mi sna dang dgon sde'i bla sprul las sne bcas la dus kyi 'khor phyogs dang / mi sems gtad phyogs/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas bcas kyi thog nas slob gso bstud mar gnang thog tang dang mnyam las dang / phan tshun shes rtogs/lhag par du khron bod dang mtsho bod kyi gzhung lam che ba gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i bod sa mtho'i steng du gzhung lam gyi dra ba gsar skrun byas pa/ slob gso'i thad slob grwa 'bring chung gnyer nas dbul phongs kyi bu phrug rnams la yig rmongs sel rogs gnang ba/ bzo tshogs dang / gung gzhon sde tshogs/ rgyal gces gzhon nu mthun grogs tshogs pa bcas rim bzhin gsar 'dzugs 477

sogs bya ba ha cang 'bor chen zhig mdzad yod pa red/'on kyang phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i lkog g.yo ngan jus 'og bod kyi kha bral ru tshogs kyis krung dbyang bi bzod sgom dang / ngang rgyud ring po gnang ba de snyoms chung nus med la rtsis te rang nyid kyi lha yul shor bar sdug khur mi theg pa blun po chu sna gar khrid kyi dpe bzhin ngan skul la rbad de yid ches byas te spyi lo /959lo'i zla 2tshes /9nyin mngon sum 'dzems med kyis drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gtong rgyur ngo rgol byas pa de ni de las ldog pa'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs la skom pa chu 'dod ltar gyi dmas gtso'i bcos sgyur 'phral mar gtong rgyu'i skul shugs shig tu gyur nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis nyin gsum gyi nang ngo log zing 'khrug 'od 'jags su btang ba dang / dus thung lo gnyis tsam nas ljongs yongs su dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur rtsa ba'i char legs grub byung ba red/ bcos bsgyur gyi bya rim nang bran g.yog mang tshogs nas sngar gyi sdug bsngal skyo bshad byed pa dang / sa zhing bgo 'grems/ thon skyed yo chas bgo 'grems/ zing 'khrug nang zhugs pa'i dngos po gzhung len bgo 'grems/gzhung sger chos gsum la sprod bun rnams 'jal sprod mi dgos pa la sogs pa'i bya rim chen mo'i nang mang tshogs rnams kyis gyon pa gzab mchor sprad de thon skyed byed pa dang / dga' ston rten 'brel gyis da lta'i bde skyid mthong ba dang sngar gyi sdug bsngal dran pa bcas 'di lta bu'i nyi ma gang nas shar ba yin/ mgon skyabs gung khran tang / mgon skyabs ma'o kru'u zhi zer gyi yod pa dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa des bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs mjug bsgril ba dang bod kyi rgya che'i 478

zhing bran mang tshogs la srid dbang gi rgyal kha rlabs po che thob pa red/skabs der rang nyid ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs chos srid gnyis ldan nang sgang srid gzhung gi char gtogs pa'i dpon rigs shig yin pa ma zad/ skabs de dus rang gi bsam par bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid dbang rtsa med du 'gro la nye ba dang / rang la gsar brje'i gnas bab de tsam gyi myong tshor med stabs thog mar dogs gzhi dang the tshom skye ba byung / 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas gsar brje byed rgyu ni mang tshogs kyi khe phan yin pa ma zad/ paṇa chen nang sgang srid gzhung gi gnas bab bcas dus kyi 'khor phyogs dang / mi sems gtad phyogs gang la gzhigs kyang krung go gung khran tang gi rjes su 'brangs rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor ba dang gung khran tang gi slob gso dang kha ma bral ba'i 'og bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug nang zhugs med cing / rang gis bsgyur bkod byed pa dang / lta ba gsar brje/mi dmangs la ngos len bcas byas na tang dang mi dmangs la mi 'di mi dgos pa ma yin pa'i rang nyid nas ngos 'dzin yang zhu kyin yod/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa brgyud btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul bod nas mthar bskyod btang ba dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs mjug bsgril zhing / bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur btang ste bod kyi zhing pa bran g.yog dang mi dmangasal chab srid thog 'dra mnyam dang rang lus rang dbang thob ste spyi tshogs kyi bdag por gyur ba de ni yongs su yang dag pa red/ 479

gsum/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs tshun bod ljongs la 'phel rgyas byung ba/(gcig) bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud/ da lta ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi thog ma'i dma' rim spyi tshogs su gnas yod pas 'gal ba gtso bo mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dang thon skyed rjes lus bar gyi 'gal ba yin pa dang / nga tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni thon skyed nus shugs bcings 'grol btang ste krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa lte bar bzung ste dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu dang / bsgyur bcos sgo dbye zab spel/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor sgo kun nas 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba zam ma chad par gong mthor 'gro ba dang spyi tshogs brtan nying bde 'khod yong ba bya rgyu de red/phyogs mtshungs bod zhi bas bcings 'grol dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed pa'i brgyud rim nang gi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur de btsan rgol rgyal gces dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la gong bkur yi rangs zhu mkhan las grub pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi mna' 'brel zhig yin pa dang / blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis bka' gnang ba'i dus rabs gsar pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur de spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi ngal rtsol pa yongs dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs la brtsi bkur zhu mkhan rgyal gces pa yin la/ mes rgyal gcig gyur la brtsi srung zhu mkhan rgyal gces pa las grub pa'i mna' 'brel 480

zhig dang / de ni ches rgya khyab che ba'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur zhig yin pa mdzub ston gnang yod/ mi dmangs srid gros ni rang rgyal gyi chab srid sgrig gzhi'i nang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dmangs gtso 'don spel byed pa'i gal che'i grub cha zhig yin pas srid gros kyis mar khe si le nyin ring lugs dang /ma'o tse tung dgongs pa/ teng zha'o phing gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi dgongs don gyi mdzub ston 'og bsgyur bcos dang 'phel rgyas brtan snying bcas kyi chab srid kyi rnam par srung skyong dang / krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og tang dmangs mnyam las bya rgyu ni mi dmangs srid gros kyi ngos nas srid zhugs srid gros kyi 'gan nus 'don spel gang legs byed pa'i gtso gnad yin la mi dmangs srid gzhung nas kyang mthong chen dang lag bstar gnang gi yod pa zhig red/tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus thad phyogs yongs dang sgo kun nas 'gyur ba med pa lag bstar gnang dang gnang bzhin yod pa red/dper na/ chos la dad pa byed dang mi byed ni spyi dmangs rnams kyi rang mos yin pa dang / chos gang la dad pa byed pa yang rang mos yin la/ rgyal gces chos gces byed pa dang / chos la dad pa rang mos byed pa de rgyal khab rtsa khrims nang gtan la 'khel ba zhig yin/ rig gnas gsar brje'i g.yon thal lam phyogs 'og dgon sde khag la gtor brlag phog pa rnams kyang rim bzhin slar gso dang don 'khyol gnang ste ljongs yongs su rig gnas gsar brje'i g.yon thal lam phyogs 'og chab srid thog gyod gzhi chen po gsum ste/nor ba dang / rdzun ma/ ma nyes kha g.yog bcas gyod gzhi gsum la dkar 'don dag sel dang / dngos po bsdad rigs phyir slog dang 'brel dpal 481

'byor gyong gun la kha gsab kyis don 'khyol gnang yod pas 'di lta bu'i rgyal yongs rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul yo bsrang dang / mang tshogs la skabs shig ring 'tsho gnas ngal gso bcas gnang bas mi sna bsam shes can dag 'dod blo yongs su tshim pa byung yod/bod kyi kha bral pa nyung shas kyis mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi 'bag gyon te dgon sder sim 'dzul dang / bod kyi brtan snying la gtor bshig bod dang mes rgyal kha bral bzo ba'i bya spyod spel na de gar 'thab rtsod yod pa ni chos dad rang mos kyi gnad don min/ deng skabs bod ljongs yongs la dgon sde che chung /700tsam dang / grwa btsun zhal grangs 46000yas mas yod pa red/ nga tsho'i gtsang khul la cha mtshon na chos lugs dad pa rang mos thog deng skabs dngos yod dgon sde 3/2dang / grwa btsun zhal grangs ༷40yas mas/ ri khrod /2dang / gnas 'dzin lha khang 44tsam yod pa spyod/mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong thad la/ bod rang skyong ljongs btsugs zin pa'i tshun du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims la bzo bcos thengs mang byas pa dang / bod rang skyong ljongs btsugs pa des sa khongs rang skyong gi rmang gzhi 'ding thub pa byung yod cing / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud/ bod mi dmangs rnams spyi tshogs kyi bdag por gyur ba dang / rgyal khab kyi don chen la do dam byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa de rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims nang gtan 'khel byas yod/ ljongs sa khul rim pa khag gi mi dmangs kyi 'thus mi'i nang bod rigs dang bod kyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi 'thus mis brgya cha 807 zin gyi yod pa dang / gron yon dang / rdzong dpon/ hre krang 482

bcas rtsa ba'i char bod rigs dang / bod kyi grangs nyung mi rigs/ rgyal gces mi sna bcas kyi blo mthun nas 'gan khur byed kyi yod/ nga tshos snga phyi bar gsum du rgya rigs bod rigs dang kha bral thabs med pa dang / bod rigs rgya rigs dang kha bral thabs med pa'i lo rgyus yun ring rang bzhin ldan pa'i kha bral thabs med pa gnyis kyi bsam blo rgyun 'khyodas byed kyi yod la/bod rigs dang rang rgyal mi rigs khag dbar gyi mthun sgril la shugs snon brgyab par don snying ha cang chen po ldan yod/ gzhan yang mi rigs rang nyid kyi goms srol ltar chos lugs la dad mos tsam ma zad/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig rtsed kyi byed sgo khag dang / gnyen sgrig gi rten 'brel byed sgo khag phru gu skye bsu'i dga' ston/ skye skar gyi rten 'brel byed sgo khagastabs mi legs par mi 'das grongs byung na chos lugs kyi cho ga gtong ba dang /sku phung dur sar skyel sbyin byed pa/ 'khrungs rtags bzhengs pa/ 'das mchod sku tshigs zin pa/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ lo 'khor mtshams su lo mchod byed pa sogs mi rigs rang nyid kyi lugs srol bkag med ngang lag bstar byed kyi yod/mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig dang 'tsho ba'i goms srol bcas kyis mi rigs gnas pa de mtshon thub kyi yod/(/)de yang rtsa khrims nang mi rigs so so'i skad yig bed spyod dgos pa gtan la phab yod pa dang /(2)bod skad yig lag bstar bya rgyur mthong chen gyis rgya che'i slob grwa khag gis kyang mi rabs rjes ma 'tshar longs yong ched bod rigs lo chung gzhon nu rnams la dma' rim slob chung lo rim dang po nas drug pa bar dang / 'bring 483

rim slob 'bring lo rim gsum pa/ ched las slob 'bring dang mtho rim slob 'bring / dge 'os slob grwa bcas bar bod yig gi slob tshan rgyun gtan bzhin slob sbyong byed kyi yod/(3)rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen dang / rgyal yongs srid gros/ ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs dang / ljongs srid gros/ sa gnas srid gros/ gzhi rim sde tshan khag bcas su bod skad yig gtso bo byas te bod rgya skad gnyis mnyam spyod byed kyi yod/(4)rang ljongs kyi zhib srol nang du gzhung yig khag bod rgya zung 'brel bya dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod/(5)rgyun gtan mang tshogs kyi khrod du mi so sos skad yig gang zhig spyod bde ba yod na de rang bed spyod byed kyi yod/(6)tshags par dang / rlung 'phrin/ brnyan 'phrin/ sa gnas kyi brnyan 'phrin sogs tshang ma rgya bod skad yig gnyis ka bed spyod byed kyi yod pa dang deng skabs ni bod ljongs kyi spyi tshogs brtan snying dang 'jol mo khug ta gar la rol ba bzhin mi rnams dga' bde'i dpal la rol bzhin yod/zhuganyis/) bod kyi rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun bya 'phur ba ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro ba/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don nang thon skyed nus shugs bcings 'grol btang ste dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu gtso bor ston gnang ba dang / bod 'di mes rgyal nang sa dang bsdur na da dung rjes lus yin par brten bod la krung dbyang gis dmigs bsal gyi gzigs skyong 'og gtsang po gcig dang chu bo gnyis kyi rgyud la 'dzugs skrun dang krung dbyang nas 'gan 484

bzhes 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs 62gsar bskrun gnang ba dang / ljongs tang ud dang / mi dmangs srid gzhung / sa gnas u yon lhan khang dang / srid 'dzin kung hru'u/ mi dmangs mang tshogs bcas tshang ma blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis 'bad brtson byas pa brgyud mi rnams dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras thob yod/'dzugs skrun legs grub zin pa de tshos ljongs yongs kyi rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor sgrig bkod bltos bcas rjes lus yin pa'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog thog mar btang ba dang / ma rtsa 'jog pa'i khor yug legs su gtong ba/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mtho ru gtong ba bcas kyi thog spyi tshogs kyi phan 'bras dang dpal 'byor phan 'bras nges can zhig thob yod/ dper na/bod ljongs khyon yongs la cha mtshon na/ spyi lo /994lo'i zla 6nang bod kyi las don thengs gsum pa'i gros tshogs krung dbyang nas skong tshogs gnang ba dang / krung dbyang gis bod la dmigs bsal srid jus kyi thugs khur dang gzigs skyong gnang ste 'dzugs skrun ma dngul la zhib 'jug gnang ba brgyud thog ma'i 'char gzhir ma dngul dung phyur 23 8yin pa de dngos spyod ma dngul gyi gnad don la zhib 'jug gnang ba brgyud ha lam sgor dung phyur 40brgal yod pa'i ma dngul gyi gnad don thag gcod dang 'brel 'od kha glog khang / ma na glog khang chu bed bzo bskrun a ma gnyis lte bar byas te rnam grangs 62legs sgrub zin nas rtsis sprod kyis bed spyod gtong 'go tshugs yod/zhib bsher dang rtsis sprod byas pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na/(1)zhing las dang / 'brog las/ nags las/ chu bed bcas kyi thad la rnam grangs 9yod pa dang spyi'i ma dngul gyi 29 697zin gyi yod pas/spyi lo 1994go/997lo bar khyon yongs kyi zhing las phyogs bsdus gsar spel 485

gyi 'bru rigs rgya ma khri 45lhag tsam thon 'phar byung ba dang / zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal gtong ba'i tshan rtsal las don la hur sems skul slong byas te tshan rtsal la brten nas sa zhing 'debs pa dang / phyugs rigs gso ba'i 'du shes zab tu gtong rgyur skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon pa/(2)nus pa'i 'byung khungs thad la rnam grangs /6'dzugs skrun zin pa des glog 'don tshad 'phar bas chab mdo dang / lha sa/ lho kha/ gzhis rtse/mnga' ris sogs kyi khul la glog yag tu song yod pa ma zad/ sbra chen dang /steng chen/ sman gling / smar khams/ mtsho smad/ shan rtsa/ snyan rong sogs rdzong khag cig la glog mkho 'don bya rgyu yag tu song yod/(3)bzo las rnam grangs // bzo skrun zin pa des thon skyed byed sgo tshugs pa dang / dper na/ lo re gro zhib rgya ma khri 3500tsam 'thag las thub pa dang / snum rgya ma khri 300lhag tsam btsag thub pa/ ar 'dam kron khri 8tsam 'phar bzo thub pa ma zad/ ke lcags gter rdo dang / rdo sol sogs 'don thub pa byung ste mdor na lo re'i thon rdzas rin thang sgor khri brgyad stong brgal ba'i thon 'phar thub pa byung yod pas lo re 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyu yin pa red/(4)'grim 'grul dang / yig zam glog 'phrin/ mkha' 'grul bcas kyi thad la rnam grangs 7tsam bzo skrun legs sgrub zin pa des skyel 'dren dang srung skar 'phrin gtong sogs thabs lam mang du song ba dang yag tu song yod/(5)rig slob 'phrod bsten dang / rgyang bsgrags brnyan 'phrin bcas kyi thad la rnam grangs /2 bzo skrun legs sgrub zin pa des slob grwa'i slob ma gsar pa mi grangs 4900tsam mang du song ba dang / nad pa'i nyal khri grangs 486

400tsam mang du song ba/ rgyang bsgrags brnyan 'phrin khyab tshad de grong khyer dang grong brdal smos ci/ gzhi rtsa'i cha nas shang dang srid 'dzin grong tsho tshang mar rgyang bsgrags brnyan 'phrin sa tshugs 'dzugs bzhin yod pa red/(6)grong khyer 'dzugs skrun dang de min gyi rnam grangs /0tsam yod pas po ta la'i thang chen bzo skrun dang / mtha' khul dbul po'i rdzong 37gyi gzhung las khang gsar skrun bya rgyu/ de min lho kha dang gzhi rtse/ mnga' ris bcas kyi chu'i las grwa dang / grong khul gyi gzhung lam/ nying khri mgron khang /lha sa'i dbus nub dang mtha' mtshams 'gag sgo gsum gyi 'dzugs skrun sogs mdor na 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs de rnams bzo skrun zin pa des gcig nas bod ljongs yongs kyi 'dzugs skrun bya 'phur ba ltar 'phel rgyas byung yod pa dang / gnyis nas 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dang yul bskor mgron por sne len zhu ba'i cha rkyen sogs sgo gang sar 'gyur ldog chen po byung bas rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor gyi sgrig bkod bltos bcas la grub 'bras chen po thob thub pa byung yod/(7)gna' shul rig dngos la mthong chen dang srung skyob gnang bzhin yod pa ni/ dper na/ lha sa'i pho brang po ta lar nyams gso thengs gnyis dang / gzhis rtse sa gnas khongs sa skya dgon par rgyal khab nas gron dngul 'bor chen bton gnang ste mi rigs kyi lo rgyus grags can gyi pho brang dang dgon par srung skyob dang mthong chen gnang gi yod pa zhig kyang red/(8)lhag par mi rnams dga' ba skyes 'os pa zhig la krung dbyang nas dmigs bsal gyis nye lam nub phyogs thon 'byed chen mo'i 'dzugs skrun thog mar dbu tshugs shing de ni de bas gzhi rgya che la grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul gtso bor byas te krung go'i nub phyogs sa khul la krung dbyang nas thugs khur 487

gzhis rtse kron chus khongs /980lor zhing las thog 'bru rigs thon 'bor dang snum rgyu pad ka thon 'bor de /965lo'i bsdu bab dang bsdur na 'bru rigs 104 977'phar ba dang / pad ka /52 597'phar yod/ 'brog las thog phyugs rigs mgo grangs /980lo dang 1965lo bsdur na 53 9sko'aphar yod/ /995lor pad ka thon 'bor de /980lo dang bsdur na 227 57sko 'phar yod/ 'brog las thog /995lo'i phyugs rigs mgo grangs de /980lo dang bsdur na 4/phro'aphar yod/ de bzhin shang grong khe las dang sne mang gnyer skyong thog mang tshogs la yong 'bab lo gong ma dang bsdur na lo re nas lo re bzhin 'phel rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red/ rang mos khrom rar 'bru rigs dang / rtsam pa/ mar/ snum/ bal dang khu lu/ lpags rigs sgo nga / tshal rigs bcas ha cang 'bel po yod pa red/(2)gzhis rtse kron chus khongs zhing grong khul gyi mang tshogs rnams kyi sdod khang mi nyung ba zhig gsar rgyag byas yod cing / khang pa khag cig ni spyi tshogs rnying pa'i sger drag dang 'byor phyug khag gi sdod khang las kyang yag pa yod/khyim chas la cha mtshon na khag cig mi rigs kyi goms srol ltar cha sgam/mchod gshom/ gdan lcog kha gdan sogs dang khag cig deng dus kyi khyim chas hra' hpha rkub stegs dang / khra' ci'i/ 'khyag sgam/ gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin sogs yod pa ma zad/ rlung 'phrin gsar 'gyur nyan pa dang /rgyan gos la do snang chen po byed pa sogs rgyas gshom byed pa/ grong khyer nang sngar dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur tsam la tha mag dang / byi ril/ ko'o rtse sogs lag 'then 'khor lo chung chung nang bzhag ste tshong bsgyur byed pa'i tshong pa nyi tshe ba de tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs 489

pa 'bring tsam du slebs par gong rim tshang mas sems khur dang sems nus gcig sgrim gyis 'bad brtson gnang dang gnang bzhin yod/(5)sngar dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur sngon bod sa gnas sde pa gzhung gis dbang bsgyur byed pa'i skabs bod kyi yig zam glog 'phrin thad sbrags tar khang zhes btsugs pa des gzhis rtse nas lha sar yi ge gcig btang dgos na nyin zhag brgyad lhag tsam lus kyi yod/ deng skabs chu tshod bzhi'i nang skyel thub pa dang / de mtshungs deng skabs tar yig dang kha par gang yin kyang chu tshod skar cha kha shas thog sa cha gang du phan tshun gleng mol thub kyi yod la/ de yang nye 'gyangs gang gi kha par gang zhig dgos kyang yod pa red/(6)sngar bcings 'grol ma btang gong gzhis rtse nas phag ri brgyud rgya gar dang / gzhis rtse nas gnya' nang sogs sa cha gzhan la tsha 'bras brje tshong dang / bal dang tshwa/ rnga ma/ lpags rigs sogs nyo tshong skyel 'dren byed pa khal g.yag dang / khal mdzo/ rta bong kho nar brten nas nyin zhag brgyad tsam 'gro dgos/ bod nas mes rgyal nang sar bskyod dgos na/ bod nas mtsho sngon dang / bod nas chab mdo brgyud rta dang khal ma kho nar brten nas lam bar zla ba kha shas 'gro rgyu ma gtogs gzhan thabs shes gang yang med/bod nas lan kru'u 'am zi khron lta bur brgyud dgos na rta khal thog lam bar ha lam zla ba gsum tsam lus kyi yod/ deng skabs rlangs 'khor thog nyin zhag bzhi tsam nang bde bgrod thub pa dang / mkha' lam thog chu tshod gcig dang skar ma bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam gyi nang bde bgrod thub kyi yod cing deng skabs kyi skyel 'dren gzhung lam thad da cha mtsho bod gzhung lam dang / khron bod gzhung lam/ krung ne gzhung lam sogs gtso bor byas pa'i gzhung lam gyi dra ba 'di 49/

'dra sngar mig gis mthong rgyu lta ci/ rna bar thos myong med pa rnams da cha mngon sum snang zhing / lha sa nas sa khul so so bar dang / sa khul so so nas rdzong khag rdzong khag nas shang khag dang grong tsho khag bcas phal mo cher gzhung lam sdom gyi dra ba ltar chags yod la rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub cing /grong khyer dang grong gseb bar gyi mi sna 'gro 'ong dang mkho dgos dngos zog gang ci dus thog 'byor thub pa ma zad/ tha na mes rgyal nang sa'i tshal rigs gsos pa yang gang dgos 'byor thub kyi yod/ skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor gyi babs tshugs so sor yang bar lam sa phag brtsigs pa'i khang pa rnams deng skabs lcags dang ar 'dam las bskrun pa sha stag yin/(7)slob gso'i bya gzhag thad/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob gong spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs su lha sar gzhung btsugs rtse slob grwa dang / rtsis phrugagazhis rtser skyid skyid na kha rtse slob grwa/ yig tshang las mgron zer ba tsam las bod yongs la sger gnyer slob grwa khag kho na nyid bsten dgos/ de yang dpon rigs dang / mtho rim che btsan 'byor phyug gi bu phrug rnams slob grwa de tshor zhugs kyi yod pa las/ zhing 'brog dbul phongs kyi bu phrug rnams slob grwa de tshor zhugs rgyu'i go skabs dang cha rkyen ha cang khag po red/bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob pa dang / lhag par tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes slob gso dang tshan rig la mthong chen dang / tshan rig la brten nas bod ljongs dar rgyas gtong dgos pa'i 'bod skul gnang bar brten ljongs yongs la cha mtshon na slob grwa chen mo dang / dma' rim dang 'bring rim ched las slob grwa khag slob grwa chung ba khag mang po btsugs gnang yod la dper na/ gzhis rtse 492

sa khul la spyi lo /996lo'i bsdoms rtsis ltar na sa khul 'di yongs la rigs 'dra min gyi slob grwa khag /042tsam dang slob ma bsdoms mi grangs 83262yas mas zin pa dang / de'i nang 'bring rim ched las slob ma 980 mtho rim slob 'bring dang dma' rim slob 'bring gi slob ma 7832 slob grwa chung ba'i slob ma dang grong tsho'i slob chung gi slob mas 75430bcas zin gyi yod pas/slob ma de rnams slob lo lon pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad kyi 75 37skodang slob grwa'i nang gtan gnas slob mas 957 yan zin gyi yod pa red/grub 'bras 'di lta bu ni tang srid rim pa khag gis slob gso'i las don la rgyab skyor gnang ba'i 'bras bu yin pa ste/ gcig nas slob gsor rgyal khab nas ma dngul 'bor chen btang gnang ba dang / gnyis nas hrang hre dang hran tung / de bzhin zhing chen khag nas slob gso'i 'gro gron thog rgyab skyor gnang ba dang / gsum nas slob gso'i 'thab phyogs khag gi rgya che'i las byed pa dang / dge rgan/ las bzo rnam pas 'bad brtson byas par brten slob gso'i las don la grub 'bras che tsam thob yod/(8)sman bcos 'phrod bsten thad bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas gong lha sar gso ba rig pa'i sman rtsis khang dang / lcags po ri sman khang /gzhis rtser skyid skyid na kha'i sman rtsis khang / de min bod khul gyi gso ba rig pa'i sger gnyer sman pa khag cig las med pa dang / mi la lha 'brum nad phog na phal cher 'chi lam du 'gro rgyu las gzhan thabs shes med cing / re zung gson yang bzhin ras 'bur tshags skyug bro ba'i rang bzhin ma gtogs med pa dang / bud med la phru gu btsas skabs 'chi gson nges med yin pa de bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes mi'i gzugs gzhi bde thang yong bar 'phrod 493

bsten sman bcos thog gron dngul mang po btang ste sman khang gsar rgyag dang /phyi lugs dang / bod lugs/ krung lugs kyi sman don mi sna 'bor chen gso skyong gnang yod/ deng skabs gzhis rtse sa khul la cha mtshon na sman bcos sgrig gzhi 28/ tsam yod pa nas rdzong rim pa'i phyi lugs dang / krung dbyi/ sa gnas mi dmangs sman khang gcig sa gnas ma bu bde srung sman khang gcigabod sman rtsis khang gcig shang rim pa'i sa gnas sngon 'gog sa tshugs sman khang gcig rdzong khag la shang rim pa'i phyi lugs sman khang /8 'gag sgo'i phyi lugs sman khang gcig ngam ring rdzong khongs bod lugs sman khang gcigardzong du ma bu bde srung sa tshugs bzhi/ shang 'phrod bsten khang /99 sgo bsten sman khang 35 sngon 'gog sgrig gzhi /9bcas yod/ nyal khri bsdoms grangs //03 yod pa de'i nang grong khyer du nyal khri 328 rdzong khag la nyal khri 4/8rdzong ma bu bde srung sa tshugs su nyal khri 25 shang 'phrod bsten khang du nyal khri 3// sgo bsten du nyal khri 25bcas yod/ sman khang de rnams la lag rtsal mi sna dang / sman don mi sna/ las bzo bcas mi grangs /7// yas mas yod/de bzhin sa gnas dang rdzong / shang / grong tsho bcas par phyugs rigs sman pa bcas yod pas mi'i bde thang la gnod pa'i lha 'brum nad gzhi gzhi rtsa'i char rtsa bcos dang bud med kyi phru gu skye bcu'i thad ma bu bde 'grol thub pa/phyugs rigs kyi skor nad rtsa med bzos pa sogs mi phyugs gnyis la sman bcos 'phrod bsten cha tshang yod stabs mi rnams dga' 'os pa'i phan 'bras thob yod/(9)ljongs yongs dang 'dra bar gzhis rtse kron chus khongs su shing 'dzugs nags las 'phel rgyas che tsam byung ste gzhung lam g.yas g.yon dang / 494
