gram pa sa stong khag la shing 'dzugs nags bzo dang / 'bras shinga'adebs gso sogs sngo ljang can du 'gyur ba dang / mthong dkon pa'i rtsache'i srog chags la srung skyob/ gzhan yang lus rtsal gyi bya gzhag tshan rig gibya gzhagami ri~Xs lag shes bzo las sogs phyogs mtha' dag la 'phel rgyasachenapo byung rtenā/ mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag ste bod zhi ba'i bcingasa'agrol thob nas 'das zin pa'i lo lnga bcu'i nang grub 'bras 'di lta bu thobapa dang /'phel rgyas chen po 'di lta bu byung ba ni stes dbang du byung ba zhig mayin te/krung go gung khran tang med na krung go gsar pa med la bod ljongs gsar pa yang med/ krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid dang / tang krung dbyang gis bod la thugs khur dang gzigs skyong gnang ba/ krungago'i mi rigs khag lnga bcu nga drug gi mi dmangs rnams kyis blo bsdus dge 'tshol dang /thun mong 'bad brtson bcas byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ rang nyidanas lo rgyus la phyi mig lta ba dang mthong thos myong tshor phran bu dran gso zhus pa tsamalas/rang nyid shes rtogs dman pas ngos 'dzin thog mi lding ba yong ngesal tshang mas dpyad gzhi yod pa zhu rgyu dang / deng skabs ni blo mthun cangatshemin gyis srog shing gnang ba'i tang krung dbyang gi 'go khrid 'og mi khri semasagacig gis 'bad 'thab byas te rlabs chen krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dar rgyas phun sum tshogs po yod pa dang / bod ljongs 'di nyidakyang rgyal yongs dang 'dra bar rnam pa bzang por gnas yod/'byung 'gyur yang tang krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrida'ogasu mthud las don khag la rang nus yod rgu bton te 'bad brtson thurgyudang /495

tā la'i yis gtso bo byed pa'i kha bral pa nyung shas dang / rang rgyal dgra 'dzin stobs shugs kyis bod 'di mes rgyal nas kha bral bzo ba dang / krung go'i bdag dbang dang 'gro ba mi'i thob thang la btsan gnod byed pa sogs kyi bya spyod la sems thag gtsang bcad kyis ngo rgol bya rgyu dang / rang re'i rgyal khab kyis dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byed pa'i dmigs yul rgyal khab stobs 'byor ldan pa dang / mi dmangs phyug po chags pa/ spyi tshogs yun ring brtan nying bde 'khod yong ba/ 'dzam gling zhi bde mnyam gnas yong ched du yin pas mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang / mi dmangs la dga' zhen/ rang gi mi rigs la dga' zhen bcas byas te spyi lo 20/0la slebs skabs mdzes sdug ldan zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i bod ljongs de bas rnam pa gsar pa zhig yong nges yin pa the tshom med/ 496

lo ngo lnga bcu'i ring bod kyi sman rtsis rig gnas kyi bya gzhag yar zla'i dpal la 'gran pa'i skor/byams pa 'phrin las/'dzam gling go la'i thor cog tu gyur pa'i kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir chags pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rang byung snod kyi tsha grang char rlung khrod dka' tshegs dang du blangs te 'od snang 'bum phrag 'phros pa'i blo gros la brten nas 'dzam gling phyogs bzhir snyan par grags pa'i mi rigs rig gzhung gsar gtod mdzad yod par/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa yang de dag khrod kyi rin bral nor bu zhig yin pa smos med la/ de yang krung hwa mes rgyal gso rig bang mdzod chen po'i nang gi gal che'i grub cha zhig yin/ lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i bod kyi gso rig 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang dang phun sum tshogs pa'i sman bcos lag len zung du 'brel ba'i khyad chos mngon par 'phags pa ldan yod pa de dag lo ngo nyis stong sum brgya'i sngon gyi sman pa grags can dpyad bu khri 497

shes nas nye rabs kyi gso rig mkhas can nam mkha'i skar tshogs la 'gran nus pa lhan rgyas kyi gzhal du med pa'i sku drin yin mod/ 'on kyang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob pa'i lo ngo lnga bcu'i gong la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs kyis 'du shes rnam pa'i khyab khongs la sgor 'dom byed pa dang thon skyed nus shugs rjes lus yin pa'i rkyen gyis gso ba rig pa de yang chos srid zung sbrel gyi dbang sgyur gral rim la zhabs 'degs zhu ba las rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi sman bcos 'phrod bsten cha rkyen shin tu zhan pa dang / gso rig gzhung lugs dang sman bcos lag rtsal kyang 'phel rgyas 'gro ba 'gor po yod pas skabs der bod yongs la bod lugs gso rig sman bcos sde tshan gsum las med pa dang rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs la sman bcos longs spyod byed rgyu ga la yod/deng 'dir gangs ljongs sa phyogs khag tu ston gyi 'bras bu bsdu ba'i skal bzang thog mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis spro ba rab tu 'phel te bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo ngo lnga bcu 'khor bar rten 'brel dang dran gso zhu ba'i mtshams 'dir kho bos bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang rjes dang lhag par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun tang gi mi rigs srid jus bzang po dang /thugs 'khur che bzhes kyi mdzad phyogs khag de bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gzigs skyong bla na med pa'i 'og bod lugs gso ba rig par sngar byung myong med pa'i 'phel rgyas rlabs chen byung nas bod lugs gso rig gi sman khang sgrig gzhi gsar 'dzugs dang / slob gso dar spel dang mi sna gso skyong / sman rdzas thon skyed/ tshan rig zhib 498

'jug bcas la grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa byung ba rnams khag so sor dbye nas klog pa po'i spyan lam du phul ba 'di yang ljongs yongs kyi rgya che'i mang tshogs dang / lhag tu 'phrod bsten mi sna yongs kyis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo ngo lnga bcu 'khor ba'i dran gso'i legs skyes 'bul ba'i rten du gyur cigagacig bod lugs gso rig sman khang gi sgrig gzhir shugs snon chen po thebs pa'i skor/bod rang skyong ljongs sman rtsis khang ni spyi lo /9/6lor gsar 'dzugs byas shing / skabs der 4lha sa sman rtsis khang zhes brjod kyi yod cing / snga rjes su sman rtsis kyi zhib 'jug mi sna stong la nye ba gso skyong byas pa red/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas gong dge slob khyen bsdoms mi bdun cu don gsum las med cing / sman khang gi 'dzugs skrun gyi spyi'i rgya khyon ni spyi khre gru bzhi ma chig stong lnga brgya lnga bcu kho na las med/ lo gcig la nad brtag sman bcos byed pa'i mi'i thang grangs ni khri gcig tsam yin zhing / skabs der nad khri rkang gcig kyang med pa red/ bod sman thon skyed byed tshad ni phal cher rgya ma lnga stong tsam red/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo ngo lnga bcu'i nang nga tsho'i sman khang ni rim bzhin ljongs yongs la bod sman sman bcos dang / sngon 'gog lus khams bde srung / slob 'khrid/ de bzhin tshan rig zhib 'jug dang bod sman thon skyed zhabs zhu byed mkhan bcas kyi lte gnas su gyur yod/ da lta sman khang yongs la las bzo mi grangs bzhi brgya 499

bzhi cu tham pa yod cing / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed pa'i skabs las ldab drug tsam 'phar snon byung yod cing / de'i nang 'phrod bsten lag rtsal gyi mi sna nyis brgya bdun cu don lnga yod pas sman khang yongs kyi las bzo'i bsdoms 'bor gyi 62 57zin yod pa dang / mtho rim ched las lag rtsal gyi go ming yod pa mi sum cu des 'phrod bsten lag rtsal mi sna'i 10 97zin yod pa red/ da lta'i 'dzugs skrun gyi rgya khyon ni spyi khre gru bzhi ma khri bzhi lhag tsam yod pa des dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed skabs las ldab nyi shu rtsa lnga 'phar snon byung yod cing / sgo bsten sman bcos pu'u dang / nad sdod pu'u/sman bzo grwa bcas khag gsum la dbye yod/ mig sngar khog nad dang / phyi bcos/ bud med phru gu dod drag gser khab sogs nad thog sde khag btsugs yod cing / spyir btang gi sgo bsten sman bcos byed pa phud/ da dung snying dang klad pa'i khrag rtsa'i nad dang pho ba'i nad/ rus chag nad/ kha nad/mig nad/ dbang po lnga'i nad sogs la sman bcos byed pa'i ched nad ched bcos kyi rim pa gnyis pa'i sde khag gam gtso gnad kyi ched bcos sde khag btsugs yod pa red/sman khang du nad khri sgrig bkod byed pa'i 'char gzhi ni 250yin zhing don dngos nad khri 220btsugs yod cing lo rer sgo bsten du sman bcos byed pa'i mi'i thengs grangs ni khri 26lhag tsam zin gyi yod/ sman khang gi rmang gzhi'i sgrig chas la'ang legs bcos ha cang chen po byung yod pa red/ nad khri bed spyod tshad ni 95 57yan la slebs yod cing / sgo bsten sman bcos pu'u dang nad khang du bod sman gyi sman bcos byed tshad ni 857yan la slebs yod pa red/ de sngon nga tsho'i sman khang gi zhor gtogs yin pa'i bod sman 500

bzo grwa de yang gsar spos byas nas rgya khyon ldab kha shas che ru btang nas rang ljongs su bod sman thon skyed byed pa'i gal che'i rten gzhir gyur cing sman khang rang nyid la bod sman bed spyod byed rgyu 'gan srung byed thub pa phud/ da dung ljongs phyi nang du bod sman mkho 'don byed pa'i las 'gan 'khur gyi yod/srol rgyun gyi bod sman btso thal gyi sbyor bar rgyal khab gyi gcig por dbang ba'i khe dbang thob pa dang / skabs de dus lo re'i thon skyed byed tshad de spyi rgya khri bcu lhag tsam zin gyi yod/ lhag par lo shas nang ljongs yongs su rgyal khab kyi sgrig gzhi'i nang bod lugs gso rig sman rdzas kyi mi sna /07/ bar 'phel rgyas phyin yod cing / da dung dmangs khrod du bod lugs gso rig sman pa 429yod pa de tshos zhing 'brog khul du sger gnyer gyi thog nas sman pa byed bzhin yod pa red/ ljongs yongs kyi shang grong sman pa3000lhag tsam yod pa'i nang 457 zin pa'i mi snas bod lugs sman pa'am yang na bod phyi zung 'brel byed pa'i thabs la brten nas mang tshogs la nad 'gog sman bcos gnang bzhin yod pa dang / chus 'ben shang btsugs byas rjes shang 'phrod bsten khang gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i nang spyir btang byas na bod lugs gso rig gi sman don mi sna gcig re bkod sgrig byas yod pa red/ dpe mtshon bod lugs gso rig sman khang 'dzugs skrun byed skabs 5lo lnga tshan brgyad pa'i 'char gzhi'i dus tshod nang lo rgyus yun ring ldan zhing rgyal phyi rgyal nang du skad grags yod pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs sman rtsis khang dang nye ba'i lo shas nang gsar du btsugs pa'i lho kha sman rtsis khang gnyis rgyal khab krung lugs gso rig sman rdzas do dam cus kyis dzimangar kham 'char gzhi'i nang bcug stabs rgyal khab dang rang skyong ljongs kyis ma dngul sgor khri tsho 500lhag tsam 501

btang nas gtso gnad 'dzugs skrun byas pas sman khang 'di gnyis kyi gzhi khyon dang / nus pa/ chu tshad sogs kyi thad la rnam pa gsar rkyang zhig thon thub yod/ da dung bod rang skyong ljongs dang sa gnas/ grong khyer/ rdzong bcas kyis ma dngul btang nas snga rjes su nag chu dang / chab mdo/ mnga' ris/ gzhis rtse/ nying khri sa gnas bcas kyi sman rtsis khang dang / de bzhin sog rdzong / ngam ring rdzong / nyi ma rdzong / go 'jo rdzong sogs su'ang sman rtsis khang gsar 'dzugs gnang yod/de min bod ljongs kyi rdzong khag tshang ma'i mi dmangs sman khang du bod sman sde khag btsugs yod/ bod sman gyi thon skyed byed pa'i nus pa shugs cher phyin yod pa dang / rtsa ba'i cha nas ljongs yongs kyi bod lugs gso rig sman rdzas kyis nad 'gog sman bcos byed pa'i dgos mkho skong thub kyi yod/ gong brjod ljongs sman rtsis khang gi bod sman bzo grwa ni ljongs yongs su bod sman thon skyed byed pa'i rten gzhi che shos su gyur yod cing lo rer bod sman spyi rgya khri tsho bcu thon skyed byed thub pa dang / bod sman gyi rnam grangs 350lhag tsam zin yod/ sa gnas khag gi sman rtsis khang dang / rdzong gi sman rtsis khang la gzhi rgya 'bring chung gi bod sman bzo grwa btsugs yod cing bod sman bzo grwa de tshos lo rer bod sman spyi rgya khri gcig yan thon skyed byed thub kyi yod pa red/rdzong sman khang gi bod lugs sde khag nang sman bzo khang btsugs yod cing mang che bas rang 'thu dang / rang bzo/ rang spyod bcas byed kyi yod pa red/bod sman thon skyed byed pa'i nus pa lo ltar rim bzhin 'phel rgyas shugs chen byung bar brten zhing 'brog sa khul du sman dkon pa'i gnad don zhi lhod du phyin yod pa red/ lhag par du bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas lo sum 502

cu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs drug cu re gnyis kyi khongs su tshud pa dang cang su'u zhing chen gyis ma dngul sgor khri tsho 7600btang nas rogs bskrun byas pa'i ljongs bod sman bzo grwa'i rgya skyed las grwa'i 'dzugs skrun gyi lasi grwa tshang ma lo lnga'i gong nas legs 'grub zin pa dang /da lta tshod lta'i thon skyed byed bzhin yod pa red/gnyis/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang gnam rig skar rtsis rig pa brgyud 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba/de ni tang dang mi dmangs kyis nga tshor dkris pa'i las 'gan gzi brjid che la dka' tshegs ldan pa zhig red/ nga tshos tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus blo brtan 'gyur med kyis lag len bstar te bod kyi gso rig dang gnam rig skar rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin dang / 'don spel/ phyogs sgrig gong mthor gtong rgyu dang / da dung dus skabs dam bzung gis shes ldan mi sna bsdu len dang / rtsa che'i sman rtsis rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob kyi byed thabs rabs dang rim pa spel te sman rtsis kyi rtsa che'i shul bzhag rig dngos dang / dpe cha/de bzhin mi rabs nas mi rabs bar bsags pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pa'i sman rtsis skor gyi sman bcos lag rtsal dang / gzhung lugs slob 'khrid/mthong brgyud lag len sogs myur skyob byed dgos pa gong rim tang srid las khungs dang dbu khrid rnam par snyan seng re 'dun zhus pa dang / de'i nyer len las snga phyir bod sman gyi 'thus mi tshogs chen dang / bod sman gyi nyams 503

myong spel res kyi tshogs 'du/ gnam rig skar rtsis skor gyi lo tshogs/ rgyal yongs bod lugs sman khang gi las don gros tshogs/ lo rgyus thog thengs dang po yin pa'i rgya che gzab rgyas kyi bod sman dar rgyas tshogs chen sogs skong 'tshogs gnang stabs rgya che'i sman rtsis las don pa'i hur brtson rang bzhin skong 'then dang sman rtsis rig gnas gong 'phel btang ste can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la legs skyes 'bul dgos pa'i skul lcag gnang ba dang / phyogs mtshungs thabs brgya jus stong gis shes yon zab la 'jon thang che ba'i shes ldan mi sna btsal 'tshol dang / gdan zhu bkur bste zhu rgyur mthong chen byas pa yin/ dper na lo rabs drug cu'i nang lcags ri 'gro phan gling gi mkhas dbang dge rgan chen mo thub bstan tshe ring mchog dang / sman rtsis khang gi de snga'i rtsis pa'i dge rgan ye shes chos 'phel mchog da dung lcags ri'i sman pa rong byams chen pa blo bzang tshul khrims dang lho kha gdeng 'go che'i sman pa 'gyur med chos dbang / chu bcos mkhas pa sman pa yon tan tshul khrims bcas gdan 'dren zhus pa dang / de rjes lo rabs bdun cu dang brgyad cu'i nang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la mchog tu gyur pa mkhas dbang khro ru tshe rnam mchog dang / mkhas dbang blo bzang snyan grags mchog mkhas dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mchog de snga sman rtsis khang gi sman pa'i dge rgan chen mo dpal ldan bstan 'dzin/ lho kha 'phyong rgyas lam rim dgon gyi sman pa blo bzang mthar phyin/ lcags ri'i sman pa brag ler pa 'phrin las brtson 'grus/de snga sman rtsis khang thon pa bod dmag ta dang dmag sgar gyi sman pa pa sangs tshe ring / sog po sman pa skal bzang rgya mtsho sogs bsdu len byas shing khong rnams 'ga' shas zhing khul dang / 'ga' shas 'brog khul/ 'ga' shas spyi 504

bde'i khongs su yod cing / khong tsho sman rtsis khang du phebs rjes gong rim tang ud nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis tang gis shes yon can la 'dzin pa'i srid jus don 'khrol gnang ba dang / mi ring bar khong rnam par rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi rgyun ud dang / yang na u yon/ da dung nang bstan chos tshogs dang / ljongs tshan rig mthun tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin mtshan gnas kyang gnang yod/ de bzhin lha sa dang / lho kha/ gzhis rtse/ mnga' ris sogs sa gnas dang rdzong mi nyung bar yang bod lugs sman pa'i gras nas mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi 'thus mi dang / srid gros kyi u yon/ nang bstan chos tshogs kyi las 'dzin phyag las gnang rgyur bkod sgrig mdzad 'dug nga rang la cha bzhag na'ang byas rjes dang / 'jon thang / nus pa gang yang med rung bong ba gser gzigs kyis ljongs tang ud dang / mi dmangs srid gzhung gi byams brtse'i thugs khur 'og snga rjes su ljongs sman rtsis khang gi yon krang dang / 'phrod bsten thing gi thing krang gzhon pa/ bod sman slob grwa chen mo'i yon krang / ljongs tshan rig mthun tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa sogs kyi go gnas thog nor srung la gdong lnga'i ming btags te rgyal khab rim pa'i rigs gcig mkhas pa dang / rgyal yongs sman khang gi phul byung yon krang /skabs drug pa dang bdun pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi/ skabs brgyad pa'i rgyal yongs srid gros u yon sogs gnang stabs nga tsho bod lugs gso rig gi las ka byed mkhan tsho chab srid kyi thob thang dang / 'tsho ba'i thob thang sngon chad gang dang mi 'dra ba yod pa ma zad/rang rang so so'i shes yon lag rtsal la gzhigs pas lag rtsal go ming 'os shing 'tshams pa gnang bar brten rang cag mi rigs kyi phul byung gi rig gnas 505

shul bzhag myur skyob byed rgyu dang / rgyud 'dzin byed rgyu/ 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu bcas par gal che'i nus pa thon rgyur mdun lam yangs shing rgya che ba bstsal byung /nga tsho snga phyi bar gsum du tang gi bka' drin dang / srid gzhung gi byams brtse/ mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor gnang ba rnams skul ma dang skul shugs shig la brtsis nas rgyun chad med par rang 'khri'i sman bcos las don dang / zhabs 'degs rnam 'gyur rgyun chad med par legs bcos dang sgrags hur brtson gyis rtsom yig 'bri ba dang nyams myong spel res kyi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te rig gzhung dpyad thabs kyi bgro gleng 'khrugs po byas shing / khyon bsdoms sman pa rgan gzhon bar gsum gyis bris pa'i rtsom yig rnam grangs 200lhag tsam zin pa dang / phul byung gi rtsom yig mang po bod ljongs gso rig mthun tshogs kyis bton pa'i dus deb thog bkod yod/ lhag par spyi lo /986zla 9pa'i nang 'tshogs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs bod sman dar rgyas kyi las don tshogs 'du'i skabs 〈 bod kyi sman rtsis ched rtsom phyogs bsdus〉zhes pa rtsom 'bri byas pa'i nang / sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis gso rig dang rtsis rig gong 'phel gtong gnang mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang / bod kyi gso rig rgyud bzhi thog ma'i 'byung khungs kyi gsal bshad/ rgyun srol bod sman gyi kun spyod slob gso/ lcags ri 'gro phan gling dang sman rtsis khang gi gdan rabs rags bsdus/ da dung bod sman mkhas pa khag cig gis lo mang ring lag len gyi nang du nad thog sman bcos gnang ba'i nyams myong / de bzhin sman rtsis gnyis bar gyi phan tshun 'brel ba sogs nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom yig spel ba dang / de dag brgyud sman rtsis gzhung lugs slob 'khrid dang / 506

man ngag lag len ngo sprod/ shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bcas par ha cang gal 'gangs che ba'i phan nus thon par brten deng gi char ljongs sman rtsis khang ni sman rtsis gnyis po gtso bor byas te bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi lte gond cig tu gyur par brten mtsho sngon dang / kun su'u/ yun nan/ si khron bcas pa'i bod rigs sa khul nas ljongs sman rtsis khang du thos bsam byed par yong mkhan mi nyung ba yod pa'i khar/ phyi'i rgyal khab bcu grangs lhag tsam gyis kyang bod du sman rtsis slob sbyong byed rgyu'i re ba bton pa'i yi ge mang po 'byor byung /sngon chad lcags ri 'gro phan gling dang sman rtsis khang gnyis ni bod kyi sman rtsis rig gzhung gi 'byung gnas yin gshis lo mang ring gsog 'jog byas pa'i rtsa che'i rig dngos dang / sman rtsis dpe cha par ma dang bris ma/sman thang / sku brnyan sogs mang po yod pa rnams rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor bshig tshabs chen byung bar sa gnas gzhan du'ang sman dpe me la bsregs pa dang sman khug chu la bskyur ba sogs blo pham yid chad kyi gnas su gyar rung tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don rnams bod ljongs su lag len mthar phyin bstar bas ljongs sman rtsis khang du mi sna ched bskos dang gron dngul gya rnams pa bstsal te snga rjes su sman rtsis dpe cha'i par shing kha gsab dang sman thang 80'dra bshus/ g.yu thog sogs kyi sku brnyan gsar bzhengs/ chabs cig rtse pho brang gi dpe mdzod khang dang / nor gling dpe mdzod khang / zhol par khang gi yig tshags khang / sa skya/ sde dge par khang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sogs nas dpe tshan khri la nye ba 'tshol bsdus kyis legs sgrig dang / par loga'adra bshus/ dpe skrun bcas byas pa dang / ljongs sman rtsis khang gi sgo bsten 507

'tshogs pa ma zad/ gtam bshad gnang mkhan mang che ba lo ngo lnga bcu'i nang gso skyong byung ba'i rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi shes ldan mi sna yin/mdor na bod kyi sman rtsis rig gnas myur skyob dang rgyud 'dzin byas te 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba des bod kyi gso rig 'di krung go'i gso rig gi gal che'i grub cha dang / bod rigs mi dmangs kyi phul du byung ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag bod ljongs sa mtho'i steng gi 'od zer 'phro ba'i rin chen mu tig cig yin pa don dngos mang pos ra sprod byas yod/gsum/ gso rig slob gso'i las don la grub 'bras g.yur du za ba thob pa/1959lor dus babs 'phel rgyas dang mang tshogs kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs nas de snga'i lcags ri 'gro phan gling dang sman rtsis khang slob grwa gnyis zla bsgril te rgya skad la lha sa grong khyer bod lugs sman khang dang / bod yig la lha sa grong khyer sman rtsis khang zhes pa rang 'jags 'jog rgyur gong rim gyi bka' slob yod/ skabs der mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog la sman khang yon krang gi dbu gnas thog sngar bzhin sman rtsis khang gi thugs 'gan che bzhes mdzad par rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi blo mos dang dga' bsu ci cher byas/de dus slob grwa dmigs bsal med kyang lcags ri 'gro phan gling dang sman rtsis khang bsdoms pas sman dpe ma thon pa mi grangs 25yod par dge rgan ched btsugs dang slob khrid 'thus tshang gnang rkyen spyi lo /96/ lo dang spyi lo 1962lo so sor slob grwa thon pa dang / slob thon lag khyer yang yon krang sku ngo 509

ma'i phyag dam sbyar ma gsol ras bstsal zhing tshang ma sman rtsis khang du thugs nyar gnang / 'on kyang slad phyin slob ma med na rgyud 'dzin gso skyong thad ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar 'gyur rgyu nyag cig la brten yon krang mkhyen rab nor bu'i thugs dgongs mi bde bar gyur nas gong rim gyi dbu khrid mjal rim bzhin sman rtsis khang du gsar skyes stobs shugs khag cig kha snon yong ba dang / zhib phra'i thad rig gnas chu tshad nges can yod pa'i gzhon nu pho mo 30skor gtong gnang thugs rje che ba zhes pa'i zhabs skul nam nam zhar zhar mdzad mthar yon krang gshegs pa'i lo rjes ma ste /963lor dma' rim slob 'bring thon pa mi grangs /0dang / rgyal gces yar thon gyi bu phrug gdan sa gsum gyi sman slob bcas khyon mi grangs 40sman rtsis khang du 'byor 'phral dge rgan drag 'dems mi gnyis bskos nas bod sman sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa ched btsugs dang slob khrid kyi thabs shes dang nang don tshang ma sngar gyi lam lugs ji ma ji bzhin phyag len gyis 〈 dpal ldan rgyud bzhi〉rtsa bar bzung ste 'grel pa 〈beeḍūr sngon po〉yis zur khrid dang / de min skabs de'i slob gso'i byed phyogs ltar las phyed slob phyed byed rgyu rgyun 'khyongs khar slob gsos 'byor med gral rim la zhabs 'degs dang slob gso dang thon skyed zung 'brel byed pa'i mdzad phyogs lag bstar thog sman gzhung slob sbyong phud da dung ngal rtsol sbyong brdar dang / dbyar kha ri la sman 'thog 'gro ba sogs byas nas bsam blo dang kun spyod gzugs po bcas 'tshar longs cung legs tsam byung / khong tsho'i slob yun lo gsum dang /966lor slob grwa thon skabs 'bring rim bod sman gyi chu tshad la slebs pa byed rgyu red/ /97/ lor ma'o kru'u zhi'i 'bod skul dang len zhus te tshang ma gzhi rim du bskyod pa dang / mang 510

tshogs la bod sman gyis sman bcos byed pa dang chabs cig phyi lugs gso rig gi shes bya phran tsam sbyangs nas de gnyis zung 'brel gyi sman bcos byas par mang tshogs kyi bstod bsngags thob yod/ da lta'i char skabs de'i slob ma mang che ba ljongs sman rtsis khang du yod pas sde khag so so'i nang rkang 'dzin gyi nus pa 'don bzhin yod/ /971 lor slar yang gong rim la sman rtsis khang du rgyud 'dzin slob ma gso skyong bya rgyu'i skor snyan seng zhus pas/ lha sa slob chung nas thon pa'i slob ma 20kha gsab byung / 'on kyang khong tsho rig gnas chu tshad dma' ba dang / lo na chung bas 'phral du sman gzhung zhib rgyas 'khrid thabs med pa ma zad dus kyi gnas bab dbang gis slob ma tshos sman gzhung blo 'dzin byed ma dgos pa dang / slob deb kyang gtan 'khel med stabs thog mar sman rdzas skor nas slob 'khrid byed rgyur dge rgan gnyis ched bskos byas rung slob ma nyung shas las mang che ba bod sman gyi shes tshad dma' ba'i skyon cha byung song /1974lor lha sa grong khyer 'phrod bsten slob grwar thengs dang po'i bod sman 'dzin grwa btsugs pa dang / de skabs slob gso gsar brje byed rgyu'i skabs dang 'khel bas bod kyi sman gzhung 〈 rgyud bzhi〉thad mar slob khrid byed mi chog pa dang / bkas ma bzo gsum gyi nang don yod rigs bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs yod gshis bod sman 'dzin khro'i slob deb gsar pa phyogs sgrig byed rgyu dang / dge rgan zur 'then byed rgyu'i las 'gan cha tshang sman rtsis khang nas blangs/ snga phyir 'bring rim ched las kyi 'dzin grwa thengs bzhi la slob ma /6/ yod pa mang che ba rang ljongs kyi sa gnas khag dang /rdzong khag chus so sor btang //983lor bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud dang srid gzhung gi byams 5//

brtse'i thugs khur 'og 'bring rim bod sman slob grwa dngos su btsugs pa dang /slob grwa'i 'go khrid dang bdag gnyer gyi las ka tshang ma ljongs sman rtsis khang nas byas pa dang sbrags bod sman gyi khyad chos 'don spel gang thub byas te sman gzhung 〈 rgyud bzhi〉dang / yang na 〈 rgyud gsum〉dang / de bzhin 〈 chos spyod〉dang / rtsis dpe 〈 'byung rtsis〉dang / 〈 lnga pa 'phrod〉sogs blo 'dzin byed rgyu dang / sdeb rgyugs 'bul rgyu/ dgongs mo skyor ta tshugs rgyu sogs sngar gyi srol rgyun bskyar gso thub pa byung ba'i khar/ 'bring rim ched slob kyi slob yun sngon la lo gsum dang de nas lo bzhi'i gtan 'bebs bzos/bod sman 'bring rim ched las slob grwa thon pa'i slob ma rnams mnga' ris dang /nag chu/ chab mdo/ gzhis rtse/ nying khri/ lha sa bcas kyi zhing 'brog sa khul du btang ba des gsham la sman pa dkon zhing sman rdzas nyung ba'i dka' ngal sel rgyur phan thogs nges can byung yod/ krung dbyang gis bod la gnang ba'i yig ang 3/ dgongs don ltar bod kyi gso rig dang / gnam rig skar rtsis dar spel shugs chen gtong rgyu dang / cha rkyen ma 'dzoms bar bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i khongs su bod sman tshan khag 'dzugs rgyu dang / cha rkyen 'dzoms mtshams dngos su bod sman slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu'i dgongs don ltar /985lo nas bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i bod sman tshan khag la 'dzin grwa gsum gnyer zhing / slob yun lo lnga yin pa dang / tshan khag gi dge rgan sogs ljongs sman rtsis khang nas ched gtong byas/ /986lo'i lo mjug tu rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyis sgrig gzhi bsgyur bcos byed skabs bod sman slob grwa chen mo'i sgrig gzhi dang 'go khrid mi sna gtan 'khel gnang ba ma zad/ krung dbyang 'phrod bsten pu'u dang / rgyal khab krung dbyi do dam cus/ rang skyong ljongs tang ud 5/2

dang srid gzhung bcas kyis bod sman slob grwa che mo 'dzugs rgyur gang ci'i rgyab skyor dang gron dngul sgor khri tsho 700gnang ste dus yun lo gcig lhag tsam ring gzhi khyon spyi khre gru bzhi ma 14447yod pa'i bod sman slob grwa'i ar las 'dzugs skrun yongs su legs grub byung ba dang / 1989lo'i zla ba 9tshes 3nyin dngos su bod sman slob grwa che mo dbu brnyes/da lta'i bod sman slob grwa chen mor slob grwa che ba'i pu'u dang / 'bring rim ched las pu'u/ zab sbyong pu'u bcas khag gsum la dbye yod la/ kho tsho'i slob yun lo lnga yin zhing / sman gzhung steng snyan sum dang / sgra dang sdeb sbyor/rtsis rig skar dag bcas slob kyi yod/ dge rgan dang las bzo mi grangs 108yod pa'i nang du ched las dang zhor rtsog dge rgan phal che ba rang skyong ljongs sman rtsis khang nas yin pa dang / lhag par rgyal khab slob gso u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin li'i tha'i dbying gis bod sman slob cher gzigs zhib gnang skabs khyed tshos gang thub kyis bod sman rang gi don dngos la bstun rgyu dang / bod sman gyi khyad chos 'don spel 'os 'tshams kyis phyi lugs gso rig shes bya bslab dgos/ dge rgan thad zhor lcog mang tsam dang ched gnyer zhung tsam byed dgos gsungs pa dang / ljongs sman rtsis khang gi nad khang dang sgo bsten/ sman bzo grwa/ gso rig zhib 'jug khang / gnam rig skar rtsis zhib 'jug khang bcas ni bod sman slob grwa che mo'i dngos sbyong byed yul yin pa dang /de bzhin lho kha dang / gzhis rtse/ nag chu bcas kyi sman rtsis khang yang bod sman slob grwa che 'bring gi slob ma tsho'i dngos sbyong byed yul gyi gnas su gyur yod/gong gsal bod sman slob grwa che mo'i khongs kyi slob che pu'u dang / ched las 'bring rim pu'u/ zab sbyong pu'u bcas par rang ljongs phud mtsho sngon dang /5/3

kun su'u/ si khron/ yun nan bcas kyi slob phrug kyang yod/ gzhan yang thabs lam sna tshogs brgyud de bod lugs sman pa 'bor chen gso skyong byas pa'i nang ljongs sman rtsis khang gcig pus da bar bod sman zab sbyong 'dzin grwa dang / gso skyong sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa btsugs par mi grangs 300lhag tsam yod pa de'i nang shin cang dang / nang sog gi sman pa'ang yod/ ljongs sman rtsis khang gis bod sman 'bring rim ched las dang / bod sman slob che'i dngos slob rnams la snga phyir dngos sbyong gi slob khrid dang / nad thog lag len/sman sbyor byed stangs sogs mdor na gzhung dang lag len zung 'brel byed rgyu dang / slob khrid dang / mthong brgyud zab khrid byed rgyu'i khyad chos 'don spel byas stabs slob ma'i sbyangs 'bras la phan skyed chen po byung song /de min gzhis rtse dang / lho kha/ mnga' ris dang / chab mdo/ lha sa bcas kyi sa gnas sman rtsis khang dang 'phrod bsten cus kyis kyang snga phyir bod sman 'dzin grwa khag 'ga' shas btsugs te khyon bsdoms mi grangs /8/ tsam slob grwa thon pa dang / spyi lo 1990lo nas bzung su'e tsel lan gyi rgya gram dmar po'i tshogs pa dang / bod la rogs skyor byed pa'i thebs rtsa lhan tshogs/de bzhin rgyal khongs phyi rgyal ba yin pa'i mi sna'i rogs skyor 'og khag so sor slob yun lo drug yin pa'i gzhis rtse spen gzhung bod lugs gso rig slob grwa dang / lho kha srong btsan bod sman slob grwa/ mnga' ris gangs dkar ti si bod lugs gso rig slob grwa bcas gsar 'dzugs byas shing / slob grwa de tshos slob khrid byed stangs dang nang don thad zhing 'brog sa khul gyi don dngos kyi gnas tshul dang 'brel ba dam zab byas te/ zhing 'brog sa khul du gnas sdod thub pa dang / bed spyod thub pa ma zad/ zhing 'brog khul du gzhis chags 514

thub pa'i dmangs khrod kyi bod lugs gso rig mi sna gso skyong bcas byed pa'i thad bgrod lam gsar pa zhig gtod pa red/ da dung rgyal khab mi don pu'u dang / 'phrod bsten pu'u/ rgyal khab krung lugs gso rig do dam cus bcas nas dge rgan gyis dge phrug khrid dgos pa'i 'bod skul ltar rang ljongs su sngon la dge phrug mi bcu khrid zin pa dang thengs gnyis pa'i khongs su slar yang mi bcu khrid pa rnams 'di lor mjug 'gril rgyu yin pa des kyang da bzhugs mkhas dbang rnam pa'i gzhung dang lag len phun sum tshogs pa rnams mu mthud rgyud 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur dgos pa rlabs chen ldan yod/lhag par 1988lor lha sa grong khyer 'phrod bsten slob grwa nas dmangs khrod kyi phyi lugs gso rig shes pa'i sman pa khag cig la lo gnyis ring bod sman gyi shes bya slob pa'i 'dzin grwa zhig btsugs te khong tshos phyogs gcig nas phyi lugs gso rig gi shes bya shes pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod sman gyi shes bya shes pa des phyi lugs dang bod sman zung 'brel gyis sman bcos byed thub par mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu chen po byed bzhin 'dug deng gi char bod kyi sa gnas khag tu rim pa gsum gyi sman bcos dra ba'i nang bod sman gyis sngon 'gog dang bde srung bya bar rang nus legs skyes 'bul bzhin yod la/ bod kyi 'phrod bsten bya gzhag nang bod sman ni med du mi rung ba'i stobs shugs shig yin/515

bzhi/ shes ldan mi sna skul slong byas nas tshan rig zhib 'jug las gar shugs snon chen po thebs pa/spyir bod kyi gso rig dang / sman rdzas rig pa/ gnam rig skar rtsis rig pa gang zhig yin rung sngon gyi mkhas dbang du mas dka' ba mang po spyad de phyi rabs rnams la thugs brtse chen pos brgyud spyod dang yig 'jog mdzad pa de ni nga tshos tshan rig zhib 'jug byed rgyur lta bas chog mi shes pa dang /mthong bas ngoms pa med pa/ spyad na 'dzad mtha' med pa zhig yin/ lo ngo lnga bcu'i ring tang gi me tog mnyam bzhad dang / mkhas brgya 'gran gleng /mi rigs srid jus bcas kyi mdzub khrid 'og bod lugs gso rig gi sgrig gzhi sngar las 'thus tshang dang / dpung khag rgyun chad med par rgya cher phyin pa'i khar sman rtsis rig gnas myur skyob dang rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i 'bras bur rang res blo bde bag phebs ngang tshan rig zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i las ka 'go tshugs thub pa byung / lo rabs drug cu pa'i dkyil nas bod sman dang krung dbyi'i phyi lugs gso rig bcas zung du 'brel ba'i 'go thog mar btod pa dang / bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su dbu brnyes skabs legs skyes 'bul ched 〈 bod kyi gso rig sman rdzas la rtog zhib rags tsam byas pa〉zhes pa de par du btab/de rjes sman khang nang gzhung lugs lag rtsal la brtson zhib dang / rang rang gi myong byang zin bris su bkod de nyams myong spel res kyi byed sgo 'khrug shos shig byung ba de'i nang mkhas dbang yon krang sku gzhon kun dga' phun tshogs dang / 516

mkhas dbang yon krang sku gzhon ngag dbang chos grags/ bud med sman pa mkhas can dbya/ ri can lha mo/ lcags ri 'gro phan gling gi mkhas dbang dge rgan thub bstan tshe reng / sman rtsis mkhas can ye shes chos 'phel/nga sman pa mkhas can 'gyur med chos dbang / chu bcos mkhas can yon tan tshul khrims bcas pas cham nad dang / pho ba'i nad/ mo nad/ mkhal nad/grib skyon/ 'bam nad/ dmu chu'i nad rigs bcos pa'i nyams myong ngo sprod gnang bar phan 'bras bzang po thon byung / de'i phyi lo 1966lo'i lo 'gor lho kha smin grol gling gi mkhan po mkhyen brtse nor bu sman khang du gdan zhus kyis smin gling rdo 'dzin gyi phyag bzhes dmu chu'i gsang sman ngos 'dzin skor la slob khrid dbu tshugs gnang rung mi ring bar rig gnas gsar brje'i shugs rkyen gyis lam lhongs ma byung bar mkhyen brtse nor bu rin po che sku gshegs pa sogs kyi tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las ka bar mtshams chad/ de nas lo rabs bdun cu'i nang bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug tsu'u zhes pa btsugs te sman pa rgan gras grags can 'ga' shas dang / dar ma gzhon skyes khag gcig mnyam du gso rig 〈 rgyud bzhi〉gtso bor byas te rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang /nad thog lag len skor la zhib 'jug byed 'go tshugs te rim bzhin 〈 bod sman gsar sgrig skya rengs gsar pa〉zhes pa'i dpe deb dang / 〈rkang rjen sman pa'i sbyor sde gsar bsgrig〉ces pa/ 〈 rgyun spyod bod sman gyi lag deb〉ces pa sogs rtsom 'bri dang / dpe skrun byas/ nad thog sman bcos skor la 〈 bod sman gyis pho ba'i bad kun smug po dang long smug po'i nad gzhir sman bcos byas pa'i myong tshor 〉zhes pa 'di ni phyi lugs glog par brgyab nas phan skyed ji byung gi ra sprod yod pas bod phyi zung 'brel gyis nad thog zhib 'jug 517

byed thengs dang po'i myong rtsom yin//977lor bod kyi sman sbyor nang nas mang tshogs kyis spyod go bde zhing /phan nus che ba'i gras te zla shel bdud rtsi ma dang / a gar /6 'khrul thang bcas krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi sman mdzod deb nang tshud//978lor bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ kun su'u/ yun nan/ si khron/shin cang bcas sa khul drug po mnyam sgril thog rang rgyal gyi thengs dang po'i khrims srol ldan pa'i sman dpe 〈 bod sman gyi sa gnas tshad gzhi〉dpe bskrun byas/ /979lor krung go'i gso rig kun 'dus kyi nang tshan 〈 bod kyi gso ba rig pa〉zhes pa bod ljongs gtso bor byas te mtsho sngon dang kun su'u sogs kyis mnyam las byed rgyur krung dbyang 'phrod bsten pu'us las 'gan gnang ba de dag snga lo legs sgrub byas pa/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun gnang zin par khyon bsdoms yig 'bru lnga 'bum skor yod/ dpe deb de ni bod lugs gso rig ngos nas bshad na gzhi rgya che la nang don cha tshang ba'i dpe deb cig dang / phyin chad bod lugs gso rig dpe deb nang nas dbang grags che shos dang / ha cang tshad ldan gyi cha 'jog yong nges yin//985lo nas 'go btsugs te bod sman slob grwa che mo'i slob deb kyi nang tshan 〈 gso rig rgyud bzhi'i sdong 'grems 'dod 'byung nor bu'i mdzod〉ces pa rtsom sgrig byas par kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma dang / phyag dam 'khod pa bka' drin du bstsal nas /987lor yongs su grub ste pe cing mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun rogs ram gnang / de bzhin bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ kun su'u/ si khron bcas kyis bod sman 'bring rim ched las rmi slob deb rnam grangs /2gsar sgrig gis deng skabs 5/8

gcig gyur thog bed spyod gtong rgyu byung yod/'byung 'gyur bod kyi gso rig dang phyi lugs gso rig zung 'brel gyis tshan rig zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i ched du nga tshos bod phyi zung 'brel gyi cosgo nas nad rtags sman bcos byed pa'i 'go tshugs shing / dang thog nga tshos bdams pa ni pho rub kyi nad de yin pa dang / gal te bcos dus yol tshe mtha' mar pho ba'i 'bras skran nad la gyur te bcos thabs dka' bar brten bod sman gyis nad der phan pa yod pa shes rjes tshan pa gzhan dang mnyam du zhib 'jug lo gsum lhag tsam byas par phan 'bras yag po byung ste krung dbyang 'phrod bsten pu'u yis sngon thon tshan rig grub 'bras kyi ming thog nas bya dga' rim pa gsum pa gnang ba dang / de ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog 'phrod bsten 'thab phyogs la ches mtho'i bya dga' thob thengs dang po red 'dug de rjes 1989lor 'bu phra'i rang bzhin gyi bshal rims zhib 'jug byas pa dang /thabs shes ni phyi lugs kyi brtag dpyad dang bod sman gyis bcos ka byas par phan nus 94sko thon pa shes rtogs byung khar/ de sngon bod sman gyis dza drag nad gzhir thabs shes med pa'i ngos 'dzin la 'gyur ldog thub bo// gzhan yang hwa shis gso rig slob grwa che ba'i sman rdzas slob grwa che mo dang mnyam las kyis sro lo dmar po zhes pa'i sngo sman dang / phyag rdor rtag ngu zhes pa'i sngo sman gnyis la rgas ka sra ba dang / sa mtho'i gso rlung mi ldeng bar phan skyed yag po yod pa ra sprod byung / yang bod sman sbyor tshad sne kha bcu gcig so sor gnyan kha gcog pa dang / nad 'bu 'gog pa'i zhib 'jug rags tsam byas par phan 'bras legs po yod pa shes byung / tshang mas shes gsal ltar rin chen rarna bsam 'phel dang / grang sbyor/ mang sbyor/ btso bkru zla shel bcas ni rtsa 5/9

gis do dam byed rgyur shugs snon rgyag ched du rang ljongs su snga rjes la 〈 bod lugs gso rig sman khang la rim pa dbye nas do dam byed pa'i tshad gzhi〉dang /〈 rgyal yongs kyi bod lugs gso rig sman khang gi las na'i srol yig〉 〈 bod lugs gso rig gi tshad ldan nad deb 'bri stangs〉 〈 bod lugs gso rig gi nad skyong pas bkol spyod byed pa'i sgrig srol〉sogs dngos su bton pas sgrig srol lam lugs khag dang las gnas kyi 'gan 'khri khag rim bzhin 'thus sgo tshang du phyin zhing rim pa dbye nas do dam byed pa'i dmigs tshad la slebs pa'i byed sgo spel ba dang phyogs bsdus dmigs tshad la do dam byed pa'i 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs rim bzhin lag bltar byas par brten bod lugs gso rig sman khang la deng rabs can gyis do dam byed pa'i bgrod lam thog bskyod bzhin yod/ bod lugs gso rig dang gnam rig skar rtsis gnyis ha cang 'brel ba dam zab yod cing / lo rgyus thog de gnyis zung 'brel gyis yul lung yar rgyas dang / thon skyed gong 'phel/ lus khams bde srung bcas par legs skyes chen po phul yod/ sngon chad dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas gong la skar nag rtsis kyi rig par ched btsugs kyi sde tshan gsum las med pa sde stod lung mtshur phu dgon dang / lho kha smin grol gling / lha sa sman rtsis khang bcas yin/ da lta ljongs sman rtsis khang tsam ma zad gzhis rtse dang / lho kha/ nag chu/ mnga' ris/ chab mdo bcas kyi sa gnas dang / de bzhin sog rdzong dang / sbra chen/ go 'jo rdzong bcas par lo tho rtsom 'bri tshogs chung dang bla mkhyen mi nyung ba yod/ lhag par 198/ lor bod ljongs gnam rig skar rtsis rig gzhung slob tshogs dbu brnyes pa dang / de nas bzung da bar lo tshogs thengs brgyad 'tshogs shing / snga phyir rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus 52/

tshogs rgyun ud kyi u yon krang sku gzhon pa kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog gis mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang / gal che'i bka' slob gnang bas bod kyi skar rtsis rig gzhung dar rgyas dang / sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas zhing 'brog thon skyed gong 'phel ched du rang nus gang yod legs skyes su 'bul rgyu'i chod sems che ru phyin song /nye ba'i lo bcu'i ring gnam rig skar rtsis rig gzhung tshogs pas mkhas dbang tshe brtan zhabs drung dang / dmu dge bsam gtan/ bsam grub rgya mtsho/ smad sog badzra/ 'jigs med/ shes rab chos 'phel/ bsam gtan/'gos klu sgrub sogs gdan zhus kyis phan tshun nyams myong spel res gnang ba dang / da dung krung go tshan rig khang rang byung tshan rig zhib 'jug khang gi mkhas dbang drin ci'u cing dang / lo tsā chen po dang rtsis rig mkhas pa hong min shan/ nan cing rtse cin ri bo'i gnam rig babs tshugs khang gi deng rabs gnam rig skar rtsis mkhas can bi'u spa'o lin sogs bod du gdan zhus thog nyi zla gza' 'dzin sogs tshan rig zhib 'jug khag la grub 'bras gsar pa thob pa ste/ dper na/ rab byung /gcis 'go legs par spos te 〈 rtsis gzhung rig ldan 'dzum pa'i 'od zer〉zhes pa gsar du phyogs sgrig byas par rang skyong ljongs tshan rtsal lhan khang gis grub 'bras rim pa gnyis pa'i bya dga' bstsal/ da dung 〈 bod ljongs gnam rig skar rtsis kyi lo bcu'i phyogs bsdoms〉zhes pa dang / 〈 dus 'khor skar rtsis ji ltar dar ba'i lo rgyus legs bshad nor bu'i phreng mdzes〉 〈 phug lugs rtsis gzhung rigs ldan 'dzum pa'i 'od zer gyi rtsis rig bang mdzod 'byed pa'i ngo sprod rags bsdus kyi lde mig〉 〈 rgya bod rtsis kyi nyi zla 'dzin tshul dang / lnga sgra/ gza' lnga sogs 522

kyi sa ris rgyab stangs dang / rtsis rgyag 'phrul 'khor zung 'brel gyi rgyu mtshan 'dren pa phug pa'i dgongs rgyan〉sogs rtsom 'bri dang / phyogs mtshungs sngon gyi rtsis gzhung grags can 〈 mkhas pa dga' byed〉dang / 〈 nyin byed snang ba 〉 〈 rnam 'grel gser gyi shing rta〉sogs dpe bskrun byas pa/ yang sgos ljongs sman rtsis khang gnam rig skar rtsis zhib 'jug khang gis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i lo re'i lo tho 'di nyid zhing 'brog thon skyed la med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa dang / lo re'i dpe skrun byed tshad nyis 'bum lhag tsam lon gyi yod pa de ni spyi tshogs kyi phan 'bras dngos rjen zhig yin la bod ljongs brnyan 'phrin las khungs dang / rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags gnyis nas nyin re'i gnam gshis sngon brda brgyud gtong byas par zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu ci che thob/ lhag par kho bos gtso 'gan rtsom sgrig pa'i 'gan 'khur ba'i 〈bod ljongs gnam rig skar rtsis kun 'dus chen mo〉zhes par yig 'bru khri drug brgya lhag zin yod pa dang / dpe tshogs 'di la nang gses su bod kyi skar nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus skor dang / bstan rtsis kyi skor/ skar rtsis kyi skor/skar rtsis la nye bar mkho ba'i re'u mig skor/ nag rtsis kyi skor bcas deb tshogs lnga yod pa de ni lo rgyus thog gzhi rgya che shos dang nang don gting zab shos/ dpyad gzhi blos 'khel shos zhig yin pa'i dpe deb mdzes bkod legs pa dang rgyu cha spus dag yin par rgyal yongs dpe deb kyi 'grems ston bya dga' ang dang po thob pa ma zad/ spyi lo 1999lor bod ljongs tshan rig lag rtsal mdun skyod kyi bya dga' ang dang po thob yod/de ltar bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo ngo lnga bcu'i ring la bod kyi sman rtsis rig gnas myur skyob dang / rgyud 'dzin gyi rmang gzhi'i thog 'phel 523

rgyas ji ltar byung tshul dang / de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo tang dang srid gzhung gi dbu khrid yang dag pa dang / byams brtse'i thugs khur/ lhag par krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus spyi dang / bye brag smre rigs srid jus/ shes yon can gyi srid jus sogs lag bstar don 'khyol byung ba'i 'bras bu yin pa gtso gnad kyis mtshams sbyor zhus yod/524
